a.example: I saw a small dog in the park near my house yesterday.
a.exampleZh: 昨天我在我家附近的公园里看到一只小狗。

abandon.example: They had to abandon the old car by the road.
abandon.exampleZh: 他们不得不把那辆旧车丢弃在路边。

abate.example: The heavy rain began to abate after midnight, and the streets slowly became safe again.
abate.exampleZh: 午夜过后，大雨开始减弱，街道慢慢又变得安全了。

abbey.example: The old abbey stands quietly on the hill near the river.
abbey.exampleZh: 这座古老的修道院静静地坐落在河边的山上。

abbreviate.example: Please abbreviate the long word so it fits on the form.
abbreviate.exampleZh: 请把这个长单词缩写，以便它能填进表格里。

abbreviation.example: The abbreviation UN stands for the United Nations.
abbreviation.exampleZh: 缩写 UN 代表联合国。

abdicate.example: The old king decided to abdicate and let his son rule the country.
abdicate.exampleZh: 老国王决定退位，让他的儿子统治国家。

abdomen.example: The doctor pressed gently on his abdomen to check for any pain.
abdomen.exampleZh: 医生轻轻按压他的腹部，检查是否有疼痛。

abduct.example: The man tried to abduct a child from the park yesterday.
abduct.exampleZh: 那名男子昨天试图从公园里诱拐一名儿童。

aberrant.example: The doctor said the test showed an aberrant result and asked for a second test.
aberrant.exampleZh: 医生说这项检查结果显示异常，要求再做一次检查。

abet.example: He was arrested for helping to abet the crime.
abet.exampleZh: 他因协助教唆犯罪而被逮捕。

abhor.example: Most people abhor cruelty to animals and want stronger laws.
abhor.exampleZh: 大多数人都痛恨虐待动物，希望有更严格的法律。

abide.example: We must abide by the school rules even when no one is watching.
abide.exampleZh: 即使没有人看着，我们也必须遵守校规。

ability.example: She has the ability to solve difficult problems quickly.
ability.exampleZh: 她有快速解决难题的能力。

abject.example: The abject poverty in that village shocked the young doctor.
abject.exampleZh: 那个村庄的极度贫困让这位年轻医生感到震惊。

abnegation.example: Her abnegation of comfort surprised everyone who knew her well.
abnegation.exampleZh: 她对舒适的放弃让所有熟悉她的人感到惊讶。

abnormal.example: It is abnormal for him to be late for work.
abnormal.exampleZh: 他上班迟到是不正常的。

aboard.example: All the passengers were safely aboard the plane before it took off.
aboard.exampleZh: 飞机起飞前，所有乘客都已安全登机。

abode.example: They moved to a small abode near the river last year.
abode.exampleZh: 他们去年搬到了河边一处小小的住所。

abolish.example: Many people want to abolish the old rule because it is unfair.
abolish.exampleZh: 许多人想要废除这条旧规定，因为它不公平。

abortion.example: She was too poor to raise another child, so she chose an abortion.
abortion.exampleZh: 她太穷了，养不起另一个孩子，所以选择了堕胎。

abound.example: Fish abound in this clear river near our small village.
abound.exampleZh: 在我们小村庄附近的这条清澈河流里，鱼很多。

about.example: The children ran about the garden while we talked about the weather.
about.exampleZh: 我们在谈论天气的时候，孩子们在花园里到处跑。

above.example: The bird is flying above the tall trees in the park.
above.exampleZh: 那只鸟在公园里高高的树木上方飞翔。

abroad.example: My sister wants to study abroad next year after she finishes school.
abroad.exampleZh: 我姐姐想在明年完成学业后去国外留学。

abrogate.example: The new leader decided to abrogate the old law last year.
abrogate.exampleZh: 新领导人去年决定废除那项旧法律。

abrupt.example: The road came to an abrupt end near the river.
abrupt.exampleZh: 这条路在河边突然到了尽头。

abscess.example: The doctor said the abscess on his leg would need to be treated soon.
abscess.exampleZh: 医生说，他腿上的脓肿需要尽快处理。

abscond.example: The thief absconded with the money before the police arrived.
abscond.exampleZh: 小偷在警察到来之前带着钱潜逃了。

absence.example: His absence from the meeting made everyone wonder where he was.
absence.exampleZh: 他缺席会议让大家都不知道他去了哪里。

absent.example: Three students were absent from class today because of the heavy rain.
absent.exampleZh: 因为大雨，今天有三名学生缺席了课程。

absolute.example: The king had absolute power over everyone in the country.
absolute.exampleZh: 国王对这个国家的每个人都有绝对的权力。

absolve.example: The judge decided to absolve him of all charges.
absolve.exampleZh: 法官决定宣布他所有罪名不成立。

absorb.example: Plants absorb water from the soil through their roots.
absorb.exampleZh: 植物通过根部从土壤中吸收水分。

abstain.example: I will abstain from sugar for one month.

abstract.example: Her abstract ideas are hard for young students to understand.
abstract.exampleZh: 她的抽象观点对年轻学生来说很难理解。

abstruse.example: This old book is too abstruse for most young readers to enjoy.
abstruse.exampleZh: 这本旧书太深奥了，大多数年轻读者读不下去。

absurd.example: It is absurd to blame the weather for our own mistakes.
absurd.exampleZh: 把我们的错误归咎于天气是荒谬的。

abundance.example: There is an abundance of fresh fruit on the farm in summer.
abundance.exampleZh: 夏天农场上有大量新鲜水果。

abundant.example: The small garden has abundant water and sunlight all summer.
abundant.exampleZh: 这个小花园整个夏天都有充足的水和阳光。

abuse.example: Parents should not abuse their power over young children.
abuse.exampleZh: 父母不应该滥用对年幼孩子的权力。

abut.example: The new library abuts the old town hall on the main street.
abut.exampleZh: 新图书馆紧靠主街上的旧市政厅。

academic.example: My academic work is hard, but I like my teachers.
academic.exampleZh: 我的学业很难，但我喜欢我的老师们。

academy.example: She studies music at a famous academy in London.
academy.exampleZh: 她在伦敦一所著名的学院学习音乐。

accede.example: The manager finally acceded to our request for a shorter meeting.
accede.exampleZh: 经理最终同意了我们将会议缩短的请求。

accelerate.example: The new machines help the workers accelerate the whole production process.
accelerate.exampleZh: 新机器帮助工人们加快了整个生产流程。

accent.example: She spoke English with a slight French accent and smiled.
accent.exampleZh: 她带着一点法国口音说英语，并且笑了。

accept.example: She decided to accept the new job offer after thinking about it.
accept.exampleZh: 她考虑之后决定接受这份新工作的录用。

access.example: You need a password to get access to the computer room.
access.exampleZh: 你需要密码才能进入机房。

accident.example: He had a small accident on his bike but was not hurt.
accident.exampleZh: 他骑自行车时出了个小事故，但没有受伤。

acclaim.example: The new film won great acclaim from critics and viewers alike.
acclaim.exampleZh: 这部新电影赢得了影评人和观众的一致称赞。

acclimate.example: It took me a week to acclimate to the cold weather here.
acclimate.exampleZh: 我花了一周时间才适应这里寒冷的天气。

accolade.example: She received a top accolade for her hard work at school.
accolade.exampleZh: 她因在学校的努力表现而获得了一项最高荣誉。

accommodate.example: The hotel can accommodate up to two hundred guests during the summer.
accommodate.exampleZh: 这家酒店在夏季最多可容纳两百位客人。

accompany.example: My mother will accompany me to the hospital tomorrow morning.
accompany.exampleZh: 我妈妈明天早上会陪我去医院。

accomplice.example: The police caught the thief and his accomplice near the bank.
accomplice.exampleZh: 警察在银行附近抓住了小偷和他的共犯。

accomplish.example: She worked hard all year and accomplished her goal of learning English.
accomplish.exampleZh: 她努力了一整年，实现了学英语的目标。

accord.example: The two sides finally reached an accord after a long and friendly talk.
accord.exampleZh: 经过长时间友好的商谈，双方终于达成了一致。

accost.example: A strange man tried to accost me on my way home last night.
accost.exampleZh: 昨晚回家路上，一个陌生男人想跟我搭话。

account.example: I opened a bank account and saved money for a new bike.
account.exampleZh: 我开了一个银行账户，存钱买一辆新自行车。

accredit.example: The school was accredited by the national education board last year.
accredit.exampleZh: 这所学校去年获得了国家教育委员会的认证。

accrue.example: Interest will accrue on your savings account every month.
accrue.exampleZh: 你的储蓄账户每个月都会累积利息。

accumulate.example: Over the years, he accumulated a large collection of old books.
accumulate.exampleZh: 多年来，他积累了大量的旧书。

accurate.example: Her report was accurate and easy to understand.
accurate.exampleZh: 她的报告准确且易于理解。

accuse.example: She accused him of taking the money without asking her.
accuse.exampleZh: 她指责他没问过她就拿走了钱。

accustom.example: It takes time to accustom yourself to a new job.
accustom.exampleZh: 适应一份新工作需要时间。

ache.example: My legs ache after the long walk, and I ache to see you.
ache.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后我的腿很疼，我很想见你。

achieve.example: You can achieve your goals if you work hard every day.
achieve.exampleZh: 如果你每天努力，你就能实现你的目标。

acid.example: The acid in lemons makes them taste very sour.
acid.exampleZh: 柠檬里的酸使它们尝起来非常酸。

acknowledge.example: She acknowledged her mistake and said sorry to the whole team.
acknowledge.exampleZh: 她承认了自己的错误，并向整个团队道了歉。

acme.example: Reaching the top of that mountain was the acme of his young career.
acme.exampleZh: 登上那座山的顶峰是他年轻事业中的最高点。

acoustics.example: The acoustics of this old hall are very good for piano music.
acoustics.exampleZh: 这座老礼堂的声学效果对于钢琴音乐来说非常好。

acquaint.example: I will acquaint you with the new rules before you start.
acquaint.exampleZh: 在你开始之前，我会让你熟悉新规则。

acquiesce.example: She did not want to go, but she finally acquiesced to his plan.
acquiesce.exampleZh: 她并不想去，但最后还是勉强同意了他的计划。

acquire.example: Children acquire language skills by listening to their parents and teachers.
acquire.exampleZh: 孩子们通过听父母和老师说话来习得语言技能。

acquisition.example: The company announced the acquisition of a small tech firm last week.
acquisition.exampleZh: 这家公司上周宣布收购了一家小型科技公司。

acquit.example: The court will acquit him if the new evidence is true.
acquit.exampleZh: 如果新证据属实，法庭将宣判他无罪。

acre.example: The farmer owns twenty acres of land near the river.
acre.exampleZh: 这位农民在河边拥有二十英亩土地。

acrid.example: The acrid smoke from the fire made everyone cough and leave the room.
acrid.exampleZh: 火灾产生的刺鼻烟雾让每个人都咳嗽着离开了房间。

acrimonious.example: Their acrimonious argument about money lasted for hours.
acrimonious.exampleZh: 他们关于钱的激烈争吵持续了几个小时。

across.example: The little boy walked across the street to meet his friends.
across.exampleZh: 那个小男孩穿过马路去见他的朋友们。

act.example: We must act now before the problem gets much worse.
act.exampleZh: 我们必须在问题变得更糟之前立即采取行动。

action.example: His quick action saved the little boy from the deep water.
action.exampleZh: 他的迅速行动把那个小男孩从深水中救了出来。

activate.example: Please activate your new bank card before you use it.
activate.exampleZh: 在使用新银行卡之前，请先激活它。

active.example: She is very active in the school music club and loves singing.
active.exampleZh: 她在学校音乐社团里非常活跃，并且喜欢唱歌。

activity.example: Regular physical activity helps children stay healthy and happy at school.
activity.exampleZh: 规律的体育活动有助于孩子在学校保持健康和快乐。

actor.example: The actor learned his lines before the play began.
actor.exampleZh: 演员在戏剧开始前学会了台词。

actual.example: The actual cost was much higher than we expected.
actual.exampleZh: 实际费用比我们预期的要高得多。

actuate.example: Good leaders actuate their teams by trust and clear goals.
actuate.exampleZh: 优秀的领导者通过信任和明确的目标来激励团队。

acute.example: She felt an acute pain in her back after lifting the heavy box.
acute.exampleZh: 她搬起重箱子后，背部感到一阵剧烈的疼痛。

adage.example: My grandmother often repeated an old adage about saving money for a rainy day.
adage.exampleZh: 我奶奶经常重复一句关于未雨绸缪的古老格言。

adapt.example: It takes time to adapt to a new school and make friends.
adapt.exampleZh: 适应新学校并交到朋友需要时间。

adaptation.example: The film adaptation of the novel was very popular with young readers.
adaptation.exampleZh: 这部小说的电影改编版在年轻读者中很受欢迎。

add.example: Please add some milk to my coffee before it gets cold.
add.exampleZh: 请在我的咖啡变凉之前加点牛奶。

addict.example: My brother is an addict and plays video games every night.
addict.exampleZh: 我弟弟是个上瘾者，每天晚上都玩电子游戏。

addition.example: In addition, we need more time and money for this project.
addition.exampleZh: 此外，我们这个项目还需要更多的时间和金钱。

address.example: Please write your address on this form and give it to me.
address.exampleZh: 请把你的地址写在这张表格上，然后交给我。

adequate.example: The small room is adequate for one person but not for two.
adequate.exampleZh: 这个小房间对一个人来说够用，但两个人就不够了。

adhere.example: Good students adhere to a simple study plan every day.
adhere.exampleZh: 好学生每天都坚持执行简单的学习计划。

adjacent.example: Our new house is adjacent to a small park and a school.
adjacent.exampleZh: 我们的新房子毗邻一个小公园和一所学校。

adjective.example: In this sentence, the word happy is an adjective.
adjective.exampleZh: 在这个句子里，happy 这个词是形容词。

adjoin.example: Our small garden adjoins the park, so we often walk there.
adjoin.exampleZh: 我们的小花园紧邻公园，所以我们常去那里散步。

adjourn.example: The judge decided to adjourn the meeting until next Monday morning.
adjourn.exampleZh: 法官决定将会议延期到下周一上午。

adjunct.example: In this job, a good computer is a useful adjunct to hard work.
adjunct.exampleZh: 在这份工作中，一台好电脑是努力工作的一项有用辅助。

adjust.example: You can adjust the chair height to make it more comfortable.
adjust.exampleZh: 你可以调节椅子的高度，让它更舒适。

administer.example: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient this morning.
administer.exampleZh: 护士今天上午会给病人服药。

administration.example: The new manager has years of experience in hospital administration.
administration.exampleZh: 这位新经理在医院行政管理方面有多年经验。

admire.example: I admire her courage and kindness.
admire.exampleZh: 我钦佩她的勇气和善良。

admission.example: The admission to the museum is free for students and children.
admission.exampleZh: 学生和儿童进博物馆是免费的。

admit.example: She admitted that she had made a mistake in the report.
admit.exampleZh: 她承认自己在报告里犯了一个错误。

admonish.example: The teacher admonished the students for talking loudly during the exam.
admonish.exampleZh: 老师告诫学生们不要在考试时大声讲话。

adolescent.example: Many adolescent boys and girls need more sleep than adults do.
adolescent.exampleZh: 许多青少年男孩和女孩比成年人需要更多的睡眠。

adopt.example: The company decided to adopt a new plan for the coming year.
adopt.exampleZh: 公司决定在来年采用一项新计划。

adore.example: Many young fans adore the singer and travel to every concert.
adore.exampleZh: 许多年轻粉丝崇拜这位歌手，并会赶赴每一场演唱会。

adorn.example: She used fresh flowers to adorn the small table before the guests arrived.
adorn.exampleZh: 客人到来之前，她用鲜花装饰了那张小桌子。

adult.example: Every adult should know how to take care of themselves.
adult.exampleZh: 每个成年人都应该知道如何照顾自己。

advance.example: The team will advance the plan by one week.
advance.exampleZh: 团队将把计划提前一周。

advantage.example: One big advantage of living near the office is the short walk to work.
advantage.exampleZh: 住在办公室附近的一大好处是走路上班很近。

advent.example: The advent of the internet changed how people learn and work.
advent.exampleZh: 互联网的出现改变了人们学习和工作的方式。

adventure.example: Our trip to the mountains turned into a real adventure.
adventure.exampleZh: 我们的山区之行变成了一次真正的冒险。

adversary.example: He is a strong adversary, but I still respect him.
adversary.exampleZh: 他是一个强大的对手，但我仍然尊重他。

adverse.example: The bad weather had an adverse effect on the small team's travel plans.
adverse.exampleZh: 恶劣天气对这个小组的出行计划产生了不利影响。

advertise.example: They advertise their new phones on TV every night.
advertise.exampleZh: 他们每天晚上在电视上为他们的新手机做广告。

advice.example: My teacher gave me good advice about how to study English.
advice.exampleZh: 老师给了我关于如何学英语的好建议。

advise.example: I advise you to see a doctor if the pain gets worse.
advise.exampleZh: 我建议你如果疼痛加重就去看医生。

advocate.example: Many doctors advocate eating more vegetables and less sugar.
advocate.exampleZh: 许多医生提倡多吃蔬菜、少吃糖。

aerial.example: The bird made a fast aerial dive to catch a fish.
aerial.exampleZh: 那只鸟从空中快速俯冲下来抓鱼。

aesthetic.example: The new library has a clean aesthetic design that students enjoy.
aesthetic.exampleZh: 新图书馆有着简洁的美学设计，学生们很喜欢。

affair.example: The party was a small family affair with good food.
affair.exampleZh: 这次聚会是一次小小的家庭活动，还有美味的食物。

affect.example: The bad weather will affect our plans for the school trip.
affect.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气会影响我们学校旅行的计划。

affection.example: She still feels deep affection for her old dog and never forgets him.
affection.exampleZh: 她对那只老狗仍怀有深厚的感情，从未忘记它。

affiliate.example: Our small club is an affiliate of the national sports association.
affiliate.exampleZh: 我们这个小俱乐部是全国体育协会的附属机构。

affinity.example: She felt a natural affinity with the children in her class.
affinity.exampleZh: 她对自己班上的孩子们有一种天然的亲和力。

affirm.example: She affirmed that the plan was safe and ready to start.
affirm.exampleZh: 她确认该计划安全且可以开始。

afflict.example: The long illness afflicted him with great pain and sadness.
afflict.exampleZh: 这场漫长的疾病使他痛苦不堪、十分悲伤。

afford.example: Many young people cannot afford to buy a house in big cities.
afford.exampleZh: 很多年轻人在大城市买不起房子。

after.example: We went home after the movie ended.
after.exampleZh: 电影结束后我们就回家了。

aftermath.example: In the aftermath of the storm, many families lost their homes.
aftermath.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，许多家庭失去了家园。

afterward.example: We had dinner and afterward went for a long walk in the park.
afterward.exampleZh: 我们吃了晚饭，随后去公园里散步了很久。

again.example: Please say that again because I did not hear you.
again.exampleZh: 请再说一遍，因为我没听见你说话。

against.example: Many people voted against the new plan because it cost too much.
against.exampleZh: 许多人投票反对这个新计划，因为它花费太多。

age.example: He started to age quickly after he stopped exercising every day.
age.exampleZh: 他每天停止锻炼之后，开始很快变老。

agency.example: She works for a small travel agency in the city center.
agency.exampleZh: 她在市中心一家小型旅行社工作。

agenda.example: The manager put the new plan on the agenda for tomorrow's meeting.
agenda.exampleZh: 经理把这项新计划列入了明天会议的议程。

agent.example: The agent showed us the new house near the park.
agent.exampleZh: 这位代理人带我们看了公园附近的新房子。

aggravate.example: Don't shout at him, because it will only aggravate the problem.
aggravate.exampleZh: 别对他大喊大叫，因为那只会让问题更严重。

aggregate.example: The aggregate cost of the three tickets is fifty dollars in total.
aggregate.exampleZh: 三张票的合计费用总共是五十美元。

aggressive.example: His aggressive behavior at the meeting surprised all of us.
aggressive.exampleZh: 他在会议上的好斗行为让我们所有人都很吃惊。

agitate.example: The loud noise began to agitate the baby and she cried.
agitate.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音开始让婴儿不安，她哭了起来。

ago.example: I moved to this city three years ago.
ago.exampleZh: 我三年前搬到了这座城市。

agony.example: He was in great agony after the accident and could not stand up.
agony.exampleZh: 事故之后他极度痛苦，站都站不起来。

agree.example: I agree with you on this plan.
agree.exampleZh: 我同意你对这个计划的看法。

agreement.example: After a long talk, they finally reached an agreement on the plan.
agreement.exampleZh: 经过长时间讨论，他们终于就这个计划达成了一致。

agriculture.example: My grandfather works in agriculture and grows rice and vegetables on his farm.
agriculture.exampleZh: 我祖父从事农业，在他的农场上种植水稻和蔬菜。

ahead.example: She walked ahead of us to show the way to the station.
ahead.exampleZh: 她走在我们前面，给我们指去车站的路。

aid.example: She gave me some aid when I was in trouble.
aid.exampleZh: 我遇到困难时，她给了我一些帮助。

ailment.example: He stayed home from work because of a minor ailment.
ailment.exampleZh: 他因为一点小病而没去上班。

aim.example: Our aim is to help students learn English well.
aim.exampleZh: 我们的目标是帮助学生学好英语。

air.example: The air in the mountains is fresh, and wet clothes dry quickly there.
air.exampleZh: 山里的空气很清新，湿衣服在那里也干得快。

aircraft.example: The aircraft landed safely at the airport after a long flight.
aircraft.exampleZh: 这架飞机在长时间飞行后安全降落在机场。

airline.example: My father works for an airline and often flies to other countries.
airline.exampleZh: 我父亲在一家航空公司工作，经常飞往其他国家。

airport.example: We need to leave for the airport very early tomorrow morning.
airport.exampleZh: 我们明天一早就要出发去机场。

aisle.example: Please keep your bags out of the aisle so people can walk through.
aisle.exampleZh: 请把你的包放在过道外，这样人们才能走过去。

alarm.example: The loud alarm woke me up at six this morning.
alarm.exampleZh: 响亮的闹钟今天早上六点把我叫醒了。

album.example: She put the old family photos into a new album.
album.exampleZh: 她把旧的家庭照片放进了一个新相册里。

alchemy.example: Ancient people believed alchemy could turn cheap metals into gold.
alchemy.exampleZh: 古人相信炼金术能把廉价金属变成黄金。

alcohol.example: Too much alcohol is bad for your health and your sleep.
alcohol.exampleZh: 过量饮酒对你的健康和睡眠都有害。

alert.example: The guard stayed alert all night and heard every small sound.
alert.exampleZh: 警卫整夜保持警觉，听到了每一个细微的声音。

alias.example: Everyone knows him by his alias, but few people know his real name.
alias.exampleZh: 大家都只知道他的别名，很少有人知道他的真实姓名。

alien.example: The alien visitor asked us many simple questions about life on Earth.
alien.exampleZh: 这位外星访客问了我们许多关于地球生活的简单问题。

alienate.example: His constant criticism began to alienate his closest friends and coworkers.
alienate.exampleZh: 他不断的批评开始使他最亲近的朋友和同事疏远。

align.example: Please align the chairs in a straight row before the guests arrive.
align.exampleZh: 请在客人到来之前把椅子排成一条直线。

alike.example: The two sisters look so alike that people often think they are twins.
alike.exampleZh: 这两姐妹长得太像了，人们常常以为她们是双胞胎。

alive.example: The old tree is still alive after the long cold winter.
alive.exampleZh: 经过漫长的寒冬，那棵老树依然活着。

all.example: All the students in my class like this new teacher.
all.exampleZh: 我班上的所有学生都喜欢这位新老师。

allege.example: The police allege that he stole the money from the shop.
allege.exampleZh: 警方声称他从商店里偷了钱。

allegiance.example: The soldiers gave their allegiance to the new king.
allegiance.exampleZh: 士兵们对新国王宣誓效忠。

allergic.example: My brother is allergic to cats, so we never keep a pet.
allergic.exampleZh: 我弟弟对猫过敏，所以我们从不养宠物。

allergy.example: My sister has an allergy to peanuts, so she avoids all nuts.
allergy.exampleZh: 我妹妹对花生过敏，所以她避免吃所有坚果。

alleviate.example: The doctor gave her some medicine to alleviate the pain in her back.
alleviate.exampleZh: 医生给她一些药来减轻她背部的疼痛。

alley.example: We walked through a narrow alley to reach the busy market street.
alley.exampleZh: 我们穿过一条狭窄的小巷，来到了繁忙的市场街。

alliance.example: The two small countries formed an alliance to protect each other.
alliance.exampleZh: 这两个小国结成联盟以互相保护。

allocate.example: The school will allocate more money to buy new books for the library.
allocate.exampleZh: 学校将拨出更多钱为图书馆购买新书。

allot.example: The teacher will allot ten minutes for each student to speak.
allot.exampleZh: 老师将给每个学生分配十分钟的发言时间。

allow.example: My parents allow me to play outside after I finish my homework.
allow.exampleZh: 我父母允许我做完作业后到外面玩。

allowance.example: My monthly allowance is small, so I save part of it.
allowance.exampleZh: 我每月的津贴不多，所以我把其中一部分存起来。

alloy.example: The factory mixes copper and zinc to make a strong alloy.
alloy.exampleZh: 工厂把铜和锌混合起来制成一种坚固的合金。

ally.example: The small country became a strong ally of its powerful neighbor.
ally.exampleZh: 这个小国成了它强大邻国的坚强盟友。

almond.example: My mother puts almonds in the cake she bakes every Sunday.
almond.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个周日烤蛋糕时都会放杏仁。

almost.example: I almost missed the bus this morning.
almost.exampleZh: 今天早上我差点错过公交车。

alone.example: She lives alone in a small house near the river.
alone.exampleZh: 她独自住在河边的一所小房子里。

along.example: We walked along the river and talked about our school days.
along.exampleZh: 我们沿着河边散步，聊着上学的日子。

alongside.example: She works alongside her sister in a small coffee shop.
alongside.exampleZh: 她在一家小咖啡店和姐姐一起工作。

alphabet.example: Children learn the alphabet before they can read simple books.
alphabet.exampleZh: 孩子们在能读简单的书之前先学字母表。

already.example: She has already finished her homework and gone out to play.
already.exampleZh: 她已经做完作业，出去玩去了。

also.example: She speaks French and also a little Spanish.
also.exampleZh: 她会说法语，也会一点西班牙语。

alter.example: She had to alter her plan when the weather turned bad.
alter.exampleZh: 天气变坏时，她不得不改变计划。

alternate.example: The two teams alternate between attack and defense during the game.
alternate.exampleZh: 比赛中两支队伍在进攻和防守之间交替。

alternative.example: If the train is full, we can take the bus as an alternative.
alternative.exampleZh: 如果火车满员了，我们可以改乘公交车作为替代选择。

although.example: Although it was raining, we still went out for a walk.
although.exampleZh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是出去散步了。

altitude.example: The plane is flying at a high altitude above the mountains.
altitude.exampleZh: 飞机正在山峦上方的高海拔处飞行。

altogether.example: I do not altogether agree with your plan for the trip.
altogether.exampleZh: 我并不完全同意你的旅行计划。

aluminium.example: This window frame is made of aluminium and it feels very light.
aluminium.exampleZh: 这个窗框是铝制的，摸起来很轻。

alumnus.example: The famous alumnus came back to his old school to talk to students.
alumnus.exampleZh: 这位著名的男校友回到母校与学生们交谈。

always.example: She is always happy when she plays with her dog.
always.exampleZh: 她和狗玩耍时总是很开心。

am.example: I am a student and I like to read books.
am.exampleZh: 我是一名学生，我喜欢读书。

amateur.example: He is an amateur photographer and takes pictures on weekends.
amateur.exampleZh: 他是业余摄影爱好者，周末拍照片。

amaze.example: The magic show amazed all the children in the room.
amaze.exampleZh: 这场魔术表演让房间里的所有孩子都感到惊奇。

ambassador.example: The ambassador met the president to talk about peace between the two countries.
ambassador.exampleZh: 大使会见了总统，讨论两国之间的和平问题。

amber.example: The little bug was trapped inside a piece of amber for millions of years.
amber.exampleZh: 那只小虫子被困在一块琥珀里长达数百万年。

ambiguous.example: The teacher's answer was ambiguous, so no one knew what to do next.
ambiguous.exampleZh: 老师的回答模棱两可，所以没人知道接下来该做什么。

ambition.example: Her ambition is to become a doctor and help people in poor villages.
ambition.exampleZh: 她的抱负是成为一名医生，帮助贫困村庄的人们。

ambitious.example: She is an ambitious young woman who wants to start her own company.
ambitious.exampleZh: 她是一个有雄心的年轻女性，想创办自己的公司。

ambulance.example: The ambulance came quickly and took the sick man to the hospital.
ambulance.exampleZh: 救护车很快赶到，把那个病人送到了医院。

ambush.example: The soldiers waited in ambush behind the trees and attacked the enemy.
ambush.exampleZh: 士兵们在树后埋伏，等待并袭击了敌人。

amenable.example: The staff are amenable to change and willing to learn new skills.
amenable.exampleZh: 员工们愿意接受改变，也愿意学习新技能。

amend.example: We will amend the plan after everyone gives their ideas.
amend.exampleZh: 大家提出意见后，我们会修改这个计划。

amenity.example: The hotel has many amenities, including a pool and a gym.
amenity.exampleZh: 这家酒店有许多便利设施，包括游泳池和健身房。

america.example: My uncle moved to America last year and works in a big city.
america.exampleZh: 我叔叔去年搬到了美国，在一座大城市工作。

amino.example: The amino group in this acid helps it dissolve in water.
amino.exampleZh: 这种酸中的氨基帮助它溶于水。

amnesty.example: The government granted amnesty to all political prisoners last year.
amnesty.exampleZh: 去年，政府赦免了所有政治犯。

among.example: She found her keys among the books on the desk.
among.exampleZh: 她在桌上的书堆里找到了她的钥匙。

amount.example: The amount of water in the bottle is enough for one person.
amount.exampleZh: 瓶中的水量足够一个人喝。

ample.example: There is ample time to finish the work before Friday.
ample.exampleZh: 在周五之前有充足的时间完成这项工作。

amplify.example: We can amplify the sound with a bigger speaker.
amplify.exampleZh: 我们可以用更大的音箱来放大声音。

amplitude.example: The amplitude of the sound wave grew larger as the speaker turned up the volume.
amplitude.exampleZh: 随着扬声器音量调大，声波的振幅变得更大。

amputate.example: The doctors had to amputate his leg after the bad accident.
amputate.exampleZh: 那次严重的事故后，医生不得不截掉他的腿。

amuse.example: My funny uncle always amuses the children with his silly stories.
amuse.exampleZh: 我有趣的叔叔总是用他那些傻乎乎的故事逗孩子们开心。

analog.example: This old radio uses an analog signal instead of a digital one.
analog.exampleZh: 这台旧收音机使用模拟信号，而不是数字信号。

analogy.example: The teacher used a simple analogy to explain how the heart works.
analogy.exampleZh: 老师用了一个简单的类比来解释心脏是如何工作的。

analyse.example: We need to analyse the data before making a decision.
analyse.exampleZh: 我们需要在做决定之前分析这些数据。

analysis.example: Our teacher asked us to write a short analysis of the story.
analysis.exampleZh: 老师让我们写一篇关于这个故事的简短分析。

analyst.example: The analyst studied the sales data and wrote a short report.
analyst.exampleZh: 分析师研究了销售数据并写了一份简短报告。

analytical.example: She has an analytical mind and can solve difficult problems quickly.
analytical.exampleZh: 她有一个善于分析的头脑，能很快解决难题。

ancestor.example: My ancestors came from a small village in the south of China.
ancestor.exampleZh: 我的祖先来自中国南方的一个小村庄。

anchor.example: The ship dropped its anchor near the small island before dark.
anchor.exampleZh: 船在天黑前把小岛附近抛下了锚。

ancient.example: We saw many ancient walls and old temples on our trip to China.
ancient.exampleZh: 我们在中国旅行时看到了许多古老的城墙和寺庙。

and.example: Tom and I like to read books after dinner.
and.exampleZh: 汤姆和我喜欢晚饭后读书。

anecdote.example: My grandfather told a funny anecdote about his first day at work.
anecdote.exampleZh: 我祖父讲了一个关于他第一天上班的搞笑趣闻。

angel.example: My little sister says her mother is an angel who always helps her.
angel.exampleZh: 我妹妹说她的妈妈是一位总是帮助她的天使。

anger.example: His anger grew when he saw the broken window.
anger.exampleZh: 当他看到破碎的窗户时，他的怒火更旺了。

angle.example: From this angle, the old house looks much bigger than before.
angle.exampleZh: 从这个角度看，这座老房子比以前大得多。

angry.example: My father was angry when he saw the broken window.
angry.exampleZh: 父亲看到破了的窗户时很生气。

animal.example: The zoo has many kinds of animals from different countries.
animal.exampleZh: 动物园里有许多来自不同国家的动物。

animation.example: The children watched a funny animation about a talking bear.
animation.exampleZh: 孩子们看了一部关于会说话的熊的有趣动画。

ankle.example: I hurt my ankle while playing basketball with my friends yesterday.
ankle.exampleZh: 昨天我和朋友们打篮球时伤了脚踝。

anniversary.example: My parents will celebrate their twentieth wedding anniversary next month.
anniversary.exampleZh: 我父母下个月将庆祝他们的二十周年结婚纪念日。

announce.example: The school will announce the new class list on Monday morning.
announce.exampleZh: 学校将在周一上午公布新的班级名单。

annoy.example: Loud music at night really annoys my neighbors.
annoy.exampleZh: 夜里大声放音乐确实让我的邻居们很恼火。

annual.example: Our school holds an annual sports meeting every October.
annual.exampleZh: 我们学校每年十月举办一次年度运动会。

anonymous.example: The writer sent an anonymous letter to the local newspaper last week.
anonymous.exampleZh: 这位作家上周给当地报社寄了一封匿名信。

another.example: I don't like this book, so please give me another one.
another.exampleZh: 我不喜欢这本书，所以请再给我一本。

answer.example: Please answer my question before you leave the office today.
answer.exampleZh: 请你在今天离开办公室之前回答我的问题。

ant.example: A small ant is carrying a piece of food to its home.
ant.exampleZh: 一只小蚂蚁正把一块食物搬回自己的家。

antagonism.example: There is clear antagonism between the two teams before every big game.
antagonism.exampleZh: 每场重要比赛前，两支球队之间都有明显的对抗情绪。

antarctic.example: The Antarctic is very cold and covered with ice all year.
antarctic.exampleZh: 南极地区非常寒冷，全年都被冰雪覆盖。

antenna.example: The old radio on the shelf still has a broken antenna.
antenna.exampleZh: 架子上那台旧收音机的天线仍然是断的。

antibiotic.example: The doctor gave him an antibiotic for the infection in his chest.
antibiotic.exampleZh: 医生给他开了一种抗生素，用于治疗他胸部的感染。

anticipate.example: We anticipate heavy traffic on the way to the airport tomorrow.
anticipate.exampleZh: 我们预计明天去机场的路上会堵车。

antidote.example: Laughter is a good antidote to stress and worry.
antidote.exampleZh: 笑是缓解压力和忧虑的一剂良方。

antipathy.example: Her deep antipathy toward loud music made every party a struggle for her.
antipathy.exampleZh: 她对吵闹音乐的强烈反感使每次聚会都让她难受。

antique.example: My grandmother keeps an antique clock on the wall in her living room.
antique.exampleZh: 我奶奶在客厅的墙上挂着一只古董钟。

antithesis.example: Her calm manner is the antithesis of his loud, angry style.
antithesis.exampleZh: 她平静的举止与他和大声愤怒的风格形成了鲜明的对照。

anxiety.example: She felt a lot of anxiety before her first day at the new job.
anxiety.exampleZh: 在新工作第一天之前，她感到非常焦虑。

anxious.example: She feels anxious about her exam tomorrow, but she is studying hard.
anxious.exampleZh: 她对明天的考试感到焦虑，但她正在努力学习。

any.example: I do not have any money with me today.
any.exampleZh: 我今天身上没带任何钱。

anybody.example: I don't think anybody here knows the answer to this question.
anybody.exampleZh: 我认为这里没有人知道这个问题的答案。

anyhow.example: I was tired, but I went to the party anyhow.
anyhow.exampleZh: 我累了，但无论如何我还是去参加了聚会。

anyone.example: Anyone can join this club if they like music.
anyone.exampleZh: 任何喜欢音乐的人都可以加入这个俱乐部。

anything.example: You can ask me anything if you do not understand the lesson.
anything.exampleZh: 如果你没听懂这堂课，你可以问我任何问题。

anyway.example: I was tired, but I went to the party anyway.
anyway.exampleZh: 我很累，但还是去参加了聚会。

anywhere.example: I can't find my keys anywhere in this room.
anywhere.exampleZh: 我在这个房间里到处都找不到我的钥匙。

apart.example: The two small towns are ten miles apart.
apart.exampleZh: 这两个小镇相距十英里。

apartment.example: My apartment is small but very clean and close to the subway.
apartment.exampleZh: 我的公寓很小，但非常干净，而且离地铁很近。

ape.example: The child likes to ape his older brother in everything he does.
ape.exampleZh: 这孩子做什么都喜欢模仿他的哥哥。

aperture.example: The camera lens has a small aperture that lets in little light.
aperture.exampleZh: 相机镜头有一个小光圈，进光量很少。

apex.example: The climber finally reached the apex of the mountain after many hours.
apex.exampleZh: 攀登者经过许多小时后终于到达了山顶。

aphorism.example: My grandfather often shares an old aphorism about saving money for rainy days.
aphorism.exampleZh: 我祖父经常分享一句关于存钱以备不时之需的老格言。

aplomb.example: She answered every question with real aplomb, even when the reporters tried to confuse her.
aplomb.exampleZh: 她非常沉着地回答了每一个问题，即使记者们试图让她困惑。

apnea.example: The doctor watched the baby carefully because apnea can be dangerous during sleep.
apnea.exampleZh: 医生仔细观察这个婴儿，因为睡眠中的呼吸暂停可能很危险。

apologetic.example: He gave me an apologetic smile after he broke my cup.
apologetic.exampleZh: 他打碎了我的杯子后，对我露出一个歉意的微笑。

apologize.example: I called my friend to apologize for being late to dinner.
apologize.exampleZh: 我打电话给朋友，为晚餐迟到道歉。

apology.example: I owe you an apology for being late to the meeting.
apology.exampleZh: 我为开会迟到向你道歉。

appall.example: The news of the accident appalled everyone in the small town.
appall.exampleZh: 事故的消息让小镇上的每个人都感到惊骇。

apparatus.example: The lab has new apparatus for testing water quality.
apparatus.exampleZh: 实验室有用于检测水质的新设备。

apparel.example: She bought new apparel for the winter season.
apparel.exampleZh: 她为冬季购置了新的服装。

apparent.example: It was apparent that he did not understand the question.
apparent.exampleZh: 很明显，他没有理解这个问题。

appeal.example: The charity made an appeal for money to help the poor children.
appeal.exampleZh: 这家慈善机构发出募捐呼吁，为贫困儿童筹款。

appear.example: A big smile appeared on her face when she heard the good news.
appear.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她脸上露出了灿烂的笑容。

appearance.example: Her sudden appearance at the party surprised everyone in the room.
appearance.exampleZh: 她在聚会上的突然出现让房间里的每个人都很惊讶。

appease.example: The teacher tried to appease the angry students with a longer break.
appease.exampleZh: 老师试图用更长的休息时间来安抚愤怒的学生。

append.example: Please append your name to the list before you leave the room.
append.exampleZh: 离开房间前，请把你的名字附加到名单上。

appendix.example: The appendix at the back of the book has extra maps and charts.
appendix.exampleZh: 书后的附录里有额外地图和图表。

appetite.example: The long walk gave me a good appetite for dinner.
appetite.exampleZh: 长途散步让我晚饭时胃口很好。

applaud.example: The whole class stood up to applaud her after the short speech.
applaud.exampleZh: 简短演讲结束后，全班同学站起来为她鼓掌。

apple.example: I eat an apple every morning before I go to school.
apple.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前吃一个苹果。

appliance.example: This kitchen appliance makes it easy to cook rice.
appliance.exampleZh: 这个厨房电器让煮米饭变得很方便。

applicable.example: This rule is applicable to all students in our school.
applicable.exampleZh: 这条规则适用于我们学校的所有学生。

applicant.example: The applicant filled out the form and waited for a reply.
applicant.exampleZh: 申请人填好表格，然后等待回复。

application.example: You can send your application to the school by email.
application.exampleZh: 你可以通过电子邮件把申请材料寄给学校。

apply.example: You can apply for this job online before Friday.
apply.exampleZh: 你可以在周五之前在线申请这份工作。

appoint.example: The company decided to appoint her as the new manager.
appoint.exampleZh: 公司决定任命她为新的经理。

appointment.example: She made an appointment to see the doctor on Friday morning.
appointment.exampleZh: 她预约了周五上午去看医生。

appraisal.example: The manager gave a fair appraisal of my work this year.
appraisal.exampleZh: 经理对我今年的工作做出了公正的评价。

appreciate.example: I really appreciate your help with my homework today.
appreciate.exampleZh: 我真的很感激你今天帮我做作业。

approach.example: We need a better approach to solve this difficult problem.
approach.exampleZh: 我们需要一种更好的方法来解这道难题。

appropriate.example: Please wear appropriate clothes for the job interview.
appropriate.exampleZh: 请为这次求职面试穿合适的衣服。

approval.example: The project cannot start without the approval of the manager.
approval.exampleZh: 没有经理的批准，这个项目无法开始。

approve.example: My parents approve of my plan to study English in London.
approve.exampleZh: 我父母赞成我去伦敦学英语的计划。

approximate.example: The approximate cost of the trip is two hundred dollars.
approximate.exampleZh: 这次旅行的大约费用是两百美元。

april.example: April is a warm and beautiful month with many flowers.
april.exampleZh: 四月是一个温暖美丽的月份，有许多花。

apron.example: The cook put on a clean apron before she started making dinner.
apron.exampleZh: 厨师在做晚饭前系上了一条干净的围裙。

apt.example: She is apt to forget her keys at home.
apt.exampleZh: 她容易把钥匙忘在家里。

aquatic.example: The zoo has a large pool for aquatic animals like fish and turtles.
aquatic.exampleZh: 动物园有一个大水池，供鱼和海龟等水生动物使用。

arbiter.example: The judge was seen as the final arbiter of the case.
arbiter.exampleZh: 这位法官被视为该案件的最终裁决者。

arbitrary.example: The teacher made an arbitrary decision without asking anyone.
arbitrary.exampleZh: 老师没有问任何人就做出了一个武断的决定。

arbitrate.example: The two sides asked an old judge to arbitrate their long dispute.
arbitrate.exampleZh: 双方请一位老法官来仲裁他们长期的纠纷。

arc.example: The rainbow formed a bright arc across the sky after the rain.
arc.exampleZh: 雨后，彩虹在天空中形成了一道明亮的弧。

arch.example: We walked through the old stone arch and into the garden.
arch.exampleZh: 我们穿过那座古老的石拱门，走进了花园。

archaeology.example: She studies archaeology at the university and often works on ancient sites.
archaeology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习考古学，经常参与古代遗址的工作。

archetype.example: The wise old teacher is a common archetype in many famous stories.
archetype.exampleZh: 智慧的老教师是许多著名故事中常见的原型。

architect.example: The architect showed us the plan for the new school.
architect.exampleZh: 这位建筑师给我们看了新学校的规划图。

architecture.example: The old museum shows the city's beautiful architecture from a hundred years ago.
architecture.exampleZh: 这座古老的博物馆展现了这座城市一百年前的美丽建筑风格。

archive.example: I found the old photos in the archive at the city library.
archive.exampleZh: 我在市图书馆的档案馆里找到了那些旧照片。

arctic.example: The arctic is very cold and covered with ice all year.
arctic.exampleZh: 北极地区非常寒冷，全年都被冰雪覆盖。

ardent.example: She is an ardent supporter of the local animal shelter.
ardent.exampleZh: 她是当地动物收容所的热情支持者。

arduous.example: Climbing the mountain was an arduous task for the young students.
arduous.exampleZh: 对这帮年轻学生来说，爬这座山是件艰巨的任务。

are.example: You and your friends are always welcome at our house.
are.exampleZh: 你和你的朋友们随时都欢迎来我们家。

area.example: The area of this room is about twenty square meters.
area.exampleZh: 这个房间的面积大约是二十平方米。

argue.example: They often argue about small things at home.
argue.exampleZh: 他们常常在家里为小事争论。

argument.example: They had a long argument about where to go for the holiday.
argument.exampleZh: 他们为去哪里度假争论了很久。

arise.example: Many problems arise when people do not talk to each other.
arise.exampleZh: 当人们彼此不交流时，许多问题就会出现。

arithmetic.example: She is good at arithmetic and can solve math problems quickly.
arithmetic.exampleZh: 她擅长算术，能很快解决数学题。

arm.example: The soldiers arm themselves with guns before the long march.
arm.exampleZh: 士兵们在长途行军前用枪武装自己。

army.example: A large army marched into the city early this morning.
army.exampleZh: 一支庞大的军队今天清晨开进了这座城市。

aroma.example: The kitchen was full of the warm aroma of fresh bread.
aroma.exampleZh: 厨房里充满了新鲜面包的温暖香气。

around.example: There are many small shops around the old train station.
around.exampleZh: 老火车站周围有很多小商店。

arouse.example: The loud noise aroused the baby from a deep sleep.
arouse.exampleZh: 巨大的响声把婴儿从沉睡中唤醒了。

arrange.example: I will arrange the chairs and tables for the meeting tomorrow.
arrange.exampleZh: 我会为明天的会议安排桌椅。

arrangement.example: The arrangement of the seats in the room was very good.
arrangement.exampleZh: 房间里座位的安排非常好。

array.example: The store has a wide array of fresh fruit on its shelves.
array.exampleZh: 这家店的货架上摆着各种各样的新鲜水果。

arrest.example: The police arrested the man after the long chase.
arrest.exampleZh: 警察在长时间追捕后逮捕了那名男子。

arrival.example: The arrival of the early train surprised everyone at the small station.
arrival.exampleZh: 早班列车的到达让小镇车站的每个人都感到惊讶。

arrive.example: We arrive at the station before the last train leaves.
arrive.exampleZh: 我们在末班火车开走之前到达车站。

arrogant.example: He is too arrogant to listen to anyone else's advice.
arrogant.exampleZh: 他太傲慢了，听不进别人的任何建议。

arrow.example: He followed the arrow on the map to find the hidden lake.
arrow.exampleZh: 他顺着地图上的箭头找到了那个隐蔽的湖泊。

arsenal.example: The old building near the river was once a large arsenal.
arsenal.exampleZh: 河边的那栋老建筑曾经是一座大型兵工厂。

art.example: She studies art at school and loves to paint pictures of her family.
art.exampleZh: 她在学校学习艺术，喜欢画家人的画。

artery.example: The doctor said the artery in his leg was blocked and needed surgery.
artery.exampleZh: 医生说他的腿部动脉堵塞了，需要做手术。

article.example: I read an interesting article about healthy eating in the newspaper today.
article.exampleZh: 我今天在报纸上读了一篇关于健康饮食的有趣文章。

articulate.example: She can articulate her ideas clearly in class.
articulate.exampleZh: 她能在课堂上清晰地表达自己的想法。

artificial.example: The flowers on the table are artificial, but they look very real.
artificial.exampleZh: 桌上的花是人造的，但看起来非常逼真。

artist.example: The young artist paints colorful pictures of the sea every morning.
artist.exampleZh: 这位年轻的艺术家每天早上都画色彩斑斓的大海。

artistic.example: She has a very artistic eye and takes beautiful photos of nature.
artistic.exampleZh: 她有很高的艺术眼光，能拍出美丽的自然照片。

artless.example: Her artless smile made everyone in the room feel relaxed.
artless.exampleZh: 她天真不做作的微笑让房间里的每个人都感到放松。

as.example: She sang as she walked home from school.
as.exampleZh: 她放学走回家时一边唱歌。

ascend.example: They slowly ascend the mountain path before the sun gets too hot.
ascend.exampleZh: 他们在太阳变得太热之前慢慢爬上那条山路。

ascertain.example: We need to ascertain the cause of the problem before we fix it.
ascertain.exampleZh: 在解决问题之前，我们需要查明问题的原因。

ash.example: The old house burned down and now only ash remains.
ash.exampleZh: 那座老房子烧毁了，现在只剩下灰烬。

ashamed.example: She felt ashamed after she lied to her best friend.
ashamed.exampleZh: 她对最好的朋友撒谎后感到惭愧。

ashore.example: After the long storm, the fishermen were happy to be safely ashore.
ashore.exampleZh: 漫长的暴风雨过后，渔民们很高兴能安全上岸。

aside.example: She stepped aside to let the old man pass.
aside.exampleZh: 她往旁边让了一步，好让那位老人过去。

ask.example: You can ask your teacher when you do not understand the lesson.
ask.exampleZh: 当你听不懂课时，你可以问老师。

asleep.example: The little boy fell asleep on the sofa while watching his favorite cartoon.
asleep.exampleZh: 小男孩在看最喜欢的动画片时在沙发上睡着了。

aspect.example: One important aspect of learning English is listening to native speakers every day.
aspect.exampleZh: 学英语的一个重要方面是每天听母语者说话。

aspiration.example: Her aspiration is to become a doctor and help poor families.
aspiration.exampleZh: 她的志向是成为一名医生，帮助贫困家庭。

aspirin.example: My doctor told me to take an aspirin after lunch.
aspirin.exampleZh: 医生让我午饭后吃一片阿司匹林。

assault.example: The soldier was hurt in an assault on the base last night.
assault.exampleZh: 那名士兵在昨晚对基地的一次袭击中受伤。

assemble.example: The workers assemble the new machines in the factory every morning.
assemble.exampleZh: 工人们每天早上在工厂里组装这些新机器。

assembly.example: The workers finished the assembly of the new machine before noon.
assembly.exampleZh: 工人们在中午之前完成了新机器的装配。

assert.example: She asserts that the plan will work, but she has no proof.
assert.exampleZh: 她断言这个计划会奏效，但她没有证据。

assess.example: Teachers assess students' progress at the end of each term.
assess.exampleZh: 老师在每学期末评估学生的学习进展。

asset.example: Her ability to stay calm under pressure is a great asset to the team.
asset.exampleZh: 她在压力下保持冷静的能力是团队的一大财富。

assign.example: The teacher will assign homework to every student before Friday.
assign.exampleZh: 老师会在周五前给每个学生布置作业。

assignment.example: Our teacher gave us a difficult assignment on Friday.
assignment.exampleZh: 老师周五给我们布置了一项难度较大的作业。

assist.example: The nurse will assist the doctor during the operation this morning.
assist.exampleZh: 今天上午护士将在手术中协助医生。

assistance.example: She asked her friend for assistance with the heavy boxes.
assistance.exampleZh: 她请朋友帮忙搬那些沉重的箱子。

assistant.example: My assistant helps me answer emails every morning.
assistant.exampleZh: 我的助手每天早上帮我回复邮件。

associate.example: I always associate this song with my happy school days.
associate.exampleZh: 我总是把这首歌和我快乐的校园时光联系在一起。

association.example: She is a member of the local sports association.
association.exampleZh: 她是当地体育协会的成员。

assume.example: I assume you will come to the meeting tomorrow morning.
assume.exampleZh: 我假设你明天早上会来开会。

assumption.example: Your plan is based on a wrong assumption about the cost.
assumption.exampleZh: 你的计划建立在一个关于成本的错误假设之上。

assure.example: I assure you that the work will be finished on time.
assure.exampleZh: 我向你保证这项工作会按时完成。

asthma.example: My doctor says my asthma gets worse when the weather turns cold.
asthma.exampleZh: 我的医生说天气变冷时我的哮喘会加重。

astonish.example: His quick answer astonished everyone in the room.
astonish.exampleZh: 他快速的回答让房间里的每个人都感到惊讶。

astronaut.example: The astronaut waved at the children before he entered the spaceship.
astronaut.exampleZh: 那位宇航员在进入飞船前向孩子们挥手。

astronomy.example: My brother studies astronomy and often looks at the stars at night.
astronomy.exampleZh: 我弟弟学习天文学，经常在晚上看星星。

at.example: I will meet you at the bus stop after school.
at.exampleZh: 放学后我会在公交车站见你。

athlete.example: The young athlete runs very fast and never gives up.
athlete.exampleZh: 这位年轻运动员跑得很快，从不放弃。

atlas.example: The old atlas on the shelf shows many countries I have never visited.
atlas.exampleZh: 书架上那本旧地图册标出了许多我从未去过的国家。

atmosphere.example: The restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere at night.
atmosphere.exampleZh: 这家餐厅在晚上有一种温暖友好的氛围。

atom.example: An atom is the smallest part of a chemical element.
atom.exampleZh: 原子是化学元素中最小的部分。

atomic.example: Atomic energy can be used to make clean electricity for many cities.
atomic.exampleZh: 原子能可以用来为许多城市生产清洁电力。

atrocious.example: The food at that restaurant was atrocious and made everyone sick.
atrocious.exampleZh: 那家餐厅的食物糟糕透顶，让每个人都生病了。

attach.example: Please attach the file to your email before you send it.
attach.exampleZh: 发送邮件之前，请把文件附上。

attachment.example: Please open the attachment to see the full report.
attachment.exampleZh: 请打开附件查看完整报告。

attack.example: The enemy will attack the small village at night.
attack.exampleZh: 敌人将在夜间进攻这个小村庄。

attain.example: She worked hard for many years to attain her goal.
attain.exampleZh: 她多年努力工作以实现自己的目标。

attempt.example: I will attempt to fix the old bike myself.
attempt.exampleZh: 我会尝试自己修这辆旧自行车。

attend.example: I will attend the meeting tomorrow morning with my team.
attend.exampleZh: 明天上午我将和我的团队一起参加会议。

attention.example: Please pay close attention to the teacher during class.
attention.exampleZh: 上课时请密切关注老师。

attic.example: We found some old boxes and a broken chair in the attic.
attic.exampleZh: 我们在阁楼里找到了一些旧箱子和一把坏椅子。

attire.example: She wore simple attire to the party last night.
attire.exampleZh: 昨晚她穿着简单的服装去参加聚会。

attitude.example: Her positive attitude helped the whole team finish the hard work on time.
attitude.exampleZh: 她积极的态度帮助整个团队按时完成了这项艰难的工作。

attorney.example: The attorney asked her client a few simple questions before the hearing.
attorney.exampleZh: 律师在听证会前问了她的客户几个简单的问题。

attract.example: The bright colors attract many small children to the toy store.
attract.exampleZh: 鲜艳的颜色吸引了许多小孩子来到玩具店。

attraction.example: The new museum is a popular attraction for families visiting the city.
attraction.exampleZh: 这座新博物馆是来这座城市旅游的家庭喜爱的景点。

attractive.example: The garden looks very attractive in spring with all its bright flowers.
attractive.exampleZh: 春天里花园开满鲜艳的花朵，看起来非常迷人。

attribute.example: People often attribute their success to hard work and a little luck.
attribute.exampleZh: 人们常常把成功归因于努力工作和一点点运气。

auction.example: They will auction the old paintings on Saturday morning.
auction.exampleZh: 他们将在周六上午拍卖这些旧画。

audience.example: The audience clapped loudly after the singer finished her last song.
audience.exampleZh: 歌手唱完最后一首歌后，观众热烈鼓掌。

audio.example: I like to listen to audio books while I walk to work.
audio.exampleZh: 我喜欢在步行上班时听有声读物。

audit.example: The bank will audit our accounts every year.
audit.exampleZh: 银行每年都会审计我们的账目。

augment.example: They plan to augment the team with two more engineers next month.
augment.exampleZh: 他们计划下个月增加两名工程师来扩充团队。

augur.example: The dark clouds augur a heavy storm tonight.
augur.exampleZh: 乌云预示着今晚会有大暴风雨。

august.example: The august judge spoke slowly and everyone in the room listened in silence.
august.exampleZh: 那位威严的法官语速缓慢，房间里的每个人都静静地听着。

aunt.example: My aunt makes delicious cookies for us every weekend.
aunt.exampleZh: 我姨母每个周末都给我们做美味的饼干。

auspicious.example: It was an auspicious day for the young couple to begin their new life.
auspicious.exampleZh: 这对年轻夫妇开始新生活的那天是个吉日。

austere.example: His austere room had only a bed and a small wooden table.
austere.exampleZh: 他那间简朴的房间里只有一张床和一张小木桌。

australia.example: My cousin moved to Australia last year to study at a university there.
australia.exampleZh: 我的表弟去年搬到澳大利亚，在那里的大学学习。

authentic.example: This restaurant serves authentic Chinese food, and the prices are very good.
authentic.exampleZh: 这家餐厅供应正宗的中餐，而且价格很实惠。

author.example: The author wrote a short book about life in a small town.
author.exampleZh: 这位作者写了一本关于小镇生活的短书。

authority.example: The local authority is responsible for keeping our city streets clean and safe.
authority.exampleZh: 当地当局负责保持我们城市街道的清洁与安全。

authorize.example: The manager will authorize the new plan tomorrow morning.
authorize.exampleZh: 经理明天上午将批准这项新计划。

auto.example: My father drives his auto to work every morning.
auto.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上开他的汽车去上班。

autobiography.example: She wrote her autobiography when she was seventy years old.
autobiography.exampleZh: 她七十岁时写了自己的自传。

automatic.example: The door is automatic, so it opens when you walk near it.
automatic.exampleZh: 这扇门是自动的，所以你走近时它就会打开。

automation.example: Our new factory uses automation to make cars faster and with fewer mistakes.
automation.exampleZh: 我们的新工厂利用自动化来更快地生产汽车，并减少错误。

automobile.example: My father drives an old automobile to work every day.
automobile.exampleZh: 我父亲每天开一辆旧汽车上班。

autonomy.example: The school gives teachers more autonomy in choosing what to teach.
autonomy.exampleZh: 学校在教学内容的选择上给予教师更多自主权。

autumn.example: The leaves turn red and yellow in autumn.

auxiliary.example: The hospital uses an auxiliary generator when the main power fails.
auxiliary.exampleZh: 医院在主电源故障时使用备用发电机。

avail.example: Hard work will avail you little if you never ask for help.
avail.exampleZh: 如果你从不求助，再努力也不会有多大用处。

available.example: Is this seat available, or is someone sitting here?
available.exampleZh: 这个座位是空的吗，还是有人坐在这里？

avalanche.example: The heavy snow caused a large avalanche on the mountain road.
avalanche.exampleZh: 大雪在山路上引发了一场巨大的雪崩。

avenue.example: The new road is a wide avenue that leads to the city center.
avenue.exampleZh: 这条新路是一条宽阔的大道，通往市中心。

average.example: The average temperature in this city is about twenty degrees in spring.
average.exampleZh: 这座城市春天的平均气温大约是二十度。

averse.example: She is averse to working late on weekends.

avert.example: She moved quickly to avert a serious problem at work.
avert.exampleZh: 她迅速采取行动，避免了工作中的严重问题。

aviation.example: My brother works in aviation and often flies to different countries.
aviation.exampleZh: 我哥哥从事航空工作，经常飞往不同的国家。

avoid.example: I always avoid eating too much sugar before going to bed.
avoid.exampleZh: 我总是避免在睡前吃太多糖。

await.example: We await the test results with great hope.
await.exampleZh: 我们满怀希望地等待测试结果。

awake.example: I was still awake at midnight, so I read a book quietly.
awake.exampleZh: 午夜时我还醒着，所以安静地读了一本书。

award.example: The school will award a prize to the best student this year.
award.exampleZh: 学校今年将把奖品授予最优秀的学生。

aware.example: She was not aware of the danger until the last minute.
aware.exampleZh: 直到最后一刻她才意识到危险。

awareness.example: Reading the news helped me develop a greater awareness of world problems.
awareness.exampleZh: 阅读新闻帮助我对世界问题有了更强的意识。

away.example: She walked away from the noisy crowd and found a quiet place.
away.exampleZh: 她离开喧闹的人群，找到了一个安静的地方。

awe.example: The children stood in awe as the stars appeared in the dark sky.
awe.exampleZh: 孩子们站在那儿，满怀敬畏地看着星星在黑暗的天空中出现。

awful.example: The weather was awful, so we stayed at home all day.
awful.exampleZh: 天气糟透了，所以我们整天都待在家里。

awkward.example: There was an awkward silence when he forgot her name.
awkward.exampleZh: 他忘了她的名字，气氛一时很尴尬。

axe.example: He used a sharp axe to cut the fallen tree into small pieces.
axe.exampleZh: 他用一把锋利的斧头把倒下的树砍成小块。

axis.example: The Earth turns around its axis once every twenty-four hours.
axis.exampleZh: 地球每二十四小时绕自己的轴转一圈。

axon.example: A nerve signal travels along the axon to the next cell.
axon.exampleZh: 神经信号沿着轴突传递到下一个细胞。

azure.example: The sky above the calm sea was a bright azure this morning.
azure.exampleZh: 今天早上，平静海面上方的天空是一片明亮的蔚蓝色。

babble.example: The baby began to babble softly while the water ran in the sink.
babble.exampleZh: 宝宝开始轻声咿咿呀呀，而水槽里的水一直流着。

baboon.example: The baboon sat on the rock and ate a piece of fruit.
baboon.exampleZh: 那只狒狒坐在岩石上，吃了一片水果。

baby.example: The baby is sleeping quietly in a warm bed.
baby.exampleZh: 婴儿正在温暖的床上安静地睡觉。

bachelor.example: My older brother is still a bachelor and lives alone in the city.
bachelor.exampleZh: 我哥哥仍然是单身汉，独自住在城里。

back.example: My back hurts after I sit in the same chair all day.
back.exampleZh: 我在同一把椅子上坐了一整天后，背部很疼。

backbone.example: Hardworking teachers are the backbone of every good school.
backbone.exampleZh: 勤奋的老师是每一所好学校的支柱。

background.example: Her family background helps her understand the problems of poor students.
background.exampleZh: 她的家庭背景有助于她理解贫困学生的问题。

backup.example: Please make a backup of these files before you change the computer.
backup.exampleZh: 在修改电脑之前，请给这些文件做一个备份。

backward.example: He took a backward step and fell into the soft chair.
backward.exampleZh: 他向后退了一步，跌进了那张软椅里。

bacon.example: I like bacon and eggs for breakfast on Sunday.
bacon.exampleZh: 我周日早餐喜欢吃咸肉煎蛋。

bacteria.example: Wash your hands often because bacteria can make you sick.
bacteria.exampleZh: 要经常洗手，因为细菌会让你生病。

bacterial.example: The doctor said the infection was bacterial and gave her some medicine.
bacterial.exampleZh: 医生说这次感染是细菌引起的，并给她开了一些药。

bacterium.example: This bacterium is very small and can make people sick.
bacterium.exampleZh: 这种细菌非常小，会让人生病。

bad.example: Smoking is very bad for your health.
bad.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的健康非常有害。

badge.example: She wears a small badge on her jacket at school every day.
badge.exampleZh: 她每天上学都在夹克上别着一枚小徽章。

badger.example: The little boy badgered his mother for sweets all afternoon.
badger.exampleZh: 小男孩整个下午都缠着妈妈要糖。

badly.example: The team played badly and lost the game by three goals.
badly.exampleZh: 这支球队打得很差，以三个球的差距输掉了比赛。

badminton.example: She plays badminton with her friends every weekend at the sports center.
badminton.exampleZh: 她每个周末都和朋友们在体育中心打羽毛球。

baffle.example: The complicated rules baffle many new players at the club.
baffle.exampleZh: 这些复杂的规则让俱乐部里的许多新玩家感到困惑。

bag.example: She put her keys and phone into her bag and left the house.
bag.exampleZh: 她把钥匙和手机放进包里，然后离开了家。

baggage.example: Please keep your baggage with you at all times in the airport.
baggage.exampleZh: 在机场请随时把您的行李带在身边。

bail.example: His family paid the bail so he could leave jail before the trial.
bail.exampleZh: 他的家人缴纳了保释金，这样他就能在审判前离开监狱。

bait.example: He used a small fish as bait and soon caught a big fish.
bait.exampleZh: 他用一条小鱼作诱饵，很快就钓到了一条大鱼。

bake.example: My mother likes to bake bread for us every Sunday morning.
bake.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢每周日早上为我们烤面包。

baker.example: The baker gets up very early to make fresh bread for us.
baker.exampleZh: 这位面包师很早就起床，为我们做新鲜面包。

bakery.example: I buy fresh bread at the bakery near my house every morning.
bakery.exampleZh: 我每天早上都在家附近的面包店买新鲜面包。

balance.example: She checks her bank balance every morning before work.
balance.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前都会查看银行余额。

balcony.example: We sat on the balcony and watched the sun go down.
balcony.exampleZh: 我们坐在阳台上看太阳落下。

bald.example: The old man with the bald head walks to the park every morning.
bald.exampleZh: 那位秃头的老人每天早上都步行去公园。

ball.example: The children played with a red ball in the park all afternoon.
ball.exampleZh: 孩子们整个下午都在公园里玩一个红色的球。

ballad.example: My grandfather often sings an old ballad about the sea.
ballad.exampleZh: 我爷爷经常唱一首关于大海的古老民谣。

ballet.example: My sister takes ballet lessons every Saturday morning at the dance school.
ballet.exampleZh: 我妹妹每周六上午在舞蹈学校上芭蕾舞课。

balloon.example: The little girl is holding a red balloon at the birthday party.
balloon.exampleZh: 那个小女孩在生日聚会上拿着一个红色的气球。

ballot.example: The workers will use a secret ballot to choose their new leader.
ballot.exampleZh: 工人们将用无记名投票选出他们的新领导。

bamboo.example: The panda sat under the tall green bamboo and ate leaves all afternoon.
bamboo.exampleZh: 那只熊猫坐在高高的绿竹下，整个下午都在吃竹叶。

ban.example: The school bans phones in class and the ban starts today.
ban.exampleZh: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机，这项禁令从今天开始。

banal.example: The movie's plot was banal and easy to guess.
banal.exampleZh: 这部电影的情节很老套，很容易猜到。

banana.example: I eat a banana every morning before I go to school.
banana.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前吃一根香蕉。

band.example: The band played loud music at the party last night.
band.exampleZh: 乐队昨晚在聚会上演奏了很响亮的音乐。

bandage.example: The nurse put a clean bandage on his injured leg.
bandage.exampleZh: 护士在他受伤的腿上包了一条干净的绷带。

bandit.example: The bandit stole money from travelers on the old road.
bandit.exampleZh: 那个强盗在老路上抢走了旅人的钱。

bandwidth.example: The new internet plan gives us more bandwidth for videos and games.
bandwidth.exampleZh: 新的网络套餐为我们提供了更多带宽，用来观看视频和玩游戏。

bang.example: The door closed with a loud bang and woke the baby.
bang.exampleZh: 门砰的一声关上，把宝宝吵醒了。

banish.example: The old king was banished from his own country.
banish.exampleZh: 这位老国王被驱逐出了自己的国家。

bank.example: I put my money in the bank near my house every month.
bank.exampleZh: 我每个月都把存在我家附近的银行里。

bankrupt.example: The company went bankrupt after losing its biggest customer last year.
bankrupt.exampleZh: 这家公司在去年失去最大的客户后破产了。

bankruptcy.example: The company had to close its stores after it declared bankruptcy last year.
bankruptcy.exampleZh: 这家公司在去年宣布破产后不得不关闭门店。

banner.example: The students hung a long red banner across the front of the school.
banner.exampleZh: 学生们在学校门前挂起了一条长长的红色横幅。

banquet.example: The rich family held a big banquet for their daughter's wedding.
banquet.exampleZh: 这个富裕的家庭为女儿的婚礼举办了一场盛大的宴会。

bar.example: There is a small bar near my house, and my friends often go there.
bar.exampleZh: 我家附近有一家小酒吧，我的朋友们常去那里。

barbarian.example: The barbarian army crossed the river and attacked the small town.
barbarian.exampleZh: 野蛮人的军队渡过河流，攻击了那座小镇。

barbaric.example: The barbaric attack on the village shocked everyone in the country.
barbaric.exampleZh: 对村庄的野蛮袭击震惊了全国每一个人。

barbecue.example: We had a barbecue in the park with our friends last Saturday.
barbecue.exampleZh: 上周六我们和朋友们在公园里进行了一次烧烤野餐。

barber.example: The barber cuts my hair every month and always does a very good job.
barber.exampleZh: 理发师每个月给我剪头发，而且总是剪得很好。

bare.example: The bare room had only a chair and a small wooden table.
bare.exampleZh: 这间空荡荡的房间里只有一把椅子和一张小木桌。

barely.example: I could barely hear him over the noise of the crowd.
barely.exampleZh: 人群的嘈杂声太大，我几乎听不见他说话。

bargain.example: She got a good bargain on that old bike at the market.
bargain.exampleZh: 她在市场上买那辆旧自行车时捡了个便宜。

barge.example: The big barge moved slowly down the river past our small house.
barge.exampleZh: 那艘大驳船缓缓驶过我们的小房子，顺着河往下走。

bark.example: The dog began to bark loudly when it heard a strange noise.
bark.exampleZh: 狗听到奇怪的声音时开始大声吠叫。

barn.example: The farmer keeps his cows and hay in the old red barn.
barn.exampleZh: 农夫把他的奶牛和干草存放在那座古老的红色谷仓里。

barrel.example: He filled the barrel with water from the old well.
barrel.exampleZh: 他把旧井里的水装满了那个桶。

barren.example: The old farmer could not grow anything on his barren land.
barren.exampleZh: 那位老农夫无法在他贫瘠的土地上种出任何东西。

barrier.example: Poor roads are a barrier to trade in this small town.
barrier.exampleZh: 糟糕的道路是这个小镇贸易的一大障碍。

base.example: The camp was built at the base of the mountain near the river.
base.exampleZh: 营地位于河流附近的山脚下。

baseball.example: My brother plays baseball with his friends every Sunday afternoon.
baseball.exampleZh: 我弟弟每个星期天下午都和他的朋友们打棒球。

baseline.example: We used last year's sales as the baseline for our new plan.
baseline.exampleZh: 我们用去年的销售额作为新计划的基线。

basement.example: We keep our old bicycles in the basement of the house.
basement.exampleZh: 我们把旧自行车存放在房子的地下室里。

bash.example: He gave the door a bash with his fist and it finally opened.
bash.exampleZh: 他用拳头猛击了一下门，门终于开了。

basic.example: Food, water, and shelter are basic needs for every person.
basic.exampleZh: 食物、水和住所是每个人的基本需求。

basically.example: The two plans are basically the same, so we can choose either one.
basically.exampleZh: 这两个计划基本上是一样的，所以我们可以任选一个。

basin.example: She washed the fresh vegetables in a basin of clean water.
basin.exampleZh: 她在一盆清水里洗了新鲜蔬菜。

basis.example: Trust is the basis of every good friendship.
basis.exampleZh: 信任是每一段良好友谊的基础。

basket.example: My mother put the fresh fruit into a basket on the table.
basket.exampleZh: 我妈妈把新鲜水果放进了桌上的篮子里。

basketball.example: My brother plays basketball with his friends every Saturday afternoon.
basketball.exampleZh: 我弟弟每周六下午都和他的朋友们打篮球。

bass.example: He plays the bass in a small band with his friends.
bass.exampleZh: 他和朋友们在一个小乐队里弹贝斯。

bat.example: A bat flew out of the dark cave and into the night sky.
bat.exampleZh: 一只蝙蝠从黑暗的洞穴里飞出来，飞进了夜空。

batch.example: The factory makes a new batch of shoes every morning.
batch.exampleZh: 这家工厂每天早上生产一批新鞋。

bath.example: She takes a warm bath every night before going to bed.
bath.exampleZh: 她每天晚上睡觉前都会洗个热水澡。

bathe.example: I like to bathe my little dog in warm water after playing outside.
bathe.exampleZh: 我喜欢在小狗在外面玩耍之后用温水给它洗澡。

bathroom.example: The bathroom is small but very clean and bright.
bathroom.exampleZh: 这间浴室虽小，但非常干净明亮。

battalion.example: A battalion of soldiers marched through the town at dawn.
battalion.exampleZh: 一营士兵在黎明时分穿过小镇行进。

batter.example: She used a heavy spoon to batter the eggs for the cake.
batter.exampleZh: 她用一把重勺子把鸡蛋打成蛋糕用的蛋糊。

battery.example: My phone battery is low, so I need to charge it soon.
battery.exampleZh: 我的手机电池电量低了，所以我需要尽快充电。

battle.example: The soldiers fought a long battle for their country.
battle.exampleZh: 士兵们为他们的国家打了一场漫长的战役。

bay.example: The small boat is safe in the bay near our house.
bay.exampleZh: 小船在我们家附近的海湾里很安全。

be.example: She wants to be a doctor when she grows up.
be.exampleZh: 她长大后想成为一名医生。

beach.example: We walked along the beach and looked for shells in the sand.
beach.exampleZh: 我们沿着海滩散步，在沙滩里找贝壳。

bead.example: A bead of sweat ran down his face as he worked.
bead.exampleZh: 他干活时，一滴汗珠顺着他的脸流了下来。

beak.example: The bird used its sharp beak to pick up the seeds.
beak.exampleZh: 那只鸟用尖尖的喙捡起种子。

beam.example: A bright beam of light came through the small window.
beam.exampleZh: 一束明亮的光从小窗户照了进来。

bean.example: I put a bean in the pot and waited for it to grow.
bean.exampleZh: 我把一颗豆子放进花盆里，等着它长大。

bear.example: I cannot bear the noise from the street, and my bear hates it too.
bear.exampleZh: 我无法忍受街上的噪音，我的熊也讨厌这噪音。

beard.example: My grandfather has a long white beard and small blue eyes.
beard.exampleZh: 我祖父留着长长的白胡须，有一双蓝色的小眼睛。

bearing.example: What he said has no bearing on our plan for next week.
bearing.exampleZh: 他所说的话与我们下周的计划没有关系。

beast.example: The hunter saw a wild beast near the river last night.
beast.exampleZh: 猎人昨晚在河边看见了一只野兽。

beat.example: Our team beat the stronger side by two goals last night.
beat.exampleZh: 昨晚我们队以两球击败了更强的对手。

beautiful.example: The garden looks very beautiful in spring every year.
beautiful.exampleZh: 这个花园每年春天看起来都非常美丽。

beauty.example: Everyone at the party said her singing had great beauty and power.
beauty.exampleZh: 聚会上的每个人都说她的歌声优美而有力。

because.example: I stayed at home because it was raining hard all day.
because.exampleZh: 我待在家里，因为一整天都在下大雨。

beckon.example: She saw her mother beckon from the door and ran to her.
beckon.exampleZh: 她看见妈妈在门口招手，就朝她跑了过去。

become.example: She wants to become a doctor when she grows up.
become.exampleZh: 她长大后想成为一名医生。

bed.example: My dog likes to sleep under the bed at night.
bed.exampleZh: 我的狗晚上喜欢睡在床底下。

bedroom.example: My bedroom is small but very bright and quiet.
bedroom.exampleZh: 我的卧室很小，但非常明亮安静。

bee.example: The bee is busy flying from flower to flower all day.
bee.exampleZh: 这只蜜蜂整天忙着在花丛间飞来飞去。

beef.example: The beef in this soup is very soft and tastes good.
beef.exampleZh: 这汤里的牛肉很软，味道很好。

beer.example: We drank cold beer and ate pizza at the party last night.
beer.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在聚会上喝冷啤酒、吃披萨。

before.example: Please wash your hands before you eat dinner.

beforehand.example: Please tell me beforehand if you cannot come to the meeting tomorrow.
beforehand.exampleZh: 如果你明天不能来开会，请事先告诉我。

beg.example: The poor man had to beg for food on the street every day.
beg.exampleZh: 那个可怜的男人每天不得不在街上乞讨食物。

begin.example: Let us begin the meeting now because everyone is here.
begin.exampleZh: 既然大家都到了，我们现在就开始会议吧。

beginning.example: The beginning of the movie was very slow and a little boring.
beginning.exampleZh: 电影的开头很慢，还有点无聊。

behalf.example: She spoke on behalf of the whole team at the meeting.
behalf.exampleZh: 她代表整个团队在会上发言。

behave.example: The children behaved well at the party and helped clean up.
behave.exampleZh: 孩子们在聚会上表现很好，还帮忙打扫了。

behavior.example: His behavior in class was very good today.
behavior.exampleZh: 他今天在课堂上的表现非常好。

behavioral.example: The doctor said his behavioral problems were caused by stress at school.
behavioral.exampleZh: 医生说他的行为问题是由学校里的压力引起的。

behind.example: The little cat is hiding behind the big tree in our garden.
behind.exampleZh: 那只小猫躲在我们花园里的大树后面。

being.example: Every living being needs clean water, food, and fresh air to stay alive.
being.exampleZh: 每一个生物都需要干净的水、食物和新鲜空气才能存活。

belief.example: Her belief in herself helped her finish the difficult race.
belief.exampleZh: 她对自己的信念帮助她跑完了那场艰难的比赛。

believe.example: I believe he will come to the party tonight.
believe.exampleZh: 我相信他今晚会来参加聚会。

bell.example: The school bell rings loudly at eight every morning.
bell.exampleZh: 学校的铃每天早上八点大声响起。

belly.example: My little brother fell down and hurt his belly on the playground.
belly.exampleZh: 我弟弟摔倒了，在操场上伤到了肚子。

belong.example: This old book belongs to my grandfather, so please treat it carefully.
belong.exampleZh: 这本旧书属于我祖父，所以请小心对待。

beloved.example: She is a beloved teacher who helps every student after class.
beloved.exampleZh: 她是一位深受爱戴的老师，课后帮助每一位学生。

below.example: The temperature stayed below zero for three days last week.
below.exampleZh: 上周气温连续三天保持在零度以下。

belt.example: He wore a black belt around his waist every day.
belt.exampleZh: 他每天都系一条黑色腰带。

bench.example: The old man sat on a wooden bench in the park.
bench.exampleZh: 那位老人坐在公园里的木长凳上。

benchmark.example: This test is a good benchmark for comparing the two systems.
benchmark.exampleZh: 这项测试是比较这两个系统的一个良好基准。

bend.example: The old man had to bend down to pick up the coin.
bend.exampleZh: 那位老人不得不弯下腰去捡那枚硬币。

beneath.example: The old boat sank beneath the calm blue water.
beneath.exampleZh: 那条旧船沉入了平静的蓝色水面之下。

beneficial.example: Regular exercise is beneficial to both your body and your mind.
beneficial.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对身体和心理都有益。

benefit.example: Regular exercise can bring great benefits to your health.
benefit.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的健康大有好处。

bent.example: The old metal gate was bent, so it would not close properly.
bent.exampleZh: 那扇旧铁门弯了，所以关不严。

berry.example: The small red berry tastes sweet and grows on a low green bush.
berry.exampleZh: 这种红色小浆果味道很甜，长在低矮的绿色灌木上。

beside.example: She sat beside the window and read a book all afternoon.
beside.exampleZh: 她坐在窗边，整个下午都在看书。

besides.example: Besides English, she also studies French and Japanese at school.
besides.exampleZh: 除了英语，她在学校还学习法语和日语。

best.example: This is the best cake I have ever tasted in my life.
best.exampleZh: 这是我一生中尝过的最好的蛋糕。

bet.example: I bet ten dollars that our team will win the game today.
bet.exampleZh: 我赌十美元我们队今天会赢这场比赛。

betray.example: He did not want to betray his friend, so he kept the secret.
betray.exampleZh: 他不想出卖自己的朋友，所以保守了这个秘密。

better.example: Getting enough sleep every night can make your health much better.
better.exampleZh: 每晚睡足觉能让你的健康好得多。

between.example: There is a small park between the school and the library.
between.exampleZh: 学校和图书馆之间有一个小公园。

beverage.example: I would like a cold beverage with my lunch today.
beverage.exampleZh: 我今天午餐时想喝一杯冷饮。

beware.example: Beware of dogs when you walk through this neighborhood at night.
beware.exampleZh: 晚上走过这个街区时要当心狗。

bewilder.example: The many strange signs in the old city bewildered the young traveler.
bewilder.exampleZh: 老城里众多奇怪的标志让这位年轻游客感到困惑。

beyond.example: The beautiful lake is just beyond those tall green trees.
beyond.exampleZh: 那个美丽的湖就在那些高大的绿树那边。

bias.example: The judge must not let personal bias affect her final decision.
bias.exampleZh: 法官不能让个人偏见影响她的最终决定。

biased.example: The judge was biased against the young man and did not listen to him.
biased.exampleZh: 法官对那个年轻人有偏见，没有听他说话。

bible.example: This old book is the bible for many young cooks.
bible.exampleZh: 这本旧书是许多年轻厨师的经典。

bibliography.example: The teacher asked us to add a bibliography at the end of our paper.
bibliography.exampleZh: 老师要求我们在论文末尾加上参考文献目录。

bicycle.example: My father rides his bicycle to work every morning when the weather is nice.
bicycle.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我爸爸每天早上骑自行车去上班。

bid.example: Three companies will bid for the new bridge project next week.
bid.exampleZh: 三家公司下周将为这座新桥项目投标。

big.example: This is a big problem for our small team.
big.exampleZh: 这对我们这个小团队来说是个大问题。

bike.example: My bike is old, but I ride it to school every day.
bike.exampleZh: 我的自行车很旧了，但我每天骑它去上学。

bilingual.example: She is bilingual and can talk easily with people from both countries.
bilingual.exampleZh: 她会说两种语言，能和来自这两个国家的人轻松交谈。

bill.example: The waiter brought our bill after we finished dinner.
bill.exampleZh: 我们吃完晚饭后，服务员给我们送来了账单。

billion.example: The company spends one billion dollars on new technology every year.
billion.exampleZh: 这家公司每年在新技术上花费十亿美元。

bin.example: Please put the empty bottles in the bin near the door.
bin.exampleZh: 请把空瓶子放进门口附近的垃圾箱里。

binary.example: The computer stores all numbers in binary form for fast processing.
binary.exampleZh: 计算机把所有数字都以二进制形式存储，以便快速处理。

bind.example: They bind the old books together with strong string.
bind.exampleZh: 他们用结实的绳子把旧书捆在一起。

biography.example: I read a short biography of a famous scientist last week.
biography.exampleZh: 上周我读了一篇关于一位著名科学家的简短传记。

biological.example: Biological research helps us understand how living things grow and change.
biological.exampleZh: 生物学研究帮助我们理解生物如何生长和变化。

biology.example: She studies biology at the university and hopes to become a teacher.
biology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习生物学，希望成为一名老师。

bird.example: A small bird is singing in the tree outside my window.
bird.exampleZh: 一只小鸟正在我窗外的树上唱歌。

birth.example: She gave birth to a healthy baby boy last night.
birth.exampleZh: 她昨晚生了一个健康的男婴。

birthday.example: My sister's birthday is next Friday, so we are planning a small party for her.
birthday.exampleZh: 我姐姐的生日在下周五，所以我们正打算为她办一个小型聚会。

biscuit.example: My little sister ate two biscuits with a glass of milk.
biscuit.exampleZh: 我妹妹就着一杯牛奶吃了两块饼干。

bit.example: I only need a bit of sugar in my tea.
bit.exampleZh: 我的茶里只需要一点糖。

bite.example: The dog may bite you if you touch its food.
bite.exampleZh: 如果你碰它的食物，那只狗可能会咬你。

bitter.example: This coffee is too bitter for me to drink.
bitter.exampleZh: 这咖啡太苦了，我喝不下。

bizarre.example: It was bizarre that our cat slept in the kitchen sink every night.
bizarre.exampleZh: 很奇怪，我们的猫每天晚上都睡在厨房的水槽里。

black.example: The black cat sleeps on my bed every night.
black.exampleZh: 那只黑猫每天晚上都睡在我的床上。

blackboard.example: The teacher wrote the new words on the blackboard with a piece of white chalk.
blackboard.exampleZh: 老师用一支白粉笔把新单词写在了黑板上。

blade.example: Be careful with that sharp blade when you cut the bread.
blade.exampleZh: 切面包时小心那片锋利的刀刃。

blame.example: Don't blame other people for your own mistakes.
blame.exampleZh: 不要因为自己的错误而责怪别人。

blank.example: Please write your name in the blank space at the top of the page.
blank.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在页面顶部的空白处。

blanket.example: She put a warm blanket on the bed before the cold night.
blanket.exampleZh: 寒冷的夜晚来临前，她在床上铺了一条暖和的毯子。

blast.example: The blast broke every window in the old building.
blast.exampleZh: 爆炸震碎了那栋旧楼的每一扇窗户。

blaze.example: The fire was a bright blaze that lit up the whole night sky.
blaze.exampleZh: 那场火是一片明亮的烈焰，照亮了整个夜空。

bleed.example: The small cut on his finger began to bleed again this morning.
bleed.exampleZh: 他手指上的小伤口今天早上又开始流血了。

blend.example: She likes to blend green tea with a little honey.
blend.exampleZh: 她喜欢在绿茶里调和一点蜂蜜。

bless.example: I bless this food and thank you for your love.
bless.exampleZh: 我祝福这些食物，并感谢你的爱。

blind.example: Love can make a smart person blind to real problems.
blind.exampleZh: 爱情会让一个聪明人对真正的问题视而不见。

blink.example: I blink when bright light shines into my eyes.
blink.exampleZh: 当强光照射到我的眼睛时，我会眨眼。

block.example: A big block of ice fell on the road and blocked traffic.
block.exampleZh: 一大块冰掉在路上，堵住了交通。

blood.example: The doctor said he lost a lot of blood in the accident.
blood.exampleZh: 医生说他在这场事故中流了很多血。

bloody.example: After the fight he had a bloody nose and went home slowly.
bloody.exampleZh: 打架之后他鼻子流血，慢慢地走回了家。

bloom.example: The flowers in our garden bloom every spring, and the whole yard looks bright.
bloom.exampleZh: 我们花园里的花每年春天都会开放，整个院子看起来都很明亮。

blossom.example: The apple trees blossom every spring, and the whole garden looks beautiful.
blossom.exampleZh: 苹果树每年春天开花，整个花园看起来很美。

blow.example: The wind began to blow hard against the small wooden house.
blow.exampleZh: 风开始猛烈地吹打着那座小木屋。

blue.example: She wore a blue dress and looked a little sad.
blue.exampleZh: 她穿了一条蓝色的裙子，看起来有点忧郁。

blueprint.example: The team followed the blueprint to build the new school.
blueprint.exampleZh: 团队按照蓝图建造了新学校。

blunder.example: He made a big blunder at work and lost the client.
blunder.exampleZh: 他在工作中犯了个大错，失去了那位客户。

blunt.example: His blunt answer made everyone in the room feel a little uncomfortable.
blunt.exampleZh: 他直率的回答让房间里的每个人都感到有点不自在。

blur.example: Tears blurred my eyes, so the words on the page turned into a blur.
blur.exampleZh: 泪水模糊了我的双眼，页面上的字变成了一团模糊的东西。

blush.example: She began to blush when everyone looked at her new dress.
blush.exampleZh: 当所有人都看向她的新裙子时，她开始脸红了。

board.example: The board met this morning and agreed to build a new school.
board.exampleZh: 董事会今天上午开会，同意建一所新学校。

boast.example: She likes to boast about her son's success in school.
boast.exampleZh: 她喜欢夸耀儿子在学校的成功。

boat.example: We took a small boat across the lake and watched the birds.
boat.exampleZh: 我们乘小船穿过湖面，看着鸟儿。

body.example: The human body needs water and food to stay healthy.
body.exampleZh: 人体需要水和食物来保持健康。

boil.example: Please boil some water before you make the tea.
boil.exampleZh: 泡茶之前请先烧一些水。

bold.example: She made a bold choice to speak the truth.
bold.exampleZh: 她做出了大胆的选择，说出真相。

bolt.example: The worker used a strong bolt to fix the heavy metal door.
bolt.exampleZh: 工人用一根结实的螺栓固定住了那扇沉重的金属门。

bomb.example: The old bomb was found in the field and the police closed the road.
bomb.exampleZh: 那颗旧炸弹在田野里被发现，警察封锁了道路。

bond.example: The bond between the two sisters is very strong.
bond.exampleZh: 这对姐妹之间的纽带非常牢固。

bone.example: The dog is happy because it has a big bone in its mouth.
bone.exampleZh: 这只狗很开心，因为它嘴里叼着一根大骨头。

bonus.example: The workers got a small bonus at the end of the year.
bonus.exampleZh: 工人们在年底获得了一笔小小的奖金。

book.example: I want to book a room and buy a book about travel.
book.exampleZh: 我想预订一个房间，并买一本关于旅行的书。

booklet.example: The nurse gave me a small booklet about healthy eating.
booklet.exampleZh: 护士给了我一本关于健康饮食的小册子。

bookmark.example: I put a bookmark in the book so I can find that page later.
bookmark.exampleZh: 我在书里放了一枚书签，这样以后就能找到那一页。

bookshelf.example: I put the new dictionary on the top shelf of my bookshelf.
bookshelf.exampleZh: 我把新词典放在书架的最上层。

boom.example: The city's tech industry boom created many new jobs for young people.
boom.exampleZh: 这座城市的科技产业繁荣为年轻人创造了许多新工作。

boost.example: The new policy will boost the local economy next year.
boost.exampleZh: 新政策将在明年促进当地经济发展。

boot.example: He put his boots by the door before leaving.
boot.exampleZh: 他出门前把靴子放在门边。

border.example: The river forms the border between the two countries.
border.exampleZh: 这条河构成了两国之间的边界。

bore.example: The long movie began to bore the children after an hour.
bore.exampleZh: 那部漫长的电影放了一小时后开始让孩子们感到厌烦。

boring.example: This movie is so boring that I fell asleep twice.
boring.exampleZh: 这部电影太无聊了，我睡着了两次。

born.example: She was born in a small town near the sea.
born.exampleZh: 她出生在海边的一个小镇上。

borrow.example: Can I borrow your pen for a minute, please?
borrow.exampleZh: 我可以借你的笔用一下吗？

bosom.example: She held the sleeping baby close to her bosom.
bosom.exampleZh: 她把熟睡的婴儿紧紧抱在胸前。

boss.example: My boss asked me to finish the report before Friday.
boss.exampleZh: 我的老板让我在周五之前完成这份报告。

both.example: Both of my sisters like to read books before bed.
both.exampleZh: 我的两个姐妹都喜欢在睡前读书。

bother.example: Please do not bother your sister while she is studying for her exam.
bother.exampleZh: 你妹妹正在准备考试，请不要打扰她。

bottle.example: She put a bottle of cold water in her bag.
bottle.exampleZh: 她把一瓶冷水放进了包里。

bottleneck.example: The narrow bridge is a bottleneck for traffic every morning.
bottleneck.exampleZh: 那座窄桥每天早上都是交通瓶颈。

bottom.example: The keys are at the bottom of my bag.

bounce.example: The ball will bounce high if you throw it at the wall.
bounce.exampleZh: 如果你把球扔向墙壁，它会弹得很高。

bound.example: The train is bound for the coast and leaves at six.
bound.exampleZh: 这趟火车开往海岸，六点发车。

boundary.example: The river forms a natural boundary between the two small villages.
boundary.exampleZh: 这条河构成了两个小村庄之间的天然分界线。

bow.example: The actor gave a deep bow after the show and the crowd clapped.
bow.exampleZh: 演出结束后，那位演员深深鞠了一躬，观众鼓起掌来。

bowl.example: She put the hot soup in a large white bowl on the table.
bowl.exampleZh: 她把热汤盛在桌上一个大白碗里。

box.example: She put the old books in a box and carried it upstairs.
box.exampleZh: 她把旧书放进一个箱子里，然后把它搬到了楼上。

boy.example: The boy is playing football with his friends in the park.
boy.exampleZh: 那个男孩正在公园里和朋友们踢足球。

boycott.example: Many people decided to boycott the company after the news about its workers.
boycott.exampleZh: 在有关其工人的新闻传出后，许多人决定抵制这家公司。

bracket.example: Put the price in brackets next to the item name.
bracket.exampleZh: 把价格写在物品名称旁边的括号里。

brain.example: Reading good books every day can help your brain stay sharp.
brain.exampleZh: 每天读好书有助于让你的大脑保持敏锐。

brainstorm.example: We need to brainstorm new ideas for the school project tomorrow.
brainstorm.exampleZh: 我们明天需要为学校的项目进行头脑风暴，想出新点子。

brake.example: You must brake slowly when the light turns red.
brake.exampleZh: 红灯亮时你必须慢慢刹车。

branch.example: The bird sat on a branch of the old tree.
branch.exampleZh: 那只鸟停在老树的一根树枝上。

brand.example: This brand of coffee is very popular with young people.
brand.exampleZh: 这个品牌的咖啡很受年轻人欢迎。

brass.example: The old lamp is made of brass and looks very beautiful.
brass.exampleZh: 这盏旧灯是黄铜做的，看起来非常漂亮。

brave.example: The brave little girl saved her cat from the tree.
brave.exampleZh: 那个勇敢的小女孩把她的猫从树上救了下来。

breach.example: The company was fined for a serious breach of safety rules.
breach.exampleZh: 这家公司因严重违反安全规定而被罚款。

bread.example: We need to buy some bread and milk for breakfast tomorrow.
bread.exampleZh: 我们明天早餐需要买些面包和牛奶。

breadth.example: The breadth of the river made it hard for us to swim across.
breadth.exampleZh: 这条河的宽度让我们很难游过去。

break.example: Be careful not to break the glass on the table.
break.exampleZh: 小心不要打破桌上的玻璃杯。

breakdown.example: A sudden breakdown of the old machine stopped all work in the factory.
breakdown.exampleZh: 那台旧机器的突然故障使工厂的所有工作都停了下来。

breakfast.example: I eat breakfast with my family every morning before school.
breakfast.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前和家人一起吃早饭。

breakthrough.example: The new drug is a major breakthrough in cancer treatment.
breakthrough.exampleZh: 这种新药是癌症治疗领域的一项重大突破。

breast.example: The baby rested its head on its mother's breast and fell asleep.
breast.exampleZh: 婴儿把头靠在母亲的胸前，睡着了。
