breath.example: He took a deep breath before he began to speak.
breath.exampleZh: 他深吸一口气，然后开始说话。

breathe.example: She closed her eyes and took a moment to breathe slowly.
breathe.exampleZh: 她闭上眼睛，花了一点时间慢慢呼吸。

breed.example: Farmers breed cows and sheep on this small farm.
breed.exampleZh: 农民在这个小农场里饲养奶牛和绵羊。

breeze.example: A cool breeze came through the open window and made the curtains move.
breeze.exampleZh: 一阵凉爽的微风从敞开的窗户吹进来，把窗帘吹动了。

bribe.example: The manager tried to bribe the police officer with money.
bribe.exampleZh: 那个经理试图用钱贿赂警察。

brick.example: The old house was built with red brick and dark wood.
brick.exampleZh: 那座老房子是用红砖和深色木材建造的。

bridge.example: The old bridge across the river is very long and strong.
bridge.exampleZh: 河上那座旧桥又长又结实。

brief.example: The teacher gave a brief talk about the new class rules.
brief.exampleZh: 老师就新的班规做了简短的讲话。

briefly.example: She briefly explained the plan before the meeting started.
briefly.exampleZh: 她在会议开始前简短地解释了这个计划。

bright.example: The bright sun made the whole room warm and happy.
bright.exampleZh: 明亮的阳光让整个房间温暖而愉快。

brilliant.example: Her brilliant idea helped the whole team finish the hard project early.
brilliant.exampleZh: 她出色的想法帮助整个团队提前完成了这个困难的项目。

brim.example: The cup was full to the brim with cold water.
brim.exampleZh: 杯子里的冷水满到了杯沿。

bring.example: Please bring your notebook to class tomorrow morning.
bring.exampleZh: 请明天早上把笔记本带到课堂上来。

brisk.example: The morning air was brisk and cold, so we walked faster.
brisk.exampleZh: 早晨的空气清冷凛冽，所以我们走得更快了。

brittle.example: This old plastic chair is brittle and may break easily.
brittle.exampleZh: 这把旧塑料椅子很脆，容易断裂。

broad.example: The river is broad and deep near the old bridge.
broad.exampleZh: 这条河在旧桥附近又宽又深。

broadband.example: We need faster broadband at home for online classes and video calls.
broadband.exampleZh: 为了上网课和视频通话，我们需要家里有更快的宽带。

broadcast.example: The radio station will broadcast the football match live this evening.
broadcast.exampleZh: 广播电台今晚将现场直播这场足球比赛。

broaden.example: Reading books can broaden your mind and help you understand other people.
broaden.exampleZh: 读书可以拓宽你的视野，帮助你理解他人。

broadly.example: The two plans are broadly similar, though the details differ a little.
broadly.exampleZh: 这两个计划大体上相似，尽管细节略有不同。

brochure.example: I picked up a travel brochure at the airport before my holiday.
brochure.exampleZh: 我在机场拿了一本旅游宣传册，为假期做准备。

broken.example: The window is broken, so we cannot keep the room warm.
broken.exampleZh: 窗户破了，所以我们没法让房间保持温暖。

broker.example: My uncle works as a broker for a company in the city.
broker.exampleZh: 我叔叔在市里一家公司做经纪人。

bronze.example: The old statue in the park is made of bronze.
bronze.exampleZh: 公园里的那座旧雕像是由青铜制成的。

brood.example: The old hen will brood over her eggs until they hatch.
brood.exampleZh: 那只老母鸡会孵在蛋上，直到它们孵出来。

brook.example: A small brook runs behind our house and flows into the river.
brook.exampleZh: 一条小溪从我们家后面流过，并流入河中。

broom.example: She used an old broom to sweep the leaves off the front porch.
broom.exampleZh: 她用一把旧扫帚把前廊上的树叶扫掉。

brow.example: He wiped the sweat from his brow and looked at the mountain.
brow.exampleZh: 他擦了擦额头上的汗，望着那座山。

brown.example: She has brown hair and brown eyes like her mother.
brown.exampleZh: 她有着像她母亲一样的棕色头发和棕色眼睛。

browse.example: I like to browse the shops on my way home.
browse.exampleZh: 我喜欢在回家的路上逛逛商店。

bruise.example: She fell off her bike and got a bruise on her knee.
bruise.exampleZh: 她从自行车上摔下来，膝盖上留下了一块瘀伤。

brush.example: I use a small brush to clean my shoes after a walk.
brush.exampleZh: 散步之后，我用一把小刷子清洁我的鞋子。

brutal.example: The winter here is brutal, and many animals cannot survive it.
brutal.exampleZh: 这里的冬天非常严酷，许多动物无法存活。

bubble.example: A soap bubble floated up and popped in the air.
bubble.exampleZh: 一个肥皂泡飘上去，在空中破了。

bucket.example: He filled the bucket with water from the well.

bud.example: The little bud on the tree will open into a flower soon.
bud.exampleZh: 树上那个小花蕾很快就会开成一朵花。

budget.example: Our family has a small budget for food each month.
budget.exampleZh: 我们家每个月用于食物的预算很少。

buffer.example: This soft mat can buffer the shock when you jump down.
buffer.exampleZh: 这块软垫可以缓冲你跳下时的冲击。

bug.example: There is a small bug on the leaf, and my computer has a bug too.
bug.exampleZh: 叶子上有一只小虫子，我的电脑也有一个故障。

build.example: They plan to build a new school near the park next year.
build.exampleZh: 他们计划明年在公园附近建一所新学校。

building.example: The new building on our street is very tall and bright.
building.exampleZh: 我们街上的那栋新大楼又高又明亮。

bulb.example: She planted a tulip bulb in the garden last autumn.
bulb.exampleZh: 去年秋天她在花园里种下了一颗郁金香球茎。

bulge.example: The bag began to bulge with all the books inside it.
bulge.exampleZh: 包里的书太多，开始鼓了起来。

bulk.example: The bulk of the work is already done, so we can finish it tomorrow.
bulk.exampleZh: 大部分工作已经完成，所以我们可以明天把它做完。

bullet.example: The bullet hit the wall just above his head.
bullet.exampleZh: 那颗子弹正好打在他头顶上方的墙上。

bulletin.example: The school put a bulletin on the wall to tell students about the new schedule.
bulletin.exampleZh: 学校在墙上贴了一张公告，告诉学生新的日程安排。

bump.example: I bumped my head on the low door and got a small bump.
bump.exampleZh: 我的头撞到了低矮的门上，起了一个小肿块。

bunch.example: She gave me a bunch of red flowers for my birthday.
bunch.exampleZh: 她送给我一束红花作为生日礼物。

bundle.example: She carried a bundle of old newspapers to the recycling bin.
bundle.exampleZh: 她把一捆旧报纸拿到回收箱。

burden.example: The extra work became a heavy burden for the small team.
burden.exampleZh: 额外的工作成了这个小团队的沉重负担。

bureau.example: The travel bureau on Main Street can help you plan your trip.
bureau.exampleZh: 主街上的旅行社可以帮你规划行程。

bureaucracy.example: The new manager said that too much bureaucracy slows down everyday work in our office.
bureaucracy.exampleZh: 新经理说，过多的官僚程序拖慢了我们办公室的日常工作。

burial.example: The burial took place on a quiet hill near the old church.
burial.exampleZh: 葬礼在古老教堂附近一座安静的小山上举行。

burn.example: Be careful with that hot pan or you will burn your hand.
burn.exampleZh: 小心那个热锅，否则你会烫伤手。

burnout.example: Many nurses feel burnout after working long hours for months.
burnout.exampleZh: 许多护士在连续数月长时间工作后感到职业倦怠。

burst.example: The water pipe burst and flooded the whole kitchen floor.
burst.exampleZh: 水管爆裂了，淹了整个厨房的地板。

bury.example: He buried the old box under a big tree in the garden.
bury.exampleZh: 他把那个旧箱子埋在了花园里的一棵大树下。

bus.example: I take the bus to school every morning at seven.
bus.exampleZh: 我每天早上七点坐公共汽车去学校。

bush.example: There is a small bush in front of our house.
bush.exampleZh: 我们家门前有一小丛灌木。

business.example: My father runs a small business in the city center.
business.exampleZh: 我父亲在市中心经营一家小企业。

busy.example: My mother is always busy in the kitchen on Sunday mornings.
busy.exampleZh: 我妈妈星期天早上总是在厨房里忙个不停。

but.example: I want to go, but I have too much work today.
but.exampleZh: 我想去，但是今天工作太多了。

butcher.example: The butcher cut the meat into small pieces for us.
butcher.exampleZh: 屠夫把肉切成了小块给我们。

butter.example: She spreads butter on her toast every morning before school.
butter.exampleZh: 她每天早上上学前都会在吐司上涂黄油。

butterfly.example: A colorful butterfly landed on the flower in our garden.
butterfly.exampleZh: 一只色彩鲜艳的蝴蝶落在我们花园里的花上。

button.example: He pressed the red button to start the machine.
button.exampleZh: 他按下红色按钮启动了机器。

buy.example: I want to buy some fresh fruit for my family today.
buy.exampleZh: 我今天想给家人买一些新鲜水果。

buzz.example: The bees buzz around the flowers all morning.
buzz.exampleZh: 蜜蜂整个上午都在花丛周围嗡嗡叫。

cab.example: The cab stopped in front of the station and we got in quickly.
cab.exampleZh: 出租车停在车站前，我们很快上了车。

cabal.example: A small cabal met in secret to plan the takeover.
cabal.exampleZh: 一个小集团秘密会面，策划接管。

cabbage.example: My mother cooks cabbage with some pork for dinner.
cabbage.exampleZh: 我妈妈用一些猪肉和卷心菜做晚饭。

cabinet.example: She keeps the clean cups in the kitchen cabinet near the door.
cabinet.exampleZh: 她把干净的杯子放在门边厨房的橱柜里。

cable.example: They laid a new cable under the sea to carry electricity.
cable.exampleZh: 他们在海底铺设了一条新电缆来输送电力。

cache.example: The old man keeps a small cache of food under the floor.
cache.exampleZh: 那位老人在地板下藏着一小批食物。

cacophony.example: The cacophony of car horns made it hard to think.
cacophony.exampleZh: 汽车喇叭的刺耳声让人难以思考。

cactus.example: My mother grows a small cactus in a pot by the window.
cactus.exampleZh: 我妈妈在窗边的花盆里种了一棵小仙人掌。

cadaver.example: The students studied the cadaver carefully during their first anatomy class.
cadaver.exampleZh: 学生们在第一堂解剖课上仔细研究这具尸体。

caddy.example: The young caddy carried the heavy golf clubs for the tired player.
caddy.exampleZh: 年轻的球童为疲惫的球员背着沉重的高尔夫球杆。

cadence.example: The soldiers marched with a steady cadence down the long road.
cadence.exampleZh: 士兵们以平稳的节奏沿着长长的路行进。

cadenza.example: The violinist played a long cadenza before the orchestra returned.
cadenza.exampleZh: 小提琴手在乐队重新加入之前演奏了一段很长的华彩乐段。

cadet.example: The young cadet learns to march and follow orders every morning.
cadet.exampleZh: 这名年轻的军校学员每天早上学习队列行进和服从命令。

cadre.example: The party sent a young cadre to lead the village team.
cadre.exampleZh: 党派了一位年轻干部去带领村里的队伍。

cafe.example: We met at a small cafe near the station and talked for hours.
cafe.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近的一家小咖啡馆见面，聊了好几个小时。

cafeteria.example: We eat lunch in the school cafeteria every day.
cafeteria.exampleZh: 我们每天在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。

cage.example: The zookeeper put the sick bird in a small cage.
cage.exampleZh: 动物园管理员把生病的小鸟关进了一个小笼子里。

cajole.example: She cajoled her little brother into eating his vegetables.
cajole.exampleZh: 她哄骗她的小弟弟吃蔬菜。

cake.example: She made a big chocolate cake for her little brother's birthday.
cake.exampleZh: 她为弟弟的生日做了一个大巧克力蛋糕。

calamity.example: The storm was a real calamity for the small village.
calamity.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨对这个小村庄来说真是一场灾难。

calcium.example: Milk and cheese are good sources of calcium for growing children.
calcium.exampleZh: 牛奶和奶酪是成长中孩子钙的良好来源。

calculate.example: Please calculate the total cost of these books for me.
calculate.exampleZh: 请帮我计算这些书的总费用。

calculus.example: I find calculus difficult, but I practice it every day after class.
calculus.exampleZh: 我觉得微积分很难，但每天课后都会练习。

calendar.example: I wrote all my meetings on the new calendar in the kitchen.
calendar.exampleZh: 我把所有会议都写在了厨房里的新日历上。

calf.example: The farmer put the young calf next to its mother in the field.
calf.exampleZh: 农夫把小牛牵到田里放在它妈妈身边。

caliber.example: Everyone respects her because she is a teacher of high caliber.
caliber.exampleZh: 大家都尊敬她，因为她是一位能力出众的老师。

calibrate.example: Please calibrate the machine before you start it.
calibrate.exampleZh: 启动机器前请先校准它。

call.example: Please call me when you get home tonight.
call.exampleZh: 你今晚到家后请给我打电话。

calligraphy.example: She practices calligraphy every morning before school.
calligraphy.exampleZh: 她每天早上上学前练习书法。

callous.example: His callous words hurt the young girl deeply.
callous.exampleZh: 他冷酷无情的话深深伤害了那个小女孩。

calm.example: She stayed calm and helped the children find a safe way out.
calm.exampleZh: 她保持平静，帮助孩子们找到了安全的出路。

caloric.example: This sweet drink has high caloric content and is not good for you.
caloric.exampleZh: 这种甜饮料热量含量高，对你不好。

calorie.example: This small cake has many calories, so I only eat it on weekends.
calorie.exampleZh: 这个小蛋糕有很多卡路里，所以我只在周末吃它。

calumny.example: His calumny against the teacher was later proved to be completely false.
calumny.exampleZh: 他对这位老师的诽谤后来被证明完全是假的。

calve.example: The glacier began to calve large blocks of ice into the sea.
calve.exampleZh: 冰川开始崩解，将大块冰崩落入海中。

camaraderie.example: The soldiers felt great camaraderie after training together for many months.
camaraderie.exampleZh: 士兵们一起训练了好几个月后，感受到了深厚的同志情谊。

camel.example: The camel walked slowly across the hot desert with a heavy bag on its back.
camel.exampleZh: 骆驼背着沉重的袋子，缓慢地走过炎热的沙漠。

cameo.example: The famous actor made a brief cameo in the new film last night.
cameo.exampleZh: 那位著名演员昨晚在新电影里客串了一个小角色。

camera.example: She took a photo of the garden with her new camera.
camera.exampleZh: 她用她的新照相机拍了一张花园的照片。

camouflage.example: The soldiers used leaves and branches as camouflage in the forest.
camouflage.exampleZh: 士兵们在森林里用树叶和树枝作为伪装。

camp.example: We will camp near the lake and put up our tent there.
camp.exampleZh: 我们将在湖边露营，并在那里搭起帐篷。

campaign.example: The students started a campaign to keep their school clean and green.
campaign.exampleZh: 学生们发起了一场让学校保持干净绿色的运动。

campus.example: Our new campus is big and has a large library.
campus.exampleZh: 我们的新校区很大，还有一座大图书馆。

can.example: I can open a can of soup for lunch today.
can.exampleZh: 我今天午餐能打开一罐汤。

canal.example: The old canal runs through the city and brings water to many farms.
canal.exampleZh: 这条古老的运河穿过城市，为许多农场送水。

cancel.example: They had to cancel the picnic because of the heavy rain.
cancel.exampleZh: 由于大雨，他们不得不取消野餐。

cancer.example: Her father died of cancer last year after a long illness.
cancer.exampleZh: 她的父亲去年在长期患病后死于癌症。

candid.example: She gave a candid answer about her mistakes in the report.
candid.exampleZh: 她坦率地谈到了自己在报告中的错误。

candidate.example: She is a strong candidate for the job at our school.
candidate.exampleZh: 她是我们学校这份工作的有力候选人。

candle.example: She lit a candle on the table and turned off the light.
candle.exampleZh: 她点燃了桌上的蜡烛，然后关掉了灯。

candor.example: Her candor about the mistake made everyone trust her more.
candor.exampleZh: 她对错误的坦率让每个人都更信任她。

candy.example: The little boy ate too much candy at his birthday party.
candy.exampleZh: 那个小男孩在他的生日聚会上吃了太多糖果。

cane.example: The old man walked slowly down the road with a wooden cane.
cane.exampleZh: 那位老人拄着一根木手杖沿路慢慢走着。

canine.example: The dog's canine teeth are sharp and strong for biting.
canine.exampleZh: 这只狗的犬齿又尖又结实，适合咬东西。

cannibal.example: The cannibal in the old story lived alone in a dark cave.
cannibal.exampleZh: 那个古老故事里的食人者独自住在一个黑暗的山洞里。

cannon.example: The old cannon stands in front of the city museum.
cannon.exampleZh: 那门旧大炮矗立在城市博物馆前面。

cannot.example: I cannot carry this heavy box by myself.
cannot.exampleZh: 我一个人不能搬动这个沉重的箱子。

canoe.example: They put the small canoe into the river and rowed to the other side.
canoe.exampleZh: 他们把小独木舟放进河里，划到了对岸。

canon.example: This novel is now considered part of the canon of modern literature.
canon.exampleZh: 这部小说现在被视为现代文学经典的一部分。

canopy.example: The monkeys jumped from branch to branch high in the forest canopy.
canopy.exampleZh: 猴子们在森林高高的树冠上从一根树枝跳到另一根树枝。

canteen.example: We eat lunch in the school canteen every day at noon.
canteen.exampleZh: 我们每天中午都在学校食堂吃午饭。

canvas.example: The artist painted a bright blue sea on a large canvas.
canvas.exampleZh: 那位画家在一块大画布上画了一片明亮的蓝色大海。

canyon.example: The river runs through a deep canyon near our small town.
canyon.exampleZh: 这条河穿过我们小镇附近一个很深的峡谷。

cap.example: He took off his cap and put it on the table.
cap.exampleZh: 他摘下帽子，把它放在桌上。

capability.example: This phone has the capability to take very clear photos.
capability.exampleZh: 这部手机具备拍摄非常清晰照片的能力。

capable.example: She is capable of doing the work well.
capable.exampleZh: 她有能力把这项工作做好。

capacious.example: The new car has a capacious trunk for all our bags.
capacious.exampleZh: 这辆新车有一个容量很大的后备箱，能装下我们所有的包。

capacity.example: The room has a capacity of fifty people.
capacity.exampleZh: 这个房间的容量是五十人。

cape.example: We walked to the cape and watched the waves hit the rocks.
cape.exampleZh: 我们走到海角，看着海浪拍打岩石。

capillary.example: Tiny capillaries carry blood from small arteries to the veins.
capillary.exampleZh: 细小的毛细血管把血液从小动脉输送到静脉。

capital.example: Beijing is the capital of China and a very big city.
capital.exampleZh: 北京是中国的首都，也是一座非常大的城市。

capitulate.example: After a long fight, the small army decided to capitulate to the enemy.
capitulate.exampleZh: 经过长时间的战斗，这支小军队决定向敌人投降。

capsize.example: The small boat capsized in the strong wind near the shore.
capsize.exampleZh: 那艘小船在岸边附近的强风中翻覆了。

capsule.example: The astronaut climbed into the small capsule and waited for launch.
capsule.exampleZh: 宇航员爬进那个小太空舱，等待发射。

captain.example: The captain told his team to stay calm during the game.
captain.exampleZh: 队长告诉他的队员在比赛中保持冷静。

caption.example: The caption under the photo tells us where it was taken.
caption.exampleZh: 照片下方的说明文字告诉了我们它是在哪里拍摄的。

captivate.example: The little girl's smile can captivate everyone in the room.
captivate.exampleZh: 那个小女孩的笑容能迷住房间里的每一个人。

captive.example: The captive bird could not fly away from its small cage.
captive.exampleZh: 那只被俘的鸟无法飞离它的小笼子。

capture.example: The police set a trap to capture the thief last night.
capture.exampleZh: 警察昨晚设下陷阱来抓住那个小偷。

car.example: My father drives a new car to work every morning.
car.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上开一辆新车去上班。

caramel.example: She likes caramel on her ice cream in the summer.
caramel.exampleZh: 夏天她喜欢在冰淇淋上放焦糖。

carat.example: She bought a one carat diamond ring for her sister.
carat.exampleZh: 她给妹妹买了一枚一克拉的钻戒。

caravan.example: The caravan traveled slowly across the hot desert for many days.
caravan.exampleZh: 这支商队在炎热的沙漠中缓慢行进，走了很多天。

carbohydrate.example: Rice and bread are good sources of carbohydrate for your body.
carbohydrate.exampleZh: 米饭和面包是你身体所需的碳水化合物的良好来源。

carbon.example: Carbon is a key element in all living things on Earth.
carbon.exampleZh: 碳是地球上所有生物体内的关键元素。

carcass.example: Farmers found the carcass of a wild deer near the river bank.
carcass.exampleZh: 农民们在河岸边发现了一具野鹿的尸体。

carcinogen.example: Radon gas is a known carcinogen that can cause lung cancer.
carcinogen.exampleZh: 氡气是一种已知的致癌物，可能导致肺癌。

card.example: She gave me her card and asked me to call her tomorrow.
card.exampleZh: 她给了我她的名片，让我明天给她打电话。

cardiac.example: The doctor said his cardiac problem needs careful treatment.
cardiac.exampleZh: 医生说他的心脏问题需要小心治疗。

cardinal.example: The cardinal rule is to stay calm and listen carefully.
cardinal.exampleZh: 最基本的原则是保持冷静并仔细倾听。

care.example: I care about my old parents and visit them every Sunday.
care.exampleZh: 我关心年迈的父母，每个周日都去看望他们。

careen.example: The old truck began to careen down the narrow street after its brakes failed.
careen.exampleZh: 刹车失灵后，那辆旧卡车开始歪歪斜斜地沿着窄街冲下去。

career.example: My sister wants a career in medicine after she finishes school.
career.exampleZh: 我姐姐想毕业后从事医学方面的职业。

careful.example: Please be careful when you cross this busy street.
careful.exampleZh: 过这条繁忙的街道时请小心。

careless.example: He lost his keys because he was too careless.
careless.exampleZh: 他太粗心了，结果把钥匙弄丢了。

caress.example: She gently caressed the sleepy cat on her lap.
caress.exampleZh: 她轻轻抚摸着腿上昏昏欲睡的猫。

caretaker.example: The caretaker locks the school gate every evening after the students leave.
caretaker.exampleZh: 学生们离开后，看管人每天晚上都会锁上学校的大门。

cargo.example: The big ship is carrying a cargo of rice to Africa.
cargo.exampleZh: 这艘大船正载着一批大米运往非洲。

caricature.example: The newspaper printed a funny caricature of the mayor on its front page.
caricature.exampleZh: 报纸在头版刊登了一幅滑稽的市长漫画。

carnage.example: The war left behind great carnage in the small town.
carnage.exampleZh: 这场战争在这个小镇留下了惨烈的大屠杀。

carnal.example: He tried to ignore his carnal desires and focus on his studies.
carnal.exampleZh: 他试图忽略肉体的欲望，专心学习。

carnival.example: The whole town wears bright costumes and dances in the street during the carnival.
carnival.exampleZh: 狂欢节期间，全镇的人都穿上鲜艳的服装，在街上跳舞。

carnivore.example: The lion is a strong carnivore that hunts other animals for food.
carnivore.exampleZh: 狮子是一种强壮的食肉动物，捕猎其他动物为食。

carol.example: The children sang a carol at the door on Christmas Eve.
carol.exampleZh: 孩子们在平安夜门口唱了一首颂歌。

carouse.example: They caroused all night after the game and sang loudly in the street.
carouse.exampleZh: 比赛结束后他们整夜狂欢畅饮，还在街上大声唱歌。

carp.example: My mother always carps about the food on the table.
carp.exampleZh: 我妈妈总是挑剔桌上的饭菜。

carpet.example: We bought a soft new carpet for the living room floor.
carpet.exampleZh: 我们为客厅地板买了一块柔软的新地毯。

carriage.example: The old carriage rolled slowly down the quiet street.
carriage.exampleZh: 那辆旧马车沿着安静的街道缓慢前行。

carrier.example: The airline is a major carrier of passengers between the two cities.
carrier.exampleZh: 这家航空公司是这两座城市之间的主要客运承运商。

carrion.example: The vultures flew down to eat the carrion on the road.
carrion.exampleZh: 秃鹫飞下来吃路上的腐肉。

carrot.example: The rabbit eats a carrot in the garden every morning.
carrot.exampleZh: 兔子每天早上在花园里吃一根胡萝卜。

carry.example: I always carry an umbrella in my bag on rainy days.
carry.exampleZh: 下雨天我总会在包里带一把伞。

cart.example: The farmer used a cart to carry the heavy bags of grain.
cart.exampleZh: 农民用手推车运送那些沉重的谷袋。

cartel.example: The companies formed a cartel to fix prices and control the market.
cartel.exampleZh: 这些公司组成了一个卡特尔，操纵价格并控制市场。

cartography.example: She studied cartography in college because she loved drawing maps.
cartography.exampleZh: 她在大学学习制图学，因为她喜欢绘制地图。

cartoon.example: My little sister watches a funny cartoon every morning before school.
cartoon.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上去上学前都会看一部有趣的卡通。

carve.example: The artist likes to carve small animals out of wood.
carve.exampleZh: 这位艺术家喜欢用木头雕刻小动物。

cascade.example: The clear water falls in a small cascade down the rocks.
cascade.exampleZh: 清澈的水顺着岩石倾泻而下，形成一个小瀑布。

case.example: In this case, the doctor said the box was safe.
case.exampleZh: 在这种情况下，医生说这个箱子是安全的。

casein.example: Casein is the main protein found in milk and cheese.
casein.exampleZh: 酪蛋白是牛奶和奶酪中的主要蛋白质。

cash.example: I have no cash with me, so can I pay by card?
cash.exampleZh: 我身上没带现金，所以可以刷卡吗？

casino.example: My uncle lost a lot of money at the casino last night.
casino.exampleZh: 我叔叔昨晚在赌场输了很多钱。

cask.example: He filled the large cask with fresh water from the well.
cask.exampleZh: 他把大木桶装满了从井里打来的清水。

cassette.example: I found an old cassette with my favorite songs in the drawer.
cassette.exampleZh: 我在抽屉里找到了一盒录着我最喜欢的歌的旧磁带。

cast.example: The director chose a strong cast for the new film about a family.
cast.exampleZh: 导演为这部关于一个家庭的新电影挑选了强大的演员阵容。

caste.example: In some countries, people still face unfair treatment because of their caste.
caste.exampleZh: 在一些国家，人们仍然因为种姓而受到不公平的对待。

castigate.example: The teacher castigated the students for being late again.
castigate.exampleZh: 老师严厉批评了学生们再次迟到。

castle.example: The old castle stands on a hill near the river.
castle.exampleZh: 那座古老的城堡坐落在河边的山上。

casual.example: She wore casual clothes and spoke in a friendly, relaxed way.
casual.exampleZh: 她穿着随意的衣服，说话友好而放松。

casualty.example: The accident caused several casualties among the workers at the factory.
casualty.exampleZh: 这起事故造成工厂里几名工人伤亡。

cat.example: The black cat sleeps on the warm chair by the window.
cat.exampleZh: 那只黑猫睡在窗边温暖的椅子上。

cataclysm.example: The flood was a cataclysm that changed the whole village forever.
cataclysm.exampleZh: 那场洪水是一场大灾难，永远改变了整个村庄。

catalog.example: The library keeps a catalog of all its books and magazines.
catalog.exampleZh: 图书馆保存着所有书籍和杂志的目录。

catalyst.example: The new policy acted as a catalyst for change in the industry.
catalyst.exampleZh: 新政策成为了该行业变革的催化剂。

catapult.example: The old catapult threw a heavy stone over the high wall.
catapult.exampleZh: 那台旧弹射器把一块沉重的石头抛过了高墙。

cataract.example: The old man cannot see well because a cataract is growing in his eye.
cataract.exampleZh: 这位老人看不清东西，因为他的眼睛里长了一块白内障。

catastrophe.example: The flood was a catastrophe for the small town and its people.
catastrophe.exampleZh: 这场洪水对这个小镇和镇上的人们来说是一场大灾难。

catch.example: I ran to catch the bus but it had already left.
catch.exampleZh: 我跑着去赶公交车，但它已经开走了。

categorize.example: Teachers often categorize students by age and grade in every school.
categorize.exampleZh: 每所学校的老师通常按年龄和年级给学生分类。

category.example: Each book in the library belongs to a different category.
category.exampleZh: 图书馆里的每本书都属于不同的类别。

cater.example: The small restaurant can cater for weddings and other big parties.
cater.exampleZh: 这家小餐馆能为婚礼和其他大型聚会承办酒席。

caterpillar.example: A green caterpillar is eating a leaf on the tree.
caterpillar.exampleZh: 一条绿色的毛毛虫正在吃树上的一片叶子。

catharsis.example: Crying at the movie gave her a sense of catharsis.
catharsis.exampleZh: 看那部电影时哭泣让她感到一种宣泄。

cathedral.example: The old cathedral stands in the middle of the city.
cathedral.exampleZh: 这座古老的大教堂坐落在城市中心。

cathode.example: The electrons flow from the cathode to the anode in this simple battery.
cathode.exampleZh: 在这个简单的电池中，电子从阴极流向阳极。

catholic.example: My grandmother is a Catholic, and she goes to church every Sunday morning.
catholic.exampleZh: 我奶奶是天主教徒，她每个星期天早上都去教堂。

cattle.example: The farmer keeps cattle on his small farm near the river.
cattle.exampleZh: 这位农民在河边的小农场里养牛。

caucus.example: The party held a caucus to choose its new leader.
caucus.exampleZh: 该党举行了一次核心小组会议来选举新的领导人。

caulk.example: We need to caulk the windows before the cold winter comes.
caulk.exampleZh: 我们需要在寒冷的冬天到来之前给窗户填缝。

causal.example: The study found a causal link between smoking and lung cancer.
causal.exampleZh: 这项研究发现了吸烟与肺癌之间的因果关系。

cause.example: The heavy rain caused a big problem for the whole city.
cause.exampleZh: 大雨给整座城市造成了一个大问题。

causeway.example: We walked along the narrow causeway to reach the small island.
causeway.exampleZh: 我们沿着狭窄的堤道走到那座小岛上。

caustic.example: His caustic words hurt her feelings, but he did not care.
caustic.exampleZh: 他尖刻的话伤了她的感情，但他并不在乎。

caution.example: Please use caution when you cross this busy street.
caution.exampleZh: 过这条繁忙的街道时请小心。

cavalier.example: He was too cavalier about other people's feelings, and nobody liked him.
cavalier.exampleZh: 他对别人的感受太傲慢，没人喜欢他。

cavalry.example: The cavalry rode quickly across the open field to help the soldiers.
cavalry.exampleZh: 骑兵迅速穿过开阔的田野去帮助士兵们。

cave.example: We walked into a dark cave and heard water dripping somewhere.
cave.exampleZh: 我们走进一个黑暗的洞穴，听到某处有水滴落的声音。

caveat.example: There is one important caveat about this plan we must discuss.
caveat.exampleZh: 关于这个计划，有一个重要的限制性条件我们必须讨论。

cavern.example: The hikers found a dark cavern deep in the mountain.
cavern.exampleZh: 徒步旅行者在大山深处发现了一个黑暗的大洞穴。

caviar.example: She spread a little caviar on the bread and smiled at her guests.
caviar.exampleZh: 她在面包上抹了一点鱼子酱，并对客人们微笑。

cavity.example: The dentist found a small cavity in my tooth yesterday.
cavity.exampleZh: 牙医昨天在我的牙上发现了一个小龋洞。

cease.example: The rain did not cease until late that night.
cease.exampleZh: 雨一直下到那天深夜才停。

cedar.example: Our old house has a tall cedar tree in the front yard.
cedar.exampleZh: 我们家的老房子前院里有一棵高大的雪松。

cede.example: They had to cede the small island to their stronger neighbor.
cede.exampleZh: 他们不得不把这座小岛割让给更强大的邻国。

ceiling.example: The lamp hangs from the ceiling above the kitchen table.
ceiling.exampleZh: 那盏灯挂在厨房桌子上方的天花板上。

celebrate.example: We celebrate her birthday with a small party at home.
celebrate.exampleZh: 我们在家举办一个小型聚会庆祝她的生日。

celebrated.example: This celebrated writer has published many books for young readers.
celebrated.exampleZh: 这位著名作家出版了许多面向年轻读者的书。

celebrity.example: The young celebrity smiled and waved at the crowd of fans.
celebrity.exampleZh: 这位年轻的名人微笑着向人群中的粉丝挥手。

celery.example: She cut some celery and put it in the soup.
celery.exampleZh: 她切了些芹菜放进汤里。

celestial.example: The stars and the moon are celestial bodies in the night sky.
celestial.exampleZh: 星星和月亮是夜空中的天体。

cell.example: The cell is very small and you can only see it under a microscope.
cell.exampleZh: 这个细胞非常小，只有在显微镜下才能看到。

cellar.example: There is an old wooden table in the cellar of our house.
cellar.exampleZh: 我们家地窖里有一张旧木桌。

cellular.example: The scientist studied the cellular structure of the plant under a microscope.
cellular.exampleZh: 科学家在显微镜下研究了这种植物的细胞结构。

celluloid.example: This old film was made with celluloid and stored in a metal box.
celluloid.exampleZh: 这部老电影是用赛璐珞制作的，被存放在一个金属盒子里。

cement.example: We used cement to fix the broken wall and cement our friendship.
cement.exampleZh: 我们用水泥修补破损的墙，也巩固了彼此的友谊。

cemetery.example: We walked slowly through the old cemetery and read the names on the stones.
cemetery.exampleZh: 我们慢慢走过那座古老的墓地，读着石碑上的名字。

censor.example: The censor removed several scenes from the film before it was shown.
censor.exampleZh: 审查员在电影放映前删掉了几个场景。

censure.example: The council voted to censure the mayor for his poor decisions.
censure.exampleZh: 议会投票决定谴责市长做出的糟糕决定。

census.example: The government does a census every ten years to count all the people.
census.exampleZh: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查，统计所有人口。

cent.example: I only have one cent left in my pocket today.
cent.exampleZh: 我今天口袋里只剩下一分钱了。

centaur.example: In the old story, a centaur taught the young hero how to shoot a bow.
centaur.exampleZh: 在那个古老的故事里，一位半人马教年轻的英雄如何射箭。

centenary.example: The school held a big party for its centenary last year.
centenary.exampleZh: 学校去年为建校一百周年举办了一场盛大的庆祝活动。

center.example: Please put the chair in the center of the room.
center.exampleZh: 请把椅子放在房间的中央。

centigrade.example: The temperature outside is twenty degrees centigrade today.
centigrade.exampleZh: 今天外面的温度是二十摄氏度。

centimeter.example: The small box is only ten centimeters wide and five centimeters tall.
centimeter.exampleZh: 这个小盒子只有十厘米宽、五厘米高。

centipede.example: I found a long centipede under the stone in our garden.
centipede.exampleZh: 我在我们花园里的石头下面发现了一条长蜈蚣。

central.example: The library is in a central part of the city.
central.exampleZh: 图书馆位于城市的中心地带。

centralize.example: The company decided to centralize all its data in one safe system.
centralize.exampleZh: 公司决定将所有数据集中到一个安全系统中。

century.example: This old bridge was built more than a century ago.
century.exampleZh: 这座古老的桥建于一个多世纪以前。

ceramic.example: She bought a beautiful ceramic bowl for her mother's birthday.
ceramic.exampleZh: 她为母亲的生日买了一个漂亮的陶瓷碗。

cereal.example: I eat cereal with milk every morning before school.
cereal.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前都吃加牛奶的谷物食品。

cerebral.example: Reading books is a cerebral activity that keeps your mind sharp.
cerebral.exampleZh: 读书是一项锻炼大脑的活动，能让你的思维保持敏锐。

ceremony.example: The wedding ceremony will begin at ten in the morning.
ceremony.exampleZh: 婚礼仪式将于上午十点开始。

certain.example: I am certain that she will come to the party tonight.
certain.exampleZh: 我确定她今晚会来参加聚会。

certainty.example: There is no certainty that the plan will work.
certainty.exampleZh: 这个计划能否成功并没有确定性。

certificate.example: She got her certificate after finishing the training course last month.
certificate.exampleZh: 她上个月完成培训课程后拿到了证书。

certify.example: The doctor must certify that he is healthy enough to work.
certify.exampleZh: 医生必须证明他身体健康，足以胜任工作。

certitude.example: She spoke with certitude about the plan, and everyone trusted her.
certitude.exampleZh: 她满怀确信地谈论这个计划，大家都信任她。

cessation.example: The two sides agreed to a cessation of fighting before the peace talks began.
cessation.exampleZh: 双方同意在和谈开始前停止战斗。

chafe.example: The rough collar began to chafe his neck after a long day.
chafe.exampleZh: 粗糙的衣领在漫长的一天后开始擦破他的脖子。

chaff.example: The farmer separated the wheat from the chaff after the autumn harvest.
chaff.exampleZh: 秋收之后，农夫把麦粒和谷壳分开。

chain.example: The old dog was tied with a strong chain to the gate.
chain.exampleZh: 那只老狗被一条结实的链子拴在门上。

chair.example: She sat on a wooden chair and read a book by the window.
chair.exampleZh: 她坐在木椅上，在窗边读一本书。

chairman.example: The chairman will speak to all the workers this morning.
chairman.exampleZh: 主席今天上午将向全体工人讲话。

chalice.example: The old king drank wine from a golden chalice at the feast.
chalice.exampleZh: 宴会上，年迈的国王用一个金圣杯喝酒。

chalk.example: The teacher wrote the new word on the board with a piece of white chalk.
chalk.exampleZh: 老师用一支白粉笔把这个新单词写在了黑板上。

challenge.example: Learning a new language is a big challenge, but I enjoy it.
challenge.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言是个很大的挑战，但我很享受。

chamber.example: The old king sat alone in a quiet chamber of the castle.
chamber.exampleZh: 年迈的国王独自坐在城堡一间安静的房间里。

champ.example: Our team worked hard and finally became the champ this year.
champ.exampleZh: 我们队努力拼搏，今年终于成为了冠军。

champagne.example: We drank a bottle of champagne to celebrate her birthday.
champagne.exampleZh: 我们喝了一瓶香槟来庆祝她的生日。

champion.example: She is the world champion, and she champions young girls in sports.
champion.exampleZh: 她是世界冠军，也是年轻女孩参与体育运动的拥护者。

chance.example: There is a good chance that we will finish the work today.
chance.exampleZh: 我们今天很有可能完成这项工作。

chancellor.example: The new chancellor promised to help students and teachers at the university.
chancellor.exampleZh: 新任校长承诺帮助大学的师生。

change.example: I want to change my old phone and buy a new one.
change.exampleZh: 我想换掉旧手机，买一部新的。

channel.example: This TV channel shows English news for students every morning.
channel.exampleZh: 这个电视频道每天早上为学生播放英语新闻。

chant.example: The crowd began to chant his name after the final goal.
chant.exampleZh: 终场进球后，人群开始反复呼喊他的名字。

chaos.example: The sudden power cut left the whole building in complete chaos.
chaos.exampleZh: 突然停电让整栋大楼陷入了彻底的混乱。

chap.example: The young chap at the counter helped me find my lost bag.
chap.exampleZh: 柜台边的那个小伙子帮我找到了丢失的包。

chapel.example: The old chapel stands quietly beside the river near our small village.
chapel.exampleZh: 那座古老的小教堂静静地矗立在我们小村庄附近的河边。

chapter.example: The first chapter of this book is easy to read.
chapter.exampleZh: 这本书的第一章很容易读。

char.example: The meat will char quickly if you leave it on the hot fire.
char.exampleZh: 如果你把肉放在旺火上不管，它很快就会烧焦。

character.example: He is a quiet boy with a kind and gentle character.
character.exampleZh: 他是一个性格温和善良的安静男孩。

characteristic.example: Kindness is a good characteristic of a true friend.
characteristic.exampleZh: 善良是真正朋友的一个良好特征。

characterize.example: Her warm smile and kind words characterize everything she does for us.
characterize.exampleZh: 她温暖的微笑和亲切的话语，是她为我们所做的一切的特点。

charcoal.example: We used charcoal to draw a big tree on the paper.
charcoal.exampleZh: 我们用炭笔在纸上画了一棵大树。

charge.example: The hotel will charge you extra if you use the minibar.
charge.exampleZh: 如果你使用迷你吧，酒店会向你额外收费。

charisma.example: The young leader had great charisma and won the trust of everyone.
charisma.exampleZh: 这位年轻领袖很有魅力，赢得了所有人的信任。

charismatic.example: She is a charismatic leader, and everyone on the team trusts her.
charismatic.exampleZh: 她是一位有魅力的领导者，团队里的每个人都信任她。

charity.example: She gives some money to charity every year to help poor children.
charity.exampleZh: 她每年都会捐一些钱给慈善机构，用来帮助贫困儿童。

charlatan.example: The doctor turned out to be a charlatan who knew nothing about medicine.
charlatan.exampleZh: 那个医生原来是个对医学一无所知的江湖骗子。

charm.example: Her smile has a natural charm that makes everyone feel welcome.
charm.exampleZh: 她的微笑有一种自然的魅力，让每个人都感到亲切。

chart.example: The teacher drew a simple chart to show the class how prices changed.
chart.exampleZh: 老师画了一张简单的图表，向全班展示价格是如何变化的。

charter.example: The king signed a charter that gave the city new rights.
charter.exampleZh: 国王签署了一份特许状，赋予了这座城市新的权利。

chase.example: The dog likes to chase rabbits in the park every morning.
chase.exampleZh: 这只狗喜欢每天早上在公园里追兔子。

chasm.example: There is a deep chasm between what they promise and what they do.
chasm.exampleZh: 他们承诺的和他们做的之间存在巨大的分歧。

chassis.example: The mechanic checked the chassis of the old car for rust.
chassis.exampleZh: 机械师检查了那辆旧车的底盘有没有生锈。

chaste.example: She lived a chaste and simple life in the small village.
chaste.exampleZh: 她在小村庄里过着贞洁而简朴的生活。

chastise.example: The teacher had to chastise the boys for talking loudly during the test.
chastise.exampleZh: 老师不得不严厉斥责那些男孩在考试时大声说话。

chat.example: We often chat with our neighbors after dinner on warm summer evenings.
chat.exampleZh: 在温暖的夏日傍晚，我们常在晚饭后和邻居聊天。

chatter.example: The birds chatter loudly in the trees every morning.
chatter.exampleZh: 鸟儿每天早上在树上大声地叽叽喳喳。

chauffeur.example: The chauffeur opened the car door for the old man.
chauffeur.exampleZh: 司机为那位老人打开了车门。

chauvinist.example: My uncle is a chauvinist who thinks men should always lead at work.
chauvinist.exampleZh: 我叔叔是个沙文主义者，他认为在工作中男人应该总是当领导。

cheap.example: This cheap shirt looks nice but it feels a little rough.
cheap.exampleZh: 这件便宜的衬衫看起来不错，但摸起来有点粗糙。

cheat.example: He tried to cheat on the test, but the teacher saw him.
cheat.exampleZh: 他考试想作弊，但被老师看见了。

check.example: Please check your answers again before you hand in the test paper.
check.exampleZh: 交试卷之前请再检查一遍你的答案。

cheek.example: The little girl touched her cheek and smiled at her mother.
cheek.exampleZh: 小女孩摸了摸自己的面颊，对妈妈笑了。

cheer.example: The loud cheers from the crowd filled the whole hall with joy.
cheer.exampleZh: 人群中响亮的欢呼声让整个大厅充满了喜悦。

cheese.example: I like cheese on my bread and a glass of milk.
cheese.exampleZh: 我喜欢在面包上放奶酪，再配一杯牛奶。

chef.example: The chef in our hotel makes very good soup every morning.
chef.exampleZh: 我们酒店的主厨每天早上都做非常好喝的汤。

chemical.example: Farmers should not use too many chemicals on the food we eat.
chemical.exampleZh: 农民不应该在我们食用的食物上使用太多化学物质。

chemotherapy.example: The doctor said she needs chemotherapy for six months.
chemotherapy.exampleZh: 医生说她已经需要化疗六个月了。

cherish.example: I cherish every moment I spend with my family.
cherish.exampleZh: 我珍爱与家人共度的每一刻。

cherry.example: The little girl ate a sweet red cherry from the bowl.
cherry.exampleZh: 小女孩从碗里吃了一颗甜甜的红樱桃。

cherub.example: The little boy looked like a cherub in his white shirt.
cherub.exampleZh: 那个小男孩穿着白衬衫，看起来像个小天使。

chess.example: My brother and I play chess every Sunday afternoon at home.
chess.exampleZh: 我哥哥和我每个星期天下午都在家下国际象棋。

chest.example: He put his hand on his chest and took a deep breath.
chest.exampleZh: 他把手放在胸口，深吸了一口气。

chew.example: Please chew your food slowly and think about your answer.
chew.exampleZh: 请慢慢咀嚼食物，并思考你的答案。

chic.example: She wore a chic black dress to the party last night.
chic.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条时髦的黑色连衣裙去参加聚会。

chicanery.example: He got the money by chicanery, not by honest work.
chicanery.exampleZh: 他靠诡计而不是诚实工作得到了这笔钱。

chick.example: The little chick follows the mother hen around the farm.
chick.exampleZh: 那只小鸡跟着母鸡在农场里到处走。

chicken.example: My mother cooks chicken with rice for dinner every Sunday.
chicken.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天晚餐都做鸡肉配米饭。

chief.example: The chief reason we moved here is the good school nearby.
chief.exampleZh: 我们搬到这里的主要原因是附近有一所好学校。

child.example: Every child in the class got a small book from the teacher.
child.exampleZh: 班上的每个孩子都从老师那里得到了一本小书。

childhood.example: My childhood was full of fun and happy days with my family.
childhood.exampleZh: 我的童年充满了与家人在一起的乐趣和快乐时光。

chill.example: The air turns chill at night, so bring a warm coat.
chill.exampleZh: 夜里空气变冷了，所以带上一件暖和的外套。

chime.example: The chime of the old clock woke me up this morning.
chime.exampleZh: 今天早上，老钟的钟声把我吵醒了。

chimera.example: The monster in the old story was a chimera with a lion's head.
chimera.exampleZh: 那个古老故事里的怪物是一只长着狮子头的嵌合体。

chimney.example: Smoke from the old chimney rose slowly into the cold winter sky.
chimney.exampleZh: 烟从旧烟囱里缓缓升起，飘入寒冷的冬日天空。

chin.example: He rested his chin on his hand and listened to the teacher.
chin.exampleZh: 他把下巴搁在手上，听老师讲课。

chip.example: The glass broke and left small chips on the kitchen floor.
chip.exampleZh: 玻璃碎了，在厨房地板上留下了小碎片。

chisel.example: He used a chisel to cut the wood into a small shape.
chisel.exampleZh: 他用凿子把木头凿成一个小形状。

chivalry.example: He showed true chivalry by helping the old lady carry her bags.
chivalry.exampleZh: 他帮老太太提包，展现了真正的骑士精神。

chlorine.example: The swimming pool smells strongly of chlorine in the summer.
chlorine.exampleZh: 夏天游泳池里有很浓的氯味。

chocolate.example: She bought a small box of chocolate for her mother's birthday.
chocolate.exampleZh: 她为妈妈的生日买了一小盒巧克力。

choice.example: The menu gives you a choice of three simple meals.
choice.exampleZh: 菜单上有三种简单餐食供你选择。

choir.example: The church choir sings beautiful songs every Sunday morning.
choir.exampleZh: 教堂唱诗班每个星期天早上都唱优美的歌曲。

choke.example: The thick smoke made him choke and he ran outside for fresh air.
choke.exampleZh: 浓烟让他窒息，他跑到外面呼吸新鲜空气。

choleric.example: My choleric uncle gets angry over the smallest things every single day.
choleric.exampleZh: 我那位暴躁的叔叔每天都会为最细小的事情发火。

choose.example: You can choose the red one or the blue one.
choose.exampleZh: 你可以选择红色的那个或蓝色的那个。

chop.example: She used a sharp knife to chop the onions for dinner.
chop.exampleZh: 她用一把锋利的刀剁洋葱准备晚饭。

chord.example: She played a soft chord on the old piano in the corner.
chord.exampleZh: 她在角落里的旧钢琴上轻轻弹了一个和弦。

chore.example: Washing dishes is my least favorite chore at home.
chore.exampleZh: 洗碗是我在家里最不喜欢的家务活。

choreography.example: The choreography in the final scene was simple but very beautiful.
choreography.exampleZh: 最后一场的编舞简单却非常优美。

chorus.example: The whole school sang the chorus together at the end of the song.
chorus.exampleZh: 整所学校在歌曲结尾一起唱了副歌。

christ.example: Many people around the world read stories about Christ in the Bible.
christ.exampleZh: 世界上许多人阅读《圣经》中关于基督的故事。

christen.example: The priest will christen the baby in the small church on Sunday.
christen.exampleZh: 牧师将在星期天在那座小教堂为婴儿施洗并命名。

christian.example: My neighbor is a Christian who goes to church every Sunday.
christian.exampleZh: 我的邻居是基督徒，每个星期天都去教堂。

chromatic.example: The old film shows the city in a warm chromatic light.
chromatic.exampleZh: 这部老电影以温暖的色彩光线展现这座城市。

chronic.example: He has a chronic cough that never seems to go away.
chronic.exampleZh: 他有一种似乎永远好不了的慢性咳嗽。

chronicle.example: This old book is a chronicle of our town's long history.
chronicle.exampleZh: 这本旧书是我们小镇悠久历史的编年史。

chronological.example: Please put these photos in chronological order, from oldest to newest.
chronological.exampleZh: 请把这些照片按时间顺序排列，从最旧的到最新的。

chrysanthemum.example: My grandmother grows yellow chrysanthemums in her garden every autumn.
chrysanthemum.exampleZh: 我奶奶每年秋天都在她的花园里种黄色的菊花。

chuck.example: Please chuck that old box in the bin before you leave.
chuck.exampleZh: 请在你离开前把那个旧箱子扔进垃圾桶。

chuckle.example: She chuckled softly when she heard the funny story about her old dog.
chuckle.exampleZh: 听到那个关于她老狗的搞笑故事时，她轻轻地笑了。

chum.example: My old chum from school came to visit me last week.
chum.exampleZh: 我上学时的老好友上周来看我了。

chunk.example: She cut the cake into a large chunk and gave it to me.
chunk.exampleZh: 她把蛋糕切成一大块，递给了我。

church.example: The old church stands near the river in our small town.
church.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂坐落在我们小镇的河边。

churlish.example: It was churlish of him to refuse her simple request.
churlish.exampleZh: 他拒绝她这个简单的请求，显得很粗鲁。

churn.example: The machine churns the milk until it becomes smooth butter.
churn.exampleZh: 这台机器搅拌牛奶，直到它变成顺滑的黄油。

cicada.example: Every summer, the cicadas sing loudly in the trees behind our house.
cicada.exampleZh: 每年夏天，蝉都会在我们屋后的树上大声鸣叫。

cider.example: My grandfather makes sweet cider from the apples in his garden.
cider.exampleZh: 我爷爷用他花园里的苹果酿制甜苹果酒。

cigar.example: My grandfather likes to smoke a cigar after dinner on Sundays.
cigar.exampleZh: 我爷爷喜欢在周日晚饭后抽一支雪茄。

cigarette.example: My father always smokes a cigarette after dinner in the garden.
cigarette.exampleZh: 我父亲总是在晚饭后在花园里抽一支香烟。

cinema.example: We went to the cinema last night to see a new film.
cinema.exampleZh: 我们昨晚去电影院看了一部新电影。

cipher.example: The spy wrote his message in cipher so no one could read it.
cipher.exampleZh: 间谍用密码写信息，这样没人能读懂。

circle.example: The children sat in a circle and sang songs together.
circle.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐成一个圆圈，一起唱歌。

circuit.example: The electricity flows through the circuit and lights up the small bulb.
circuit.exampleZh: 电流通过电路，点亮了那只小灯泡。

circular.example: The table has a circular top, and the company sent a circular to all staff.
circular.exampleZh: 这张桌子有一个圆形的桌面，公司还向全体员工发了一份通告。

circulate.example: Blood circulates through the body and carries oxygen to every cell.
circulate.exampleZh: 血液在体内循环，把氧气输送到每一个细胞。

circulation.example: Regular exercise helps improve blood circulation in the body.
circulation.exampleZh: 规律运动有助于改善体内的血液循环。

circumference.example: The circumference of the circle is about ten meters.
circumference.exampleZh: 这个圆的周长大约是十米。

circumstance.example: Under these difficult circumstances, we must stay calm and help each other.
circumstance.exampleZh: 在这种困难的情况下，我们必须保持冷静并互相帮助。

circumvent.example: They found a way to circumvent the new rules.
circumvent.exampleZh: 他们找到了规避新规定的办法。

circus.example: The children were excited to see the circus come to their town.
circus.exampleZh: 孩子们看到马戏团来到他们镇上，都很兴奋。

citadel.example: The old city was protected by a strong citadel on the hill.
citadel.exampleZh: 这座古城由山上一座坚固的堡垒保护着。

cite.example: The teacher asked us to cite two sources in the report.
cite.exampleZh: 老师要求我们在报告中引用两个来源。

citizen.example: Every citizen should follow the law and help keep the city clean.
citizen.exampleZh: 每位公民都应遵守法律，并帮助保持城市整洁。

citrus.example: Oranges and lemons are both kinds of citrus.
citrus.exampleZh: 橙子和柠檬都是柑橘属植物。

city.example: My sister moved to a big city last year for her new job.
city.exampleZh: 我姐姐去年为了她的新工作搬到了一个大城市。

civic.example: Good civic pride helps people keep their city clean and safe.
civic.exampleZh: 良好的公民自豪感有助于人们保持城市清洁与安全。

civil.example: Every citizen should know their civil rights and duties.
civil.exampleZh: 每个公民都应该了解自己的公民权利和义务。

civilian.example: The soldier helped a civilian find a safe place during the storm.
civilian.exampleZh: 那名士兵在暴风雨中帮助一位平民找到了安全的地方。

civilization.example: Ancient Egypt had a great civilization with rich art and strong kings.
civilization.exampleZh: 古埃及拥有伟大的文明，艺术丰富，国王强大。

civilize.example: Teachers tried to civilize the wild boy through kindness and daily lessons.
civilize.exampleZh: 老师们试图通过关爱和日常课程来教化这个野性的男孩。

claim.example: She claims the bag is hers, but I am not sure.
claim.exampleZh: 她声称这个包是她的，但我不确定。

clairvoyant.example: The clairvoyant woman knew about our secret plan before we told anyone.
clairvoyant.exampleZh: 那位有千里眼的女人在我们告诉任何人之前就知道了我们的秘密计划。

clamber.example: The children clambered over the rocks to reach the beach.
clamber.exampleZh: 孩子们攀爬过岩石，到达了海滩。

clamor.example: The clamor from the crowd grew louder as the players left the field.
clamor.exampleZh: 球员们离场时，人群的喧闹声变得更响了。

clamp.example: He used a clamp to hold the two pieces of wood together.
clamp.exampleZh: 他用夹具把两块木头夹在一起。

clan.example: The whole clan came together to celebrate the old man's birthday.
clan.exampleZh: 整个宗族聚在一起庆祝这位老人的生日。

clang.example: The loud clang of the old bell woke everyone in the small town.
clang.exampleZh: 那口旧钟响亮的叮当声吵醒了小镇上的每个人。

clannish.example: The small village is clannish and rarely welcomes outsiders.
clannish.exampleZh: 这个小村庄很排外，很少欢迎外来人。

clap.example: The children clap their hands and sing a happy song.
clap.exampleZh: 孩子们拍着手，唱着一首欢快的歌。

clarify.example: Please clarify your question so everyone can understand it.
clarify.exampleZh: 请澄清你的问题，以便每个人都能理解。

clarinet.example: She plays the clarinet in her school band every Friday afternoon.
clarinet.exampleZh: 她每周五下午在学校乐队里吹单簧管。

clarity.example: The clarity of her writing makes the report easy to understand.
clarity.exampleZh: 她的写作清晰明了，使这份报告易于理解。

clash.example: Their ideas often clash during the meeting, but they still work well together.
clash.exampleZh: 他们的想法在会上常常冲突，但他们仍然合作得很好。

clasp.example: She wore a small silver clasp on her coat and held it tight.
clasp.exampleZh: 她外套上有一个小小的银色扣子，她紧紧地握着它。

class.example: The whole class went to the museum to learn about ancient history today.
class.exampleZh: 今天全班同学都去博物馆学习古代历史。

classic.example: This old film is a classic story that many families still enjoy today.
classic.exampleZh: 这部老电影是一个经典故事，如今许多家庭仍然喜欢看。

classical.example: She likes classical music, so she often plays Mozart at home.
classical.exampleZh: 她喜欢古典音乐，所以她经常在家播放莫扎特的作品。

classification.example: The library uses a simple classification system for its books.
classification.exampleZh: 这家图书馆用一套简单的分类系统来整理书籍。

classify.example: Scientists classify these animals into two groups based on their size.
classify.exampleZh: 科学家根据体型把这些动物归为两类。

clause.example: This clause in the contract explains how we should pay the money.
clause.exampleZh: 合同中的这一条款说明了我们应该如何支付这笔钱。

clavicle.example: The doctor said he broke his clavicle when he fell off his bike.
clavicle.exampleZh: 医生说他从自行车上摔下来时摔断了锁骨。

claw.example: The cat used its sharp claws to catch the small mouse.
claw.exampleZh: 那只猫用锋利的爪子抓住了小老鼠。

clay.example: The children made small cups and animals from wet clay.
clay.exampleZh: 孩子们用湿黏土做了小杯子和动物。

clean.example: I clean my room every morning before I go to school.
clean.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前打扫我的房间。

clear.example: The sky will clear this afternoon, so the game is not cancelled.
clear.exampleZh: 今天下午天会放晴，所以比赛不会取消。

clearance.example: The workers waited for clearance before they entered the old building.
clearance.exampleZh: 工人们等到获得许可后才进入那栋旧楼。

clench.example: He clenched his fist when he heard the bad news.
clench.exampleZh: 听到那个坏消息时，他握紧了拳头。

clergy.example: The clergy led the morning service in the small village church.
clergy.exampleZh: 神职人员在小村庄的教堂里主持了早晨的礼拜。

cleric.example: The young cleric spoke kindly to everyone in the village.
cleric.exampleZh: 这位年轻的神职人员对村里的每个人都和善地说话。

clerk.example: The clerk at the front desk helped me find my room key.
clerk.exampleZh: 前台的职员帮我找到了我的房间钥匙。

clever.example: She is a clever girl and she always finds good answers to hard problems.
clever.exampleZh: 她是个聪明的女孩，总能找到解决难题的好办法。

cliché.example: The movie is full of clichés and the story feels old and boring.
cliché.exampleZh: 这部电影满是陈词滥调，故事让人觉得老套又无聊。

click.example: Please click the red button to save your new file.
click.exampleZh: 请点击红色按钮来保存你的新文件。

client.example: Our client wants to see the new design on Monday morning.
client.exampleZh: 我们的客户想在周一上午看到新设计。

cliff.example: We stood at the edge of the cliff and looked down at the sea.
cliff.exampleZh: 我们站在悬崖边，向下望着大海。

climactic.example: The final song was the climactic moment of the whole concert.
climactic.exampleZh: 最后一首歌是整个演唱会的高潮时刻。

climate.example: The climate in this city is warm and wet all year.
climate.exampleZh: 这座城市的气候一年四季温暖湿润。

climax.example: The movie reaches its climax when the two friends finally meet again.
climax.exampleZh: 当两个朋友终于再次相见时，电影达到了高潮。

climb.example: We climb the hill every Sunday morning before breakfast.
climb.exampleZh: 我们每个星期天早上早饭前都会爬那座小山。

clime.example: In a warm clime, people often grow fruit all year round.
clime.exampleZh: 在温暖的气候里，人们常常全年都能种植水果。

clinch.example: After months of talks, the two sides finally clinched the deal.
clinch.exampleZh: 经过数月谈判，双方终于敲定了这笔交易。

cling.example: Small children often cling to their mothers in a strange place.
cling.exampleZh: 小孩子在陌生的地方常常紧紧抓着母亲不放。

clinic.example: The new clinic near my home is open every day.
clinic.exampleZh: 我家附近的新诊所周一至周日都开门。

clinical.example: Doctors did a clinical test to see if the new drug was safe.
clinical.exampleZh: 医生做了一项临床测试，以检验这种新药是否安全。

clip.example: Please clip these papers together and put them in the box.
clip.exampleZh: 请把这些纸夹在一起，然后放进盒子里。

clique.example: The small clique at school never let other students join their group.
clique.exampleZh: 学校里那个小集团从不让其他学生加入他们的圈子。

cloak.example: He wore a dark cloak over his shoulders and hid his face.
cloak.exampleZh: 他肩上披着一件深色斗篷，遮住了脸。

clock.example: The clock on the kitchen wall is five minutes fast.
clock.exampleZh: 厨房墙上的时钟快了五分钟。

clockwise.example: Turn the small handle clockwise to open the wooden box.
clockwise.exampleZh: 顺时针转动这个小把手就能打开木盒。

clog.example: The leaves clog the drain every fall and cause small floods.
clog.exampleZh: 每年秋天落叶都会堵住下水道，造成小小的积水。

cloister.example: The old monk walked slowly through the quiet cloister after morning prayer.
cloister.exampleZh: 晨祷之后，那位老修士慢慢走过安静的回廊。

clone.example: Scientists used a cell from the adult sheep to clone a healthy new lamb.
clone.exampleZh: 科学家用这只成年羊的细胞克隆出了一只健康的新生羔羊。

close.example: Please close the door when you leave the room.
close.exampleZh: 离开房间时请把门关上。

closet.example: She keeps her old photos in a closet upstairs.
closet.exampleZh: 她把旧照片放在楼上的壁橱里。

closure.example: The closure of the old factory left many people without jobs.
closure.exampleZh: 那家旧工厂的关闭让许多人失去了工作。

clot.example: A small blood clot blocked the flow of blood in his leg.
clot.exampleZh: 一个小血块阻塞了他腿部的血流。

cloth.example: She used a clean cloth to wipe the table after dinner.
cloth.exampleZh: 晚饭后她用一块干净的布擦桌子。

clothes.example: She washes her clothes every weekend and hangs them outside to dry.
clothes.exampleZh: 她每个周末洗衣服，然后把衣服挂在外面晾干。

cloud.example: Dark clouds covered the sky before the storm began.
cloud.exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前，乌云遮住了天空。

clover.example: The little girl found a four-leaf clover in the green field.
clover.exampleZh: 小女孩在绿色的田野里找到了一株四叶草。

clown.example: The clown at the party made all the children laugh loudly.
clown.exampleZh: 派对上的小丑让所有孩子都大声笑了起来。

club.example: He joined a tennis club and plays there every weekend.
club.exampleZh: 他加入了一个网球俱乐部，每个周末都在那里打球。

clue.example: The police found an important clue near the old house.
clue.exampleZh: 警方在那座老房子附近发现了一条重要线索。

cluster.example: A cluster of stars appeared in the night sky.
cluster.exampleZh: 夜空中出现了一簇星星。

clutch.example: She had to clutch the rope tightly while crossing the old bridge.
clutch.exampleZh: 过那座旧桥时，她不得不紧紧抓住绳子。

coach.example: Our coach trains the team every morning and we take a coach to the game.
coach.exampleZh: 我们的教练每天早上训练球队，我们乘长途客车去比赛。

coagulate.example: When blood cools, it begins to coagulate and becomes thick.
coagulate.exampleZh: 血液冷却后开始凝结，变得黏稠。

coal.example: The old train still burns coal to make steam for its long journeys.
coal.exampleZh: 这列老火车仍然烧煤来产生蒸汽，供它长途行驶。

coalition.example: The two parties formed a coalition to win the election.
coalition.exampleZh: 两个政党结成联盟以赢得选举。

coarse.example: The old table has a coarse surface that feels rough under your hand.
coarse.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子的表面很粗糙，用手摸上去感觉很不平。

coast.example: We walked along the coast and watched the big waves.
coast.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸散步，看着巨大的海浪。

coastal.example: The small coastal town is quiet in winter.
coastal.exampleZh: 这个沿海小镇在冬天很安静。

coat.example: She put on a warm coat before going out in the cold wind.
coat.exampleZh: 她在寒冷的寒风中出门前穿上了一件暖和的外套。

cob.example: The farmer picked a heavy cob of corn from the field.
cob.exampleZh: 农夫从田里摘了一穗沉甸甸的玉米。

cobble.example: He tried to cobble together a small table from old wood.
cobble.exampleZh: 他试着用旧木料粗制滥造地拼出一张小桌子。

cobra.example: The cobra lifted its head and looked straight at us.
cobra.exampleZh: 那条眼镜蛇抬起头，直直地看着我们。

cocaine.example: The police found cocaine in his car and arrested him immediately.
cocaine.exampleZh: 警方在他的车里发现了可卡因，并立即逮捕了他。

cock.example: The farmer keeps a big cock and several hens in the yard.
cock.exampleZh: 农夫在院子里养了一只大公鸡和几只母鸡。

cocktail.example: She made a fresh fruit cocktail for the party and everyone loved it.
cocktail.exampleZh: 她为聚会做了一杯新鲜水果鸡尾酒，大家都很喜欢。

cocky.example: He is too cocky to listen to anyone's advice.
cocky.exampleZh: 他太自大了，听不进任何人的建议。

coconut.example: The coconut is big and hard, and it has sweet water inside.
coconut.exampleZh: 这个椰子又大又硬，里面还有甜甜的水。

coda.example: The final song served as a gentle coda to the concert.
coda.exampleZh: 最后一首歌作为演唱会的温柔尾声。

code.example: The nurse wrote a code on the form and the doctor read it.
code.exampleZh: 护士在表格上写了一个代码，医生读了它。

codeine.example: The doctor gave him some codeine to help with the pain.
codeine.exampleZh: 医生给了他一些可待因来帮助止痛。

codify.example: The team worked for years to codify the old rules into one clear book.
codify.exampleZh: 团队花了多年时间把旧规则编纂成一本清晰的书。

coefficient.example: The teacher asked us to find the coefficient in this simple math problem.
coefficient.exampleZh: 老师让我们在这道简单的数学题中找出系数。

coercion.example: He signed the contract under coercion and later asked a lawyer for help.
coercion.exampleZh: 他在胁迫下签了那份合同，后来向律师求助。

coexist.example: Different kinds of animals can coexist peacefully in the same forest.
coexist.exampleZh: 不同种类的动物可以在同一片森林中和平共存。

coffee.example: I drink a cup of coffee every morning before I go to work.
coffee.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都喝一杯咖啡。

coffin.example: They carried the coffin slowly into the old church.
coffin.exampleZh: 他们把棺材慢慢地抬进了那座老教堂。

cog.example: The small cog turns the big wheel slowly.
cog.exampleZh: 这个小嵌齿轮缓慢地带动大轮子。

cogent.example: Her cogent argument convinced the whole team to change the plan.
cogent.exampleZh: 她有说服力的论证让整个团队改变了计划。

cognitive.example: Music can help children improve their cognitive skills.
cognitive.exampleZh: 音乐可以帮助儿童提高他们的认知能力。

cognizant.example: She was fully cognizant of the risks before signing the contract.
cognizant.exampleZh: 她在签合同前已充分认识到其中的风险。

cohabit.example: They decided to cohabit before they got married last year.
cohabit.exampleZh: 他们去年结婚前决定同居。

coherent.example: Her story was coherent and easy for everyone to follow.
coherent.exampleZh: 她的叙述连贯一致，大家都很容易听懂。

cohesive.example: Our team is cohesive because everyone helps each other every day.
cohesive.exampleZh: 我们的团队很有凝聚力，因为大家每天都互相帮助。

coil.example: The snake began to coil around a thick branch near the river.
coil.exampleZh: 那条蛇开始在河边的粗树枝上盘绕起来。

coin.example: She put a coin in the machine and bought a drink.
coin.exampleZh: 她把一枚硬币放进机器里，买了一瓶饮料。

coincide.example: The two events coincide every year, so we can attend both together.
coincide.exampleZh: 这两个活动每年都会同时举行，所以我们可以两个都参加。

coincidence.example: It was a coincidence that we met at the same cafe.
coincidence.exampleZh: 我们在同一家咖啡馆遇见，纯属巧合。

cola.example: I drink a cold cola with my lunch every day.
cola.exampleZh: 我每天午饭时都喝一杯冰可乐。

cold.example: It is cold today, and my sister has a bad cold.
cold.exampleZh: 今天很冷，我妹妹还得了重感冒。

collaborate.example: Our team will collaborate with the new school on this small project.
collaborate.exampleZh: 我们团队将在这项小项目上与那所新学校合作。

collaboration.example: The two schools started a collaboration to help students learn new skills.
collaboration.exampleZh: 这两所学校开始了合作，帮助学生学 习新技能。

collapse.example: The old bridge collapsed in the storm, and many people were hurt.
collapse.exampleZh: 那座旧桥在暴风雨中倒塌了，许多人受了伤。

collar.example: The dog wore a red collar around its neck.
collar.exampleZh: 那只狗的脖子上戴着一个红色项圈。

collateral.example: The bank asked for collateral before it agreed to lend him the money.
collateral.exampleZh: 银行在同意借钱给他之前要求提供抵押品。

colleague.example: I often eat lunch with a friendly colleague from my office.
colleague.exampleZh: 我经常和办公室里一位友善的同事一起吃午饭。

collect.example: My brother likes to collect old coins from many different countries.
collect.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜欢收集来自许多不同国家的旧硬币。

collection.example: My collection of old coins is small but very interesting.
collection.exampleZh: 我的旧硬币收藏品不多，但很有趣。

collective.example: The team made a collective effort to finish the project on time.
collective.exampleZh: 团队集体努力，按时完成了项目。

collector.example: The collector keeps old coins and stamps in a small wooden box.
collector.exampleZh: 这位收藏家把旧硬币和邮票放在一个小木盒里。

college.example: My sister studies at a small college near our home.
college.exampleZh: 我姐姐在我们家附近的一所小学院里读书。

collide.example: The two cars collided at the corner because the driver did not stop.
collide.exampleZh: 两辆车在拐角处相撞，因为那名司机没有停车。

collision.example: The two cars slowed down to avoid a collision at the busy corner.
collision.exampleZh: 两辆车减速以避免在繁忙的街角发生碰撞。

colloquial.example: His colloquial style makes the book easy and fun to read.
colloquial.exampleZh: 他的口语化风格让这本书读起来轻松又有趣。

colonel.example: The colonel told his soldiers to rest before the long march.
colonel.exampleZh: 上校让士兵们在长途行军前休息。

colonial.example: Kenya was under British colonial rule for many years.
colonial.exampleZh: 肯尼亚曾多年处于英国的殖民统治之下。

colonialism.example: Many African countries became independent after a long struggle against colonialism in the twentieth century.
colonialism.exampleZh: 许多非洲国家在二十世纪经历了长期的反殖民主义斗争后获得了独立。

colony.example: The small colony grew into a busy town over the years.
colony.exampleZh: 这个小小的殖民地多年来发展成了一座繁忙的城镇。

color.example: The walls of her room are a soft color that makes people feel calm.
color.exampleZh: 她房间的墙壁是一种柔和的颜色，让人感到平静。

colossal.example: The new museum is a colossal building in the middle of the city.
colossal.exampleZh: 这座新博物馆是市中心一座巨大的建筑。

colt.example: The young colt ran fast across the green field near the farm.
colt.exampleZh: 那匹小雄马在农场附近的绿色田野上飞快地奔跑。

column.example: The teacher wrote the numbers in a column on the board.
column.exampleZh: 老师把数字写在黑板上的一列里。

coma.example: The old man was in a coma for three weeks after the accident.
coma.exampleZh: 事故之后，那位老人昏迷了三个星期。

comatose.example: After the car accident, he was comatose in the hospital for three weeks.
comatose.exampleZh: 车祸之后，他在医院里昏迷了三个星期。

comb.example: She used a comb to comb her hair and search for the lost key.
comb.exampleZh: 她用一把梳子梳理头发，并搜寻那把丢失的钥匙。

combat.example: Doctors are working hard to combat the spread of the disease.
combat.exampleZh: 医生们正在努力与疾病的传播作斗争。

combatant.example: The soldiers captured three enemy combatants during the fight near the river.
combatant.exampleZh: 士兵们在河边附近的战斗中俘虏了三名敌方战斗人员。

combination.example: The new plan is a good combination of hard work and careful thinking.
combination.exampleZh: 这个新方案是努力工作和细心思考的良好结合。

combine.example: You can combine the two small teams into one group.
combine.exampleZh: 你可以把这两个小团队合并成一个组。

combustion.example: The combustion of wood produces heat and light.
combustion.exampleZh: 木材的燃烧会产生热和光。

come.example: Please come to my house after work today so we can talk.
come.exampleZh: 今天下班后请来我家，这样我们可以谈谈。

comedic.example: The movie has a comedic tone that makes everyone laugh.
comedic.exampleZh: 这部电影有一种喜剧的基调，让每个人都笑了。

comedy.example: We watched a funny comedy last night and laughed all evening.
comedy.exampleZh: 我们昨晚看了一部有趣的喜剧，笑了一整晚。

comely.example: The village girl had a comely face and a warm smile for everyone.
comely.exampleZh: 那个乡村女孩面容清秀，对每个人都露出温暖的微笑。

comet.example: Last night we saw a bright comet in the sky through a small telescope.
comet.exampleZh: 昨晚我们用一台小望远镜在天空中看到了一颗明亮的彗星。

comfort.example: Her kind words gave me great comfort when I was sad.
comfort.exampleZh: 我难过时，她温柔的话语给了我很大的安慰。

comfortable.example: This chair is very comfortable and I can sit here all day.
comfortable.exampleZh: 这把椅子很舒服，我可以在这儿坐一整天。

comic.example: This comic book makes my little brother laugh every night.
comic.exampleZh: 这本漫画书让我弟弟每天晚上都笑。

comical.example: The clown's comical walk made all the children laugh loudly.
comical.exampleZh: 小丑滑稽的走路姿势让所有孩子都大声笑了起来。

command.example: The officer gave a clear command, and the soldiers moved at once.
command.exampleZh: 军官下达了明确的命令，士兵们立刻行动。

commander.example: The commander ordered his soldiers to move forward before sunrise.
commander.exampleZh: 指挥官命令他的士兵在日出前向前推进。

commemorate.example: We visit the park every year to commemorate our old teacher.
commemorate.exampleZh: 我们每年都去公园纪念我们以前的老师。

commend.example: My teacher will commend her hard work in front of the whole class.
commend.exampleZh: 老师会在全班面前称赞她的努力。

commendable.example: Her hard work on the project was commendable and helped the whole team.
commendable.exampleZh: 她在这个项目上的努力值得称赞，也帮助了整个团队。

commensurate.example: Her salary is commensurate with her skills and years of hard work.
commensurate.exampleZh: 她的薪水与她的技能和多年的辛勤工作相称。

comment.example: Please leave a comment under the video if you have any questions.
comment.exampleZh: 如果你有任何问题，请在视频下方留下评论。

commentary.example: The radio commentary on the football match was clear and exciting.
commentary.exampleZh: 这场足球比赛的电台实况报道清晰又精彩。

commerce.example: Online commerce has grown quickly in recent years.
commerce.exampleZh: 近年来，线上商业发展迅速。

commercial.example: The commercial for the new phone is very popular with young people.
commercial.exampleZh: 这款新手机的商业广告很受年轻人欢迎。

commiserate.example: My friends came to commiserate with me after I lost my job.
commiserate.exampleZh: 我失业后，朋友们前来安慰我。

commission.example: The city set up a commission to study the traffic problem.
commission.exampleZh: 市里成立了一个委员会来研究交通问题。

commit.example: He did not want to commit a crime, so he told the truth.
commit.exampleZh: 他不想犯罪，所以他说了实话。

commitment.example: She made a strong commitment to her studies this year.
commitment.exampleZh: 她今年对自己的学业做出了坚定的承诺。

committed.example: She is committed to her job and works hard every day.
committed.exampleZh: 她对工作很投入，每天都努力工作。

committee.example: The committee will meet on Monday to discuss the new plan.
committee.exampleZh: 委员会将于周一开会讨论这项新计划。

commodity.example: Clean water is a valuable commodity in many dry countries.
commodity.exampleZh: 在许多干旱国家，清洁的水是一种宝贵的商品。

commodore.example: The commodore gave orders to all the ships in the harbor.
commodore.exampleZh: 海军准将向港口里的所有舰船下达了命令。

common.example: This is a common problem for many young students today.
common.exampleZh: 这是当今许多年轻学生的一个普通问题。

commonplace.example: Such rude remarks are commonplace on the internet today.
commonplace.exampleZh: 如今在互联网上，这类粗鲁的言论司空见惯。

commonwealth.example: The small island nation joined the commonwealth last year.
commonwealth.exampleZh: 这个小岛国去年加入了该联邦。

commotion.example: The loud noise outside caused a big commotion in the quiet street.
commotion.exampleZh: 外面的巨响在安静的街道上引起了一阵大骚动。

communal.example: We share a communal kitchen and garden in our small building.
communal.exampleZh: 我们这栋小楼里共用一个厨房和一个花园。

communicate.example: We communicate with our teacher by email every day.
communicate.exampleZh: 我们每天通过电子邮件和老师交流。

communication.example: Good communication between parents and children helps solve many family problems.
communication.exampleZh: 父母和孩子之间良好的沟通有助于解决许多家庭问题。

communism.example: Many people in that country believed communism would bring equality to workers.
communism.exampleZh: 那个国家的许多人相信共产主义会给工人带来平等。

communist.example: My grandfather was a communist and he often told us stories about his youth.
communist.exampleZh: 我的祖父是一名共产主义者，他常常给我们讲他年轻时的故事。

community.example: Our community works together to keep the park clean and safe.
community.exampleZh: 我们的社区齐心协力保持公园的清洁与安全。

commute.example: She commutes to work by train every morning.
commute.exampleZh: 她每天早上坐火车通勤上班。

compact.example: The small apartment has a compact kitchen and two bright rooms.
compact.exampleZh: 这套小公寓有一个紧凑的厨房和两个明亮的房间。

companion.example: My dog is my best companion on long walks.
companion.exampleZh: 我的狗是我长途散步时最好的同伴。

company.example: My father works for a small company in our town.
company.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们镇上的一家小公司工作。

comparable.example: These two phones are comparable in price and size.
comparable.exampleZh: 这两部手机在价格和大小上差不多。

comparative.example: This study gives a comparative view of the two systems.
comparative.exampleZh: 这项研究对这两个系统做了比较性的分析。

compare.example: We often compare prices before we buy a new phone.
compare.exampleZh: 我们在买新手机之前常常比较价格。

comparison.example: This comparison shows that my new phone is faster than the old one.
comparison.exampleZh: 这个比较表明我的新手机比旧手机快。

compartment.example: She put her bag in the overhead compartment and sat down.
compartment.exampleZh: 她把包放进头顶的行李隔间，然后坐下了。

compass.example: A compass helps us find the right way home.
compass.exampleZh: 罗盘帮助我们找到回家的正确方向。

compassion.example: She showed great compassion for the sick child and stayed with him all night.
compassion.exampleZh: 她对那个生病的孩子表现出极大的同情，整夜陪着他。

compatible.example: This new app is compatible with most phones and tablets.
compatible.exampleZh: 这款新应用与大多数手机和平板电脑兼容。

compel.example: Bad weather compelled us to stay at home all day.
compel.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气迫使我们整天待在家里。

compendium.example: This small compendium explains the basic rules of our game in simple words.
compendium.exampleZh: 这本小手册用简单的语言解释了我们游戏的基本规则。

compensate.example: The company paid him money to compensate for the lost time.
compensate.exampleZh: 公司付给他钱来补偿他损失的时间。

compensation.example: The company paid him compensation for the injury he suffered at work.
compensation.exampleZh: 公司为他工作中所受的伤害支付了赔偿。

compete.example: Many small shops compete with each other for more customers.
compete.exampleZh: 许多小商店为了获得更多顾客而互相竞争。

competition.example: There is a lot of competition between the two small shops on our street.
competition.exampleZh: 我们街上的两家小店之间存在激烈的竞争。

competitive.example: The job market is very competitive for new graduates this year.
competitive.exampleZh: 今年的就业市场对刚毕业的学生来说竞争非常激烈。

competitor.example: Our main competitor sells the same product at a much lower price.
competitor.exampleZh: 我们的主要竞争对手以低得多的价格出售同样的产品。

compile.example: We compile a list of new words every week.
compile.exampleZh: 我们每周汇编一份新单词表。

complacent.example: He became complacent after winning one game and stopped practicing hard.
complacent.exampleZh: 他赢了一场比赛后就变得自满，不再努力练习了。

complain.example: She always complains about the food in the school dining hall.
complain.exampleZh: 她总是抱怨学校食堂的饭菜。

complaint.example: The customer made a complaint about the cold soup at the restaurant.
complaint.exampleZh: 这位顾客投诉餐厅的汤是凉的。

complement.example: The bright red scarf is a perfect complement to her dark coat.
complement.exampleZh: 那条鲜红的围巾是她深色外套的完美点缀。

complete.example: Please complete all your homework before you go out to play.
complete.exampleZh: 请你出去玩耍前完成所有的作业。

complex.example: The new shopping complex is large and very complex inside.
complex.exampleZh: 这座新的购物综合体很大，里面非常复杂。

complexion.example: She has a fair complexion and bright eyes.

complexity.example: The complexity of this new game makes it hard for young children.
complexity.exampleZh: 这个新游戏的复杂性让年幼的孩子很难玩。

compliant.example: The company's new safety rules are fully compliant with the law.
compliant.exampleZh: 公司的新安全规定完全符合法律规定。

complicit.example: She was complicit in the plan to hide the money from the police.
complicit.exampleZh: 她参与了那个把钱藏起来、不让警察发现的计划。

compliment.example: She gave me a nice compliment about my new coat today.
compliment.exampleZh: 她今天对我的新外套说了一句很好的赞美。

comply.example: All students must comply with the school rules during the exam.
comply.exampleZh: 所有学生在考试期间必须遵守学校的规则。

component.example: Each component of the machine is easy to replace.
component.exampleZh: 这台机器的每个部件都很容易更换。

comport.example: His calm behavior does not comport with what he told us yesterday.
comport.exampleZh: 他冷静的举止与他昨天告诉我们的话不相称。

compose.example: The teacher asked us to compose a short song for the class.
compose.exampleZh: 老师让我们为班级创作一首短歌。

composer.example: The famous composer wrote many songs for children.
composer.exampleZh: 这位著名的作曲家为孩子们写了许多歌曲。

composite.example: This composite material is strong and light enough for airplane parts.
composite.exampleZh: 这种复合材料足够坚固且轻便，适合用于飞机制造。

composition.example: The composition of the team changed after two new members joined.
composition.exampleZh: 两名新成员加入后，团队的构成发生了变化。

composure.example: She kept her composure even when everyone around her started to panic.
composure.exampleZh: 即使周围的人开始惊慌，她仍保持沉着。

compound.example: This chemical compound can make the soil and water more dangerous.
compound.exampleZh: 这种化合物会使土壤和水更加危险。

comprehend.example: I cannot comprehend why he left without saying a word to us.
comprehend.exampleZh: 我无法理解他为什么一句话都没说就离开了。

comprehension.example: Reading every day can improve your comprehension of English texts.
comprehension.exampleZh: 每天阅读可以提高你对英语文本的理解力。

comprehensive.example: The report gives a comprehensive view of the city's water problems.
comprehensive.exampleZh: 这份报告全面介绍了这座城市的水资源问题。

compress.example: You can compress the files to save space on your computer.
compress.exampleZh: 你可以压缩这些文件来节省电脑空间。

comprise.example: The team comprises five engineers and two designers from our office.
comprise.exampleZh: 这个团队由我们办公室的五名工程师和两名设计师组成。

compromise.example: Both sides agreed to compromise so the project could move forward.
compromise.exampleZh: 双方同意妥协，这样项目才能继续推进。

compulsion.example: He felt a sudden compulsion to check his phone during the meeting.
compulsion.exampleZh: 开会时他突然有一种想看手机的冲动。

compulsive.example: She has a compulsive habit of checking her phone every few minutes.
compulsive.exampleZh: 她有一个难以自制的习惯，每隔几分钟就查看一次手机。

compunction.example: She felt a sudden compunction about lying to her old friend.
compunction.exampleZh: 她对向老朋友撒谎感到一阵内疚。

compute.example: We compute the total cost before we buy anything.
compute.exampleZh: 我们在买东西之前会先计算总花费。

computer.example: I use my computer every day to write emails and read news.
computer.exampleZh: 我每天用我的计算机写电子邮件和看新闻。

comrade.example: My father said his old comrade helped him find a job in the city.
comrade.exampleZh: 我父亲说他的老同志帮他在城里找到了一份工作。

concatenate.example: You can concatenate these two short strings to make one longer word.
concatenate.exampleZh: 你可以把这两个短字符串连接起来，组成一个更长的单词。

conceal.example: She tried to conceal the letter under a pile of books.
conceal.exampleZh: 她试着把信藏在一堆书下面。

concede.example: He finally conceded that his plan had some serious problems.
concede.exampleZh: 他最终承认他的计划存在一些严重问题。

conceit.example: His conceit made him believe he was better than everyone else.
conceit.exampleZh: 他的自负让他觉得自己比所有人都强。

conceited.example: He is too conceited to listen to anyone else's advice.
conceited.exampleZh: 他太自负了，听不进别人的任何建议。

conceive.example: She could not conceive of a life without music and books.
conceive.exampleZh: 她无法构想一种没有音乐和书籍的生活。

concentrate.example: I cannot concentrate on my work when the room is too noisy.
concentrate.exampleZh: 房间太吵的时候，我无法专心工作。

concentration.example: Good concentration helps you finish your homework faster and with fewer mistakes.
concentration.exampleZh: 良好的专注力能帮你更快完成作业，并减少错误。

concentric.example: The two circles are concentric and share the same center point.
concentric.exampleZh: 这两个圆是同心的，共享同一个圆心。

concept.example: The concept of time is hard for young children to understand.
concept.exampleZh: 时间这个概念对幼儿来说很难理解。

conception.example: Her conception of friendship is based on trust and honest talk.
conception.exampleZh: 她对友谊的构想建立在信任和坦诚交谈之上。

concern.example: This problem concerns everyone, so we should care about it together.
concern.exampleZh: 这个问题涉及每个人，所以我们应该共同关心它。

concerning.example: I have a question concerning tomorrow's meeting time.
concerning.exampleZh: 我有一个关于明天会议时间的问题。

concert.example: The band will play a concert in the park on Sunday.
concert.exampleZh: 乐队将于周日在公园举办一场音乐会。

concession.example: The company made a small concession to the workers and raised their pay.
concession.exampleZh: 公司对工人做出了小小的让步，提高了他们的工资。

concise.example: Her concise report made the main point very clear to everyone.
concise.exampleZh: 她简明的报告让每个人都清楚地明白了要点。

conclude.example: After the long talk, we conclude that the plan will work well.
conclude.exampleZh: 经过长时间讨论，我们得出结论：这个计划会很好地奏效。

conclusion.example: We finally reached a clear conclusion after the long meeting.
conclusion.exampleZh: 经过漫长的会议，我们终于得出了明确的结论。

conclusive.example: The police found conclusive evidence that he stole the money.
conclusive.exampleZh: 警方找到了他偷钱的确实证据。

concord.example: There is complete concord between what he says and what he does.
concord.exampleZh: 他说的和做的完全一致。

concourse.example: Many people waited in the main concourse for their trains this morning.
concourse.exampleZh: 今天早上许多人在主大厅里等火车。

concrete.example: We need a concrete plan before we start the new project.
concrete.exampleZh: 在开始新项目之前，我们需要一个具体的计划。

concur.example: I concur with your plan, and the two events may concur next week.
concur.exampleZh: 我同意你的计划，而且这两件事可能在下周同时发生。

condemn.example: Many people condemn violence because it hurts innocent families.
condemn.exampleZh: 许多人谴责暴力，因为它伤害无辜的家庭。

condense.example: The cold air made the water condense into small drops on the glass.
condense.exampleZh: 冷空气使水在玻璃上凝结成小水珠。

condescend.example: He would not condescend to explain the rules to the new players.
condescend.exampleZh: 他不愿屈尊向新队员解释规则。

condiment.example: She added a few condiments to the soup to make it taste better.
condiment.exampleZh: 她往汤里加了几种调味品，让它味道更好。

condition.example: The doctor said his condition is getting better every day.
condition.exampleZh: 医生说他的病情每天都在好转。

conditional.example: The job offer is conditional on passing a background check.
conditional.exampleZh: 这份工作录用是有条件的，取决于能否通过背景调查。

condole.example: We went to condole with her after her father died.
condole.exampleZh: 她父亲去世后，我们去向她表示慰问。

condone.example: Parents should not condone bad behavior just because they love their children.
condone.exampleZh: 父母不应仅仅因为爱孩子就纵容不良行为。

conduce.example: Regular exercise and good sleep conduce to better health.
conduce.exampleZh: 规律运动和良好睡眠有助于身体健康。

conducive.example: A quiet room is conducive to good study and clear thinking.
conducive.exampleZh: 安静的房间有助于良好的学习和清晰的思考。

conduct.example: The teacher must conduct the test in a quiet room.
conduct.exampleZh: 老师必须在安静的房间里进行这次测试。

conductor.example: The conductor raised his hands and the music began.
conductor.exampleZh: 指挥举起双手，音乐随即响起。

conduit.example: The old pipe acts as a conduit for water from the river.
conduit.exampleZh: 这根旧管道充当了从河里引水的通道。

cone.example: The child built a tall cone with wet sand on the beach.
cone.exampleZh: 那个孩子在沙滩上用湿沙子堆了一个高高的圆锥体。

confabulate.example: After the accident, he began to confabulate stories about the crash.
confabulate.exampleZh: 事故发生后，他开始编造关于那场车祸的故事。

confederacy.example: The small states formed a confederacy to protect themselves against stronger neighbors.
confederacy.exampleZh: 这些小国组成了一个邦联，以保护自己免受更强邻国的侵犯。

confederate.example: He trusted his old confederate to help him in the difficult fight.
confederate.exampleZh: 他信任他的老同盟者，在艰难的斗争中帮助他。

confer.example: The doctors will confer with the family before they decide on the treatment.
confer.exampleZh: 医生们会先与家属商谈，然后再决定治疗方案。

conference.example: She will speak at the conference about her new book next week.
conference.exampleZh: 她下周将在会议上介绍她的新书。

confess.example: He finally confessed that he had taken the money from the drawer.
confess.exampleZh: 他终于承认自己从抽屉里拿了那些钱。

confidant.example: Tom is my closest confidant, and I tell him everything.
confidant.exampleZh: 汤姆是我最亲密的知己，我什么事都告诉他。

confide.example: She confided in her best friend about her worries.
confide.exampleZh: 她向最好的朋友吐露了自己的烦恼。

confidence.example: Her confidence grew after she gave a short speech to the class.
confidence.exampleZh: 她在班上做了一次简短演讲后，信心增强了。

confident.example: She feels confident when she speaks English in front of her classmates.
confident.exampleZh: 她在同学面前说英语时感到自信。

confidentiality.example: The doctor promised confidentiality about everything I told her.
confidentiality.exampleZh: 医生承诺对我告诉她的一切保密。

configuration.example: The default configuration is easy for new users to change.
configuration.exampleZh: 默认配置对新用户来说很容易修改。

confine.example: The doctor told him to confine his activities to light exercise for a week.
confine.exampleZh: 医生让他一周内把活动限制在轻度锻炼范围内。

confirm.example: Please confirm your seat number before the plane takes off.
confirm.exampleZh: 请在飞机起飞前确认你的座位号。

confirmation.example: I am waiting for a confirmation email about my flight time.
confirmation.exampleZh: 我正在等一封关于航班时间的确认邮件。

confiscate.example: The teacher will confiscate any phone used during the exam.
confiscate.exampleZh: 老师会没收考试期间使用的任何手机。

conflagration.example: The old wooden houses were destroyed in a terrible conflagration last night.
conflagration.exampleZh: 那些古老的木屋昨晚在一场可怕的大火中被烧毁。

conflate.example: Do not conflate this problem with the other one.
conflate.exampleZh: 不要把这个问题和另一个问题混为一谈。

conflict.example: There is a serious conflict between the two teams about the new plan.
conflict.exampleZh: 两个团队之间就新计划存在严重的冲突。

confluence.example: The small town sits at the confluence of two wide rivers.
confluence.exampleZh: 这座小镇坐落在两条宽阔河流的汇流处。

conform.example: All students must conform to the school rules during exams.
conform.exampleZh: 所有学生在考试期间都必须遵守学校的规定。

confound.example: The two twin brothers look so alike that they often confound their teachers.
confound.exampleZh: 这对双胞胎兄弟长得太像了，常常让他们的老师感到困惑。

confront.example: We must confront our fears if we want to grow.
confront.exampleZh: 如果我们想成长，就必须面对自己的恐惧。

confuse.example: The teacher's long explanation confused most of the students in class.
confuse.exampleZh: 老师冗长的讲解让班里大多数学生感到困惑。

confusion.example: There was a lot of confusion about the new school rules.
confusion.exampleZh: 关于学校的新规定，大家有很多困惑。

congeal.example: Cold air made the soup congeal into a thick, sticky mass.
congeal.exampleZh: 冷空气使汤凝结成一块浓稠发黏的东西。

congenial.example: She found the new office congenial and soon made good friends there.
congenial.exampleZh: 她觉得新办公室环境很适宜，很快就在那里交到了好朋友。

congenital.example: He has a congenital heart problem and sees a doctor often.
congenital.exampleZh: 他有先天性的心脏问题，经常去看医生。

congest.example: Too many cars congest the narrow streets every morning.
congest.exampleZh: 每天早上，太多的汽车使狭窄的街道变得拥挤。

conglomerate.example: The conglomerate owns hotels, banks, and several large farms in the south.
conglomerate.exampleZh: 这个企业集团拥有酒店、银行和南方的几个大农场。

congratulate.example: I want to congratulate you on passing your driving test today.
congratulate.exampleZh: 我想祝贺你今天通过了驾照考试。

congregation.example: The whole congregation stood up and sang a song together.
