congregation.exampleZh: 全体会众站起来一起唱了一首歌。

congress.example: Congress will vote on the new law next week.
congress.exampleZh: 国会将在下周对这项新法律进行投票。

congruent.example: The two triangles are congruent, so their sides and angles match exactly.
congruent.exampleZh: 这两个三角形全等，所以它们的边和角完全一致。

conjecture.example: His idea was only a conjecture, and no one could prove it true.
conjecture.exampleZh: 他的想法只是推测，没有人能证明它是对的。

conjoin.example: The two rivers conjoin near the old bridge and flow to the sea.
conjoin.exampleZh: 两条河在旧桥附近汇合，然后流入大海。

conjugal.example: They talked about their conjugal life with the young couple.
conjugal.exampleZh: 他们和那对年轻夫妇谈论了他们的婚姻生活。

conjunction.example: The word but is a common conjunction that joins two ideas together.
conjunction.exampleZh: but 这个词是一个常见的连词，用来把两个想法连接起来。

conjure.example: The magician can conjure a rabbit from his empty hat.
conjure.exampleZh: 那个魔术师能从空帽子里变出一只兔子。

connect.example: Please connect the printer to your computer before you start the report.
connect.exampleZh: 开始写报告前，请先把打印机连接到电脑上。

connection.example: There is a strong connection between daily exercise and good health.
connection.exampleZh: 每天锻炼与身体健康之间存在很强的联系。

connive.example: The manager seemed to connive at the theft because he never reported it.
connive.exampleZh: 经理似乎对那起盗窃行为默默纵容，因为他从未上报。

connoisseur.example: My uncle is a connoisseur of fine tea and old books.
connoisseur.exampleZh: 我叔叔是优质茶叶和古旧书籍的鉴赏家。

connotation.example: The word home has a warm connotation for most people.
connotation.exampleZh: 对大多数人来说，home 这个词带有温暖的隐含意义。

connote.example: Dark clouds often connote coming rain to farmers in the village.
connote.exampleZh: 乌云常常向村里的农民暗示即将下雨。

connubial.example: They lived a happy connubial life in a small house near the sea.
connubial.exampleZh: 他们在海边的一栋小房子里过着幸福的婚姻生活。

conquer.example: She worked hard to conquer her fear of public speaking.
conquer.exampleZh: 她努力克服了对公开演讲的恐惧。

conquest.example: The king's greatest conquest brought gold and land to his people.
conquest.exampleZh: 国王最伟大的一次征服为他的人民带来了黄金和土地。

conscience.example: His conscience told him to tell the truth about the broken window.
conscience.exampleZh: 他的良心告诉他要说出打破窗户的真相。

conscientious.example: She is a conscientious student who always finishes her homework on time.
conscientious.exampleZh: 她是个认真的学生，总是按时完成作业。

conscious.example: She was still conscious and could answer the doctor's simple questions.
conscious.exampleZh: 她神志清醒，能回答医生的简单问题。

consciousness.example: After the accident, he slowly regained consciousness and recognized the people around him.
consciousness.exampleZh: 事故之后，他慢慢恢复了知觉，认出了周围的人。

consecrate.example: They consecrated the new church with a quiet ceremony last Sunday.
consecrate.exampleZh: 上周日他们用一场安静的仪式奉献了这座新教堂。

consecutive.example: She won the race for three consecutive years.
consecutive.exampleZh: 她连续三年赢得了这项比赛。

consensus.example: The team finally reached a consensus on the new plan.
consensus.exampleZh: 团队最终就新计划达成了共识。

consent.example: My parents gave their consent before I joined the school trip.
consent.exampleZh: 我参加学校旅行之前，父母表示了同意。

consequence.example: Not studying for the test had a bad consequence for him.
consequence.exampleZh: 没有为考试复习给他带来了糟糕的后果。

consequently.example: It rained all day, and consequently the game was cancelled.
consequently.exampleZh: 下了一整天雨，因此比赛被取消了。

conservation.example: Water conservation is important for all people in dry areas.
conservation.exampleZh: 节约用水对干旱地区的所有人来说都很重要。

conservative.example: My grandfather is very conservative and does not like new ideas.
conservative.exampleZh: 我的祖父非常保守，不喜欢新思想。

conservatory.example: She studies piano at a music conservatory in the city center.
conservatory.exampleZh: 她在市中心的一所音乐学院学习钢琴。

conserve.example: We must conserve water because the city has very little rain this year.
conserve.exampleZh: 我们必须节约用水，因为今年这座城市降雨很少。

consider.example: I will consider your idea and tell you tomorrow.
consider.exampleZh: 我会考虑你的想法，明天告诉你。

considerable.example: The storm caused considerable damage to houses near the river.
considerable.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨对河边的房屋造成了相当大的破坏。

considerate.example: She is always considerate of her old neighbors and helps them carry bags.
considerate.exampleZh: 她总是很体贴年老的邻居，帮他们提袋子。

consideration.example: Price is an important consideration when we choose a new car.
consideration.exampleZh: 价格是我们选择新车时的一个重要考虑因素。

consign.example: We will consign the boxes to the shipping company tomorrow morning.
consign.exampleZh: 我们明天上午会把箱子交付给船运公司。

consist.example: The team consists of six students and one teacher.
consist.exampleZh: 这个团队由六名学生和一名老师组成。

consistency.example: The consistency of the sauce should be thick but easy to pour.
consistency.exampleZh: 这种酱汁的浓度应该是浓稠但容易倒出来的。

consistent.example: His work is consistent and always done on time.
consistent.exampleZh: 他的工作始终如一，而且总是按时完成。

consolation.example: Her kind words gave me great consolation after I lost the game.
consolation.exampleZh: 我输掉比赛后，她温暖的话语给了我很大的安慰。

console.example: She tried to console her friend after the bad news, then checked the console.
console.exampleZh: 听到坏消息后，她试着安慰朋友，然后检查了控制台。

consolidate.example: We need to consolidate our small loans into one monthly payment.
consolidate.exampleZh: 我们需要把小额贷款合并成一笔每月还款。

consort.example: The queen arrived with her royal consort and greeted the guests warmly.
consort.exampleZh: 女王与她的王室配偶一同抵达，并热情地问候了宾客。

conspicuous.example: Her red coat was very conspicuous in the crowd.
conspicuous.exampleZh: 她的红大衣在人群中非常显眼。

conspiracy.example: The police found a conspiracy to steal the money from the bank.
conspiracy.exampleZh: 警方发现了一个从银行偷钱的阴谋。

conspire.example: Bad weather and poor planning conspired to ruin our trip.
conspire.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气和糟糕的规划共同导致我们的旅行泡汤了。

constancy.example: Her constancy in daily practice made her a much better singer over time.
constancy.exampleZh: 她在日常练习中的坚持不懈使她随着时间推移成为了一名好得多的歌手。

constant.example: The machine needs constant care, so we check it every morning.
constant.exampleZh: 这台机器需要不断的维护，所以我们每天早上都检查它。

constellation.example: The constellation of stars was easy to see on the clear night.
constellation.exampleZh: 在晴朗的夜晚，那片星座很容易看见。

consternation.example: To her consternation, the door was wide open when she got home.
consternation.exampleZh: 让她惊愕的是，她到家时门大开着。

constipation.example: Drinking enough water every day can help you avoid constipation.
constipation.exampleZh: 每天喝足够的水可以帮助你避免便秘。

constituent.example: The voters in this district are the most important constituents for the mayor.
constituent.exampleZh: 这个选区的选民是市长最重要的选民群体。

constitute.example: These small parts together constitute the whole machine.
constitute.exampleZh: 这些小零件一起构成了整台机器。

constitution.example: The new constitution gives every citizen the right to vote.
constitution.exampleZh: 新宪法赋予每位公民投票权。

constitutional.example: The court said the new law is not constitutional.
constitutional.exampleZh: 法院表示这项新法律不符合宪法。

constrain.example: Her busy schedule constrains her from spending more time with family.
constrain.exampleZh: 繁忙的日程限制了她与家人共度更多时间。

constraint.example: Time is a real constraint when we plan a short trip.
constraint.exampleZh: 当我们计划一次短途旅行时，时间是一个真正的限制。

construct.example: They plan to construct a new bridge across the river next year.
construct.exampleZh: 他们计划明年在河上建造一座新桥。

construction.example: The new bridge is still under construction and will open next year.
construction.exampleZh: 这座新桥仍在建设中，将于明年开放。

consul.example: The consul helped the travelers get new passports after their bags were stolen.
consul.exampleZh: 行李被盗后，领事帮助这些旅客拿到了新护照。

consult.example: You should consult your doctor before you take this new medicine.
consult.exampleZh: 服用这种新药之前，你应该咨询你的医生。

consultant.example: The company hired a consultant to help them improve their sales.
consultant.exampleZh: 公司聘请了一位顾问来帮助他们提高销售额。

consume.example: People in big cities consume too much energy every day.
consume.exampleZh: 大城市里的人每天消耗太多能源。

consumer.example: Every consumer has the right to know what is in the food they buy.
consumer.exampleZh: 每位消费者都有权知道自己购买的食品里含有什么。

consummate.example: Her performance was a consummate display of skill and grace.
consummate.exampleZh: 她的表演是技巧与优雅的完美展现。

consumption.example: The country's energy consumption keeps rising as more factories open every year.
consumption.exampleZh: 随着每年更多工厂开工，这个国家的能源消耗持续上升。

contact.example: Please contact me by email if you have any questions.
contact.exampleZh: 如果你有任何问题，请通过电子邮件联系我。

contagion.example: The fear of contagion spread quickly through the small town last week.
contagion.exampleZh: 上周，对传染的恐惧迅速传遍了这座小镇。

contagious.example: Her laughter was contagious, and soon everyone in the room was smiling.
contagious.exampleZh: 她的笑声很有感染力，很快房间里的每个人都笑了。

contain.example: This box can contain all of my old books.
contain.exampleZh: 这个箱子能装下我所有的旧书。

container.example: The workers put the fresh fruit into a large plastic container.
container.exampleZh: 工人们把新鲜水果放进一个大塑料容器里。

contaminate.example: The factory dumped waste into the river and contaminated the water.
contaminate.exampleZh: 那家工厂把废料倒进河里，污染了河水。

contemn.example: He tends to contemn anyone who disagrees with his simple ideas.
contemn.exampleZh: 他往往蔑视任何不同意他简单想法的人。

contemplate.example: She likes to contemplate the quiet lake before making any big plans.
contemplate.exampleZh: 她喜欢在制定任何重大计划前静静地凝望这片湖面沉思。

contemporaneous.example: The two writers were contemporaneous and often wrote about the same events.
contemporaneous.exampleZh: 这两位作家处于同一时期，常常写同样的事件。

contemporary.example: This museum shows contemporary art by young artists from around the world.
contemporary.exampleZh: 这家博物馆展出世界各地年轻艺术家的当代艺术作品。

contempt.example: She looked at him with contempt after he broke his promise.
contempt.exampleZh: 他违背诺言后，她轻蔑地看着他。

contend.example: She had to contend with many problems at work last week.
contend.exampleZh: 上周她不得不应对工作中的许多问题。

content.example: The content of this book is easy to understand and very useful.
content.exampleZh: 这本书的内容通俗易懂，而且非常有用。

contentious.example: This is a contentious issue that many people disagree about.
contentious.exampleZh: 这是一个许多人意见不一的有争议的问题。

contest.example: She won the singing contest last year and now teaches others.
contest.exampleZh: 她去年赢得了歌唱比赛，现在教其他人。

context.example: The teacher explained the word's meaning by looking at the context.
context.exampleZh: 老师通过看上下文来解释这个词的意思。

contiguous.example: Our school is contiguous to a large park with many tall trees.
contiguous.exampleZh: 我们学校与一个有许多高树的大公园相邻。

continent.example: Africa is a large continent with many different countries and languages.
continent.exampleZh: 非洲是一个拥有许多不同国家和语言的大陆。

contingency.example: We saved some money as a contingency in case of sudden problems.
contingency.exampleZh: 我们存了一些钱作为应急之用，以防突发问题。

contingent.example: The trip is contingent on the weather, so we will decide tomorrow.
contingent.exampleZh: 这次旅行视天气情况而定，所以我们明天再决定。

continual.example: Her continual questions made it hard for me to finish my work.
continual.exampleZh: 她频繁的提问让我很难完成工作。

continue.example: The rain will continue all night, so take your umbrella with you.
continue.exampleZh: 雨会持续下一整夜，所以带上你的伞。

continuity.example: Keeping notes helps maintain continuity in our work from day to day.
continuity.exampleZh: 记笔记有助于我们保持日常工作的连续性。

continuous.example: The machine makes a continuous noise all day and night.
continuous.exampleZh: 这台机器日夜不停地发出连续的噪音。

contort.example: His face contorted with pain when he tried to stand up.
contort.exampleZh: 当他试图站起来时，他的脸因疼痛而扭曲了。

contour.example: The map shows the contour of the hill clearly.
contour.exampleZh: 地图清楚地显示了这座山的等高线。

contraband.example: The police found a lot of contraband hidden inside the old truck.
contraband.exampleZh: 警方在那辆旧卡车里发现了大量藏匿的走私货。

contract.example: The company signed a new contract with a local factory last week.
contract.exampleZh: 公司上周与当地一家工厂签订了一份新合同。

contraction.example: The contraction of the metal made the bridge slightly shorter.
contraction.exampleZh: 金属的收缩使桥稍微变短了。

contradiction.example: There is a clear contradiction between what he says and what he does.
contradiction.exampleZh: 他说的和做的之间存在明显的矛盾。

contrast.example: The contrast between the two pictures is easy to see.
contrast.exampleZh: 这两幅图之间的对比很容易看出来。

contravene.example: Drivers who contravene the traffic rules will be fined by the police.
contravene.exampleZh: 违反交通规则的司机将被警方罚款。

contribute.example: Many small habits contribute to a healthy and happy life.
contribute.exampleZh: 许多小习惯有助于健康快乐的生活。

contribution.example: Everyone thanked her for her great contribution to the school.
contribution.exampleZh: 大家都感谢她对学校的巨大贡献。

contrite.example: She felt truly contrite after seeing how much her words had hurt him.
contrite.exampleZh: 看到她的话给他带来多大伤害后，她真心感到懊悔。

contrive.example: They contrived a simple plan to save money for the trip.
contrive.exampleZh: 他们想出了一个简单的计划，为这次旅行攒钱。

control.example: Parents should control how much time their children spend on screens.
control.exampleZh: 父母应该控制孩子花在屏幕上的时间。

controversial.example: The new school rule is controversial because many parents and students disagree with it.
controversial.exampleZh: 这条新校规有争议，因为许多家长和学生都不赞同。

controversy.example: There is still a lot of controversy about this new law.
controversy.exampleZh: 关于这项新法律仍有很多争议。

convalesce.example: She went home to convalesce after her long stay in the hospital.
convalesce.exampleZh: 她在医院住了很久之后回家康复。

convene.example: The manager will convene a short meeting at nine tomorrow morning.
convene.exampleZh: 经理将于明天上午九点召集一次简短的会议。

convenience.example: Online shopping brings great convenience to people with busy lives.
convenience.exampleZh: 网上购物给生活忙碌的人带来了很大的便利。

convenient.example: This small shop is very convenient for people who live nearby.
convenient.exampleZh: 这家小店对住在附近的人来说非常方便。

convent.example: The old convent on the hill is home to twelve nuns.
convent.exampleZh: 山上的那座古老女修道院是十二位修女的家。

convention.example: The yearly science convention brings many young students to our city.
convention.exampleZh: 一年一度的科学大会把许多年轻学生带到了我们这座城市。

conventional.example: She prefers conventional cooking methods to modern ones.
conventional.exampleZh: 她更喜欢传统的烹饪方法，而不是现代的方法。

converge.example: Many small roads converge at the old bridge near our town.
converge.exampleZh: 许多小路在我们镇附近的那座旧桥处汇聚。

conversant.example: She is fully conversant with the new computer system at work.
conversant.exampleZh: 她完全熟悉工作中的新电脑系统。

conversation.example: I had a long conversation with my teacher after class today.
conversation.exampleZh: 今天下课后我和老师进行了一次长谈。

conversion.example: The conversion of the old factory into apartments took two years.
conversion.exampleZh: 把旧工厂改成公寓的这次转变花了两年时间。

convert.example: They plan to convert the old factory into a small library.
convert.exampleZh: 他们计划把这座旧工厂改造成一个小图书馆。

convex.example: The mirror has a convex surface that makes things look smaller.
convex.exampleZh: 这面镜子有一个凸起的表面，会让东西看起来变小。

convey.example: Her smile can convey warmth without a single word.
convey.exampleZh: 她的微笑无需一句话就能传达温暖。

convict.example: The court convicted him of theft, and he became a convict in that prison.
convict.exampleZh: 法庭判定他犯有盗窃罪，他成了那所监狱里的囚犯。

conviction.example: Her strong conviction helped her finish the difficult work.
conviction.exampleZh: 她坚定的信念帮助她完成了这项艰难的工作。

convince.example: She tried to convince her parents to let her study abroad.
convince.exampleZh: 她试图说服父母让她出国留学。

convivial.example: The dinner was convivial, and everyone talked happily until midnight.
convivial.exampleZh: 那顿晚餐气氛欢乐，大家愉快地聊到午夜。

convoke.example: The president decided to convoke a meeting to discuss the new plan.
convoke.exampleZh: 总统决定召开会议讨论新计划。

cook.example: My mother can cook delicious meals for the family every day.
cook.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天都能为家人做美味的饭菜。

cool.example: The soup is too hot, so let it cool for a few minutes.
cool.exampleZh: 汤太烫了，让它凉几分钟。

cooperate.example: Good students always cooperate with their classmates when they do group work.
cooperate.exampleZh: 好学生在做小组作业时总是和同学合作。

cooperative.example: The farmers formed a cooperative to sell their fruit at a better price.
cooperative.exampleZh: 农民们成立了一个合作社，以更好的价格出售他们的水果。

coordinate.example: She will coordinate the meeting times with all the team members.
coordinate.exampleZh: 她将与所有团队成员协调会议时间。

cop.example: The cop helped the lost child find his way home.
cop.exampleZh: 那位警察帮助迷路的孩子找到了回家的路。

cope.example: I don't know how to cope with all this work.
cope.exampleZh: 我不知道如何应付这么多工作。

copious.example: She took copious notes during the lecture and read them again at night.
copious.exampleZh: 她在讲座中记了大量笔记，晚上又读了一遍。

copy.example: Please copy this page and keep the copy in your bag.
copy.exampleZh: 请复印这一页，并把副本放在你的包里。

copyright.example: The writer still owns the copyright to all his early books.
copyright.exampleZh: 这位作家仍然拥有他所有早期书籍的版权。

coral.example: The fish live in the warm sea near the coral.
coral.exampleZh: 这些鱼生活在珊瑚附近温暖的海洋里。

cord.example: He tied the box with a strong cord before carrying it upstairs.
cord.exampleZh: 他把箱子用一根结实的绳子捆好，然后搬上楼。

cordial.example: She gave me a cordial welcome and made me feel at home.
cordial.exampleZh: 她热情地欢迎我，让我感到宾至如归。

core.example: The core of an apple is not good to eat.

cork.example: The cork came out of the bottle with a loud pop.
cork.exampleZh: 软木塞伴随一声巨响从瓶子里弹了出来。

corn.example: My mother cooks sweet corn for dinner every Sunday.
corn.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天晚餐都煮甜玉米。

cornea.example: The doctor said a small scratch on his cornea would heal in a few days.
cornea.exampleZh: 医生说他的角膜上有一道小划痕，几天内就会愈合。

corner.example: The cat is sleeping in the corner of the room.
corner.exampleZh: 猫正在房间的角落里睡觉。

cornerstone.example: Trust is the cornerstone of every good friendship.
cornerstone.exampleZh: 信任是每一段美好友谊的基石。

corollary.example: A rise in prices is a natural corollary of the shortage.
corollary.exampleZh: 物价上涨是短缺的必然结果。

coronation.example: The whole country celebrated the young king's coronation with music and dancing.
coronation.exampleZh: 全国人民用音乐和舞蹈庆祝年轻国王的加冕礼。

corporate.example: She works for a large corporate office in the city.
corporate.exampleZh: 她在城里一家大型公司办公室工作。

corporation.example: She works for a large corporation that makes computers and phones.
corporation.exampleZh: 她在一家生产电脑和手机的大公司工作。

corporeal.example: The story is about the corporeal needs of hungry people, not their dreams.
corporeal.exampleZh: 这个故事讲的是饥饿人们物质上的需求，而不是他们的梦想。

corps.example: The medical corps arrived early to help the wounded soldiers.
corps.exampleZh: 医疗队很早就到达了，去帮助受伤的士兵。

corpse.example: The police found a corpse near the river this morning.
corpse.exampleZh: 今天早上警察在河边发现了一具尸体。

corpus.example: The researcher searched the corpus for examples of this word.
corpus.exampleZh: 研究者在语料库中查找这个词的例句。

corpuscle.example: A red corpuscle carries oxygen from the lungs to the rest of the body.
corpuscle.exampleZh: 红细胞将氧气从肺部输送到身体其他部位。

corral.example: The farmer put the horses in the corral before the storm came.
corral.exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前，农夫把马关进了畜栏。

correct.example: Please correct your answers if they are not correct.
correct.exampleZh: 如果你的答案不正确，请改正。

correction.example: The teacher made a small correction to my spelling homework.
correction.exampleZh: 老师对我的拼写作业做了一个小修改。

correlate.example: Scientists found that sleep hours correlate with mood and memory.
correlate.exampleZh: 科学家发现，睡眠时长与情绪和记忆力相关。

correlation.example: There is a clear correlation between exercise and better sleep.
correlation.exampleZh: 运动与更好的睡眠之间存在明显的相关性。

correspond.example: Your answer does not correspond with the facts we already know.
correspond.exampleZh: 你的答案与我们已知的事实不符。

correspondence.example: We kept in close correspondence with the school about our son's progress.
correspondence.exampleZh: 我们就儿子的学习进展与学校保持着密切的通信往来。

correspondent.example: The foreign correspondent sent a short report from the capital last night.
correspondent.exampleZh: 那名驻外记者昨晚从首都发回了一篇简短的报道。

corresponding.example: Each student has a corresponding number on the class list.
corresponding.exampleZh: 每个学生在班级名单上都有一个对应的编号。

corridor.example: I walked down the long corridor to find my classroom.
corridor.exampleZh: 我沿着长长的走廊走，去找我的教室。

corroborate.example: The two witnesses corroborate his story about the missing keys.
corroborate.exampleZh: 两名证人的说法证实了他关于钥匙丢失的讲述。

corrode.example: Salt water can corrode the metal parts of a boat over time.
corrode.exampleZh: 盐水会随着时间腐蚀船上的金属部件。

corrosion.example: Regular painting helps protect the metal bridge from corrosion.
corrosion.exampleZh: 定期刷漆有助于保护这座金属桥免受腐蚀。

corrugated.example: The roof of the old shed is made of corrugated metal.
corrugated.exampleZh: 那座旧棚屋的屋顶是用波纹金属做的。

corrupt.example: Bad friends can corrupt a young mind and lead him to make wrong choices.
corrupt.exampleZh: 坏朋友会腐蚀年轻的心灵，导致他做出错误的选择。

corruption.example: The new leader promised to fight corruption and make the government honest again.
corruption.exampleZh: 新领导人承诺打击腐败，让政府重新变得廉洁。

corset.example: She wore a tight corset under her dress to look thinner.
corset.exampleZh: 她在裙子下穿了紧身胸衣，让自己看起来更瘦。

cosign.example: My father had to cosign the loan before the bank would lend me the money.
cosign.exampleZh: 银行借钱给我之前，我父亲必须先共同签署这笔贷款。

cosmetic.example: She bought some cosmetic products at the store and put them in her bag.
cosmetic.exampleZh: 她在商店买了一些化妆品，把它们放进了包里。

cosmic.example: Scientists study cosmic rays to learn more about our universe.
cosmic.exampleZh: 科学家研究宇宙射线，以更多地了解我们的宇宙。

cosmopolitan.example: Living in a big city made her more cosmopolitan and open to new ideas.
cosmopolitan.exampleZh: 住在大城市让她变得更加见多识广，也更容易接受新观念。

cosmos.example: Scientists study the cosmos to learn how stars and planets form.
cosmos.exampleZh: 科学家研究宇宙，以了解恒星和行星是如何形成的。

cost.example: The cost of the trip was higher than we expected.
cost.exampleZh: 这次旅行的费用比我们预期的要高。

costly.example: The repairs were costly, so we waited until next year.
costly.exampleZh: 维修费用很高，所以我们等到明年才做。

costume.example: She wore a beautiful costume to the school party last night.
costume.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一件漂亮的戏服去参加学校的派对。

cot.example: The baby is sleeping on a small cot next to our bed.
cot.exampleZh: 婴儿正在我们床边的一张帆布小床上睡觉。

cottage.example: They live in a small cottage near the lake.
cottage.exampleZh: 他们住在湖边一间小村舍里。

cotton.example: This shirt is made of soft cotton and it feels very comfortable.
cotton.exampleZh: 这件衬衫是用柔软的棉布做的，穿起来非常舒服。

couch.example: We sat on the couch and watched a movie together last night.
couch.exampleZh: 昨晚我们坐在长沙发上一起看了一部电影。

cough.example: My son has a bad cough, so he stayed home from school today.
cough.exampleZh: 我儿子咳嗽得厉害，所以今天他待在家里没去上学。

could.example: When I was young, I could run very fast.

council.example: The city council will meet on Monday to discuss the new park.
council.exampleZh: 市议会将于周一开会讨论新公园。

counsel.example: My lawyer gave me good counsel before I signed the contract.
counsel.exampleZh: 在签合同之前，我的律师给了我很好的忠告。

count.example: Please count the books on the desk and tell me the total.
count.exampleZh: 请数一数桌上的书，并告诉我总数。

countenance.example: Her calm countenance gave us hope during the hard days.
countenance.exampleZh: 在艰难的日子里，她平静的面容给了我们希望。

counter.example: The girl put her money on the counter and left the shop.
counter.exampleZh: 女孩把钱放在柜台上，然后离开了商店。

counteract.example: He drank some milk to counteract the spicy taste of the food.
counteract.exampleZh: 他喝了些牛奶来抵消食物的辣味。

counterbalance.example: The heavy box on the other side will counterbalance the weight of the machine.
counterbalance.exampleZh: 另一侧那个沉重的箱子将平衡这台机器的重量。

counterfeit.example: The police found counterfeit money in his old bag.
counterfeit.exampleZh: 警察在他的旧包里发现了假钞。

countermand.example: The general countermanded the order before the soldiers left the camp.
countermand.exampleZh: 将军在士兵们离开营地之前撤销了那道命令。

counterpart.example: The manager met her counterpart from the other company yesterday.
counterpart.exampleZh: 经理昨天会见了另一家公司的对应负责人。

counterpoint.example: The bright melody is a good counterpoint to the slow, heavy bass.
counterpoint.exampleZh: 明亮的旋律是对缓慢沉重低音的良好对位。

counterproductive.example: Shouting at the children is counterproductive because it makes them more stubborn.
counterproductive.exampleZh: 对孩子大吼大叫会事与愿违，因为这让他们更固执。

countless.example: She has helped countless people in her small town over the years.
countless.exampleZh: 这些年来，她帮助了小镇上无数的人。

country.example: My country is very big and has many beautiful cities and small villages.
country.exampleZh: 我的国家很大，有许多美丽的城市和小村庄。

county.example: Our county has a new library and a large park.
county.exampleZh: 我们县有一座新图书馆和一个大公园。

coup.example: The army tried to seize power in a coup last night.
coup.exampleZh: 军队昨晚试图通过政变夺取权力。

couple.example: A young couple lives next door, and they often invite us over for dinner.
couple.exampleZh: 一对年轻夫妇住在隔壁，他们经常邀请我们过去吃晚饭。

coupon.example: I used a coupon to buy this shirt for half price.
coupon.exampleZh: 我用一张优惠券以半价买了这件衬衫。

courage.example: It takes real courage to speak the truth when everyone else stays silent.
courage.exampleZh: 当其他人都保持沉默时，说出真相需要真正的勇气。

course.example: This course is easy, and we learn many new things every day.
course.exampleZh: 这门课程很容易，我们每天都学到很多新东西。

court.example: The court will decide the case next week.
court.exampleZh: 法院将在下周裁决此案。

courteous.example: The courteous waiter helped us carry our bags to the door.
courteous.exampleZh: 那位有礼貌的服务员帮我们把包搬到门口。

courtesy.example: Thank you for your courtesy to our guests.
courtesy.exampleZh: 感谢您对我们客人的礼貌。

courtyard.example: The children play games in the small courtyard behind our house.
courtyard.exampleZh: 孩子们在我们房子后面的小庭院里玩游戏。

cousin.example: My cousin and I played basketball together after school yesterday.
cousin.exampleZh: 我表弟和我昨天放学后一起打了篮球。

cover.example: Snow covered the whole garden last night, so we stayed inside.
cover.exampleZh: 昨晚大雪覆盖了整个花园，所以我们待在家里。

coverage.example: The newspaper's coverage of the local election was very detailed.
coverage.exampleZh: 报纸对地方选举的报道非常详细。

covet.example: He coveted his neighbor's new car and thought about it every day.
covet.exampleZh: 他觊觎邻居的新车，每天都在想着它。

covetous.example: The covetous man wanted his neighbor's land and money.
covetous.exampleZh: 那个贪婪的人想要邻居的土地和钱财。

cow.example: The farmer milks one cow every morning before the sun comes up.
cow.exampleZh: 农夫每天早上太阳升起前给一头奶牛挤奶。

coward.example: The boy was called a coward because he ran away from the fight.
coward.exampleZh: 那个男孩因为从打斗中逃跑而被叫做懦夫。

cozy.example: This small room is warm and cozy on cold winter nights.
cozy.exampleZh: 这个小小的房间在寒冷的冬夜里温暖又舒适。

crab.example: We caught a small crab in the shallow water near the beach.
crab.exampleZh: 我们在海滩附近的浅水里抓到一只小螃蟹。

crack.example: The ice will crack if you step on it too hard.
crack.exampleZh: 如果你踩得太用力，冰面会裂开。

cradle.example: The small town is known as the cradle of the country's music.
cradle.exampleZh: 这个小镇被认为是该国音乐的发源地。

craft.example: She learned the craft of making paper flowers from her grandmother.
craft.exampleZh: 她从祖母那里学会了制作纸花的工艺。

cramp.example: A sudden cramp in my leg woke me up last night.
cramp.exampleZh: 昨晚腿部突然抽筋把我疼醒了。

crane.example: A tall crane lifted the heavy box onto the roof.
crane.exampleZh: 一台高耸的起重机把那个沉重的箱子吊到了屋顶上。

crank.example: The old man next door is a harmless crank who talks to his bike.
crank.exampleZh: 隔壁那位老人是个无害的怪人，总对着自己的自行车说话。

crash.example: The old car crashed into a tree near my house last night.
crash.exampleZh: 昨晚那辆旧车在我家附近撞到了一棵树上。

crate.example: He put the fresh apples into a large wooden crate.
crate.exampleZh: 他把新鲜的苹果放进一个大木箱里。

crater.example: The old volcano has a deep crater near its top.
crater.exampleZh: 这座古老的火山顶部附近有一个很深的火山口。

crave.example: After a long day at work, I crave a hot bowl of soup.
crave.exampleZh: 工作一整天后，我渴望喝一碗热汤。

crawl.example: The baby can crawl across the floor to reach his toys.
crawl.exampleZh: 婴儿能爬过地板去够他的玩具。

crayon.example: The little girl drew a big yellow sun with her new crayon.
crayon.exampleZh: 小女孩用她的新蜡笔画了一个大大的黄色太阳。

crazy.example: My little brother is crazy about playing football with his friends after school.
crazy.exampleZh: 我弟弟非常着迷于放学后和朋友们一起踢足球。

creak.example: The old wooden stairs creak whenever someone walks up them at night.
creak.exampleZh: 每当有人夜里走上那段旧木楼梯时，楼梯就会嘎吱作响。

cream.example: She put some cream on her face after washing it.
cream.exampleZh: 她洗完脸后涂了一些乳霜。

crease.example: She folded the letter and made a sharp crease in the paper.
crease.exampleZh: 她把信折起来，在纸上压出一道清晰的折痕。

create.example: The new rules may create problems for small shops.
create.exampleZh: 新规定可能会给小商店带来问题。

creation.example: The creation of this garden took many years of hard work.
creation.exampleZh: 这个花园的创造花了许多年的辛勤劳动。

creative.example: She has a creative way of solving problems at work.
creative.exampleZh: 她在工作中有一套创造性的解决问题的方法。

creature.example: The small creature lives in the dark forest near our village.
creature.exampleZh: 这种小生物住在我们村庄附近的黑暗森林里。

credence.example: Few people gave credence to his story about the missing money.
credence.exampleZh: 很少有人相信他关于那笔丢失的钱的说法。

credentials.example: You need the right credentials to apply for this job.
credentials.exampleZh: 你需要合适的资历才能申请这份工作。

credible.example: Her story is credible because she has proof.
credible.exampleZh: 她的说法可信，因为她有证据。

credit.example: She got credit for her hard work on the project.
credit.exampleZh: 她因在这个项目上的努力而获得赞扬。

creditor.example: The bank is the main creditor, so it must approve the sale.
creditor.exampleZh: 银行是主要债权人，因此必须批准这笔出售。

creed.example: Her creed is to treat everyone with kindness and respect.
creed.exampleZh: 她的信条是以善良和尊重对待每一个人。

creek.example: A small creek runs behind our house and flows into the river.
creek.exampleZh: 一条小溪从我们房子后面流过，然后汇入河中。

creep.example: Ivy can creep up the wall of our old house very quickly.
creep.exampleZh: 常春藤会很快地爬上我们老房子的墙。

cremate.example: They will cremate his body tomorrow morning at the local cemetery.
cremate.exampleZh: 他们明天早上会在当地墓地将他的遗体火化。

creole.example: Many people in the Caribbean speak a creole at home and English at school.
creole.exampleZh: 加勒比地区的许多人在家里说克里奥尔语，在学校说英语。

crest.example: We finally reached the crest of the hill after a long walk.
crest.exampleZh: 走了很久之后，我们终于到达了山顶。

cricket.example: The children listened to a cricket singing in the garden last night.
cricket.exampleZh: 昨晚孩子们听着花园里一只蟋蟀在歌唱。

crime.example: The police are trying to stop crime in this city.
crime.exampleZh: 警方正努力阻止这座城市的犯罪。

criminal.example: The police caught the criminal near the bank last night.
criminal.exampleZh: 警察昨晚在银行附近抓住了那个罪犯。

crimson.example: She wore a crimson dress to the party last night.
crimson.exampleZh: 昨晚她穿了一条深红色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

cripple.example: The storm badly crippled the small town's power supply for weeks.
cripple.exampleZh: 暴风雨严重破坏了小镇的电力供应，持续了好几周。

crisis.example: The country is facing a serious economic crisis this year.
crisis.exampleZh: 这个国家今年正面临一场严重的经济危机。

crisp.example: The morning air is crisp and the leaves are dry under my feet.
crisp.exampleZh: 清晨的空气很清新，脚下的落叶很干爽。

criterion.example: The teacher used a clear criterion to judge our science projects.
criterion.exampleZh: 老师用一条明确的标准来评判我们的科学项目。

critic.example: The critic wrote a short review of the new film.
critic.exampleZh: 这位评论家为这部新电影写了一篇短评。

critical.example: Clean water is critical for the health of every child.
critical.exampleZh: 干净的水对每个孩子的健康都至关重要。

criticism.example: Her honest criticism helped me improve my writing skills.
criticism.exampleZh: 她坦诚的批评帮助我提高了写作能力。

criticize.example: My teacher will criticize my essay if I make too many spelling mistakes.
criticize.exampleZh: 如果我拼写错误太多，老师会批评我的文章。

critique.example: Her critique of the plan was fair and easy to understand.
critique.exampleZh: 她对这份计划的批判性分析很公正，也通俗易懂。

crocodile.example: The crocodile lay still by the river and waited for its next meal.
crocodile.exampleZh: 鳄鱼一动不动地躺在河边，等待下一顿饭。

crop.example: The farmers expect a good crop of rice this year.
crop.exampleZh: 农民们预计今年水稻会有好收成。

cross.example: Look both ways before you cross the busy street.
cross.exampleZh: 穿过繁忙的街道前，要先看两边。

crouch.example: She had to crouch down to look under the low table.
crouch.exampleZh: 她不得不蹲下来看那张矮桌子底下。

crow.example: A black crow sat on the fence and began to crow loudly.
crow.exampleZh: 一只黑色的乌鸦停在篱笆上，开始大声啼叫。

crowd.example: A large crowd stood outside the store and waited for the doors to open.
crowd.exampleZh: 一大群人站在店外，等待商店开门。

crown.example: The queen wore a gold crown on her head at the party.
crown.exampleZh: 女王在聚会上头戴一顶金王冠。

crucial.example: Good sleep is crucial for your health and your mood.
crucial.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠对你的健康和情绪至关重要。

crucible.example: The long illness was a crucible that made the whole family stronger.
crucible.exampleZh: 这场漫长的疾病是一个熔炉，让全家人变得更坚强。

crude.example: His crude drawing was hard to understand at first.
crude.exampleZh: 他粗糙的画作一开始很难看懂。

cruel.example: It is cruel to laugh at a child who is trying his best.
cruel.exampleZh: 嘲笑一个正在尽力的孩子是残忍的。

cruise.example: We took a cruise along the river and stopped at three small towns.
cruise.exampleZh: 我们乘船沿河游览，在三个小镇停留。

crumble.example: The old stone wall began to crumble after years of heavy rain.
crumble.exampleZh: 多年的暴雨过后，那堵旧石墙开始崩塌。

crush.example: The machine can crush the stones into fine powder very quickly.
crush.exampleZh: 这台机器能很快把石头压成细粉。

crust.example: The bread has a hard crust and a soft inside.
crust.exampleZh: 这块面包有一层硬外壳，里面很软。

crux.example: The crux of the problem is that we have too little time.
crux.exampleZh: 问题的关键在于我们的时间太少了。

cry.example: The baby began to cry when she could not find her mother.
cry.exampleZh: 那个婴儿找不到妈妈时开始哭了起来。

crypt.example: The old church has a dark crypt below the main floor.
crypt.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂主楼层下面有一个黑暗的地窖。

cryptic.example: His cryptic message left everyone guessing what he really meant.
cryptic.exampleZh: 他那条隐晦的消息让每个人都在猜他到底是什么意思。

crystal.example: She keeps a small crystal on her desk because it looks beautiful in the sun.
crystal.exampleZh: 她在书桌上放着一块小水晶，因为它在阳光下看起来很漂亮。

cub.example: The mother bear protects her cub from danger in the forest.
cub.exampleZh: 母熊在森林里保护她的幼崽免受危险。

cube.example: A cube has six equal square faces and looks like a dice.
cube.exampleZh: 立方体有六个相等的正方形面，看起来像骰子。

cubic.example: The box has a volume of two cubic meters.
cubic.exampleZh: 这个盒子的体积是两立方米。

cuckold.example: The old story says the king became a cuckold because his wife loved another man.
cuckold.exampleZh: 那个古老的故事说，国王因为妻子爱上了另一个男人而成了戴绿帽子的人。

cuckoo.example: A cuckoo sang in the tree behind our small house.
cuckoo.exampleZh: 一只布谷鸟在我们小屋后面的树上歌唱。

cucumber.example: She cut the cucumber into thin slices for our salad.
cucumber.exampleZh: 她把黄瓜切成薄片，用来做我们的沙拉。

cud.example: The cow chews its cud slowly while standing in the field.
cud.exampleZh: 奶牛站在田野里慢慢地咀嚼反刍的食物。

cuddle.example: The little girl likes to cuddle her soft toy before going to sleep.
cuddle.exampleZh: 这个小女孩喜欢在睡觉前抱着她的软玩具。

cudgel.example: The old man used a heavy cudgel to protect his sheep from wolves.
cudgel.exampleZh: 那位老人用一根沉重的棍棒保护他的羊群免受狼的侵害。

cue.example: Her smile was a cue for me to start the song.
cue.exampleZh: 她的微笑是我开始唱歌的提示。

cuff.example: The police put cuffs on the man and led him away.
cuff.exampleZh: 警察给那个男人戴上手铐，把他带走了。

cult.example: People warned us that the group might be a dangerous cult.
cult.exampleZh: 人们警告我们说，那个团体可能是一个危险的邪教。

cultivate.example: Farmers cultivate the land every spring so their crops can grow well.
cultivate.exampleZh: 农民每年春天耕作土地，好让庄稼长得好。

cultivation.example: The cultivation of rice requires a lot of water and hard work.
cultivation.exampleZh: 水稻的种植需要大量的水和辛勤的劳动。

culture.example: Food is an important part of every culture around the world.
culture.exampleZh: 食物是世界上每一种文化的重要组成部分。

cumber.example: Heavy old rules cumber the small team and slow its work.
cumber.exampleZh: 沉重的旧规则拖累了这个小团队，使他们的工作变慢。

cumulative.example: The cumulative effect of small savings grew into a large amount over time.
cumulative.exampleZh: 小额储蓄的累积效应随着时间的推移变成了一大笔钱。

cuneiform.example: Ancient people used cuneiform to write things on clay tablets.
cuneiform.exampleZh: 古人使用楔形文字在泥板上书写。

cup.example: The cup of tea is too hot to drink now.
cup.exampleZh: 这杯茶太烫了，现在喝不了。

cupboard.example: She put the clean cups and plates in the cupboard.
cupboard.exampleZh: 她把干净的杯子和盘子放进橱柜里。

curator.example: The curator showed us the new paintings in the museum.
curator.exampleZh: 馆长带我们看了博物馆里的新画作。

curb.example: The city built a new curb to keep cars away from the school.
curb.exampleZh: 市政府新建了路边石，让汽车远离学校。

curdle.example: If you add lemon juice to warm milk, it will curdle quickly.
curdle.exampleZh: 如果你往温牛奶里加柠檬汁，它很快就会凝结。

cure.example: The new medicine may cure his cough in a few days.
cure.exampleZh: 这种新药也许几天内就能治好他的咳嗽。

curfew.example: The city has a curfew for all teenagers after ten at night.
curfew.exampleZh: 这座城市对所有青少年实行晚上十点后的宵禁。

curio.example: He found a small curio in the old shop and bought it.
curio.exampleZh: 他在那家老店里发现了一件小古董，就把它买下了。

curiosity.example: My curiosity made me open the old box.
curiosity.exampleZh: 我的好奇心促使我打开了那个旧盒子。

curious.example: The curious little boy asked his mother many questions about the stars.
curious.exampleZh: 那个好奇的小男孩问了他妈妈许多关于星星的问题。

curl.example: The little girl likes to curl her hair before the show.
curl.exampleZh: 这个小女孩喜欢在演出前把头发卷起来。

curmudgeon.example: My old neighbor is a real curmudgeon who never smiles at anyone.
curmudgeon.exampleZh: 我的老邻居是个十足的脾气暴躁的人，从不朝任何人笑。

currant.example: My mother put some currants in the cake she baked yesterday.
currant.exampleZh: 我妈妈在她昨天烤的蛋糕里放了一些葡萄干。

currency.example: The country uses a new currency, so prices in the shops have changed.
currency.exampleZh: 这个国家使用一种新货币，因此商店里的价格已经变了。

current.example: The current in the wire is strong, and the current trend looks good.
current.exampleZh: 电线中的电流很强，当前的趋势看起来不错。

curriculum.example: The school added computer science to its curriculum this year.
curriculum.exampleZh: 学校今年把计算机科学加入了课程。

curry.example: My mother makes curry with rice and vegetables every Friday night.
curry.exampleZh: 我妈妈每周五晚上都会用米饭和蔬菜做咖喱。

curse.example: The old man began to curse when he lost his keys.
curse.exampleZh: 那位老人丢了钥匙后开始咒骂。

cursive.example: Her cursive handwriting is beautiful and easy to read.
cursive.exampleZh: 她的草书字迹漂亮又容易辨认。

cursor.example: Move the cursor to the end of the line and click there.
cursor.exampleZh: 把光标移到这一行的末尾，然后在那里点击。

cursory.example: He gave the report a cursory look before the meeting.
cursory.exampleZh: 会议前他只是粗略地看了一眼那份报告。

curt.example: His curt reply made it clear he did not want to talk.
curt.exampleZh: 他简短粗暴的回答清楚表明他不想说话。

curtail.example: The company had to curtail its spending after sales fell last year.
curtail.exampleZh: 去年销售额下降后，公司不得不缩减开支。

curve.example: The road makes a sharp curve near the old bridge, so drive slowly.
curve.exampleZh: 这条路在旧桥附近有一个急转弯，所以要慢点开。

cushion.example: I put a soft cushion on the chair to make it more comfortable.
cushion.exampleZh: 我在椅子上放了一个柔软的垫子，让它更舒服。

cusp.example: The small boat reached the cusp of the huge wave and then slid down.
cusp.exampleZh: 小船到达巨浪的尖端，然后滑了下去。

custard.example: My mother made a sweet custard for dessert after dinner.
custard.exampleZh: 晚饭后，妈妈做了一份甜甜的蛋奶冻当甜点。

custodian.example: The custodian of the building keeps the keys safe.
custodian.exampleZh: 这栋楼的保管人负责保管钥匙。

custody.example: The mother was given custody of her two young children.
custody.exampleZh: 这位母亲获得了两个年幼孩子的监护权。

custom.example: It is a local custom to eat dumplings at the new year.
custom.exampleZh: 在新年吃饺子是当地的习俗。

customary.example: It is customary to bring a small gift when you visit a friend's home.
customary.exampleZh: 去朋友家做客时带一份小礼物是惯例。

customer.example: The customer asked the waiter for a glass of water.
customer.exampleZh: 那位顾客向服务员要了一杯水。

cut.example: The doctor cleaned the cut on his hand and told him to rest.
cut.exampleZh: 医生清洗了他手上的伤口，并让他休息。

cute.example: The little girl has a cute smile and everyone likes her.
cute.exampleZh: 这个小女孩有一个可爱的笑容，大家都喜欢她。

cycle.example: The cycle of the seasons brings warm summers and cold winters.
cycle.exampleZh: 四季的循环带来温暖的夏天和寒冷的冬天。

cylinder.example: The engine has four cylinders, and each one holds a small metal cylinder.
cylinder.exampleZh: 这个发动机有四个气缸，每个气缸里都有一个小金属圆柱体。

cymbal.example: The drummer hit the cymbal loudly at the end of the song.
cymbal.exampleZh: 鼓手在歌曲结尾处用力敲响了钹。

cynic.example: He is a cynic who never trusts any politician's promises.
cynic.exampleZh: 他是个愤世嫉俗者，从不相信任何政客的承诺。

cynosure.example: At the party, she was the cynosure of every eye in the room.
cynosure.exampleZh: 在聚会上，她是房间里所有人目光的焦点。

dabble.example: She likes to dabble in painting on weekends.
dabble.exampleZh: 她喜欢在周末涉猎绘画。

dactyl.example: A dactyl is a foot with one long and two short beats in poetry.
dactyl.exampleZh: 扬抑格音步是诗歌中一个长音节加两个短音节构成的音步。

daddy.example: My daddy makes the best pancakes for us every Sunday morning.
daddy.exampleZh: 我爸爸每个星期天早上都给我们做最好吃的薄煎饼。

daffodil.example: Every spring, yellow daffodils grow in the garden behind our house.
daffodil.exampleZh: 每年春天，我们家屋后的花园里都会长出黄色的水仙花。

daft.example: It was a daft idea to go swimming in the cold river.
daft.exampleZh: 在冰冷的河里游泳是个愚蠢的主意。

dagger.example: He hid a small dagger under his coat before leaving the house.
dagger.exampleZh: 他出门前把一把小匕首藏在了外套下面。

daily.example: I read the daily news on my phone every morning before work.
daily.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都用手机看每日新闻。

dairy.example: We buy milk and cheese at the dairy near our house.
dairy.exampleZh: 我们在家附近的乳制品店买牛奶和奶酪。

dally.example: Don't dally on the way home, or you will miss dinner.
dally.exampleZh: 别在路上磨蹭，否则你会错过晚饭。

dam.example: The old dam across the river helps keep the town safe.
dam.exampleZh: 河上的那座旧水坝帮助保护小镇的安全。

damage.example: The storm did a lot of damage to the old house.
damage.exampleZh: 暴风雨给那栋老房子造成了很大损害。

damn.example: I don't give a damn about what he says.
damn.exampleZh: 我一点也不在乎他说什么。

damp.example: The damp towel on the chair made my shirt wet.
damp.exampleZh: 椅子上那条潮湿的毛巾把我的衬衫弄湿了。

dance.example: She loves to dance with her friends at the party every weekend.
dance.exampleZh: 她喜欢每个周末在聚会上和朋友们跳舞。

dandelion.example: The little girl picked a yellow dandelion from the grass and smiled.
dandelion.exampleZh: 小女孩从草地上摘了一朵黄色的蒲公英，笑了。

dandy.example: He is a real dandy who always wears a nice suit and bright shoes.
dandy.exampleZh: 他是个真正的花花公子，总是穿着漂亮的西装和亮眼的鞋子。

danger.example: The broken bridge is a danger to everyone who walks across it.
danger.exampleZh: 这座破损的桥对所有从上面走过的人来说都是危险。

dangerous.example: It is dangerous to swim in this river after heavy rain.
dangerous.exampleZh: 大雨过后在这条河里游泳很危险。

dapple.example: The sunlight dapples the quiet garden path with soft shadows.
dapple.exampleZh: 阳光在小花园的小径上洒下柔和的斑驳光影。

dare.example: He did not dare to tell his parents the truth about the exam.
dare.exampleZh: 他不敢把考试的真相告诉父母。

dark.example: The room is dark, so please turn on the light.

darling.example: My darling, you look lovely in that new dress.
darling.exampleZh: 亲爱的，你穿那条新裙子真好看。

dart.example: The little boy threw a dart at the board and ran to check it.
dart.exampleZh: 小男孩把一支飞镖投向镖盘，然后跑过去查看。

dash.example: He dashed across the street to catch the early bus.
dash.exampleZh: 他猛冲过马路去赶早班公交车。

data.example: Our teacher showed us the data from the science test.
data.exampleZh: 老师给我们看了科学测试的数据。

database.example: The company stores all customer records in a large database.
database.exampleZh: 公司把所有客户记录都存放在一个大型数据库中。

date.example: Please write the date on your paper and date it today.
date.exampleZh: 请在试卷上写下日期，并注明今天的日期。

daughter.example: Their daughter is a doctor in the city hospital.
daughter.exampleZh: 他们的女儿是市里一家医院的医生。

daunt.example: The long exam did not daunt her, and she studied harder.
daunt.exampleZh: 这场漫长的考试并没有让她气馁，她反而更加努力地学习。

davenport.example: My grandmother likes to take a short nap on the davenport every afternoon.
davenport.exampleZh: 我奶奶喜欢每天下午在长沙发上小睡一会儿。

dawn.example: The new year marks the dawn of a better life for everyone.
dawn.exampleZh: 新年标志着每个人更好生活的开端。

day.example: We spent the whole day at the beach with our friends.
day.exampleZh: 我们和朋友们在海滩上度过了整整一天。

daylight.example: We left the house before daylight and walked to the station.
daylight.exampleZh: 我们在天亮前离开家，步行去了车站。

daytime.example: The baby usually sleeps during the daytime and stays awake at night.
daytime.exampleZh: 这个婴儿白天通常睡觉，晚上醒着。

dazzle.example: The bright lights of the city dazzle visitors at night.
dazzle.exampleZh: 城市的明亮灯光在夜晚让游客目眩。

de facto.example: He is the de facto leader of the group, though nobody voted for him.
de facto.exampleZh: 尽管没有人投票选他，他却是这个团体事实上的领导者。

de jure.example: The de jure owner of the land is still the old family.
de jure.exampleZh: 这块土地法律上的所有者仍是那个老家族。

dead.example: The old dog is dead, but his toys are still here.
dead.exampleZh: 那只老狗已经死了，但他的玩具还在这里。

deadline.example: I have to finish this report before the deadline on Friday.
deadline.exampleZh: 我必须在周五的截止日期前完成这份报告。

deadlock.example: The two sides reached a deadlock in the talks and went home.
deadlock.exampleZh: 双方在谈判中陷入僵局，于是各自回家了。

deadly.example: The snake's bite is deadly, so please stay away from it.
deadly.exampleZh: 这条蛇的咬伤是致命的，所以请远离它。

deadpan.example: She told the joke in a deadpan voice and nobody laughed at first.
deadpan.exampleZh: 她用冷冰冰的语气讲了这个笑话，一开始没有人笑。

deadweight.example: The old debt became a deadweight on the small family business.
deadweight.exampleZh: 这笔旧债成了这个小家族企业的重负。

deaf.example: The old man is deaf in one ear and cannot hear well.
deaf.exampleZh: 那位老人一只耳朵聋了，听不太清楚。

deal.example: I do not know how to deal with this difficult problem.
deal.exampleZh: 我不知道如何处理这个棘手的问题。

dealer.example: The car dealer sold us a new car at a low price.
dealer.exampleZh: 这位汽车经销商以低价卖给了我们一辆新车。

dean.example: The dean of our college gave a short speech at the meeting.
dean.exampleZh: 我们学院的院长在会上做了简短的讲话。

dear.example: Oh dear, this beautiful old watch is far too dear for me.
dear.exampleZh: 哎呀，这块漂亮的老手表对我来说太贵了。

dearth.example: There is a dearth of fresh water in this dry region.
dearth.exampleZh: 这个干旱地区缺乏淡水。

death.example: The old man's death made everyone in the small village very sad.
death.exampleZh: 这位老人的死亡让小村庄里的每个人都非常难过。

debacle.example: The company's new product was a complete debacle and lost millions of dollars.
debacle.exampleZh: 公司的新产品彻底失败，损失了数百万美元。

debark.example: After the long flight, we debarked from the plane and walked to the terminal.
debark.exampleZh: 长途飞行后，我们从飞机上下来，步行前往航站楼。

debase.example: He never lets money debase his art or his honest way of living.
debase.exampleZh: 他从不让金钱贬低他的艺术或他诚实的生活方式。

debate.example: The students had a long debate about school rules after class.
debate.exampleZh: 学生们课后就校规进行了长时间的辩论。

debauch.example: Bad friends can debauch a young man and ruin his whole life.
debauch.exampleZh: 坏朋友会使一个年轻人堕落，毁掉他的一生。

debilitate.example: The long illness debilitated him and made simple tasks feel very hard.
debilitate.exampleZh: 长期疾病使他变得虚弱，让简单的事情都变得很难。

debit.example: The bank will debit your account for the monthly fee tomorrow.
debit.exampleZh: 银行明天会从你的账户中扣除月度手续费。

debrief.example: The manager will debrief the team after the meeting.
debrief.exampleZh: 经理会在会议结束后听取团队的汇报。

debris.example: After the storm, workers found debris from the broken roof on the street.
debris.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，工人们在街上发现了破损屋顶的碎片。

debt.example: He used all his savings to pay off his debt last year.
debt.exampleZh: 他去年用全部积蓄还清了债务。

debug.example: The programmer will debug the new app before its release tomorrow.
debug.exampleZh: 程序员会在明天发布前调试这款新应用。

debut.example: She made her debut on stage at the age of ten.
debut.exampleZh: 她十岁时首次登台演出。

debutante.example: The young debutante wore a white dress to her first party.
debutante.exampleZh: 这位初次参加社交活动的少女穿着白色连衣裙去参加她的第一场舞会。

decade.example: My father has worked in this factory for almost a decade.
decade.exampleZh: 我父亲在这家工厂工作了将近十年。

decadence.example: The old city showed signs of decadence after years of neglect.
decadence.exampleZh: 这座城市在多年荒废后显露出衰败的迹象。

decadent.example: The old city had a decadent beauty that attracted many young artists.
decadent.exampleZh: 这座老城有一种颓废的美，吸引了许多年轻艺术家。

decaffeinated.example: I drink decaffeinated coffee in the evening so I can sleep well.
decaffeinated.exampleZh: 我晚上喝脱咖啡因的咖啡，这样能睡得好。

decapitate.example: The cruel king ordered his men to decapitate the prisoner at dawn.
decapitate.exampleZh: 那个残忍的国王下令在黎明时分将囚犯斩首。

decathlon.example: He won the decathlon after training hard for many years.
decathlon.exampleZh: 他经过多年刻苦训练后赢得了十项全能比赛。

decay.example: Fallen leaves slowly decay and turn into rich soil on the forest floor.
decay.exampleZh: 落叶慢慢腐烂，在森林地面上变成肥沃的土壤。

decease.example: After his father's sudden decease, he had to take care of the family business.
decease.exampleZh: 父亲突然去世后，他不得不接手家族生意。

deceit.example: His deceit hurt everyone who had trusted him for years.
deceit.exampleZh: 他的欺骗伤害了所有多年来信任他的人。

deceitful.example: He was deceitful about the money and lied to his own family.
deceitful.exampleZh: 他在钱的事情上很不诚实，对自己家人撒了谎。

deceive.example: He tried to deceive his friends about the broken window.
deceive.exampleZh: 他试图就打破窗户的事欺骗他的朋友们。

decelerate.example: The train began to decelerate as it came into the station.

december.example: My family always has a big dinner together in December.
december.exampleZh: 我们家总是在十二月一起吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。

decency.example: He treated everyone with decency and respect, even when he was angry.
decency.exampleZh: 即使生气时，他也以体面和尊重对待每个人。

decennial.example: The town holds a decennial festival to celebrate its history.
decennial.exampleZh: 这个小镇每十年举办一次节庆来庆祝它的历史。

decent.example: He is a decent man who always helps his neighbors.
decent.exampleZh: 他是一个正派的人，总是帮助邻居。

deception.example: His kind words were just a deception to get my money.
deception.exampleZh: 他的好话只是为了骗我钱的诡计。

deceptive.example: The mirror's deceptive shine made the old table look new.
deceptive.exampleZh: 镜子般迷人的光泽让这张旧桌子看起来像新的。

decibel.example: The music was so loud that it reached over one hundred decibels.
decibel.exampleZh: 音乐太响了，音量超过了一百分贝。

decide.example: We must decide which plan to follow before the meeting starts.
decide.exampleZh: 我们必须在会议开始前决定采用哪个方案。

deciduous.example: Many deciduous trees lose their leaves every autumn.
deciduous.exampleZh: 许多落叶树每年秋天都会落叶。

decile.example: The teacher divided the class into ten groups, and each decile had five students.
decile.exampleZh: 老师把班级分成十组，每个十分位组有五名学生。

decimal.example: The decimal system makes it easy to add and multiply numbers.
decimal.exampleZh: 十进位制使数字的加法和乘法变得容易。

decimate.example: The long war decimated the small town's population.
decimate.exampleZh: 漫长的战争使这个小镇的人口大批减少。

decipher.example: It took her a long time to decipher the old letter.
decipher.exampleZh: 她花了很长时间才破译那封旧信。

decision.example: She made a quick decision to walk home instead of waiting.
decision.exampleZh: 她果断决定步行回家，不再等了。

decisive.example: Her decisive answer ended the long discussion.
decisive.exampleZh: 她明确的回答结束了漫长的讨论。

deck.example: We sat on the deck and watched the sun go down.
deck.exampleZh: 我们坐在甲板上看太阳落下。

declaim.example: He liked to declaim against modern music at every family dinner.
declaim.exampleZh: 他喜欢在每次家庭聚餐上慷慨激昂地抨击现代音乐。

declaration.example: The two countries signed a joint declaration to protect the environment.
declaration.exampleZh: 两国签署了一份保护环境的联合宣言。

declare.example: The government will declare the new law next week.
declare.exampleZh: 政府将于下周宣布这项新法律。

decline.example: Sales began to decline last year, and the company closed two small offices.
decline.exampleZh: 去年销售额开始下降，公司关闭了两个小办公室。

declivity.example: The old road runs down a steep declivity toward the river.
declivity.exampleZh: 那条老路沿着陡峭的下坡通向河边。

decode.example: Can you decode this secret message for me?
decode.exampleZh: 你能帮我解码这条秘密信息吗？

decompose.example: Bacteria help decompose dead leaves and old wood into rich soil.
decompose.exampleZh: 细菌帮助把枯叶和旧木头分解成肥沃的土壤。

decomposition.example: The decomposition of the old leaves takes several months in wet soil.
decomposition.exampleZh: 在潮湿的土壤中，这些旧叶子的分解需要好几个月。

decorate.example: We decorate the classroom with colorful paper flowers before the school festival.
decorate.exampleZh: 学校节日前，我们用彩色的纸花装饰教室。

decoration.example: The Christmas tree looks beautiful with all its bright decorations.
decoration.exampleZh: 圣诞树上挂满明亮的装饰品，看起来很漂亮。

decorous.example: She gave a decorous bow after the short piano performance.
decorous.exampleZh: 简短的钢琴表演结束后，她礼貌地鞠了一躬。

decorum.example: He always behaves with great decorum at formal dinners.
decorum.exampleZh: 他在正式晚宴上总是表现得非常得体。

decoy.example: The hunter used a wooden duck as a decoy to attract real birds.
decoy.exampleZh: 猎人用一只木鸭作为诱饵来吸引真鸟。

decrease.example: The number of students in our class will decrease next year.
decrease.exampleZh: 我们班的学生人数明年会减少。

decrepit.example: The decrepit old house on our street has been empty for years.
decrepit.exampleZh: 我们街上那栋破旧的老房子已经空了好几年了。

decriminalize.example: Many countries want to decriminalize small drug offenses to reduce prison numbers.
decriminalize.exampleZh: 许多国家希望将少量毒品犯罪非刑事化，以减少监狱人数。

decry.example: Many people decry the new rules as unfair to poor families.
decry.exampleZh: 许多人公开谴责这些新规定对贫困家庭不公平。

dedicate.example: She decided to dedicate her free time to helping children learn music.
dedicate.exampleZh: 她决定把自己的空闲时间奉献给帮助孩子们学习音乐。

dedicated.example: She is a dedicated teacher who always helps her students after class.
dedicated.exampleZh: 她是一位专注的教师，课后总是帮助她的学生。

dedication.example: Her dedication to the job made everyone on the team respect her.
dedication.exampleZh: 她对工作的奉献让团队里的每个人都尊敬她。

deduce.example: From these clues we can deduce the answer.
deduce.exampleZh: 从这些线索中我们可以推断出答案。

deduct.example: The company will deduct the fee from your next payment.
deduct.exampleZh: 公司将从你的下一笔付款中扣除这笔费用。

deduction.example: Your monthly deduction covers taxes and health insurance.
deduction.exampleZh: 你每月的扣除额包含税费和健康保险。

deductive.example: His deductive reasoning helped us find the correct answer quickly.
deductive.exampleZh: 他的演绎推理帮助我们很快找到了正确答案。

deed.example: She is known for her good deeds in the community.
deed.exampleZh: 她因在社区里的善行而为人所知。

deem.example: Most people deem this book useful for beginners.
deem.exampleZh: 大多数人认为这本书对初学者很有用。

deep.example: The lake is very deep, so children must stay near the shore.
deep.exampleZh: 这个湖非常深，所以孩子们必须待在岸边附近。

deer.example: We saw a young deer drinking water by the river this morning.
deer.exampleZh: 今天早上我们看到一只小鹿在河边喝水。

defamation.example: He sued the newspaper for defamation after they published false stories about him.
defamation.exampleZh: 在那家报纸刊登了关于他的虚假报道后，他起诉该报纸诽谤。

default.example: The company was forced to default on its loan last year.
default.exampleZh: 这家公司去年被迫拖欠了贷款。

defeat.example: Our team worked hard and finally defeated the strong rival in the final game.
defeat.exampleZh: 我们队努力拼搏，最终在决赛中击败了强劲的对手。

defecate.example: The dog needs to defecate after eating its food.
defecate.exampleZh: 狗吃完食物后需要排便。

defect.example: The engineers found a small defect in the new engine.
defect.exampleZh: 工程师们在新发动机中发现了一个小缺陷。

defection.example: The soldier's defection shocked his family and his old friends.
defection.exampleZh: 那名士兵的叛逃令他的家人和老朋友感到震惊。

defective.example: The company recalled the defective toys before any child could get hurt.
defective.exampleZh: 公司在任何孩子受伤之前召回了那些有缺陷的玩具。

defence.example: The country spends a lot of money on defence each year.
defence.exampleZh: 这个国家每年在国防上花费大量资金。

defend.example: We must defend our home from the strong wind and rain.
defend.exampleZh: 我们必须保护我们的家免受狂风暴雨的侵袭。

defendant.example: The defendant stood quietly in court and waited for the judge to speak.
defendant.exampleZh: 被告静静地站在法庭上，等待法官发言。

defensible.example: Her decision was defensible because she had all the facts.
defensible.exampleZh: 她的决定是站得住脚的，因为她掌握了所有事实。

defensive.example: He became very defensive when we asked him about the missing money.
defensive.exampleZh: 当我们问他那笔丢失的钱时，他变得非常防备。

defer.example: We must defer the meeting until next week because the manager is away.
defer.exampleZh: 因为经理不在，我们必须把会议推迟到下周。

deference.example: He spoke with great deference to his old teacher.
deference.exampleZh: 他对年迈的老师说话时满怀敬意。

defiance.example: His quiet defiance surprised the whole class.
defiance.exampleZh: 他无声的违抗让全班都感到惊讶。

defiant.example: The defiant boy refused to say sorry to his teacher.
defiant.exampleZh: 那个叛逆的男孩拒绝向老师道歉。

deficiency.example: A deficiency of vitamin D can make your bones weak and easy to break.
deficiency.exampleZh: 缺乏维生素D会使你的骨骼变得脆弱，容易骨折。

deficient.example: The old computer is deficient in memory, so it runs very slowly.
deficient.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑内存不足，所以运行得很慢。

deficit.example: The country has a large trade deficit this year.
deficit.exampleZh: 今年这个国家存在巨大的贸易逆差。

defile.example: Littering can defile the beautiful park and hurt the animals living there.
defile.exampleZh: 乱扔垃圾会弄脏美丽的公园，并伤害生活在那里的动物。

define.example: The teacher asked us to define the word in our own simple terms.
define.exampleZh: 老师让我们用自己简单的话给这个词下定义。

definite.example: We need a definite answer before we make the final plan.
definite.exampleZh: 在制定最终计划之前，我们需要一个明确的答复。

definitely.example: I will definitely come to your party on Saturday night.
definitely.exampleZh: 我星期六晚上一定会来参加你的聚会。

definition.example: The teacher gave a clear definition of the new word.
definition.exampleZh: 老师给这个新单词下了一个清晰的定义。

definitive.example: The new study gives us a definitive answer to this old question.
definitive.exampleZh: 这项新研究为这个老问题给出了决定性的答案。

deflate.example: The nurse used a small pump to deflate the air mattress before moving the bed.
deflate.exampleZh: 护士在搬床之前用一个小气泵给气垫放气。

deflation.example: The country faced deflation after prices fell for many months.
deflation.exampleZh: 物价连续多月下跌后，这个国家面临通货紧缩。

deflect.example: His quick joke helped deflect attention from the awkward question.
deflect.exampleZh: 他的一句俏皮话帮助转移了人们对那个尴尬问题的注意。

defoliant.example: Farmers used a defoliant to remove the leaves before harvest.
defoliant.exampleZh: 农民在收获前使用落叶剂去除叶子。

deforest.example: People often deforest large areas to build new farms and roads.
deforest.exampleZh: 人们常常砍伐大片森林来修建新的农场和道路。

deforestation.example: Deforestation is a serious problem because it destroys the homes of many animals.
deforestation.exampleZh: 森林砍伐是一个严重的问题，因为它破坏了许多动物的家园。

deform.example: The strong heat can deform the plastic bottle very quickly.
deform.exampleZh: 高温会让塑料瓶很快变形。

deformity.example: The accident left him with a slight deformity in his left hand.
deformity.exampleZh: 这场事故使他的左手留下了轻微的畸形。

defraud.example: He tried to defraud the old woman of her savings.
defraud.exampleZh: 他试图骗取那位老妇人的积蓄。

defray.example: His parents helped him defray the cost of his college education.
defray.exampleZh: 他的父母帮他支付了大学教育的费用。

defrock.example: The church decided to defrock the priest after he broke his vows.
defrock.exampleZh: 在他违背誓言后，教会决定免去这位神父的圣职。

defrost.example: Please defrost the chicken in cold water before you cook it tonight.
defrost.exampleZh: 今晚做饭前，请用冷水把鸡肉解冻。

deft.example: She is deft with her hands and can fix almost anything.
deft.exampleZh: 她的双手很灵巧，几乎什么都能修好。

defunct.example: That old factory is now defunct and no one works there.
defunct.exampleZh: 那家旧工厂现在已经废弃，没有人在那里工作了。

defy.example: He chose to defy his parents and move to another city.
defy.exampleZh: 他选择违抗父母，搬到了另一座城市。

degenerate.example: Too much comfort can make a strong mind degenerate over time.
degenerate.exampleZh: 过多的安逸会使坚强的意志逐渐退化。

degradation.example: Plastic degradation in the ocean can take hundreds of years.
degradation.exampleZh: 塑料在海洋中的降解可能需要数百年时间。

degrade.example: Do not let small failures degrade your confidence in daily life.
degrade.exampleZh: 不要让小的失败降低你在日常生活中的信心。

degree.example: The water temperature is thirty degrees today, so the pool feels warm.
degree.exampleZh: 今天水温是三十度，所以泳池感觉很暖和。

dehumanize.example: Cruel working conditions can dehumanize workers and make them feel like machines.
dehumanize.exampleZh: 残酷的工作条件会使工人失去人性，让他们觉得自己像机器一样。

dehydrate.example: The strong sun will dehydrate your body if you forget to drink water.
dehydrate.exampleZh: 如果你忘记喝水，强烈的阳光会使你的身体脱水。

deice.example: We must deice the plane before it can fly in winter.
deice.exampleZh: 在冬天，飞机起飞前我们必须给它除冰。

deign.example: She did not deign to answer my simple question.
deign.exampleZh: 她不屑于回答我那个简单的问题。

deist.example: The deist believed that reason, not revelation, shows us the truth about God.
deist.exampleZh: 这位自然神论者相信，是理性而非启示向我们揭示了关于上帝的真理。

deity.example: In the old story, a powerful deity created the sky and the sea.
deity.exampleZh: 在古老的故事中，一位强大的神创造了天空和海洋。

deject.example: The bad news did not deject her, and she kept working.
deject.exampleZh: 这个坏消息没有使她沮丧，她继续工作。

dejection.example: After losing the game, he sat alone in quiet dejection.
dejection.exampleZh: 输掉比赛后，他独自坐着，陷入默默的沮丧。

delay.example: Heavy rain delayed our flight for two hours this morning.
delay.exampleZh: 大雨今天上午使我们的航班延误了两个小时。

delegate.example: Our manager will delegate the task to a trusted team member.
delegate.exampleZh: 我们的经理会把这项任务委派给一位值得信赖的团队成员。

delegation.example: The manager sent a small delegation to meet our foreign partners.
delegation.exampleZh: 经理派了一个小型代表团去会见我们的外国合作伙伴。

delete.example: Please delete the old files before you start the new project.
delete.exampleZh: 请你在开始新项目之前删除这些旧文件。

deleterious.example: Too much sugar is deleterious to your health and your teeth.
deleterious.exampleZh: 摄入过多糖分对你的健康和牙齿有害。

deliberate.example: The teacher made a deliberate choice to give us more time.
deliberate.exampleZh: 老师经过深思熟虑，决定给我们更多时间。

delicacy.example: Jellyfish is a local delicacy that visitors are eager to try.
delicacy.exampleZh: 海蜇是当地的美味，游客们都很想尝一尝。

delicate.example: She wore a delicate dress with small flowers on it.
delicate.exampleZh: 她穿了一条上面带有小花的精致连衣裙。

delicious.example: My mother makes delicious soup for us every Sunday afternoon.
delicious.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天下午都会给我们做美味的汤。

delight.example: Her smile filled the room with delight, and it made everyone happy.
delight.exampleZh: 她的微笑让整个房间充满喜悦，也让每个人都感到快乐。

delimit.example: The river delimits the northern edge of the old town.
delimit.exampleZh: 这条河划定了老城区的北部边界。

delineate.example: The report clearly delineates the main problems and their possible solutions.
delineate.exampleZh: 这份报告清晰地描绘了主要问题及其可能的解决办法。

delinquency.example: The school has a program to help teenagers avoid delinquency.
delinquency.exampleZh: 学校有一个帮助青少年避免违法犯罪的项目。

delinquent.example: The court ordered the delinquent to pay the money back to the shop.
delinquent.exampleZh: 法院命令这名少年犯把钱赔给那家商店。

delirious.example: The sick man became delirious and did not know where he was.
delirious.exampleZh: 那个病人变得精神错乱，不知道自己身在何处。

delirium.example: The old man was in delirium after the high fever.
delirium.exampleZh: 高烧之后，那位老人陷入了谵妄状态。

deliver.example: She will deliver the baby at the hospital tonight.
deliver.exampleZh: 她今晚会在医院接生这个婴儿。

deliverance.example: The old story tells of a prisoner's deliverance from his dark cell.
deliverance.exampleZh: 这个古老的故事讲述了囚犯从黑暗牢房中获得解救的经历。

delivery.example: The delivery of the package was late because of the heavy snow.
delivery.exampleZh: 由于大雪，包裹的递送延迟了。

delta.example: The river slows down and forms a large delta near the sea.
delta.exampleZh: 河流在入海处流速减慢，形成了一大片三角洲。

deluge.example: The heavy rain turned into a deluge that flooded the small town.
deluge.exampleZh: 大雨变成了一场洪水，淹没了这个小镇。

delusion.example: His belief that everyone loves him is just a delusion.
delusion.exampleZh: 他认为每个人都喜欢他，这只是一种错觉。

delve.example: She likes to delve into old books to learn about history.
delve.exampleZh: 她喜欢钻研旧书来了解历史。

demagogue.example: The demagogue told the crowd only what they wanted to hear.
demagogue.exampleZh: 那个煽动家只对人群说他们想听的话。

demagoguery.example: The leader's demagoguery turned angry crowds against innocent people.
demagoguery.exampleZh: 这位领导人的煽动让愤怒的民众转而针对无辜的人。

demand.example: Many customers demand better service from the new store.
demand.exampleZh: 许多顾客要求这家新店提供更好的服务。

demanding.example: This job is demanding, but I learn a lot every day.
demanding.exampleZh: 这份工作要求很高，但我每天都能学到很多东西。

demean.example: Don't let anyone demean you because of your mistakes.
demean.exampleZh: 不要因为你的错误就让任何人贬低你。

demeanor.example: His calm demeanor made everyone feel safe during the long meeting.
demeanor.exampleZh: 在漫长的会议上，他沉稳的举止让每个人都感到安心。

demented.example: The old man became demented after the terrible accident last year.
demented.exampleZh: 那位老人在去年的可怕事故之后变得精神错乱了。

demise.example: The sudden demise of the small bank surprised everyone in the town.
demise.exampleZh: 这家小银行的突然倒闭让镇上所有人都感到意外。

demobilize.example: The army will demobilize many soldiers after the long war ends.
demobilize.exampleZh: 漫长的战争结束后，军队将使许多士兵复员。

democracy.example: In a democracy, people have the right to choose their leaders.
democracy.exampleZh: 在民主国家，人民有权选择自己的领导人。

democrat.example: He is a democrat who believes that everyone should have a voice.
democrat.exampleZh: 他是一位民主主义者，认为每个人都应该有发言权。

democratic.example: Our school lets students make choices in a democratic way.
democratic.exampleZh: 我们学校让学生以民主的方式做出选择。

democratization.example: The democratization of information changed how people learn and share news.
democratization.exampleZh: 信息的民主化改变了人们学习和分享新闻的方式。

demographic.example: The company studies demographic changes to plan new products for older customers.
demographic.exampleZh: 公司研究人口结构变化，以便为年长顾客规划新产品。

demography.example: The demography of our town is changing as more young families move in.
demography.exampleZh: 随着更多年轻家庭搬来，我们小镇的人口结构正在变化。

demolish.example: The old workers will demolish the empty building next month.
demolish.exampleZh: 工人们下个月将拆除这座空建筑。

demon.example: The little boy thinks a demon lives under his bed at night.
demon.exampleZh: 这个小男孩认为夜里有个恶魔住在他的床底下。

demonstrable.example: The scientists said the new drug has a demonstrable effect on high blood pressure.
demonstrable.exampleZh: 科学家们表示这种新药对高血压有可证明的疗效。

demonstrate.example: The teacher will demonstrate the simple experiment to the whole class.
demonstrate.exampleZh: 老师将向全班演示这个简单的实验。

demonstration.example: The teacher gave a short demonstration of how the machine works.
demonstration.exampleZh: 老师简短示范了这台机器如何运作。

demonstrative.example: She is very demonstrative and often hugs her friends when they meet.
demonstrative.exampleZh: 她非常感情外露，见到朋友时常常拥抱他们。

demoralize.example: Bad news can demoralize the whole team before a big game.
demoralize.exampleZh: 坏消息可能会在大赛前让整个团队士气低落。

demote.example: The company may demote him if he keeps making serious mistakes.
demote.exampleZh: 如果他继续犯严重错误，公司可能会将他降职。

demotic.example: The writer chose demotic language so that ordinary people could enjoy his stories.
demotic.exampleZh: 这位作家选用了通俗的语言，以便普通人也能欣赏他的故事。

demure.example: She gave a demure smile and said nothing at the meeting.
demure.exampleZh: 她在会上端庄地笑了笑，什么也没说。

deniable.example: The company said the payment was deniable because no written contract existed.
deniable.exampleZh: 公司表示这笔付款是可以否认的，因为不存在书面合同。

denial.example: His denial of the mistake made everyone in the room angry.
denial.exampleZh: 他否认这个错误让房间里的每个人都很生气。

denigrate.example: You should not denigrate other people's work just because you disagree.
denigrate.exampleZh: 你不应该仅仅因为不同意就贬低别人的工作。

denizen.example: The old café is a favorite spot for every denizen of this small town.
denizen.exampleZh: 这家老咖啡馆是这个小镇上每位居民最喜欢的地方。

denomination.example: This old coin has a denomination of ten and belongs to a rare group.
denomination.exampleZh: 这枚旧硬币的面额是十，属于一个稀有的类别。

denotation.example: The denotation of this word is clear, but its feeling is not.
denotation.exampleZh: 这个词的字面意义很清楚，但它的情感色彩并不清楚。

denote.example: In math, the letter x often denotes an unknown number.
denote.exampleZh: 在数学中，字母 x 常表示一个未知数。

denounce.example: The workers denounced the plan because it would cut their pay.
denounce.exampleZh: 工人们谴责这个计划，因为它会削减他们的工资。

dense.example: The forest is so dense that sunlight can hardly reach the ground.
dense.exampleZh: 这片森林非常茂密，阳光几乎照不到地面。

density.example: The density of this material is higher than that of water.
density.exampleZh: 这种材料的密度比水高。

dental.example: I have a dental appointment tomorrow morning at the clinic near my office.
dental.exampleZh: 我明天上午在办公室附近的诊所有一个牙科预约。

dentist.example: I have a dentist appointment tomorrow morning at nine.
dentist.exampleZh: 我明天早上九点约了牙医。

denture.example: My grandfather wears a denture when he eats his meals.
denture.exampleZh: 我爷爷吃饭时会戴上假牙。

denude.example: Heavy rain denuded the hillside of its grass and soil.
denude.exampleZh: 大雨使山坡失去了草皮和土壤。

deny.example: He denies taking the money, but no one believes his story.
deny.exampleZh: 他否认拿了那笔钱，但没人相信他的话。

deodorant.example: I use deodorant every morning before I go to work.
deodorant.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会用除臭剂。

depart.example: The train will depart from the station at eight tomorrow morning.
depart.exampleZh: 火车将于明天早上八点从车站出发。

department.example: She works in the sales department of a large company.
department.exampleZh: 她在一家大公司的销售部工作。

departure.example: His sudden departure from the team surprised all of us.
departure.exampleZh: 他突然离开队伍让我们所有人都很吃惊。

depend.example: Children still depend on their parents for food and shelter.
depend.exampleZh: 孩子们仍然依靠父母提供食物和住所。

dependant.example: Her two young children are dependants and need her care every day.
dependant.exampleZh: 她的两个年幼孩子是受扶养者，每天都需要她的照顾。

dependence.example: Our dependence on oil makes the whole economy weak.
dependence.exampleZh: 我们对石油的依赖使整个经济变得脆弱。

dependency.example: The country's economy has a strong dependency on oil exports.
dependency.exampleZh: 这个国家的经济对石油出口有很强的依赖。

dependent.example: Children are dependent on their parents for food and shelter.
dependent.exampleZh: 孩子们依赖父母提供食物和住所。

depict.example: The artist likes to depict village life in his simple drawings.
depict.exampleZh: 这位画家喜欢在简单的画作中描绘乡村生活。

deplete.example: Years of heavy fishing have depleted the fish in this river.
deplete.exampleZh: 多年的过度捕捞已经使这条河里的鱼大量减少。

depletion.example: The rapid depletion of the forest worries many local farmers.
depletion.exampleZh: 森林的快速枯竭让许多当地农民感到担忧。

deplorable.example: The old hotel was in a deplorable state after years of neglect.
deplorable.exampleZh: 那家老旅馆在多年无人打理后状况糟得可悲。

deplore.example: Many people deplore the waste of food in rich countries.
deplore.exampleZh: 许多人强烈反对富裕国家浪费食物。

deploy.example: The company will deploy more workers to the new factory next month.
deploy.exampleZh: 公司下个月将向新工厂调配更多工人。

deployment.example: The deployment of the new software will start next Monday morning.
deployment.exampleZh: 新软件的部署将于下周一上午开始。

depopulate.example: The long war depopulated many small villages in the north.
depopulate.exampleZh: 长期的战争使北方许多小村庄人口减少。

deport.example: The government decided to deport him because his visa had expired.
deport.exampleZh: 政府决定将他驱逐出境，因为他的签证已经过期。

deportation.example: The man faces deportation after the court found him guilty.
deportation.exampleZh: 法院判定他有罪后，他面临驱逐出境。

depose.example: The people voted to depose the old king and choose a new leader.
depose.exampleZh: 人民投票废黜了老国王，并选出新的领导人。

deposit.example: You can deposit the money at the bank this afternoon.
deposit.exampleZh: 你今天下午可以把钱存进银行。

deposition.example: The slow river left a thick deposition of sand near the old bridge.
deposition.exampleZh: 缓慢的河流在旧桥附近留下了厚厚的沙沉积物。

depository.example: The bank keeps its gold in a secure depository near the city center.
depository.exampleZh: 银行把黄金存放在市中心附近一个安全的金库里。

deprave.example: Bad friends can deprave a young person's mind.
deprave.exampleZh: 坏朋友会腐蚀年轻人的心灵。

depravity.example: The old story shows how greed can lead to deep depravity.
depravity.exampleZh: 这个古老的故事说明贪婪会如何导致深深的堕落。

deprecate.example: Many teachers deprecate the use of phones during class.
deprecate.exampleZh: 许多老师不赞成在课堂上使用手机。

depreciate.example: The value of his old car will depreciate quickly over the next few years.
depreciate.exampleZh: 他那辆旧车的价值在接下来的几年里会迅速贬值。

depredation.example: The war brought depredation and hunger to many small villages.
depredation.exampleZh: 战争给许多小村庄带来了劫掠和饥饿。

depress.example: The bad news may depress him for a few days.
depress.exampleZh: 这个坏消息可能会让他沮丧几天。

depressant.example: The doctor gave him a mild depressant to help him sleep.
depressant.exampleZh: 医生给了他一种温和的镇静剂来帮助他入睡。

depression.example: My uncle suffered from deep depression after he lost his job last year.
depression.exampleZh: 我叔叔去年失业后患上了严重的抑郁症。

depressive.example: The rainy weather and long nights made him feel depressive and tired.
depressive.exampleZh: 阴雨的天气和漫长的夜晚让他感到抑郁和疲惫。

deprivation.example: The long drought caused serious water deprivation for many small villages.
deprivation.exampleZh: 长期干旱让许多小村庄严重缺水。

deprive.example: The new law may deprive many poor families of their homes.
deprive.exampleZh: 这项新法律可能会使许多贫困家庭失去家园。

depth.example: The depth of the lake surprised everyone in the small boat.
depth.exampleZh: 湖的深度让小船上的每个人都感到惊讶。

deputation.example: A deputation from the workers met the manager to discuss the new rules.
deputation.exampleZh: 一个工人代表团会见了经理，讨论新规定。

deputize.example: The manager will deputize his assistant to attend the meeting tomorrow.
deputize.exampleZh: 经理将委派他的助手代表他参加明天的会议。

deputy.example: The deputy took charge of the meeting while the manager was away.
deputy.exampleZh: 经理不在时，副手负责主持了会议。

derange.example: The terrible accident was enough to derange his mind for many years.
derange.exampleZh: 那场可怕的事故足以让他的精神错乱很多年。

derelict.example: The derelict old house on our street was finally pulled down last week.
derelict.exampleZh: 我们街上那栋废弃的旧房子上周终于被拆掉了。

dereliction.example: The manager was fired for dereliction of duty after the accident.
dereliction.exampleZh: 事故发生后，那名经理因玩忽职守被解雇了。

deride.example: Some people deride his idea, but I think it is quite useful.
deride.exampleZh: 有些人嘲笑他的想法，但我觉得它相当有用。

derivative.example: This painting looks derivative because it copies ideas from other artists.
derivative.exampleZh: 这幅画看起来缺乏独创性，因为它抄袭了其他艺术家的想法。

derive.example: We derive most of our water from the river nearby.
derive.exampleZh: 我们的大部分用水取自附近的这条河。

dermatitis.example: Her skin became red and itchy because of dermatitis on her hands.
dermatitis.exampleZh: 由于手上的皮炎，她的皮肤变得又红又痒。

dermatology.example: She wants to study dermatology because she cares about skin health.
dermatology.exampleZh: 她想学习皮肤病学，因为她关心皮肤健康。

descend.example: The plane began to descend slowly toward the runway in the fog.
descend.exampleZh: 飞机开始在雾中缓慢下降，朝跑道飞去。

descendant.example: She is a direct descendant of a famous king.
descendant.exampleZh: 她是一位著名国王的直系后裔。

descent.example: The descent from the mountain was steep and slow.

describe.example: Can you describe the man you saw in the park yesterday?
describe.exampleZh: 你能描述一下你昨天在公园里看到的那个男人吗？

description.example: This book gives a clear description of life in a small town.
description.exampleZh: 这本书清楚地描述了小镇上的生活。

descriptive.example: The book has a descriptive title that tells you exactly what it is about.
descriptive.exampleZh: 这本书有一个描述性的标题，清楚地告诉你它是关于什么的。

desecrate.example: Some people were angry when vandals desecrated the old church last night.
desecrate.exampleZh: 昨晚破坏者亵渎了那座古老的教堂，一些人对此感到愤怒。

desert.example: The soldier did not desert his friends when the long march began.
desert.exampleZh: 长途行军开始时，那名士兵没有抛弃他的朋友。

deserve.example: Everyone deserves a fair chance to show what they can do.
deserve.exampleZh: 每个人都应得到公平的机会来展示自己的能力。

desiccate.example: The hot sun and dry wind can desiccate the small plants very quickly.
desiccate.exampleZh: 炎热的太阳和干燥的风能很快使这些小植物干枯。

desiccation.example: The hot sun caused desiccation of the soil and the plants died.
desiccation.exampleZh: 烈日使土壤干燥，植物都枯死了。

design.example: She will design a new garden for our small house.
design.exampleZh: 她将为我们的那栋小房子设计一个新花园。

designate.example: The company designated him as the new manager of the sales team.
designate.exampleZh: 公司指定他为销售团队的新经理。

designation.example: Her designation as team leader was announced at the meeting.
designation.exampleZh: 她被任命为团队负责人的消息在会议上宣布了。

desirability.example: The desirability of the plan depends on its cost.
desirability.exampleZh: 这个计划是否可取取决于它的成本。

desirable.example: A quiet room is desirable when you need to study for an exam.
desirable.exampleZh: 当你需要为考试学习时，一个安静的房间是可取的。

desire.example: She has a strong desire to learn English well.
desire.exampleZh: 她有一个学好英语的强烈愿望。

desist.example: He asked them to desist from making noise during the meeting.
desist.exampleZh: 他要求他们在会议期间停止吵闹。

desk.example: I put my books and pens on the desk and start to study.
desk.exampleZh: 我把书和笔放在书桌上，然后开始学习。

desktop.example: I put the photo on my desktop so I can see it every day.
desktop.exampleZh: 我把这张照片放在桌面上，这样我每天都能看到它。

desolate.example: The old house stood alone on a desolate hill far from town.
desolate.exampleZh: 那座老房子孤零零地立在远离城镇的荒凉山丘上。

desolation.example: After the fire, a deep desolation covered the empty town and its silent streets.
desolation.exampleZh: 大火过后，一片深重的荒凉笼罩着空荡的小镇和寂静的街道。

despair.example: After losing his job, he fell into deep despair and stopped talking to friends.
despair.exampleZh: 失去工作后，他陷入深深的绝望，不再和朋友说话。

desperate.example: The lost hikers were desperate for water after two days in the desert.
desperate.exampleZh: 迷失的徒步者在沙漠里待了两天后极度渴望水。

desperation.example: In desperation, he ran into the street and shouted for help.
desperation.exampleZh: 绝望之下，他跑到街上大声呼救。

despicable.example: It is despicable to treat a small child like that.
despicable.exampleZh: 那样对待一个小孩子是可鄙的。

despise.example: I despise people who are rude to waiters and taxi drivers.
despise.exampleZh: 我鄙视那些对服务员和出租车司机无礼的人。

despite.example: Despite the heavy rain, we still went to school on time.
despite.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，我们仍然准时去了学校。

despondency.example: After losing the game, he sank into deep despondency and stopped talking to friends.
despondency.exampleZh: 输掉比赛后，他陷入深深的沮丧之中，不再和朋友说话。

despondent.example: She felt despondent after failing the exam for the third time.
despondent.exampleZh: 第三次考试失利后，她感到很沮丧。

dessert.example: We had ice cream for dessert after dinner last night.
dessert.exampleZh: 昨晚晚饭后我们吃了冰淇淋作为甜点。

destination.example: After a long flight, we finally reached our destination.
destination.exampleZh: 经过长途飞行，我们终于到达了目的地。

destined.example: She was destined to become a great singer one day.
destined.exampleZh: 她注定有一天会成为一位伟大的歌手。

destiny.example: She believed it was her destiny to become a doctor.
destiny.exampleZh: 她相信成为医生是她的命运。

destitute.example: The flood left many families destitute and in need of help.
destitute.exampleZh: 洪水使许多家庭一贫如洗，急需援助。

destroy.example: The big fire destroyed many old houses in our small town.
destroy.exampleZh: 那场大火摧毁了我们小镇上的许多老房子。

destructible.example: This old paper is destructible, so please keep it away from water.
destructible.exampleZh: 这种旧纸容易破损，所以请让它远离水。

destruction.example: The war caused great destruction to the city and its people.
destruction.exampleZh: 这场战争给这座城市及其人民带来了巨大的破坏。

destructive.example: War is a destructive force that hurts many innocent people.
destructive.exampleZh: 战争是一种破坏性的力量，会伤害许多无辜的人。

detach.example: Please detach the last page and give it to the teacher.
detach.exampleZh: 请把最后一页分开，交给老师。

detachment.example: She watched the accident with a strange detachment and said nothing.
detachment.exampleZh: 她以一种奇怪的超然态度看着那场事故，什么也没说。

detail.example: She told me every detail of the trip and I wrote them down.
detail.exampleZh: 她把旅行的每个细节都告诉了我，我把它们记了下来。

detain.example: The police can detain a person for questioning for only a few hours.
detain.exampleZh: 警方拘留一个人问话只能持续几个小时。

detect.example: Scientists can detect very small changes in the air.
detect.exampleZh: 科学家能够探测到空气中非常微小的变化。

detection.example: Early detection of the disease can save many lives.
detection.exampleZh: 早期发现这种疾病可以挽救许多生命。

detective.example: The detective asked the old man a few simple questions about the missing car.
detective.exampleZh: 侦探就那辆丢失的汽车问了老人几个简单的问题。

detector.example: The smoke detector on the ceiling beeped loudly last night.
detector.exampleZh: 天花板上的烟雾探测器昨晚响得很厉害。

detention.example: The teacher gave him detention because he was late for class again.
detention.exampleZh: 老师罚他课后留校，因为他上课又迟到了。

deter.example: The bright lights in the yard help deter thieves at night.
deter.exampleZh: 院子里的明亮灯光有助于在夜间威慑窃贼。

detergent.example: Please put some detergent in the washing machine before you wash these clothes.
detergent.exampleZh: 洗这些衣服之前，请往洗衣机里放一些洗涤剂。

deteriorate.example: Without regular repairs, the old bridge will deteriorate quickly over the next few years.
deteriorate.exampleZh: 如果不定期维修，这座老桥在未来几年内会迅速恶化。

determinant.example: Hard work is the main determinant of success in this job.
