determinant.exampleZh: 努力工作是在这份工作中取得成功的主要决定因素。

determination.example: Her determination to learn English helped her pass the exam.
determination.exampleZh: 她学英语的决心帮助她通过了考试。

determine.example: We need to determine the cause of the problem before we fix it.
determine.exampleZh: 我们需要先确定问题的原因，然后再修复它。

deterrence.example: The threat of punishment acts as a deterrence against crime.
deterrence.exampleZh: 惩罚的威胁对犯罪起到威慑作用。

deterrent.example: The high fence is a deterrent against thieves at night.
deterrent.exampleZh: 高高的围栏是夜间防盗的威慑物。

detest.example: I detest people who are cruel to animals and never show kindness.
detest.exampleZh: 我厌恶那些对动物残忍、从不表现善意的人。

detonate.example: The workers used a remote control to detonate the bomb safely.
detonate.exampleZh: 工人们用遥控器安全地引爆了炸弹。

detonation.example: The loud detonation shook the windows of every house on the street.
detonation.exampleZh: 那声巨大的爆炸震动了街上每栋房子的窗户。

detour.example: We had to take a detour because the main road was under repair.
detour.exampleZh: 因为主路正在维修，我们不得不绕道而行。

detract.example: His constant complaints detract from the good work of the team.
detract.exampleZh: 他不断的抱怨贬低了团队的出色工作。

detraction.example: He spoke of her success without any detraction or envy.
detraction.exampleZh: 他谈到她的成功时，没有丝毫贬低或嫉妒。

detriment.example: Too little sleep can be a detriment to your health.
detriment.exampleZh: 睡眠太少会对你的健康造成损害。

detrimental.example: Too much screen time is detrimental to children's health and their sleep.
detrimental.exampleZh: 过多的屏幕时间有损孩子的健康和睡眠。

devastate.example: The storm devastated the small town and left many families without homes.
devastate.exampleZh: 这场风暴摧毁了那个小镇，使许多家庭无家可归。

devastation.example: The war brought terrible devastation to the small town and its people.
devastation.exampleZh: 战争给这个小镇和它的人民带来了可怕的破坏。

develop.example: The small company plans to develop a new app for students.
develop.exampleZh: 这家小公司计划为学生开发一款新应用。

development.example: The rapid development of new technology has changed our daily lives.
development.exampleZh: 新技术的快速发展改变了我们的日常生活。

deviance.example: The teacher saw the deviance in his behavior and asked him to stop.
deviance.exampleZh: 老师注意到他行为中的偏差，并要求他停止。

deviate.example: He never deviates from his plan, even when things get hard.
deviate.exampleZh: 即使事情变得困难，他也从不偏离自己的计划。

deviation.example: The small deviation from the plan caused a short delay.
deviation.exampleZh: 偏离计划的一小点偏差造成了短暂的延误。

device.example: This small device helps me measure the temperature of the water.
device.exampleZh: 这个小装置帮我测量水的温度。

devil.example: The old story says the devil lives under the dark bridge.
devil.exampleZh: 那个古老的故事说，魔鬼住在黑暗的桥下。

devious.example: He took a devious route to avoid the busy streets.
devious.exampleZh: 他走了一条迂回的路线来避开繁忙的街道。

devise.example: Our team will devise a simple plan to help new students.
devise.exampleZh: 我们团队将设计一个简单的计划来帮助新学生。

devoid.example: The room was devoid of furniture and seemed very cold and empty.
devoid.exampleZh: 这个房间没有家具，显得又冷又空。

devolution.example: The region gained more power through devolution from the central government last year.
devolution.exampleZh: 该地区去年通过中央政府的权力下放获得了更多权力。

devote.example: She devotes every weekend to helping the old people in her town.
devote.exampleZh: 她把每个周末都用来帮助镇上的老人。

devotedly.example: She devotedly cared for her old dog for many years.
devotedly.exampleZh: 她多年来忠实地照顾着她的老狗。

devotion.example: Her devotion to her students made her a much loved teacher.
devotion.exampleZh: 她对学生的奉献使她成为一位深受爱戴的老师。

devotional.example: She starts every morning with a short devotional reading before work.
devotional.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前都会读一小段虔诚的读物。

devout.example: My grandmother is a devout woman who prays every morning.
devout.exampleZh: 我的祖母是一位虔诚的妇人，她每天早上都会祈祷。

dew.example: The grass was wet with dew when we walked outside early this morning.
dew.exampleZh: 今天一大早我们出去散步时，草地被露水打湿了。

dexterity.example: She showed great dexterity in solving the tricky puzzle.
dexterity.exampleZh: 她在解决那道难题时表现得非常灵巧。

diabetes.example: My father has diabetes and must avoid sugar every day.
diabetes.exampleZh: 我父亲患有糖尿病，每天都必须避免吃糖。

diabetic.example: My doctor says I should eat less sugar because my father is diabetic.
diabetic.exampleZh: 医生说因为我父亲是糖尿病患者，我应该少吃糖。

diabolical.example: The villain in that film was truly diabolical and scared everyone.
diabolical.exampleZh: 那部电影里的反派真是穷凶极恶，把大家都吓坏了。

diagnose.example: The doctor could not diagnose her illness, so she went to another hospital.
diagnose.exampleZh: 医生无法诊断她的病，所以她去了另一家医院。

diagnosis.example: The doctor made a quick diagnosis after asking about my pain.
diagnosis.exampleZh: 医生在询问我的疼痛情况后迅速做出了诊断。

diagnostic.example: The doctor ran a diagnostic test to find the cause of her pain.
diagnostic.exampleZh: 医生做了一项诊断性检查，以找出她疼痛的原因。

diagonal.example: The diagonal line on the square divides it into two triangles.
diagonal.exampleZh: 正方形上的对角线把它分成两个三角形。

diagram.example: The teacher drew a simple diagram to show how water moves in plants.
diagram.exampleZh: 老师画了一张简单的示意图，说明水在植物中是如何流动的。

dial.example: He turned the dial to call his mother on the old phone.
dial.exampleZh: 他转动拨号盘，用那部旧电话给母亲打电话。

dialect.example: My grandmother speaks a local dialect that I cannot understand well.
dialect.exampleZh: 我奶奶说一种我听不太懂的当地方言。

dialectic.example: The teacher used dialectic to help students question their own ideas.
dialectic.exampleZh: 老师运用辩证法帮助学生质疑自己的想法。

dialogue.example: The two leaders had a short dialogue about the new plan.
dialogue.exampleZh: 两位领导人就新计划进行了一次简短的对话。

diameter.example: The circle has a diameter of about ten centimeters.
diameter.exampleZh: 这个圆的直径大约是十厘米。

diamond.example: She wore a small diamond on her ring at the party.
diamond.exampleZh: 她在派对上戴着一枚镶着小钻石的戒指。

diarrhea.example: The child had diarrhea for two days and could not go to school.
diarrhea.exampleZh: 这个孩子腹泻了两天，没法去上学。

diary.example: I write in my diary every night before I go to bed.
diary.exampleZh: 我每晚睡前都会在日记里写点东西。

dice.example: We played a fun dice game at the party last night.
dice.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在聚会上玩了一个有趣的骰子游戏。

dichotomy.example: There is a clear dichotomy between what he says and what he does.
dichotomy.exampleZh: 他说的和做的之间存在明显的对立。

dictate.example: The manager will dictate the new rules to all the workers today.
dictate.exampleZh: 经理今天将向所有工人口授新规定。

dictator.example: The country suffered for years under a cruel dictator who banned all free speech.
dictator.exampleZh: 这个国家在一位禁止一切言论自由的残酷独裁者统治下受苦多年。

dictatorial.example: The dictatorial manager never listened to any of his workers' ideas.
dictatorial.exampleZh: 那位专横的经理从不听取工人提出的任何想法。

dictatorship.example: The country lived under a harsh dictatorship for many years.
dictatorship.exampleZh: 这个国家在严酷的独裁统治下生活了很多年。

diction.example: Her clear diction made the speech easy to follow.
diction.exampleZh: 她清晰的措辞让演讲很容易听懂。

dictionary.example: I use this dictionary to look up new words after class.
dictionary.exampleZh: 我在课后用这本词典查生词。

didactic.example: His didactic tone made the simple story feel like a lecture.
didactic.exampleZh: 他说教的语气让这个简单的故事听起来像一场训话。

die.example: Her old dog died quietly in his sleep last night.
die.exampleZh: 她的老狗昨晚在睡梦中安静地死去了。

diesel.example: The truck uses diesel and is very loud when it starts.
diesel.exampleZh: 这辆卡车用柴油，启动时声音很大。

diet.example: My doctor says a healthy diet and daily exercise will help me feel better.
diet.exampleZh: 我的医生说健康的饮食和每天锻炼会帮助我感觉更好。

dietary.example: Doctors say a good dietary habit helps children stay healthy and strong.
dietary.exampleZh: 医生说良好的饮食习惯有助于孩子保持健康和强壮。

differ.example: Our views differ, but we can still be good friends.
differ.exampleZh: 我们的看法不同，但我们仍然可以做好朋友。

difference.example: The main difference between the two plans is the price.
difference.exampleZh: 这两个方案之间的主要差异是价格。

different.example: My sister and I have different ideas about how to spend the weekend.
different.exampleZh: 我和妹妹对于如何度过周末有不同想法。

differentiate.example: Teachers help students differentiate between facts and opinions in class.
differentiate.exampleZh: 老师帮助学生在课堂上区分事实和观点。

difficult.example: This math problem is very difficult for most students in my class.
difficult.exampleZh: 这道数学题对我班大多数学生来说非常难。

difficulty.example: I had some difficulty finding the right answer to this question.
difficulty.exampleZh: 我在找到这个问题的正确答案时遇到了一些困难。

diffident.example: The diffident boy spoke softly and avoided looking at anyone in the room.
diffident.exampleZh: 那个羞怯的男孩说话很轻，避免与房间里的任何人对视。

diffuse.example: The teacher helped diffuse the new idea through the whole school.
diffuse.exampleZh: 老师帮助把这个新想法传播到了整个学校。

diffusion.example: The rapid diffusion of new ideas changed the small town.
diffusion.exampleZh: 新思想的迅速传播改变了这个小镇。

dig.example: They dig a hole in the garden to plant a tree.
dig.exampleZh: 他们在花园里挖了一个洞来种树。

digest.example: It takes time to digest this book and understand its main idea.
digest.exampleZh: 消化这本书并理解其主要观点需要时间。

digestive.example: My doctor says walking after dinner is good for the digestive system.
digestive.exampleZh: 我的医生说饭后散步对消化系统有好处。

digit.example: Please write each digit of your phone number clearly on this line.
digit.exampleZh: 请把你的电话号码的每一位数字清楚地写在这一行上。

digital.example: My watch has a digital screen that shows the time and date.
digital.exampleZh: 我的手表有一个数字显示屏，可以显示时间和日期。

dignity.example: She always treats everyone with dignity and respect.
dignity.exampleZh: 她总是以尊重和体面对待每一个人。

digress.example: Let's not digress from the main topic during this meeting.
digress.exampleZh: 我们在这次会议中不要偏离主要话题。

dilapidated.example: They live in a small dilapidated house near the old bridge.
dilapidated.exampleZh: 他们住在老桥附近一栋破旧的小房子里。

dilemma.example: She faced a dilemma about whether to accept the new job offer.
dilemma.exampleZh: 她面临一个两难困境：是否接受这份新工作。

diligent.example: She is a diligent student who always finishes her homework on time.
diligent.exampleZh: 她是个勤奋的学生，总是按时完成作业。

dilute.example: Please dilute the juice with water before you give it to the baby.
dilute.exampleZh: 请先用水把果汁稀释，再喂给宝宝。

dim.example: The room was dim, so I turned on a small lamp.
dim.exampleZh: 房间很昏暗，所以我打开了一盏小灯。

dimension.example: The dimensions of the room are ten feet by twelve feet.
dimension.exampleZh: 这个房间的尺寸是十英尺乘十二英尺。

diminish.example: The noise from the street began to diminish after midnight.
diminish.exampleZh: 午夜过后，街上的噪音开始减弱。

diminutive.example: Her diminutive dog fits easily into a small bag.
diminutive.exampleZh: 她那小巧的狗很容易装进一个小包里。

dine.example: We usually dine at home on Sunday evenings with our family.
dine.exampleZh: 我们星期天晚上通常和家人一起在家进餐。

dinner.example: We usually have dinner together at seven every evening.
dinner.exampleZh: 我们通常每天晚上七点一起吃晚饭。

dint.example: By dint of hard work, she passed the exam.
dint.exampleZh: 凭借努力，她通过了考试。

diode.example: The small diode lets current flow in only one direction.
diode.exampleZh: 这个小二极管只允许电流朝一个方向流动。

dip.example: She dipped her brush in the paint and began to colour the wall.
dip.exampleZh: 她把画笔蘸进颜料里，开始给墙上色。

diploma.example: She put her college diploma on the wall next to her desk.
diploma.exampleZh: 她把大学文凭挂在了书桌旁的墙上。

diplomacy.example: Diplomacy is often better than fighting when countries disagree with each other.
diplomacy.exampleZh: 当国家之间意见不合时，外交往往比争斗更好。

diplomatic.example: She was very diplomatic when she told him about the mistake.
diplomatic.exampleZh: 她告诉他这个错误时说得非常委婉。

dire.example: The flood left the village in dire need of food and clean water.
dire.exampleZh: 洪水过后，这个村庄急需食物和干净的水，情况十分悲惨。

direct.example: She gave me a direct answer to my question.
direct.exampleZh: 她对我的问题给了直接的答复。

direction.example: Please read the directions on the box before you use this new machine.
direction.exampleZh: 使用这台新机器前，请先阅读盒子上的用法说明。

directive.example: The manager gave a clear directive about the new safety rules.
directive.exampleZh: 经理就新的安全规定给出了明确的指示。

directly.example: Please speak directly to the manager about your problem tomorrow morning.
directly.exampleZh: 请明天上午直接跟经理谈你的问题。

director.example: She is the new director of our school music program.
director.exampleZh: 她是我们学校音乐项目的新主任。

directory.example: I looked up his number in the phone directory.
directory.exampleZh: 我在电话簿里查了他的号码。

dirge.example: The slow dirge played at the funeral made everyone feel deeply sad.
dirge.exampleZh: 葬礼上演奏的缓慢挽歌让每个人都感到深深的悲伤。

dirt.example: His shoes were covered with dirt after the long walk.
dirt.exampleZh: 走了很远的路之后，他的鞋上沾满了尘土。

dirty.example: His dirty shoes made the floor messy after the long walk outside.
dirty.exampleZh: 走了很长的路之后，他脏兮兮的鞋子把地板弄得乱糟糟的。

disability.example: His disability does not stop him from living a happy and full life.
disability.exampleZh: 他的残疾并没有阻止他过上幸福而充实的生活。

disable.example: The accident disabled him, but he still lives a full and happy life.
disable.exampleZh: 那场事故使他残疾，但他依然过着充实而幸福的生活。

disabled.example: The hotel has a ramp for disabled guests.
disabled.exampleZh: 这家酒店为残疾客人设置了坡道。

disadvantage.example: One disadvantage of this plan is that it costs too much money.
disadvantage.exampleZh: 这个计划的一个缺点是要花太多钱。

disagree.example: My parents often disagree about which movie we should watch.
disagree.exampleZh: 我父母经常为我们该看哪部电影而意见不一致。

disappear.example: The sun disappeared behind the clouds and the sky turned gray.
disappear.exampleZh: 太阳消失在云层后面，天空变得灰暗。

disappoint.example: I hope the movie will not disappoint you and your friends tonight.
disappoint.exampleZh: 我希望这部电影今晚不会让你和你的朋友们失望。

disappointment.example: Losing the game was a big disappointment for the whole team.
disappointment.exampleZh: 输掉这场比赛让整个队伍都非常失望。

disapprove.example: My parents disapprove of my plan to travel alone.
disapprove.exampleZh: 我父母不赞成我独自旅行的计划。

disarm.example: The two countries agreed to disarm after a long and difficult peace talk.
disarm.exampleZh: 经过漫长而艰难的和平谈判，两国同意解除武装。

disarray.example: After the party, the whole room was in complete disarray.
disarray.exampleZh: 派对结束后，整个房间一片混乱。

disaster.example: The flood was a disaster for the small village and its people.
disaster.exampleZh: 这场洪水对这个小村庄和村民来说是一场灾难。

disastrous.example: The party was a disastrous failure, and everyone went home early.
disastrous.exampleZh: 那次聚会是一次灾难性的失败，大家都早早回家了。

disbelief.example: She looked at the broken window in disbelief and asked what happened.
disbelief.exampleZh: 她难以置信地看着破碎的窗户，问发生了什么事。

disburse.example: The company will disburse the funds to each worker next week.
disburse.exampleZh: 公司将在下周向每位工人支付这笔款项。

discard.example: Please discard the old newspapers before the guests arrive today.
discard.exampleZh: 请在今天的客人到来之前把旧报纸丢掉。

discern.example: It is hard to discern the truth from what he says.
discern.exampleZh: 很难从他的话语中辨别出真相。

discharge.example: The nurse said he can discharge from the hospital tomorrow morning.
discharge.exampleZh: 护士说他明天早上可以出院。

disciple.example: The young disciple learned from his teacher every day.
disciple.exampleZh: 这位年轻的弟子每天都向他的老师学习。

discipline.example: Good discipline helps students learn better in every school subject.
discipline.exampleZh: 良好的纪律有助于学生在每门学科上学得更好。

disclaim.example: She disclaimed any knowledge of the missing money.
disclaim.exampleZh: 她否认对这丢失的钱有任何了解。

disclose.example: The company refused to disclose the real reason for the sudden change.
disclose.exampleZh: 公司拒绝透露这一突然变动的真实原因。

disclosure.example: The company made a full disclosure of its financial problems to the public.
disclosure.exampleZh: 该公司向公众全面披露了其财务问题。

disco.example: We danced all night at the disco near the beach.
disco.exampleZh: 我们在海滩附近的迪斯科舞厅跳了一整夜舞。

discolor.example: Too much sun can discolor the curtains in a few weeks.
discolor.exampleZh: 阳光太强会让窗帘在几周内褪色。

discomfit.example: The unexpected question seemed to discomfit the young speaker.
discomfit.exampleZh: 那个意外的问题似乎让这位年轻的演讲者感到狼狈。

discomfort.example: She felt some discomfort in her back after sitting all day.
discomfort.exampleZh: 坐了一整天后，她感到背部有些不适。

discontent.example: There is growing discontent among workers about the long hours.
discontent.exampleZh: 工人们对于长时间工作越来越不满。

discontinuity.example: The sudden discontinuity in the data made the scientists question their results.
discontinuity.exampleZh: 数据中突然的间断使科学家们对结果产生了疑问。

discord.example: The new rules caused discord among the team members.
discord.exampleZh: 新规定在团队成员之间引起了不和。

discount.example: The store gives a ten percent discount to students on every book.
discount.exampleZh: 这家书店每本书都给学生打九折。

discourse.example: Her discourse on climate change was clear and easy to follow.
discourse.exampleZh: 她关于气候变化的论述清晰易懂。

discover.example: We were surprised to discover a small cat under the old car.
discover.exampleZh: 我们惊讶地发现旧车底下有一只小猫。

discovery.example: The discovery of a new planet excited the whole team.
discovery.exampleZh: 发现一颗新行星让整个团队感到兴奋。

discredit.example: The scandal may discredit the whole team in the eyes of the public.
discredit.exampleZh: 这起丑闻可能会在公众眼中败坏整个团队的名声。

discreet.example: She was discreet about the news and told only a few close friends.
discreet.exampleZh: 她对这个消息很慎重，只告诉了几个亲近的朋友。

discrepancy.example: There is a small discrepancy between the two reports.
discrepancy.exampleZh: 这两份报告之间有一处小的差异。

discrete.example: The data is stored in discrete groups for easy study.
discrete.exampleZh: 这些数据被分成离散的组，便于研究。

discretion.example: The manager has the discretion to change the plan if needed.
discretion.exampleZh: 如果需要，经理有权自行决定修改计划。

discriminate.example: We should not discriminate against people because of their skin color.
discriminate.exampleZh: 我们不应该因为肤色而歧视他人。

discrimination.example: She spoke out against discrimination at work and helped many young people.
discrimination.exampleZh: 她公开反对职场歧视，帮助了许多年轻人。

discursive.example: His discursive speech wandered from topic to topic and confused everyone.
discursive.exampleZh: 他那散漫的讲话从一个话题跳到另一个话题，让所有人都很困惑。

discuss.example: We often discuss our plans together after dinner at home.
discuss.exampleZh: 我们经常在家吃完晚饭后一起讨论我们的计划。

discussion.example: We had a long discussion about the plan after lunch.
discussion.exampleZh: 午饭后我们就这个计划进行了长时间的讨论。

disdain.example: She looked at the old newspaper with disdain and threw it away.
disdain.exampleZh: 她轻蔑地看了一眼那份旧报纸，然后把它扔掉了。

disease.example: This disease can spread quickly from one person to another.
disease.exampleZh: 这种疾病可以很快从一个人传播给另一个人。

disgorge.example: The train disgorged hundreds of passengers onto the crowded platform.
disgorge.exampleZh: 火车把数百名乘客吐到拥挤的站台上。

disgrace.example: He brought disgrace on his family by cheating in the exam.
disgrace.exampleZh: 他考试作弊，给家人丢了脸。

disguise.example: He wore a hat and sunglasses to disguise himself on the busy street.
disguise.exampleZh: 他在繁忙的街上戴了帽子和太阳镜来伪装自己。

disgust.example: The smell of old garbage filled her with disgust.
disgust.exampleZh: 旧垃圾的气味让她感到恶心。

dish.example: She put the hot dish on the table and smiled at us.
dish.exampleZh: 她把热腾腾的菜肴放在桌上，朝我们笑了笑。

dishearten.example: The long delay began to dishearten the young team.
dishearten.exampleZh: 长时间的延误开始让这支年轻的团队感到泄气。

dishonest.example: It is dishonest to take money that does not belong to you.
dishonest.exampleZh: 拿走不属于你的钱是不诚实的。

disillusion.example: The bad news disillusioned him about the job he once loved.
disillusion.exampleZh: 这个坏消息使他对自己曾经热爱的工作不再抱幻想。

disincentive.example: High taxes can be a disincentive for people who want to start a business.
disincentive.exampleZh: 高税收对于想要创业的人来说可能是一种抑制因素。

disinfect.example: We must disinfect the kitchen table after cooking raw meat.
disinfect.exampleZh: 做完生肉后我们必须给厨房餐桌消毒。

disintegrate.example: The old paper slowly disintegrated in the water.
disintegrate.exampleZh: 那张旧纸在水中慢慢碎裂了。

disinterested.example: A good judge must stay disinterested and listen to both sides.
disinterested.exampleZh: 一位好的法官必须保持公正，听取双方的意见。

disjointed.example: The movie was so disjointed that I could not follow the story.
disjointed.exampleZh: 这部电影太不连贯了，我根本跟不上故事情节。

disk.example: I saved the photos on a disk and put it in my bag.
disk.exampleZh: 我把照片保存在一张磁盘上，然后把它放进了我的包里。

dislike.example: I dislike getting up early on cold winter mornings.
dislike.exampleZh: 我不喜欢在寒冷的冬日早晨早起。

dislocate.example: The sudden fall dislocated his shoulder and disrupted his whole day.
dislocate.exampleZh: 那一跤使他的肩膀脱臼了，也打乱了他一整天的安排。

dismiss.example: The manager decided to dismiss two workers because they were always late.
dismiss.exampleZh: 经理决定解雇两名工人，因为他们总是迟到。

disorder.example: The storm left the whole town in disorder and damaged many homes.
disorder.exampleZh: 暴风雨使整个小镇陷入混乱，还损坏了许多房屋。

dispassionate.example: A good judge must stay dispassionate when listening to both sides.
dispassionate.exampleZh: 好的法官在听取双方陈述时必须保持冷静客观。

dispatch.example: The manager will dispatch the packages to customers early tomorrow morning.
dispatch.exampleZh: 经理明天一早会把包裹发送给客户。

dispel.example: The teacher's kind words helped dispel my fear of speaking in class.
dispel.exampleZh: 老师亲切的话语帮助我打消了在课堂上发言的恐惧。

dispensable.example: This old map is dispensable because we have a new phone app.
dispensable.exampleZh: 这张旧地图是可有可无的，因为我们有了新的手机应用。

dispense.example: The nurse will dispense the medicine to each patient this morning.
dispense.exampleZh: 今天上午护士会给每位病人分发药物。

disperse.example: The wind helped disperse the seeds across the wide field.
disperse.exampleZh: 风帮助把种子散播到广阔的田野上。

dispirited.example: After losing the game, the whole team looked tired and dispirited.
dispirited.exampleZh: 输掉比赛后，整个队伍看起来又累又沮丧。

displace.example: New machines often displace workers who have done the same job for years.
displace.exampleZh: 新机器常常取代那些多年做同一份工作的工人。

display.example: The store will display its new phones in the front window.
display.exampleZh: 这家商店会把新手机陈列在临街的橱窗里。

displease.example: His rude words may displease the teacher and upset the whole class.
displease.exampleZh: 他无礼的话可能会让老师不快，并让全班同学心烦。

disposal.example: The safe disposal of old batteries is important for the environment.
disposal.exampleZh: 安全处理旧电池对环境很重要。

dispose.example: We must dispose of the old papers before the new term starts.
dispose.exampleZh: 我们必须在开学前处理掉这些旧文件。

disposition.example: Her cheerful disposition makes her easy to work with.
disposition.exampleZh: 她开朗的性情使她很容易与人共事。

dispossess.example: The new law may dispossess many families of their homes.
dispossess.exampleZh: 新法律可能会剥夺许多家庭的住房。

disproportionate.example: The punishment was disproportionate to the small mistake he made.
disproportionate.exampleZh: 这个惩罚与他犯的小错误不成比例。

disprove.example: The new evidence may disprove the old story about the missing key.
disprove.exampleZh: 新证据可能会推翻关于那把丢失钥匙的旧说法。

dispute.example: The two companies are still trying to settle their long dispute over the land.
dispute.exampleZh: 这两家公司仍在努力解决他们之间关于这块土地的长期争端。

disqualify.example: The referee disqualified the player for breaking the rules twice.
disqualify.exampleZh: 裁判因该球员两次犯规而取消了他的资格。

disquiet.example: The strange silence in the house filled her with disquiet.
disquiet.exampleZh: 屋子里奇怪的寂静让她感到不安。

disregard.example: He chose to disregard the warning and drove on in the rain.
disregard.exampleZh: 他选择无视警告，继续在雨中开车。

disrepair.example: The old house was in disrepair after many years of neglect.
disrepair.exampleZh: 这所老房子因多年无人照管而失修。

disrepute.example: The scandal brought the whole company into disrepute among its customers.
disrepute.exampleZh: 这起丑闻使整个公司在客户中声名扫地。

disrupt.example: The heavy snow may disrupt train service across the north tomorrow.
disrupt.exampleZh: 明天的大雪可能会扰乱北方的火车运行。

disruption.example: The storm caused a big disruption to train services this morning.
disruption.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨今天早上严重扰乱了火车服务。

dissatisfaction.example: The manager felt dissatisfaction with the slow progress of the project.
dissatisfaction.exampleZh: 经理对项目进展缓慢感到不满。

dissatisfy.example: Long wait times at the airport often dissatisfy even the most patient travelers.
dissatisfy.exampleZh: 机场漫长的等待时间常常让即使最有耐心的旅客也感到不满。

disseminate.example: Teachers use the internet to disseminate useful ideas to students around the world.
disseminate.exampleZh: 老师们利用互联网向世界各地的学生传播有用的思想。

dissent.example: Several members expressed dissent during the meeting but finally accepted the plan.
dissent.exampleZh: 几名成员在会议中表达了异议，但最终接受了该计划。

dissertation.example: She spent two years writing her dissertation on modern Chinese literature.
dissertation.exampleZh: 她花了两年时间写关于中国现代文学的学位论文。

dissolve.example: Stir the sugar until it dissolves completely in the hot water.
dissolve.exampleZh: 搅拌糖，直到它完全溶解在热水中。

dissonance.example: There was a clear dissonance between his words and his actions.
dissonance.exampleZh: 他的言语和行为之间存在明显的不一致。

dissuade.example: My friends tried to dissuade me from quitting school, but I did not listen.
dissuade.exampleZh: 我的朋友们试图劝我不要退学，但我没有听。

distance.example: The distance between our two houses is only a short walk.
distance.exampleZh: 我们两家之间的距离只有一小段步行的路程。

distant.example: She moved to a distant city and rarely calls her old friends.
distant.exampleZh: 她搬到了一座遥远的城市，很少给老朋友打电话。

distaste.example: She felt a strong distaste for the smell of old cooking oil.
distaste.exampleZh: 她对旧食用油的气味感到强烈的厌恶。

distill.example: She learned to distill the main idea from every long article.
distill.exampleZh: 她学会了从每一篇长文章中提炼出主要观点。

distinct.example: The two sisters have distinct voices, so I can tell them apart on the phone.
distinct.exampleZh: 这对姐妹的声音截然不同，所以我在电话里能分辨出她们。

distinction.example: There is a clear distinction between the two plans.
distinction.exampleZh: 这两个计划之间有明显的区别。

distinctive.example: Her voice has a distinctive sound that everyone can easily recognize.
distinctive.exampleZh: 她的嗓音有一种独特的音色，每个人都很容易辨认出来。

distinguish.example: It is hard to distinguish the twins because they look exactly alike.
distinguish.exampleZh: 很难区分这对双胞胎，因为他们长得一模一样。

distort.example: The old mirror can distort your face and make it look very strange.
distort.exampleZh: 那面旧镜子会扭曲你的脸，让它看起来很奇怪。

distortion.example: The distortion in the photo made her face look very strange.
distortion.exampleZh: 照片中的扭曲让她的脸看起来很陌生。

distract.example: Loud music can distract me when I try to study at home.
distract.exampleZh: 我在家想学习时，吵闹的音乐会让我分心。

distress.example: The bad news caused him great distress, and he could not sleep.
distress.exampleZh: 这个坏消息让他非常痛苦，他无法入睡。

distribute.example: The teacher will distribute the new books to all students tomorrow morning.
distribute.exampleZh: 老师明天上午会把新书分发给所有学生。

distribution.example: The company controls the distribution of its products across the country.
distribution.exampleZh: 这家公司控制其产品在全国各地的分销。

district.example: Our school is in a quiet district near the river.
district.exampleZh: 我们学校位于河边一个安静的区域。

distrust.example: His constant lies caused her deep distrust of everything he said.
distrust.exampleZh: 他不断的撒谎使她对他说的一切都深感怀疑。

disturb.example: Please do not disturb me while I am studying for my exam.
disturb.exampleZh: 我在准备考试的时候请不要打扰我。

disturbance.example: The loud noise outside caused a serious disturbance during the night.
disturbance.exampleZh: 外面的巨大噪音在夜间引起了严重的骚乱。

disunite.example: The war disunited the small country and turned neighbors against each other.
disunite.exampleZh: 战争使这个小国分裂，让邻里之间彼此对立。

ditch.example: The car went off the road and fell into a ditch near the farm.
ditch.exampleZh: 汽车偏离道路，掉进了农场附近的一条沟里。

divalent.example: A divalent metal ion can bind to two other atoms at once.
divalent.exampleZh: 二价金属离子可以同时与另外两个原子结合。

dive.example: She likes to dive into the clear blue water on hot summer days.
dive.exampleZh: 在炎热的夏日，她喜欢跳进清澈湛蓝的水里。

diverge.example: The two roads diverge here, so we must choose one way.
diverge.exampleZh: 两条路在这里分叉，所以我们必须选择一条路。

diverse.example: This city has many diverse restaurants with food from around the world.
diverse.exampleZh: 这座城市有许多形形色色的餐厅，供应来自世界各地的美食。

diversify.example: The company wants to diversify its business by selling new products.
diversify.exampleZh: 这家公司想通过销售新产品来实现业务多样化。

diversity.example: Our school welcomes students from many countries and celebrates this diversity.
diversity.exampleZh: 我们学校欢迎来自许多国家的学生，并珍视这种多样性。

divert.example: The police diverted traffic to a side street after the accident.
divert.exampleZh: 事故发生后，警察把车辆引导到一条侧路上。

divest.example: The company decided to divest its old factories and focus on new technology.
divest.exampleZh: 公司决定出售其旧工厂，专注于新技术。

divide.example: A small river divides the two villages, but a bridge connects them.
divide.exampleZh: 一条小河流经两个村庄之间，把两地分开，但一座桥又把它们连接起来。

dividend.example: The company pays a dividend to its shareholders every year.
dividend.exampleZh: 公司每年向股东支付股息。

divine.example: The ancient temple was seen as a divine place by the local people.
divine.exampleZh: 这座古老的寺庙被当地人视为神圣之地。

divinity.example: The old temple was built to honor the divinity of the sun.
divinity.exampleZh: 这座古老的庙宇是为了敬奉太阳的神性而建的。

division.example: The company created a new sales division to handle online orders.
division.exampleZh: 公司成立了一个新的销售部门来处理网上订单。

divisive.example: The new school rule was divisive and upset many parents.
divisive.exampleZh: 新的学校规定引起了分裂，让许多家长感到不满。

divorce.example: Her parents decided to divorce after twenty years of unhappy marriage.
divorce.exampleZh: 她的父母在二十年不幸的婚姻之后决定离婚。

divulge.example: He was careful not to divulge the secret to anyone at work.
divulge.exampleZh: 他小心翼翼地不向工作中的任何人泄露这个秘密。

dizzy.example: After the long ride, I felt dizzy and had to sit down.
dizzy.exampleZh: 长时间乘车之后，我感到头晕，不得不坐下来。

do.example: What do you want to do this weekend with your friends?
do.exampleZh: 这个周末你想和朋友们做什么？

docile.example: The docile horse let the little girl feed it and brush its mane.
docile.exampleZh: 那匹温顺的马让小女孩喂它吃东西，还给它梳理鬃毛。

dock.example: The small boat came back to the dock before the storm arrived.
dock.exampleZh: 小船在暴风雨来临前回到了码头。

doctor.example: My doctor told me to drink more water and get some rest.
doctor.exampleZh: 我的医生让我多喝水，好好休息一下。

doctorate.example: She earned her doctorate in physics after five years of hard study.
doctorate.exampleZh: 经过五年的刻苦学习，她获得了物理学博士学位。

doctrine.example: The church teaches this doctrine to all its members.
doctrine.exampleZh: 教会向所有成员教导这一教义。

document.example: Please keep every important document in this safe box.
document.exampleZh: 请把每一份重要文件都保存在这个保险箱里。

documentary.example: We watched a documentary about wild animals in class today.
documentary.exampleZh: 我们今天在课上看了一部关于野生动物的纪录片。

documentation.example: Please keep all documentation in a safe place for future use.
documentation.exampleZh: 请将所有文件资料保存在安全的地方以备将来使用。

dodge.example: He tried to dodge the question by asking me one instead.
dodge.exampleZh: 他试图反问我一个问题来推托那个问题。

doff.example: He doffed his hat and bowed to the old lady.
doff.exampleZh: 他脱下帽子，向那位老太太鞠了一躬。

dogged.example: His dogged effort finally helped the small team win the game.
dogged.exampleZh: 他不懈的努力最终帮助这支小球队赢得了比赛。

dogma.example: The old dogma still shapes how many people think today.
dogma.exampleZh: 这条古老的教条至今仍影响着许多人的想法。

dogmatic.example: His dogmatic views made it hard for the team to discuss new ideas.
dogmatic.exampleZh: 他固执己见的观点使团队难以讨论新想法。

doing.example: I like doing my homework before dinner every day.
doing.exampleZh: 我喜欢每天在晚饭前做作业。

dole.example: The government gives dole to people who have no work.
dole.exampleZh: 政府向没有工作的人发放失业救济金。

doll.example: My little sister got a new doll for her birthday.
doll.exampleZh: 我妹妹生日时得到了一个新洋娃娃。

dolphin.example: We saw a dolphin jump out of the water near our boat.
dolphin.exampleZh: 我们看到一只海豚在船边跃出水面。

domain.example: Medical research is a difficult domain for young students to enter.
domain.exampleZh: 医学研究是一个年轻学生很难进入的领域。

dome.example: The old church has a large white dome on its roof.
dome.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂屋顶上有一个巨大的白色圆顶。

domestic.example: She buys domestic products because they are cheaper and easy to find.
domestic.exampleZh: 她购买国内产品，因为它们更便宜，也容易买到。

domesticate.example: People began to domesticate wild animals thousands of years ago.
domesticate.exampleZh: 几千年前，人们就开始驯养野生动物。

dominant.example: She is the dominant player on our team this year.
dominant.exampleZh: 她是今年我们队里占优势的球员。

dominate.example: Big companies often dominate the market and make it hard for small shops to grow.
dominate.exampleZh: 大公司常常支配市场，让小商店很难发展。

dominion.example: The king ruled his dominion with a firm hand for many years.
dominion.exampleZh: 国王以强硬手段统治他的领地多年。

donate.example: Every year, many people donate clothes and money to help poor children.
donate.exampleZh: 每年都有很多人捐赠衣服和钱来帮助贫困儿童。

donation.example: She made a small donation to the school library last week.
donation.exampleZh: 她上周向学校图书馆捐了一笔小钱。

donor.example: The donor gave blood at the hospital to help a sick child.
donor.exampleZh: 这位献血者在医院献血，帮助一个生病的孩子。

doom.example: Bad luck seemed to doom the small team from the very start.
doom.exampleZh: 坏运气似乎从一开始就注定了这个小团队的失败。

doomsday.example: Some people believe doomsday will come when the world ends.
doomsday.exampleZh: 有些人相信当世界终结时，末日就会到来。

door.example: Please close the door when you leave the room.
door.exampleZh: 你离开房间时请把门关上。

dope.example: The police found dope in his car and arrested him at once.
dope.exampleZh: 警察在他车里发现了毒品，立刻逮捕了他。

dormant.example: The volcano is dormant now but may wake up someday.
dormant.exampleZh: 这座火山现在处于休眠状态，但也许有一天会苏醒。

dormitory.example: The students walk back to their dormitory after class every afternoon.
dormitory.exampleZh: 学生们每天下午下课后走回他们的宿舍。

dorsal.example: The shark has a large dorsal fin on its back.
dorsal.exampleZh: 这条鲨鱼的背上有一个很大的背鳍。

dose.example: The doctor told him to take a small dose every morning.
dose.exampleZh: 医生让他每天早上服用一小剂。

dot.example: There is a small red dot on the map.

dotage.example: In his dotage, the old man often forgot his own name.
dotage.exampleZh: 到了老年昏聩的时候，这位老人常常忘记自己的名字。

double.example: I asked for a double room, but they gave me two single beds.
double.exampleZh: 我要了一间双人房，但他们给了我两张单人床。

doubt.example: I doubt he will come to the meeting today.
doubt.exampleZh: 我怀疑他今天不会来开会。

doubtful.example: It is doubtful that he will come to the meeting today.
doubtful.exampleZh: 他今天是否会来参加会议还不确定。

dough.example: She mixed flour and water to make the dough for bread.
dough.exampleZh: 她把面粉和水混合起来做面包用的生面团。

douse.example: He used a bucket of water to douse the small fire in the yard.
douse.exampleZh: 他用一桶水浇灭了院子里的那场小火。

dowdy.example: She wore a dowdy old coat that made her look much older.
dowdy.exampleZh: 她穿了一件过时的旧外套，让她看起来老了很多。

downfall.example: His greed was the main cause of his downfall.
downfall.exampleZh: 他的贪婪是他垮台的主要原因。

downgrade.example: The company had to downgrade the software after many users reported serious problems.
downgrade.exampleZh: 在众多用户报告严重问题后，公司不得不降低这款软件的级别。

downplay.example: She tried to downplay the problem, but everyone knew it was serious.
downplay.exampleZh: 她试图淡化这个问题，但大家都知道它很严重。

downright.example: That movie was downright boring, so we left the theater early.
downright.exampleZh: 那部电影无聊透顶，所以我们提前离开了电影院。

downstairs.example: I left my bag downstairs this morning and ran to the bus stop.
downstairs.exampleZh: 今天早上我把包落在楼下，然后跑去公交站了。

downstream.example: The small boat moved slowly downstream after the heavy rain.
downstream.exampleZh: 大雨过后，小船缓缓地顺流而下。

downtime.example: The factory lost a lot of money during the unexpected downtime last week.
downtime.exampleZh: 上周意外停机期间，工厂损失了很多钱。

downtown.example: We took the bus downtown to buy some new shoes.
downtown.exampleZh: 我们坐公交车去市中心买了几双新鞋。

downturn.example: The small shop lost many customers during the economic downturn last year.
downturn.exampleZh: 去年经济低迷时期，这家小店失去了许多顾客。

downward.example: The ball rolled downward along the hill and stopped near the tree.
downward.exampleZh: 球沿着山坡向下滚动，停在树附近。

dowry.example: In the old story, the bride's family gave silver and cloth as a dowry.
dowry.exampleZh: 在那个古老的故事里，新娘的家人给了银子和布匹作为嫁妆。

doze.example: I often doze off on the sofa after lunch on weekends.
doze.exampleZh: 周末午饭后我常常在沙发上打瞌睡。

dozen.example: We bought a dozen eggs and some bread at the store.
dozen.exampleZh: 我们在商店买了一打鸡蛋和一些面包。

drab.example: The walls of the old office were drab and needed new paint.
drab.exampleZh: 那间旧办公室的墙壁单调乏味，需要重新粉刷。

draft.example: She wrote a first draft of the report and gave it to her teacher.
draft.exampleZh: 她写了一份报告的初稿，然后交给了她的老师。

drag.example: He had to drag the heavy box across the floor to the door.
drag.exampleZh: 他不得不把那个沉重的箱子拖过地板，拖到门口。

dragon.example: The dragon in the story is very large and breathes fire.
dragon.exampleZh: 故事里的龙非常大，还会喷火。

drain.example: The old pipe can drain the water from the sink quickly.
drain.exampleZh: 那根旧管子能很快把水槽里的水排掉。

drama.example: The drama at school was fun and all my friends came to watch.
drama.exampleZh: 学校的戏剧很有意思，我所有的朋友都来看了。

dramatic.example: The movie has a dramatic ending that surprised everyone in the room.
dramatic.exampleZh: 这部电影有一个戏剧性的结局，房间里的每个人都感到意外。

drastic.example: The company made drastic changes to its plan after the bad year.
drastic.exampleZh: 在糟糕的一年后，公司对计划做出了激烈的改变。

draw.example: She likes to draw pictures of her cat and dog.

drawback.example: The only drawback of this plan is that it costs too much.
drawback.exampleZh: 这个计划的唯一缺点是花费太高。

drawl.example: He drawled his answer slowly, as if he had all day.
drawl.exampleZh: 他慢吞吞地拖长调子回答，好像有一整天的时间。

dread.example: Many students dread speaking in front of the whole class.
dread.exampleZh: 许多学生害怕在全班同学面前发言。

dream.example: I had a strange dream last night, and I still dream of flying.
dream.exampleZh: 昨晚我做了一个奇怪的梦，现在我仍然梦想着飞翔。

dreary.example: The rainy Monday morning felt dreary and long for everyone in the office.
dreary.exampleZh: 那个下雨的周一早晨，办公室里的每个人都觉得沉闷而漫长。

drench.example: The heavy rain drenched us on our way home from school.
drench.exampleZh: 大雨把我们在放学回家的路上淋得浑身湿透。

dress.example: She wore a beautiful dress to the party last night.
dress.exampleZh: 昨晚她穿了一条漂亮的连衣裙去参加聚会。

dried.example: I added dried tomatoes and cheese to the pasta.
dried.exampleZh: 我在意面里加了番茄干和奶酪。

drift.example: The small boat began to drift slowly down the quiet river.
drift.exampleZh: 小船开始顺着平静的河水慢慢漂流。

drill.example: The teacher will drill the students on new words every morning.
drill.exampleZh: 老师每天早上都会训练学生记新单词。

drink.example: I drink a glass of water every morning before breakfast.
drink.exampleZh: 我每天早上早饭前喝一杯水。

drip.example: Water began to drip from the old roof after the heavy rain last night.
drip.exampleZh: 昨晚大雨过后，水开始从旧屋顶往下滴。

drive.example: He drives his children to school every morning.
drive.exampleZh: 他每天早上开车送孩子们去学校。

driver.example: The driver stopped the car and asked me for directions.

drizzle.example: A light drizzle fell all morning, so we stayed inside and read books.
drizzle.exampleZh: 整个上午都下着毛毛雨，所以我们待在屋里看书。

droll.example: The old man told a droll story that made everyone at the table laugh.
droll.exampleZh: 老人讲了一个古怪有趣的故事，让桌边的人都笑了。

droop.example: The flowers in the garden droop because nobody waters them.
droop.exampleZh: 花园里的花因为没人浇水而低垂。

drop.example: Be careful not to drop the glass cup on the floor.
drop.exampleZh: 小心别把玻璃杯掉到地板上。

drought.example: The long drought made it hard for farmers to grow food.
drought.exampleZh: 长期的干旱使农民难以种植粮食。

drove.example: A drove of sheep moved slowly across the wide green field.
drove.exampleZh: 一群羊慢慢地走过广阔的绿色田野。

drown.example: He nearly drowned in the river while trying to save his dog.
drown.exampleZh: 他在试图救自己的狗时差点在河里淹死。

drowsy.example: The warm room and long lesson made the students feel drowsy.
drowsy.exampleZh: 温暖的房间和漫长的课程让学生们昏昏欲睡。

drub.example: Our team drubbed them twice last year and they never came back.
drub.exampleZh: 我们队去年两次痛打他们，他们再也没回来过。

drudge.example: He worked as a drudge in the kitchen for many years.
drudge.exampleZh: 他在厨房里做了很多年的苦工。

drug.example: The doctor gave him a drug to help with the pain.
drug.exampleZh: 医生给了他一种药来缓解疼痛。

drum.example: She played the drum in the school band every Friday.
drum.exampleZh: 她每周五在学校乐队里打鼓。

dry.example: The hot sun made the wet clothes dry very quickly.
dry.exampleZh: 炎热的太阳使湿衣服很快就干了。

dual.example: This phone has a dual camera on the back.
dual.exampleZh: 这款手机的背面有双重摄像头。

dub.example: His friends dubbed him the king of the small kitchen.
dub.exampleZh: 他的朋友们称他为小厨房之王。

dubious.example: I am dubious about his story because it seems too strange.
dubious.exampleZh: 我对他的说法表示怀疑，因为那听起来太奇怪了。

duck.example: The little duck swam across the pond and then hid under the tree.
duck.exampleZh: 小鸭子游过池塘，然后躲到了树下。

duct.example: The hot air travels through a long duct to reach every room.
duct.exampleZh: 热空气通过一条长长的管道输送到每个房间。

dud.example: The new movie was a dud, and nobody wanted to watch it again.
dud.exampleZh: 这部新电影是个失败之作，没人想再看一遍。

due.example: The rent is due today, so please pay it before noon.
due.exampleZh: 房租今天到期，请在中午前付清。

duel.example: The two men fought a duel at dawn to settle their dispute.
duel.exampleZh: 两个男人在黎明时分进行决斗以解决他们的争端。

duet.example: The two sisters sang a beautiful duet at the school concert last night.
duet.exampleZh: 两个姐妹昨晚在学校音乐会上唱了一首美妙的二重唱。

duke.example: The duke lives in a big old castle near the river.
duke.exampleZh: 公爵住在河边一座古老的大城堡里。

dull.example: The long meeting was dull, so many people fell asleep.
dull.exampleZh: 那场漫长的会议很乏味，所以很多人都睡着了。

dumb.example: He felt dumb after asking such a simple question in class.
dumb.exampleZh: 他在课堂上问了这么简单的问题后觉得自己很蠢。

dummy.example: The store put a dummy in the window to show the new dress.
dummy.exampleZh: 商店在橱窗里放了一个假人来展示那条新裙子。

dump.example: They dump the old chairs near the river every spring.
dump.exampleZh: 他们每年春天都把旧椅子倾倒到河边。

dun.example: My landlord keeps calling to dun me for the rent.
dun.exampleZh: 房东一直打电话向我催讨房租。

dungeon.example: The old castle has a dark dungeon under the ground.
dungeon.exampleZh: 那座古老的城堡地下有一个黑暗的地牢。

duplicate.example: Please do not duplicate this file because we only need one copy.
duplicate.exampleZh: 请不要复制这个文件，因为我们只需要一份。

duplicity.example: His duplicity made her trust him less every day.
duplicity.exampleZh: 他的口是心非让她对他的信任一天比一天少。

durable.example: This bag is durable and will last for many years.
durable.exampleZh: 这个包很耐用，能用很多年。

duration.example: The duration of the meeting was about two hours.
duration.exampleZh: 会议的持续时间大约是两小时。

duress.example: He signed the contract under duress and later asked the court to cancel it.
duress.exampleZh: 他在胁迫下签了这份合同，后来请求法院将其撤销。

during.example: I read two books during the summer holiday last year.
during.exampleZh: 去年暑假期间我读了两本书。

dusk.example: The sky turns orange and pink at dusk.
dusk.exampleZh: 黄昏时天空变成橙色和粉色。

dust.example: The old books on the shelf were covered with thick dust.
dust.exampleZh: 书架上的旧书覆盖着厚厚的灰尘。

dutch.example: My friend brought some Dutch cheese back from his trip to Amsterdam.
dutch.exampleZh: 我的朋友从阿姆斯特丹旅行回来时带了一些荷兰奶酪。

duty.example: It is our duty to help each other at school.
duty.exampleZh: 在学校里互相帮助是我们的责任。

dwarf.example: The kind dwarf lives in a small house deep in the forest.
dwarf.exampleZh: 那个善良的矮人住在森林深处的一间小房子里。

dwell.example: She likes to dwell on the happy memories of her childhood.
dwell.exampleZh: 她喜欢细细回味童年时的快乐记忆。

dwelling.example: Their small dwelling near the river was quiet and very clean.
dwelling.exampleZh: 他们在河边的小住所安静又非常干净。

dwindle.example: Their water supply began to dwindle after weeks without rain.
dwindle.exampleZh: 几周没有下雨后，他们的供水开始减少。

dye.example: She used a red dye to color the old shirt.
dye.exampleZh: 她用一种红色染料给这件旧衬衫染色。

dying.example: The old man is dying, so his family stays by his bed.
dying.exampleZh: 那位老人快要离世了，所以家人守在他床边。

dynamic.example: The city has a dynamic music scene that attracts young people from everywhere.
dynamic.exampleZh: 这座城市有着充满活力的音乐氛围，吸引着来自各地的年轻人。

dynamics.example: The dynamics of the group changed when a new leader joined.
dynamics.exampleZh: 当一位新领导加入后，这个群体的动态发生了变化。

dynamism.example: Her energy and dynamism made the small team successful.
dynamism.exampleZh: 她的活力和干劲让这个小团队取得了成功。

dynasty.example: The Tang dynasty is famous for its poetry and art.
dynasty.exampleZh: 唐朝以诗歌和艺术闻名。

dysfunction.example: The doctor said the patient's heart dysfunction needs careful treatment.
dysfunction.exampleZh: 医生说病人的心脏功能障碍需要仔细治疗。

dyslexia.example: His dyslexia made reading aloud in class very hard for him.
dyslexia.exampleZh: 他的阅读障碍使他在课堂上大声朗读变得非常困难。

dyspepsia.example: The doctor said my stomach pain was caused by dyspepsia.
dyspepsia.exampleZh: 医生说我的胃痛是由消化不良引起的。

dyspeptic.example: My dyspeptic uncle often complains about the food at family dinners.
dyspeptic.exampleZh: 我那位脾气坏又消化不良的叔叔常常抱怨家庭聚餐的饭菜。

dystopia.example: The novel describes a dark dystopia where people cannot choose their own jobs.
dystopia.exampleZh: 这部小说描述了一个人们无法选择自己工作的黑暗反乌托邦。

eager.example: The children are eager to open their gifts on Christmas morning.
eager.exampleZh: 孩子们渴望在圣诞节早晨打开他们的礼物。

eagle.example: The eagle flew high above the mountain and looked for food.
eagle.exampleZh: 那只鹰在山上方高高飞翔，寻找食物。

ear.example: My little sister has a small flower behind her left ear.
ear.exampleZh: 我妹妹的左耳后面别着一朵小花。

early.example: I usually wake up early to catch the first bus.
early.exampleZh: 我通常早起来赶第一班公交车。

earn.example: She works hard to earn enough money for her family.
earn.exampleZh: 她努力工作，为家人挣足够的钱。

earnest.example: She made an earnest effort to learn English well this year.
earnest.exampleZh: 她今年认真学习英语，付出了诚挚的努力。

earnings.example: Her monthly earnings grew after she started a new job.
earnings.exampleZh: 她开始新工作后，每月的收入增加了。

earth.example: The earth is round and moves around the sun.
earth.exampleZh: 地球是圆的，它绕着太阳转。

earthquake.example: The earthquake last night broke many windows in our old school building.
earthquake.exampleZh: 昨晚的地震震坏了我们那栋旧校舍的许多窗户。

earthshaking.example: The small team made an earthshaking discovery that changed science forever.
earthshaking.exampleZh: 这个小团队做出了一项改变科学进程的惊天动地的大发现。

ease.example: Reading this book can help ease your stress after a long day.
ease.exampleZh: 读这本书能帮你缓解漫长一天之后的压力。

east.example: The sun rises in the east every morning.
east.exampleZh: 太阳每天早上从东方升起。

eastbound.example: The eastbound train leaves the station at eight every morning.
eastbound.exampleZh: 向东开的列车每天早上八点从车站出发。

easterly.example: A cool easterly wind blew across the field all morning.
easterly.exampleZh: 整个上午，一阵凉爽的东风从东边吹过田野。

eastern.example: The eastern part of the country is warmer and gets more rain.
eastern.exampleZh: 这个国家的东部地区更温暖，雨水也更多。

eastward.example: The birds flew eastward over the lake at sunrise.
eastward.exampleZh: 日出时鸟群向东飞过湖面。

easy.example: This easy test only takes ten minutes for most students.
easy.exampleZh: 这道容易的测验对大多数学生来说只需十分钟。

easygoing.example: My easygoing neighbor often sits in the sun and talks with everyone.
easygoing.exampleZh: 我那位随和的邻居常常坐在阳光下和每个人聊天。

eat.example: We usually eat dinner together at home every evening.
eat.exampleZh: 我们通常每天晚上在家一起吃晚饭。

eavesdrop.example: She liked to eavesdrop on her neighbors talking in the garden.
eavesdrop.exampleZh: 她喜欢偷听邻居们在花园里说话。

ebb.example: As the tide began to ebb, the fishing boats slowly returned to the shore.
ebb.exampleZh: 潮水开始退去，渔船慢慢回到了岸边。

ebullient.example: Her ebullient mood spread to everyone at the office party.
ebullient.exampleZh: 她热情洋溢的情绪感染了办公室聚会上的每一个人。

eccentric.example: The old man is eccentric but very kind to his neighbors.
eccentric.exampleZh: 这位老人很古怪，但对邻居非常友善。

eccentricity.example: His friends loved his eccentricity and never found it strange.
eccentricity.exampleZh: 他的朋友们喜欢他的古怪，从不觉得这有什么奇怪。

echo.example: The echo of our voices came back from the empty hall.
echo.exampleZh: 我们的声音从空荡荡的大厅里传回来，形成了回声。

eclectic.example: Her taste in music is eclectic, mixing jazz, folk songs, and old rock.
eclectic.exampleZh: 她的音乐品味兼收并蓄，融合了爵士乐、民歌和老摇滚。

eclecticism.example: Her design shows eclecticism, mixing old and new styles in one room.
eclecticism.exampleZh: 她的设计体现出折衷主义，在一个房间里融合了新旧风格。

eclipse.example: The moon will eclipse the sun tomorrow, and everyone wants to watch.
eclipse.exampleZh: 月亮明天会遮住太阳形成日食，大家都想看。

ecology.example: Students study ecology to learn how plants and animals depend on each other.
ecology.exampleZh: 学生们学习生态学，以了解植物和动物如何彼此依赖。

econometric.example: The econometric study shows that higher prices reduce demand for the product.
econometric.exampleZh: 这项计量经济学研究表明，价格上涨会降低对该产品的需求。

economic.example: The country is going through a difficult economic period this year.
economic.exampleZh: 这个国家今年正经历一段艰难的经济时期。

economical.example: This small car is very economical on gas for daily city driving.
economical.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车在日常城市驾驶中非常省油。

economics.example: She studies economics at university because she wants to understand how markets work.
economics.exampleZh: 她在大学学习经济学，因为她想了解市场如何运作。

economist.example: The economist explained why prices rise so quickly in small towns.
economist.exampleZh: 这位经济学家解释了为什么小城镇的物价上涨得如此之快。

economy.example: The country's economy is growing slowly but steadily this year.
economy.exampleZh: 这个国家的经济今年增长缓慢但稳定。

ecosystem.example: A forest is a rich ecosystem with many plants and animals.
ecosystem.exampleZh: 森林是一个拥有许多动植物的丰富生态系统。

ecstasy.example: She was in ecstasy when she heard the good news about her son.
ecstasy.exampleZh: 听到关于儿子的好消息时，她欣喜若狂。

edacious.example: The edacious dog ate all the food in the bowl.
edacious.exampleZh: 那只贪吃的狗吃光了碗里所有的食物。

eddy.example: The small boat was caught in a strong eddy near the rocks.
eddy.exampleZh: 小船在岩石附近被一个强漩涡卷住了。

edge.example: She stood at the edge of the pool and slowly moved forward.
edge.exampleZh: 她站在泳池边缘，慢慢向前移动。

edible.example: This mushroom looks nice, but only some kinds are edible.
edible.exampleZh: 这种蘑菇看起来不错，但只有部分种类可以食用。

edict.example: The king issued an edict that all citizens must pay new taxes.
edict.exampleZh: 国王颁布了一道法令，要求所有公民必须缴纳新税。

edifice.example: The old edifice stands at the center of the town.
edifice.exampleZh: 这座古老的大厦矗立在城镇的中心。

edify.example: Good books can edify young readers and help them think more clearly.
edify.exampleZh: 好书能启迪年轻读者，帮助他们更清晰地思考。

edit.example: She will edit the video before we share it with the class.
edit.exampleZh: 在我们把视频分享给全班之前，她会先剪辑它。

edition.example: This book is the second edition, and it has many new pictures.
edition.exampleZh: 这本书是第二版，里面有很多新图片。

editor.example: The editor read my story and made a few small changes.
editor.exampleZh: 编辑读了我的故事，并做了几处小修改。

editorial.example: The newspaper published an editorial about the new school rules.
editorial.exampleZh: 报纸发表了一篇关于新校规的社论。

educate.example: Parents should educate their children to be kind and honest.
educate.exampleZh: 父母应该教育孩子善良诚实。

education.example: She believes that education can change a person's life.
education.exampleZh: 她相信教育能够改变一个人的一生。

educational.example: This educational video teaches children about animals in a fun way.
educational.exampleZh: 这部有教育意义的视频以有趣的方式教孩子们认识动物。

effect.example: The new law will have a big effect on small businesses.
effect.exampleZh: 新法律将对小企业产生很大影响。

effective.example: This simple plan is very effective and it saves us time.
effective.exampleZh: 这个简单的计划非常有效，它为我们节省了时间。

effectively.example: She explained the plan clearly and effectively, so everyone understood it quickly.
effectively.exampleZh: 她清楚而有效地解释了计划，所以每个人都很快理解了。

effectual.example: The new medicine was effectual and helped him feel much better soon.
effectual.exampleZh: 这种新药很奏效，很快帮助他感觉好多了。

effeminate.example: Some people unfairly say he is effeminate because he speaks softly.
effeminate.exampleZh: 有些人因为他说起话来轻声细语就不公平地说他女人气。

effervescent.example: The effervescent soda bubbled over the glass and made the children laugh.
effervescent.exampleZh: 冒泡的汽水从杯子里溢出来，逗得孩子们笑了起来。

effete.example: The effete old king could no longer lead his people.
effete.exampleZh: 那位衰弱的老国王再也无法领导他的人民了。

efficacy.example: The doctor questioned the efficacy of the new drug for young children.
efficacy.exampleZh: 医生对这种新药对幼儿的功效提出了质疑。

efficiency.example: The new machine greatly improved our work efficiency in the factory.
efficiency.exampleZh: 这台新机器大大提高了我们工厂的工作效率。

efficient.example: This new machine is very efficient and saves us a lot of time.
efficient.exampleZh: 这台新机器非常高效，为我们节省了大量时间。

effigy.example: The angry crowd burned an effigy of the unpopular leader in the square.
effigy.exampleZh: 愤怒的人群在广场上焚烧了那位不受欢迎的领袖的模拟像。

efflorescence.example: The garden showed a bright efflorescence of color every spring.
efflorescence.exampleZh: 这个花园每年春天都会绽放出绚丽的花朵。

effort.example: She put a lot of effort into her English homework last night.
effort.exampleZh: 她昨晚在英语作业上花了很多功夫。

effrontery.example: He had the effrontery to ask for more money after doing so little.
effrontery.exampleZh: 他干了那么少的活，竟然还有脸要更多的钱。

egalitarian.example: She believes an egalitarian society gives everyone the same chance.
egalitarian.exampleZh: 她相信平等主义的社会给每个人同样的机会。

egg.example: She had a boiled egg and a glass of milk for breakfast.
egg.exampleZh: 她早餐吃了一个煮鸡蛋和一杯牛奶。

ego.example: His huge ego makes it hard for him to listen to others.
ego.exampleZh: 他极度自负，很难听进别人的话。

egocentric.example: He is too egocentric to notice how his words hurt others.
egocentric.exampleZh: 他太自我中心了，以至于没注意到自己的话伤害了别人。

egoism.example: His egoism made it hard for him to work well with other people.
egoism.exampleZh: 他的利己主义使他很难与其他人良好合作。

egoistic.example: He is too egoistic to care about anyone else's feelings.
egoistic.exampleZh: 他太自私自利了，根本不在乎别人的感受。

egotism.example: His egotism made it hard for him to keep any real friends.
egotism.exampleZh: 他的自大让他很难留住任何真正的朋友。

eight.example: My little sister is eight years old and loves to draw pictures.
eight.exampleZh: 我妹妹八岁了，她喜欢画画。

eighteen.example: My sister is eighteen years old and studies at a high school.
eighteen.exampleZh: 我姐姐十八岁，在一所高中读书。

eighth.example: She finished eighth in the race and won a small prize.
eighth.exampleZh: 她在比赛中获得第八名，赢得了一个小奖品。

eighty.example: My grandmother is eighty years old and still walks to the park every morning.
eighty.exampleZh: 我的祖母八十岁了，每天早上仍步行去公园。

either.example: You can take either road, but both lead to the same station.
either.exampleZh: 你可以走两条路中的任意一条，但两条都通向同一个车站。

eject.example: The machine will eject the empty tray when the button is pressed.
eject.exampleZh: 按下按钮后，机器会弹出空托盘。

elaborate.example: She gave an elaborate explanation of the plan to her team.
elaborate.exampleZh: 她向团队详细说明了这个计划。

elapse.example: Several hours elapsed before the doctor finally came to see him.
elapse.exampleZh: 几个小时过去了，医生才终于来看他。

elastic.example: This elastic band can stretch a lot without breaking.
elastic.exampleZh: 这条橡皮圈可以拉伸很多而不会断。

elated.example: She felt elated after hearing the good news from her boss.
elated.exampleZh: 听到老板带来的好消息后，她感到兴高采烈。

elbow.example: He hurt his elbow when he fell off the bike yesterday.
elbow.exampleZh: 他昨天从自行车上摔下来时伤到了肘部。

elder.example: My elder sister always helps me with my homework after school.
elder.exampleZh: 我姐姐放学后总是帮我做作业。

elderly.example: The elderly man walks slowly in the park every morning.
elderly.exampleZh: 那位年长的男子每天早上在公园里慢慢散步。

elect.example: The students will elect a new class leader tomorrow morning.
elect.exampleZh: 学生们明天上午将选举一位新的班长。

election.example: The country will hold a general election next month to choose a new leader.
election.exampleZh: 这个国家下个月将举行大选，选出新的领导人。

electorate.example: The electorate will vote for a new mayor next week.
electorate.exampleZh: 选民们下周将投票选出新市长。

electric.example: My father bought an electric car last month and he loves it.
electric.exampleZh: 我父亲上个月买了一辆电动汽车，他非常喜欢它。

electrical.example: The electrical wiring in this old house needs to be replaced soon.
electrical.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的电线需要尽快更换。

electrician.example: The electrician fixed the broken lights in our kitchen yesterday.
electrician.exampleZh: 电工昨天修好了我们厨房里坏掉的灯。

electricity.example: We use electricity to light our home and run machines.
electricity.exampleZh: 我们用电力照明房屋并驱动机器。

electrocute.example: Do not touch that broken wire, or you could be electrocuted.
electrocute.exampleZh: 不要碰那根破损的电线，否则你可能会触电。

electron.example: An electron is a tiny particle that moves around the center of an atom.
electron.exampleZh: 电子是围绕原子中心运动的一种微小粒子。

electronic.example: My electronic watch keeps very good time and shows the date.
electronic.exampleZh: 我的电子手表走时很准，还能显示日期。

elegant.example: She wore an elegant black dress to the party last night.
elegant.exampleZh: 昨晚她穿了一条优雅的黑色连衣裙去参加聚会。

elegy.example: The poet wrote a sad elegy for his old friend.
elegy.exampleZh: 诗人为他的老朋友写了一首悲伤的挽歌。

element.example: Trust is a key element of any good friendship.
element.exampleZh: 信任是任何良好友谊的关键要素。

elementary.example: Elementary math teaches children basic skills like adding and subtracting.
elementary.exampleZh: 小学数学教孩子们加减法这类基本技能。

elephant.example: The elephant is very big and drinks a lot of water every day.
elephant.exampleZh: 大象很大，每天要喝很多水。

elephantine.example: The old elephantine sofa was too big and heavy to move.
elephantine.exampleZh: 那张又大又笨重的旧沙发太大太重，搬不动。

elevate.example: Good teachers elevate their students' thinking through simple questions.
elevate.exampleZh: 好老师通过简单的问题提升学生的思维。

elevator.example: The elevator is slow, so we often take the stairs.
elevator.exampleZh: 电梯很慢，所以我们经常走楼梯。

elfin.example: Her elfin smile and tiny hands made everyone at the party smile too.
elfin.exampleZh: 她那小精灵般的笑容和小巧的双手让派对上的每个人都露出了笑容。

elicit.example: The teacher asked a few questions to elicit answers from the quiet students.
elicit.exampleZh: 老师问了几个问题，引导那些安静的学生回答问题。

eligible.example: She is eligible to vote in the next election.
eligible.exampleZh: 她有资格在下次选举中投票。

eliminate.example: We must eliminate all the old files from this computer today.
eliminate.exampleZh: 我们今天必须从这台电脑上删除所有旧文件。

elite.example: Only the elite of the team joined the final meeting.
elite.exampleZh: 只有团队的精英参加了最后的会议。

elixir.example: The old story says this water is an elixir that can cure every illness.
elixir.exampleZh: 古老的故事说这种水是一种能治愈所有疾病的万能药。

ellipse.example: The teacher drew a perfect ellipse on the board with a long string.
ellipse.exampleZh: 老师用一根长绳子在黑板上画了一个完美的椭圆。

ellipsis.example: In the sentence she left out two words, marked by an ellipsis.
ellipsis.exampleZh: 在这个句子中，她省略了两个词，并用省略号标出。

elongate.example: You can elongate the dough by rolling it gently with your hands.
elongate.exampleZh: 你可以用手轻轻揉搓，把面团拉长。

elopement.example: The young couple's elopement surprised their parents and shocked the whole village.
elopement.exampleZh: 这对年轻情侣的私奔让他们的父母感到意外，也震惊了整个村子。

eloquence.example: Her eloquence made the whole room listen to every word she said.
eloquence.exampleZh: 她的雄辩让全场每个人都认真听她说的每一句话。

eloquent.example: Her eloquent speech about kindness made everyone in the room quiet.
eloquent.exampleZh: 她那番关于善意的雄辩演讲让房间里的每个人都安静下来。

elsewhere.example: She looked for her keys here, but they were elsewhere.
elsewhere.exampleZh: 她在这里找钥匙，但钥匙在别处。

elude.example: The answer still eludes me, though I have read the question three times.
elude.exampleZh: 尽管我把问题读了三遍，那个答案仍然让我想不出来。

elusive.example: The exact meaning of this word is elusive and hard to remember.
elusive.exampleZh: 这个词的确切含义难以捉摸，也很难记住。

emaciated.example: After the long illness, the old dog looked thin and emaciated.
emaciated.exampleZh: 久病之后，那只老狗看起来瘦弱而憔悴。

emancipate.example: The new law helped to emancipate women from unfair old rules.
emancipate.exampleZh: 新法律帮助女性从不公平的旧规矩中解放出来。

embargo.example: The government put an embargo on oil exports last year.
embargo.exampleZh: 政府去年对石油出口实施了禁运。

embark.example: We will embark on a new project next week.
embark.exampleZh: 我们下周将着手一个新项目。

embarkation.example: The passengers waited for embarkation on the large ship.
embarkation.exampleZh: 乘客们等待着登上那艘大船。

embarrass.example: I did not want to embarrass him in front of his friends.
embarrass.exampleZh: 我不想在他的朋友面前让他难堪。

embarrassment.example: He felt great embarrassment when he forgot her name in front of everyone.
embarrassment.exampleZh: 他在众人面前忘了她的名字，感到非常尴尬。

embassy.example: She went to the embassy to get a visa for her trip.
embassy.exampleZh: 她去大使馆办理旅行签证。

embattled.example: The embattled team kept fighting hard until the very last minute of the game.
embattled.exampleZh: 这支陷入困境的球队一直奋力拼搏，直到比赛的最后一分钟。

embed.example: The teacher helped embed new ideas in the students' minds.
embed.exampleZh: 老师帮助把新观念植入学生的头脑中。

embellish.example: She likes to embellish her stories with funny details.
embellish.exampleZh: 她喜欢用有趣的细节来润色她的故事。

embellishment.example: The dress has some simple embellishments along the neckline.
embellishment.exampleZh: 这条连衣裙的领口处有一些简单的装饰。

embezzle.example: He was fired because he tried to embezzle money from the company.
embezzle.exampleZh: 他因为试图挪用公司的钱而被解雇了。

embezzlement.example: The manager was arrested for embezzlement after the company found missing money.
embezzlement.exampleZh: 公司发现资金短缺后，这名经理因挪用公款而被逮捕。

emblem.example: The dove is a well-known emblem of peace.
emblem.exampleZh: 鸽子是众所周知的和平象征。

emblematic.example: The white dove is emblematic of peace in many cultures.
emblematic.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，白鸽是和平的象征。

embodiment.example: She is the embodiment of kindness and hard work.
embodiment.exampleZh: 她是善良与勤奋的化身。

embody.example: Her daily actions embody the values she talks about with others.
embody.exampleZh: 她的日常行动体现了她与他人谈论的价值观。

embrace.example: She learned to embrace change instead of fearing it every day.
embrace.exampleZh: 她学会了接受变化，而不是每天惧怕它。

embroidery.example: My grandmother taught me how to do embroidery when I was young.
embroidery.exampleZh: 我小时候，奶奶教我怎么做刺绣。

embryo.example: The project is still an embryo, but its basic idea is clear.
embryo.exampleZh: 这个项目仍处于雏形阶段，但它的基本想法已经清楚了。

embryonic.example: The plan is still embryonic and needs much more work.
embryonic.exampleZh: 这个计划仍处于萌芽阶段，还需要做大量工作。

emerge.example: The sun began to emerge from behind the gray clouds.
emerge.exampleZh: 太阳开始从灰色的云层后面露出来。

emergency.example: In an emergency, call the police and stay calm.
emergency.exampleZh: 遇到紧急情况时，报警并保持冷静。

emigrant.example: My grandfather was an emigrant who left his small village for America.
emigrant.exampleZh: 我的祖父是一位离开小村庄前往美国的移民。

emigration.example: He left his small town and began a new life through emigration.
emigration.exampleZh: 他离开了小镇，通过移居国外开始了新的生活。

eminence.example: The doctor achieved great eminence through years of careful research and honest work.
eminence.exampleZh: 这位医生通过多年的严谨研究和诚实工作获得了卓越的声望。

eminent.example: He is an eminent scientist who has taught at many famous universities.
eminent.exampleZh: 他是一位杰出的科学家，曾在许多著名大学任教。

emissary.example: The king sent an emissary to the neighboring country to discuss peace.
emissary.exampleZh: 国王派了一位使者前往邻国商讨和平。

emission.example: The factory must reduce its carbon emission to protect the air we breathe.
emission.exampleZh: 这家工厂必须减少碳排放，以保护我们呼吸的空气。

emit.example: The old factory emits thick black smoke into the air every morning.
emit.exampleZh: 那家旧工厂每天早上向空气中排放浓浓的黑烟。

emotion.example: She could not hide the strong emotion in her voice.
emotion.exampleZh: 她无法掩饰声音中强烈的情感。

emotional.example: She became very emotional when she watched the old family video last night.
emotional.exampleZh: 昨晚她看那段家庭旧录像时情绪非常激动。

empathetic.example: She is an empathetic listener who always tries to understand how other people feel.
empathetic.exampleZh: 她是一位有共情的倾听者，总是努力去理解别人的感受。

empathy.example: Good doctors show empathy when their patients are afraid and worried.
empathy.exampleZh: 好医生在病人感到害怕和担忧时会表现出同理心。

emperor.example: The emperor lived in a large palace with his family.
emperor.exampleZh: 皇帝和他的家人住在一座大宫殿里。

emphasis.example: Our teacher puts great emphasis on daily reading and writing practice.
emphasis.exampleZh: 我们老师非常强调每天的阅读和写作练习。

emphasize.example: I want to emphasize that safety comes first in all our work.
emphasize.exampleZh: 我想强调，在我们所有工作中安全第一。

empire.example: The Roman empire was once the largest and most powerful in the world.
empire.exampleZh: 罗马帝国曾是世界上最大、最强的帝国。

empirical.example: The study gives empirical evidence that sleep helps students learn better.
empirical.exampleZh: 这项研究提供了实证证据，证明睡眠有助于学生学得更好。

emplacement.example: The old cannons still stand on the stone emplacement near the sea.
emplacement.exampleZh: 那些旧大炮仍然立在海边的石头炮台上。

employ.example: Many small shops employ local students to help during the summer holidays.
employ.exampleZh: 许多小商店在暑假期间雇用当地学生帮忙。

employee.example: The company gave every employee a new laptop and a small bonus.
employee.exampleZh: 公司给每位员工发了一台新笔记本电脑和一笔小额奖金。

employer.example: My employer gave me a day off after I worked hard.
employer.exampleZh: 我努力工作后，老板给了我一天假。

employment.example: She found employment at a small company near her home.
employment.exampleZh: 她在家附近的一家小公司找到了工作。

empower.example: Good teachers empower students to ask questions and find their own answers.
empower.exampleZh: 好老师让学生有能力提出问题并自己找到答案。

empty.example: The room was empty, so we sat on the floor and talked.
empty.exampleZh: 房间里空无一人，于是我们坐在地板上聊天。

emulate.example: Many young players try to emulate their favorite stars on the court.
emulate.exampleZh: 许多年轻球员试图在球场上模仿他们最喜欢的球星。

enable.example: This new app enables students to study at home easily.
enable.exampleZh: 这款新应用使学生能够在家轻松学习。

enact.example: The government will enact a new law to protect clean water.
enact.exampleZh: 政府将颁布一项新法律来保护清洁水源。

enactment.example: The enactment of the new law took place last Monday morning.
enactment.exampleZh: 新法律的颁布发生在上周一上午。

enamel.example: The old cup is covered with blue enamel and still looks beautiful.
enamel.exampleZh: 那个旧杯子覆有蓝色搪瓷，看上去依然很漂亮。

enchant.example: The little girl's singing voice seemed to enchant everyone in the room.
enchant.exampleZh: 这个小女孩的歌声似乎让房间里的每个人都陶醉了。

enchantment.example: The old forest is full of quiet enchantment for anyone who walks there.
enchantment.exampleZh: 对任何走在那里的人来说，这片古老的森林充满了宁静的魅力。

encipher.example: They used a secret key to encipher the message before sending it.
encipher.exampleZh: 他们在发送之前用密匙把信息译成了密码。

enclave.example: This small town is an enclave surrounded by another country.
enclave.exampleZh: 这个小镇是被另一个国家包围的一块飞地。

encode.example: We need to encode the message before sending it to the other office.
encode.exampleZh: 我们需要在把消息发送到另一个办公室之前对它进行编码。

encompass.example: The park encompasses a lake, a forest, and a small playground.
encompass.exampleZh: 这个公园包含一个湖、一片森林和一个小操场。

encounter.example: I met an old friend on the train, and our encounter made me happy.
encounter.exampleZh: 我在火车上遇到了一位老朋友，这次邂逅让我很开心。

encourage.example: My parents always encourage me to try new things.
encourage.exampleZh: 父母总是鼓励我去尝试新事物。

encroach.example: New buildings slowly encroach on the old farmland near our town.
encroach.exampleZh: 新建筑慢慢侵占了我们镇附近的旧农田。

encryption.example: Strong encryption keeps your messages safe from other people.
encryption.exampleZh: 强加密可以保护你的信息不被他人看到。

encumbrance.example: The old car became an encumbrance after we moved to the city.
encumbrance.exampleZh: 搬到城里后，那辆旧车成了累赘。

encyclopedia.example: I looked up the history of ancient China in our new encyclopedia.
encyclopedia.exampleZh: 我在我们的新百科全书里查了中国古代史。

end.example: The end of the movie made everyone in the room cry.
end.exampleZh: 电影的结局让房间里的每个人都哭了。

endanger.example: Pollution and hunting endanger many wild animals around the world.
endanger.exampleZh: 污染和捕猎危及世界上许多野生动物。

endangerment.example: Pollution is a serious endangerment to the health of wild animals.
endangerment.exampleZh: 污染对野生动物的健康是一种严重的危害。

endear.example: Her kind words endear her to everyone in the office.
endear.exampleZh: 她亲切的话语使办公室里每个人都喜欢她。

endeavor.example: She put great endeavor into learning English and never gave up.
endeavor.exampleZh: 她在学习英语上付出了极大的努力，从未放弃。

endemic.example: This bird is endemic to the small island and lives nowhere else.
endemic.exampleZh: 这种鸟是该小岛特有的，在其他地方都见不到。

ending.example: The movie has a happy ending that made everyone smile.
ending.exampleZh: 这部电影有一个让大家都微笑的快乐结局。

endorsement.example: Her endorsement of the plan helped the team get the money.
endorsement.exampleZh: 她对这项计划的支持帮助团队拿到了资金。

endowment.example: The school received a large endowment from a former student last year.
endowment.exampleZh: 这所学校去年收到了一位老校友的一大笔捐赠。

endurance.example: Running a marathon requires great endurance and a strong mind.
endurance.exampleZh: 跑马拉松需要很强的耐力和坚强的意志。

endure.example: She had to endure a lot of pain after the accident.
endure.exampleZh: 事故之后，她不得不忍受许多痛苦。

enemy.example: The dog is a good friend and never an enemy to us.
enemy.exampleZh: 狗是我们的好朋友，从不是我们的敌人。

energetic.example: The energetic children ran around the park all afternoon.
energetic.exampleZh: 那些精力充沛的孩子整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。

energy.example: She has enough energy to play tennis after work.
energy.exampleZh: 她下班后有足够的精力打网球。

enforce.example: The police must enforce the new traffic rules on every busy road.
enforce.exampleZh: 警方必须在每条繁忙的道路上执行新的交通规则。

enforcement.example: The police are responsible for the enforcement of traffic laws.
enforcement.exampleZh: 警察负责交通法规的执行。

enfranchise.example: The new law will enfranchise thousands of citizens who were not allowed to vote.
enfranchise.exampleZh: 新法律将给予数千名此前不被允许投票的公民选举权。

engage.example: She likes to engage in sports and reading after school.
engage.exampleZh: 她喜欢在放学后参与体育运动和阅读。

engagement.example: Their engagement was announced at a small family dinner last week.
engagement.exampleZh: 他们的订婚消息是上周在一次小型家庭晚宴上宣布的。

engender.example: Poor communication can engender fear and anger among the team.
engender.exampleZh: 沟通不畅会在团队中产生恐惧和愤怒。

engine.example: The engine of the old car makes a loud noise every morning.
engine.exampleZh: 那辆旧车的发动机每天早上都会发出很大的噪音。

engineer.example: The engineer plans and builds a new bridge for the city.
engineer.exampleZh: 这位工程师为城市策划并建造了一座新桥。

engineering.example: My brother studies engineering at a large university in the north.
engineering.exampleZh: 我哥哥在北方的一所大型大学学习工程学。

engrave.example: Her words were engraved on my mind after that long talk.
engrave.exampleZh: 那次长谈之后，她的话深深印在了我的心里。

engraving.example: The old man showed us an engraving of a mountain village on the wall.
engraving.exampleZh: 那位老人给我们看了墙上的一幅山村版画。

engross.example: The movie was so exciting that it engrossed everyone in the room.
engross.exampleZh: 这部电影太精彩了，让房间里的每个人都全神贯注。

engrossing.example: The movie was so engrossing that I forgot to eat dinner.
engrossing.exampleZh: 这部电影太引人入胜了，我忘了吃晚饭。

engulf.example: Dark clouds engulfed the small village before the storm arrived.
engulf.exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前，乌云吞没了这个小村庄。

enhance.example: Good sleep and daily exercise can enhance your memory and learning skills.
enhance.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠和每天锻炼可以提高你的记忆力和学习能力。

enigma.example: Her sudden silence was an enigma to all of us.
enigma.exampleZh: 她突然的沉默对我们所有人来说都是个谜。

enjoin.example: The judge enjoined the company from selling the unsafe toys.
enjoin.exampleZh: 法官责令该公司停止销售不安全的玩具。

enjoy.example: I enjoy reading books in the park on sunny days.
enjoy.exampleZh: 我喜欢在阳光明媚的日子里在公园读书。

enlarge.example: We plan to enlarge the photo and hang it in the living room.
enlarge.exampleZh: 我们打算把这张照片放大，挂在客厅里。

enlighten.example: My teacher used a simple story to enlighten us about the value of hard work.
enlighten.exampleZh: 老师用一个简单的故事启发我们认识努力的价值。

enlightenment.example: Reading good books can bring enlightenment to a young mind.
enlightenment.exampleZh: 读好书能给年轻的心灵带来启迪。

enmity.example: There was deep enmity between the two families for many years.
enmity.exampleZh: 这两家人之间多年来一直存在着深深的敌意。

ennui.example: After weeks of rain, a deep ennui settled over the quiet town.
ennui.exampleZh: 连续下了几周的雨后，一种深深的厌倦笼罩着这个安静的小镇。

enormity.example: The enormity of the damage shocked everyone in the small town.
enormity.exampleZh: 巨大的破坏程度震惊了小镇上的每一个人。

enormous.example: The elephant is an enormous animal with very strong legs.
enormous.exampleZh: 大象是一种巨大的动物，腿非常强壮。

enough.example: We have enough time to finish the work before dinner.
enough.exampleZh: 我们有足够的时间在晚饭前完成这项工作。

enquiry.example: She made an enquiry about the price of the tickets.

enrage.example: His rude words enraged the old man and everyone in the room.
enrage.exampleZh: 他粗鲁的话激怒了那位老人和房间里的所有人。

enrich.example: Reading good books can enrich your life in many ways.
enrich.exampleZh: 读好书能在很多方面丰富你的人生。

enroll.example: She plans to enroll in the evening class next month.
enroll.exampleZh: 她打算下个月报名参加晚班课程。

enrolment.example: The school's enrolment rose sharply this year because of the new courses.
enrolment.exampleZh: 由于开设了新课程，今年这所学校的注册人数大幅上升。

ensconce.example: She ensconced herself in a quiet corner of the library to read.
ensconce.exampleZh: 她安坐在图书馆一个安静的角落里读书。

ensemble.example: The whole ensemble of musicians played together very well last night.
ensemble.exampleZh: 昨晚整个乐团的音乐家们一起演奏得非常好。

ensue.example: After the heavy rain, serious problems will ensue for the farmers.
ensue.exampleZh: 大雨过后，农民们将面临随之而来的严重问题。

ensure.example: Please ensure that the door is locked before you leave the office.
ensure.exampleZh: 离开办公室前，请确保门已锁好。

entail.example: This new job will entail a lot of travel and long hours.
entail.exampleZh: 这份新工作需要大量出差和长时间工作。

entangle.example: The fish got entangled in the old net near the shore.
entangle.exampleZh: 那条鱼在岸边附近被一张旧渔网缠住了。

entanglement.example: The company's entanglement with the scandal damaged its reputation.
entanglement.exampleZh: 公司与这桩丑闻的牵连损害了它的声誉。

entente.example: The two countries signed an entente to keep peace in the region.
entente.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项协定，以维护该地区的和平。

enter.example: Please enter your name and password before you start the test.
enter.exampleZh: 请在开始测试前输入你的姓名和密码。

enterprise.example: This small enterprise makes good products and sells them to many countries.
enterprise.exampleZh: 这家小企业生产优质产品，并把它们销往许多国家。

entertain.example: We often entertain friends at home on weekends.
entertain.exampleZh: 我们周末常在家里招待朋友。

entertainment.example: Music and movies are my favorite forms of entertainment at home.
entertainment.exampleZh: 音乐和电影是我在家最喜欢的娱乐方式。

enthrall.example: The magician's tricks enthralled the children for the whole afternoon.
enthrall.exampleZh: 魔术师的戏法让整个下午的孩子们都着迷了。

enthralling.example: The movie was so enthralling that nobody wanted to leave the theater.
enthralling.exampleZh: 这部电影太迷人了，没人想离开影院。

enthusiasm.example: Her enthusiasm for music makes everyone around her happy.
enthusiasm.exampleZh: 她对音乐的热情让身边每个人都感到快乐。

enthusiastic.example: She is very enthusiastic about her new job at the small bookshop.
enthusiastic.exampleZh: 她对在那家小书店的新工作非常热情。

entice.example: The store uses free candy to entice children into buying toys.
entice.exampleZh: 这家商店用免费糖果引诱孩子们买玩具。

entire.example: She spent the entire day cleaning her small house.
entire.exampleZh: 她花了一整天时间打扫她的小房子。

entirety.example: I read the entire book in its entirety last night.
entirety.exampleZh: 我昨晚把这本书完整地读了一遍。

entitle.example: This ticket entitles you to a free drink at the show.
entitle.exampleZh: 这张票让你有权在演出时免费获得一杯饮料。

entitlements.example: All workers should know their basic rights and entitlements under the new law.
entitlements.exampleZh: 所有工人都应了解新法律赋予他们的基本权利和应得待遇。

entity.example: Each entity in the database has its own unique name and number.
entity.exampleZh: 数据库中的每个实体都有自己的唯一名称和编号。

entomology.example: She studies entomology at the university and often collects insects in the park.
entomology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习昆虫学，还经常在公园里采集昆虫。

entourage.example: The famous singer arrived at the hotel with a large entourage of assistants.
entourage.exampleZh: 那位著名歌手带着一大群助理随行人员抵达酒店。

entrails.example: The old story says the hunter looked at the animal's entrails to find his way home.
entrails.exampleZh: 那个古老的故事说，猎人查看动物的内脏来找到回家的路。

entrance.example: The main entrance of the school is always busy in the morning.
entrance.exampleZh: 学校的主入口在早上总是很繁忙。

entrepreneur.example: The young entrepreneur started a small company and worked hard every day.
entrepreneur.exampleZh: 这位年轻的企业家创办了一家小公司，每天努力工作。

entrepreneurship.example: Her course on entrepreneurship helps young people start small businesses.
entrepreneurship.exampleZh: 她的创业精神课程帮助年轻人创办小企业。

entrust.example: I entrust my keys to my neighbor when I travel.
entrust.exampleZh: 我出门旅行时把钥匙托付给邻居。

entry.example: The guard checked my name at the entry to the building.
entry.exampleZh: 保安在进入大楼的入口处核对了我的名字。

enumerate.example: Please enumerate the three main reasons for your answer.
enumerate.exampleZh: 请列举你这个答案的三个主要理由。

enumeration.example: The report gives a clear enumeration of all the problems we found.
enumeration.exampleZh: 报告对我们发现的所有问题作了清晰的列举。

enunciate.example: The teacher asked him to enunciate his words clearly so everyone could understand.
enunciate.exampleZh: 老师让他把话说清楚，好让每个人都能听懂。

enunciation.example: Her clear enunciation made the speech easy for everyone to understand.
enunciation.exampleZh: 她清晰的发音让每个人都容易听懂这场演讲。

envelope.example: She put the letter in a white envelope and mailed it.
envelope.exampleZh: 她把信放进一个白色的信封里，然后寄了出去。

enviable.example: She has an enviable job that lets her travel around the world.
enviable.exampleZh: 她有一份令人羡慕的工作，可以让她环游世界。

environment.example: We should all work together to protect the environment for future generations.
environment.exampleZh: 我们都应该共同努力，为子孙后代保护环境。

environmental.example: Environmental problems are getting worse, so we should protect the earth.
environmental.exampleZh: 环境问题日益严重，所以我们应该保护地球。

envisage.example: We envisage a small garden behind the new house.
envisage.exampleZh: 我们设想在新房子后面建一个小花园。

envoy.example: The king sent an envoy to talk with the leaders of the other country.
envoy.exampleZh: 国王派了一位使节去与另一个国家的领导人会谈。

envy.example: She felt envy when she saw her friend's new car.
envy.exampleZh: 她看到朋友的新车时感到羡慕。

enzyme.example: This enzyme helps your stomach break down food after every meal.
enzyme.exampleZh: 这种酶有助于你的胃在每餐后分解食物。

ephemeral.example: The beauty of the sunset was ephemeral and lasted only a few minutes.
ephemeral.exampleZh: 日落的美是短暂的，只持续了几分钟。

epic.example: The film is an epic about a long journey across the sea.
epic.exampleZh: 这部电影是一部关于横渡大海漫长旅程的史诗。

epicurean.example: My epicurean friend spends all his money on fine food and wine.
epicurean.exampleZh: 我那位崇尚享乐主义的朋友把所有的钱都花在美食和美酒上。

epidemic.example: The flu epidemic spread quickly through the school last winter.
epidemic.exampleZh: 去年冬天，流感疫情在学校里迅速蔓延。

epidemiology.example: She studies epidemiology at the university because she wants to understand how diseases spread.
epidemiology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习流行病学，因为她想了解疾病是如何传播的。

epigram.example: My teacher wrote a short epigram about the danger of pride.
epigram.exampleZh: 老师写了一句关于骄傲之危险的简短警句。

epilogue.example: The epilogue of the novel tells us what happened to the family.
epilogue.exampleZh: 这部小说的尾声讲述了这家人后来的遭遇。

episode.example: That funny episode at the airport is still my favorite story to tell.
episode.exampleZh: 机场那段好笑的经历至今仍是我最爱讲的故事。

episodic.example: The band's episodic shows made it hard for fans to follow them.
episodic.exampleZh: 这支乐队偶尔才有的演出让歌迷很难持续关注他们。

epistemology.example: His course in epistemology helped her question what she really knew.
epistemology.exampleZh: 他的认识论课程帮助她质疑自己真正知道的东西。

epistle.example: He read the long epistle from his old friend twice.
epistle.exampleZh: 他把老朋友寄来的那封长信读了两遍。

epitaph.example: The old stone had a short epitaph that told the story of his life.
epitaph.exampleZh: 那块古老的石头上刻着一句简短的墓志铭，讲述了他一生的故事。

epithet.example: His teammates gave him the epithet Iron Man after he scored the winning goal.
epithet.exampleZh: 在他攻入制胜球后，队友们给他起了“钢铁侠”这个绰号。

epitome.example: She is the epitome of a kind and hardworking student.
epitome.exampleZh: 她是善良又勤奋的学生的典型。

epoch.example: The invention of the internet started a new epoch in human history.
epoch.exampleZh: 互联网的发明开启了人类历史的新纪元。

epochal.example: The invention of the internet was an epochal change in how people live.
epochal.exampleZh: 互联网的发明是改变人们生活方式的划时代变革。

equable.example: Her equable temper makes her easy to work with.
equable.exampleZh: 她平和的脾气使她容易相处。

equal.example: Everyone should have an equal chance to learn and to grow.
equal.exampleZh: 每个人都应该拥有平等的学习和成长机会。

equality.example: We all believe that equality between men and women is very important.
equality.exampleZh: 我们都认为男女平等非常重要。

equanimity.example: She accepted the bad news with equanimity and stayed calm.
equanimity.exampleZh: 她平静地接受了这个坏消息，保持了镇定。

equate.example: Many people wrongly equate having money with being truly happy.
equate.exampleZh: 许多人错误地把有钱等同于真正幸福。

equation.example: Learning to solve a simple equation helps students understand math better.
equation.exampleZh: 学习解一个简单的方程式有助于学生更好地理解数学。

equator.example: The equator is a line that goes around the middle of the earth.
equator.exampleZh: 赤道是一条环绕地球中部的线。

equilibrium.example: The market slowly returned to equilibrium after the price shock.
equilibrium.exampleZh: 价格冲击之后，市场慢慢恢复了平衡。

equine.example: The horse's long face and strong legs are equine features.
equine.exampleZh: 马的长脸和强壮的腿都是马的特征。

equinox.example: The spring equinox is a day when day and night are almost the same length.
