equinox.exampleZh: 春分这一天，白天和黑夜的长度几乎相同。

equip.example: The school will equip every classroom with a new computer this year.
equip.exampleZh: 学校今年将为每间教室配备一台新电脑。

equipment.example: The school bought new equipment for the science lab last week.
equipment.exampleZh: 学校上周为科学实验室购买了新设备。

equitable.example: The teacher tried to find an equitable way to share the class work.
equitable.exampleZh: 老师试图找到一种公平的方式来分担班级的工作。

equitation.example: She learned equitation at a small farm near her home.
equitation.exampleZh: 她在家附近的一个小农场学习骑术。

equity.example: The company treats all its workers with equity and respect.
equity.exampleZh: 公司公平且尊重地对待所有员工。

equivalent.example: This cheap bag is equivalent to the expensive one in quality.
equivalent.exampleZh: 这个便宜的包在质量上等同于那个贵的包。

era.example: The internet changed the world in a new era of technology.
era.exampleZh: 互联网在技术的新时代改变了世界。

eradicate.example: The city is working hard to eradicate the disease from poor areas.
eradicate.exampleZh: 这座城市正在努力从贫困地区根除这种疾病。

erase.example: Please erase the wrong words on the blackboard before class starts.
erase.exampleZh: 请在开始上课前擦掉黑板上的错字。

erasure.example: The erasure of old files made room for new ones.
erasure.exampleZh: 擦除旧文件为新文件腾出了空间。

erect.example: The workers will erect a new bridge across the river next year.
erect.exampleZh: 工人们明年将在河上建造一座新桥。

ergonomic.example: This chair has an ergonomic design that makes long hours of work comfortable.
ergonomic.exampleZh: 这把椅子有符合人体工学的设计，让长时间工作也很舒适。

erode.example: Waves slowly erode the rocks along this coast.
erode.exampleZh: 海浪慢慢侵蚀着这片海岸上的岩石。

erosion.example: Wind and rain cause serious erosion of the soil on this hill.
erosion.exampleZh: 风雨导致这座山上的土壤严重侵蚀。

erotic.example: The movie has some erotic scenes that are not suitable for children.
erotic.exampleZh: 这部电影有一些不适合儿童观看的性爱情节。

eroticism.example: The film was criticized for its use of eroticism in several scenes.
eroticism.exampleZh: 这部电影因在几个场景中运用色情元素而受到批评。

err.example: People who err should be given a chance to correct themselves.
err.exampleZh: 犯错的人应该有机会改正自己。

errand.example: My mother asked me to run an errand at the bank this morning.
errand.exampleZh: 今天早上妈妈让我去银行办件事。

errant.example: The errant dog wandered far from home and could not find its way back.
errant.exampleZh: 那只迷途的狗走离家很远，找不到回来的路。

erratic.example: The old bus was erratic and often arrived at strange times.
erratic.exampleZh: 那辆旧公交车很不稳定，经常在奇怪的时间到站。

erroneous.example: The report was based on erroneous information and had to be corrected.
erroneous.exampleZh: 这份报告基于错误的信息，因此不得不进行更正。

error.example: This small error in the report caused a big problem.
error.exampleZh: 报告中的这个小错误导致了一个大问题。

erudite.example: She is an erudite woman who loves reading old books.
erudite.exampleZh: 她是一位热爱阅读古书的博学女性。

erupt.example: The volcano erupted suddenly last night and dark smoke rose into the sky.
erupt.exampleZh: 这座火山昨晚突然喷发，黑烟升上了天空。

eruption.example: The sudden eruption of the volcano forced many families to leave their homes.
eruption.exampleZh: 火山的突然喷发迫使许多家庭离开家园。

escalate.example: Small problems can escalate quickly if we do not talk about them.
escalate.exampleZh: 如果我们不谈论小问题，它们可能很快升级。

escalation.example: The small argument led to an escalation of trouble between the two teams.
escalation.exampleZh: 这场小争吵导致两队之间的麻烦不断升级。

escape.example: The cat tried to escape through the small open window.
escape.exampleZh: 那只猫试图从敞开的小窗户逃走。

eschew.example: My doctor told me to eschew sugar and salt for a month.
eschew.exampleZh: 医生让我一个月内避开糖和盐。

escort.example: Two police officers escort the children across the busy street every morning.
escort.exampleZh: 每天早晨两名警察护送孩子们过繁忙的马路。

esoteric.example: The professor's esoteric lecture was difficult for most students to follow.
esoteric.exampleZh: 教授那场深奥的讲座，大多数学生都很难听懂。

espionage.example: The police caught two men who were involved in espionage against the government.
espionage.exampleZh: 警方抓获了两名参与针对政府间谍活动的男子。

espousal.example: His espousal of the new plan surprised all of us.
espousal.exampleZh: 他对新计划的支持让我们所有人都感到意外。

essay.example: She wrote a short essay about her summer trip for the school magazine.
essay.exampleZh: 她为校刊写了一篇关于暑期旅行的短文。

essayist.example: The essayist writes short pieces about daily life in a quiet town.
essayist.exampleZh: 这位散文家写的是关于小镇日常生活的短篇作品。

essence.example: The essence of her idea is simple and easy to understand.
essence.exampleZh: 她的想法的本质很简单，容易理解。

essential.example: Good sleep is essential for your health and your daily work.
essential.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠对你的健康和日常工作都是必不可少的。

essentially.example: This problem is essentially the same as the one we solved last week.
essentially.exampleZh: 这个问题本质上和我们上周解决的那个问题是一样的。

establish.example: We hope to establish a small library in our school this year.
establish.exampleZh: 我们希望今年在我们学校建立一个小图书馆。

establishment.example: The establishment of the new school took two years.
establishment.exampleZh: 这所新学校的建立花了两年时间。

estate.example: His family owns a large estate in the countryside.
estate.exampleZh: 他家在乡下拥有一座很大的庄园。

esteem.example: I have great esteem for my teacher because she always helps us.
esteem.exampleZh: 我非常敬重我的老师，因为她总是帮助我们。

estimate.example: We estimate the trip will take about three hours by train.
estimate.exampleZh: 我们估计乘火车这趟旅程大约需要三个小时。

estimation.example: My estimation of the cost was close to the final price.
estimation.exampleZh: 我对成本的估计接近最终价格。

estrange.example: His long silence began to estrange him from his old friends.
estrange.exampleZh: 长久的沉默使他开始与老朋友疏远。

etched.example: The old man's words were etched deeply in my memory.
etched.exampleZh: 那位老人的话深深印在我的记忆里。

eternal.example: The love between a mother and her child is eternal.
eternal.exampleZh: 母亲与孩子之间的爱是永恒的。

ethic.example: A strong work ethic helps young people succeed in their jobs.
ethic.exampleZh: 强烈的职业道德有助于年轻人在工作中取得成功。

ethics.example: He studies ethics at university because he wants to make fair decisions.
ethics.exampleZh: 他在大学学习伦理学，因为他想做出公平的决定。

ethnic.example: This city has many ethnic groups, and each one has its own food and music.
ethnic.exampleZh: 这座城市有许多族群，每个族群都有自己的食物和音乐。

ethnocentric.example: His ethnocentric view made him think his own culture was better than others.
ethnocentric.exampleZh: 他的民族中心主义观点使他认为自己的文化比别人的更好。

ethnography.example: Ethnography helps us understand how people live in different cultures.
ethnography.exampleZh: 民族志帮助我们理解不同文化中人们的生活方式。

etymology.example: The etymology of this word is very interesting to many students.
etymology.exampleZh: 这个词的词源对许多学生来说很有趣。

eulogy.example: He gave a moving eulogy at his teacher's funeral.
eulogy.exampleZh: 他在老师的葬礼上致了一篇感人的悼词。

euphemism.example: People often use a euphemism for death instead of saying the word directly.
euphemism.exampleZh: 人们常用委婉语来指代死亡，而不直接说出这个词。

euphoria.example: The fans felt pure euphoria when their team won the final game.
euphoria.exampleZh: 当他们的球队赢得决赛时，球迷们感到了纯粹的狂喜。

evacuate.example: The teacher told the students to evacuate the building when the fire alarm rang.
evacuate.exampleZh: 火警响起时，老师让学生们撤离大楼。

evade.example: You cannot evade the problem forever, so talk to your teacher today.
evade.exampleZh: 你不能永远回避这个问题，所以今天就去和你的老师谈谈吧。

evaluate.example: We need to evaluate the results before we make a final decision.
evaluate.exampleZh: 我们需要在做出最终决定之前评估结果。

evaluation.example: The teacher gave a fair evaluation of each student's work.
evaluation.exampleZh: 老师对每个学生的作业给出了公正的评价。

evanescent.example: The beauty of the sunset was evanescent and soon faded away.
evanescent.exampleZh: 日落的美是短暂的，很快就消失了。

evasion.example: His evasion of my question made me trust him even less.
evasion.exampleZh: 他对我问题的回避让我更加不信任他了。

evasive.example: His evasive answers made everyone even more suspicious.
evasive.exampleZh: 他躲闪的回答让所有人都更加怀疑了。

even.example: The table is even, so the cups do not fall.
even.exampleZh: 这张桌子很平坦，所以杯子不会掉下来。

evenly.example: Spread the butter evenly on the bread before you add the cheese.
evenly.exampleZh: 在加奶酪之前，把黄油均匀地涂在面包上。

event.example: The school sports event was fun for everyone.
event.exampleZh: 学校的体育比赛项目对每个人来说都很有趣。

eventually.example: After many tries, he eventually passed the driving test last week.
eventually.exampleZh: 尝试了很多次之后，他上周终于通过了驾照考试。

ever.example: Have you ever seen a rainbow after a heavy rain?
ever.exampleZh: 你曾经见过大雨过后的彩虹吗？

every.example: Every student in the class has a new book.
every.exampleZh: 班里的每个学生都有一本新书。

evict.example: The landlord tried to evict the family from their small apartment last winter.
evict.exampleZh: 房东去年冬天试图把那家人从他们的小公寓里赶出去。

evidence.example: The police found no evidence that he was at the scene.
evidence.exampleZh: 警方没有找到他在现场的證據。

evident.example: It is evident that he works very hard every day.
evident.exampleZh: 很明显，他每天都工作得很努力。

evidently.example: He was evidently very tired after the long trip.
evidently.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，他显然非常疲惫。

evil.example: In the story, the evil king brought great trouble to the poor village.
evil.exampleZh: 在故事里，那个邪恶的国王给贫穷的村庄带来了巨大的灾祸。

evocation.example: The old song is a sweet evocation of my childhood summers.
evocation.exampleZh: 那首老歌甜美地唤起了我童年的夏天。

evocative.example: The old song is evocative of my happy childhood in the countryside.
evocative.exampleZh: 这首老歌让我想起在乡下快乐的童年。

evoke.example: The old song can evoke happy memories of my childhood.
evoke.exampleZh: 这首老歌能唤起我对童年的快乐回忆。

evolution.example: The evolution of language is a slow but steady process.
evolution.exampleZh: 语言的演变是一个缓慢而稳定的过程。

evolutionary.example: The bird's wings are an evolutionary change that helped it survive.
evolutionary.exampleZh: 这种鸟的翅膀是一种帮助它生存下来的进化变化。

evolve.example: Languages evolve slowly over many years as people use them.
evolve.exampleZh: 随着人们的使用，语言在许多年里缓慢地演变。

exacerbate.example: His angry words only exacerbated the problem between the two teams.
exacerbate.exampleZh: 他的愤怒言辞只是使两队之间的问题更加恶化。

exact.example: Nobody knows the exact number of people in the room.
exact.exampleZh: 没人知道房间里确切的（精确的）人数。

exacting.example: She is an exacting teacher who expects every student to work hard.
exacting.exampleZh: 她是一位要求严格的老师，期望每个学生都努力学习。

exaggerate.example: Don't exaggerate the story, or people will not believe you.
exaggerate.exampleZh: 不要夸大这件事，否则人们不会相信你。

exalt.example: The coach exalted him to team captain after his great season.
exalt.exampleZh: 在他表现出色的赛季之后，教练提拔他当了队长。

exam.example: I have a math exam tomorrow morning, so I need to study tonight.
exam.exampleZh: 我明天早上有一场数学考试，所以今晚我需要学习。

examination.example: The doctor did a careful examination of my eyes this morning.
examination.exampleZh: 今天上午医生对我的眼睛做了仔细检查。

examine.example: The doctor will examine your throat carefully before giving you any medicine.
examine.exampleZh: 医生在给你开药之前会仔细检查你的喉咙。

example.example: This is a good example for all of us to follow.
example.exampleZh: 这是我们大家都可以学习的一个好榜样。

exasperate.example: His constant lateness began to exasperate the whole team.
exasperate.exampleZh: 他经常迟到，开始让整个团队都感到恼火。

excavate.example: They plan to excavate the old site next summer.
excavate.exampleZh: 他们计划明年夏天发掘这个旧遗址。

exceed.example: The car's speed can exceed one hundred miles per hour on the highway.
exceed.exampleZh: 这辆车在高速公路上时速能超过一百英里。

excel.example: She excels at math and always helps her classmates with difficult problems.
excel.exampleZh: 她擅长数学，总是帮助同学解决难题。

excellence.example: Her excellence in math helped her win a big prize.
excellence.exampleZh: 她在数学上的卓越表现为她赢得了一个大奖。

excellent.example: She is an excellent teacher and all her students love her class.
excellent.exampleZh: 她是一位杰出的老师，所有学生都喜欢她的课。

except.example: Everyone went to the party except Tom, who stayed home sick.
except.exampleZh: 除了汤姆生病待在家里，大家都去参加了聚会。

exception.example: Every rule has an exception, so ask your teacher if you are unsure.
exception.exampleZh: 每条规则都有例外，所以如果不确定就去问老师。

exceptional.example: Her skill in math is exceptional for a student her age.
exceptional.exampleZh: 以她这个年龄的学生来说，她的数学能力非常杰出。

excerpt.example: The teacher read a short excerpt from the book to the class.
excerpt.exampleZh: 老师向全班朗读了这本书的一小段节选。

excess.example: Eating too much sugar can lead to an excess of fat in the body.
excess.exampleZh: 吃太多糖会导致体内脂肪过量。

excessive.example: Excessive noise from the street makes it hard to sleep at night.
excessive.exampleZh: 街上过分的噪音让人夜里难以入睡。

excessively.example: He exercises excessively and often feels very tired after work.
excessively.exampleZh: 他过度锻炼，下班后经常感到非常疲惫。

exchange.example: We often exchange ideas and small gifts with our new classmates.
exchange.exampleZh: 我们经常和新同学交流想法，还互送小礼物。

excise.example: The doctor had to excise the small growth, and the government also raised the excise on fuel.
excise.exampleZh: 医生不得不切除那个小肿块，政府也提高了燃料消费税。

excite.example: Good news can excite the whole team and make them work harder.
excite.exampleZh: 好消息能激励整个团队，让他们更加努力地工作。

excitement.example: The children jumped up and down with excitement when the bus arrived.
excitement.exampleZh: 公共汽车到站时，孩子们兴奋得跳上跳下。

exclaim.example: She exclaimed with joy when she saw the beautiful gift.
exclaim.exampleZh: 她看到那份漂亮的礼物时高兴地叫了起来。

exclamation.example: She ended the sentence with an exclamation mark to show her surprise.
exclamation.exampleZh: 她在句末加上感叹号来表达她的惊讶。

exclude.example: The school excludes students who are late for class too many times.
exclude.exampleZh: 学校把上课迟到次数太多的学生排除在外。

exclusion.example: Her exclusion from the team made her very sad.
exclusion.exampleZh: 她被排除在队伍之外，这让她非常难过。

exclusive.example: This room is exclusive to club members and their guests.
exclusive.exampleZh: 这个房间只供俱乐部会员及其客人使用。

exclusively.example: This room is used exclusively for meetings and quiet study.
exclusively.exampleZh: 这个房间专门用于开会和安静学习。

excommunicate.example: The church decided to excommunicate him after he refused to change his views.
excommunicate.exampleZh: 在他拒绝改变自己的观点后，教会决定将他逐出教会。

excrete.example: The body excretes waste through the skin and the kidneys.
excrete.exampleZh: 身体通过皮肤和肾脏排泄废物。

excursion.example: Our school plans a short excursion to the mountains next spring.
excursion.exampleZh: 我们学校计划明年春天去山里进行一次短途旅行。

execrable.example: The food at that restaurant was execrable and made everyone sick.
execrable.exampleZh: 那家餐厅的食物极其糟糕，让所有人都生病了。

execute.example: The team will execute the new plan next week.
execute.exampleZh: 团队将在下周执行这项新计划。

execution.example: The execution of the new plan will begin next Monday morning.
execution.exampleZh: 新计划的执行将于下周一上午开始。

executive.example: She is a senior executive at a large bank in the city.
executive.exampleZh: 她是这座城市一家大型银行的高级行政主管。

executor.example: The lawyer said my uncle was the executor of the old man's will.
executor.exampleZh: 律师说我叔叔是那位老人遗嘱的执行人。

exegesis.example: His careful exegesis of the ancient text helped the students understand its meaning.
exegesis.exampleZh: 他对这篇古老文本的细致注释帮助学生理解了它的含义。

exemplary.example: Her work at the hospital is exemplary for all young nurses.
exemplary.exampleZh: 她在医院的工作是所有年轻护士的模范。

exempt.example: Small businesses are exempt from this new tax for two years.
exempt.exampleZh: 小企业两年内免缴这项新税。

exemption.example: The new law gives small businesses an exemption from some taxes.
exemption.exampleZh: 新法律使小企业可以免除部分税收。

exercise.example: Regular exercise and a healthy diet help you stay strong and feel happy.
exercise.exampleZh: 经常锻炼和健康的饮食能帮助你保持强壮、心情愉快。

exert.example: Parents exert a strong influence on how their children learn and grow.
exert.exampleZh: 父母对孩子的学习和成长有很强的影响。

exhaust.example: The long run exhausted him, and he fell asleep on the sofa.
exhaust.exampleZh: 长跑使他精疲力尽，他倒在沙发上睡着了。

exhaustion.example: After the long race, he fell asleep from pure exhaustion.
exhaustion.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他因极度疲惫而睡着了。

exhibit.example: The museum will exhibit many old paintings from China next month.
exhibit.exampleZh: 博物馆下个月将展出许多来自中国的古老画作。

exhibition.example: We went to an art exhibition in the city last Sunday.
exhibition.exampleZh: 上周日我们去了市里的一场艺术展览。

exhilarate.example: The good news exhilarated everyone in the office and made us all smile.
exhilarate.exampleZh: 这个好消息让办公室里的每个人都兴奋不已，让我们都笑了。

exhilarating.example: The fast ride on the mountain roller coaster was really exhilarating for everyone.
exhilarating.exampleZh: 在山地过山车上的快速乘坐对每个人来说都非常令人兴奋。

exigency.example: The doctor acted quickly because the exigency of the case left no time to waste.
exigency.exampleZh: 医生迅速行动，因为情况的紧迫性让他没有时间可以浪费。

exile.example: After many years in exile, he finally returned to his home country.
exile.exampleZh: 流亡多年后，他终于回到了自己的祖国。

exist.example: Many small shops still exist on this quiet old street.
exist.exampleZh: 这条安静的老街上仍然存在许多小商店。

existence.example: The old man lives a quiet existence in a small village.
existence.exampleZh: 这位老人住在一个小村庄里过着安静的生活。

existential.example: She often asks existential questions about the meaning of life.
existential.exampleZh: 她经常提出关于生命意义的存在主义问题。

exit.example: Please use the side exit when you leave the building.
exit.exampleZh: 你离开大楼时请走侧面的出口。

exodus.example: The war caused a large exodus of families from the small town.
exodus.exampleZh: 战争导致大批家庭从这座小镇出走。

exogenous.example: The doctor said the infection was exogenous and came from outside the patient's body.
exogenous.exampleZh: 医生说这种感染是外源的，来自病人体外。

exonerate.example: The new evidence will exonerate him and he can go home.
exonerate.exampleZh: 新证据将证明他无罪，他可以回家了。

exorbitant.example: The hotel charges exorbitant prices for a simple cup of coffee.
exorbitant.exampleZh: 这家酒店一杯简单的咖啡就要价过高。

exorcise.example: The old priest tried to exorcise the evil spirit from the house.
exorcise.exampleZh: 那位老祭司试图把邪灵从房子里驱除出去。

exotic.example: She grows exotic flowers from South America in her small garden.
exotic.exampleZh: 她在自己的小花园里种植来自南美洲的异国花卉。

expand.example: The company plans to expand its business into new markets next year.
expand.exampleZh: 公司计划明年将业务扩展到新的市场。

expanse.example: The wide expanse of blue sky made everyone feel calm and happy.
expanse.exampleZh: 广阔无垠的蓝天让每个人都感到平静而快乐。

expansion.example: The rapid expansion of the company created many new jobs in the city.
expansion.exampleZh: 公司的快速扩张在城里创造了许多新的工作岗位。

expansive.example: The view from the hill was expansive and quiet.
expansive.exampleZh: 从山上望去的景色广阔而宁静。

expatriate.example: My uncle is an expatriate who has lived in Japan for ten years.
expatriate.exampleZh: 我的叔叔是一位在日本生活了十年的移居国外者。

expect.example: We expect good weather for the trip next week.
expect.exampleZh: 我们预计下周旅行期间天气会很好。

expectancy.example: The students waited with great expectancy for the exam results to arrive.
expectancy.exampleZh: 学生们满怀期待地等待考试成绩公布。

expectation.example: Her parents have high expectations for her English study this year.
expectation.exampleZh: 她父母对她今年的英语学习抱有很高的期望。

expedient.example: It was expedient to take the short cut, though it was risky.
expedient.exampleZh: 走这条近路虽然冒险，却是权宜之策。

expedition.example: They went on an expedition to the mountains to study wild animals.
expedition.exampleZh: 他们去山里探险，研究野生动物。

expeditious.example: The staff gave us an expeditious reply to our email.
expeditious.exampleZh: 工作人员迅速回复了我们的邮件。

expel.example: The school decided to expel the student after he broke the rules.
expel.exampleZh: 他违反规定后，学校决定开除这名学生。

expend.example: We expend too much time on small problems every day.
expend.exampleZh: 我们每天在小问题上花费太多时间。

expenditure.example: Their monthly expenditure on food is higher than last year.
expenditure.exampleZh: 他们每月在食物上的支出比去年更高。

expense.example: She keeps a record of every expense during the trip.
expense.exampleZh: 她记录了旅行期间的每一笔开支。

expensive.example: This coat is too expensive for me to buy.
expensive.exampleZh: 这件外套太贵了，我买不起。

experience.example: She has a lot of experience in teaching young children English.
experience.exampleZh: 她在教幼儿英语方面很有经验。

experiential.example: The trip was an experiential lesson in how other people live.
experiential.exampleZh: 这次旅行是一次了解他人如何生活的体验式学习。

experiment.example: We did a simple experiment in class to see how plants grow.
experiment.exampleZh: 我们在课堂上做了一个简单的实验，观察植物如何生长。

experimental.example: The school is testing an experimental reading program this year.
experimental.exampleZh: 学校今年正在试点一项试验性的阅读课程。

experimentation.example: Careful experimentation is needed before we use this new method.
experimentation.exampleZh: 在我们使用这种新方法之前，需要进行仔细的实验。

expert.example: She is an expert in computer science and often helps her students.
expert.exampleZh: 她是计算机科学方面的专家，经常帮助她的学生。

expertise.example: Her expertise in design helped the small team finish the project.
expertise.exampleZh: 她在设计方面的专业知识帮助这个小团队完成了项目。

expire.example: My passport will expire next month, so I need to renew it soon.
expire.exampleZh: 我的护照下个月到期，所以我需要尽快续办。

explain.example: Please explain this rule to me in simple words.
explain.exampleZh: 请用简单的话向我解释这条规则。

explanation.example: She gave a clear explanation of the rules to the new students.
explanation.exampleZh: 她向新学生清楚地解释了这些规则。

explanatory.example: The teacher wrote a short explanatory note to help us understand the rule.
explanatory.exampleZh: 老师写了一段简短的说明性注释，帮助我们理解这条规则。

expletive.example: He shouted an expletive when he dropped the heavy box on his foot.
expletive.exampleZh: 他把沉重的箱子砸到脚上时，骂了一句脏话。

explicable.example: The delay is explicable because the train broke down on the way.
explicable.exampleZh: 这次延误是可解释的，因为火车在路上抛锚了。

explicit.example: Her instructions were explicit, so everyone knew exactly what to do.
explicit.exampleZh: 她的指示很明确，所以每个人都清楚该做什么。

explode.example: The old car exploded with a loud noise, and everyone ran away quickly.
explode.exampleZh: 那辆旧车随着一声巨响爆炸了，所有人都迅速跑开了。

exploit.example: Some companies exploit young workers by paying them very little money.
exploit.exampleZh: 一些公司通过支付极低的工资来剥削年轻工人。

exploitative.example: The company was criticized for its exploitative treatment of young workers.
exploitative.exampleZh: 这家公司因剥削年轻工人而受到批评。

exploration.example: Space exploration helps us learn more about the planets and stars.
exploration.exampleZh: 太空探索帮助我们更多地了解行星和恒星。

exploratory.example: The team made an exploratory visit to the old building before they started work.
exploratory.exampleZh: 团队在开工前对那栋老建筑进行了一次勘查走访。

explore.example: We explore the old forest near our town every summer.
explore.exampleZh: 每年夏天我们都会探索镇子附近的古老森林。

explosion.example: The explosion broke many windows in the old factory.
explosion.exampleZh: 那次爆炸震碎了老工厂的许多窗户。

explosive.example: The bomb contained a powerful explosive that destroyed the old building.
explosive.exampleZh: 炸弹中装有威力强大的炸药，摧毁了那座旧建筑。

exponent.example: She is a strong exponent of clean energy for every city.
exponent.exampleZh: 她是每个城市都应使用清洁能源的坚定倡导者。

exponential.example: The city's population showed exponential growth over the past ten years.
exponential.exampleZh: 这座城市的人口在过去十年里呈现出指数级增长。

export.example: The country exports a lot of fresh fruit to many other countries every year.
export.exampleZh: 这个国家每年向许多其他国家出口大量新鲜水果。

expose.example: The news exposed a serious problem in the city's water system.
expose.exampleZh: 这则新闻暴露了城市供水系统中的一个严重问题。

exposition.example: The museum will hold an exposition of modern art next month.
exposition.exampleZh: 博物馆下个月将举办一场现代艺术展览会。

expository.example: The teacher gave an expository talk about how plants grow.
expository.exampleZh: 老师做了一场关于植物如何生长的说明性讲座。

expostulate.example: My mother expostulated with me about my late nights, but I did not listen.
expostulate.exampleZh: 母亲劝诫我不要熬夜，但我没有听。

exposure.example: Long exposure to sunlight can hurt your skin.
exposure.exampleZh: 长时间暴露在阳光下会伤害你的皮肤。

exposé.example: The newspaper published an exposé about the company's illegal dealings.
exposé.exampleZh: 报纸刊登了一篇关于该公司非法交易的曝光报道。

expound.example: She expounded the rules of the game so everyone could play.
expound.exampleZh: 她详细解释了游戏规则，这样每个人都能参与。

express.example: She expressed her ideas clearly, and the express train arrived on time.
express.exampleZh: 她清楚地表达了自己的想法，特快列车也准时到达了。

expression.example: Her calm expression showed she was not angry with us.
expression.exampleZh: 她平静的表情表明她没有生我们的气。

expressly.example: The rules expressly say that students must not use phones in class.
expressly.exampleZh: 规定明确地指出学生不得在课堂上使用手机。

expropriate.example: The government can expropriate private land when it is needed for a new public road.
expropriate.exampleZh: 当需要修建新的公共道路时，政府可以征用私人土地。

expulsion.example: The school announced his expulsion after he broke the rules twice.
expulsion.exampleZh: 在他两次违反规定后，学校宣布将他开除。

expurgate.example: The editor had to expurgate the book before it could be published.
expurgate.exampleZh: 编辑在书出版前不得不对其进行删节。

exquisite.example: She wore an exquisite dress to the party last night.
exquisite.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条精美的裙子去参加聚会。

extant.example: Only three extant copies of this old book are known to us.
extant.exampleZh: 目前已知这本书只有三本传世的副本。

extemporaneous.example: His extemporaneous speech surprised everyone because he had no notes.
extemporaneous.exampleZh: 他的即席演讲让所有人惊讶，因为他没有准备任何笔记。

extend.example: They plan to extend the road to the small village next year.
extend.exampleZh: 他们计划明年把这条公路延伸到那个小村庄。

extension.example: She asked the office for an extension on her project deadline.
extension.exampleZh: 她向办公室申请延长项目截止日期。

extensive.example: The school has extensive gardens and a large sports field.
extensive.exampleZh: 这所学校有广阔的花园和一个大型运动场。

extent.example: The extent of the damage was much worse than we expected.
extent.exampleZh: 损失的程度比我们预想的严重得多。

extenuate.example: The judge said his difficult childhood could extenuate the crime a little.
extenuate.exampleZh: 法官说，他艰难的童年可能在一定程度上减轻这项罪行。

exterminate.example: We must exterminate the rats in the old house.
exterminate.exampleZh: 我们必须消灭老房子里的老鼠。

external.example: The external walls of the old house need new paint this summer.
external.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的外墙今年夏天需要刷上新漆。

extinct.example: Many large animals became extinct long before humans built the first cities.
extinct.exampleZh: 许多大型动物在人类建造第一批城市之前很久就灭绝了。

extinguish.example: Firefighters worked all night to extinguish the forest fire.
extinguish.exampleZh: 消防员奋战了一整夜才扑灭这场森林大火。

extol.example: Many teachers extol the value of reading every day.
extol.exampleZh: 许多老师推崇每天阅读的价值。

extort.example: The man tried to extort money from the shop owner.
extort.exampleZh: 那个男人试图向店主勒索钱财。

extra.example: She bought an extra ticket for her best friend.
extra.exampleZh: 她为最好的朋友多买了一张票。

extract.example: She used a small tool to extract the juice from the lemon.
extract.exampleZh: 她用一个小工具从柠檬中榨取汁液。

extraction.example: The dentist's extraction of the bad tooth took only a few minutes.
extraction.exampleZh: 牙医拔掉那颗坏牙只花了几分钟。

extradite.example: The small country agreed to extradite the man to face trial at home.
extradite.exampleZh: 这个小国同意引渡该男子回国受审。

extraneous.example: The report was hard to read because it was full of extraneous details.
extraneous.exampleZh: 这份报告很难读，因为里面充满了无关的细节。

extraordinary.example: She has an extraordinary memory and can remember every name.
extraordinary.exampleZh: 她的记忆力非凡，能记住每一个名字。

extrapolate.example: We can extrapolate the final cost from the first few months of data.
extrapolate.exampleZh: 我们可以根据前几个月的数据推断出最终成本。

extraterrestrial.example: Some people believe extraterrestrial life may exist on other planets.
extraterrestrial.exampleZh: 有些人相信其他行星上可能存在外星生命。

extravagance.example: His taste for extravagance soon left him with no money at all.
extravagance.exampleZh: 他追求奢侈的品味很快让他身无分文。

extravagant.example: She thinks his extravagant gifts are too much for a simple birthday.
extravagant.exampleZh: 她觉得他那些奢侈的礼物对一个简单的生日来说太过分了。

extreme.example: In extreme weather, people should stay home and avoid going outside.
extreme.exampleZh: 在极端天气下，人们应该待在家里，避免外出。

extremely.example: The exam was extremely hard for most of the students.
extremely.exampleZh: 这次考试对大多数学生来说极其难。

extremist.example: The police arrested an extremist who planned to attack the small village.
extremist.exampleZh: 警方逮捕了一名计划袭击这个小村庄的极端分子。

extrinsic.example: Her motivation for studying was extrinsic, coming from her parents rather than herself.
extrinsic.exampleZh: 她学习的动力是外在的，来自父母而不是她自己。

extrovert.example: My sister is an extrovert who loves talking to new people at parties.
extrovert.exampleZh: 我妹妹是个外向的人，喜欢在聚会上和新认识的人聊天。

exuberance.example: The garden was full of green exuberance after the warm spring rain.
exuberance.exampleZh: 温暖的春雨过后，花园里满是一片翠绿的茂盛景象。

exude.example: Fresh flowers exude a sweet smell in the warm room.
exude.exampleZh: 鲜花在温暖的房间里散发出甜美的气味。

exult.example: The whole team began to exult when they won the final game.
exult.exampleZh: 当全队赢得最后一场比赛时，他们开始欢欣鼓舞。

fabric.example: The fabric of this old shirt is soft and easy to wash.
fabric.exampleZh: 这件旧衬衫的织物很柔软，也很容易洗。

fabricate.example: He tried to fabricate an excuse for being late to class.
fabricate.exampleZh: 他试图为上课迟到编造一个借口。

fabrication.example: The whole story was a fabrication and nobody believed it.
fabrication.exampleZh: 整个故事都是捏造的，没有人相信它。

fabulous.example: She had a fabulous time at the party with her friends.
fabulous.exampleZh: 她和朋友们在聚会上玩得非常开心。

facade.example: Behind that calm facade, he was actually very nervous.
facade.exampleZh: 在那平静的外表之下，他其实非常紧张。

face.example: She washed her face with cold water and looked out the window.
face.exampleZh: 她用冷水洗了脸，然后望向窗外。

facet.example: Every facet of the problem needs to be studied carefully.
facet.exampleZh: 这个问题的每一个方面都需要仔细研究。

facetious.example: His facetious answer made everyone laugh during the serious meeting.
facetious.exampleZh: 在严肃的会议上，他滑稽的回答让大家笑了起来。

facetiousness.example: His facetiousness in class often made the teacher smile.
facetiousness.exampleZh: 他在课堂上爱开玩笑的样子常常让老师微笑。

facial.example: She uses a facial cleanser every morning before she goes to work.
facial.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前都会用一款面部清洁产品。

facile.example: His facile answer showed that he had not thought about the problem.
facile.exampleZh: 他轻率的回答说明他并没有认真思考这个问题。

facilitate.example: Good roads facilitate travel between the two cities.
facilitate.exampleZh: 良好的道路便利了两座城市之间的往来。

facility.example: The new sports facility has a pool and a large gym.
facility.exampleZh: 新的体育设施有一个游泳池和一个大健身房。

fact.example: The fact that she passed the test surprised everyone in the class.
fact.exampleZh: 她通过考试这一事实让班上所有人都感到惊讶。

faction.example: The party split into a small faction after a big argument.
faction.exampleZh: 一场大争吵之后，这个政党分裂成了一个小派系。

factitious.example: Her cheerful smile seemed factitious and made everyone feel a little uncomfortable.
factitious.exampleZh: 她那愉快的微笑显得很做作，让大家都有点不自在。

factor.example: Hard work is an important factor in winning the game.
factor.exampleZh: 努力是赢得比赛的一个重要因素。

factory.example: My father works at a car factory near our city.
factory.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们城市附近的一家汽车工厂工作。

faculty.example: The whole faculty meets in the main hall every Monday morning.
faculty.exampleZh: 全体教员每周一上午都在主楼大厅开会。

fade.example: The bright paint on the old wooden fence slowly faded in the summer sun.
fade.exampleZh: 旧木栅栏上鲜艳的油漆在夏日阳光下慢慢褪色了。

fail.example: If you do not study, you may fail the test.
fail.exampleZh: 如果你不学习，你可能会考试不及格。

failure.example: His failure to check the data caused a big problem for the team.
failure.exampleZh: 他未能核对数据，给团队带来了大问题。

faint.example: The old man felt faint and sat down on the bench.
faint.exampleZh: 那位老人感到头晕，便在长椅上坐了下来。

fair.example: The teacher is always fair to every student in her class.
fair.exampleZh: 这位老师对她班上的每个学生总是很公平。

faith.example: She has great faith in her teacher's advice.
faith.exampleZh: 她非常信任老师的建议。

faithful.example: She is a faithful friend who always helps me when I am sad.
faithful.exampleZh: 她是一个忠实的朋友，我难过时总是帮助我。

fake.example: The police said the money in his bag was fake.
fake.exampleZh: 警方说他包里的钱是假的。

fall.example: Many yellow leaves fall from the tall trees in the cold autumn wind.
fall.exampleZh: 许多黄叶在寒冷的秋风中从高高的树上落下来。

fallacy.example: It is a common fallacy that money always brings happiness.
fallacy.exampleZh: 认为金钱总能带来幸福是一种常见的谬误。

fallibility.example: She accepts her own fallibility and learns from mistakes.
fallibility.exampleZh: 她接受自己易犯错这一点，并从错误中学习。

fallow.example: The farmer left the field fallow for a year to make the soil rich again.
fallow.exampleZh: 农民让那块田地休耕一年，使土壤重新变得肥沃。

false.example: The news on that website is false, so do not believe it.
false.exampleZh: 那个网站上的消息是假的，所以不要相信。

falsification.example: The scientist was accused of falsification of the data in his report.
falsification.exampleZh: 这位科学家被指控在其报告中篡改数据。

falter.example: The old man's steps began to falter as he walked up the hill.
falter.exampleZh: 那位老人走上山坡时，脚步开始变得蹒跚。

fame.example: She won fame as a singer at a young age.
fame.exampleZh: 她年纪轻轻就作为歌手赢得了名声。

familial.example: She has a strong familial bond with her cousins and grandparents.
familial.exampleZh: 她与表亲和祖父母有着牢固的家庭纽带。

familiar.example: This song sounds familiar to me, but I cannot remember its name.
familiar.exampleZh: 这首歌听起来很熟悉，但我想不起它的名字。

familiarity.example: Her familiarity with the old city helped us find the best small shops.
familiarity.exampleZh: 她对老城区的熟悉帮我们找到了最好的小店。

family.example: My family likes to eat dinner together every evening.
family.exampleZh: 我的家人喜欢每天晚上一起吃晚饭。

famine.example: The long war caused a terrible famine in that poor country.
famine.exampleZh: 长期的战争在那个贫穷的国家造成了严重的饥荒。

famous.example: This small town is famous for its beautiful old bridge.
famous.exampleZh: 这个小镇因其美丽的古桥而闻名。

fanatic.example: My brother is a football fanatic and never misses a match.
fanatic.exampleZh: 我弟弟是个足球狂热者，从不错过任何一场比赛。

fancy.example: She wore a fancy dress to the party and everyone liked it.
fancy.exampleZh: 她穿了一条花哨的连衣裙去参加聚会，大家都很喜欢。

fanfare.example: The new store opened with great fanfare, but few people came.
fanfare.exampleZh: 这家新店大张旗鼓地开业了，但来的人很少。

fantasy.example: Many children live in a happy world of fantasy and magic.
fantasy.exampleZh: 许多孩子生活在一个充满幻想与魔法的快乐世界里。

far.example: The station is not far from my new house.
far.exampleZh: 车站离我的新房子不远。

farce.example: The meeting turned into a farce when everyone started shouting.
farce.exampleZh: 当所有人都开始大喊大叫时，会议变成了一场闹剧。

fare.example: The bus fare is two dollars, and she pays it every morning.
fare.exampleZh: 公交车费是两美元，她每天早上都付这笔钱。

farewell.example: We had a farewell party for our teacher on Friday.
farewell.exampleZh: 周五我们为老师举办了一场欢送会。

farm.example: My grandparents live on a small farm and grow vegetables every year.
farm.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在一个小农场里，每年都种蔬菜。

farsighted.example: My farsighted grandfather always planned for the future of our family.
farsighted.exampleZh: 我那位有远见的祖父总是为我们家庭的未来做打算。

farther.example: My new school is farther from home than the old one.
farther.exampleZh: 我的新学校比旧学校离家更远。

fascinate.example: The stars in the night sky fascinate my little brother every time.
fascinate.exampleZh: 夜空中的星星每次都让我弟弟着迷。

fascism.example: The history class studied how fascism rose in Europe before the Second World War.
fascism.exampleZh: 历史课研究了法西斯主义在第二次世界大战前如何在欧洲兴起。

fashion.example: She always follows the latest fashion in clothes and music.
fashion.exampleZh: 她在服装和音乐上总是追随最新的时尚。

fashionable.example: She wears fashionable clothes to work every day.
fashionable.exampleZh: 她每天穿时髦的衣服去上班。

fast.example: He runs very fast, but he can also fast for a day.
fast.exampleZh: 他跑得很快，但也能禁食一整天。

fastidious.example: She is fastidious about her tea and only drinks the best.
fastidious.exampleZh: 她对茶很讲究，只喝最好的。

fat.example: Too much fat in your food is not good for your heart.
fat.exampleZh: 食物中脂肪过多对你的心脏不好。

fatal.example: He made one fatal mistake and lost the whole game.
fatal.exampleZh: 他犯了一个致命错误，输掉了整场比赛。

fatalism.example: His fatalism made him stop trying to change the situation.
fatalism.exampleZh: 他的宿命论使他不再尝试改变现状。

fatalistic.example: The old farmer had a fatalistic view of the weather and never worried about rain.
fatalistic.exampleZh: 这位老农对天气抱着听天由命的态度，从不担心下雨。

fate.example: She believed that fate brought them together on that cold winter night.
fate.exampleZh: 她相信是命运在那个寒冷的冬夜把他们带到了一起。

father.example: My father teaches me how to ride a bike every weekend.
father.exampleZh: 我父亲每个周末都教我骑自行车。

fatherhood.example: Fatherhood taught him to be more patient and kind.
fatherhood.exampleZh: 父亲身份教会他更有耐心、更善良。

fatherland.example: My grandfather often told us stories about his fatherland.
fatherland.exampleZh: 我祖父经常给我们讲关于他祖国的故事。

fathom.example: I cannot fathom why she left so suddenly without saying a word.
fathom.exampleZh: 我无法理解她为什么一句话都没说就突然离开了。

fathomless.example: The dark ocean seemed fathomless to the small children on the boat.
fathomless.exampleZh: 在船上的小孩子看来，那片漆黑的大海深不可测。

fatigue.example: After the long trip, she felt a deep fatigue in her legs.
fatigue.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，她感到腿部一阵深深的疲劳。

fatten.example: Farmers fatten the pigs before selling them at the market.
fatten.exampleZh: 农民在把猪卖到市场之前会把它们养肥。

fatuous.example: It was a fatuous remark that made everyone in the room laugh at him.
fatuous.exampleZh: 那是一句愚昧的话，让房间里的每个人都嘲笑他。

fault.example: The fault in the old machine was easy to find.
fault.exampleZh: 那台旧机器的故障很容易找到。

favor.example: She asked her friend for a small favor and he agreed to help her.
favor.exampleZh: 她向朋友讨了个小忙，他答应帮她。

favorable.example: The weather was favorable for our trip to the mountains last weekend.
favorable.exampleZh: 上周末的天气对我们的登山之旅很有利。

favorite.example: My favorite food is noodles, and I eat them every week.
favorite.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的食物是面条，我每周都吃。

favoritism.example: The teacher was accused of favoritism when she gave the prize to her own son.
favoritism.exampleZh: 当老师把奖品给了自己的儿子时，她被指责偏袒。

fawn.example: The little deer is a fawn, and some workers fawn on their boss.
fawn.exampleZh: 那只小鹿是只幼鹿，而有些员工会讨好他们的老板。

fear.example: She has a great fear of the dark, so she sleeps with a light on.
fear.exampleZh: 她非常害怕黑暗，所以睡觉时开着灯。

feasibility.example: We need to check the feasibility of this plan before we spend money.
feasibility.exampleZh: 在花钱之前，我们需要先核查这个计划的可行性。

feasible.example: It is not feasible to finish this work in one day.
feasible.exampleZh: 在一天内完成这项工作是不可行的。

feast.example: The whole village prepares a big feast for the harvest festival.
feast.exampleZh: 整个村庄都为丰收节准备了一场盛大的宴会。

feat.example: Climbing that mountain alone was a great feat for a young boy.
feat.exampleZh: 独自爬上那座山对一个小男孩来说是一项伟大的壮举。

feature.example: The best feature of this small town is its quiet old streets.
feature.exampleZh: 这座小镇最大的特色是它安静的古老街道。

february.example: My birthday is in February, so we often have a small party then.
february.exampleZh: 我的生日在二月，所以我们常常那时办一个小聚会。

fecal.example: The doctor found fecal bacteria in the water sample from the old well.
fecal.exampleZh: 医生在旧水井的水样中发现了粪便细菌。

fecund.example: The fecund soil near the river helps farmers grow many crops each year.
fecund.exampleZh: 河边肥沃的土壤帮助农民每年种植许多庄稼。

federal.example: The federal government passed a new law to protect the national parks.
federal.exampleZh: 联邦政府通过了一项新法律来保护国家公园。

federation.example: The sports federation meets every year to make rules for all its member clubs.
federation.exampleZh: 这个体育联合会每年开会，为所有成员俱乐部制定规则。

fee.example: The school fee is not too high for most families here.
fee.exampleZh: 对这里的大多数家庭来说，学费不算太高。

feeble.example: The old man was too feeble to walk up the stairs alone.
feeble.exampleZh: 那位老人太虚弱了，无法独自走上楼梯。

feed.example: Farmers feed the cows fresh grass every morning before sunrise.
feed.exampleZh: 农民每天日出前用新鲜青草喂牛。

feedback.example: The teacher gave me useful feedback on my English essay.
feedback.exampleZh: 老师对我的英语作文给出了有用的反馈。

feel.example: I feel happy when I play with my friends after school.
feel.exampleZh: 放学后和朋友们一起玩时，我感觉很开心。

feeling.example: I had a strange feeling that someone was watching me.
feeling.exampleZh: 我有一种奇怪的感觉，好像有人在看着我。

feet.example: My feet are cold after walking in the snow for an hour.
feet.exampleZh: 在雪地里走了一个小时后，我的脚很冷。

feign.example: She tried to feign a smile, but her eyes showed real sadness.
feign.exampleZh: 她试图假装微笑，但她的眼睛流露出真正的悲伤。

feigned.example: He gave a feigned smile to hide how angry he really was.
feigned.exampleZh: 他假装笑了笑，以掩饰自己其实有多生气。

feint.example: The boxer made a quick feint to the left and then hit hard.
feint.exampleZh: 拳击手向左做了一个快速的佯攻，然后重重出击。

felicity.example: Her felicity in choosing words made the simple speech memorable.
felicity.exampleZh: 她在选词上的巧妙使这篇简单的演讲令人难忘。

feline.example: The cat has soft fur and moves with feline grace.
feline.exampleZh: 这只猫有柔软的毛，动作带着猫科动物般的优雅。

fellow.example: He is a friendly fellow who always helps his classmates after school.
fellow.exampleZh: 他是个友善的家伙，放学后总是帮助同学。

fellowship.example: She won a fellowship to study abroad for one year.
fellowship.exampleZh: 她获得了一笔奖学金，可以出国学习一年。

felon.example: The felon was sent to prison for ten years.
felon.exampleZh: 这名重罪犯被判处十年监禁。

female.example: The female doctor talked with my mother for a long time.
female.exampleZh: 那位女医生和我母亲谈了很长时间。

feminine.example: Her soft voice and gentle smile give her a very feminine manner.
feminine.exampleZh: 她轻柔的声音和温柔的微笑让她有一种非常女性化的气质。

femininity.example: Her kindness and grace show a gentle femininity that everyone admires.
femininity.exampleZh: 她的善良与优雅展现出一种人人都欣赏的温柔女性气质。

feminism.example: Modern feminism works for equal pay and equal rights for women.
feminism.exampleZh: 现代女权主义致力于为女性争取同等的薪酬和同等的权利。

feminist.example: She is a feminist who works hard for equal rights for women.
feminist.exampleZh: 她是一位女权主义者，为女性的平等权利而努力。

fence.example: The farmer built a wooden fence around the field to keep the sheep safe.
fence.exampleZh: 农夫在田地周围建了一道木栅栏，以保护羊群安全。

fend.example: She had to fend for her little brother while their parents worked.
fend.exampleZh: 父母工作时，她得照料弟弟。

ferment.example: The juice will ferment for a week before we drink it.
ferment.exampleZh: 果汁要发酵一周我们才会喝。

ferocious.example: The ferocious dog scared all the children in the small park.
ferocious.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗吓坏了小公园里的所有孩子。

ferocity.example: The ferocity of the storm surprised everyone in the small town.
ferocity.exampleZh: 这场风暴的猛烈程度让小镇上的每个人都感到惊讶。

ferry.example: We took the ferry across the river and it was very cheap.
ferry.exampleZh: 我们乘渡轮过了河，票价很便宜。

fertile.example: The soil near the river is very fertile and good for growing vegetables.
fertile.exampleZh: 河边的土壤非常肥沃，适合种植蔬菜。

fertility.example: The rich soil of the valley gives the farmers good fertility for their crops.
fertility.exampleZh: 山谷里肥沃的土壤为农民的庄稼提供了良好的肥力。

fertilizer.example: The farmer put fertilizer on his corn to help it grow.
fertilizer.exampleZh: 农民给玉米施了肥料，帮助它生长。

fervent.example: She is a fervent supporter of the local animal shelter.
fervent.exampleZh: 她是当地动物收容所的热情支持者。

fervor.example: She spoke with great fervor about her plans to help the poor.
fervor.exampleZh: 她满怀热情地讲述自己帮助穷人的计划。

fester.example: If you ignore a small wound, it can fester and become dangerous.
fester.exampleZh: 如果忽视小伤口，它可能会溃烂并变得危险。

festering.example: The doctor said the festering wound needed to be cleaned every day.
festering.exampleZh: 医生说那个溃烂的伤口需要每天清洗。

festival.example: The whole town comes together to celebrate the music festival every summer.
festival.exampleZh: 每年夏天，全镇的人都会聚在一起庆祝这个音乐节。

festive.example: The whole street looks festive with lights and red flags today.
festive.exampleZh: 今天整条街挂满彩灯和红旗，看起来很有节日气氛。

fetal.example: The doctor checked the fetal heart rate during the regular checkup.
fetal.exampleZh: 医生在常规检查中检查了胎儿的心率。

fetch.example: Please fetch my coat from the bedroom and bring it here.
fetch.exampleZh: 请从卧室把我的外套取来，带到这里。

fetus.example: The doctor said the fetus is growing well and looks healthy.
fetus.exampleZh: 医生说胎儿发育良好，看起来很健康。

feud.example: The two families have had a feud for over fifty years.
feud.exampleZh: 这两个家族之间的世仇已经持续了五十多年。

fever.example: She has a high fever and needs to rest in bed today.
fever.exampleZh: 她发高烧，今天需要卧床休息。

few.example: Few people know how to fix this old computer.
few.exampleZh: 很少有人知道如何修好这台旧电脑。

fiber.example: Fiber in fresh fruit and vegetables is good for your body.
fiber.exampleZh: 新鲜水果和蔬菜中的纤维对你的身体有好处。

fickle.example: The weather here is fickle and can change several times a day.
fickle.exampleZh: 这里的天气变化无常，一天之内可能变好几次。

fiction.example: She likes to read fiction before she goes to sleep at night.
fiction.exampleZh: 她喜欢在晚上睡觉前读小说。

fictitious.example: The story in the newspaper was completely fictitious and had no facts.
fictitious.exampleZh: 报纸上的那个故事完全是虚构的，没有任何事实依据。

fidelity.example: His fidelity to his old friends never changed over the years.
fidelity.exampleZh: 多年来，他对老朋友的忠诚从未改变。

fidget.example: The child began to fidget in his seat while waiting for the movie to start.
fidget.exampleZh: 那个孩子在等电影开场时开始在座位上坐立不安。

field.example: The children are playing football in the field behind our school.
field.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们学校后面的田野里踢足球。

fieldwork.example: Her fieldwork in the mountains helped her understand how wild animals live.
fieldwork.exampleZh: 她在山区的实地考察帮助她了解了野生动物的生活。

fierce.example: The fierce dog ran after the ball across the wide field.
fierce.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗穿过宽阔的田野追赶球。

fiery.example: The fiery sun made everyone sweat during the long walk home.
fiery.exampleZh: 炽热的太阳让每个人在漫长的回家路上都汗流浃背。

fifteen.example: My little sister is fifteen years old and she loves to draw.
fifteen.exampleZh: 我的妹妹十五岁，她喜欢画画。

fifteenth.example: Her birthday is on the fifteenth day of May.
fifteenth.exampleZh: 她的生日在五月十五日。

fifth.example: Our team finished fifth in the school running race last week.
fifth.exampleZh: 我们队在上周的学校跑步比赛中获得了第五名。

fifty.example: My grandmother lives in a small house with fifty red roses in her garden.
fifty.exampleZh: 我的祖母住在一座小房子里，她的花园里种着五十朵红玫瑰。

fight.example: The two brothers often fight about small things, but they still love each other.
fight.exampleZh: 两兄弟常常为小事争吵，但他们仍然彼此相爱。

figure.example: The figure in the report shows sales grew last year.
figure.exampleZh: 报告中的数字显示去年销售额增长了。

file.example: Please file these papers in the cabinet after you read them.
file.exampleZh: 请你看完这些文件后把它们归入柜子里。

fill.example: Please fill this glass with cold water for me.
fill.exampleZh: 请帮我把这个杯子装满冷水。

film.example: We watched a funny film about a small dog last night.
film.exampleZh: 昨晚我们看了一部关于一只小狗的搞笑电影。

filter.example: You can use a filter to clean the water before you drink it.
filter.exampleZh: 你可以用过滤器把水净化后再喝。

final.example: This is my final answer, and I will not change it.
final.exampleZh: 这是我的最终答案，我不会改变它。

finality.example: She spoke with finality, and no one in the room argued.
finality.exampleZh: 她以断然的语气说话，房间里没有人再争辩。

finalize.example: We need to finalize the plan before Friday.
finalize.exampleZh: 我们需要在周五之前完成这个计划。

finally.example: After many long hours of practice, she finally passed the driving test.
finally.exampleZh: 经过许多个小时的练习，她终于通过了驾照考试。

finance.example: The company needs more finance to open a new store this year.
finance.exampleZh: 公司今年需要更多资金来开一家新店。

financial.example: She works in a financial company and handles money for large banks.
financial.exampleZh: 她在一家金融公司工作，为大型银行处理资金。

financier.example: The financier made a lot of money by investing in new companies.
financier.exampleZh: 这位金融家通过投资新公司赚了很多钱。

find.example: She cannot find her keys, so she asks her brother for help.
find.exampleZh: 她找不到钥匙，于是向弟弟求助。

finding.example: The new finding may help doctors treat this common disease.
finding.exampleZh: 这一新发现可能有助于医生治疗这种常见疾病。

fine.example: The fine is small, and the weather is fine today.
fine.exampleZh: 罚款金额很小，而且今天天气很好。

fineness.example: The fineness of the silk makes this dress feel soft and light.
fineness.exampleZh: 这种丝绸的纤细使这条连衣裙摸起来柔软又轻盈。

finger.example: She cut her finger while chopping vegetables in the kitchen.
finger.exampleZh: 她在厨房切菜时切到了手指。

fingerprint.example: The police found a fingerprint on the glass door.
fingerprint.exampleZh: 警方在玻璃门上发现了一枚指纹。

finicky.example: My finicky cat refuses to eat any food that is not fresh.
finicky.exampleZh: 我那挑剔的猫拒绝吃任何不新鲜的食物。

finish.example: I will finish my work before six and then go home.
finish.exampleZh: 我会在六点前完成工作，然后回家。

finite.example: Our planet has finite resources, so we must use them wisely.
finite.exampleZh: 我们的星球资源是有限的，所以我们必须明智地使用它们。

fire.example: The old man made a small fire to keep warm last night.
fire.exampleZh: 老人昨晚生了一小堆火来取暖。

firestorm.example: The new law caused a firestorm of angry debate across the country.
firestorm.exampleZh: 这项新法律在全国引发了激烈的愤怒争论。

firewood.example: We collected dry firewood in the forest to make a fire for cooking.
firewood.exampleZh: 我们在森林里收集干柴火来生火做饭。

firm.example: This firm makes good shoes, and its workers are firm about quality.
firm.exampleZh: 这家公司生产好鞋，员工对质量要求很坚定。

firmament.example: The stars filled the dark firmament above the quiet village.
firmament.exampleZh: 星星布满了宁静村庄上方黑暗的苍穹。

firmware.example: You may need to update the firmware before the new printer will work.
firmware.exampleZh: 在新打印机正常工作之前，你可能需要更新固件。

first.example: This is my first day at the new school.
first.exampleZh: 这是我在新学校的第一天。

fiscal.example: The government announced a new fiscal plan to help small businesses this year.
fiscal.exampleZh: 政府宣布了一项新的财政计划，以在今年帮助小企业。

fish.example: We caught a big fish in the river yesterday and cooked it for dinner.
fish.exampleZh: 我们昨天在河里抓到一条大鱼，晚餐把它煮了。

fishery.example: The small town depends on its fishery for jobs and food.
fishery.exampleZh: 这个小镇依靠它的渔业提供就业和食物。

fission.example: The scientist explained how fission releases energy inside a nuclear power plant.
fission.exampleZh: 科学家解释了裂变如何在核电站内部释放能量。

fissure.example: A thin fissure ran down the wall after the earthquake.
fissure.exampleZh: 地震后墙上出现了一道细长的裂缝。

fit.example: These shoes fit me well, and the color is right for the party.
fit.exampleZh: 这双鞋很合我的脚，颜色也适合参加聚会。

fitful.example: His fitful sleep was broken by the noise outside.
fitful.exampleZh: 他断断续续的睡眠被外面的噪音打断了。

fitness.example: Good fitness helps you enjoy sports and daily life.
fitness.exampleZh: 良好的健康状态能让你享受运动和日常生活。

five.example: My sister has five new books on her desk.
five.exampleZh: 我妹妹的书桌上有五本新书。

fix.example: I can fix the broken chair, but I need a screwdriver first.
fix.exampleZh: 我能修好这把坏椅子，但我首先需要一把螺丝刀。

fixation.example: His fixation on the past keeps him from enjoying the present.
fixation.exampleZh: 他对过去的固着使他无法享受当下。

fixture.example: The old lamp is a fixture in our living room.
fixture.exampleZh: 那盏旧灯是我们客厅里的固定装置。

flag.example: The flag on the old building is fading in the sun.
flag.exampleZh: 旧楼上的旗帜在阳光下渐渐褪色。

flagrant.example: The judge called the company's flagrant cheating a serious crime against the public.
flagrant.exampleZh: 法官称该公司公然作弊是严重侵害公众的犯罪行为。

flair.example: She has a real flair for making simple food taste great.
flair.exampleZh: 她有一种真正的天赋，能把简单的食物做得非常美味。

flake.example: A flake of snow landed on her hand and quickly melted.
flake.exampleZh: 一片雪花落在她的手上，很快就融化了。

flamboyance.example: His flamboyance made him stand out at every party he went to.
flamboyance.exampleZh: 他的浮夸使他在参加的每一个聚会上都很引人注目。

flamboyant.example: Her flamboyant red dress made her the center of attention at the party.
flamboyant.exampleZh: 她那件艳丽的红裙子让她成了聚会的焦点。

flame.example: The flame of the small fire gave us light and warmth all night.
flame.exampleZh: 那堆小火燃起的火焰整夜给我们光和温暖。

flank.example: The old church stands on the left flank of the hill.
flank.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂坐落在小山的左侧。

flap.example: The bird began to flap its wings and then flew away.
flap.exampleZh: 那只鸟开始拍打翅膀，然后飞走了。

flare.example: The red signal flare lit up the sky and everyone saw it clearly.
flare.exampleZh: 红色信号弹照亮了天空，每个人都看得清清楚楚。

flash.example: A bright flash of lightning lit up the sky for a second.
flash.exampleZh: 一道明亮的闪电照亮了天空一秒钟。

flashback.example: The movie uses a flashback to show the hero as a young boy.
flashback.exampleZh: 这部电影用一段闪回展现男主角小时候的样子。

flashy.example: He bought a flashy car to show off his new money.
flashy.exampleZh: 他买了一辆浮华的汽车来炫耀他的新财富。

flask.example: She poured the blue liquid into a small flask and waited.
flask.exampleZh: 她把蓝色液体倒进一个小烧瓶里，然后等待着。

flat.example: The land near the river is flat and good for farming.
flat.exampleZh: 河边的土地很平坦，适合耕种。

flatter.example: He tried to flatter his boss to get a better job.
flatter.exampleZh: 他试图奉承老板，以获得一份更好的工作。

flattery.example: She did not believe his flattery because she knew he wanted something.
flattery.exampleZh: 她不相信他的奉承，因为她知道他有所图。

flaunt.example: She likes to flaunt her new phone in front of her friends.
flaunt.exampleZh: 她喜欢在朋友面前炫耀自己的新手机。

flavor.example: This soup has a rich flavor, so please add some salt.
flavor.exampleZh: 这汤味道很浓，请再加点盐。

flaw.example: The only flaw in this old table is a small crack on top.
flaw.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子唯一的瑕疵是顶部有一道小裂纹。

flawed.example: The plan was flawed, so we had to start again.
flawed.exampleZh: 这个计划有缺陷，所以我们不得不重新开始。

fleck.example: A few flecks of dust settled on the old wooden table.
fleck.exampleZh: 一些灰尘的小斑点落在了旧木桌上。

fledgling.example: The fledgling writer asked many questions at her first meeting.
fledgling.exampleZh: 这位新手作家在第一次会议上问了很多问题。

flee.example: The thief tried to flee when he saw the police car.
flee.exampleZh: 小偷看到警车时试图逃跑。

fleet.example: The fishing fleet returned to the harbor before the storm arrived.
fleet.exampleZh: 渔船队在暴风雨来临前返回了港口。

fleeting.example: The beauty of the sunset was fleeting, so we took a photo quickly.
fleeting.exampleZh: 日落的美景很短暂，所以我们赶紧拍了一张照片。

flesh.example: The flesh of this fruit is sweet and soft.
flesh.exampleZh: 这种水果的果肉又甜又软。

flexibility.example: Regular exercise can improve the flexibility of your body and mind.
flexibility.exampleZh: 经常锻炼可以改善你身体和心灵的灵活性。

flexible.example: This flexible schedule lets me spend more time with my family.
flexible.exampleZh: 这个灵活的时间安排让我能有更多时间陪伴家人。

flicker.example: The candle flame began to flicker when the wind blew through the window.
flicker.exampleZh: 风从窗户吹进来时，烛火开始摇曳。

flight.example: Our flight to Beijing leaves early tomorrow morning.
flight.exampleZh: 我们飞往北京的航班明天一早出发。

flimsy.example: This flimsy box cannot hold all these heavy books.
flimsy.exampleZh: 这个轻薄的箱子装不下所有这些沉重的书。

flinch.example: She did not flinch when the dog ran toward her.
flinch.exampleZh: 当那只狗朝她跑来时，她没有退缩。

fling.example: He decided to fling the old ball across the wide river.
fling.exampleZh: 他决定把那个旧球猛扔过宽阔的河。

flint.example: He struck the flint to make a small fire.
flint.exampleZh: 他敲击燧石生起了一小堆火。

flippant.example: His flippant answer made the teacher angry.
flippant.exampleZh: 他轻率的回答让老师生气了。

flirt.example: He likes to flirt with the girls in his class.
flirt.exampleZh: 他喜欢和班上的女孩调情。

flit.example: Bees flit from flower to flower in the warm spring sun.
flit.exampleZh: 蜜蜂在温暖的春日阳光下从一朵花轻快地飞到另一朵花上。

float.example: The empty bottle will float on the water until someone picks it up.
float.exampleZh: 那个空瓶子会一直漂浮在水面上，直到有人把它捡起来。

flock.example: A large flock of birds flew over the quiet lake this morning.
flock.exampleZh: 今天早上，一大群鸟飞过了安静的湖面。

floe.example: A large floe drifted slowly past the ship in the cold water.
floe.exampleZh: 一大块浮冰在冰冷的水中缓缓漂过船旁。

flood.example: Heavy rain caused a flood that covered the whole village.
flood.exampleZh: 大雨引发了一场洪水，淹没了整个村庄。

floor.example: The children sat on the floor and played with their toys.
floor.exampleZh: 孩子们坐在地板上玩玩具。

flora.example: The flora of this island is very rich and full of rare plants.
flora.exampleZh: 这个岛屿的植物区系非常丰富，长满了稀有植物。

floral.example: The garden was full of floral scents in early spring.
floral.exampleZh: 初春时节，花园里充满了花的芬芳。

florid.example: The old man had a florid face and a warm smile.
florid.exampleZh: 那位老人脸色红润，笑容温暖。

flounder.example: He began to flounder in the deep water and called for help.
flounder.exampleZh: 他开始在深水中挣扎，大声呼救。

flour.example: She needs some flour to make bread for her family.
flour.exampleZh: 她需要一些面粉来为家人做面包。

flourish.example: With enough sunlight and water, these small plants will flourish in the garden.
flourish.exampleZh: 只要有充足的阳光和水，这些小植物就会在花园里茁壮成长。

flout.example: The young driver chose to flout the traffic rules and drove too fast.
flout.exampleZh: 那个年轻司机选择无视交通规则，把车开得太快了。

flow.example: The river flows slowly through our small town and the water is very clear.
flow.exampleZh: 这条河缓缓流经我们的小镇，河水非常清澈。

flower.example: The girl picked a red flower in the garden and gave it to her mother.
flower.exampleZh: 女孩在花园里摘了一朵红花，把它送给了她的妈妈。

fluctuate.example: Prices often fluctuate during the busy holiday season.
fluctuate.exampleZh: 在繁忙的假期期间，价格经常会波动。

fluctuation.example: The small fluctuations in temperature do not affect the plants much.
fluctuation.exampleZh: 温度的这些小波动对植物影响不大。

fluency.example: Her fluency in English helps her feel confident at work.
fluency.exampleZh: 她流利的英语让她在工作中感到自信。

fluent.example: She is fluent in three languages and speaks them every day.
fluent.exampleZh: 她能流利地说三种语言，而且每天都用它们交流。

fluff.example: The cat left small bits of fluff on my black coat.
fluff.exampleZh: 猫在我的黑色外套上留下了一点点绒毛。

fluid.example: The doctor told him to drink more fluids and rest in bed.
fluid.exampleZh: 医生让他多喝流质食物并卧床休息。

fluidity.example: The fluidity of the dance surprised everyone in the room.
fluidity.exampleZh: 这段舞蹈的流畅性让房间里的每个人都感到惊讶。

fluke.example: Winning the game was a fluke because our best player was absent.
fluke.exampleZh: 我们赢了那场比赛纯属侥幸，因为我们最好的球员缺席了。

flummox.example: The sudden question flummoxed me and I could not answer.
flummox.exampleZh: 这个突然的问题使我困惑，我答不上来。

flunk.example: If you do not study, you will flunk the final exam.
flunk.exampleZh: 如果你不学习，你期末考试就会不及格。

fluorescent.example: The bright fluorescent light above my desk makes the room feel cold at night.
fluorescent.exampleZh: 我书桌上方明亮的荧光灯让房间在夜里显得很冷。

flurry.example: A flurry of snow covered the road in a few minutes.
flurry.exampleZh: 一阵小雪几分钟内就覆盖了道路。

flush.example: Her cheeks began to flush after she ran up the stairs.
flush.exampleZh: 她跑上楼梯后，脸颊开始泛红。

fluster.example: The sudden question flustered her, and she forgot her words.
fluster.exampleZh: 这个突然的问题让她慌了神，她忘了自己要说什么。

flutter.example: The white dove will flutter its wings before it flies away.
flutter.exampleZh: 白鸽在飞走之前会拍打翅膀。

flux.example: The flux of visitors to the website is highest on weekends.
flux.exampleZh: 网站访客的流量在周末最高。

fly.example: Birds fly south in winter, and a fly got into the kitchen.
fly.exampleZh: 鸟儿在冬天飞往南方，还有一只苍蝇飞进了厨房。

foal.example: The little foal stayed close to its mother all day in the field.
foal.exampleZh: 那只小马驹整天都紧跟着妈妈待在田野里。

foam.example: A thick layer of foam covered the top of the cold beer.
foam.exampleZh: 一层厚厚的泡沫覆盖在冰啤酒的表面。

focal.example: The focal point of the photo is the old tree.
focal.exampleZh: 这张照片的焦点是那棵老树。

focus.example: Please focus on your homework and finish it before dinner.
focus.exampleZh: 请集中精力做作业，在晚饭前完成。

fodder.example: The old news stories became fodder for his new book.
fodder.exampleZh: 那些旧新闻故事成了他新书的素材。

foe.example: He treated every new idea as a foe instead of a friend.
foe.exampleZh: 他把每一个新想法都当作敌人而不是朋友。

fog.example: The heavy fog made it hard to see the road ahead.
fog.exampleZh: 浓雾使人很难看清前方的路。

foible.example: Everyone has a foible, and his is always arriving late.
foible.exampleZh: 每个人都有小缺点，他的缺点就是总是迟到。

foil.example: The thief used a thin sheet of foil to block the alarm.
foil.exampleZh: 小偷用一片薄薄的金属箔挡住了警报器。

foist.example: She tried to foist her old books on me again.
foist.exampleZh: 她又想把她的旧书强加给我。

fold.example: She will fold the clean clothes and put them in the drawer.
fold.exampleZh: 她会把干净的衣服叠好，放进抽屉里。

folder.example: I saved all my photos in a folder on the computer.
folder.exampleZh: 我把所有的照片都保存在电脑上的一个文件夹里。

foliage.example: The green foliage of the trees looks beautiful in the warm spring sun.
foliage.exampleZh: 在温暖的春日阳光下，树上绿色的叶子看起来很美。

folio.example: The old library keeps a rare folio of Shakespeare's plays.
folio.exampleZh: 这座古老的图书馆收藏着一册莎士比亚戏剧的珍稀对开本。

folk.example: My grandmother likes to sing old folk songs from her hometown.
folk.exampleZh: 我奶奶喜欢唱家乡的老民歌。

folklore.example: My grandmother told me old folklore about the river near her village.
folklore.exampleZh: 我奶奶给我讲了关于她村子附近那条河的老民间传说。

follow.example: Please follow me and I will show you the way to the station.
follow.exampleZh: 请跟我走，我会指给你去车站的路。

follow-up.example: The doctor will do a follow-up next week to check my health.
follow-up.exampleZh: 医生下周会做一次随访来检查我的健康状况。

following.example: Please read the following words and write them in your notebook.
following.exampleZh: 请读下列单词，并把它们写在笔记本上。

folly.example: It was folly to spend all his money on such an old car.
folly.exampleZh: 把所有的钱都花在这样一辆旧车上真是太愚蠢了。

foment.example: Bad leaders often foment anger among young people to gain more power.
foment.exampleZh: 糟糕的领导人常常在年轻人中煽动愤怒以获取更多权力。

food.example: We need to buy enough food and water for the long trip.
food.exampleZh: 我们需要为这次长途旅行买足够的食物和水。

fool.example: It is not kind to fool a child with a false promise.
fool.exampleZh: 用虚假的承诺欺骗孩子是不友善的。

foolhardy.example: It was foolhardy to climb that steep rock alone.
foolhardy.exampleZh: 独自攀爬那块陡峭的岩石太鲁莽了。

foot.example: My left foot hurts after the long walk home.
foot.exampleZh: 走了很长的路回家后，我的左脚疼。

footnote.example: The footnote at the bottom of the page explains the difficult word.
footnote.exampleZh: 页面底部的脚注解释了这个难懂的单词。

footprint.example: The dog left muddy footprints all over the clean kitchen floor.
footprint.exampleZh: 那只狗在干净的厨房地板上到处留下了泥脚印。

footstep.example: I heard his footsteps on the stairs and ran to open the door.
footstep.exampleZh: 我听到楼梯上他的脚步声，就跑过去开门。

for.example: I bought a gift for my mother because she loves flowers.
for.exampleZh: 我给妈妈买了一份礼物，因为她喜欢花。

forage.example: The birds forage for food in the snow every morning.
forage.exampleZh: 这些鸟每天早上在雪地里觅食。

foray.example: His first foray into business was small but taught him a lot.
foray.exampleZh: 他第一次涉足商界规模不大，却让他学到了很多。

forbear.example: She could not forbear a smile when she saw the puppy.
forbear.exampleZh: 看到那只小狗时，她忍不住笑了。

forbearance.example: He showed great forbearance when his noisy neighbors kept him awake all night.
forbearance.exampleZh: 当吵闹的邻居让他整夜无法入睡时，他表现出了极大的忍耐。

forbid.example: My parents forbid me to swim in that river alone.
forbid.exampleZh: 我父母不许我一个人在那条河里游泳。

forbidding.example: The old house looked dark and forbidding in the heavy rain.
forbidding.exampleZh: 那座老房子在大雨中显得阴暗而令人生畏。

force.example: The police used force to stop the angry crowd.
force.exampleZh: 警察使用武力阻止了愤怒的人群。

forceful.example: She gave a forceful speech that made everyone agree with her.
forceful.exampleZh: 她做了一场有说服力的演讲，让每个人都同意她的看法。

forcible.example: The police used forcible action to stop the crowd from entering.
forcible.exampleZh: 警察采取强制行动，阻止人群进入。

foreboding.example: She felt a deep foreboding before the old door opened.
foreboding.exampleZh: 在那扇旧门打开之前，她感到一阵深深的不祥预感。

forecast.example: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
forecast.exampleZh: 天气预报说明天会下雨。

foreclose.example: The bank may foreclose on the house if we miss too many payments.
foreclose.exampleZh: 如果我们拖欠太多次还款，银行可能会取消这栋房子的抵押品赎回权。

foreclosure.example: The bank started foreclosure after the family stopped paying the loan.
foreclosure.exampleZh: 这家人停止还贷后，银行启动了取消抵押品赎回权的程序。

foreground.example: The bright flowers in the foreground make this photo look lively.
foreground.exampleZh: 前景中鲜艳的花朵让这张照片看起来很生动。

forehead.example: She put her hand on his forehead to see if he had a fever.
forehead.exampleZh: 她把手放在他的额头上，看看他是否发烧了。

foreign.example: She likes to learn foreign languages and often listens to songs from other countries.
foreign.exampleZh: 她喜欢学习外语，还经常听其他国家的歌曲。

foreigner.example: The foreigner asked me for directions to the train station.
foreigner.exampleZh: 这位外国人向我询问去火车站的路。

foremost.example: She is one of the foremost experts on climate change in the world.
foremost.exampleZh: 她是世界上最重要的气候变化专家之一。

forensic.example: The police asked a forensic doctor to examine the room carefully.
forensic.exampleZh: 警方请了一位法医仔细检查那个房间。

foresee.example: Nobody can foresee what will happen in the next few years.
foresee.exampleZh: 没人能预见未来几年会发生什么。

foreshadow.example: The dark clouds foreshadow a heavy storm this afternoon.
foreshadow.exampleZh: 这些乌云预示着今天下午会有一场大暴雨。

foresight.example: Good leaders use foresight to prepare for problems before they happen.
foresight.exampleZh: 优秀的领导者运用远见，在问题发生之前就做好准备。

forest.example: Many wild animals live in this large forest near our town.
forest.exampleZh: 许多野生动物生活在我们镇附近的这片大森林里。

forestall.example: The company lowered its prices to forestall a new competitor.
forestall.exampleZh: 这家公司降低价格，以抢先阻止新竞争者的出现。

forestry.example: My uncle works in forestry and takes care of the trees.
forestry.exampleZh: 我叔叔从事林业工作，负责照料树木。

foretell.example: No one can foretell what will happen in the coming years.
foretell.exampleZh: 没有人能预言未来几年会发生什么。

forethought.example: With a little forethought, she packed everything she needed for the trip.
forethought.exampleZh: 稍加事先考虑，她就带齐了旅行所需的一切。

forever.example: I will keep this old photo forever because it reminds me of home.
forever.exampleZh: 我会永远保存这张旧照片，因为它让我想起家。

forfeit.example: He had to forfeit the game because he arrived too late.
forfeit.exampleZh: 他因为到得太晚，不得不放弃这场比赛。

forge.example: The old blacksmith will forge a strong knife in his shop.
forge.exampleZh: 老铁匠会在他的铺子里锻造一把坚固的刀。

forgery.example: The police found that the painting was a clever forgery.
forgery.exampleZh: 警方发现这幅画是一件巧妙的伪造品。

forget.example: I always forget my umbrella when the weather is sunny.
forget.exampleZh: 天气晴朗时，我总是忘记带伞。

forgetful.example: My forgetful grandfather often leaves his keys on the kitchen table.
forgetful.exampleZh: 我健忘的祖父经常把钥匙落在厨房桌子上。

forgive.example: I hope you can forgive me for being late again.
forgive.exampleZh: 我希望你能原谅我又迟到了。

forgiveness.example: She asked for forgiveness after saying those unkind words to her friend.
forgiveness.exampleZh: 她对朋友说了那些刻薄的话之后请求原谅。

forgo.example: She decided to forgo dessert and save room for a cup of tea.
forgo.exampleZh: 她决定不吃甜点，留点肚子喝杯茶。

fork.example: Please put a fork and a knife beside my plate.
fork.exampleZh: 请把一把叉子和一把刀放在我的盘子旁边。

forlorn.example: The forlorn little dog waited by the gate for its owner.
forlorn.exampleZh: 那只孤独的小狗在门口等着它的主人。

form.example: Please fill in this form and give it back to me.
form.exampleZh: 请填写这张表格，然后交还给我。

formal.example: We need to wear formal clothes to the meeting tomorrow.
formal.exampleZh: 我们明天开会需要穿正式的衣服。

formality.example: She treated the meeting as a simple formality and spoke very casually.
formality.exampleZh: 她把这会议当作简单的例行公事，说话很随意。

format.example: Please check the format of your file before you send it.
format.exampleZh: 发送文件之前，请检查一下文件的格式。

formation.example: The formation of ice on the lake takes only a few cold nights.
formation.exampleZh: 湖面结冰的形成只需要几个寒冷的夜晚。

former.example: The former teacher now works at a small library near her home.
former.exampleZh: 这位以前的老师现在在她家附近的一家小图书馆工作。

formidable.example: The old castle has formidable walls that keep everyone safe.
formidable.exampleZh: 这座古老的城堡有令人敬畏的城墙，保护着每个人的安全。

formula.example: The scientist wrote a simple formula on the board for his students.
formula.exampleZh: 科学家在黑板上给学生们写了一个简单的公式。

formulate.example: The team will formulate a simple plan for the new project.
formulate.exampleZh: 团队将为新项目制定一个简单的计划。

formulation.example: The formulation of this new policy took several months of careful discussion.
formulation.exampleZh: 这项新政策的构想经过了好几个月的仔细讨论。

forsake.example: He would never forsake his old friends when they need his help.
forsake.exampleZh: 当老朋友需要他帮助时，他绝不会抛弃他们。

forte.example: Her real forte is explaining difficult ideas in a simple way.
forte.exampleZh: 她真正的长处是能把难懂的想法讲得很简单。

forth.example: She stepped forth from the crowd and asked a simple question.
forth.exampleZh: 她从人群中向前走出，问了一个简单的问题。

forthcoming.example: The forthcoming meeting will help us plan the new project.
forthcoming.exampleZh: 即将到来的会议将帮助我们规划新项目。

forthright.example: She gave a forthright answer and did not hide her real opinion.
forthright.exampleZh: 她给出了直率的回答，没有隐藏自己的真实看法。

fortification.example: The old fortification on the hill still stands today.
fortification.exampleZh: 山上的古老防御工事至今仍然矗立。

fortify.example: We drink milk and eat vegetables to fortify our bodies.
fortify.exampleZh: 我们喝牛奶、吃蔬菜来增强体质。

fortitude.example: She faced her long illness with quiet fortitude every single day.
fortitude.exampleZh: 她每天都以平静的坚韧面对漫长的病痛。

fortnight.example: We will stay at the beach for a fortnight this summer.
fortnight.exampleZh: 今年夏天我们会在海滩上待两个星期。

fortuitous.example: Our meeting at the small cafe was completely fortuitous and led to a good friendship.
fortuitous.exampleZh: 我们在一家小咖啡馆的相遇完全是偶然的，并且促成了一段美好的友谊。

fortunate.example: I feel fortunate to have such kind friends around me.
fortunate.exampleZh: 能拥有这么友善的朋友在身边，我感到很幸运。

fortune.example: Her family lost their fortune in the war but never lost hope.
fortune.exampleZh: 她的家族在战争中失去了财富，但从未失去希望。

forty.example: My grandmother has lived in this small town for forty years.
forty.exampleZh: 我的祖母在这个小镇上住了四十年。

forum.example: Many students share their ideas on the school forum every day.
forum.exampleZh: 许多学生每天都在学校论坛上分享他们的想法。

forward.example: She took a step forward and smiled at the teacher.
forward.exampleZh: 她向前迈了一步，对老师笑了笑。

fossil.example: The scientist found an old fish fossil in the rock.
fossil.exampleZh: 科学家在岩石里发现了一块古老的鱼化石。

fossilize.example: Old ideas can fossilize in a mind that never questions them.
fossilize.exampleZh: 在从不质疑的头脑里，旧观念会僵化。

foster.example: Good teachers foster a love of learning in their students.
foster.exampleZh: 好老师会培养学生的求知热情。

foul.example: The foul smell from the old trash can made everyone leave the room.
foul.exampleZh: 旧垃圾桶散发的恶臭让每个人都离开了房间。

found.example: The workers will found a new factory near the river next year.
found.exampleZh: 工人们明年将在河边建立一座新工厂。

foundation.example: A strong education gives children a good foundation for the future.
foundation.exampleZh: 良好的教育为孩子们的未来打下坚实的基础。

foundational.example: Reading and math are foundational skills that every child needs at school.
foundational.exampleZh: 阅读和数学是每个孩子在学校都需要的基础技能。

founder.example: The founder of the small company still works there every day.
founder.exampleZh: 这家小公司的创始人现在仍然每天在那里工作。

fountain.example: The children played happily near the fountain in the park.
fountain.exampleZh: 孩子们在公园的喷泉旁开心地玩耍。

four.example: Our team has four new members this year.
four.exampleZh: 我们团队今年有四位新成员。

fourth.example: She finished fourth in the race and won a small prize.
fourth.exampleZh: 她在比赛中获得第四名，赢得了一个小奖品。

fraction.example: Only a small fraction of the students came to class today.
fraction.exampleZh: 今天只有一小部分学生来上课。

fracture.example: The doctor said the small bone in his wrist had a minor fracture.
fracture.exampleZh: 医生说他手腕上的一块小骨头有轻微的骨折。

fragile.example: This old glass is very fragile, so please hold it with care.
fragile.exampleZh: 这个旧玻璃杯很易碎，所以请小心拿它。

fragility.example: The fragility of the old glass made everyone handle it with great care.
fragility.exampleZh: 这块旧玻璃很易碎，所以每个人都格外小心地拿它。

fragment.example: The glass fell and broke into small fragments on the floor.
fragment.exampleZh: 玻璃杯掉下来，在地板上摔成了小碎片。

fragmentary.example: The old letter was fragmentary, so we could not understand the whole story.
fragmentary.exampleZh: 这封旧信残缺不全，所以我们无法理解整个故事。

fragrance.example: The light fragrance of fresh flowers filled the whole room this morning.
fragrance.exampleZh: 今天早上，鲜花的淡淡芳香充满了整个房间。

fragrant.example: The garden is full of fragrant flowers in spring.
fragrant.exampleZh: 春天，花园里开满了芬芳的花朵。

frail.example: The frail old man needs help walking up the stairs.
frail.exampleZh: 这位虚弱的老人需要人搀扶才能上楼梯。

frame.example: The frame of the old house is made of strong wood.
frame.exampleZh: 这座老房子的框架是用结实的木头做的。

framework.example: This framework helps us understand how the whole system works.
framework.exampleZh: 这个框架帮助我们理解整个系统是如何运作的。

franchise.example: He bought a small restaurant franchise and now runs his own business.
franchise.exampleZh: 他买下了一家小餐馆的特许经营权，现在经营着自己的生意。

frank.example: To be frank, I do not like your new plan.
frank.exampleZh: 坦白说，我不喜欢你的新计划。

frantic.example: The frantic mother ran through the crowd looking for her lost child.
frantic.exampleZh: 那位焦急的母亲在人群中奔跑，寻找她走失的孩子。

fraternity.example: He joined a fraternity when he started college last year.
fraternity.exampleZh: 他去年上大学时加入了一个兄弟会。

fraud.example: He was arrested for fraud after taking money from old people.
fraud.exampleZh: 他因骗取老年人的钱财而被以诈骗罪逮捕。

fraudulent.example: The company fired him because he used fraudulent documents to get the job.
fraudulent.exampleZh: 公司解雇了他，因为他用伪造的文件获得了这份工作。

fraught.example: The meeting was fraught with tension from the very start.
fraught.exampleZh: 会议从一开始就充满了紧张气氛。

fray.example: The old rope began to fray after years of hard use.
fray.exampleZh: 这根旧绳子在多年重度使用后开始磨损。

freak.example: The little boy called the strange old man a freak.
freak.exampleZh: 那个小男孩把那个奇怪的老人叫作怪物。

freckle.example: She has a small freckle on her nose.
freckle.exampleZh: 她的鼻子上有一个小雀斑。

free.example: The museum is free for students, so we can visit it today.
free.exampleZh: 博物馆对学生免费，所以我们今天可以去参观。

freedom.example: She moved to a new city and finally felt real freedom.
freedom.exampleZh: 她搬到了一座新城市，终于感受到了真正的自由。

freelance.example: She left her office job and became a freelance writer last year.
freelance.exampleZh: 她去年辞去了办公室工作，成为一名自由撰稿人。

freeman.example: The freeman voted in the town election every year.
freeman.exampleZh: 这位自由民每年都参加镇上的选举投票。

freestyle.example: She won the race with a fast freestyle swim.
freestyle.exampleZh: 她以快速的自由泳赢得了比赛。

freeway.example: We drove on the freeway for two hours to visit my grandparents.
freeway.exampleZh: 我们在高速公路上开了两个小时的车去看望我的祖父母。

freeze.example: The water in the small pond will freeze when the weather gets very cold.
freeze.exampleZh: 天气变得很冷时，小池塘里的水会结冰。

freight.example: The freight was loaded onto the train early this morning.
freight.exampleZh: 货物今天一早被装上了火车。

freighter.example: The freighter carried a large load of grain across the sea.
freighter.exampleZh: 这艘货船载着大量谷物横渡大海。

frenzy.example: The whole city was in a frenzy after the team won the final game.
frenzy.exampleZh: 球队赢得决赛后，整座城市陷入了狂热。

frequency.example: The frequency of buses on this route is very high.
frequency.exampleZh: 这条线路的公交车班次频率很高。

frequent.example: Traffic jams are frequent on this road during rush hour.
frequent.exampleZh: 高峰时段这条路经常堵车。

fresco.example: The old church walls are covered with a beautiful fresco from the twelfth century.
fresco.exampleZh: 那座古老教堂的墙壁上覆盖着一幅十二世纪的美丽壁画。

fresh.example: She bought some fresh vegetables from the small shop near her home.
fresh.exampleZh: 她从家附近的小店买了一些新鲜蔬菜。

freshman.example: As a freshman, she joined the school tennis team last week.
freshman.exampleZh: 作为大一新生，她上周加入了学校网球队。

fret.example: Do not fret about the small mistakes you made today.
fret.exampleZh: 不要为你今天犯的小错误而烦恼。

fretful.example: The tired baby became fretful when she could not find her favorite toy.
fretful.exampleZh: 疲惫的宝宝找不到她最喜欢的玩具时变得烦躁起来。

friction.example: There was some friction between the two teams at first, but they soon became friends.
friction.exampleZh: 起初两个团队之间有些摩擦，但他们很快就成了朋友。

friend.example: My best friend lives in the same building and we walk to school together.
friend.exampleZh: 我最好的朋友住在同一栋楼里，我们一起走路上学。

friendly.example: Our new neighbors are very friendly and often help us.
friendly.exampleZh: 我们的新邻居非常友好，经常帮助我们。

friendship.example: True friendship is built on trust and honest words.
friendship.exampleZh: 真正的友谊建立在信任和诚实的话语之上。

fright.example: The loud noise gave the little boy a real fright.
fright.exampleZh: 那声巨响把小男孩吓了一大跳。

frigid.example: Her frigid voice made everyone in the room feel nervous.
frigid.exampleZh: 她冷淡的声音让房间里的每个人都感到紧张。

fringe.example: Her bright scarf has a long fringe at both ends.
fringe.exampleZh: 她的亮色围巾两端都有长流苏。

fritter.example: He tends to fritter away his money on small things he never uses.
fritter.exampleZh: 他总把花在那些自己从不使用的小东西上，把钱浪费掉。

frivolity.example: Her constant frivolity at work made the serious meeting feel like a joke.
frivolity.exampleZh: 她在工作中一贯的轻浮举动让这场严肃的会议变得像个玩笑。

frivolous.example: Her frivolous comments at the meeting made everyone feel a little uncomfortable.
frivolous.exampleZh: 她在会上那些轻浮的言论让大家都有点不舒服。

frolic.example: The children frolic in the garden all afternoon.
frolic.exampleZh: 孩子们整个下午都在花园里嬉戏。

from.example: She walked home from school with her best friend every day.
from.exampleZh: 她每天和最好的朋友一起从学校走回家。

front.example: The old man sat in front of the house and watched the children play.
front.exampleZh: 老人坐在房子前面，看着孩子们玩耍。

frontal.example: The frontal part of the car was badly damaged in the accident.
frontal.exampleZh: 汽车的前部在事故中严重受损。

frontier.example: Space is often called the final frontier for human exploration.
frontier.exampleZh: 太空常被称为人类探索的最终前沿。

frost.example: There was a heavy frost on the grass this morning.
frost.exampleZh: 今天早上草地上结了一层厚厚的霜。

frostbite.example: His fingers got frostbite after he walked home in the cold snow.
frostbite.exampleZh: 他在寒冷的雪地里走回家后，手指被冻伤了。

frown.example: She gave a small frown when she read the letter.
frown.exampleZh: 她读那封信时微微皱了皱眉。

frozen.example: The lake is frozen and the children can skate on it.
frozen.exampleZh: 湖面结冰了，孩子们可以在上面滑冰。

frugal.example: My grandmother is frugal and never wastes food or money.
frugal.exampleZh: 我的祖母很节俭，从不浪费食物或金钱。

frugality.example: Her frugality helped the family save money for a new house.
frugality.exampleZh: 她的节俭帮助这个家庭攒下钱买了一栋新房子。

fruit.example: Fresh fruit and vegetables are good for your health every day.
fruit.exampleZh: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜每天对你的健康有益。

fruitful.example: Our long talk was fruitful and helped us solve the problem.
fruitful.exampleZh: 我们的长谈富有成效，帮助我们解决了问题。

fruition.example: All his hard work finally came to fruition this year.
fruition.exampleZh: 他所有的努力今年终于取得了成果。

fruitless.example: Their fruitless search for the lost keys lasted all morning.
fruitless.exampleZh: 他们徒劳地找了一上午丢失的钥匙。

frustrate.example: The bad weather frustrated our plan to have a picnic in the park.
frustrate.exampleZh: 糟糕的天气让我们去公园野餐的计划受挫了。

frustrating.example: Waiting for the bus in the rain is really frustrating.
frustrating.exampleZh: 在雨中等待公共汽车真令人沮丧。

frustration.example: He felt a deep sense of frustration when his plan failed again.
frustration.exampleZh: 当他的计划再次失败时，他深感挫败。

fry.example: I like to fry eggs in a little butter for breakfast.
fry.exampleZh: 早餐时我喜欢用一点黄油煎鸡蛋。

fuel.example: This dry wood is good fuel for the fire.
fuel.exampleZh: 这些干木头是生火的好燃料。

fugitive.example: The fugitive ran through the dark woods to escape from the police.
fugitive.exampleZh: 那个逃亡者穿过黑暗的树林奔跑，以躲避警察。

fulfill.example: Hard work can help you fulfill your dream of becoming a teacher.
fulfill.exampleZh: 努力可以帮助你实现成为一名教师的梦想。

fulfillment.example: She found great fulfillment in helping others every day.
fulfillment.exampleZh: 她每天帮助他人，从中获得了极大的满足感。

full.example: The glass is full of cold water, so please drink it slowly.
full.exampleZh: 杯子里装满了凉水，请慢慢喝。

fullness.example: The fullness of her schedule left no time for rest.
fullness.exampleZh: 她日程排得很满，没有时间休息。

fully.example: She was fully aware of the danger but said nothing.
fully.exampleZh: 她完全意识到了危险，却什么也没说。

fulsome.example: His fulsome praise made everyone at the meeting feel uneasy.
fulsome.exampleZh: 他过分的赞美让会上的每个人都感到不自在。

fumble.example: She had to fumble in the dark for her keys.
fumble.exampleZh: 她只能在黑暗中摸索着找钥匙。

fun.example: We had a lot of fun at the party last night.
fun.exampleZh: 昨晚的聚会上我们玩得很开心。

function.example: The main function of this machine is to save time.
function.exampleZh: 这台机器的主要功能是节省时间。

fund.example: The school used the fund to buy new books for the library.
fund.exampleZh: 学校用这笔资金为图书馆购买了新书。

fundamental.example: Trust is fundamental to any good friendship between two people.
fundamental.exampleZh: 信任是两个人之间任何良好友谊的根本。

funeral.example: Many people came to the funeral to say goodbye to their old friend.
funeral.exampleZh: 许多人来参加葬礼，向他们的老朋友告别。

funnel.example: The mechanic poured the oil into the engine through a small funnel.
funnel.exampleZh: 技工通过一个小漏斗把油倒进发动机里。

funny.example: The funny little dog runs after its tail in the park.
funny.exampleZh: 那只滑稽的小狗在公园里追着自己的尾巴跑。

fur.example: The cat has soft white fur and big green eyes.
fur.exampleZh: 这只猫有柔软的白色毛皮和一双绿色的大眼睛。

furbelow.example: The old dress had a bright furbelow along its edge.
furbelow.exampleZh: 那条旧裙子的边上有一道亮丽的裙褶。

furious.example: My father was furious when he found out about the broken window.
furious.exampleZh: 我父亲发现窗户被打破后勃然大怒。

furnace.example: The workers kept the furnace very hot all night long.
furnace.exampleZh: 工人们整夜都让熔炉保持高温。

furnish.example: We can furnish the new office with desks and chairs next week.
furnish.exampleZh: 我们下周可以用桌子和椅子来布置新办公室。

furnishings.example: The new apartment has modern furnishings and a very large kitchen.
