furnishings.exampleZh: 这套新公寓有现代的家具陈设和一间很大的厨房。

further.example: We need more time to further discuss this plan tomorrow.
further.exampleZh: 我们需要更多时间明天进一步讨论这个计划。

furtherance.example: The new rules are meant to support the furtherance of small local businesses.
furtherance.exampleZh: 这些新规定旨在支持本地小企业的发展。

furthermore.example: The room is small and, furthermore, it has no windows.
furthermore.exampleZh: 这个房间很小，而且没有窗户。

furthest.example: This is the furthest point we can reach on foot today.
furthest.exampleZh: 这是我们今天步行能到达的最远的地方。

fury.example: Her fury was so strong that she could not speak at all.
fury.exampleZh: 她的狂怒如此强烈，以至于她完全说不出话来。

fuse.example: The two companies will fuse their small teams into one strong group.
fuse.exampleZh: 这两家公司将把他们的小团队合并成一个强大的团队。

fuselage.example: The plane's fuselage was damaged in the crash.
fuselage.exampleZh: 飞机在坠毁时机身受损。

fusion.example: The fusion of these two ideas created a completely new style of music.
fusion.exampleZh: 这两种理念的融合创造了一种全新的音乐风格。

fuss.example: She made a big fuss about the small mistake in the report.
fuss.exampleZh: 她对报告中的那个小错误大惊小怪。

fussy.example: My fussy cat will not eat any food that is not fresh.
fussy.exampleZh: 我那爱挑剔的猫不吃任何不新鲜的食物。

futile.example: Trying to change his mind again would be a futile waste of time.
futile.exampleZh: 再次试图改变他的想法将是徒劳地浪费时间。

futility.example: She soon saw the futility of arguing with him about the plan.
futility.exampleZh: 她很快就看出为这个计划和他争论是徒劳的。

future.example: I want to be a doctor in the future.
future.exampleZh: 我将来想成为一名医生。

futurism.example: Futurism was an art movement that celebrated speed, technology, and modern city life.
futurism.exampleZh: 未来主义是一场颂扬速度、技术与现代城市生活的艺术运动。

futuristic.example: The new library has a futuristic design with glass walls and bright lights.
futuristic.exampleZh: 这座新图书馆采用未来派设计，有玻璃墙和明亮的灯光。

futurity.example: No one can predict the futurity of this young artist.
futurity.exampleZh: 没有人能预测这位年轻艺术家的未来。

gab.example: We sat on the porch and had a nice gab about old friends.
gab.exampleZh: 我们坐在门廊上，愉快地闲聊着老朋友的事。

gabble.example: He was so nervous that he began to gabble and no one understood him.
gabble.exampleZh: 他太紧张了，开始急促而含糊地说话，没人听懂他。

gadfly.example: My little brother is a gadfly who keeps asking me endless questions.
gadfly.exampleZh: 我弟弟是个惹人烦的家伙，总是没完没了地问我问题。

gadget.example: My father bought a small gadget that helps him open jars easily.
gadget.exampleZh: 我爸爸买了一个小装置，能帮他轻松打开罐子。

gaiety.example: The music and dancing filled the whole room with gaiety.
gaiety.exampleZh: 音乐和舞蹈让整个房间充满了欢乐。

gain.example: She gained a lot of useful experience from her first job.
gain.exampleZh: 她从第一份工作中获得了很多有用的经验。

gainsay.example: No one can gainsay the fact that she works very hard every day.
gainsay.exampleZh: 没有人能否认她每天都非常努力这一事实。

galaxy.example: Our solar system is just a tiny part of the huge galaxy.
galaxy.exampleZh: 我们的太阳系只是这个巨大星系中极小的一部分。

gale.example: A strong gale blew down several trees in our neighborhood last night.
gale.exampleZh: 昨晚一场强风把我们社区的好几棵树吹倒了。

gall.example: It took a lot of gall to ask for more money after such poor work.
gall.exampleZh: 干了这么差的活还敢要更多钱，真是厚脸皮。

gallant.example: The gallant young man helped the old lady cross the busy street.
gallant.exampleZh: 那位殷勤的年轻人帮助老太太穿过了繁忙的街道。

gallery.example: We walked through the art gallery and looked at many old paintings.
gallery.exampleZh: 我们穿过画廊，看了许多古老的画作。

galley.example: The cook prepared soup for the sailors in the small galley.
galley.exampleZh: 厨师在狭小的船上厨房里为水手们准备汤。

gallon.example: My car needs about ten gallons of gas for the long trip.
gallon.exampleZh: 我的车跑这趟长途大约需要十加仑汽油。

gallop.example: The horse began to gallop across the wide open field.
gallop.exampleZh: 那匹马开始在开阔的田野上飞奔。

galvanize.example: The good news galvanized the whole team to work harder.
galvanize.exampleZh: 这个好消息激励了整个团队更加努力地工作。

gambit.example: His first move was a clever gambit to win more time.
gambit.exampleZh: 他的第一步是一个巧妙的策略，用来争取更多时间。

gamble.example: He likes to gamble on cards, but it is a risky game.
gamble.exampleZh: 他喜欢赌牌，但这是一项冒险的游戏。

gamut.example: Her emotions ran the full gamut from joy to deep sadness.
gamut.exampleZh: 她的情绪经历了从喜悦到深深悲伤的整个过程。

gang.example: A gang of boys was playing basketball in the park.
gang.exampleZh: 一帮男孩在公园里打篮球。

gap.example: There is a big gap between the two teams in skill.
gap.exampleZh: 两支队伍在技术上有很大的差距。

gape.example: The children gaped at the huge elephant in the zoo.
gape.exampleZh: 孩子们目瞪口呆地看着动物园里那头巨大的大象。

garage.example: Our car stays in the garage when it rains.
garage.exampleZh: 下雨时我们的车停在车库里。

garb.example: She wore a simple garb of white cotton for the ceremony.
garb.exampleZh: 她在仪式上穿了一身简单的白色棉质装束。

garbage.example: Please put the garbage in the bin before you leave the kitchen.
garbage.exampleZh: 离开厨房前请把垃圾放进垃圾桶里。

garble.example: The reporter was accused of garbling the facts in his story.
garble.exampleZh: 这名记者被指责在报道中歪曲了事实。

garden.example: My grandmother grows tomatoes and flowers in her small garden.
garden.exampleZh: 我奶奶在她的小花园里种西红柿和花。

gardener.example: The gardener waters the flowers in the garden every morning.
gardener.exampleZh: 园丁每天早上给花园里的花浇水。

gargantuan.example: The new stadium is gargantuan and can hold thousands of people.
gargantuan.exampleZh: 这座新体育场非常巨大，能容纳数千人。

garlic.example: My mother puts fresh garlic in almost every dish she cooks.
garlic.exampleZh: 我妈妈做的几乎每道菜里都会放新鲜大蒜。

garment.example: She wore a warm garment over her shirt on a cold day.
garment.exampleZh: 寒冷的日子里，她在衬衫外面穿了一件暖和的外衣。

garner.example: She worked hard to garner support from her friends and family.
garner.exampleZh: 她努力争取朋友和家人的支持。

garnish.example: She used fresh parsley to garnish the soup before serving it.
garnish.exampleZh: 她在上汤前用新鲜欧芹为汤做点缀。

garrison.example: A small garrison defended the old fort for many years.
garrison.exampleZh: 一支小守备部队守卫这座旧堡垒多年。

garrulous.example: My garrulous neighbor talked for an hour about his new garden.
garrulous.exampleZh: 我那喋喋不休的邻居聊了一个小时他的新花园。

gas.example: The gas from the old stove made the whole kitchen smell bad.
gas.exampleZh: 旧炉子泄漏的煤气让整个厨房都很难闻。

gash.example: He fell on broken glass and got a deep gash on his arm.
gash.exampleZh: 他摔在碎玻璃上，手臂划出了一道很深的伤口。

gasoline.example: We need to buy gasoline before we start our long drive tomorrow.
gasoline.exampleZh: 我们明天开始长途驾驶前需要买汽油。

gasp.example: She gasped for breath after running up the stairs.
gasp.exampleZh: 她跑上楼梯后大口喘气。

gate.example: Please close the gate before the dog runs out of the yard.
gate.exampleZh: 请在狗跑出院子之前把大门关上。

gather.example: People gather in the square every evening to talk and sing.
gather.exampleZh: 人们每天晚上聚集在广场上聊天和唱歌。

gaudy.example: Her gaudy dress had too many bright colors for the party.
gaudy.exampleZh: 她的那条俗丽连衣裙对这次聚会来说颜色太鲜艳了。

gauge.example: We used a simple tool to gauge the depth of the water.
gauge.exampleZh: 我们用一种简单的工具测量了水的深度。

gay.example: The gay colors of the flowers made the whole garden look bright and cheerful.
gay.exampleZh: 花朵鲜艳的色彩让整个花园显得明亮又欢快。

gaze.example: She gazed at the stars for a long time last night.
gaze.exampleZh: 昨晚她久久地凝视着星空。

gear.example: He shifted into a lower gear before driving up the steep hill.
gear.exampleZh: 他在开上陡坡之前换到了低速挡。

gel.example: The doctor put a cool gel on my skin before the test.
gel.exampleZh: 医生在检查前在我皮肤上涂了一层凉凉的凝胶。

gelatin.example: She added gelatin to the fruit juice to make a simple dessert.
gelatin.exampleZh: 她在果汁里加了明胶，做成了一道简单的甜点。

genalogy.example: My teacher showed us a genalogy of the old family in class today.
genalogy.exampleZh: 我的老师今天在课堂上给我们看了一个古老家族的家谱。

gender.example: Please write your name and gender on the form.
gender.exampleZh: 请在表格上写下你的姓名和性别。

gene.example: Each gene in your body carries information that helps decide how you grow.
gene.exampleZh: 你身体里的每个基因都携带着帮助决定你如何生长的信息。

genealogy.example: She studies genealogy to learn more about her family's past.
genealogy.exampleZh: 她研究家谱学，以更多地了解自己家族的过去。

general.example: In general, the book is easy to read for most students.
general.exampleZh: 总的来说，这本书对大多数学生来说很容易读。

generate.example: Solar panels generate clean electricity from sunlight during the day.
generate.exampleZh: 太阳能板在白天利用阳光产生清洁的电力。

generation.example: This new generation of students learns quickly with simple online tools.
generation.exampleZh: 这一代新学生借助简单的在线工具学得很快。

generic.example: This is a generic drug, not the expensive brand name one.
generic.exampleZh: 这是一种非专利药，不是那种昂贵的品牌药。

generous.example: My generous neighbor often shares his fresh vegetables with everyone on the street.
generous.exampleZh: 我慷慨的邻居经常把新鲜蔬菜分给街上的每个人。

genetic.example: Genetic studies help scientists understand why some diseases pass from parents to children.
genetic.exampleZh: 遗传学研究帮助科学家理解为什么有些疾病会从父母传给孩子。

genial.example: Our new neighbor is a genial old man who always greets everyone warmly.
genial.exampleZh: 我们的新邻居是一位和蔼的老人，他总是热情地跟大家打招呼。

genius.example: Everyone says he is a genius at math.
genius.exampleZh: 大家都说他是数学天才。

genre.example: This genre of music is very popular with young people today.
genre.exampleZh: 这种音乐类型如今在年轻人中非常流行。

genteel.example: Her genteel manners made everyone at the simple dinner feel a little nervous.
genteel.exampleZh: 她文雅的举止让这顿简朴晚餐上的每个人都感到有些不自在。

gentle.example: She is very gentle with the small children in her class.
gentle.exampleZh: 她对她班上的小孩子们非常温和。

genuine.example: Her smile was genuine, and everyone in the room felt welcome.
genuine.exampleZh: 她的笑容很真诚，房间里的每个人都感到受欢迎。

genus.example: The scientist grouped these animals into a single genus.
genus.exampleZh: 科学家把这些动物归入同一个属。

geography.example: I like geography because it helps me understand maps and different places.
geography.exampleZh: 我喜欢地理，因为它帮助我理解地图和不同的地方。

geology.example: She studies geology at the university and often goes on field trips.
geology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习地质学，并且经常参加野外考察。

geometric.example: The geometric pattern on the floor looks like a set of perfect triangles.
geometric.exampleZh: 地板上的几何图案看起来像一组完美的三角形。

geometry.example: The students learn about geometry by measuring shapes and angles in class.
geometry.exampleZh: 学生们在课堂上通过测量图形和角度来学习几何学。

germ.example: Wash your hands with soap to stop germs from spreading.
germ.exampleZh: 用肥皂洗手可以阻止细菌传播。

germane.example: Her question was germane to the topic we were discussing.
germane.exampleZh: 她的问题与我们正在讨论的话题密切相关。

germanium.example: Germanium is a hard gray element used in making computer chips.
germanium.exampleZh: 锗是一种坚硬的灰色元素，用于制造计算机芯片。

germinate.example: The seeds will germinate soon if you keep the soil warm and wet.
germinate.exampleZh: 如果你保持土壤温暖湿润，这些种子很快就会发芽。

gesture.example: She made a small gesture with her hand to say goodbye.
gesture.exampleZh: 她用手做了个小手势表示再见。

geyser.example: The geyser shoots hot water high into the air every hour.
geyser.exampleZh: 这个间歇泉每小时都会把热水高高喷向空中。

ghastly.example: The old house looked ghastly in the dark, so we ran away quickly.
ghastly.exampleZh: 那座老房子在黑暗中显得十分可怕，所以我们很快就跑开了。

ghost.example: She says a ghost lives in the old house near the river.
ghost.exampleZh: 她说河边那栋老房子里住着一个鬼。

giant.example: That tech giant builds giant machines for farms around the world.
giant.exampleZh: 那家科技巨头为世界各地的农场制造巨型机器。

giddy.example: The fast spinning ride made me feel giddy and a little sick.
giddy.exampleZh: 快速旋转的游乐设施让我头晕，还有点恶心。

gift.example: Her gift for music made everyone in the family very proud.
gift.exampleZh: 她的音乐天赋让家里每个人都感到非常自豪。

gigantic.example: The blue whale is a gigantic animal that lives in the ocean.
gigantic.exampleZh: 蓝鲸是一种生活在海洋里的巨大动物。

giggle.example: The little girl began to giggle when her father made a funny face.
giggle.exampleZh: 当爸爸做了个鬼脸时，小女孩开始咯咯地笑起来。

gild.example: They tried to gild the plain truth with pretty words.
gild.exampleZh: 他们试图用漂亮话粉饰朴实的事实。

gimmick.example: The free gift is just a gimmick to make people buy the product.
gimmick.exampleZh: 免费赠品只是一个让人购买该产品的噱头。

gin.example: He poured a little gin into his glass and drank it slowly.
gin.exampleZh: 他往杯子里倒了一点杜松子酒，然后慢慢喝了下去。

ginger.example: She added fresh ginger to the soup for a warm, spicy taste.
ginger.exampleZh: 她在汤里加了新鲜的姜，带来温暖辛辣的味道。

giraffe.example: We saw a tall giraffe eating leaves from a tree at the zoo.
giraffe.exampleZh: 我们在动物园看到一只高大的长颈鹿在吃树上的叶子。

girder.example: The heavy steel girder supports the whole weight of the bridge above the water.
girder.exampleZh: 那根沉重的钢制主梁支撑着水面上方整座桥的重量。

girl.example: The little girl next door likes to play with her dog.
girl.exampleZh: 隔壁的小女孩喜欢和她的狗一起玩。

give.example: Please give this book to your sister when you go home.
give.exampleZh: 你回家时请把这本书给你的妹妹。

glacial.example: The glacial ice is very thick and cold here.
glacial.exampleZh: 这里的冰川冰非常厚而且很冷。

glacier.example: The glacier moves slowly down the mountain and looks blue in the sun.
glacier.exampleZh: 冰川沿着山体缓慢向下移动，在阳光下看起来是蓝色的。

glad.example: I am very glad to meet you and your family today.
glad.exampleZh: 今天见到你和你的家人，我非常高兴。

glamor.example: The old city has a special glamor that draws many visitors every year.
glamor.exampleZh: 这座古城有一种特别的魅力，每年吸引许多游客。

glance.example: She glanced at her watch and hurried toward the door.
glance.exampleZh: 她瞥了一眼手表，匆匆走向门口。

gland.example: The doctor said a small gland behind my nose was swollen.
gland.exampleZh: 医生说，我鼻子后面的一个小腺体肿了。

glare.example: The sun's glare on the wet road made driving very hard yesterday.
glare.exampleZh: 昨天湿路面上耀眼的阳光让开车变得非常困难。

glass.example: Please pour me a glass of cold water from the fridge.
glass.exampleZh: 请从冰箱里给我倒一杯冷水。

glaze.example: The potter will glaze the bowl before the final firing.
glaze.exampleZh: 陶艺师会在最后一次烧制前给碗上釉。

gleam.example: A faint gleam of light came through the dark clouds.
gleam.exampleZh: 一道微弱的光从乌云中透了出来。

glean.example: She gleaned useful information from the old newspapers.
glean.exampleZh: 她从旧报纸中慢慢收集到了有用的信息。

glide.example: The small boat glided quietly across the lake at sunset.
glide.exampleZh: 日落时分，小船静静地滑过湖面。

glimmer.example: A glimmer of light appeared under the door.
glimmer.exampleZh: 门缝下出现了一丝微光。

glimpse.example: I caught a quick glimpse of the singer through the crowd.
glimpse.exampleZh: 我在人群中飞快地瞥见了那位歌手。

glisten.example: The wet leaves glisten in the morning sun after the rain.
glisten.exampleZh: 雨后，湿漉漉的叶子在晨光中闪闪发光。

glitter.example: The stars glitter in the dark sky above the quiet little town.
glitter.exampleZh: 星星在安静小镇上方的夜空中闪闪发光。

gloat.example: He gloated over his rival's mistake instead of offering help.
gloat.exampleZh: 他对对手的错误幸灾乐祸，而不是伸出援手。

global.example: Global trade has grown quickly over the past twenty years.
global.exampleZh: 全球贸易在过去二十年里迅速增长。

globe.example: People from all over the globe came to watch the games.
globe.exampleZh: 来自世界各地的人们前来观看这场运动会。

gloom.example: A deep gloom filled the room after the bad news.
gloom.exampleZh: 坏消息传来后，一种深深的忧郁笼罩了整个房间。

gloomy.example: The weather was gloomy, so we stayed home and read books all day.
gloomy.exampleZh: 天气阴沉，所以我们待在家里读了一整天书。

glorify.example: Some movies glorify war and make young people want to join the army.
glorify.exampleZh: 有些电影美化战争，让年轻人想要参军。

glorious.example: The team had a glorious win in front of their home fans.
glorious.exampleZh: 球队在主场球迷面前取得了一场光荣的胜利。

glory.example: The old soldier won great glory for his country in the war.
glory.exampleZh: 那位老兵在战争中为他的国家赢得了巨大的荣誉。

gloss.example: The old table has a nice gloss after he polishes it.
gloss.exampleZh: 他擦过之后，这张旧桌子有了好看的光泽。

glossary.example: The teacher added a glossary at the end of the book.
glossary.exampleZh: 老师在书的末尾加了一个词汇表。

glove.example: He wears a warm glove on each hand when it is cold outside.
glove.exampleZh: 外面冷的时候，他两只手各戴一只暖和的手套。

glow.example: The candles glow softly on the table while we eat dinner.
glow.exampleZh: 我们吃晚饭时，桌上的蜡烛柔和地发着光。

glue.example: Please use some glue to stick the paper on the wall.
glue.exampleZh: 请用一些胶水把纸粘在墙上。

go.example: We often go to the park on Sunday mornings with our dog.
go.exampleZh: 我们经常在周日早上带狗去公园。

goad.example: His constant teasing only served to goad her into working even harder.
goad.exampleZh: 他不断的取笑只是刺激她更加努力地工作。

goal.example: My goal is to learn English well this year.
goal.exampleZh: 我的目标是今年把英语学好。

goat.example: The little goat eats grass on the hill every morning.
goat.exampleZh: 那只小山羊每天早上在山坡上吃草。

gobble.example: The hungry dog gobbled his food in seconds.
gobble.exampleZh: 那只饿狗几秒钟就把食物狼吞虎咽地吃光了。

god.example: In many old stories, people pray to a god for rain.
god.exampleZh: 在许多古老的故事里，人们向神祈求降雨。

gold.example: She wore a ring made of gold on her left hand.
gold.exampleZh: 她左手戴着一枚金戒指。

golden.example: The little girl wore a golden dress to the party.
golden.exampleZh: 小女孩穿着一条金色的裙子去参加派对。

golf.example: My father plays golf with his friends every Sunday morning.
golf.exampleZh: 我父亲每个星期天早上都和他的朋友们打高尔夫球。

good.example: She is very good at math and always helps her friends.
good.exampleZh: 她数学很好，而且总是帮助朋友。

goods.example: The goods in this shop are cheap and very good.
goods.exampleZh: 这家商店里的商品便宜而且质量很好。

goose.example: The farmer keeps a goose and two ducks near the small pond.
goose.exampleZh: 农夫在小池塘边养了一只鹅和两只鸭子。

gorge.example: The river runs through a deep gorge below our village.
gorge.exampleZh: 这条河从我们村庄下方的深峡谷中流过。

gorgeous.example: The garden looks gorgeous in spring when all the flowers open.
gorgeous.exampleZh: 春天所有的花都开放时，花园看起来美极了。

gorilla.example: The big gorilla sat quietly under a tree and ate leaves.
gorilla.exampleZh: 那只大猩猩安静地坐在树下吃叶子。

gossip.example: She loves to gossip about her neighbors, but nobody believes her stories.
gossip.exampleZh: 她喜欢说邻居的闲话，但没人相信她的话。

govern.example: Good laws govern how people live and work together.
govern.exampleZh: 良好的法律规范着人们如何共同生活和 work。

government.example: The government plans to build a new school in our town next year.
government.exampleZh: 政府计划明年在我们镇上建一所新学校。

governor.example: The governor of our state visited the small town last week.
governor.exampleZh: 我们州的州长上周访问了这座小镇。

gow.example: Her face began to gow with joy when she saw the gift.
gow.exampleZh: 当她看到礼物时，她的脸因喜悦而开始发光。

gown.example: The bride wore a long white gown at her wedding last Saturday.
gown.exampleZh: 新娘在上周六的婚礼上穿了一件长长的白色礼服。

grab.example: He grabbed his bag and ran to catch the bus.
grab.exampleZh: 他抓起包就跑着去赶公交车。

grace.example: She moved across the stage with great grace and quiet confidence.
grace.exampleZh: 她以极大的优雅和沉静的自信走过舞台。

grade.example: My teacher gave me a good grade on the math test.
grade.exampleZh: 老师给我的数学考试打了个好成绩。

gradient.example: The mountain has a steep gradient near the top, so climbing is hard.
gradient.exampleZh: 这座山靠近山顶的地方坡度很陡，所以爬起来很费劲。

gradual.example: The baby made a gradual change from milk to solid food.
gradual.exampleZh: 宝宝从喝奶逐渐过渡到吃固体食物。

graduate.example: My sister will graduate from college next June and then look for a job.
graduate.exampleZh: 我姐姐明年六月大学毕业，然后找工作。

grain.example: This bread is made from a grain called wheat.
grain.exampleZh: 这种面包是由一种叫小麦的谷物做成的。

gram.example: This small coin weighs about one gram, which is very light.
gram.exampleZh: 这枚小硬币大约重一克，非常轻。

grammar.example: I need a good grammar book to study English.
grammar.exampleZh: 我需要一本好的语法书来学习英语。

granary.example: The old granary near the farm still holds last year's wheat.
granary.exampleZh: 农场附近的旧谷仓里仍存着去年的小麦。

grand.example: The old hotel has a grand entrance and a very large garden.
grand.exampleZh: 这家老酒店有一个宏伟的入口和一个非常大的花园。

grandchild.example: My grandchild likes to visit us every weekend and play in the garden.
grandchild.exampleZh: 我的孙子每个周末都喜欢来看我们，并在花园里玩。

grant.example: The school gave him a grant to study art in Paris.
grant.exampleZh: 学校给了他一份补助金，让他去巴黎学习艺术。

granular.example: The soil here is granular and easy to dig.
granular.exampleZh: 这里的土壤是颗粒状的，很容易挖掘。

grape.example: She put a bunch of red grapes in a small bowl.
grape.exampleZh: 她把一串红葡萄放进一个小碗里。

graph.example: Please draw a graph to show how the price changes.
graph.exampleZh: 请画一张图表来显示价格是如何变化的。

graphic.example: She gave a graphic description of the accident to the police.
graphic.exampleZh: 她向警方生动地描述了那场事故。

grasp.example: She quickly grasped the main idea of the lesson and answered every question.
grasp.exampleZh: 她很快理解了这节课的主要内容，并回答了每一个问题。

grass.example: The children are playing on the green grass behind their house.
grass.exampleZh: 孩子们正在他们房子后面的绿色草地上玩耍。

grateful.example: I am very grateful to my teacher for her help with my English.
grateful.exampleZh: 我非常感谢老师在我英语学习上给予的帮助。

gratitude.example: I want to show my gratitude to you for all your help.
gratitude.exampleZh: 我想向你表达我的感激之情，感谢你所有的帮助。

grave.example: The doctor said my father's illness was grave but not hopeless.
grave.exampleZh: 医生说我父亲的病很严重，但并非没有希望。

gravel.example: The workers spread gravel on the wet road to make it safer.
gravel.exampleZh: 工人们在湿滑的路面上铺上砾石，使其更安全。

gravity.example: The gravity of the situation made everyone quiet and serious.
gravity.exampleZh: 局势的严重性让每个人都安静而严肃。

graze.example: The cows graze in the field behind the old farm every morning.
graze.exampleZh: 奶牛每天早晨在旧农场后面的田野里吃草。

grease.example: Put some grease on the wheel to make it turn easily.
grease.exampleZh: 在轮子上涂些油脂，让它转动得更顺畅。

great.example: This is a great day for our small town.
great.exampleZh: 对我们这个小镇来说，这是伟大的一天。

greed.example: His greed for money made him lose all his good friends.
greed.exampleZh: 他对金钱的贪婪让他失去了所有好朋友。

greedy.example: The greedy boy ate all the cookies before dinner.
greedy.exampleZh: 那个贪吃的男孩在晚饭前把所有饼干都吃光了。

green.example: The green leaves look fresh after the rain, and green is her favorite color.
green.exampleZh: 雨后绿色的叶子看起来很清新，而绿色是她最喜欢的颜色。

greet.example: She always greets her neighbors with a friendly smile every morning.
greet.exampleZh: 她每天早上总是带着友善的微笑问候邻居。

gregarious.example: She is a gregarious person who loves to talk with everyone.
gregarious.exampleZh: 她是个爱社交的人，喜欢和每个人交谈。

grief.example: She felt deep grief after her old dog died last winter.
grief.exampleZh: 去年冬天她的老狗死后，她感到深深的悲痛。

grieve.example: She still grieves for her old dog, but she is slowly feeling better.
grieve.exampleZh: 她仍然为她的老狗感到悲伤，但她正在慢慢好起来。

grill.example: We cooked burgers on the grill in the backyard last night.
grill.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在后院的烤架上烤了汉堡。

grim.example: The news from the hospital was grim and made everyone very quiet.
grim.exampleZh: 医院传来的消息很糟糕，让大家都沉默不语。

grimace.example: He made a grimace when he tasted the sour lemon.
grimace.exampleZh: 他尝到酸柠檬时做了个怪相。

grin.example: She grinned at me when she heard the good news.
grin.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她冲我咧嘴笑了。

grind.example: She has to grind coffee beans every morning before work.
grind.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前都得磨咖啡豆。

grip.example: She had to grip the rail tightly to keep her balance.
grip.exampleZh: 她不得不紧紧抓住栏杆以保持平衡。

grit.example: She showed real grit and kept running even after she fell down.
grit.exampleZh: 她展现出真正的毅力，摔倒后仍继续奔跑。

groan.example: She gave a loud groan when she saw the huge pile of homework.
groan.exampleZh: 看到那一大堆作业时，她大声呻吟了一声。

grocer.example: The grocer sells fresh fruit and vegetables every morning.
grocer.exampleZh: 这位食品杂货商每天早上卖新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

groom.example: The young groom smiled at his bride during the wedding ceremony.
groom.exampleZh: 婚礼上，年轻的新郎对着新娘微笑。

groove.example: The needle follows the groove and plays a soft old song.
groove.exampleZh: 唱针沿着凹槽走，放出一首轻柔的老歌。

grope.example: She groped for the light switch in the dark room.
grope.exampleZh: 她在黑暗的房间里摸索着找电灯开关。

gross.example: The gross weight of the box is heavy for one person to lift.
gross.exampleZh: 这个箱子的总重对一个人来说太重了，搬不动。

ground.example: The plane was stuck on the ground after the storm.
ground.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，飞机被困在地面上。

group.example: Our teacher put us in a group of four to finish the work.
group.exampleZh: 老师把我们分成四人一组来完成这项工作。

grove.example: We walked through a quiet grove of orange trees behind the farm.
grove.exampleZh: 我们穿过农场后面一片安静的橘子小树林。

grow.example: Children grow taller and stronger when they eat well and sleep enough.
grow.exampleZh: 孩子们吃得好、睡得足，就会长得更高更壮。

growl.example: The old dog began to growl at the stranger near the gate.
growl.exampleZh: 那只老狗开始在门边对陌生人低声咆哮。

growth.example: The fast growth of the city brought many new jobs for young people.
growth.exampleZh: 这座城市的快速增长为年轻人带来了许多新工作。

grub.example: The bird dug in the soil and found a fat grub for its lunch.
grub.exampleZh: 那只鸟在土里挖掘，找到了一只肥硕的幼虫当午餐。

grudge.example: She still holds a grudge against her old friend.
grudge.exampleZh: 她仍然对老朋友心存怨恨。

grumble.example: He likes to grumble about the food at work.
grumble.exampleZh: 他喜欢抱怨单位的饭菜。

grunt.example: The old man grunted and turned away without saying a word.
grunt.exampleZh: 老人咕哝了一声，一句话也没说就转身走开了。

guarantee.example: The store gives a one-year guarantee on all its watches.
guarantee.exampleZh: 这家店对所有手表提供一年的保修。

guard.example: Two soldiers guard the gate day and night.
guard.exampleZh: 两名士兵日夜守卫着大门。

guess.example: I guess she is at home now.

guest.example: We have a guest from Canada staying with us this week.
guest.exampleZh: 这周有一位来自加拿大的客人住在我们家。

guidance.example: My teacher gave me useful guidance on how to study English.
guidance.exampleZh: 老师就如何学习英语给了我有用的指导。

guide.example: Our guide showed us the way through the old town.
guide.exampleZh: 我们的向导带我们穿过了老城区。

guideline.example: Please follow the safety guidelines when you use the machines.
guideline.exampleZh: 使用这些机器时，请遵守安全准则。

guild.example: The old guild trained young workers in the skills of their trade.
guild.exampleZh: 这个古老的行会教年轻工人学习本行业的技能。

guilt.example: He felt a deep sense of guilt after he lied to his mother.
guilt.exampleZh: 他对母亲撒谎后感到深深的内疚。

guilty.example: He felt guilty about breaking his promise to his best friend.
guilty.exampleZh: 他因为对最好的朋友违背诺言而感到内疚。

guise.example: He entered the room in the guise of a waiter.
guise.exampleZh: 他以服务员的外表走进了房间。

gulf.example: There is a wide gulf between the two countries on this issue.
gulf.exampleZh: 两国在这个问题上存在巨大鸿沟。

gull.example: Do not let that man gull you into buying his old car.
gull.exampleZh: 别让那个人骗你买他那辆旧车。

gullible.example: The gullible old man gave all his money to a stranger.
gullible.exampleZh: 那位轻信他人的老人把所有的钱都给了一个陌生人。

gum.example: The boy chews gum in class and hides the wrapper in his pocket.
gum.exampleZh: 那个男孩在课堂上嚼口香糖，把包装纸藏在了口袋里。

gun.example: The police officer told him to put the gun down slowly.
gun.exampleZh: 警察让他慢慢把枪放下。

gust.example: A cold gust of wind blew the leaves across the yard.
gust.exampleZh: 一阵冷风吹过，把树叶刮过院子。

gut.example: She trusted her gut and left the job without a plan.
gut.exampleZh: 她相信自己的直觉，毫无计划地辞了职。

guy.example: That guy over there is my older brother and he works here.
guy.exampleZh: 那边那个家伙是我哥哥，他在这里工作。

gymnasium.example: Our new gymnasium has a large basketball court and a small exercise room.
gymnasium.exampleZh: 我们的新体育馆有一个大篮球场和一个小型健身室。

gypsy.example: A gypsy family stopped by our town and sold beautiful baskets.
gypsy.exampleZh: 一个吉普赛家庭在我们镇上停留，卖漂亮的篮子。

habit.example: Reading before bed is a good habit for children.
habit.exampleZh: 睡前阅读对孩子来说是一个好习惯。

habitable.example: Scientists believe this planet may be habitable for humans in the future.
habitable.exampleZh: 科学家认为这颗行星未来可能适合人类居住。

habitat.example: This forest is a good habitat for many birds and small animals.
habitat.exampleZh: 这片森林是许多鸟类和小动物的良好栖息地。

habitual.example: His habitual late arrival at meetings makes his team angry.
habitual.exampleZh: 他习惯性开会迟到，这让他的团队很生气。

habituate.example: Parents can habituate their children to reading early.
habituate.exampleZh: 父母可以让孩子早早习惯阅读。

hail.example: The crowd began to hail the young winner with loud cheers.
hail.exampleZh: 人群开始用响亮的欢呼声向这位年轻的获胜者致意。

hair.example: Her long hair is very beautiful in the sun.
hair.exampleZh: 她的长发在阳光下非常漂亮。

haircut.example: I need a haircut before the party on Saturday.
haircut.exampleZh: 周六聚会之前我需要理个发。

hale.example: My grandfather is still hale and active at eighty years old.
hale.exampleZh: 我的祖父八十岁了，依然健壮而活跃。

half.example: I ate half of the cake and gave the rest to my sister.
half.exampleZh: 我吃了一半蛋糕，把剩下的给了我妹妹。

hall.example: We waited in the hall for ten minutes before the show began.
hall.exampleZh: 演出开始前，我们在门厅里等了十分钟。

hallucinate.example: When she is very tired, she may hallucinate and see things that are not there.
hallucinate.exampleZh: 当她非常疲惫时，她可能会产生幻觉，看到并不存在的东西。

halo.example: The moon had a soft halo around it in the night sky.
halo.exampleZh: 夜空中，月亮周围有一圈柔和的光晕。

halt.example: The train came to a halt at a small station.
halt.exampleZh: 火车在一个小站停了下来。

ham.example: We ate ham and eggs for breakfast at the small hotel.
ham.exampleZh: 我们在那家小旅馆早餐吃了火腿和鸡蛋。

hamburger.example: I ate a hamburger with cheese and fries for lunch today.
hamburger.exampleZh: 我今天午餐吃了一个加奶酪的汉堡包和薯条。

hammer.example: He used a hammer to fix the broken chair in the kitchen.
hammer.exampleZh: 他用锤子修好了厨房里那把坏掉的椅子。

hamper.example: Heavy rain hampered the rescue team all through the night.
hamper.exampleZh: 大雨整夜妨碍了救援队的工作。

hand.example: Please hand the book to your teacher before class starts.
hand.exampleZh: 请在开始上课前把书交给你的老师。

handbook.example: The new staff read the handbook before they started work.
handbook.exampleZh: 新员工在开始工作前阅读了这本手册。

handful.example: Only a handful of students came to the early morning class today.
handful.exampleZh: 今天早上只有少数几个学生来上早课。

handicap.example: His poor English was a real handicap when he started the new job.
handicap.exampleZh: 他刚开始这份新工作时，英语不好确实是个很大的障碍。

handle.example: She knows how to handle difficult problems at work every day.
handle.exampleZh: 她知道如何处理每天工作中的难题。

handsome.example: Her brother is a handsome young man with a kind smile.
handsome.exampleZh: 她哥哥是个英俊的年轻人，笑容和善。

handwriting.example: Her handwriting is small and neat, so her notes are easy to read.
handwriting.exampleZh: 她的笔迹又小又工整，所以她的笔记很容易读。

handy.example: This small tool is very handy when I fix things at home.
handy.exampleZh: 这个小工具在我家里修东西时很方便。

hang.example: Please hang your wet coat on the hook behind the door.
hang.exampleZh: 请把你的湿外套挂在门后的挂钩上。

happen.example: Accidents like this can happen to anyone at any time.
happen.exampleZh: 像这样的事故随时可能发生在任何人身上。

happiness.example: True happiness comes from good friends and a simple life.
happiness.exampleZh: 真正的幸福来自好朋友和简单的生活。

harass.example: The boys often harass the new student after class.
harass.exampleZh: 那些男孩放学后经常骚扰那个新来的学生。

harbor.example: The small boat found a safe harbor before the storm arrived.
harbor.exampleZh: 小船在暴风雨来临前找到了一个安全的港口。

hard.example: This bread is very hard, so please cut it slowly.
hard.exampleZh: 这块面包很硬，请慢慢切。

harden.example: Years of hard work hardened his heart and made him cold.
harden.exampleZh: 多年的艰辛使他的心变冷酷了，让他变得冷漠。

hardly.example: I could hardly hear him because the room was very noisy.
hardly.exampleZh: 房间里很吵，我几乎听不见他说话。

hardship.example: Many families face great hardship during the cold winter months.
hardship.exampleZh: 许多家庭在寒冷的冬季月份里面临巨大的艰难困苦。

hardware.example: The store sells computers and other hardware at low prices.
hardware.exampleZh: 这家商店以低价出售电脑和其他硬件。

hardy.example: This hardy plant can grow well in cold weather.
hardy.exampleZh: 这种耐寒的植物在寒冷的天气里也能长得好。

hare.example: A hare ran across the field and disappeared into the tall grass.
hare.exampleZh: 一只野兔跑过田野，消失在深草丛中。

harm.example: Too much sun can harm your skin, so wear a hat outside.
harm.exampleZh: 阳光过多会伤害你的皮肤，所以在户外要戴帽子。

harmony.example: The village lives in harmony with nature and its people.
harmony.exampleZh: 这个村庄与自然以及村民们和谐相处。

harness.example: We can harness the power of the wind to make clean electricity.
harness.exampleZh: 我们可以利用风能来生产清洁的电力。

harsh.example: The winter here is harsh, and the wind is very cold.
harsh.exampleZh: 这里的冬天很严酷，风也非常冷。

harvest.example: Farmers harvest the rice in autumn and sell it at the local market.
harvest.exampleZh: 农民在秋天收割水稻，然后拿到当地市场去卖。

haste.example: In his haste to leave, he forgot his keys and phone.
haste.exampleZh: 他匆忙离开时忘了带钥匙和手机。

hasten.example: The rain made us hasten our steps toward the bus stop.
hasten.exampleZh: 下雨使我们加快脚步走向公交车站。

hasty.example: She made a hasty decision and later felt very sorry for it.
hasty.exampleZh: 她匆忙做了一个决定，后来为此感到非常后悔。

hat.example: He wears a warm hat when he walks outside in winter.
hat.exampleZh: 冬天他在外面走路时会戴一顶暖和的帽子。

hatch.example: The birds will hatch their eggs in the nest near our house.
hatch.exampleZh: 这些鸟会在我们家附近的巢里孵化它们的蛋。

hate.example: I hate waiting in long lines at the bank.
hate.exampleZh: 我讨厌在银行排长队等候。

hatred.example: Her deep hatred of lies made her tell the truth even when it was hard.
hatred.exampleZh: 她对谎言的深切憎恨使她即使在困难时也说出真相。

haul.example: They had to haul the heavy boxes up the stairs to the truck.
haul.exampleZh: 他们不得不把沉重的箱子拖上楼梯，搬到卡车上。

haunt.example: The old man likes to haunt the small park near his house.
haunt.exampleZh: 那位老人喜欢常去他家附近的小公园。

have.example: I have two small dogs and they love to play in the garden.
have.exampleZh: 我有两只小狗，它们喜欢在花园里玩耍。

hawk.example: The hawk flew high above the field and looked for small animals.
hawk.exampleZh: 那只鹰在田野上空高高飞翔，寻找小动物。

hay.example: The farmer put dry hay in the barn for the cows.
hay.exampleZh: 农民把干草放进谷仓里给奶牛吃。

hazard.example: Smoking is a serious health hazard for both smokers and people around them.
hazard.exampleZh: 吸烟对吸烟者及其周围的人都是严重的健康危害。

he.example: He is my best friend and he helps me every day.
he.exampleZh: 他是我最好的朋友，他每天都帮助我。

head.example: The head of the company will lead the team.
head.exampleZh: 公司的领导将率领这个团队。

headache.example: I had a bad headache this morning, so I stayed home from work.
headache.exampleZh: 今天早上我头痛得厉害，所以没去上班，待在家里。

heading.example: The heading at the top of the page tells you what the article is about.
heading.exampleZh: 页面顶部的标题告诉你这篇文章讲的是什么。

headline.example: The big headline on the front page caught my eye.
headline.exampleZh: 头版上的大字标题吸引了我的注意。

headquarters.example: The company moved its headquarters to a bigger city last year.
headquarters.exampleZh: 这家公司去年把总部搬到了一座更大的城市。

heal.example: Time can heal a broken heart and help people move on.
heal.exampleZh: 时间能治愈破碎的心，帮助人们继续前行。

health.example: Regular exercise and good food are important for your health.
health.exampleZh: 经常锻炼和良好的饮食对你的健康很重要。

heap.example: A heap of dirty clothes lay on the floor beside his bed.
heap.exampleZh: 一堆脏衣服放在他床边的地板上。

hear.example: I can hear the birds singing outside my window every morning.
hear.exampleZh: 每天早上我都能听见窗外鸟儿在歌唱。

hearing.example: My grandfather's hearing is not good, so he often asks us to speak louder.
hearing.exampleZh: 我祖父的听力不好，所以他经常让我们说话大声一点。

heart.example: My heart beats faster when I run to school in the morning.
heart.exampleZh: 早上跑着去学校时，我的心跳得更快。

heat.example: The heat from the sun made the room very warm.
heat.exampleZh: 太阳的热量让房间变得非常温暖。

heater.example: The heater in my room is not working today.
heater.exampleZh: 我房间里的加热器今天坏了。

heaven.example: She believes her kind grandmother is now in heaven.
heaven.exampleZh: 她相信她那慈祥的祖母现在在天堂里。

heavy.example: The box is too heavy for me to carry alone.
heavy.exampleZh: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人搬不动。

hectic.example: My life is very hectic because I have two jobs and three kids.
hectic.exampleZh: 我的生活非常忙碌，因为我有两份工作和三个孩子。

hedge.example: A thick hedge in the garden keeps the neighbors from seeing our yard.
hedge.exampleZh: 花园里一道厚厚的树篱挡住了邻居看我们院子的视线。

heel.example: My new shoes hurt my heel when I walk too far.
heel.exampleZh: 我的新鞋走太远时会磨我的脚后跟。

height.example: The height of the mountain is over two thousand meters.
height.exampleZh: 这座山的高度超过两千米。

heighten.example: The loud noise heightened her fear of the dark.
heighten.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音加剧了她对黑暗的恐惧。

heir.example: The old king had no heir, so his brother took the throne.
heir.exampleZh: 老王没有继承人，所以他的弟弟登上了王位。

helicopter.example: The helicopter landed on the roof of the tall building.
helicopter.exampleZh: 直升机降落在高楼屋顶上。

hell.example: He said the pain felt like hell, but he never gave up.
hell.exampleZh: 他说那种痛苦就像地狱，但他从未放弃。

hello.example: I smile and say hello to my new teacher every morning.
hello.exampleZh: 我每天早上都微笑着向新老师问好。

help.example: Could you help me carry these books to the library?
help.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这些书搬到图书馆吗？

helpful.example: Your advice was very helpful, and I finished the work on time.
helpful.exampleZh: 你的建议非常有帮助，我按时完成了工作。

hemisphere.example: The left hemisphere of the brain controls the right side of the body.
hemisphere.exampleZh: 大脑的左半球控制身体的右侧。

hence.example: It rained all day, and hence the game was canceled.
hence.exampleZh: 下了一整天雨，因此比赛取消了。

henceforth.example: Henceforth, all students must bring their books to every class.
henceforth.exampleZh: 从今以后，所有学生每次上课都必须带书。

her.example: I gave her a book yesterday, and she liked it very much.
her.exampleZh: 昨天我给了她一本书，她非常喜欢。

herald.example: The first flowers are a herald of spring, and they herald warmer days ahead.
herald.exampleZh: 最早开放的花朵是春天的先驱，它们预示着温暖的日子即将到来。

herb.example: My mother grows some herbs in a small garden behind our house.
herb.exampleZh: 我妈妈在我们房子后面的小花园里种了一些香草。

herd.example: The farmer will herd the sheep back to the field before sunset.
herd.exampleZh: 农民会在日落前把羊群赶回田里。

here.example: Please come here and sit next to me.

heritage.example: This old city is famous for its rich cultural heritage.
heritage.exampleZh: 这座古城以其丰富的文化遗产而闻名。

hero.example: Everyone in the town called the young firefighter a hero after he saved two children.
hero.exampleZh: 这名年轻的消防员救下两个孩子后，镇上的每个人都称他为英雄。

heroic.example: The heroic firefighter saved two children from the burning house.
heroic.exampleZh: 那位英勇的消防员从燃烧的房子里救出了两个孩子。

heroin.example: The police found heroin in his bag and arrested him at the airport.
heroin.exampleZh: 警察在他的包里发现了海洛因，并在机场逮捕了他。

hesitate.example: I hesitate to ask him for help again.
hesitate.exampleZh: 我犹豫要不要再找他帮忙。

hide.example: The cat likes to hide under the bed when it is scared.
hide.exampleZh: 那只猫害怕时喜欢躲在床底下。

hierarchy.example: The company has a clear hierarchy of managers and workers.
hierarchy.exampleZh: 公司里有着明确的经理与员工的等级制度。

high.example: The wall is very high, so we cannot climb over it.
high.exampleZh: 这堵墙很高，所以我们爬不过去。

highlight.example: The teacher used a bright color to highlight the most important words.
highlight.exampleZh: 老师用明亮的颜色来突出最重要的单词。

highly.example: This book is highly useful for students who want to learn English.
highly.exampleZh: 这本书对想学英语的学生非常有用。

highway.example: We drove along the highway for three hours to visit my grandparents.
highway.exampleZh: 我们沿着高速公路开了三个小时去看望我的祖父母。

hijack.example: The thieves tried to hijack the truck on a quiet road last night.
hijack.exampleZh: 昨晚小偷们试图在一条安静的路上劫持那辆卡车。

hill.example: The children ran up the green hill behind their house.
hill.exampleZh: 孩子们跑上了他们家后面的绿色小山。

hinder.example: Bad weather can hinder our work outside.
hinder.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气会妨碍我们在户外的工作。

hindrance.example: Lack of sleep can be a hindrance to learning new things.
hindrance.exampleZh: 睡眠不足会成为学习新事物的障碍。

hint.example: He gave me a hint about the answer.
hint.exampleZh: 他给了我一个关于答案的提示。

hip.example: My grandmother fell and hurt her hip while walking in the garden.
hip.exampleZh: 我奶奶在花园里散步时摔倒，伤到了髋部。

hire.example: We decided to hire a small car for the weekend trip.
hire.exampleZh: 我们决定租一辆小汽车用于周末旅行。

historian.example: The historian wrote a book about life in ancient China.
historian.exampleZh: 这位历史学家写了一本关于中国古代生活的书。

historic.example: This historic building is famous all over the world.
historic.exampleZh: 这座有历史意义的建筑闻名全世界。

historical.example: This historical novel tells the story of a small town.
historical.exampleZh: 这部历史小说讲述了一个小镇的故事。

history.example: I like reading books about the history of China.
history.exampleZh: 我喜欢读关于中国历史的书。

hit.example: The ball hit the window and broke the glass.
hit.exampleZh: 球打中了窗户，把玻璃打碎了。

hitch.example: He tried to hitch a ride to the airport before sunrise.
hitch.exampleZh: 他试图在日出前搭便车去机场。

hitherto.example: The plan has worked well, but hitherto no one has asked the workers for their opinion.
hitherto.exampleZh: 这个计划一直运行良好，但迄今还没有人征求过工人们的意见。

hive.example: The beekeeper opened the hive and checked the honey inside.
hive.exampleZh: 养蜂人打开蜂箱，检查里面的蜂蜜。

hoist.example: The workers used a rope to hoist the heavy box onto the truck.
hoist.exampleZh: 工人们用绳子把那只沉重的箱子吊上了卡车。

hold.example: Please hold my bag while I open the door.
hold.exampleZh: 请帮我拿一下包，我来开门。

holder.example: The holder of the ticket must show it at the door.
holder.exampleZh: 票的持有者必须在门口出示它。

hole.example: There is a small hole in the wall near the door.
hole.exampleZh: 门附近的墙上有一个小洞。

holiday.example: The summer holiday is a good time to visit my grandparents.
holiday.exampleZh: 暑假是看望我祖父母的好时候。

hollow.example: The old tree is hollow inside, so small animals can hide there.
hollow.exampleZh: 这棵老树里面是空心的，所以小动物可以躲在那里。

holy.example: This old church is a holy place for many people.
holy.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂对许多人来说是一个神圣的地方。

home.example: I go home after school every day to see my family.
home.exampleZh: 我每天放学后回家看望家人。

homework.example: I always finish my homework before I watch TV in the evening.
homework.exampleZh: 我总是在晚上看电视之前完成我的家庭作业。

homogeneous.example: The mixture stays homogeneous because the small particles are spread evenly through it.
homogeneous.exampleZh: 这种混合物保持均匀，因为小颗粒均匀地分布在其中。

honest.example: She is an honest girl and always tells the truth.
honest.exampleZh: 她是个诚实的女孩，总是说实话。

honesty.example: Her honesty made everyone in the team trust her.
honesty.exampleZh: 她的诚实让团队里的每个人都信任她。

honey.example: My little daughter likes to put honey in her warm tea.
honey.exampleZh: 我的小女儿喜欢在热茶里加蜂蜜。

honor.example: It is a great honor to meet you and your family today.
honor.exampleZh: 今天能见到您和您的家人是我的莫大荣幸。

hook.example: She used a small hook to hang the picture on the wall.
hook.exampleZh: 她用一个小挂钩把画挂在墙上。

hope.example: I hope you can come to my birthday party next week.
hope.exampleZh: 我希望你下周能来参加我的生日聚会。

hopeful.example: She is hopeful that her brother will pass the exam this time.
hopeful.exampleZh: 她希望她哥哥这次能通过考试。

hopeless.example: After failing the test three times, he felt hopeless about passing the course.
hopeless.exampleZh: 在三次考试失败后，他对通过这门课程感到绝望。

horizon.example: Traveling to new countries can broaden your horizon and change how you see the world.
horizon.exampleZh: 去新的国家旅行可以开阔你的眼界，并改变你看世界的方式。

horizontal.example: The picture looks better when the line is horizontal.
horizontal.exampleZh: 当这条线是水平的时候，这幅画看起来更好。

horn.example: The old car's horn made a loud noise in the street.
horn.exampleZh: 那辆旧汽车的喇叭在街上发出了很大的声响。

horrible.example: The weather was horrible, so we stayed at home all day.
horrible.exampleZh: 天气糟透了，所以我们整天待在家里。

horror.example: She screamed in horror when she saw the dark figure.
horror.exampleZh: 当她看到那个黑影时，她惊恐地尖叫起来。

horse.example: The farmer rides a brown horse across the wide green field every morning.
horse.exampleZh: 农夫每天早上骑着棕色的马穿过宽阔的绿色田野。

hospital.example: My mother works as a nurse in a large hospital near our home.
hospital.exampleZh: 我妈妈在我们家附近的一家大医院里当护士。

hospitality.example: The people in this small town are famous for their warm hospitality.
hospitality.exampleZh: 这个小镇的人们以热情好客而闻名。

host.example: The host welcomed many guests and hosted a big dinner at his house.
host.exampleZh: 主人欢迎了许多客人，并在家里举办了一场盛大的晚宴。

hostage.example: The police tried to save the hostage from the small room.
hostage.exampleZh: 警察试图从那个小房间里救出人质。

hostile.example: The two countries have been hostile to each other for many years.
hostile.exampleZh: 这两个国家多年来一直相互敌对。

hostility.example: His hostile words showed his deep hostility toward the new plan.
hostility.exampleZh: 他充满敌意的话语显示出他对这个新计划的深深敌意。

hot.example: The soup is too hot to eat right now.
hot.exampleZh: 这汤现在太烫了，没法吃。

hotel.example: We stayed in a small hotel near the beach during our summer holiday.
hotel.exampleZh: 暑假期间我们住在海滩附近的一家小旅馆里。

hound.example: The security guard began to hound the reporters away from the door.
hound.exampleZh: 保安开始把记者们从那扇门旁驱赶走。

hour.example: I study English for one hour every evening after dinner.
hour.exampleZh: 我每天晚饭后学一小时英语。

house.example: They bought a small house near the river last year.
house.exampleZh: 他们去年在河边买了一座小房子。

household.example: Every household in this small town uses water carefully in summer.
household.exampleZh: 这个小镇上的每一户人家在夏天都节约用水。

housewife.example: My mother is a housewife and she cooks for us every day.
housewife.exampleZh: 我妈妈是家庭主妇，她每天为我们做饭。

housework.example: I help my mother with the housework every Saturday morning.
housework.exampleZh: 我每周六早上都帮妈妈做家务。

housing.example: The cost of housing in this city has risen sharply over the past year.
housing.exampleZh: 过去一年里，这座城市的住房成本急剧上涨。

hover.example: A small bird hovered above the flowers before it flew away.
hover.exampleZh: 一只小鸟在花朵上方盘旋，然后飞走了。

how.example: How do you usually go to school in the morning?
how.exampleZh: 你早上通常怎样去学校？

however.example: The task was hard; however, we finished it on time.
however.exampleZh: 这项任务很难，然而我们按时完成了。

huddle.example: The children huddle together under the blanket to keep warm.
huddle.exampleZh: 孩子们挤在毯子下取暖。

hug.example: She gave her mother a warm hug at the airport.
hug.exampleZh: 她在机场给了妈妈一个温暖的拥抱。

huge.example: The new stadium is huge and can hold thousands of people.
huge.exampleZh: 这座新体育场非常巨大，能容纳数千人。

human.example: Every human needs clean water and fresh air to live a healthy life.
human.exampleZh: 每个人都需要干净的水和新鲜的空气才能过上健康的生活。

humanity.example: The teacher said that all of humanity must work together to protect the earth.
humanity.exampleZh: 老师说全人类必须共同努力保护地球。

humble.example: He is humble about his success and always thanks the people around him.
humble.exampleZh: 他对自己的成功很谦逊，总是感谢身边的人。

humid.example: The air in the small room felt very humid after the rain.
humid.exampleZh: 雨后那个小房间里的空气感觉非常潮湿。

humidity.example: The humidity in the room is very high in summer.
humidity.exampleZh: 夏天房间里的湿度很高。

humiliate.example: He tried to humiliate her in front of the whole class.
humiliate.exampleZh: 他试图在全班同学面前羞辱她。

humor.example: His good humor made the long meeting feel much shorter.
humor.exampleZh: 他良好的幽默感让漫长的会议显得短了许多。

hundred.example: There are about two hundred students in our school this year.
hundred.exampleZh: 今年我们学校大约有两百名学生。

hunger.example: Many children in poor countries still suffer from hunger every day.
hunger.exampleZh: 贫困国家的许多儿童仍然每天忍受饥饿。

hunt.example: The police are hunting for the missing boy in the woods.
hunt.exampleZh: 警察正在树林里搜寻那个失踪的男孩。

hurdle.example: She jumped over the last hurdle and won the race.
hurdle.exampleZh: 她跳过最后一个栏，赢得了比赛。

hurry.example: I had to hurry home because dinner was almost ready.
hurry.exampleZh: 我得赶紧回家，因为晚饭快准备好了。

hurt.example: Be careful with that knife, or you will hurt your hand.
hurt.exampleZh: 小心那把刀，否则你会伤到你的手。

husband.example: My husband cooks dinner for our family every evening after work.
husband.exampleZh: 我丈夫每天下班后都为我们家做晚饭。

hut.example: The old man lives alone in a small hut near the river.
hut.exampleZh: 这位老人独自住在河边的一间小屋里。

hybrid.example: This car is a hybrid that uses both gas and electricity.
hybrid.exampleZh: 这辆车是一种混合动力车，既用汽油又用电。

hydrogen.example: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen, so hydrogen is an important part of it.
hydrogen.exampleZh: 水由氢和氧组成，所以氢是水的重要组成部分。

hypothesis.example: Her hypothesis explains why the test failed.
hypothesis.exampleZh: 她的假设解释了测试失败的原因。

hysterical.example: She became hysterical when she heard the bad news about her friend.
hysterical.exampleZh: 她听到朋友的坏消息时变得歇斯底里。

iambic.example: The poem is written in iambic rhythm, so each line sounds like a heartbeat.
iambic.exampleZh: 这首诗采用抑扬格节奏，所以每一行听起来都像心跳。

iatrogenic.example: The patient's new infection was iatrogenic and came from the hospital treatment.
iatrogenic.exampleZh: 病人的新感染是医源性的，来自医院的治疗。

iceberg.example: The ship hit an iceberg and sank into the cold sea.
iceberg.exampleZh: 那艘船撞上冰山，沉入了冰冷的大海。

icicle.example: An icicle hung from the roof and shone in the morning sun.
icicle.exampleZh: 一根冰柱挂在屋顶上，在晨光中闪闪发亮。

icon.example: The icon on my phone screen opens the camera app.
icon.exampleZh: 我手机屏幕上的这个图标可以打开相机应用。

iconoclasm.example: Her iconoclasm often made the older teachers feel uncomfortable at school.
iconoclasm.exampleZh: 她的反传统做法常让学校里的老教师感到不自在。

iconoclast.example: He is an iconoclast who likes to question old ideas.
iconoclast.exampleZh: 他是一个喜欢质疑旧观念的打破传统的人。

iconography.example: The iconography of the old church tells stories from the Bible.
iconography.exampleZh: 这座古老教堂的图像体系讲述了圣经中的故事。

ideological.example: The two parties have deep ideological differences that make compromise very difficult.
ideological.exampleZh: 这两个政党之间存在深刻的意识形态分歧，使妥协变得非常困难。

ideology.example: The party's ideology shapes how people think about work and family.
ideology.exampleZh: 该政党的意识形态影响着人们如何看待工作和家庭。

idiom.example: Learning an idiom helps you understand how native speakers really talk.
idiom.exampleZh: 学习习语有助于你理解母语者真实的说话方式。

idiomatic.example: Her English sounds very idiomatic because she learned phrases from native speakers.
idiomatic.exampleZh: 她的英语听起来很地道，因为她从母语者那里学到了很多短语。

idiosyncrasy.example: Everyone who knows him accepts his strange idiosyncrasies without much complaint.
idiosyncrasy.exampleZh: 认识他的人都接受他那些奇怪的特质，没什么怨言。

idiosyncratic.example: His idiosyncratic way of speaking made him easy to remember.
idiosyncratic.exampleZh: 他独特的说话方式让他很容易被人记住。

idiot.example: He felt like an idiot after forgetting his friend's name.
idiot.exampleZh: 他忘了朋友的名字，觉得自己像个白痴。

idiotic.example: It was an idiotic idea to drive without checking the brakes first.
idiotic.exampleZh: 不先检查刹车就开车是个愚蠢的主意。

idle.example: He sat idle by the window all afternoon doing nothing.
idle.exampleZh: 他整个下午都无所事事地坐在窗边。

idol.example: Many young fans treat this singer as their idol and copy his style.
idol.exampleZh: 许多年轻粉丝把这位歌手当作偶像，并模仿他的风格。

idolatry.example: Their blind idolatry of the young singer surprised everyone in the small town.
idolatry.exampleZh: 他们对这位年轻歌手的盲目崇拜让小镇上的每个人都感到惊讶。

idolize.example: Many young fans idolize famous singers and copy everything they do.
idolize.exampleZh: 许多年轻粉丝把著名歌手当作偶像崇拜，并模仿他们的一举一动。

idyllic.example: We spent an idyllic weekend by the lake with no phones or noise.
idyllic.exampleZh: 我们在湖边度过了一个田园诗般的周末，没有手机，也没有噪音。

ignite.example: A single match can ignite the dry grass in seconds.
ignite.exampleZh: 一根火柴就能在几秒内点燃干草。

ignition.example: The car's engine would not start because the ignition was broken.
ignition.exampleZh: 汽车的发动机无法启动，因为点火装置坏了。

ignorant.example: He is ignorant of the basic rules of the game.
ignorant.exampleZh: 他对这个游戏的基本规则一无所知。

ignore.example: You should not ignore your health when you are busy with work.
ignore.exampleZh: 忙于工作时，你不应该忽视自己的健康。

illegal.example: It is illegal to park your car on this street.
illegal.exampleZh: 在这条街上停车是违法的。

illegality.example: The court found illegality in the way the contract was signed.
illegality.exampleZh: 法院认定该合同的签署方式存在违法情形。

illegible.example: His handwriting was so illegible that nobody could read the note.
illegible.exampleZh: 他的字迹太模糊了，没人能看懂那张便条。

illegitimate.example: The court refused to accept the illegitimate contract signed by the two men.
illegitimate.exampleZh: 法院拒绝接受这两个人签署的那份非法合同。

illicit.example: The police found illicit drugs in the back of his car.
illicit.exampleZh: 警方在他车后部发现了违禁毒品。

illiterate.example: My grandfather was illiterate, but he could still fix almost anything.
illiterate.exampleZh: 我的祖父不识字，但他仍然几乎什么都能修。

illness.example: His long illness kept him home from school for many weeks.
illness.exampleZh: 他的长期疾病使他在家待了好几个星期没去上学。

illuminate.example: These new facts help illuminate the problem for us.
illuminate.exampleZh: 这些新事实有助于为我们阐明这个问题。

illumination.example: The warm illumination from the lamps made the small room feel cozy.
illumination.exampleZh: 灯发出的温暖照明让这个小房间感觉很舒适。

illusion.example: The mirror created the illusion that the small room was much larger.
illusion.exampleZh: 镜子造成了一种错觉，让这个小房间看起来大得多。

illusory.example: The hope of easy money is often illusory and leads to trouble.
illusory.exampleZh: 轻松赚钱的希望往往是虚幻的，会招来麻烦。

illustrate.example: Let me illustrate my point with a simple example from daily life.
illustrate.exampleZh: 让我用一个日常生活中的简单例子来说明我的观点。

illustrative.example: This chart is illustrative of how the whole system works.
illustrative.exampleZh: 这张图表用于说明整个系统是如何运作的。

image.example: The company wants to improve its image among young customers.
image.exampleZh: 这家公司想在年轻顾客中改善自己的形象。

imagery.example: The poet uses vivid imagery to describe the quiet lake at night.
imagery.exampleZh: 诗人用生动的意象来描写夜晚宁静的湖面。

imaginary.example: The dragon in the story is imaginary, but the children still love it.
imaginary.exampleZh: 故事里的龙是虚构的，但孩子们仍然很喜欢它。

imagination.example: Children have a rich imagination and love to tell funny stories.
imagination.exampleZh: 孩子们有丰富的想象力，喜欢讲有趣的故事。

imaginative.example: She is an imaginative child who often makes up exciting stories.
imaginative.exampleZh: 她是个富有想象力的孩子，常常编出精彩的故事。

imagine.example: I can imagine how happy you felt that day.
imagine.exampleZh: 我能想象你那天有多开心。

imbecile.example: He called me an imbecile just because I forgot his name.
imbecile.exampleZh: 他只是因为我忘了他的名字就叫我蠢人。

imitate.example: Many young children imitate their parents when they learn to speak.
imitate.exampleZh: 许多幼儿在学说话时会模仿他们的父母。

imitation.example: Children learn language through imitation of the people around them.
imitation.exampleZh: 孩子们通过模仿周围的人来学习语言。

immaculate.example: Her small kitchen was immaculate, with every dish and spoon in its place.
immaculate.exampleZh: 她的小厨房一尘不染，每件餐具和勺子都放在原位。

immature.example: He is still too immature to make such an important decision on his own.
immature.exampleZh: 他还太不成熟，无法独自做出这么重要的决定。

immediate.example: Please give me an immediate answer to my simple question.
immediate.exampleZh: 请立即回答我这个简单的问题。

immense.example: The immense tree in our garden gives shade to the whole family.
immense.exampleZh: 我们花园里那棵巨大的树为全家人遮阴。

immersion.example: Language immersion helps students learn faster than studying grammar rules alone.
immersion.exampleZh: 语言沉浸式学习比单纯学习语法规则能帮助学生学得更快。

immigrant.example: The immigrant works hard to build a new life in this city.
immigrant.exampleZh: 这位移民努力工作，想在这座城市建立新的生活。

immigrate.example: Many families immigrate to this country to find better jobs and safer lives.
immigrate.exampleZh: 许多家庭移居到这个国家，为了找到更好的工作和更安全的生活。

imminent.example: Dark clouds gathered, and everyone knew a heavy storm was imminent.
imminent.exampleZh: 乌云聚集，大家都知道一场暴风雨即将来临。

immolation.example: The ancient story describes the immolation of a lamb on the stone altar.
immolation.exampleZh: 这个古老的故事描述了在石祭坛上献祭一只羔羊。

immune.example: After the vaccine, she was immune to that disease and felt much safer.
immune.exampleZh: 接种疫苗后，她对那种疾病有了免疫力，感觉安全多了。

immunology.example: She studies immunology at the university because she wants to help sick people.
immunology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习免疫学，因为她想帮助生病的人。

impact.example: The new road had a big impact on traffic in our town.
impact.exampleZh: 这条新路对我们镇上的交通产生了很大影响。

impair.example: Too much noise can impair your hearing over a long time.
impair.exampleZh: 长期处于过多噪音中会损害你的听力。

impalpable.example: The difference between the two wines was impalpable to most people.
impalpable.exampleZh: 这两种葡萄酒之间的差别对大多数人来说难以察觉。

impart.example: My grandmother liked to impart her cooking skills to us.
impart.exampleZh: 我奶奶喜欢把她的烹饪技巧传授给我们。

impartial.example: A good judge must stay impartial and listen to both sides of the story.
impartial.exampleZh: 一位好法官必须保持公正，听取双方的说法。

impassioned.example: She made an impassioned speech about protecting the city's parks.
impassioned.exampleZh: 她发表了一场慷慨激昂的演讲，呼吁保护城市的公园。

impassive.example: He kept an impassive face during the whole meeting.
impassive.exampleZh: 整个会议期间他一直面无表情。

impatient.example: The children were impatient to open their gifts on Christmas morning.
impatient.exampleZh: 孩子们急切地想在圣诞节早上打开礼物。

impeach.example: The House voted to impeach the president for abuse of power.
impeach.exampleZh: 众议院投票决定以滥用权力为由弹劾总统。

impeccable.example: Her English is impeccable, and everyone in the office trusts her writing.
impeccable.exampleZh: 她的英语无可挑剔，办公室里的每个人都信任她的写作。

impecunious.example: The impecunious young man could not pay for his dinner last night.
impecunious.exampleZh: 那个身无分文的年轻人昨晚付不起他的晚餐钱。

impede.example: Heavy rain may impede the rescue team's work in the mountains.
impede.exampleZh: 大雨可能会阻碍救援队在山区的工作。

impediment.example: A lack of money was a serious impediment to his education.
impediment.exampleZh: 缺钱是他接受教育的一个严重障碍。

impel.example: Strong wind impelled the small boat toward the rocky shore.
impel.exampleZh: 强风把小船推向多岩石的海岸。

impenetrable.example: The thick walls of the old castle were impenetrable to any attack.
impenetrable.exampleZh: 那座古老城堡的厚墙任何进攻都无法攻破。

imperative.example: It is imperative that we act now to protect the children.
imperative.exampleZh: 我们现在就必须采取行动保护孩子们，这一点至关重要。

imperceptible.example: The change in his voice was so slight that it was almost imperceptible.
imperceptible.exampleZh: 他声音的变化非常轻微，几乎察觉不到。

imperfection.example: Every person has some imperfections, and we should accept them with kindness.
imperfection.exampleZh: 每个人都有一些缺点，我们应该以善意接受它们。

imperial.example: The imperial palace in Beijing is very large and famous.
imperial.exampleZh: 北京的皇宫非常大而且著名。

imperialism.example: Many history books say that imperialism brought great harm to smaller countries.
imperialism.exampleZh: 许多历史书说帝国主义给小国带来了巨大伤害。

imperil.example: Smoking can imperil your health and the health of people around you.
imperil.exampleZh: 吸烟会危及你的健康以及你身边人的健康。

imperious.example: The imperious manager demanded that everyone stop talking and listen to him at once.
imperious.exampleZh: 那位专横的经理要求所有人立刻停止说话，听他讲。

impersonate.example: He tried to impersonate a police officer to enter the building.
impersonate.exampleZh: 他试图冒充警察进入那栋大楼。

impertinent.example: It was impertinent of him to ask about her salary.
impertinent.exampleZh: 他问她薪水的事，这样做很不礼貌。

imperturbable.example: The teacher stayed imperturbable even when the students made a lot of noise.
imperturbable.exampleZh: 即使学生们非常吵闹，老师依然保持沉着。

impervious.example: This jacket is impervious to rain, so you can walk outside in a storm.
impervious.exampleZh: 这件夹克不透水，所以你可以在暴风雨中在外面走。

impetuous.example: His impetuous decision to quit school surprised all of his friends.
impetuous.exampleZh: 他冲动地决定退学，这让所有朋友都很吃惊。

impetus.example: The new policy gave a strong impetus to local business growth.
impetus.exampleZh: 这项新政策有力地推动了当地企业的增长。

impiety.example: His impiety shocked the old villagers who went to the temple every day.
impiety.exampleZh: 他的不虔敬让每天去寺庙的老村民们感到震惊。

impinge.example: Her problems never impinge on the work we do together.
impinge.exampleZh: 她的问题从不会影响我们一起做的工作。

impious.example: The impious son never visited his old parents.
impious.exampleZh: 这个不孝的儿子从不看望年迈的父母。

impish.example: The impish boy hid his sister's shoes and laughed at her.
impish.exampleZh: 那个顽皮的小男孩把妹妹的鞋藏了起来，还冲她笑。

implacable.example: The implacable old man refused to forgive his neighbor for a small mistake.
implacable.exampleZh: 那个固执的老人因为一个小错误而拒绝原谅他的邻居。

implant.example: Doctors often implant a small device to help a weak heart.
implant.exampleZh: 医生常植入一个小装置来帮助衰弱的心脏。

implausible.example: The excuse he gave for being late sounded implausible to everyone in the room.
implausible.exampleZh: 他为迟到给出的借口在屋里所有人听来都不像真的。

implement.example: The team will implement the new plan next week with simple tools.
implement.exampleZh: 团队下周将用简单的工具实施这项新计划。

implicate.example: The new evidence may implicate several people in the crime.
implicate.exampleZh: 新证据可能会牵连几个人与这起犯罪有关。

implicature.example: His implicature was clear even though he never said it directly.
implicature.exampleZh: 尽管他从未直接说出来，他的言外之意仍很清楚。

implicit.example: There was an implicit warning in her quiet voice.
implicit.exampleZh: 她平静的声音里带着一种含蓄的警告。

implore.example: She implored the doctor to save her little dog.
implore.exampleZh: 她恳求医生救救她的小狗。

implosion.example: The sudden implosion of the old building shook the ground.
implosion.exampleZh: 那座旧建筑的突然内爆震动了地面。

imply.example: Her quiet smile seemed to imply that she already knew the answer.
imply.exampleZh: 她安静的微笑似乎暗示她已经知道答案了。

impolitic.example: It was impolitic to criticize your boss during the meeting.
impolitic.exampleZh: 在会上批评你的老板是不明智的。

import.example: The country imports most of its oil from abroad, so prices matter a lot.
import.exampleZh: 这个国家大部分石油依靠进口，所以价格影响很大。

importunate.example: The importunate salesman called me three times before I finally said yes.
importunate.exampleZh: 那个纠缠不休的推销员在我最终答应之前给我打了三次电话。

impose.example: The government decided to impose new taxes on large companies this year.
impose.exampleZh: 政府决定今年对大公司征收新税。

imposing.example: The old library is an imposing building with tall stone walls.
imposing.exampleZh: 这座古老的图书馆是一座有着高耸石墙的宏伟建筑。

impossibility.example: It is a physical impossibility for one person to lift this heavy box alone.
impossibility.exampleZh: 一个人独自抬起这个沉重的箱子在物理上是不可能的。

impostor.example: The police caught the impostor who pretended to be a doctor.
impostor.exampleZh: 警方抓住了那个冒充医生的骗子。

impotence.example: He felt a deep sense of impotence when he could not help his friend.
impotence.exampleZh: 当他无法帮助朋友时，他感到一种深深的无力感。

impotent.example: He felt impotent when he could not help his sick mother.
impotent.exampleZh: 当他无法帮助生病的母亲时，他感到无能为力。

impoverish.example: Years of war and drought have impoverished this small farming village.
impoverish.exampleZh: 多年的战争和干旱使这个小村庄变得贫困。

impractical.example: His plan to finish all the work today is completely impractical.
impractical.exampleZh: 他今天完成所有工作的计划完全不切实际。

impregnable.example: The old castle was impregnable, so the enemy army could not take it.
impregnable.exampleZh: 这座古老的城堡坚不可摧，所以敌军无法攻下它。

impression.example: My first impression of this city was very good.
impression.exampleZh: 我对这座城市的第一印象非常好。

impressive.example: Her speech at the meeting was really impressive and made everyone think.
impressive.exampleZh: 她在会上的演讲真的很令人印象深刻，让每个人都认真思考。

imprimatur.example: The book could not be printed without the official imprimatur of the church.
imprimatur.exampleZh: 没有教会的正式批准，这本书就不能印刷。

imprint.example: The teacher's words left a deep imprint on my mind.
imprint.exampleZh: 老师的话在我心中留下了深深的印记。

imprison.example: The judge decided to imprison him for three years for stealing the money.
imprison.exampleZh: 法官决定因他偷钱而判处他三年监禁。

impromptu.example: She gave an impromptu speech at the party and everyone loved it.
impromptu.exampleZh: 她在聚会上做了一段即兴演讲，大家都很喜欢。

improve.example: Reading English books every day can improve your writing skills.
improve.exampleZh: 每天读英文书能提高你的写作能力。

improvise.example: When the piano broke, she had to improvise a song with her voice.
improvise.exampleZh: 钢琴坏了，她只好用嗓音即兴创作了一首歌。

imprudent.example: It was imprudent of him to lend her all his money.
imprudent.exampleZh: 他把所有的钱都借给她，真是太不谨慎了。

impudent.example: It was impudent of him to ask for more money after doing so little.
impudent.exampleZh: 他干了那么少的活还想要更多钱，真是厚颜无耻。

impugn.example: Do not impugn his honesty without clear proof.
impugn.exampleZh: 没有明确的证据，不要质疑他的诚实。

impulse.example: She bought the dress on impulse without thinking about the price.
impulse.exampleZh: 她一时冲动买下了那条裙子，没有考虑价格。

impulsive.example: He is too impulsive to think carefully before making big decisions.
impulsive.exampleZh: 他太冲动了，做大决定之前不会仔细思考。

inability.example: His inability to swim kept him away from the deep water.
inability.exampleZh: 他因为不会游泳而不敢靠近深水区。

inaccessible.example: The old road is now inaccessible to cars after the storm.
inaccessible.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，这条旧路现在汽车无法通行。

inaccuracy.example: The small inaccuracy in the report caused a big problem for our team.
inaccuracy.exampleZh: 报告中的这个小误差给我们团队带来了大麻烦。

inaccurate.example: The weather report was inaccurate, so we got caught in the rain.
inaccurate.exampleZh: 天气预报不准确，所以我们被雨淋了。

inaction.example: His inaction made the problem worse than it needed to be.
inaction.exampleZh: 他的不作为让问题变得比原本更糟。

inactive.example: The old account is inactive, so you cannot use it now.
inactive.exampleZh: 那个旧账户已闲置，所以你现在不能使用它。

inadequate.example: The old computer is inadequate for running the new software.
inadequate.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑不足以运行新软件。

inadvertent.example: His inadvertent comment hurt her feelings at the party last night.
inadvertent.exampleZh: 他昨晚在聚会上无意间的一句评论伤害了她的感情。

inane.example: His inane comments made the whole meeting feel like a waste of time.
inane.exampleZh: 他那些空洞愚蠢的评论让整个会议感觉像是在浪费时间。

inanimate.example: The children talked to the inanimate toys as if they were alive.
inanimate.exampleZh: 孩子们对着那些没有生命的玩具说话，好像它们是活的一样。

inappropriate.example: It is inappropriate to wear shorts to a formal job interview.
inappropriate.exampleZh: 穿短裤去参加正式的工作面试是不合适的。

inarticulate.example: He was too inarticulate to explain his feelings clearly.
inarticulate.exampleZh: 他太不善言辞，无法清楚地解释自己的感受。

inasmuch.example: Inasmuch as it was raining, we stayed at home all day.
inasmuch.exampleZh: 因为下雨，我们整天都待在家里。

inattention.example: His inattention to detail caused several small mistakes in the report.
inattention.exampleZh: 他对细节的疏忽导致报告中出现了几个小错误。

inattentive.example: The inattentive driver did not see the red light.
inattentive.exampleZh: 那个漫不经心的司机没有看到红灯。

inaudible.example: The music was so quiet that it was inaudible to most people.
inaudible.exampleZh: 音乐声太轻了，大多数人几乎听不见。

inaugural.example: The president gave his inaugural speech on a cold January morning.
inaugural.exampleZh: 总统在一个寒冷的一月早晨发表了就职演说。

inaugurate.example: The city will inaugurate its new library next week.
inaugurate.exampleZh: 该市将于下周为新图书馆举行开幕仪式。

inauguration.example: The inauguration of the new library will take place next Monday morning.
inauguration.exampleZh: 新图书馆的落成典礼将于下周一上午举行。

inauspicious.example: It was an inauspicious start when the car would not move.
inauspicious.exampleZh: 汽车发动不了，这是一个不祥的开端。

inborn.example: She has an inborn talent for music and loves to sing.
inborn.exampleZh: 她天生有音乐天赋，喜欢唱歌。

inbound.example: The inbound flight arrived on time this morning.
inbound.exampleZh: 这趟入境航班今天早上准时到达。

inbox.example: I check my inbox every morning before I start work.
inbox.exampleZh: 我每天早上开始工作前都会查看收件箱。

incalculable.example: The storm caused incalculable damage to the small coastal town.
incalculable.exampleZh: 这场风暴给那个沿海小镇造成了无法估量的损失。

incandescent.example: The incandescent bulb glowed warmly above the dinner table.
incandescent.exampleZh: 白炽灯泡在餐桌上方温暖地发着光。

incapacitate.example: The accident may incapacitate him for work for several weeks.
incapacitate.exampleZh: 这场事故可能使他数周无法工作。

incapacity.example: His illness caused a temporary incapacity to work for several weeks.
incapacity.exampleZh: 他的病导致他暂时无法工作了几周。

incarceration.example: His ten years of incarceration changed him into a quiet and careful man.
incarceration.exampleZh: 十年的牢狱生活使他变成了一个沉默而谨慎的人。

incarnation.example: She is the living incarnation of kindness and patience in our classroom.
incarnation.exampleZh: 她是我们班里善良与耐心的鲜活化身。

incendiary.example: The police found an incendiary device near the old building last night.
incendiary.exampleZh: 昨晚，警方在那栋旧楼附近发现了一个燃烧装置。

incense.example: The sweet incense filled the small room and made everyone feel calm.
incense.exampleZh: 甜甜的香气充满了小房间，让每个人都感到平静。

incentive.example: The company offers a cash bonus as an incentive for good work.
incentive.exampleZh: 公司提供现金奖金作为好好工作的激励。

inception.example: Since its inception, the small club has grown into a large group.
inception.exampleZh: 自成立之初起，这个小俱乐部已经发展成为了一个大团体。

incessant.example: The baby's incessant crying kept the whole family awake all night.
incessant.exampleZh: 婴儿不停歇的哭声让全家人整夜都没睡着。

inchoate.example: Her inchoate plan was still too vague to explain to the group.
inchoate.exampleZh: 她那尚在初期的计划还太模糊，无法向大家解释。

incidence.example: The incidence of the disease is higher in older people.
incidence.exampleZh: 这种疾病在老年人中的发生率更高。

incident.example: The small incident at the station taught us to be more careful.
incident.exampleZh: 车站的那起小事件教会了我们要更加小心。

incidental.example: This problem is incidental and should not worry us too much.
incidental.exampleZh: 这个问题是偶然的，不应让我们过于担心。

incinerate.example: The old factory was built to incinerate waste safely every day.
incinerate.exampleZh: 这座旧工厂是为了每天安全焚毁垃圾而建的。

incipient.example: The doctor noticed the incipient signs of the disease early.
incipient.exampleZh: 医生很早就注意到了这种疾病的初期迹象。

incision.example: The doctor made a small incision in his leg to remove the glass.
incision.exampleZh: 医生在他的腿上切了一个小切口，以取出玻璃。

incisive.example: Her incisive question made the whole team rethink the plan.
incisive.exampleZh: 她那尖锐的问题让整个团队重新思考了这个计划。

incite.example: The loud speech helped incite the crowd to break the rules.
incite.exampleZh: 那场大声的演讲帮助煽动人群去违反规则。

incivility.example: His incivility at the meeting made everyone feel uncomfortable and upset.
incivility.exampleZh: 他在会上的无礼让每个人都感到不舒服和心烦。

inclination.example: He has a strong inclination to help others when they need it.
inclination.exampleZh: 当别人需要帮助时，他有一种强烈的倾向去帮助他们。

incline.example: The road inclines sharply here, so please walk slowly and carefully.
incline.exampleZh: 这条路在这里急剧倾斜，所以请慢慢小心地走。

include.example: The price includes breakfast and free Wi-Fi in every room.
include.exampleZh: 这个价格包括早餐以及每个房间的免费无线网络。

inclusive.example: Our school is an inclusive place where every student feels welcome and safe.
inclusive.exampleZh: 我们学校是一个包容的地方，每个学生都感到受欢迎和安心。

incognito.example: The famous writer often travels incognito so that people will not recognize him.
incognito.exampleZh: 这位著名作家常常匿名旅行，这样人们就不会认出他。

incoherent.example: His speech was incoherent because he was too tired to think clearly.
incoherent.exampleZh: 他的讲话语无伦次，因为他太累了，无法清晰思考。

income.example: Her monthly income is enough to pay the rent and buy food.
income.exampleZh: 她的月收入足够支付房租和购买食物。

incoming.example: The incoming train is late again this morning.
incoming.exampleZh: 今天早上进来的那趟火车又晚点了。

incommensurate.example: His small salary is incommensurate with the long hours he works.
incommensurate.exampleZh: 他微薄的薪水与他长时间的工作不相称。

incommode.example: I hope my early call did not incommode you too much this morning.
incommode.exampleZh: 希望我今早打来的电话没有太打扰你。

incomparable.example: Her kindness to the old man was incomparable and touched everyone in the town.
incomparable.exampleZh: 她对那位老人的善良无可比拟，感动了镇上的每一个人。

incompatible.example: His plan is incompatible with the needs of our team.
incompatible.exampleZh: 他的计划与我们团队的需求不相容。

incompetent.example: The new manager is completely incompetent and cannot solve simple problems.
incompetent.exampleZh: 新经理完全不胜任，连简单的问题都解决不了。

incomplete.example: My essay is incomplete because I lost the last page.
incomplete.exampleZh: 我的文章不完整，因为我把最后一页弄丢了。

incomprehensible.example: The teacher's explanation was so fast that it became completely incomprehensible to most students.
incomprehensible.exampleZh: 老师的讲解太快了，对大多数学生来说变得完全无法理解。

inconceivable.example: It is inconceivable that she would forget her own birthday.
inconceivable.exampleZh: 她竟然会忘记自己的生日，这真是难以置信。

inconclusive.example: The test results were inconclusive, so the doctor ordered more tests.
inconclusive.exampleZh: 检查结果不确定，所以医生安排了更多检查。

incongruous.example: His loud laugh was incongruous in the quiet library.
incongruous.exampleZh: 他响亮的笑声在安静的图书馆里显得很不协调。

inconsequential.example: Do not worry about such inconsequential details and focus on the main goal.
inconsequential.exampleZh: 不要为这些微不足道的细节担心，专注于主要目标。

inconsiderable.example: The cost was inconsiderable, so we did not worry about it.
inconsiderable.exampleZh: 费用微不足道，所以我们并不担心。

inconsiderate.example: It was inconsiderate of him to play loud music late at night.
inconsiderate.exampleZh: 他深夜大声放音乐，真是不体谅人。

inconsistency.example: The inconsistency in his story made the police doubt him.
inconsistency.exampleZh: 他叙述中的前后矛盾让警方对他产生了怀疑。

inconsistent.example: His story was inconsistent with the facts we already knew.
inconsistent.exampleZh: 他的说法与我们已经知道的事实不一致。

inconspicuous.example: She wore an inconspicuous gray coat and stood quietly by the door.
inconspicuous.exampleZh: 她穿着一件不显眼的灰色外套，静静地站在门边。

inconstancy.example: His inconstancy made it hard for friends to trust his promises.
inconstancy.exampleZh: 他的反复无常让朋友们很难相信他的承诺。

incontestable.example: Her answer was so clear and simple that it was incontestable.
incontestable.exampleZh: 她的回答如此清晰简单，以至于无可争辩。

incontrovertible.example: The video gave us incontrovertible proof that he was there.
incontrovertible.exampleZh: 那段视频给了我们无可辩驳的证据，证明他当时在场。

inconvenience.example: The road work caused a lot of inconvenience for people living nearby.
inconvenience.exampleZh: 道路施工给附近的居民带来了很多不便。

incorporate.example: We will incorporate your ideas into the new plan next week.
incorporate.exampleZh: 我们下周会把你的想法纳入新计划中。

incorrect.example: The answer on your test is incorrect, so please try again.
incorrect.exampleZh: 你试卷上的答案不正确，所以请再试一次。

incorrigible.example: He is an incorrigible liar who never tells the truth.
incorrigible.exampleZh: 他是个屡教不改的骗子，从不说实话。

incorruptible.example: The incorruptible judge never took money from anyone.
incorruptible.exampleZh: 那位廉洁的法官从不接受任何人的钱。

increase.example: The company plans to increase its sales by ten percent this year.
increase.exampleZh: 公司计划今年将销售额提高百分之十。

incredible.example: The view from the top of the mountain was incredible.
incredible.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的风景令人难以置信。

increment.example: The company offered him a small increment in salary after his first year.
increment.exampleZh: 第一年之后，公司给他小幅加薪。

incriminate.example: The police found new evidence to incriminate the man in the robbery case.
incriminate.exampleZh: 警方找到了新证据，证明这名男子与这起抢劫案有关。

incubate.example: The mother bird stays on the nest to incubate her eggs until they hatch.
incubate.exampleZh: 鸟妈妈待在巢里孵蛋，直到它们孵化出来。

incubus.example: The fear of failure became an incubus that haunted him every night.
incubus.exampleZh: 对失败的恐惧成了一个梦魇，每晚都纠缠着他。

inculcate.example: Parents should inculcate good habits in their children from an early age.
inculcate.exampleZh: 父母应该从小就向孩子反复灌输良好的习惯。

incumbent.example: The incumbent mayor will run again in the next election.
incumbent.exampleZh: 现任市长将参加下一届选举。

incur.example: Careless driving can incur heavy fines and serious trouble.
incur.exampleZh: 粗心驾驶会招致高额罚款和严重麻烦。

incurable.example: The doctor said the disease was incurable, so we tried to make him comfortable.
incurable.exampleZh: 医生说这种病无法治愈，所以我们尽量让他舒服一些。

incursion.example: The soldiers fought hard to stop the sudden incursion into their land.
incursion.exampleZh: 士兵们奋力阻止对本国领土的突然入侵。

indebted.example: I am deeply indebted to my parents for their endless love and support.
indebted.exampleZh: 我非常感激父母无尽的关爱与支持。

indecent.example: His indecent jokes made everyone at the dinner table uncomfortable.
indecent.exampleZh: 他不堪入耳的笑话让餐桌上的每个人都很不舒服。

indecisive.example: He was too indecisive to choose between the two jobs.
indecisive.exampleZh: 他太犹豫不决，无法在两个工作之间做出选择。

indecorous.example: His loud joke at the dinner table was indecorous and made everyone uncomfortable.
indecorous.exampleZh: 他在餐桌上的大声玩笑很不得体，让所有人都感到不自在。

indefatigable.example: Her indefatigable effort helped the small team finish the hard project.
indefatigable.exampleZh: 她不懈的努力帮助这个小团队完成了这个艰难的项目。

indefeasible.example: Every citizen has an indefeasible right to a fair trial under the law.
indefeasible.exampleZh: 每个公民都依法享有不可剥夺的公正审判权。

indefensible.example: His decision to ignore the warning was completely indefensible.
indefensible.exampleZh: 他无视警告的决定是完全站不住脚的。

indefinite.example: The meeting was put off for an indefinite period because of the storm.
indefinite.exampleZh: 由于暴风雨，会议被无限期推迟了。

indelible.example: The memory of that day left an indelible mark on my mind.
indelible.exampleZh: 那一天的记忆在我心中留下了不可磨灭的印记。

indemnity.example: The insurance company paid an indemnity for the damage to the house.
indemnity.exampleZh: 保险公司为房屋受损支付了赔偿金。

indenture.example: The young man signed an indenture to learn the trade for five years.
indenture.exampleZh: 那个年轻人为学习这门手艺签了一份为期五年的师徒契约。

independence.example: She moved to a new city and learned what independence really means.
independence.exampleZh: 她搬到一个新城市，才真正明白独立意味着什么。

independent.example: She is an independent thinker who likes to solve problems alone.
independent.exampleZh: 她是一个喜欢独自解决问题的独立思考者。

index.example: The library has an index to help you find books.
index.exampleZh: 图书馆有一个索引帮你查找书籍。

indicate.example: Dark clouds often indicate that rain is coming soon.
indicate.exampleZh: 乌云常常表明很快就要下雨了。

indicative.example: Dark clouds are often indicative of rain coming soon.
indicative.exampleZh: 乌云常常预示着很快就要下雨。

indicator.example: The number of cars on the road is a good indicator of traffic.
indicator.exampleZh: 路上的汽车数量是交通状况的良好指标。

indict.example: The police decided to indict him for stealing money from the company.
indict.exampleZh: 警方决定以从公司偷钱的罪名起诉他。

indictable.example: Murder is an indictable crime in most countries.
indictable.exampleZh: 在大多数国家，谋杀都是可起诉的罪行。

indifferent.example: She seems indifferent to the cold weather and never wears a coat.
indifferent.exampleZh: 她似乎对寒冷的天气毫不在意，从不穿外套。

indigenous.example: The museum shows the art of indigenous people from this region.
indigenous.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了这个地区土著人的艺术作品。

indigent.example: The indigent family could not pay for their children's school books.
indigent.exampleZh: 这个贫困的家庭付不起孩子们的课本费。

indignant.example: She was indignant when she learned that her work had been ignored.
indignant.exampleZh: 当她得知自己的工作被忽视时，她感到愤慨。

indignation.example: She felt deep indignation when she saw the unfair treatment of the workers.
indignation.exampleZh: 当她看到工人们受到不公平的对待时，她感到深深的愤慨。

indignity.example: He felt a deep indignity when they laughed at his old clothes.
indignity.exampleZh: 当他们嘲笑他的旧衣服时，他感到深深的侮辱。

indirect.example: The report gave only indirect evidence of the problem.
indirect.exampleZh: 这份报告只提供了问题的间接证据。

indiscreet.example: It was indiscreet of him to share the secret with strangers.
indiscreet.exampleZh: 他把秘密告诉陌生人，这样做很不慎重。

indiscretion.example: He later regretted his indiscretion at the party last night.
indiscretion.exampleZh: 他后来后悔昨晚在聚会上的轻率言行。

indiscriminate.example: The storm caused indiscriminate damage to houses, trees and cars.
indiscriminate.exampleZh: 这场风暴对房屋、树木和汽车造成了不分对象的破坏。

indispensable.example: A good teacher is indispensable to every student who wants to learn.
indispensable.exampleZh: 对每个想学习的学生来说，一位好老师都是不可或缺的。

indisputable.example: The fact that she works harder than anyone else is indisputable to us.
indisputable.exampleZh: 她比任何人都更努力，这一点对我们来说无可争辩。

indistinct.example: The old photo was faint and indistinct, so I could not see the faces clearly.
indistinct.exampleZh: 那张旧照片又淡又模糊，我看不清上面的脸。

indistinguishable.example: The twins look so similar that they are almost indistinguishable to me.
indistinguishable.exampleZh: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，对我来说几乎无法区分。

individual.example: Each individual student has a different way of learning new words.
individual.exampleZh: 每个个别学生都有不同的学习新单词的方法。

individualism.example: Too much individualism can make a team weak and hard to lead.
individualism.exampleZh: 过多的个人主义会让团队变得薄弱且难以领导。

indivisible.example: The country is one indivisible nation, and the people will always stay together.
indivisible.exampleZh: 这个国家是一个不可分割的民族，人民将永远团结在一起。

indolent.example: The indolent boy spent all afternoon sleeping on the sofa.
indolent.exampleZh: 那个懒散的男孩整个下午都躺在沙发上睡觉。

indomitable.example: Her indomitable spirit helped her finish the race despite the injury.
indomitable.exampleZh: 尽管受伤，她不屈不挠的精神帮助她跑完了比赛。

indoor.example: The children play indoor games on rainy days.
indoor.exampleZh: 下雨天孩子们在室内玩游戏。

induce.example: Stress can induce serious health problems in many people.
induce.exampleZh: 压力会诱发许多人的严重健康问题。

inducement.example: The money was a strong inducement for him to take the new job.
inducement.exampleZh: 这笔钱是他接受这份新工作的强有力诱因。

indulge.example: Parents should not indulge their children too much at home.
indulge.exampleZh: 父母在家里不应该太纵容孩子。

indulgent.example: Her indulgent parents let her stay up late every night.
indulgent.exampleZh: 她溺爱的父母允许她每天晚上熬夜。

industrial.example: This city is famous for its large industrial area and many factories.
industrial.exampleZh: 这座城市以其大型工业区和众多工厂而闻名。

industrious.example: She is an industrious worker who always finishes her tasks on time.
industrious.exampleZh: 她是个勤奋的员工，总是按时完成工作。

inebriated.example: The man was clearly inebriated after drinking too much beer at the party.
inebriated.exampleZh: 那个男人在聚会上喝了太多啤酒后明显醉了。

ineffable.example: The beauty of the sunset was ineffable and left us silent.
ineffable.exampleZh: 日落的美难以言喻，让我们默默无言。

ineffective.example: The old medicine was ineffective, so the doctor gave him a new one.
ineffective.exampleZh: 这种旧药不起作用，所以医生给他换了一种新药。
