inefficient.example: This old machine is inefficient and wastes a lot of time.
inefficient.exampleZh: 这台旧机器效率低，浪费了很多时间。

ineligible.example: He is ineligible for the job because he has no experience.
ineligible.exampleZh: 他没有经验，所以没有资格做这份工作。

inept.example: He was fired because his inept handling of the project cost the company money.
inept.exampleZh: 他因为对这个项目的处理不当给公司造成了损失而被解雇。

ineptitude.example: His ineptitude at fixing the sink made the problem much worse.
ineptitude.exampleZh: 他修水槽时的笨手笨脚让问题变得更糟了。

inequality.example: The gap between rich and poor shows a clear inequality in our society today.
inequality.exampleZh: 贫富差距体现了当今社会明显的不平等现象。

inequity.example: The workers complained about the inequity in pay between the two teams.
inequity.exampleZh: 工人们抱怨两个团队之间薪酬上的不公平。

inerrancy.example: Many people question the inerrancy of old books and ancient stories.
inerrancy.exampleZh: 许多人质疑古书和古老故事的绝对正确性。

inert.example: The chemical is inert and does not react with water at room temperature.
inert.exampleZh: 这种化学物质是惰性的，在室温下不与水反应。

inertia.example: It takes effort to overcome inertia and start exercising regularly.
inertia.exampleZh: 要克服惰性并开始定期锻炼需要付出努力。

inescapable.example: It is an inescapable fact that we must work harder to succeed.
inescapable.exampleZh: 我们必须更加努力才能成功，这是一个不可避免的事实。

inestimable.example: Her help during that hard time was inestimable to our whole family.
inestimable.exampleZh: 在那段艰难时期，她的帮助对我们全家来说是无价的。

inevitable.example: With so little time left, mistakes were inevitable in the final report.
inevitable.exampleZh: 剩下的时间太少，最终报告里出错是不可避免的。

inexhaustible.example: Her patience with the children seemed inexhaustible, even after a long day.
inexhaustible.exampleZh: 她对孩子们的耐心似乎无穷无尽，即使忙了一整天之后也是如此。

inexorable.example: The inexorable rise of prices made life hard for many poor families.
inexorable.exampleZh: 物价不可阻挡的上涨让许多贫困家庭生活艰难。

inexperienced.example: She is young and inexperienced, so please help her with this task.
inexperienced.exampleZh: 她年轻又缺乏经验，所以请帮她完成这项任务。

inexplicable.example: The sudden change in his mood was inexplicable to everyone in the room.
inexplicable.exampleZh: 他情绪的突然变化让房间里的每个人都无法解释。

infallible.example: No one is infallible, so we should check our work carefully.
infallible.exampleZh: 没有人是永无过失的，所以我们应该仔细检查自己的工作。

infamous.example: This street is infamous for its noisy bars and dirty restaurants.
infamous.exampleZh: 这条街因吵闹的酒吧和脏乱的餐馆而臭名昭著。

infancy.example: The idea was still in its infancy when we first discussed it.
infancy.exampleZh: 我们最初讨论这个想法时，它还处于初期阶段。

infant.example: The infant slept quietly in her mother's arms all afternoon.
infant.exampleZh: 那个婴儿整个下午都在母亲的怀里安静地睡着。

infatuated.example: He is so infatuated with her that he thinks about her all day.
infatuated.exampleZh: 他如此迷恋她，以至于整天都在想她。

infect.example: The sick child can infect others with the virus at school.
infect.exampleZh: 那个生病的孩子可能在学校把病毒传染给别人。

infection.example: The doctor said the infection is getting better with the new medicine.
infection.exampleZh: 医生说，用了这种新药，感染正在好转。

infectious.example: Her laughter is infectious and makes everyone in the room smile.
infectious.exampleZh: 她的笑声很有感染力，让房间里的每个人都笑了起来。

infer.example: We can infer from his smile that he is very happy today.
infer.exampleZh: 我们可以从他的微笑推断出他今天很开心。

inference.example: She made an inference about the answer from the clues.
inference.exampleZh: 她根据线索对答案做出了推断。

inferior.example: This old phone is inferior to my new one in every way.
inferior.exampleZh: 这部旧手机在各方面都比我新买的这部差。

inferno.example: The old factory turned into an inferno within minutes after the explosion.
inferno.exampleZh: 爆炸后，那座旧工厂在几分钟内变成了一片火海。

infertile.example: The dry, sandy soil here is too infertile for most crops to grow well.
infertile.exampleZh: 这里干燥的沙质土壤太贫瘠，大多数作物都无法良好生长。

infestation.example: The old house had a bad infestation of rats and insects.
infestation.exampleZh: 那栋老房子有严重的鼠虫侵扰。

infidel.example: The old king did not allow any infidel to enter his city.
infidel.exampleZh: 这位老国王不允许任何异教徒进入他的城市。

infinite.example: The night sky seems infinite when you look at all those stars.
infinite.exampleZh: 当你望着那些星星时，夜空显得无限广阔。

infinitesimal.example: The chance of that happening is infinitesimal, so we should not worry.
infinitesimal.exampleZh: 那件事发生的几率极小，所以我们不用担心。

infinitive.example: In English class we learned that the infinitive form of a verb usually begins with to.
infinitive.exampleZh: 在英语课上，我们学到了动词的不定式形式通常以 to 开头。

infinity.example: The night sky seems to stretch into infinity above us.
infinity.exampleZh: 夜空在我们头顶似乎一直延伸到无限之中。

infirm.example: The infirm old man walks slowly with a wooden stick.
infirm.exampleZh: 那位体弱的老人拄着木棍慢慢走。

infirmary.example: The nurse took the sick boy to the infirmary after he fell down.
infirmary.exampleZh: 那个男孩摔倒后，护士把这名生病的孩子送到了医务室。

inflame.example: His rude words only served to inflame the angry crowd.
inflame.exampleZh: 他那番粗鲁的话只是让愤怒的人群更加激愤。

inflammable.example: The old wooden house is inflammable, so never use fire near it.
inflammable.exampleZh: 那座旧木屋易燃，所以千万别在附近用火。

inflammation.example: The doctor gave him some medicine to reduce the inflammation in his knee.
inflammation.exampleZh: 医生给了他一些药，以减轻他膝盖的炎症。

inflate.example: Prices will inflate quickly if the government prints too much money.
inflate.exampleZh: 如果政府印太多钱，物价就会迅速上涨。

inflation.example: The country is facing high inflation and rising food prices this year.
inflation.exampleZh: 该国今年正面临高通货膨胀和食品价格上涨。

inflection.example: The teacher explained how a small inflection can change the meaning of a word.
inflection.exampleZh: 老师解释了小小的词形变化如何改变一个单词的意思。

influence.example: Parents have a strong influence on how their children behave.
influence.exampleZh: 父母对孩子的行为方式有很大影响。

influential.example: She is an influential writer who has helped many young people.
influential.exampleZh: 她是一位有影响力的作家，帮助过许多年轻人。

influx.example: The small town saw a sudden influx of tourists last summer.
influx.exampleZh: 去年夏天，这个小镇迎来了游客的突然涌入。

inform.example: Please inform your teacher if you cannot come to class tomorrow.
inform.exampleZh: 如果你明天不能来上课，请通知你的老师。

informal.example: We had an informal talk about our plans for the summer.
informal.exampleZh: 我们就夏天的计划进行了一次非正式的交谈。

informant.example: The police found the thief after an informant gave them his address.
informant.exampleZh: 一名线人向警方提供了他的地址后，警方找到了那个小偷。

information.example: You can find more information about the course on our website.
information.exampleZh: 你可以在我们的网站上找到关于这门课程的更多信息。

infraction.example: The player got a small infraction for touching the ball with his hand.
infraction.exampleZh: 这名球员因用手触球而被判了一次小犯规。

infrared.example: The camera can see heat through infrared light, even in a dark room.
infrared.exampleZh: 即使在黑暗的房间里，这台相机也能通过红外线看到热量。

infrastructure.example: The city spent a lot of money on new infrastructure like roads and bridges.
infrastructure.exampleZh: 这座城市在道路和桥梁等新基础设施上投入了大量资金。

infringe.example: You must not infringe the rights of other people.
infringe.exampleZh: 你不得侵犯他人的权利。

infringement.example: The company was fined for infringement of the safety rules.
infringement.exampleZh: 这家公司因违反安全规定而被罚款。

infuriate.example: His rude words infuriated everyone in the room.
infuriate.exampleZh: 他无礼的话激怒了房间里的每一个人。

infuse.example: She tries to infuse her lessons with humor and real life stories.
infuse.exampleZh: 她努力在课堂上灌输幽默和真实的生活故事。

ingenious.example: She found an ingenious way to fix the old bike with simple tools.
ingenious.exampleZh: 她用简单的工具想出了一个巧妙的方法来修好那辆旧自行车。

ingenuity.example: Her ingenuity made the small kitchen easy to use.
ingenuity.exampleZh: 她的巧思让这个小厨房用起来很方便。

ingenuous.example: Her ingenuous question showed that she still trusted everyone she met.
ingenuous.exampleZh: 她天真的问题表明她仍然信任遇到的每一个人。

ingest.example: People ingest food and water every day to stay alive.
ingest.exampleZh: 人们每天摄取食物和水以维持生命。

ingrained.example: The habit of waking up early was deeply ingrained in him.
ingrained.exampleZh: 早起这个习惯在他身上根深蒂固。

ingratiate.example: He tried to ingratiate himself with the new manager by working late.
ingratiate.exampleZh: 他加班工作，试图讨好新来的经理。

ingredient.example: Flour is the main ingredient in this simple cake recipe.
ingredient.exampleZh: 面粉是这个简单蛋糕食谱中的主要原料。

inhabit.example: Many rare birds inhabit the forests of this small island.
inhabit.exampleZh: 许多珍稀鸟类栖息在这座小岛的森林中。

inhabitant.example: Every inhabitant of the small island knows the old fisherman well.
inhabitant.exampleZh: 这个岛上的每一位居民都认识那位老渔夫。

inherent.example: The baby has an inherent ability to learn language from the people around her.
inherent.exampleZh: 这个婴儿天生就有从身边人那里学习语言的能力。

inherit.example: She will inherit her grandmother's small house next year.
inherit.exampleZh: 她明年将继承她祖母的那栋小房子。

inhibit.example: Cold weather can inhibit the growth of these plants.
inhibit.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气会抑制这些植物的生长。

inhibition.example: He felt a strong inhibition about speaking in front of the whole class.
inhibition.exampleZh: 他在全班同学面前讲话时感到很强的心理抑制。

inhospitable.example: The desert is an inhospitable place with very little water or shade.
inhospitable.exampleZh: 这片沙漠是一个荒凉的地方，几乎没有水和阴凉。

inhuman.example: It was inhuman to leave the old man alone in the cold.
inhuman.exampleZh: 把那位老人独自留在寒冷中，真是太不近人情了。

inhumane.example: Treating prisoners that way is inhumane and should not be allowed.
inhumane.exampleZh: 那样对待囚犯是不人道的，不应该被允许。

initial.example: The initial plan was simple, but we changed it later.
initial.exampleZh: 最初的计划很简单，但后来我们改了。

initiate.example: The company will initiate a new training program for all new members next month.
initiate.exampleZh: 公司下个月将为所有新成员启动一项新的培训计划。

initiative.example: She took the initiative to help the new students in her class.
initiative.exampleZh: 她主动帮助班里的新同学。

inject.example: The nurse will inject the medicine into his arm this morning.
inject.exampleZh: 护士今天早上会把药注射进他的手臂。

injection.example: The nurse gave him an injection of medicine in his arm.
injection.exampleZh: 护士在他的手臂上给他注射了药物。

injudicious.example: It was injudicious of him to lend her so much money.
injudicious.exampleZh: 借给她那么多钱是他判断不当。

injure.example: He injured his leg while playing football with his friends yesterday.
injure.exampleZh: 他昨天和朋友们踢足球时伤了腿。

injury.example: He missed two games because of a knee injury.
injury.exampleZh: 他因为膝盖受伤而缺席了两场比赛。

injustice.example: She felt a deep sense of injustice when she lost her job for no real reason.
injustice.exampleZh: 当她毫无真正理由地失去工作时，她感到深深的不公正。

inland.example: The small town is far inland, away from the sea and busy cities.
inland.exampleZh: 这个小镇远在内陆，远离大海和繁忙的城市。

inlet.example: The small boat came into the inlet through a narrow opening in the rocks.
inlet.exampleZh: 小船穿过岩石间的狭窄开口进入了这个小水湾。

inmate.example: The inmate reads a book in his room every day.
inmate.exampleZh: 这个囚犯每天在房间里读一本书。

innate.example: She has an innate ability to make people feel comfortable.
innate.exampleZh: 她有一种天生的能力，能让人感到自在。

inner.example: Her inner strength helped her stay calm during the difficult exam.
inner.exampleZh: 她内心的力量帮助她在艰难的考试中保持冷静。

innocent.example: The young boy was innocent, and he did not know the danger.
innocent.exampleZh: 这个小男孩很天真，他不知道其中的危险。

innovate.example: Small teams often innovate faster than big companies.
innovate.exampleZh: 小团队往往比大公司创新得更快。

innovation.example: Her new idea brought real innovation to the small team.
innovation.exampleZh: 她的新想法给这个小团队带来了真正的创新。

innumerable.example: There are innumerable stars in the night sky, and we can never count them all.
innumerable.exampleZh: 夜空中有无数的星星，我们永远也数不完。

inoculate.example: Doctors inoculate children against many diseases when they are very young.
inoculate.exampleZh: 医生在孩子们很小的时候就为他们接种疫苗，预防许多疾病。

inoffensive.example: The quiet music in the cafe was inoffensive and helped me relax.
inoffensive.exampleZh: 咖啡馆里轻柔的音乐不会令人讨厌，帮助我放松下来。

inordinate.example: He has an inordinate fear of small mistakes at work.
inordinate.exampleZh: 他对工作中的小错误有过分的恐惧。

input.example: The teacher asked us to input our answers into the computer.
input.exampleZh: 老师让我们把答案输入电脑。

inquest.example: The police held an inquest to find out why the old man died.
inquest.exampleZh: 警方举行了一次调查审讯，以查明那位老人死亡的原因。

inquire.example: She called the hotel to inquire about the price of a room.
inquire.exampleZh: 她打电话给酒店，询问一间房的价格。

inquiry.example: She made a polite inquiry about the train times at the station.
inquiry.exampleZh: 她在车站礼貌地询问了火车的时刻。

inquisition.example: The reporter's inquisition made the manager nervous and he refused to answer more questions.
inquisition.exampleZh: 记者的严厉盘问让经理很紧张，他拒绝再回答更多问题。

inquisitive.example: The inquisitive child asked many questions about the stars.
inquisitive.exampleZh: 这个好奇的孩子问了很多关于星星的问题。

insane.example: It seems insane to drive in such heavy snow.
insane.exampleZh: 在这么大的雪里开车似乎是极不明智的。

insatiable.example: His insatiable appetite for new gadgets keeps him spending money every week.
insatiable.exampleZh: 他对新电子产品贪得无厌的兴趣让他每周都在花钱。

inscribe.example: They inscribe the names of the students on the wall of the school.
inscribe.exampleZh: 他们把学生的名字刻写在学校墙上。

inscrutable.example: His inscrutable smile made everyone wonder what he was really thinking.
inscrutable.exampleZh: 他那神秘莫测的微笑让每个人都想知道他到底在想什么。

insect.example: A small insect landed on my hand and then flew away.
insect.exampleZh: 一只小昆虫落在我的手上，然后飞走了。

insecure.example: She often feels insecure when speaking English in front of the class.
insecure.exampleZh: 她在全班面前说英语时常常感到缺乏信心。

insensitive.example: He was insensitive to her feelings and never said sorry.
insensitive.exampleZh: 他对她的感受很迟钝，从不道歉。

insert.example: Please insert your card into the machine and wait for the green light.
insert.exampleZh: 请将您的卡插入机器，然后等待绿灯亮起。

insidious.example: The insidious disease spread slowly through the town before anyone noticed it.
insidious.exampleZh: 这种潜伏的疾病在任何人注意到之前就慢慢传遍了全镇。

insight.example: Her book gives us a deep insight into how children learn to read.
insight.exampleZh: 她的书让我们深入洞悉儿童是如何学会阅读的。

insignia.example: The officer wears a small gold insignia on his uniform.
insignia.exampleZh: 这位军官的制服上戴着一枚小小的金色徽章。

insignificant.example: The mistake was small and insignificant, so nobody noticed it.
insignificant.exampleZh: 这个错误很小，也无关紧要，所以没人注意到。

insincere.example: Her smile looked insincere because she never meant the kind words she said.
insincere.exampleZh: 她的微笑看起来很不真诚，因为她说的那些好话从来都不是真心的。

insist.example: She insists on walking to school every day, even in the rain.
insist.exampleZh: 她坚持每天走路去学校，即使下雨也不例外。

insolence.example: His insolence to the teacher surprised everyone in the class.
insolence.exampleZh: 他对老师的无礼让班上所有人都感到惊讶。

insoluble.example: This problem is insoluble, so we must ask for help.
insoluble.exampleZh: 这个问题无法解决，所以我们必须寻求帮助。

inspect.example: The teacher will inspect our homework before the class starts.
inspect.exampleZh: 老师会在上课前检查我们的作业。

inspiration.example: My teacher's story gave me inspiration to work harder.
inspiration.exampleZh: 老师的故事给了我努力学习的灵感。

inspire.example: Her kind words inspired me to try again.
inspire.exampleZh: 她亲切的话语鼓舞了我再去尝试一次。

install.example: We will install the new software on your computer tomorrow.
install.exampleZh: 我们明天会在你的电脑上安装新软件。

installment.example: I pay for my new phone in monthly installments over one year.
installment.exampleZh: 我用一年的时间按月分期付款购买这部新手机。

instance.example: She gave me a good instance of how the system works.
instance.exampleZh: 她给了我一个关于这个系统如何运作的好例子。

instant.example: Instant noodles are cheap and quick to make for lunch.
instant.exampleZh: 速食面便宜，做午饭也很快。

instantaneous.example: The internet gives us almost instantaneous access to information from around the world.
instantaneous.exampleZh: 互联网让我们几乎能瞬间获取来自世界各地的信息。

instigate.example: He tried to instigate a fight between the two boys.
instigate.exampleZh: 他试图煽动两个男孩打架。

instill.example: Good teachers instill a love of learning in their students.
instill.exampleZh: 好老师会慢慢培养学生对学习的热爱。

instinct.example: She trusted her instinct and ran away from the danger.
instinct.exampleZh: 她相信自己的直觉，逃离了危险。

institute.example: The city plans to institute new rules for the use of water.
institute.exampleZh: 该市计划制定新的用水规定。

institution.example: The bank is an important institution in our town.
institution.exampleZh: 这家银行是我们镇上的重要机构。

instruct.example: The teacher instructed us to read the whole chapter before Friday.
instruct.exampleZh: 老师指示我们在周五之前读完整个章节。

instrument.example: The doctor used a small instrument to check my ears.
instrument.exampleZh: 医生用一个小仪器检查我的耳朵。

instrumental.example: She was instrumental in helping the team finish the project on time.
instrumental.exampleZh: 她在帮助团队按时完成项目方面起了重要作用。

insubordinate.example: The insubordinate soldier refused to follow his officer's clear orders.
insubordinate.exampleZh: 那个不服从的士兵拒绝执行军官的明确命令。

insubstantial.example: The soup was tasty but too insubstantial to fill me up.
insubstantial.exampleZh: 这汤味道不错，但太不顶饱了。

insufficient.example: There was insufficient light in the room to read the map clearly.
insufficient.exampleZh: 房间里光线不足，看不清地图。

insular.example: Their insular village rarely sees visitors from the outside world.
insular.exampleZh: 他们那个与世隔绝的村庄很少有外界来客。

insulate.example: Thick walls insulate the house from cold wind in winter.
insulate.exampleZh: 厚厚的墙壁在冬天能让房子隔绝寒风。

insult.example: Please do not insult your classmates when you are angry.
insult.exampleZh: 你生气时请不要侮辱你的同学。

insure.example: We insure our house and car with a local company.
insure.exampleZh: 我们在一家本地公司为房子和汽车投保。

insurgent.example: The army fought the insurgents for three days near the bridge.
insurgent.exampleZh: 军队在桥附近与叛乱分子战斗了三天。

insurmountable.example: The team faced an insurmountable problem and could not finish the work.
insurmountable.exampleZh: 团队遇到了一个无法克服的问题，无法完成这项工作。

intact.example: The old vase stayed intact after the move to our new house.
intact.exampleZh: 搬到新家后，那个旧花瓶依然完整无缺。

intake.example: The doctor said I should reduce my daily intake of sugar and salt.
intake.exampleZh: 医生说我应该减少每天糖和盐的摄入量。

integral.example: Trust is an integral part of any good friendship.
integral.exampleZh: 信任是任何良好友谊中不可或缺的一部分。

integrate.example: We need to integrate the new software with our old system.
integrate.exampleZh: 我们需要把新软件与旧系统整合起来。

integration.example: The integration of these two teams took several months to complete.
integration.exampleZh: 这两个团队的整合花了几个月才完成。

integrity.example: She is known for her honesty and integrity at work.
integrity.exampleZh: 她因工作中的诚实和正直而闻名。

intellect.example: Her intellect makes her one of the best students in our class.
intellect.exampleZh: 她的才智使她成为我们班上最优秀的学生之一。

intellectual.example: She enjoys intellectual talks with her friends about books and ideas.
intellectual.exampleZh: 她喜欢和朋友们就书籍和思想进行智力上的交流。

intelligence.example: The intelligence report gave the police important new information about the case.
intelligence.exampleZh: 这份情报报告为警方提供了关于此案的重要新信息。

intelligent.example: She is an intelligent student who asks good questions in class.
intelligent.exampleZh: 她是个聪明的学生，在课堂上会提出好问题。

intemperate.example: His intemperate remarks at dinner upset everyone at the table.
intemperate.exampleZh: 他在晚餐时过激的言论让桌上所有人都感到不快。

intend.example: I intend to finish my homework before dinner tonight.
intend.exampleZh: 我打算今晚在晚饭前完成作业。

intense.example: The intense heat made everyone stay inside the house all afternoon.
intense.exampleZh: 强烈的酷热让大家整个下午都待在屋里。

intensify.example: The heavy rain and strong wind intensified the danger on the mountain road.
intensify.exampleZh: 大雨和强风加剧了山路上的危险。

intensity.example: The intensity of the storm surprised everyone in the small village.
intensity.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨的强度让小村庄里的每个人都感到惊讶。

intensive.example: The team did two weeks of intensive training before the big match.
intensive.exampleZh: 这支队伍在重要比赛前进行了两周的强化训练。

intent.example: She had no intent to hurt anyone with her words.
intent.exampleZh: 她说那些话并无伤害任何人的意图。

intention.example: I have no intention of changing my mind about this plan.
intention.exampleZh: 我没有改变这个计划的打算。

interact.example: Students interact with each other during group work in class.
interact.exampleZh: 学生们在课堂上进行小组活动时互相交流互动。

interaction.example: Good interaction between teachers and students makes learning easier and more fun.
interaction.exampleZh: 师生之间良好的互动使学习更轻松、更有趣。

intercept.example: The police tried to intercept the car before it reached the bridge.
intercept.exampleZh: 警察试图在汽车到达桥之前将它拦截。

interchange.example: We interchange ideas in class and learn from each other.
interchange.exampleZh: 我们在课堂上交换想法，互相学习。

intercourse.example: Daily intercourse with friendly neighbors makes our life happier and more meaningful.
intercourse.exampleZh: 与友好邻居的日常交往让我们的生活更快乐、更有意义。

interdependent.example: In a small village, people's lives are often interdependent and full of trust.
interdependent.exampleZh: 在小村庄里，人们的生活往往相互依存，充满信任。

interest.example: She has a strong interest in music and plays the piano every day.
interest.exampleZh: 她对音乐有浓厚的兴趣，每天都弹钢琴。

interfere.example: Please do not interfere with my work while I am busy.
interfere.exampleZh: 我忙的时候请不要干涉我的工作。

interference.example: The loud noise caused interference with the phone call.
interference.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音对电话通话造成了干扰。

interim.example: The company hired an interim manager until they find a permanent one.
interim.exampleZh: 公司聘请了一位临时经理，直到他们找到长期人选。

interior.example: The interior of the old house was warm and very clean.
interior.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的内部温暖又非常干净。

interject.example: She often interjects with funny comments when we talk about work.
interject.exampleZh: 我们谈工作时，她常常插话讲些有趣的评论。

interlock.example: The two parts interlock to keep the door firmly closed.
interlock.exampleZh: 这两个部件互相扣合，使门牢牢关闭。

interloper.example: The guards stopped the interloper before he could enter the private garden.
interloper.exampleZh: 警卫在闯入者进入私人花园之前拦住了他。

intermediary.example: The bank acts as an intermediary between buyers and sellers in the deal.
intermediary.exampleZh: 在这笔交易中，银行充当买方与卖方之间的中间人。

intermediate.example: This class is for intermediate students who already know the basics.
intermediate.exampleZh: 这个班适合已经掌握基础知识的中级学生。

interminable.example: The meeting was interminable, and everyone wanted to go home.
interminable.exampleZh: 会议漫长得没完没了，大家都想回家。

intermingle.example: The two colors intermingle slowly when you mix them together in the glass.
intermingle.exampleZh: 当你在玻璃杯中把它们混合在一起时，这两种颜色会慢慢交融。

intermittent.example: The intermittent rain stopped and started all afternoon.
intermittent.exampleZh: 断断续续的雨下了一整个下午，时停时下。

internal.example: The company keeps its internal reports private and only managers can read them.
internal.exampleZh: 公司将其内部报告保密，只有经理可以阅读。

international.example: She works for an international company and travels to many countries.
international.exampleZh: 她在一家国际公司工作，经常去很多国家出差。

interplay.example: The interplay between light and shadow makes this painting interesting.
interplay.exampleZh: 光与影的相互作用让这幅画变得有趣。

interpret.example: Can you interpret what the teacher said in simple words?
interpret.exampleZh: 你能用简单的话解释一下老师说了什么吗？

interpretation.example: Her interpretation of the poem was very different from mine.
interpretation.exampleZh: 她对这首诗的诠释和我的很不一样。

interrogate.example: The police wanted to interrogate the man about the missing money.
interrogate.exampleZh: 警方想就那笔失踪的钱审问这名男子。

interrupt.example: Please do not interrupt me while I am speaking on the phone.
interrupt.exampleZh: 我打电话的时候请不要打断我。

intersect.example: The two roads intersect near the old bridge in the town center.
intersect.exampleZh: 这两条路在镇中心的那座旧桥附近相交。

intersection.example: Turn left at the next intersection and you will see the bank.
intersection.exampleZh: 在下一个十字路口向左转，你就会看到那家银行。

intersperse.example: She likes to intersperse small flowers among the tall green grass.
intersperse.exampleZh: 她喜欢在高高的绿草间点缀一些小花朵。

interstate.example: We drove for hours on the interstate to visit my grandparents.
interstate.exampleZh: 我们在州际公路上开了好几个小时的车去看望我的祖父母。

intervene.example: The teacher had to intervene when the two students started arguing loudly.
intervene.exampleZh: 当两个学生开始大声争吵时，老师不得不进行干预。

intervention.example: The teacher's quick intervention stopped the argument between the two boys.
intervention.exampleZh: 老师迅速的干预阻止了两个男孩之间的争吵。

interview.example: I have a job interview tomorrow morning, so I need to prepare well.
interview.exampleZh: 我明天上午有一场求职面试，所以我需要好好准备。

intimacy.example: Trust and honest talks can build true intimacy between two people.
intimacy.exampleZh: 信任和坦诚的交流能在两个人之间建立真正的亲密。

intimate.example: She is on intimate terms with her new roommate.
intimate.exampleZh: 她和新室友关系很亲密。

intimidate.example: Big dogs sometimes intimidate small children at the park.
intimidate.exampleZh: 大狗有时会在公园里吓到小孩子。

intolerable.example: The heat in the small room was intolerable, so we opened all the windows.
intolerable.exampleZh: 小房间里的热度让人无法忍受，所以我们把所有的窗户都打开了。

intolerant.example: He is intolerant of people who disagree with his ideas.
intolerant.exampleZh: 他对不同意他想法的人很不宽容。

intoxicate.example: The sweet smell of flowers can intoxicate anyone walking through the garden.
intoxicate.exampleZh: 花香能让任何走过花园的人陶醉。

intractable.example: This is an intractable problem that no one knows how to solve.
intractable.exampleZh: 这是一个没人知道如何解决的棘手问题。

intricate.example: The old watch has an intricate design inside.
intricate.exampleZh: 这块旧手表内部有一个精细复杂的设计。

intrigue.example: The old castle's secret history intrigues many visitors every year.
intrigue.exampleZh: 这座古堡的神秘历史每年都激起许多游客的兴趣。

intrinsic.example: Curiosity is an intrinsic part of how young children learn about the world.
intrinsic.exampleZh: 好奇心是幼儿认识世界的内在组成部分。

introduce.example: Let me introduce you to my new teacher.
introduce.exampleZh: 让我把你介绍给我的新老师认识。

introduction.example: This book has a short introduction at the beginning.
introduction.exampleZh: 这本书的开头有一篇简短的引言。

introvert.example: As an introvert, she enjoys reading alone at home on quiet weekends.
introvert.exampleZh: 作为一个内向的人，她喜欢在安静的周末独自在家看书。

intrude.example: Please do not intrude on their private conversation.
intrude.exampleZh: 请不要侵扰他们的私人谈话。

intrusion.example: The loud noise was an intrusion into our quiet evening at home.
intrusion.exampleZh: 那阵喧闹声侵扰了我们在家安静的傍晚。

intuition.example: Her intuition told her that something was wrong with the plan.
intuition.exampleZh: 她的直觉告诉她这个计划有问题。

intuitive.example: The app has an intuitive design that is easy for older people to use.
intuitive.exampleZh: 这款应用的设计很直观，老年人也很容易使用。

inundate.example: Fans inundated the young singer with letters after her first concert.
inundate.exampleZh: 首场演唱会后，粉丝们纷纷给这位年轻歌手写信，让她应接不暇。

invade.example: The soldiers did not expect the enemy to invade from the north.
invade.exampleZh: 士兵们没有料到敌人会从北方入侵。

invalid.example: The old ticket is invalid because the date has already passed.
invalid.exampleZh: 这张旧票已经作废，因为上面的日期已经过了。

invaluable.example: Her advice was invaluable when I started my new job.
invaluable.exampleZh: 我开始新工作时，她的建议非常宝贵。

invasion.example: The sudden invasion of the small country shocked people around the world.
invasion.exampleZh: 对这个弱小国家的突然入侵让全世界的人们感到震惊。

invent.example: He invented a small machine to help his mother clean the house.
invent.exampleZh: 他发明了一台小机器来帮母亲打扫房子。

invention.example: The invention of the telephone changed how people talked to each other.
invention.exampleZh: 电话的发明改变了人们相互交谈的方式。

inventive.example: She is an inventive cook who makes new dishes from simple ingredients.
inventive.exampleZh: 她是一位善于创造的厨师，能用简单的食材做出新菜。

inventory.example: The manager checked the inventory before ordering new supplies for the store.
inventory.exampleZh: 经理在下订单采购新货之前检查了店里的库存。

inverse.example: The inverse of this problem is easy to understand.
inverse.exampleZh: 这个问题的反面很容易理解。

invert.example: Please invert the glass before you put it on the table.
invert.exampleZh: 请把杯子倒过来再放到桌上。

invest.example: She plans to invest her savings in a small local business next year.
invest.exampleZh: 她计划明年把积蓄投资到当地一家小企业。

investigate.example: The police will investigate the case and find out the truth.
investigate.exampleZh: 警方将调查这个案件并查明真相。

investigation.example: The police started an investigation into the missing money.
investigation.exampleZh: 警方开始调查那笔失踪的钱。

investor.example: The investor bought a small house near the river last year.
investor.exampleZh: 这位投资者去年在河边买了一栋小房子。

inveterate.example: He is an inveterate liar, so nobody trusts what he says.
inveterate.exampleZh: 他是个积习难改的骗子，所以没人相信他说的话。

invidious.example: It is invidious to compare the two students in front of the whole class.
invidious.exampleZh: 在全班同学面前比较这两个学生是不公平的。

invisible.example: The small bug is invisible on this white wall.
invisible.exampleZh: 这只小虫在这面白墙上肉眼看不见。

invitation.example: I got an invitation to her birthday party next week.
invitation.exampleZh: 我收到了她下周生日聚会的邀请。

invite.example: I would like to invite you to my birthday party this Saturday.
invite.exampleZh: 我想邀请你这周六来参加我的生日聚会。

invoke.example: The lawyer decided to invoke an old law to help his client.
invoke.exampleZh: 律师决定援引一条旧法律来帮助他的当事人。

involuntary.example: She gave an involuntary smile when she heard the good news.
involuntary.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她不自觉地笑了笑。

involve.example: The new job will involve a lot of travel and long hours.
involve.exampleZh: 这份新工作将涉及大量出差和长时间工作。

involvement.example: Her involvement in the school project helped the whole team finish on time.
involvement.exampleZh: 她对该学校项目的参与帮助整个团队按时完成了任务。

irate.example: The irate customer called the manager to complain about the broken phone.
irate.exampleZh: 那位愤怒的顾客打电话给经理，投诉那部坏掉的手机。

iron.example: She used a hot iron to press the shirt flat.
iron.exampleZh: 她用热熨斗把衬衫熨平。

ironic.example: It is ironic that the fire station burned down last night.
ironic.exampleZh: 消防站昨晚被烧毁了，这真是具有讽刺意味。

irony.example: The irony is that the fire station burned down last night.
irony.exampleZh: 讽刺的是，消防站昨晚被烧毁了。

irrational.example: It is irrational to be afraid of a small cat.
irrational.exampleZh: 害怕一只小猫是不合理的。

irredeemable.example: His bad habits seemed irredeemable after so many years.
irredeemable.exampleZh: 这么多年过去了，他的坏习惯似乎已经无法挽回了。

irregular.example: His sleep was irregular, so the doctor told him to rest more.
irregular.exampleZh: 他的睡眠不规律，所以医生让他多休息。

irrelevant.example: Your question is irrelevant to the topic we are discussing today.
irrelevant.exampleZh: 你的问题与我们今天讨论的话题不相关。

irreparable.example: The damage to the old painting was irreparable, so the museum covered it carefully.
irreparable.exampleZh: 这幅古画的损伤无法修复，因此博物馆小心地把它遮盖起来。

irrespective.example: Irrespective of the weather, we will hold the game tomorrow.
irrespective.exampleZh: 不管天气如何，我们明天都会举行比赛。

irresponsible.example: It is irresponsible to leave a young child alone at home.
irresponsible.exampleZh: 把幼童独自留在家里是不负责任的。

irreverent.example: His irreverent joke about the teacher made everyone in the room laugh.
irreverent.exampleZh: 他对老师那个不恭敬的玩笑让房间里的每个人都笑了。

irreversible.example: The damage to the old forest is irreversible, so we must protect it now.
irreversible.exampleZh: 对这片古老森林的破坏是不可逆的，所以我们现在必须保护它。

irrevocable.example: The judge said the decision was irrevocable and could not be changed.
irrevocable.exampleZh: 法官说这个判决是不可撤销的，无法改变。

irrigate.example: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the river every summer.
irrigate.exampleZh: 农民每年夏天用河水灌溉田地。

irrigation.example: The farmer uses irrigation to bring water to his crops in summer.
irrigation.exampleZh: 农民在夏天用灌溉给庄稼供水。

irritability.example: Lack of sleep often causes irritability in both children and adults.
irritability.exampleZh: 睡眠不足常常会导致儿童和成人易怒。

irritable.example: He gets irritable when he is tired and hungry after work.
irritable.exampleZh: 他下班后又累又饿时就会变得易怒。

irritate.example: Loud music late at night can irritate your neighbors and cause problems.
irritate.exampleZh: 深夜大声放音乐会激怒邻居并引发矛盾。

irritation.example: My skin showed some irritation after I used the new soap.
irritation.exampleZh: 我用了新肥皂后皮肤出现了些发炎。

island.example: This small island is famous for its clean beaches and fresh seafood.
island.exampleZh: 这个小岛以干净的海滩和新鲜的海鲜而闻名。

isle.example: The small isle lies far from the busy mainland.
isle.exampleZh: 这座小岛远离繁忙的大陆。

isolate.example: The doctor had to isolate the sick child from the others.
isolate.exampleZh: 医生不得不把生病的孩子与其他人隔离开来。

isolation.example: The old man lived in isolation after his family moved away.
isolation.exampleZh: 家人搬走后，这位老人过着与世隔绝的生活。

isomer.example: Each isomer has the same chemical formula but a different structure.
isomer.exampleZh: 每种同分异构体都有相同的化学式，但结构不同。

isotope.example: Scientists use a special isotope of carbon to date very old objects.
isotope.exampleZh: 科学家用碳的一种特殊同位素来确定非常古老物体的年代。

issue.example: The team discussed the issue at the meeting and agreed on a plan.
issue.exampleZh: 团队在会上讨论了这个议题，并达成了一项计划。

italic.example: The book title on the cover is in italic letters.
italic.exampleZh: 封面上的书名是斜体字母。

italicize.example: Teachers often italicize new words so students can find them easily.
italicize.exampleZh: 老师经常把生词印成斜体，这样学生就能轻松找到它们。

item.example: Please check each item on the list before you leave the store.
item.exampleZh: 离开商店前，请核对清单上的每一项。

itemize.example: Please itemize the costs in the report before the meeting.
itemize.exampleZh: 请在会议前把报告中的费用逐条列明。

iterate.example: We need to iterate on this plan until the team agrees.
iterate.exampleZh: 我们需要反复修改这个计划，直到团队达成一致。

iteration.example: Each iteration of the design made the product easier to use.
iteration.exampleZh: 设计的每一次迭代都让产品更易于使用。

itinerant.example: The itinerant musician travels from town to town to play for local people.
itinerant.exampleZh: 这位巡回音乐家从一个城镇走到另一个城镇，为当地人演奏。

itinerary.example: Please send me your travel itinerary before you leave for Japan.
itinerary.exampleZh: 请在你出发去日本之前把旅行行程表发给我。

ivory.example: The old piano has ivory keys that feel smooth and cool.
ivory.exampleZh: 这架旧钢琴的琴键是象牙做的，摸起来光滑又凉爽。

ivy.example: Ivy grows on the old brick wall behind our school.
ivy.exampleZh: 常春藤长在我们学校后面的旧砖墙上。

jab.example: The nurse gave him a quick jab in the arm.
jab.exampleZh: 护士在他的胳膊上快速打了一针。

jabber.example: Stop jabbering and tell me clearly what happened last night.
jabber.exampleZh: 别含糊其辞地乱说，清楚地告诉我昨晚发生了什么。

jack.example: He used a jack to lift the car and change the flat tire.
jack.exampleZh: 他用千斤顶把车抬起来，换了瘪掉的轮胎。

jacket.example: He put on his warm jacket and went out to meet his friends.
jacket.exampleZh: 他穿上暖和的夹克，出门去见朋友们。

jade.example: The old woman wore a beautiful jade necklace to the party.
jade.exampleZh: 那位老妇人戴着一条漂亮的玉项链去参加聚会。

jaded.example: After years of the same routine, he felt jaded and wanted a change.
jaded.exampleZh: 多年重复同样的日常之后，他感到厌倦，想要换个环境。

jagged.example: The jagged rocks along the coast made walking very difficult for us.
jagged.exampleZh: 海岸边参差不齐的岩石让我们很难行走。

jail.example: The thief was sent to jail for two years after the trial.
jail.exampleZh: 审判后，那个小偷被送进监狱服刑两年。

jam.example: I put some strawberry jam on my bread and ate it quickly.
jam.exampleZh: 我在面包上涂了一些草莓酱，然后很快吃掉了。

jangle.example: The loud bells jangle every morning and wake the whole street.
jangle.exampleZh: 每天早上响亮的钟声刺耳地响，把整条街的人都吵醒了。

janitor.example: The janitor cleans our school every morning before the students come.
janitor.exampleZh: 看门人每天早上在学生到来之前打扫我们学校。

jar.example: The glass jar on the kitchen shelf is full of fresh cookies.
jar.exampleZh: 厨房架子上的玻璃罐里装满了新鲜饼干。

jargon.example: The doctor used too much medical jargon, so I could not understand him.
jargon.exampleZh: 医生用了太多医学术语，所以我听不懂他的话。

jaundice.example: The doctor said the yellow color of his skin came from jaundice.
jaundice.exampleZh: 医生说他的皮肤发黄是黄疸造成的。

jaunt.example: We took a short jaunt to the mountains last weekend.
jaunt.exampleZh: 上周末我们去山里做了一次短途旅行。

jaunty.example: He walked into the room with a jaunty little wave and a big smile.
jaunty.exampleZh: 他轻快地挥了挥手，笑容满面地走进房间。

jazz.example: My father loves jazz and plays it on the radio every Sunday morning.
jazz.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢爵士乐，每个星期天早上都会在收音机上播放。

jealous.example: She felt jealous when her best friend started spending more time with someone else.
jealous.exampleZh: 当她最好的朋友开始花更多时间跟别人在一起时，她感到嫉妒。

jealousy.example: Her jealousy made it hard for her to trust her best friend.
jealousy.exampleZh: 她的嫉妒让她很难信任自己最好的朋友。

jeer.example: The boys jeered at him when he fell down in the race.
jeer.exampleZh: 他在赛跑中摔倒时，男孩们嘲笑他。

jelly.example: The children ate sweet jelly with fruit for dessert after dinner.
jelly.exampleZh: 孩子们晚饭后吃了带水果的甜果冻作为甜点。

jeopardize.example: Staying up late every night can jeopardize your health.
jeopardize.exampleZh: 每天熬夜可能会危及你的健康。

jeopardy.example: His careless words put the whole project in jeopardy.
jeopardy.exampleZh: 他轻率的话让整个项目陷入了危险。

jerk.example: He gave the rope a quick jerk and the box moved forward.
jerk.exampleZh: 他猛地拉了一下绳子，箱子就向前移动了。

jest.example: His funny jest made the whole class laugh for a long time.
jest.exampleZh: 他有趣的玩笑让全班笑了很久。

jet.example: The jet flew over the city and made a loud noise.
jet.exampleZh: 喷气式飞机飞过城市上空，发出了很大的噪音。

jewel.example: She wore a beautiful jewel around her neck at the party.
jewel.exampleZh: 她在聚会上脖子上戴着一颗美丽的宝石。

jewelry.example: She keeps her jewelry in a small box on the table.
jewelry.exampleZh: 她把首饰放在桌上的一个小盒子里。

job.example: She found a new job at a small bookshop near her home.
job.exampleZh: 她在家附近的一家小书店找到了一份新工作。

jockey.example: The jockey rode his horse very fast and won the big race.
jockey.exampleZh: 那位职业赛马骑师骑着马飞快地跑，赢得了那场大赛。

jog.example: I jog in the park every morning before breakfast.
jog.exampleZh: 我每天早上在公园慢跑，然后再吃早餐。

join.example: Would you like to join us for dinner tonight?
join.exampleZh: 你今晚想和我们一起吃饭吗？

joint.example: They signed a joint agreement to share the water and the costs.
joint.exampleZh: 他们签署了一项共同协议，共享水源并分摊费用。

joke.example: He told a funny joke and everyone at the table laughed.
joke.exampleZh: 他讲了个有趣的笑话，桌上的人都笑了。

jolly.example: She is a jolly teacher who always makes her students laugh.
jolly.exampleZh: 她是一位快乐的老师，总是让学生们发笑。

jolt.example: The bus jolted over the rough road and woke the sleeping child.
jolt.exampleZh: 公交车在崎岖的路上颠簸，把睡着的孩子弄醒了。

jostle.example: People jostle each other to get on the crowded bus.
jostle.exampleZh: 人们互相推挤着上拥挤的公交车。

journal.example: She writes in her journal every night before going to bed.
journal.exampleZh: 她每晚睡觉前都会在日记里写点东西。

journalism.example: She wants to study journalism so she can write for a newspaper.
journalism.exampleZh: 她想学习新闻学，这样就能为报纸撰稿。

journalist.example: The journalist asked the mayor several questions about the new school.
journalist.exampleZh: 那名新闻记者就新学校的事向市长提了几个问题。

journey.example: Our journey to the small mountain village took three hours by bus.
journey.exampleZh: 我们去那个小山村的路程坐公交车花了三个小时。

jovial.example: Our jovial teacher always makes the whole class laugh with his funny stories.
jovial.exampleZh: 我们那位和蔼快活的老师总用他有趣的故事让全班笑起来。

joy.example: The children jumped with joy when they saw the snow.
joy.exampleZh: 孩子们看到雪时高兴得跳了起来。

joyful.example: The children were joyful when they saw the first snow of winter.
joyful.exampleZh: 孩子们看到冬天的第一场雪时非常快乐。

joyous.example: The whole family felt joyous at the little girl's birthday party.
joyous.exampleZh: 全家人都在小女孩的生日聚会上感到非常快乐。

jubilant.example: The whole team was jubilant after winning the final game.
jubilant.exampleZh: 赢得决赛后，整个队伍都欢欣鼓舞。

jubilee.example: The whole town held a big party for the queen's golden jubilee last summer.
jubilee.exampleZh: 去年夏天，全镇为女王登基五十周年纪念举办了一场盛大的聚会。

judge.example: The judge listened carefully to both sides before making a decision.
judge.exampleZh: 法官在做出决定之前仔细听取了双方的陈述。

judgment.example: I trust your judgment on this matter more than my own.
judgment.exampleZh: 在这件事上，比起我自己的判断，我更信任你的判断。

judicial.example: The judicial system must be fair to everyone, rich or poor.
judicial.exampleZh: 司法制度必须对所有人一视同仁，无论贫富。

judiciary.example: The judiciary must remain independent so that all citizens receive a fair trial.
judiciary.exampleZh: 司法系统必须保持独立，这样所有公民才能得到公正的审判。

judicious.example: A judicious teacher gives students clear rules but also lets them choose.
judicious.exampleZh: 一位明智的老师会给出明确的规则，但也让学生自己选择。

juggernaut.example: The new company became a juggernaut that crushed all its smaller rivals.
juggernaut.exampleZh: 这家新公司成为一股不可抗拒的强大力量，碾碎了所有规模较小的竞争对手。

juggle.example: She has to juggle work and two young children every day.
juggle.exampleZh: 她每天都要尽力兼顾工作和两个年幼的孩子。

juice.example: I drink a glass of orange juice every morning before school.
juice.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前喝一杯橙汁。

juicy.example: The waiter brought us a juicy peach for dessert after lunch.
juicy.exampleZh: 午餐后，服务员给我们端来一个多汁的桃子作为甜点。

jumble.example: Her books and clothes were all jumbled together in one big box.
jumble.exampleZh: 她的书和衣服全都混杂在一个大箱子里。

jump.example: The cat tried to jump over the small wall but fell down.
jump.exampleZh: 那只猫想跳过那堵矮墙，但摔了下来。

junction.example: Turn left at the junction of the two roads.
junction.exampleZh: 在两条路的交汇处向左转。

juncture.example: At this critical juncture, we must stay calm and think clearly.
juncture.exampleZh: 在这个关键时刻，我们必须保持冷静并清晰地思考。

jungle.example: The lost children walked through the dark jungle for three days.
jungle.exampleZh: 迷路的孩子们在黑暗的丛林中走了三天。

junior.example: He is a junior at our school and plays basketball very well.
junior.exampleZh: 他是我们学校三年级的学生，篮球打得很好。

junk.example: Please throw that old junk away before it fills the whole room.
junk.exampleZh: 请把那堆旧破烂扔掉，免得它堆满整个房间。

jurisdiction.example: The court said the case was outside its jurisdiction.
jurisdiction.exampleZh: 法院表示该案件不在其管辖权范围内。

jurisprudence.example: She studies jurisprudence at a famous law school in London.
jurisprudence.exampleZh: 她在伦敦一所著名的法学院学习法理学。

juror.example: The juror asked the judge a question about the evidence.
juror.exampleZh: 那名陪审员就证据向法官提了一个问题。

jury.example: The jury listened carefully to all the evidence before making a decision.
jury.exampleZh: 陪审团在做出裁决前仔细听取了所有证据。

just.example: It is not just a game but also a lesson about fairness.
just.exampleZh: 这不仅仅是一场游戏，也是一堂关于公平的课。

justice.example: The judge believed that justice must be fair to everyone in the country.
justice.exampleZh: 这位法官认为，正义必须对全国每一个人都公平。

justification.example: There is no justification for treating people so badly.
justification.exampleZh: 没有任何正当理由这样恶劣地对待别人。

justify.example: Nothing can justify treating your old friends so badly.
justify.exampleZh: 没有任何理由可以为如此恶劣地对待老朋友辩护。

jut.example: A small rock juts out from the side of the cliff.
jut.exampleZh: 一块小岩石从悬崖一侧突出来。

juvenile.example: The juvenile bird cannot fly yet, so it stays in the nest.
juvenile.exampleZh: 这只幼鸟还不会飞，所以它待在巢里。

juxtapose.example: The exhibition juxtaposes old photos with modern paintings to show change.
juxtapose.exampleZh: 展览把老照片与现代绘画并列展示，以呈现变化。

kaleidoscope.example: The city at night is a kaleidoscope of lights and colors.
kaleidoscope.exampleZh: 夜晚的城市是一个灯光与色彩交织的万花筒。

kappa.example: Kappa is the tenth letter of the Greek alphabet, often used in math.
kappa.exampleZh: 卡帕是希腊字母表的第十个字母，常用于数学中。

karma.example: She believes good karma will bring her luck in the future.
karma.exampleZh: 她相信善业会在未来给她带来好运。

keel.example: The strong wind made the small boat keel over near the shore.
keel.exampleZh: 强风使小船在岸边倾覆。

keelhaul.example: The old captain would keelhaul any sailor who broke the rules.
keelhaul.exampleZh: 那个老船长会严厉惩罚任何违反规定的船员。

keen.example: She is keen to learn English and practices every day.
keen.exampleZh: 她渴望学习英语，并且每天都练习。

keep.example: Please keep the door closed while the baby is sleeping.
keep.exampleZh: 宝宝睡觉时请把门关着。

keeper.example: The keeper feeds the animals every morning before the park opens.
keeper.exampleZh: 管理员每天早上在公园开放前给动物喂食。

kelp.example: Kelp grows in the cold sea and is often used in food.
kelp.exampleZh: 海带生长在寒冷的海水中，常被用于食物。

kelvin.example: The scientist measured the temperature of the liquid in kelvin.
kelvin.exampleZh: 科学家用开尔文测量了这种液体的温度。

kempt.example: His hair was always kempt and neat before he went to work.
kempt.exampleZh: 他去上班前，头发总是梳理得整洁利落。

ken.example: That subject is beyond my ken, so I cannot explain it.
ken.exampleZh: 那个主题超出了我的认知范围，所以我无法解释。

kennel.example: The small dog sleeps in a warm kennel beside the house.
kennel.exampleZh: 那只小狗睡在房子旁边一个温暖的狗舍里。

keratin.example: Keratin makes your hair and nails strong and healthy.
keratin.exampleZh: 角蛋白能让你的头发和指甲强健健康。

kernel.example: The kernel of his idea is simple and easy to understand.
kernel.exampleZh: 他这个想法的核心很简单，也容易理解。

kerosene.example: We used kerosene to light the old lamp during the power cut.
kerosene.exampleZh: 停电时我们用煤油点亮了那盏旧灯。

kettle.example: She put the kettle on the stove to make tea for us.
kettle.exampleZh: 她把水壶放在炉子上，给我们烧水泡茶。

key.example: The small key to the front door is under the old mat.
key.exampleZh: 前门的那把小钥匙在旧垫子下面。

keyboard.example: I type on my keyboard every day at work.
keyboard.exampleZh: 我每天上班都用键盘打字。

keynote.example: Her keynote on climate change opened the conference this morning.
keynote.exampleZh: 她关于气候变化的主旨演讲今天上午拉开了会议的序幕。

keystone.example: Trust is the keystone of any good friendship.
keystone.exampleZh: 信任是任何良好友谊的基石。

kibbutz.example: My cousin lived on a kibbutz in Israel for two years.
kibbutz.exampleZh: 我的表弟在以色列的一个基布兹住了两年。

kibosh.example: The heavy rain put the kibosh on our plan for a picnic today.
kibosh.exampleZh: 这场大雨让我们今天的野餐计划彻底泡汤了。

kick.example: He gave the ball a hard kick and it flew over the wall.
kick.exampleZh: 他用力踢了球，球飞过了墙。

kickback.example: The manager was arrested for taking a kickback from the supplier.
kickback.exampleZh: 经理因收受供应商的回扣而被逮捕。

kid.example: The kid likes to kid his sister about her new shoes.
kid.exampleZh: 这个小孩喜欢拿他姐姐的新鞋开玩笑。

kidnap.example: The police caught the man who tried to kidnap a young girl.
kidnap.exampleZh: 警方抓住了那个试图绑架一个小女孩的男子。

kidney.example: The doctor told him to drink more water because his kidney was not working well.
kidney.exampleZh: 医生告诉他要多喝水，因为他的肾脏功能不太好。

kill.example: The cold weather can kill young plants in the garden.
kill.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气会杀死花园里的幼苗。

killifish.example: We saw a small killifish swimming near the rocks in the clear water.
killifish.exampleZh: 我们看到一条小鳉鱼在清澈水中的岩石附近游动。

killjoy.example: My brother is such a killjoy that he never laughs at any funny story.
killjoy.exampleZh: 我弟弟真是个扫兴的人，他听到任何好笑的故事都不笑。

kilo.example: The bag of rice weighs two kilos, so it is easy for me to carry.
kilo.exampleZh: 这袋米重两公斤，所以对我来说很容易搬。

kilogram.example: This bag of rice weighs about one kilogram and is easy to carry.
kilogram.exampleZh: 这袋大米重约一公斤，很容易携带。

kilojoule.example: This small bar of chocolate gives your body about two hundred kilojoules of energy.
kilojoule.exampleZh: 这块小巧克力为你的身体提供约两百千焦的能量。

kilometer.example: The school is only one kilometer from my house.
kilometer.exampleZh: 学校离我家只有一公里。

kiloton.example: The bomb had a force of about ten kilotons, which is very powerful.
kiloton.exampleZh: 这颗炸弹的威力约为十千吨，非常强大。

kilovolt.example: The power line carries electricity at two hundred kilovolts across the valley.
kilovolt.exampleZh: 这条输电线以两百千伏的电压跨越山谷输送电力。

kilowatt.example: This small machine uses about one kilowatt of power every hour.
kilowatt.exampleZh: 这台小机器每小时大约使用一千瓦的电力。

kimono.example: She wore a beautiful silk kimono to the festival last night.
kimono.exampleZh: 昨晚她穿着一件漂亮的丝绸和服去参加节日活动。

kin.example: All my kin came to the wedding, and we ate together.
kin.exampleZh: 所有亲属都来参加了婚礼，我们一起吃了饭。

kinase.example: This kinase helps control how cells grow and divide.
kinase.exampleZh: 这种激酶有助于控制细胞如何生长和分裂。

kind.example: My mother is very kind to the new students in our class.
kind.exampleZh: 我妈妈对我们班的新同学非常和蔼。

kindergarten.example: My little sister goes to kindergarten every morning with her best friend.
kindergarten.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上和她最好的朋友一起去幼儿园。

kindle.example: Her warm words kindled a new hope in his heart.
kindle.exampleZh: 她温暖的话语在他心中唤起了新的希望。

kindred.example: Kindred spirits often understand each other without saying a word.
kindred.exampleZh: 同类的人常常不用说话就能互相理解。

kinematic.example: The kinematic analysis of the robot arm showed smooth and accurate movement.
kinematic.exampleZh: 对机器人手臂的运动学分析显示出平稳而准确的动作。

kinesiology.example: She studies kinesiology to understand how the human body moves.
kinesiology.exampleZh: 她学习运动学，以了解人体是如何运动的。

kinetic.example: The kinetic energy of the moving ball pushed the small box across the floor.
kinetic.exampleZh: 运动球体的动能把小盒子推着滑过地板。

kinetics.example: The kinetics of this chemical reaction are easy to study in the lab.
kinetics.exampleZh: 这个化学反应的动力学在实验室里很容易研究。

king.example: The king lived in a big castle with his family.
king.exampleZh: 国王和他的家人住在一座大城堡里。

kingdom.example: The old king ruled his kingdom for forty years.
kingdom.exampleZh: 这位老国王统治他的王国四十年。

kingfisher.example: The kingfisher sat on a branch by the river and waited for a fish.
kingfisher.exampleZh: 翠鸟停在河边的树枝上，等待鱼儿出现。

kingpin.example: The old kingpin was replaced before the truck could be driven again.
kingpin.exampleZh: 在卡车再次上路行驶之前，那个旧的主销被更换了。

kink.example: There is a small kink in the rope, so the water cannot flow through.
kink.exampleZh: 绳子上有一个小纽结，所以水流不过去。

kinship.example: The two families feel a strong kinship because they share the same old traditions.
kinship.exampleZh: 这两个家庭因共享相同的古老传统而感到一种强烈的亲缘关系。

kinsman.example: His old kinsman came to visit the family last week.
kinsman.exampleZh: 他年长的男亲戚上周来家里做客。

kiosk.example: We bought cold drinks from a small kiosk near the park gate.
kiosk.exampleZh: 我们在公园大门附近的一个小售货亭买了冷饮。

kiss.example: She gave her baby a gentle kiss on the cheek before bed.
kiss.exampleZh: 她在睡前轻轻吻了一下宝宝的脸颊。

kit.example: She keeps a small kit of tools in the kitchen drawer.
kit.exampleZh: 她在厨房抽屉里放着一小套工具。

kitchen.example: My mother is cooking dinner in the kitchen right now.
kitchen.exampleZh: 我妈妈现在正在厨房里做晚饭。

kite.example: The little boy runs across the field and flies his red kite in the wind.
kite.exampleZh: 小男孩跑过田野，在风中放他的红色风筝。

kith.example: She invited all her kith and kin to the small family dinner.
kith.exampleZh: 她邀请了所有的亲朋好友来参加这场小型家庭晚餐。

kitsch.example: The room was full of pink plastic flowers and other cheap kitsch.
kitsch.exampleZh: 房间里摆满了粉色的塑料花和其他廉价的庸俗装饰。

kitten.example: The little kitten is sleeping in a warm box.
kitten.exampleZh: 这只小猫正在一个温暖的箱子里睡觉。

kleptomania.example: Doctors believe his stealing comes from kleptomania rather than real need.
kleptomania.exampleZh: 医生认为他的偷窃行为源于盗窃癖，而非真正的需要。

klystron.example: The engineer tested the klystron before the radar system started working.
klystron.exampleZh: 工程师在雷达系统开始工作前测试了速调管。

knack.example: She has a knack for making difficult ideas easy to understand.
knack.exampleZh: 她有把复杂的想法讲得通俗易懂的诀窍。

knackered.example: I was completely knackered after the long walk home.
knackered.exampleZh: 走了很长的路回家后，我累得筋疲力尽。

knapsack.example: He put some food and a map into his knapsack before the long walk.
knapsack.exampleZh: 长途步行前，他把一些食物和一张地图放进了背包里。

knave.example: The old story says that a clever knave stole the farmer's horse.
knave.exampleZh: 这个古老的故事说，一个聪明的无赖偷走了农夫的马车。

knead.example: She kneads the dough with her hands for five minutes.

knee.example: He fell off his bike and hurt his left knee.
knee.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来，伤了左膝盖。

kneecap.example: The bullet hit his kneecap and he fell to the ground in pain.
kneecap.exampleZh: 子弹击中了他的膝盖骨，他痛苦地倒在地上。

kneel.example: She had to kneel down to tie her little son's shoes.
kneel.exampleZh: 她不得不跪下来给她小儿子的鞋系鞋带。

knell.example: The old bell rang a knell for the end of an age.
knell.exampleZh: 那口古老的钟为旧时代的终结敲响了丧钟。

knick-knack.example: My grandmother keeps many knick-knacks on the shelf in her living room.
knick-knack.exampleZh: 我奶奶在客厅的架子上放着许多小摆设。

knife.example: He used a sharp knife to cut the bread.
knife.exampleZh: 他用一把锋利的刀切面包。

knight.example: The brave knight rode a white horse to the old castle.
knight.exampleZh: 那位勇敢的骑士骑着白马前往古老的城堡。

knighthood.example: The brave soldier received a knighthood from the queen after the war.
knighthood.exampleZh: 战争结束后，这位勇敢的士兵从女王那里获得了骑士称号。

knit.example: She likes to knit warm sweaters for her family in winter.
knit.exampleZh: 冬天她喜欢为家人编织温暖的毛衣。

knitwear.example: She bought warm knitwear for the cold winter days ahead.
knitwear.exampleZh: 她为即将到来的寒冷冬日买了保暖的针织衣物。

knob.example: Please turn the knob on the radio to make the music louder.
knob.exampleZh: 请转动收音机上的旋钮，把音乐声调大一些。

knock.example: Someone knocked on the door three times and then walked away quickly.
knock.exampleZh: 有人敲了三下门，然后很快走开了。

knockout.example: She won the boxing match with a quick knockout in round two.
knockout.exampleZh: 她在第二回合以一记快速击倒赢得了这场拳击比赛。

knoll.example: A small house stands on the green knoll behind the church.
knoll.exampleZh: 一座小房子坐落在教堂后面那个绿色的小圆丘上。

knot.example: The sailor tied a strong knot to keep the boat safe.
knot.exampleZh: 水手打了一个结实的结，让船保持安全。

knout.example: In old Russia, a knout was used as a whip to punish prisoners.
knout.exampleZh: 在旧时的俄国，皮鞭被用作鞭打囚犯的刑具。

know.example: I know his name, but I do not know him very well.
know.exampleZh: 我知道他的名字，但我不太了解他。

knowledge.example: She has a lot of knowledge about animals and plants.
knowledge.exampleZh: 她对动植物有很多了解。

knuckle.example: He hit his knuckle on the hard door and it hurt a lot.
knuckle.exampleZh: 他的指关节撞到了硬门上，疼得很厉害。

koala.example: The koala sleeps in the tree for many hours each day.
koala.exampleZh: 考拉每天在树上睡很多个小时。

koan.example: The teacher told a short koan to help us think about our daily life.
koan.exampleZh: 老师讲了一个简短的公案，帮助我们思考日常生活。

kohl.example: She put black kohl around her eyes before the party.
kohl.exampleZh: 聚会前，她在眼睛周围涂了黑色眼线膏。

kohlrabi.example: My grandmother grows kohlrabi in her small garden every spring.
kohlrabi.exampleZh: 我奶奶每年春天都在她的小菜园里种苤蓝。

kook.example: The old man down the street is a kook who talks to his cats.
kook.exampleZh: 街那头的老头是个怪人，总跟自己的猫说话。

kooky.example: My kooky neighbor keeps a fake pink flamingo in his garden.
kooky.exampleZh: 我那古怪的邻居在花园里放了一只粉色的假火烈鸟。

kopeck.example: He only had one kopeck left in his old coat pocket.
kopeck.exampleZh: 他的旧外套口袋里只剩下一个戈比了。

koran.example: My friend reads the Koran every morning before he goes to work.
koran.exampleZh: 我的朋友每天早上上班前都会读《古兰经》。

koruna.example: The price of the coffee was about fifty korunas in Prague.
koruna.exampleZh: 在布拉格，这杯咖啡的价格大约是五十克朗。

kosher.example: This restaurant only serves kosher food, so our Jewish friends can eat here.
kosher.exampleZh: 这家餐厅只供应犹太教规允许的食物，所以我们的犹太朋友可以在这里用餐。

kowtow.example: He refused to kowtow to the new boss and kept his own opinion.
kowtow.exampleZh: 他拒绝向新老板卑躬屈膝，坚持自己的意见。

kraal.example: The farmer built a kraal to keep his cattle safe at night.
kraal.exampleZh: 农夫建了一个牛栏，让牛在夜里安全。

kraft.example: She wrapped the gift in brown kraft paper and tied it with string.
kraft.exampleZh: 她用棕色牛皮纸包好礼物，然后用绳子系上。

kremlin.example: The kremlin in Moscow is a famous old building that many people visit each year.
kremlin.exampleZh: 莫斯科的克里姆林宫是一座古老的著名建筑，每年有很多人去参观。

krill.example: The blue whale eats a lot of krill every day in cold water.
krill.exampleZh: 蓝鲸每天在寒冷的水域里吃大量的磷虾。

kris.example: He kept an old kris on the wall above his bed.
kris.exampleZh: 他把一把旧波状刃短剑挂在床头的墙上。

krona.example: One krona does not buy much in Sweden today.
krona.exampleZh: 如今在瑞典，一克朗买不了多少东西。

krone.example: She paid ten krone for a cup of coffee in the city.
krone.exampleZh: 她在城里花十克朗买了一杯咖啡。

krypton.example: Krypton is a colorless gas that is often used in some kinds of bright lights.
krypton.exampleZh: 氪是一种无色气体，常用于某些明亮的灯中。

kudos.example: She received great kudos from her team for finishing the hard project on time.
kudos.exampleZh: 她因按时完成这个艰难的项目而获得了团队的高度赞誉。

kudzu.example: Kudzu grows very fast and covers trees and old buildings.
kudzu.exampleZh: 葛藤生长得非常快，会覆盖树木和旧建筑。

kungfu.example: My grandfather taught me kungfu when I was a young boy.
kungfu.exampleZh: 我小时候，爷爷教我功夫。

kurtosis.example: Investors use kurtosis to measure how extreme the returns of a stock can be.
kurtosis.exampleZh: 投资者用峰度来衡量一只股票的回报可能有多极端。

kvass.example: My grandfather drinks a cold glass of kvass after work every summer day.
kvass.exampleZh: 我祖父每年夏天的每个工作日下班后都要喝一杯冰格瓦斯。

kwashiorkor.example: The doctor said the thin child was suffering from kwashiorkor.
kwashiorkor.exampleZh: 医生说那个瘦弱的孩子患有夸休可尔症。

kyphosis.example: The doctor said his kyphosis was caused by years of poor posture.
kyphosis.exampleZh: 医生说他的脊柱后凸是多年不良姿势造成的。

kyrie.example: The choir sang a beautiful kyrie at the beginning of the Sunday service.
kyrie.exampleZh: 周日的礼拜开始时，唱诗班唱了一首优美的主怜颂。

lab.example: The students did a simple test in the science lab today.
lab.exampleZh: 学生们今天在科学实验室里做了一个简单的测试。

label.example: Please read the label on the bottle before you take the medicine.
label.exampleZh: 服药前请先阅读瓶子上的标签。

labile.example: His labile mood changes quickly, so his friends never know what to expect.
labile.exampleZh: 他情绪不稳定，变化很快，朋友们永远猜不到他会怎样。

labor.example: The workers gave their labor to build the new road.
labor.exampleZh: 工人们付出劳动来修建这条新路。

laboratory.example: The students did a simple science experiment in the laboratory today.
laboratory.exampleZh: 学生们今天在实验室里做了一个简单的科学实验。

laborious.example: Cleaning the whole house was a laborious job for the two of us.
laborious.exampleZh: 打扫整栋房子对我们两个人来说是一项费力的工作。

labyrinth.example: The old building was a labyrinth of dark halls and narrow stairs.
labyrinth.exampleZh: 那座老建筑是一座由昏暗走廊和狭窄楼梯构成的迷宫。

lace.example: She tied the lace on her old shoe and left.
lace.exampleZh: 她系好旧鞋上的鞋带就离开了。

lack.example: Many students lack confidence when they speak English in front of others.
lack.exampleZh: 许多学生在别人面前说英语时缺乏信心。

lackadaisical.example: His lackadaisical attitude made the whole team work much harder.
lackadaisical.exampleZh: 他散漫的态度让整个团队干活辛苦得多。

laconic.example: His laconic reply made it clear that he did not want to talk.
laconic.exampleZh: 他简短的回答明确表示，他不想说话。

lacquer.example: The small wooden box is covered with shiny black lacquer.
lacquer.exampleZh: 这个小木盒上涂着一层闪亮的黑漆。

lacrimal.example: The doctor said my lacrimal glands produce too many tears.
lacrimal.exampleZh: 医生说是我的泪腺分泌了太多眼泪。

lactate.example: Some verbs like lactate mean to produce milk, while the noun form refers to a salt.
lactate.exampleZh: 像 lactate 这样的动词意思是分泌乳汁，而它的名词形式则指一种盐。

lactation.example: Good nutrition and rest are important for healthy lactation in new mothers.
lactation.exampleZh: 良好的营养和休息对新手妈妈的健康泌乳很重要。

lactic.example: Lactic acid can build up in your muscles after very hard exercise.
lactic.exampleZh: 剧烈运动后，乳酸会在你的肌肉中堆积。

lactose.example: Some people cannot drink milk because their bodies do not digest lactose well.
lactose.exampleZh: 有些人因为身体不能很好地消化乳糖而不能喝牛奶。

lacuna.example: There is a small lacuna in the report where the data is missing.
lacuna.exampleZh: 报告中有一处小小的空白，数据缺失了。

ladder.example: He put the ladder against the wall and climbed up to fix the roof.
ladder.exampleZh: 他把梯子靠在墙上，爬上去修理屋顶。

laden.example: The truck was laden with boxes of fresh fruit for the market.
laden.exampleZh: 卡车满载着一箱箱新鲜水果，要运往市场。

ladle.example: She used a ladle to serve hot soup to every guest.
ladle.exampleZh: 她用长柄勺给每位客人盛了热汤。

lady.example: The lady in the blue hat is my teacher.
lady.exampleZh: 那位戴蓝帽子的女士是我的老师。

lag.example: He began to lag behind the other runners in the final mile.
lag.exampleZh: 在最后一英里，他开始落后于其他跑步者。

laggard.example: Our company cannot afford to be a laggard in this fast-changing market.
laggard.exampleZh: 在这个瞬息万变的市场中，我们公司不能做落后者。

lagoon.example: We swam in the warm lagoon behind the beach and saw small fish.
lagoon.exampleZh: 我们在海滩后面的温暖泻湖里游泳，看见了小鱼。

laity.example: The priest explained the new rules to the laity in simple words.
laity.exampleZh: 神父用简单的语言向俗人信众解释了新规定。

lake.example: We walked around the lake and took many photos of the ducks.
lake.exampleZh: 我们绕着湖散步，拍了许多鸭子的照片。

lam.example: The young man was on the lam after breaking the law last night.
lam.exampleZh: 那个年轻人昨晚犯法后一直在逃。

lamb.example: The little lamb follows its mother across the green field.
lamb.exampleZh: 小羔羊跟着它的妈妈穿过绿色的田野。

lambaste.example: The teacher lambasted the students for coming late again.
lambaste.exampleZh: 老师严厉斥责学生们再次迟到。

lame.example: His lame excuse for being late made everyone laugh.
lame.exampleZh: 他为迟到编的蹩脚借口让大家笑了。

lament.example: Many people lament the loss of small shops in their old town.
lament.exampleZh: 许多人痛惜老城区小店铺的消失。

lamentation.example: Her loud lamentation filled the quiet room after the bad news.
lamentation.exampleZh: 坏消息传来后，她响亮的恸哭声充满了安静的房间。

laminar.example: The water in the pipe moved in a smooth laminar flow.
laminar.exampleZh: 管道中的水以平稳的层流方式流动。

laminate.example: They laminate the wooden table with a thin, clear plastic sheet.
laminate.exampleZh: 他们用一层薄而透明的塑料薄板覆盖这张木桌。

lamp.example: The small lamp on my desk gives me enough light to read.
lamp.exampleZh: 我桌上的那盏小台灯给我足够的光线读书。

lampoon.example: The writer used a lampoon to make fun of the mayor's new plan.
lampoon.exampleZh: 这位作家用一篇讽刺文章来取笑市长的新计划。

lance.example: The knight raised his lance and rode toward the enemy.
lance.exampleZh: 骑士举起长矛，向敌人骑去。

lancet.example: The doctor used a lancet to make a small cut.
lancet.exampleZh: 医生用柳叶刀切开了一个小口。

land.example: The plane will land in Beijing in ten minutes.
land.exampleZh: 飞机将在十分钟后在北京降落。

landed.example: The landed family owned a large farm and many animals.
landed.exampleZh: 这个拥有土地的家庭拥有一座大农场和许多动物。

landfall.example: After many weeks at sea, the sailors finally saw landfall at dawn.
landfall.exampleZh: 在海上航行了许多周后，水手们终于在黎明时看到了陆地。

landfill.example: The old factory site is now a landfill for city waste.
landfill.exampleZh: 这个旧厂址现在是城市垃圾的填埋场。

landform.example: This landform was shaped by wind and water over many years.
landform.exampleZh: 这一地貌是风和水多年作用形成的。

landholding.example: His landholding makes him one of the richest men in the village.
landholding.exampleZh: 他拥有的土地使他成为村里最富有的男人之一。

landing.example: The plane made a smooth landing at the airport after a long flight.
landing.exampleZh: 飞机在长时间飞行后平稳地降落在机场。

landlady.example: Our landlady fixed the broken heater in the kitchen yesterday morning.
landlady.exampleZh: 我们的女房东昨天早上修好了厨房里坏掉的暖气。

landlocked.example: This small landlocked country has no sea, so ships cannot reach it.
landlocked.exampleZh: 这个小内陆国家没有海，所以船只无法到达那里。

landlord.example: The landlord raised the rent again, so we plan to move out next month.
landlord.exampleZh: 房东又涨了房租，所以我们打算下个月搬走。

landmark.example: The old church is a famous landmark in our city.
landmark.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂是我们城市著名的地标。

landowner.example: The landowner let the farmers grow rice on his large field.
landowner.exampleZh: 这位土地所有者让农民们在他的大片田地上种植水稻。

landscape.example: We stopped on the hill to enjoy the beautiful landscape below.
landscape.exampleZh: 我们在山上停下来欣赏下方美丽的风景。

landslide.example: The heavy rain caused a landslide that blocked the mountain road.
landslide.exampleZh: 大雨引发了一场滑坡，堵塞了山路。

lane.example: The old man walks slowly down the narrow lane every morning.
lane.exampleZh: 那位老人每天早上都沿着这条狭窄的小巷慢慢走。

language.example: Learning a new language takes time, practice and patience every day.
language.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要时间、每天练习和耐心。

languid.example: The hot afternoon made everyone feel languid and slow.
languid.exampleZh: 炎热的下午让每个人都感到倦怠而迟缓。

languish.example: Without water, the plants in the garden will slowly languish and die.
languish.exampleZh: 没有水，花园里的植物会慢慢衰弱并死去。

languor.example: After the long hot afternoon, a pleasant languor spread through her tired body.
languor.exampleZh: 漫长炎热的下午过后，一种惬意的倦怠感蔓延到她疲惫的身体里。

lank.example: The tall lank boy stood quietly by the old wooden door.
lank.exampleZh: 那个瘦削的高个子男孩静静地站在旧木门旁。

lanky.example: The lanky boy walked slowly across the school yard.
lanky.exampleZh: 那个瘦长的男孩慢慢地走过学校操场。

lantern.example: We hung a red lantern outside the door during the festival.
lantern.exampleZh: 节日期间，我们在门外挂了一盏红色的灯笼。

lanyard.example: He keeps his key card on a lanyard around his neck.
lanyard.exampleZh: 他把门禁卡挂在脖子上的挂带里。

lap.example: The cat sat on my lap and began to lap the milk.
lap.exampleZh: 猫坐在我的大腿上，开始舔牛奶。

laparoscopy.example: The doctor used laparoscopy to look inside her stomach.
laparoscopy.exampleZh: 医生用腹腔镜检查她的胃部。

lapel.example: He wore a small pin on his lapel at the party.
lapel.exampleZh: 他在聚会上把一枚小别针别在翻领上。

lapidary.example: The old lapidary cut the stone with great care and skill.
lapidary.exampleZh: 这位年迈的玉石匠非常小心而熟练地切割这块石头。

lapse.example: A short lapse in attention caused the small mistake.
lapse.exampleZh: 一时的注意力疏忽导致了这个小错误。

laptop.example: I take my laptop to the coffee shop every morning.
laptop.exampleZh: 我每天早上都带笔记本电脑去咖啡店。

larboard.example: The sailor stood on the larboard and watched the waves.
larboard.exampleZh: 水手站在左舷，望着海浪。

larceny.example: The young man was charged with larceny after taking money from the shop.
larceny.exampleZh: 那个年轻男子从商店拿了钱后，被控盗窃罪。

larch.example: The tall larch in our garden turns bright yellow every autumn.
larch.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵高大落叶松每到秋天就会变成亮黄色。

lard.example: My grandmother cooks vegetables in lard because it makes the food taste richer.
lard.exampleZh: 我奶奶用猪油炒菜，因为这样食物味道更香。

larder.example: She kept a large bag of rice in the cool larder.
larder.exampleZh: 她在阴凉的食品储藏室里放了一大袋米。

large.example: A large dog ran across the road and scared the small children.
large.exampleZh: 一只大狗跑过马路，吓到了那些小孩子。

largely.example: The work was done largely by students from the same school.
largely.exampleZh: 这项工作主要由同一所学校的学生完成。

largesse.example: Her largesse helped many poor families in the small town.
largesse.exampleZh: 她的慷慨捐助帮助了小镇上的许多贫困家庭。

lariat.example: The cowboy threw his lariat around the calf's legs.
lariat.exampleZh: 牛仔把套索套在小牛的腿上。

lark.example: The lark sang a sweet song above the green field this morning.
lark.exampleZh: 今天早晨，云雀在绿色田野上方唱着甜美的歌。

larva.example: A caterpillar is the larva of a butterfly and eats many leaves.
larva.exampleZh: 毛毛虫是蝴蝶的幼虫，会吃很多叶子。

laryngeal.example: The doctor examined her laryngeal area after she lost her voice.
laryngeal.exampleZh: 她失声后，医生检查了她的喉部。

laryngitis.example: My doctor said I have laryngitis and told me to rest my voice.
laryngitis.exampleZh: 医生说我得了喉炎，让我少说话，让嗓子休息。

laryngoscope.example: The doctor used a laryngoscope to look inside the patient's throat.
laryngoscope.exampleZh: 医生用喉镜查看病人的喉咙内部。

larynx.example: The doctor looked inside his larynx to see why his voice was hoarse.
larynx.exampleZh: 医生检查了他的喉部，想看看他声音沙哑的原因。

lascivious.example: His lascivious jokes made everyone at the dinner table feel uncomfortable.
lascivious.exampleZh: 他那淫荡的玩笑让餐桌上的每个人都感到不舒服。

laser.example: The doctor used a laser to fix the problem in my eye.
laser.exampleZh: 医生用激光修复了我眼睛里的问题。

lash.example: The strong wind began to lash the trees and the rain hit the windows.
lash.exampleZh: 强风开始猛击树木，雨水打在窗户上。

lassitude.example: After the long trip, a deep lassitude kept her in bed all day.
lassitude.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，深深的疲倦让她整天都待在床上。

lasso.example: The cowboy threw his lasso around the calf's legs and pulled it tight.
lasso.exampleZh: 牛仔把套索扔向小牛的腿，并把它拉紧。

last.example: This is the last bus, and the trip will last an hour.
last.exampleZh: 这是末班车，这趟行程将持续一个小时。

latch.example: She lifted the latch and pushed the heavy wooden door open.
latch.exampleZh: 她抬起门闩，推开了沉重的木门。

late.example: She was late for work because her bus broke down.
late.exampleZh: 她上班迟到了，因为她的公交车坏了。

lately.example: I have not seen my old friend lately.
lately.exampleZh: 我最近没有见到我的老朋友。

latency.example: There is often a short latency between the infection and the first symptoms.
latency.exampleZh: 感染和最初症状之间通常有一段短暂的潜伏期。

latent.example: The doctor said the virus may stay latent in the body for years.
latent.exampleZh: 医生说这种病毒可能在体内潜伏多年。

later.example: She said she would call me later, but she never did.
later.exampleZh: 她说稍后会给我打电话，但她一直没打。

lateral.example: The doctor checked the lateral side of my knee after the fall.
lateral.exampleZh: 摔倒后，医生检查了我膝盖的侧面。

latest.example: Have you heard the latest news about our new teacher?
latest.exampleZh: 你听说关于我们新老师的最新消息了吗？

latex.example: This pillow is made of latex and feels very soft.
latex.exampleZh: 这个枕头由乳胶制成，摸起来非常柔软。

lathe.example: The worker used a lathe to make a smooth metal part.
lathe.exampleZh: 工人用车床加工出一个光滑的金属零件。

latitude.example: The island lies at a latitude of about twenty degrees north.
latitude.exampleZh: 这个岛位于北纬约二十度的地方。

latrine.example: The old latrine behind the school was dirty and smelled very bad.
latrine.exampleZh: 学校后面的旧茅坑很脏，而且闻起来很臭。

latter.example: Of the two plans, I prefer the latter because it is cheaper.
latter.exampleZh: 在这两个方案中，我更喜欢后者，因为它更便宜。

lattice.example: The metal lattice on the window keeps the birds out.
lattice.exampleZh: 窗户上的金属格子把鸟挡在外面。

laud.example: The teacher will laud her students for their hard work.
laud.exampleZh: 老师会因学生们的努力而称赞他们。

laudable.example: Trying to help others every day is a laudable habit.
laudable.exampleZh: 每天尽力帮助他人是一个值得称赞的习惯。

laudanum.example: The doctor gave her a little laudanum to help her sleep.
laudanum.exampleZh: 医生给了她一点鸦片酊帮助她入睡。

laudatory.example: Her speech about the old teacher was warm and laudatory.
laudatory.exampleZh: 她对那位老教师的讲话热情而充满赞美。

laugh.example: The children began to laugh at the funny story.
laugh.exampleZh: 孩子们听了这个有趣的故事开始笑起来。

laughter.example: The room was full of laughter after he told a funny joke.
laughter.exampleZh: 他讲了一个有趣的笑话后，房间里充满了笑声。

launch.example: The company will launch its new phone next week.
launch.exampleZh: 公司将于下周推出它的新手机。

launder.example: The gang tried to launder money through a small restaurant.
launder.exampleZh: 这个团伙试图通过一家小餐馆洗钱。

laundry.example: I need to take my dirty clothes to the laundry this afternoon.
laundry.exampleZh: 我今天下午需要把脏衣服送到洗衣店去。

laurel.example: The young poet won a laurel crown for his beautiful poem.
laurel.exampleZh: 这位年轻诗人因他优美的诗篇赢得了桂冠。

lava.example: The hot lava flowed slowly down the side of the volcano.
lava.exampleZh: 炽热的熔岩顺着火山坡缓缓流下。

lavatory.example: Excuse me, where is the lavatory on this floor?
lavatory.exampleZh: 打扰一下，这一层的洗手间在哪里？

lavender.example: She put some lavender in the small vase by the window.
lavender.exampleZh: 她在窗边的小花瓶里放了一些薰衣草。

lavish.example: She is always lavish with her time and money for friends.
lavish.exampleZh: 她对朋友总是慷慨地付出时间和金钱。

law.example: Newton's law of gravity explains why objects fall to the ground.
law.exampleZh: 牛顿的万有引力定律解释了物体为什么会落到地上。

lawful.example: It is lawful to park your car here after six o'clock.
lawful.exampleZh: 六点以后在这里停车是合法的。

lawmaker.example: The lawmaker spoke to voters about the new school plan.
lawmaker.exampleZh: 这位议员向选民介绍了新的学校计划。

lawn.example: The children are playing football on the lawn in front of the house.
lawn.exampleZh: 孩子们正在房子前面的草坪上踢足球。

lawsuit.example: The company faced a lawsuit after the accident last year.
lawsuit.exampleZh: 去年事故发生后，这家公司面临一场诉讼。

lawyer.example: The lawyer asked the judge for more time to prepare the case.
lawyer.exampleZh: 律师请求法官给予更多时间准备案件。

lax.example: The school has become lax about checking students' homework.
lax.exampleZh: 学校在检查学生作业方面变得松懈了。

laxity.example: The teacher blamed the team's laxity for their poor results this season.
laxity.exampleZh: 老师把这支队伍本赛季成绩不佳归咎于他们的松懈。

lay.example: She will lay the books on the table before lunch.
lay.exampleZh: 她会在午饭前把书放在桌子上。

layer.example: Each layer of the cake was soft and sweet.
layer.exampleZh: 蛋糕的每一层都松软香甜。

layette.example: She packed a small layette for the baby before leaving the hospital.
layette.exampleZh: 出院前她为宝宝收拾好了一套小小的婴儿用品。

layman.example: As a layman, I found the doctor's explanation hard to follow.
layman.exampleZh: 作为一名外行，我觉得医生的解释很难听懂。

layoff.example: The company announced a big layoff because sales were very low this year.
layoff.exampleZh: 公司宣布大幅裁员，因为今年销售额非常低。

layout.example: The new layout of the room makes it look bigger.
layout.exampleZh: 房间的新布局让它看起来更大了。

layover.example: We had a long layover in Tokyo before our flight to London.
layover.exampleZh: 在飞往伦敦的航班之前，我们在东京有一段很长的中途停留。

lazy.example: My lazy brother never cleans his room on weekends.
lazy.exampleZh: 我懒惰的弟弟周末从不打扫他的房间。

leach.example: Rain slowly leaches the salt out of the soil.
leach.exampleZh: 雨水慢慢把盐分从土壤中滤出。

lead.example: Good leaders lead by example and help their team succeed.
lead.exampleZh: 好的领导者以身作则，帮助团队取得成功。

leaden.example: The leaden sky made the whole afternoon feel slow and sad.
leaden.exampleZh: 铅灰色的天空让整个下午都显得缓慢而忧伤。

leader.example: The team leader helps everyone work together and finish the job on time.
leader.exampleZh: 团队领导者帮助大家协同工作，并按时完成工作。

leadership.example: Good leadership helps a team solve problems and reach its goals together.
leadership.exampleZh: 良好的领导力能帮助团队解决问题并共同达成目标。

leading.example: She is a leading expert in this field.
leading.exampleZh: 她是这一领域的领军专家。

leaf.example: A green leaf fell from the tree and landed on the grass.
leaf.exampleZh: 一片绿叶从树上落下，掉在草地上。

leaflet.example: She handed me a leaflet about the new library hours.
leaflet.exampleZh: 她递给我一张关于图书馆新开放时间的传单。

league.example: The two small countries formed a league to protect each other.
league.exampleZh: 这两个小国结成了一个联盟来互相保护。

leak.example: The old pipe began to leak water all over the kitchen floor.
leak.exampleZh: 那根旧管子开始漏水，水流满了厨房地板。

leakage.example: The plumber found a small leakage under the kitchen sink yesterday.
leakage.exampleZh: 水管工昨天在厨房水槽下面发现了一处小渗漏。

lean.example: The old man had to lean on his stick while walking.
lean.exampleZh: 那位老人走路时不得不倚靠他的拐杖。

leap.example: The cat made a big leap onto the table to catch the fly.
leap.exampleZh: 那只猫纵身一跃跳上桌子去抓苍蝇。

learned.example: The learned professor explained the old book in a simple way.
learned.exampleZh: 这位博学的教授用简单的方式讲解了这本古书。

learning.example: Learning a new language takes time, so please be patient with yourself.
learning.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要时间，所以请对自己有耐心。

lease.example: We signed a two-year lease for the small apartment near the park.
lease.exampleZh: 我们为公园附近的那套小公寓签了一份两年的租约。

leash.example: The dog pulled hard on its leash when it saw another dog.
leash.exampleZh: 那只狗看到另一只狗时，使劲地拽着它的皮带。

least.example: She has the least money but still helps others.
least.exampleZh: 她的钱最少，但仍然帮助别人。

leather.example: This bag is made of soft brown leather.
leather.exampleZh: 这个包是用柔软的棕色皮革制成的。

leave.example: Please don't leave your bag on the table when you go.
leave.exampleZh: 你走的时候请不要把包落在桌子上。

lecture.example: The teacher gave a short lecture about the history of our city.
lecture.exampleZh: 老师做了一场关于我们城市历史的简短讲座。

ledge.example: The climber rested on a narrow ledge and looked down at the valley.
ledge.exampleZh: 攀登者在一个狭窄的岩架上休息，俯视着山谷。

ledger.example: The accountant checked every entry in the company ledger before the meeting.
ledger.exampleZh: 会计在会议前核对了公司分类账中的每一条记录。

lee.example: We found a warm lee behind the old stone wall.
lee.exampleZh: 我们在那堵旧石墙后面找到了一个温暖的避风处。

leech.example: The leech stuck to his leg after he walked through the wet grass.
leech.exampleZh: 他走过湿草地后，一只水蛭粘在了他的腿上。

leeward.example: The small boat moved slowly to the leeward side of the island.
leeward.exampleZh: 小船慢慢驶向岛屿的背风一侧。

left.example: Please turn left at the next corner, and the bank is on your left.
left.exampleZh: 请在下一个路口向左转，银行就在你的左边。

leg.example: He hurt his left leg while playing football with friends yesterday.
leg.exampleZh: 他昨天和朋友们踢足球时伤了左腿。

legacy.example: His legacy includes a small library and a fund for poor students.
legacy.exampleZh: 他的遗产包括一个小图书馆和一笔资助贫困学生的基金。

legal.example: It is not legal to drive a car without a license.
legal.exampleZh: 没有驾照开车是不合法的。

legalize.example: Many countries have legalized same-sex marriage in recent years.
legalize.exampleZh: 近年来，许多国家已使同性婚姻合法化。

legate.example: The legate arrived in the city to speak for the pope.
legate.exampleZh: 使节抵达该城，代表教皇发言。

legation.example: The small country opened a legation in the capital city last year.
legation.exampleZh: 这个小国去年在首都设立了一个公使馆。

legend.example: The old story of the dragon is a famous legend in our town.
legend.exampleZh: 那个关于龙的古老故事是我们镇上著名的传说。

legendary.example: The legendary hero in this old story is very brave and kind.
legendary.exampleZh: 这个古老故事里的传奇英雄非常勇敢善良。

legerdemain.example: The magician's legerdemain fooled everyone in the room.
legerdemain.exampleZh: 魔术师的戏法骗过了房间里的所有人。

legible.example: The teacher asked us to write in legible handwriting so everyone could read it.
legible.exampleZh: 老师让我们用清晰易读的字迹书写，这样每个人都能看懂。

legion.example: A legion of fans waited outside the stadium after the big game.
legion.exampleZh: 大批球迷在重要比赛后等在体育场外。

legislate.example: The government must legislate to protect the environment for future generations.
legislate.exampleZh: 政府必须立法保护环境，造福子孙后代。

legislation.example: The new legislation will protect workers and make the rules clearer for everyone.
legislation.exampleZh: 这项新立法将保护工人，并使规则对每个人都更清晰。

legislative.example: The legislative group met today to discuss the new school rules.
legislative.exampleZh: 立法小组今天开会讨论新的学校规定。

legislator.example: The legislator voted for a new law to help poor families.
legislator.exampleZh: 这位立法者投票支持一项帮助贫困家庭的新法律。

legislature.example: The state legislature voted to pass the new education law last week.
legislature.exampleZh: 州立法机关上周投票通过了新的教育法。

legitimate.example: She has a legitimate reason to ask for more time.
legitimate.exampleZh: 她有正当的理由要求更多时间。

leisure.example: In my leisure time, I like to read books and take long walks.
leisure.exampleZh: 在空闲时间，我喜欢读书和长时间散步。

lemma.example: The math teacher explained one useful lemma before starting the new lesson.
lemma.exampleZh: 数学老师在开始新课前讲解了一个有用的引理。

lemming.example: People who follow the crowd without thinking are often called lemmings.
lemming.exampleZh: 不加思考随大流的人常被称作盲从者。

lend.example: My friend will lend me his bike for the weekend.
lend.exampleZh: 我的朋友会把他的自行车借给我过周末。

lender.example: The bank is the main lender for the new hotel project.
lender.exampleZh: 这家银行是新酒店项目的主要贷款机构。

length.example: Please measure the length of this table before we buy a new cover.
length.exampleZh: 在我们买新桌布之前，请量一下这张桌子的长度。

lengthen.example: We can lengthen the skirt by adding a few more inches.
lengthen.exampleZh: 我们可以再加几英寸把这条裙子加长。

leniency.example: The judge showed leniency toward the young man because he seemed truly sorry.
leniency.exampleZh: 法官对那个年轻人从宽处理，因为他看起来真心悔过。

lenient.example: The teacher was lenient with us because we were all very tired.
lenient.exampleZh: 老师对我们很宽容，因为我们都很累了。

lens.example: The lens of my camera is dirty, so the photos look a little blurry.
lens.exampleZh: 我相机的镜头脏了，所以照片看起来有点模糊。

lentil.example: My mother makes a warm soup with lentils and carrots.
lentil.exampleZh: 我妈妈用兵豆和胡萝卜做了一锅热汤。

leopard.example: We saw a leopard sleeping quietly on a thick tree branch.
leopard.exampleZh: 我们看到一只豹子静静地睡在粗大的树枝上。

leper.example: People turned away from him as if he were a leper.
leper.exampleZh: 人们像躲避麻风病人一样躲着他。

leprosy.example: Leprosy is a serious disease that can damage the skin and nerves.
leprosy.exampleZh: 麻风病是一种严重的疾病，会损伤皮肤和神经。

lesbian.example: She told her parents that she is a lesbian and they support her.
lesbian.exampleZh: 她告诉父母自己是女同性恋者，他们支持她。

lesson.example: We learned a useful lesson from our first English class today.
lesson.exampleZh: 我们今天从第一节英语课上学到了一个有用的教训。

lest.example: She whispered lest anyone hear her secret plan.
lest.exampleZh: 她小声说话，以免有人听到她的秘密计划。

let.example: Please let me know if you need any help with this.
let.exampleZh: 如果你需要这方面的任何帮助，请告诉我。

letdown.example: The movie was a big letdown for everyone in my family.
letdown.exampleZh: 这部电影让我们全家人都大失所望。

lethal.example: The snake's bite can be lethal to small animals and even to people.
lethal.exampleZh: 这种蛇的咬伤对小动物甚至对人都是致命的。

lethargic.example: After lunch he felt lethargic and could not finish his homework.
lethargic.exampleZh: 午饭后他感到无精打采，没能完成作业。

lethargy.example: After the long illness, he felt a deep lethargy that made even small tasks difficult.
lethargy.exampleZh: 久病之后，他感到一种深深的倦怠，连小事都变得困难。

letter.example: My sister sent me a short letter last week.
letter.exampleZh: 我姐姐上周给我寄了一封短信。

lettuce.example: I put fresh lettuce and tomato in my sandwich for lunch today.
lettuce.exampleZh: 今天午餐我在三明治里放了新鲜的生菜和番茄。

letup.example: After hours of heavy rain, there was finally a letup in the storm.
letup.exampleZh: 大雨下了几个小时后，暴风雨终于减弱了。

level.example: The water level in the river is very high this year.
level.exampleZh: 今年河里的水位非常高。

lever.example: The manager used his influence as a lever to change the old rules.
lever.exampleZh: 经理利用他的影响力作为杠杆来改变旧规则。

leverage.example: Companies can use social media to leverage their influence and reach more customers.
leverage.exampleZh: 公司可以利用社交媒体发挥影响力，触达更多客户。

levitate.example: The magician made the table levitate above the floor for a few seconds.
levitate.exampleZh: 魔术师让桌子在地板上方悬浮了几秒钟。

levity.example: His levity during the serious meeting upset his boss.
