levity.exampleZh: 他在严肃会议上的轻浮态度让老板很不满。

levy.example: The city will levy a new tax on all cars next year.
levy.exampleZh: 该市明年将对所有汽车征收一项新税。

lewd.example: The teacher told him not to use lewd words in class.
lewd.exampleZh: 老师告诉他不要在课堂上使用下流的话。

lexeme.example: In this sentence, the word walks is a lexeme with several forms.
lexeme.exampleZh: 在这个句子中，walks 这个词是一个拥有多种形式的词位。

lexical.example: The lexical meaning of a word differs from its grammatical function.
lexical.exampleZh: 一个词的词汇意义不同于它的语法功能。

lexicon.example: This old lexicon lists many words that we no longer use today.
lexicon.exampleZh: 这本旧词典收录了许多我们今天不再使用的词。

liability.example: The company accepts full liability for the damage caused by its truck.
liability.exampleZh: 公司对其卡车造成的损坏承担全部责任。

liable.example: The company is liable for any damage caused by its products.
liable.exampleZh: 公司对其产品造成的任何损害负有法律责任。

liaise.example: Please liaise with the client before Friday so we can confirm the plan.
liaise.exampleZh: 请在周五前与客户联系，以便我们确认计划。

liaison.example: She acts as the liaison between our school and the local library.
liaison.exampleZh: 她担任我们学校和当地图书馆之间的联络人。

libation.example: They poured a libation of wine on the ground for the gods.
libation.exampleZh: 他们把葡萄酒作为奠酒洒在地上献给众神。

libel.example: He sued the newspaper for libel after it published untrue claims about him.
libel.exampleZh: 在该报发表了关于他的不实说法后，他起诉这家报社诽谤。

liberal.example: Her liberal views on education made her a popular teacher.
liberal.exampleZh: 她在教育上的开明观点使她成为一位受欢迎的老师。

liberalism.example: Modern liberalism often stresses personal freedom and tolerance for different ideas.
liberalism.exampleZh: 现代自由主义常常强调个人自由以及对不同观点的宽容。

liberate.example: The soldiers helped to liberate the small town from enemy control.
liberate.exampleZh: 士兵们帮助把这个小镇从敌人的控制中解放出来。

libertarian.example: My uncle is a libertarian who wants less government control over daily life.
libertarian.exampleZh: 我叔叔是个自由意志主义者，他希望政府少干预日常生活。

liberty.example: People in that country fought for their liberty and won it.
liberty.exampleZh: 那个国家的人民为自由而战并赢得了自由。

libido.example: Stress and lack of sleep can lower a person's libido.
libido.exampleZh: 压力和睡眠不足会降低一个人的性欲。

librarian.example: The librarian helped me find three books about ancient China.
librarian.exampleZh: 图书管理员帮我找到了三本关于古代中国的书。

library.example: I go to the library every week to borrow books.
library.exampleZh: 我每周都去图书馆借书。

license.example: You need a license to drive a car in most countries.
license.exampleZh: 在大多数国家，你需要执照才能开车。

licensor.example: The licensor allows the company to use its brand name on all products.
licensor.exampleZh: 许可方允许该公司在所有产品上使用其品牌名称。

licentious.example: The licentious behavior at the party shocked the quiet neighborhood.
licentious.exampleZh: 聚会上放荡的行为震惊了这个安静的街区。

lichen.example: The gray lichen grows slowly on the rocks near the river.
lichen.exampleZh: 灰色的地衣在河边的岩石上缓缓生长。

licit.example: They only buy licit goods from shops that pay taxes.
licit.exampleZh: 他们只从缴税的商店购买合法商品。

lick.example: The dog likes to lick the plate clean after dinner every day.
lick.exampleZh: 那只狗每天晚饭后都喜欢把盘子舔干净。

lid.example: She lifted the lid of the pot to see the soup.

lie.example: Don't lie to your friends; tell them the truth.
lie.exampleZh: 不要对朋友说谎，告诉他们真相。

lien.example: The bank kept a lien on the house until the loan was fully paid.
lien.exampleZh: 银行对该房屋保留了留置权，直到贷款全部还清。

lieutenant.example: The young lieutenant led his soldiers across the small river at night.
lieutenant.exampleZh: 那位年轻的中尉带领士兵们在夜里渡过了小河。

life.example: City life is busy, but I still find time to relax with friends.
life.exampleZh: 城市生活很忙碌，但我仍会抽时间与朋友放松。

lifelike.example: The lifelike painting of the old man looks almost like a real person.
lifelike.exampleZh: 那幅老人的逼真画像看起来几乎就像真人一样。

lifeline.example: The river is a lifeline for the farmers in this dry region.
lifeline.exampleZh: 这条河是这个干旱地区农民的生命线。

lifestyle.example: My new job changed my lifestyle in many good ways.
lifestyle.exampleZh: 我的新工作在很多好的方面改变了我的生活方式。

lifetime.example: He spent a lifetime working as a teacher in a small village school.
lifetime.exampleZh: 他一生都在一所乡村小学当老师。

lift.example: She lifted the heavy box and carried it to the elevator.
lift.exampleZh: 她把那个沉重的箱子搬起来，然后搬到了电梯那儿。

liftoff.example: The rocket's liftoff was delayed by ten minutes due to strong winds.
liftoff.exampleZh: 由于强风，火箭的发射推迟了十分钟。

light.example: The room is bright because the light from the window is very strong.
light.exampleZh: 房间很亮，因为从窗户照进来的光非常强。

lighten.example: The morning sun will lighten the room and make everyone feel happy.
lighten.exampleZh: 早晨的阳光会照亮房间，让每个人都感到快乐。

lighter.example: He took a lighter from his pocket and lit the candle.
lighter.exampleZh: 他从口袋里拿出一个打火机，点燃了蜡烛。

lightning.example: The lightning lit up the whole sky during the storm last night.
lightning.exampleZh: 昨晚暴风雨中，闪电照亮了整个天空。

lightweight.example: This lightweight bag is easy to carry on long trips.
lightweight.exampleZh: 这个轻量的包在长途旅行中很容易携带。

lignite.example: This old power plant burns lignite to make electricity for the whole town.
lignite.exampleZh: 这座老电厂燃烧褐煤，为整个小镇发电。

like.example: I like this small house because it looks like my grandmother's home.
like.exampleZh: 我喜欢这所小房子，因为它看起来像我祖母的家。

likelihood.example: There is a high likelihood of rain tomorrow afternoon.
likelihood.exampleZh: 明天下午下雨的可能性很大。

liken.example: Some people liken the human brain to a very powerful computer.
liken.exampleZh: 有些人把人类的大脑比作一台非常强大的计算机。

likewise.example: She works hard, and her brother likewise works hard every day.
likewise.exampleZh: 她很努力，她的弟弟同样每天都很努力。

lilac.example: She put a small lilac in a glass of water on the table.
lilac.exampleZh: 她把一小枝丁香花插在桌上的水杯里。

lilt.example: She speaks English with a pleasant lilt that makes her easy to listen to.
lilt.exampleZh: 她说英语时带着一种悦耳的抑扬顿挫，让人听起来很轻松。

limb.example: The bird hurt one limb and could not fly for a few days.
limb.exampleZh: 那只鸟伤了一条腿，几天都不能飞。

limber.example: The dancers do simple exercises to limber up before the show.
limber.exampleZh: 舞者们在演出前做简单的运动来活动身体。

limbo.example: After college, she was in limbo for a year before finding a job.
limbo.exampleZh: 大学毕业后，她在找到工作前有一年的时间处于不确定的状态。

lime.example: He added lime to the soil to help his garden grow better.
lime.exampleZh: 他在土壤里加了石灰，好让花园长得更好。

limelight.example: The young singer enjoyed the limelight after her first big show.
limelight.exampleZh: 这位年轻歌手在第一次大型演出后享受到了公众的关注。

limestone.example: The old church was built with limestone from a nearby hill.
limestone.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂是用附近山丘上的石灰岩建造的。

limit.example: The city has a speed limit of thirty miles per hour.
limit.exampleZh: 这座城市规定车速限制为每小时三十英里。

limitation.example: One limitation of this plan is that it costs too much money.
limitation.exampleZh: 这个方案的一个局限是它花费太多钱。

limited.example: Our choices are limited because the store closes early today.
limited.exampleZh: 我们的选择很有限，因为这家店今天关门早。

limn.example: The old artist liked to limn the quiet river in his small sketchbook.
limn.exampleZh: 那位老画家喜欢在小速写本上描绘那条安静的河流。

limousine.example: The rich man arrived at the hotel in a long black limousine.
limousine.exampleZh: 那位富人乘坐一辆黑色长豪华轿车抵达酒店。

limp.example: After the long race, his legs felt limp and he could barely walk.
limp.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他的双腿发软无力，几乎走不动了。

limpid.example: The limpid water in the lake let us see every small stone below.
limpid.exampleZh: 湖中清澈的水让我们能看到下面的每一块小石头。

linchpin.example: Trust is the linchpin of every good friendship.
linchpin.exampleZh: 信任是每一段良好友谊的关键。

line.example: Please stand in line and wait for your turn.

lineage.example: Her lineage can be traced back to a small village in the north.
lineage.exampleZh: 她的血统可以追溯到北方的一个小村庄。

lineal.example: She can trace her lineal ancestors back to a small village in the north.
lineal.exampleZh: 她能把自己的直系祖先追溯到北方的一个小村庄。

linear.example: The graph shows a linear increase in sales over the past five years.
linear.exampleZh: 这张图显示过去五年销售额呈线性增长。

linen.example: She washed the linen and hung it in the sun.
linen.exampleZh: 她洗了亚麻布并把它挂在阳光下晾晒。

liner.example: The old liner still carries passengers across the sea every week.
liner.exampleZh: 那艘旧班轮仍然每周载着乘客横渡大海。

linger.example: She lingered by the old gate, not wanting to say goodbye.
linger.exampleZh: 她在旧门口徘徊，不想说再见。

lingo.example: Learning the local lingo helped him make friends quickly at his new job.
lingo.exampleZh: 学会当地的行话帮助他在新工作中很快交到了朋友。

lingua franca.example: English works as a lingua franca for people from many different countries.
lingua franca.exampleZh: 英语是来自许多不同国家的人们的通用语。

linguistic.example: Her linguistic skills help her learn new languages very quickly.
linguistic.exampleZh: 她的语言能力帮助她很快学会新的语言。

linguistics.example: She studies linguistics at college because she loves learning how languages work.
linguistics.exampleZh: 她在大学学习语言学，因为她喜欢了解语言的运作方式。

liniment.example: The nurse put some liniment on my sore back.
liniment.exampleZh: 护士在我酸痛的背上涂了一些搽剂。

lining.example: The coat has a warm lining that keeps me comfortable in cold weather.
lining.exampleZh: 这件外套有温暖的内衬，让我在寒冷的天气里也很舒适。

link.example: There is a strong link between sleep and good health.
link.exampleZh: 睡眠与健康之间有着密切的联系。

linkage.example: There is a strong linkage between daily exercise and better sleep.
linkage.exampleZh: 日常锻炼与更好的睡眠之间存在很强的联系。

lint.example: The nurse cleaned the small cut and covered it with soft lint.
lint.exampleZh: 护士清理了小伤口，并用柔软的棉绒布把它盖住。

lion.example: The lion sleeps under a tree all afternoon.
lion.exampleZh: 那头狮子整个下午都在树下睡觉。

lionization.example: The young singer's sudden lionization by the media surprised her old friends.
lionization.exampleZh: 媒体对这位年轻歌手突如其来的追捧让她的老朋友们感到惊讶。

lionize.example: The media lionized the young singer after her first hit song.
lionize.exampleZh: 这位年轻歌手凭借第一首热门歌曲走红后，媒体开始追捧她。

lip.example: She put a little red color on her lips before the party.
lip.exampleZh: 聚会前她在嘴唇上涂了一点红色。

lipid.example: Eating too much lipid can be bad for your heart.
lipid.exampleZh: 摄入过多脂质可能对心脏有害。

liquefaction.example: The heat caused the liquefaction of the ice into water.

liquefy.example: Heat the butter until it liquefies, then add the flour and stir well.
liquefy.exampleZh: 把黄油加热至液化，然后加入面粉并搅拌均匀。

liquid.example: Water is a liquid that flows easily and takes the shape of its container.
liquid.exampleZh: 水是一种液体，它容易流动，并会呈现容器的形状。

liquidity.example: The bank checks its liquidity every day to make sure it can pay its bills.
liquidity.exampleZh: 这家银行每天检查其流动性，以确保能够支付账单。

liquor.example: He drank too much liquor at the party last night.
liquor.exampleZh: 他昨晚在聚会上喝了太多烈酒。

list.example: Please list all the items you need on this shopping list.
list.exampleZh: 请在这张购物清单上列出你需要的所有物品。

listen.example: Please listen carefully to your teacher in class every day.
listen.exampleZh: 请每天在课堂上认真听老师讲课。

liter.example: Please buy two liters of milk at the store on your way home.
liter.exampleZh: 请在回家的路上到商店买两升牛奶。

literacy.example: Basic literacy helps children do better in school and in life.
literacy.exampleZh: 基本的读写能力能帮助孩子在学校和生活中表现得更好。

literal.example: He gave a literal translation of the sentence, word for word.
literal.exampleZh: 他给出了这个句子的字面翻译，逐字逐句。

literally.example: He literally translated the Chinese poem word by word.
literally.exampleZh: 他把这首中文诗逐字地直译了出来。

literary.example: She enjoys literary works more than simple popular novels.
literary.exampleZh: 她更喜欢文学作品，而不是简单的通俗小说。

literate.example: She is a literate woman who loves reading books every day.
literate.exampleZh: 她是一位有读写能力的女性，每天都喜欢读书。

literature.example: She enjoys reading English literature in her free time.
literature.exampleZh: 她空闲时喜欢读英国文学。

lithium.example: Lithium is a light metal used in many batteries today.
lithium.exampleZh: 锂是一种轻金属，如今被用于许多电池中。

lithograph.example: The museum bought an old lithograph of a city street.
lithograph.exampleZh: 博物馆买下了一幅描绘城市街道的古老石版画。

lithography.example: This old book was made using lithography more than a hundred years ago.
lithography.exampleZh: 这本旧书是一百多年前用平版印刷术制作的。

litigant.example: The judge asked the litigant to explain the facts of the case.
litigant.exampleZh: 法官要求诉讼当事人说明案件事实。

litigation.example: The company faced long litigation after the accident.
litigation.exampleZh: 事故发生后，这家公司面临漫长的诉讼。

litmus.example: The teacher used litmus to test whether the liquid was an acid.
litmus.exampleZh: 老师用石蕊来检测这种液体是不是酸。

litre.example: I bought two litres of milk at the small shop near my home.
litre.exampleZh: 我在家附近的小店买了两升牛奶。

litter.example: People should not throw litter on the ground in the park.
litter.exampleZh: 人们不应该在公园里把垃圾扔在地上。

little.example: The little boy has little money and little time to play.
little.exampleZh: 这个小男孩没有多少钱，也没有多少时间玩。

live.example: I live in a small city, but my parents live on a farm.
live.exampleZh: 我住在一座小城市里，但我父母住在农场。

livelihood.example: Fishing is the main livelihood for many families in this small village.
livelihood.exampleZh: 捕鱼是这个小时庄里许多家庭的主要生计。

lively.example: The children are lively and full of fun at the party.
lively.exampleZh: 孩子们在聚会上很活泼，充满乐趣。

liver.example: The doctor said my liver is healthy after the latest test.
liver.exampleZh: 医生说，最近的检查显示我的肝脏很健康。

livestock.example: Our farm keeps livestock such as cows sheep and pigs.
livestock.exampleZh: 我们的农场饲养牛、羊和猪等牲畜。

livid.example: My father was livid when he saw the broken window this morning.
livid.exampleZh: 今天早上我父亲看到破了的窗户时勃然大怒。

living.example: She is a living example of how hard work can change a life.
living.exampleZh: 她是努力如何改变人生的活生生的例子。

llama.example: The llama walked slowly across the field and looked at us.
llama.exampleZh: 那只美洲驼慢慢走过田野，看着我们。

load.example: The workers will load the heavy boxes onto the truck this morning.
load.exampleZh: 工人们今天早上会把重箱子装上卡车。

loaf.example: He bought a loaf of fresh bread and then loafed around all afternoon.
loaf.exampleZh: 他买了一条新鲜面包，然后整个下午都在闲逛。

loan.example: The bank gave him a loan to buy a small house.
loan.exampleZh: 银行给他一笔贷款，用来买一栋小房子。

loath.example: She was loath to leave the party so early.
loath.exampleZh: 她很不情愿这么早离开聚会。

loathe.example: I loathe the way he speaks to his mother.
loathe.exampleZh: 我讨厌他对他母亲说话的方式。

loathsome.example: The dirty old kitchen was full of loathsome smells and insects.
loathsome.exampleZh: 那个肮脏的旧厨房里满是令人作呕的气味和昆虫。

lobar.example: The doctor found a small lobar problem in the left lung.
lobar.exampleZh: 医生在左肺发现了一处小的肺叶问题。

lobby.example: The group waited in the hotel lobby and asked to speak to the manager.
lobby.exampleZh: 这群人在酒店大堂等候，并要求与经理谈谈。

lobe.example: The doctor said the small growth was on the left lobe of her lung.
lobe.exampleZh: 医生说那个小肿块长在她左肺的肺叶上。

lobster.example: We ate fresh lobster at a small restaurant near the sea.
lobster.exampleZh: 我们在海边的一家小餐馆吃了新鲜的龙虾。

local.example: The local people are very kind to visitors.
local.exampleZh: 当地人对来访者非常友善。

locality.example: The locality of the new school is quiet and easy to reach.
locality.exampleZh: 新学校所在的位置很安静，也很容易到达。

localization.example: The localization of the app into Chinese took our team three weeks.
localization.exampleZh: 把这个应用本地化成中文花了我们团队三周时间。

localize.example: Doctors can localize the pain in your back with a simple test.
localize.exampleZh: 医生可以通过一个简单的测试来确定你背部疼痛的位置。

locate.example: Can you help me locate the nearest train station on this map?
locate.exampleZh: 你能帮我在这张地图上找到最近的火车站吗？

location.example: The location of the new school is near the park.
location.exampleZh: 新学校的位置在公园附近。

lock.example: Please lock the door before you leave the house.
lock.exampleZh: 离开房子前请把门锁好。

locker.example: I left my bag in the locker near the gym door.
locker.exampleZh: 我把包放在了健身房门口附近的储物柜里。

locomotion.example: The robot uses wheels for locomotion on flat ground.
locomotion.exampleZh: 这个机器人在平地上用轮子移动。

locomotive.example: The old locomotive pulled a long line of cars through the mountains.
locomotive.exampleZh: 那台旧机车拉着长长的一列车厢穿过群山。

locoweed.example: The cow got sick after eating locoweed in the field.
locoweed.exampleZh: 那头牛在田里吃了疯草后就生病了。

locust.example: A large swarm of locust flew over the field and ate all the corn.
locust.exampleZh: 一大群蝗虫飞过田野，吃光了所有的玉米。

lodge.example: We will lodge a complaint with the hotel about the noisy room.
lodge.exampleZh: 我们将就这个吵闹的房间向旅馆提出投诉。

lodging.example: We found cheap lodging near the train station for two nights.
lodging.exampleZh: 我们在火车站附近找到了便宜的住处，住了两晚。

loess.example: The farmers built their houses on the thick loess soil near the river.
loess.exampleZh: 农民们在河边的深厚黄土上建造了他们的房子。

loft.example: We keep old boxes and winter clothes in the loft.
loft.exampleZh: 我们把旧箱子和冬天的衣服放在阁楼里。

lofty.example: He has lofty dreams of helping poor children around the world.
lofty.exampleZh: 他怀有帮助全世界贫困儿童的崇高理想。

log.example: The captain wrote the ship's speed in the log every morning.
log.exampleZh: 船长每天早上把船速记入航海日志。

logarithm.example: The base ten logarithm of one hundred is simply two.
logarithm.exampleZh: 一百的以十为底的对数就是二。

logic.example: Her logic is clear, so everyone understands her plan quickly.
logic.exampleZh: 她的逻辑很清晰，所以大家很快就理解了她的计划。

logical.example: His answer was logical and easy for everyone to understand.
logical.exampleZh: 他的回答合乎逻辑，每个人都容易理解。

logistic.example: The logistic work of moving food to the camp took two days.
logistic.exampleZh: 把食物运到营地的后勤工作花了两天时间。

logistics.example: The logistics of moving the whole team to a new city took months.
logistics.exampleZh: 把整个团队搬到一座新城市的后勤工作花了几个月时间。

loin.example: The butcher cut a thick slice of loin for the roast.
loin.exampleZh: 屠夫切了一大块腰肉用来烤肉。

loiter.example: A few boys loiter near the school gate every afternoon.
loiter.exampleZh: 几个男孩每天下午都在学校门口附近闲逛。

loll.example: He lolled on the sofa all afternoon, watching TV and doing nothing.
loll.exampleZh: 他整个下午懒洋洋地靠在沙发上看电视，什么也不做。

lonely.example: He felt lonely in the big city, so he called his family every night.
lonely.exampleZh: 他在大城市里感到孤独，所以每晚都给家人打电话。

long.example: She has long hair and longs to travel far away.
long.exampleZh: 她留着长发，渴望去远方旅行。

longing.example: She felt a deep longing for her home far across the sea.
longing.exampleZh: 她对远在海那边的家乡怀有深深的渴望。

longitude.example: The ship's longitude was recorded every hour during the long voyage.
longitude.exampleZh: 在漫长的航行中，每小时都记录了这艘船的经度。

longitudinal.example: The study uses longitudinal data to track students over ten years.
longitudinal.exampleZh: 这项研究使用纵向数据对学生进行长达十年的追踪。

look.example: Please look at the picture and tell me what you see.
look.exampleZh: 请看这张图片，告诉我你看到了什么。

loom.example: A dark shape loomed out of the fog as we walked home.
loom.exampleZh: 我们走回家时，一个黑色的身影从雾中隐约出现。

loop.example: The program uses a loop to repeat the same steps many times.
loop.exampleZh: 这个程序用循环来重复同样的步骤很多次。

loophole.example: The new tax law has a loophole that lets rich people pay less.
loophole.exampleZh: 新税法有一个漏洞，让富人能少缴税。

loose.example: This shirt is too loose for me, so I need a smaller one.
loose.exampleZh: 这件衬衫对我来说太宽松了，所以我需要一件小一点的。

loosen.example: Please loosen the rope a little so the box can move.
loosen.exampleZh: 请把绳子松开一点，这样箱子就能移动了。

loot.example: The thieves hid the loot under an old bridge near the river.
loot.exampleZh: 小偷们把赃物藏在河边一座旧桥下面。

loquacious.example: My loquacious neighbor talked for an hour about his new garden.
loquacious.exampleZh: 我那多话的邻居讲了一个小时他新弄的花园。

lord.example: The lord owned a large castle and many fields near the river.
lord.exampleZh: 这位领主持有河边的一座大城堡和许多田地。

lordly.example: He gave a lordly wave and walked past us without a word.
lordly.exampleZh: 他摆出高傲的姿态挥了挥手，一言不发地从我们身边走过。

lore.example: The old man shared the lore of his village with the children.
lore.exampleZh: 老人把村里的民间传说讲给孩子们听。

lorn.example: The old man felt lorn after his friends moved away.
lorn.exampleZh: 朋友们搬走后，那位老人感到孤寂。

lorry.example: The lorry stopped in front of our house and the driver got out.
lorry.exampleZh: 卡车停在我家门前，司机下了车。

lose.example: Be careful with your phone so you do not lose it again.
lose.exampleZh: 小心你的手机，别再把它弄丢了。

loss.example: The company reported a big loss last year and closed two factories.
loss.exampleZh: 公司去年报告了巨额亏损，并关闭了两家工厂。

lost.example: The lost dog was found near the park by a kind old man.
lost.exampleZh: 那只走失的狗在公园附近被一位善良的老人找到了。

lot.example: A lot of people came to the small town for the big festival.
lot.exampleZh: 许多人来到这个小镇参加这个盛大的节日。

lotion.example: She puts lotion on her hands every night before bed.
lotion.exampleZh: 她每天晚上睡觉前都会在手上涂护肤液。

lottery.example: Winning the lottery is a matter of luck, not skill.
lottery.exampleZh: 中彩票靠的是运气，而不是技巧。

loud.example: The music is too loud, so please turn it down.
loud.exampleZh: 音乐太大声了，请把它关小一点。

loudspeaker.example: The teacher spoke into the loudspeaker so everyone in the hall could hear.
loudspeaker.exampleZh: 老师对着扬声器讲话，好让大厅里的每个人都能听到。

lounge.example: We waited in the hotel lounge and talked about our trip.
lounge.exampleZh: 我们在酒店休息室里等候，聊着我们的旅行。

louse.example: The boy scratched his head because a louse was hiding in his hair.
louse.exampleZh: 男孩挠了挠头，因为一只虱子藏在他的头发里。

lout.example: That lout pushed past everyone and never said sorry.
lout.exampleZh: 那个粗鲁的人推开所有人，却一句抱歉也没说。

love.example: I love my family and I love reading books at home.
love.exampleZh: 我爱我的家人，我也喜欢在家读书。

lovely.example: She has a lovely smile and is kind to everyone.
lovely.exampleZh: 她有一个可爱的笑容，对每个人都很友善。

lover.example: My sister is a great lover of music and she plays the piano every day.
lover.exampleZh: 我姐姐是个很热爱音乐的人，她每天都弹钢琴。

low.example: The plane flew low over the small houses near the river.
low.exampleZh: 飞机低低地飞过河边的小房子。

lower.example: Please lower your voice because the baby is sleeping in the next room.
lower.exampleZh: 请把声音放低一些，因为宝宝在隔壁房间睡觉。

lowland.example: The farmers grow rice in the lowland near the river.
lowland.exampleZh: 农民们在河边的低地上种植水稻。

lowly.example: He was a lowly clerk, but everyone respected his honest work.
lowly.exampleZh: 他只是一个地位低下的职员，但每个人都尊重他诚实的工作。

loyal.example: A loyal friend will always stand by you when times are hard.
loyal.exampleZh: 忠诚的朋友在你艰难的时候总会支持你。

loyalty.example: True loyalty means standing by your friends even when things get hard.
loyalty.exampleZh: 真正的忠诚意味着即使事情变得艰难，也依然支持你的朋友。

lubricate.example: Please lubricate the wheels before you use the bike again.
lubricate.exampleZh: 请在你再次使用自行车之前给轮子上润滑油。

lucid.example: Her explanation was so lucid that every student understood it quickly.
lucid.exampleZh: 她的解释非常清晰，每个学生都很快听懂了。

luck.example: I wish you good luck in your new job.

lucky.example: You are very lucky to have such kind friends.
lucky.exampleZh: 你很幸运，有这样善良的朋友。

ludicrous.example: The idea of a cat running a company is ludicrous, but it makes a funny cartoon.
ludicrous.exampleZh: 让猫来经营公司这个想法很荒谬，但画成动画却很有趣。

luggage.example: I put my luggage in the car and drove to the airport.
luggage.exampleZh: 我把行李放进车里，然后开车去了机场。

lull.example: The soft music helped lull the baby to sleep.
lull.exampleZh: 轻柔的音乐帮助哄婴儿入睡。

lumbar.example: The doctor said my back pain comes from a lumbar problem.
lumbar.exampleZh: 医生说我的背痛来自腰部的问题。

lumber.example: They cut down the old tree and sold the lumber to a local builder.
lumber.exampleZh: 他们砍倒了那棵老树，把木材卖给了当地的一家建筑商。

lumen.example: The small lamp gives off about eight hundred lumens of bright light.
lumen.exampleZh: 这盏小灯发出约八百流明的明亮光线。

luminance.example: The luminance of the screen is too high for my eyes at night.
luminance.exampleZh: 夜里屏幕的亮度对我的眼睛来说太高了。

luminary.example: She became a luminary in the field of science.
luminary.exampleZh: 她成了科学领域的杰出人物。

luminous.example: The moon is very luminous tonight and lights up the whole garden.
luminous.exampleZh: 今晚的月亮非常明亮，照亮了整个花园。

lump.example: He found a small lump of sugar at the bottom of his cup.
lump.exampleZh: 他在杯底发现了一小块方糖。

lunacy.example: It was lunacy to drive in that storm without any lights.
lunacy.exampleZh: 在那场暴风雨中不开灯就开车，简直是疯了。

lunar.example: The lunar surface is covered with dust and many small rocks.
lunar.exampleZh: 月球表面覆盖着尘土和许多小岩石。

lunatic.example: The old man shouted at the children and they called him a lunatic.
lunatic.exampleZh: 那个老人冲着孩子们大喊大叫，他们便叫他疯子。

lunch.example: I eat lunch with my friends at school every day.
lunch.exampleZh: 我每天在学校和朋友们一起吃午饭。

lung.example: Smoking can hurt your lungs, so it is better to never start.
lung.exampleZh: 吸烟会伤害你的肺，所以最好永远不要开始吸烟。

lunge.example: The dog tried to lunge at the ball but missed.
lunge.exampleZh: 那只狗试图向球猛扑过去，但扑空了。

lurch.example: The old bus lurched forward and made everyone grab the seats.
lurch.exampleZh: 那辆旧公交车猛地向前一冲，让每个人都抓紧了座位。

lure.example: The bright light can lure small fish into the net at night.
lure.exampleZh: 夜里的亮光能把小鱼引诱进网里。

lurid.example: The newspaper told a lurid story about the crime.
lurid.exampleZh: 报纸对这起犯罪事件做了一个耸人听闻的报道。

lurk.example: A strange man lurked in the shadow behind the old house.
lurk.exampleZh: 一个陌生男人潜伏在老房子后面的阴影里。

luscious.example: This cake is luscious and sweet, and everyone wants more.
luscious.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕香甜美味，每个人都想再吃一些。

lush.example: The garden looks lush after the warm spring rain.
lush.exampleZh: 温暖的春雨过后，花园看起来郁郁葱葱。

lust.example: His lust for money made him forget his family and old friends.
lust.exampleZh: 他对金钱的贪欲让他忘记了家人和老朋友。

lustre.example: The old vase still has a soft lustre after many years.
lustre.exampleZh: 这只旧花瓶多年之后仍然带着柔和的光泽。

lute.example: She sat by the window and played a soft song on her lute.
lute.exampleZh: 她坐在窗边，用她的鲁特琴弹奏了一首柔和的曲子。

luxuriant.example: The garden was full of luxuriant green plants after the warm spring rain.
luxuriant.exampleZh: 温暖的春雨过后，花园里长满了繁茂的绿色植物。

luxurious.example: They stayed in a luxurious hotel near the sea during their holiday.
luxurious.exampleZh: 他们度假时住在海边一家豪华的酒店里。

luxury.example: She saves money all year so she can enjoy a little luxury on holiday.
luxury.exampleZh: 她全年都在存钱，以便度假时能享受一点奢华。

lyceum.example: The old lyceum in our town now hosts concerts and public lectures.
lyceum.exampleZh: 我们镇上的旧演讲厅现在举办音乐会和公开讲座。

lychee.example: My grandmother buys fresh lychee from the market every summer morning.
lychee.exampleZh: 我奶奶每年夏天早上都会从市场买新鲜荔枝。

lying.example: He is lying on the sofa and reading a book.

lymph.example: The doctor said the clear fluid in my swollen neck is lymph.
lymph.exampleZh: 医生说，我肿胀的脖子里那清澈的液体是淋巴液。

lymphatic.example: The lymphatic system helps the body fight infection and remove waste.
lymphatic.exampleZh: 淋巴系统帮助身体抵抗感染并清除废物。

lymphocyte.example: The doctor found a high number of lymphocytes in her blood test.
lymphocyte.exampleZh: 医生在她的血液检查中发现了大量淋巴细胞。

lymphoma.example: The doctor said her father has lymphoma and needs to start treatment soon.
lymphoma.exampleZh: 医生说她的父亲得了淋巴瘤，需要尽快开始治疗。

lyric.example: He wrote the lyrics for his new song last night.
lyric.exampleZh: 他昨晚为新歌写了歌词。

lyrical.example: Her lyrical voice made the simple song feel warm and full of feeling.
lyrical.exampleZh: 她抒情的嗓音让这首简单的歌显得温暖而富有感情。

macabre.example: The old house had a macabre story about ghosts and death.
macabre.exampleZh: 那座老房子有一个关于鬼魂和死亡的可怕故事。

machiavellian.example: He used machiavellian tricks to take control of the small company.
machiavellian.exampleZh: 他用权谋手段控制了这家小公司。

machine.example: The washing machine in our kitchen is very old but still works well.
machine.exampleZh: 我们厨房里的洗衣机很旧了，但仍然运转良好。

machinery.example: The factory bought new machinery to make the work faster and safer.
machinery.exampleZh: 工厂购买了新机器，让工作更快、更安全。

machismo.example: His constant talk about strength and dominance shows a lot of machismo.
machismo.exampleZh: 他总是谈论力量和支配，显得很有大男子气概。

macho.example: He acts very macho, but he is actually kind and gentle.
macho.exampleZh: 他表现得很强横大男子主义，但其实他既善良又温柔。

macrocosm.example: The ocean is a small world that reflects the larger macrocosm.
macrocosm.exampleZh: 海洋是一个小世界，反映着更大的宏观世界。

macroeconomic.example: The government uses macroeconomic policy to control inflation and support steady economic growth.
macroeconomic.exampleZh: 政府运用宏观经济政策来控制通货膨胀并支持经济稳定增长。

macroeconomics.example: She studies macroeconomics because she wants to understand how national economies grow.
macroeconomics.exampleZh: 她学习宏观经济学，因为她想了解国家经济如何增长。

madness.example: His madness made him run through the streets at night.
madness.exampleZh: 他的疯狂让他夜里在街上奔跑。

madrigal.example: The choir sang a beautiful madrigal about love and spring.
madrigal.exampleZh: 合唱团唱了一首关于爱情和春天的优美牧歌。

magazine.example: She reads a fashion magazine every week to learn new styles.
magazine.exampleZh: 她每周读一本时尚杂志来学习新的风格。

maggot.example: A maggot crawled out of the old apple on the ground.
maggot.exampleZh: 一条蛆从地上那个烂苹果里爬了出来。

magic.example: The children believe the old box has magic inside it.
magic.exampleZh: 孩子们相信那个旧盒子里有魔法。

magisterial.example: His magisterial voice made everyone in the room listen carefully.
magisterial.exampleZh: 他那威严的声音让房间里的每个人都认真倾听。

magistrate.example: The magistrate listened carefully to both sides before making a decision.
magistrate.exampleZh: 治安法官在做出决定前仔细听取了双方的意见。

magma.example: The hot magma slowly flowed down the side of the volcano.
magma.exampleZh: 炽热的岩浆沿着火山坡缓缓流下。

magnanimous.example: The magnanimous winner shook hands with the boy who had beaten him before.
magnanimous.exampleZh: 那位宽宏大量的获胜者与曾经击败过他的男孩握了手。

magnate.example: The old magnate built a new school for the children in his town.
magnate.exampleZh: 这位年迈的大亨为他镇上的孩子们建了一所新学校。

magnet.example: The magnet on the fridge holds all our shopping lists.
magnet.exampleZh: 冰箱上的磁铁吸着我们家所有的购物清单。

magnetic.example: This small magnetic toy attracts metal pins and paper clips.
magnetic.exampleZh: 这个小小的磁性玩具能吸住金属针和回形针。

magnificent.example: We saw a magnificent view of the mountains from the top of the hill.
magnificent.exampleZh: 我们从山顶上看到了壮丽的山景。

magnify.example: Social media can magnify small problems and make them seem much worse.
magnify.exampleZh: 社交媒体会放大一些小问题，使它们看起来严重得多。

magnitude.example: The magnitude of the earthquake surprised everyone in the small town.
magnitude.exampleZh: 这场地震的震级让小城里的每个人都感到惊讶。

magnum opus.example: His latest novel is widely praised as his magnum opus.
magnum opus.exampleZh: 他最新的小说被广泛赞誉为他的杰作。

mahogany.example: The old table is made of dark mahogany.
mahogany.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子是用深色红木做的。

maid.example: The young maid cleaned the rooms every morning before the family woke up.
maid.exampleZh: 那位年轻的女仆每天早上在家人醒来前打扫房间。

maiden.example: The maiden sang a soft song by the old river.
maiden.exampleZh: 那位少女在古老的河边唱着一首轻柔的歌。

mail.example: I check my mail every morning before I start work.
mail.exampleZh: 我每天早上开始工作前都会查看邮件。

maim.example: The bomb maimed many innocent people in the crowded market.
maim.exampleZh: 炸弹在拥挤的市场上使许多无辜者致残。

main.example: The main road is busy in the morning, so we take the train.
main.exampleZh: 早上的主干道很繁忙，所以我们坐火车。

mainland.example: Many people take a train to travel from Hong Kong to the mainland.
mainland.exampleZh: 很多人乘坐火车从香港前往大陆。

mainly.example: The class is mainly made up of students from small towns.
mainly.exampleZh: 这个班主要由来自小城镇的学生组成。

mainstream.example: Green energy has become part of the mainstream in many countries today.
mainstream.exampleZh: 如今，绿色能源在许多国家已成为主流的一部分。

maintain.example: We must maintain the machines well so they can run every day.
maintain.exampleZh: 我们必须好好维修这些机器，这样它们每天都能运转。

maintenance.example: Regular maintenance keeps the old car running well.
maintenance.exampleZh: 定期保养能让这辆旧车保持良好运转。

maize.example: Farmers in this village grow maize and beans every year.
maize.exampleZh: 这个村子的农民每年都种植玉米和豆类。

majestic.example: The old castle looks majestic on top of the green hill.
majestic.exampleZh: 那座古老的城堡在绿色山丘上显得雄伟壮观。

majesty.example: The majesty of the mountains made everyone stop and stare in silence.
majesty.exampleZh: 群山的雄伟让每个人都停下脚步，默默凝视。

major.example: She chose history as her major in college last year.
major.exampleZh: 她去年在大学里选择了历史作为她的专业。

majority.example: The majority of students agree with the new school rule.
majority.exampleZh: 大多数学生都同意这条新校规。

make.example: She wants to make a small cake for her mother.
make.exampleZh: 她想为她的母亲做一个小蛋糕。

makeup.example: She wears little makeup and likes simple clothes.
makeup.exampleZh: 她很少化妆，喜欢简单的衣服。

maladapted.example: These maladapted plants cannot survive the cold winters here.
maladapted.exampleZh: 这些适应不良的植物无法在这里寒冷的冬天中存活。

maladjustment.example: His maladjustment to the new school made him quiet and unhappy.
maladjustment.exampleZh: 他对新学校适应不良，变得沉默寡言、闷闷不乐。

maladroit.example: His maladroit attempt to fix the machine made the problem worse.
maladroit.exampleZh: 他笨拙地试图修理这台机器，结果把问题弄得更糟了。

malady.example: This strange malady makes him tired and weak every day.
malady.exampleZh: 这种奇怪的疾病使他每天都感到疲倦和虚弱。

malaise.example: After the long illness, he felt a vague malaise that kept him awake at night.
malaise.exampleZh: 久病之后，他感到一种莫名的不适，使他夜不能寐。

malapropism.example: His speech was funny because of a malapropism in almost every sentence.
malapropism.exampleZh: 他的演讲很有趣，因为几乎每句话里都有一个近音词误用。

malaria.example: Many children in Africa get malaria from mosquito bites every year.
malaria.exampleZh: 非洲许多儿童每年都因蚊虫叮咬而患上疟疾。

malcontent.example: The malcontent refused to follow the new rules.
malcontent.exampleZh: 这个不满者拒绝遵守新规定。

male.example: The male nurse helped the old man walk slowly to his room.
male.exampleZh: 那位男护士扶着老人慢慢走回他的房间。

malefactor.example: The police finally caught the malefactor who had robbed three small shops.
malefactor.exampleZh: 警方终于抓住了那个抢劫了三家小商店的作恶者。

malevolent.example: The malevolent man tried to hurt the small dog.
malevolent.exampleZh: 那个心存恶意的人试图伤害那只小狗。

malfeasance.example: The manager was fired for malfeasance after he stole company money.
malfeasance.exampleZh: 这名经理因偷窃公司资金而被解雇，其行为属于渎职。

malfunction.example: The machine began to malfunction after running for ten hours without a break.
malfunction.exampleZh: 这台机器连续运行十个小时后开始发生故障。

malice.example: She spoke with malice and tried to hurt her friend.
malice.exampleZh: 她带着恶意说话，试图伤害她的朋友。

malicious.example: He spread a malicious rumor about his coworker to make her look bad.
malicious.exampleZh: 他散布关于同事的恶意谣言，想让她难堪。

malign.example: His malign words hurt the team and made everyone feel unhappy.
malign.exampleZh: 他恶意的言辞伤害了团队，让每个人都感到不快。

malignancy.example: The doctor said the test showed no sign of malignancy.
malignancy.exampleZh: 医生说检查结果显示没有恶性病变的迹象。

malignant.example: The doctor said the tumor was malignant and needed quick treatment.
malignant.exampleZh: 医生说这个肿瘤是恶性的，需要尽快治疗。

malinger.example: He tried to malinger to avoid the difficult work on Friday.
malinger.exampleZh: 他周五试图装病逃差，以避开那项困难的工作。

malleable.example: Young children are malleable and learn new habits very quickly.
malleable.exampleZh: 幼儿可塑性很强，能很快学会新的习惯。

malnutrition.example: Many children in poor areas suffer from malnutrition because they never get enough healthy food.
malnutrition.exampleZh: 贫困地区的许多儿童因为从来得不到足够的健康食物而遭受营养不良。

malpractice.example: The doctor was sued for malpractice after the surgery went wrong.
malpractice.exampleZh: 手术出问题后，这位医生因医疗事故被起诉。

maltreat.example: We should never maltreat animals or people who cannot defend themselves.
maltreat.exampleZh: 我们绝不应该虐待动物或无法保护自己的人。

mammal.example: The whale is a mammal that lives in the ocean and breathes air.
mammal.exampleZh: 鲸鱼是一种生活在海洋里、呼吸空气的哺乳动物。

mammoth.example: The new museum is a mammoth building with many rooms.
mammoth.exampleZh: 新博物馆是一座有许多房间的巨大建筑。

man.example: The man next to me can operate the machine well.
man.exampleZh: 我旁边的那个男人能很好地操作这台机器。

manacle.example: The police put a heavy manacle on each of his wrists.
manacle.exampleZh: 警察在他的每只手腕上都戴上了沉重的手铐。

manage.example: She manages a small team and still finds time to help others.
manage.exampleZh: 她管理一个小团队，还能抽出时间帮助别人。

management.example: Good management of your time makes daily work much easier.
management.exampleZh: 妥善管理时间能让日常工作轻松很多。

managerial.example: She has strong managerial skills and leads her team well.
managerial.exampleZh: 她有很强的管理能力，把团队带领得很好。

mandate.example: The new law gives the city a mandate to improve public schools.
mandate.exampleZh: 新法律授权该市改善公立学校。

mandatory.example: It is mandatory for all students to wear a helmet here.
mandatory.exampleZh: 这里所有学生都必须戴头盔。

mane.example: The big brown horse has a long mane and a gentle face.
mane.exampleZh: 那匹棕色的大马有一头长鬃毛和一张温顺的脸。

maneuver.example: The general planned a clever maneuver to surprise the enemy at dawn.
maneuver.exampleZh: 将军策划了一个巧妙的策略，以便在黎明时突袭敌人。

mangle.example: The machine mangled his shirt and tore it into small pieces.
mangle.exampleZh: 机器把他的衬衫绞坏，撕成了小碎片。

mania.example: His mania for old stamps made him spend all his money.
mania.exampleZh: 他对旧邮票的狂热让他花光了所有的钱。

manic.example: He gets manic before every big exam and cannot sleep.
manic.exampleZh: 每次大考前他都会变得躁狂，睡不着觉。

manifest.example: The happy smile on her face was a manifest sign of relief.
manifest.exampleZh: 她脸上开心的笑容是宽慰的明显迹象。

manifestation.example: The loud crowd outside was a clear manifestation of the people's anger.
manifestation.exampleZh: 外面喧闹的人群是民众愤怒的明显表现。

manifesto.example: The new leader wrote a manifesto to explain his ideas to the people.
manifesto.exampleZh: 新领导人写了一份宣言，向人们解释他的想法。

manifold.example: The internet offers a manifold ways to learn new skills today.
manifold.exampleZh: 如今互联网提供了多种多样的学习新技能的方式。

manipulate.example: He tried to manipulate the small group with false stories.
manipulate.exampleZh: 他试图用虚假的故事操纵这个小团体。

manipulative.example: He is a manipulative person who always gets what he wants.
manipulative.exampleZh: 他是一个善于操纵他人的人，总能得到自己想要的东西。

mankind.example: Scientists believe that mankind must protect the earth for future generations.
mankind.exampleZh: 科学家认为人类必须为子孙后代保护地球。

manly.example: His deep voice and strong hands made him look very manly.
manly.exampleZh: 他低沉的嗓音和有力的双手让他看起来很有男子气概。

mannequin.example: The store put a new dress on the mannequin in the window.
mannequin.exampleZh: 商店把一条新连衣裙穿在橱窗里的人体模型上。

manner.example: She spoke in a kind manner and helped the new students feel welcome.
manner.exampleZh: 她以友善的态度说话，帮助新同学感到受欢迎。

manor.example: The old manor stands quietly among tall trees and green fields.
manor.exampleZh: 那座古老的庄园静静地坐落在高树和绿野之间。

manpower.example: The company needs more manpower to finish the project on time.
manpower.exampleZh: 公司需要更多人力才能按时完成这个项目。

mansion.example: The old mansion at the end of our street has a huge garden.
mansion.exampleZh: 我们街道尽头的那座旧宅邸有一个很大的花园。

mantra.example: She repeats her favorite mantra every morning before she starts work.
mantra.exampleZh: 她每天早上开始工作前都会重复她最喜欢的口头禅。

manual.example: He bought a manual for his new car and read it carefully.
manual.exampleZh: 他为自己的新车买了一本手册，并仔细阅读了它。

manufacture.example: That factory manufactures cheap toys for children all over the world.
manufacture.exampleZh: 那家工厂为全世界的孩子生产廉价玩具。

manuscript.example: She sent her manuscript to a publisher last week.
manuscript.exampleZh: 她上周把手稿寄给了一家出版社。

map.example: We used a map to plan our trip to the mountains.
map.exampleZh: 我们用一张地图规划了去山区的旅行。

maple.example: The big maple in our garden turns bright red every autumn.
maple.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵大枫树每到秋天就变成鲜红色。

mar.example: The loud argument marred an otherwise pleasant evening for everyone at the table.
mar.exampleZh: 那场大声的争吵毁掉了原本愉快的夜晚，让在座的每个人都受了影响。

marathon.example: Running a marathon takes months of training and a lot of patience.
marathon.exampleZh: 跑马拉松需要数月的训练和极大的耐心。

marble.example: The floor of the old hall was made of smooth white marble.
marble.exampleZh: 那座古老大厅的地板是用光滑的白色大理石铺成的。

march.example: The soldiers march through the cold streets of the city at dawn.
march.exampleZh: 士兵们在黎明时分穿过城市寒冷的街道。

mare.example: The gray mare ran across the field with her young foal.
mare.exampleZh: 那匹灰色母马带着她的小马驹跑过田野。

margin.example: There is a small note in the margin of this page.
margin.exampleZh: 这一页的页边空白处有一个小注释。

marginal.example: The old road is marginal and few people use it now.
marginal.exampleZh: 这条旧路很边缘，现在很少有人使用。

marina.example: The small boat is tied to the dock at the marina.
marina.exampleZh: 小船拴在码头的船坞上。

marine.example: The marine animals live in clean water near the beach.
marine.exampleZh: 这些海洋动物生活在海滩附近的干净水域中。

marionette.example: The little boy laughed when the marionette danced across the small stage.
marionette.exampleZh: 当提线木偶在小舞台上跳舞时，小男孩笑了。

marital.example: Her marital status changed after she moved to a new city.
marital.exampleZh: 她搬到新城市后，婚姻状况发生了变化。

maritime.example: The country has a strong maritime tradition and many busy ports.
maritime.exampleZh: 这个国家有悠久的航海传统和许多繁忙的港口。

mark.example: The teacher put a red mark on my test paper.
mark.exampleZh: 老师在我的试卷上做了一个红色的标记。

market.example: The small company wants to market its new product in the local market.
market.exampleZh: 这家小公司想在本地市场推销它的新产品。

marmalade.example: She puts sweet orange marmalade on her toast every morning.
marmalade.exampleZh: 她每天早上都在吐司上抹甜橘子酱。

marriage.example: Their happy marriage has lasted for more than thirty years.
marriage.exampleZh: 他们幸福的婚姻已经持续了三十多年。

marrow.example: The doctor said the marrow inside your bones makes new blood cells.
marrow.exampleZh: 医生说，你骨头里的骨髓会制造新的血细胞。

marry.example: I want to marry him next year in a small church.
marry.exampleZh: 我想明年在一座小教堂里嫁给他。

marsh.example: The birds built their nests in the marsh near the river.
marsh.exampleZh: 鸟儿在河边的沼泽里筑巢。

marshal.example: The marshal told the crowd to stand behind the yellow line.
marshal.exampleZh: 警长让人群站在黄线后面。

martial.example: He has practiced martial arts since he was a young boy.
martial.exampleZh: 他从小就开始练习武术。

martyr.example: The old soldier became a martyr for his country after the long war.
martyr.exampleZh: 那场漫长的战争之后，这位老兵成了为国捐躯的烈士。

marvel.example: It is a marvel that the small team finished the huge project so quickly.
marvel.exampleZh: 这个小团队如此迅速地完成这个庞大项目，真是一个奇迹。

masculine.example: His deep voice and short hair make him look very masculine.
masculine.exampleZh: 他低沉的嗓音和短发让他看起来很阳刚。

mash.example: She used a fork to mash the potatoes before adding butter.
mash.exampleZh: 她加黄油之前先用叉子把土豆捣碎。

mask.example: He wore a mask on the bus and tried to mask his cough.
mask.exampleZh: 他在公交车上戴着口罩，并试图掩饰自己的咳嗽。

mass.example: A large mass of people waited outside the stadium before the big game.
mass.exampleZh: 一大群人在这场比赛前等在体育场外。

massacre.example: The soldiers were blamed for the massacre of many innocent people.
massacre.exampleZh: 士兵们因屠杀许多无辜民众而受到谴责。

massive.example: The storm caused massive damage to homes near the coast.
massive.exampleZh: 这场风暴对海岸附近的房屋造成了巨大破坏。

master.example: She worked hard to master English before she went to study abroad.
master.exampleZh: 她出国留学前努力学习，掌握了英语。

masterpiece.example: This old painting is a masterpiece of modern art.
masterpiece.exampleZh: 这幅古老的画是现代艺术的杰作。

mastery.example: Years of practice gave her real mastery of the piano.
mastery.exampleZh: 多年的练习让她真正掌握了钢琴。

match.example: My brother found a box of matches and lit a small fire.
match.exampleZh: 我弟弟找到一盒火柴，点了一堆小火。

mate.example: My best mate helps me with my homework every day.
mate.exampleZh: 我最好的伙伴每天帮我做作业。

material.example: This material is strong and cheap, so we use it to build houses.
material.exampleZh: 这种材料又结实又便宜，所以我们用它来盖房子。

materialism.example: Her book explains how materialism shapes the way modern people think about money.
materialism.exampleZh: 她的书解释了物质主义如何影响现代人对金钱的看法。

maternal.example: She looks like her maternal grandmother in many old family photos.
maternal.exampleZh: 在许多旧家庭照片里，她看起来很像她的外祖母。

mathematical.example: She has strong mathematical skills and can solve these problems quickly.
mathematical.exampleZh: 她有很强的数学能力，能很快解出这些问题。

mathematics.example: I like mathematics because it helps me solve problems in daily life.
mathematics.exampleZh: 我喜欢数学，因为它能帮我解决日常生活中的问题。

matriarch.example: The old matriarch decided who could join the family dinner.
matriarch.exampleZh: 这位年长的女家长决定谁能参加家庭晚餐。

matriculate.example: She will matriculate at the local university next month.
matriculate.exampleZh: 她下个月将在当地大学注册入学。

matrimony.example: They entered matrimony after ten years of being close friends.
matrimony.exampleZh: 他们在做了十年好朋友之后步入了婚姻。

matrix.example: The scientist used a matrix to organize the numbers into rows and columns.
matrix.exampleZh: 科学家用一个矩阵把数字组织成行和列。

matter.example: It does not matter if we are a little late today.
matter.exampleZh: 我们今天稍微迟到一点没关系。

mature.example: She is mature enough to handle this problem calmly.
mature.exampleZh: 她足够成熟，能够冷静地处理这个问题。

maturity.example: Her maturity helps her solve problems calmly at work every day.
maturity.exampleZh: 她的成熟帮助她在工作中每天冷静地解决问题。

maul.example: The big dog mauled the toy and tore it apart.
maul.exampleZh: 那只大狗粗暴地撕咬玩具，把它撕成了碎片。

maunder.example: The old man would maunder about his youth while walking slowly through the park.
maunder.exampleZh: 那位老人一边在公园里慢慢走着，一边唠叨着他年轻时的往事。

maven.example: She is a maven in computer science and often helps students.
maven.exampleZh: 她是计算机科学方面的专家，经常帮助学生。

maverick.example: She is a maverick who always questions the old rules.
maverick.exampleZh: 她是个特立独行的人，总是质疑旧规则。

maxim.example: My father often said that hard work is the best maxim for a happy life.
maxim.exampleZh: 我父亲常说，努力工作是幸福生活的最佳格言。

maximize.example: We try to maximize our time by planning every day carefully.
maximize.exampleZh: 我们通过仔细规划每一天来充分利用时间。

maximum.example: The car can hold a maximum of five people.
maximum.exampleZh: 这辆车最多能坐五个人。

may.example: You may take one apple and eat it after lunch.
may.exampleZh: 你可以拿一个苹果，午饭后吃。

maybe.example: Maybe it will rain later this afternoon, so bring an umbrella.
maybe.exampleZh: 大概今天下午会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

mayhem.example: The sudden power cut caused mayhem in the busy train station.
mayhem.exampleZh: 突然停电在繁忙的火车站里引起了大混乱。

mayor.example: The mayor of our city opened the new park last week.
mayor.exampleZh: 我们城市的市长上周为这座新公园揭幕。

maze.example: We got lost in the maze and could not find the way out.
maze.exampleZh: 我们在迷宫里迷路了，找不到出去的路。

meadow.example: The cows are eating grass in the green meadow behind our house.
meadow.exampleZh: 奶牛正在我们房子后面的绿色草地上吃草。

mean.example: I did not mean to hurt your feelings last night.
mean.exampleZh: 我昨晚不是故意要伤害你的感情。

meander.example: The river meanders quietly through the green fields behind our small town.
meander.exampleZh: 那条河静静地蜿蜒流过我们小镇后面的绿色田野。

meaning.example: I do not understand the meaning of this word.
meaning.exampleZh: 我不明白这个词的意思。

meaningful.example: Talking with my grandfather is always meaningful and teaches me a lot.
meaningful.exampleZh: 和祖父聊天总是很有意义，让我学到很多。

means.example: This tool is a good means of fixing the old chair.
means.exampleZh: 这个工具是修理那把旧椅子的好方法。

meantime.example: In the meantime, I will finish my homework and wait for you.
meantime.exampleZh: 在此期间，我会写完作业并等你。

meanwhile.example: She cooked dinner; meanwhile, her brother cleaned the whole living room.
meanwhile.exampleZh: 她做晚饭，与此同时，她弟弟打扫了整个客厅。

measurable.example: The team made measurable progress on the project this month.
measurable.exampleZh: 这个月团队在项目上取得了可衡量的进展。

measure.example: The doctor will measure your height and weight before the check-up.
measure.exampleZh: 医生会在检查前测量你的身高和体重。

measurement.example: The measurement of the room shows it is ten feet wide.
measurement.exampleZh: 对这个房间的测量显示它有十英尺宽。

mechanic.example: The mechanic fixed my car in about an hour.
mechanic.exampleZh: 技工用了大约一个小时修好我的车。

mechanical.example: The robot's mechanical movements look stiff and strange to most people.
mechanical.exampleZh: 这个机器人的机械动作在大多数人看来僵硬又奇怪。

mechanics.example: He studies mechanics because he wants to understand how machines and bridges work.
mechanics.exampleZh: 他学习力学，因为他想了解机器和桥梁是如何运作的。

mechanism.example: The clock has a simple mechanism that keeps it running all day.
mechanism.exampleZh: 这个钟有一个简单的机械装置，使它整天运转。

medal.example: She won a gold medal in the race last year.
medal.exampleZh: 她去年在那场比赛中赢得了一枚金牌。

meddle.example: Please do not meddle in things that are none of your business.
meddle.exampleZh: 请不要干涉与你无关的事情。

meddlesome.example: My meddlesome neighbor always asks about my private life.
meddlesome.exampleZh: 我爱管闲事的邻居总是打听我的私生活。

media.example: The media often report news about famous people and sports events.
media.exampleZh: 媒体经常报道关于名人和体育赛事的新闻。

median.example: The median of these five numbers is the middle one.
median.exampleZh: 这五个数字的中位数是中间那个。

mediate.example: A teacher helped mediate the dispute between the two students.
mediate.exampleZh: 一位老师帮助调解了两个学生之间的争执。

mediation.example: The two sides agreed to try mediation before going to court.
mediation.exampleZh: 双方同意在诉诸法庭之前先尝试调解。

medical.example: She needs medical help after the accident on the road.
medical.exampleZh: 她在路上发生事故后需要医疗救助。

medication.example: The doctor gave me medication to help with my bad cough.
medication.exampleZh: 医生给我开了药来帮助缓解我严重的咳嗽。

medicine.example: The doctor gave me medicine for my bad cold.
medicine.exampleZh: 医生给了我治重感冒的药。

medieval.example: This old town still has many medieval buildings and narrow streets.
medieval.exampleZh: 这座老城仍有许多中世纪建筑和狭窄的街道。

mediocre.example: The food was mediocre, but the service was very friendly and fast.
mediocre.exampleZh: 食物很普通，但服务非常友好且快捷。

meditate.example: Every morning she sits quietly by the window and meditates for ten minutes.
meditate.exampleZh: 每天早上她都安静地坐在窗边冥想十分钟。

meditation.example: Daily meditation helps her stay calm and focused at work.
meditation.exampleZh: 每天冥想有助于她在工作中保持平静和专注。

medium.example: The internet is a powerful medium for sharing news with many people.
medium.exampleZh: 互联网是向许多人分享新闻的强大媒介。

meek.example: She is a meek girl who never argues with anyone.
meek.exampleZh: 她是个温顺的女孩，从不和任何人争吵。

meet.example: I am happy to meet my old friend at the park today.
meet.exampleZh: 今天我很高兴在公园遇见我的老朋友。

meeting.example: I have a meeting with my teacher after class today.
meeting.exampleZh: 今天下课后我和老师有一个会面。

melancholy.example: A deep melancholy filled the old house after she left.
melancholy.exampleZh: 她离开后，一种深深的忧郁笼罩了那座老房子。

melanin.example: Melanin gives our skin, hair, and eyes their dark color.
melanin.exampleZh: 黑色素赋予我们的皮肤、头发和眼睛深色。

melee.example: A sudden melee broke out near the exit when the doors finally opened.
melee.exampleZh: 当大门终于打开时，出口附近突然爆发了一场混战。

mellow.example: The old musician played a mellow song on his guitar last night.
mellow.exampleZh: 那位老音乐家昨晚用吉他弹奏了一首柔和的曲子。

melodramatic.example: She was being melodramatic about losing her pen, but we still laughed.
melodramatic.exampleZh: 她为丢了一支笔就大惊小怪，不过我们还是笑了。

melody.example: The melody of this old song stays in my head all day.
melody.exampleZh: 这首老歌的旋律一整天都萦绕在我脑海里。

melt.example: The ice will melt quickly in the hot summer sun.
melt.exampleZh: 在炎热的夏日阳光下，冰会很快融化。

melting.example: The melting snow turned the road into a small river.
melting.exampleZh: 融化的雪把这条路变成了小河。

member.example: Every member of the team must wear a name badge.
member.exampleZh: 团队的每位成员都必须佩戴姓名牌。

membership.example: The club's membership has grown to over three hundred people this year.
membership.exampleZh: 今年这个俱乐部的会员人数已经增长到三百多人。

memoir.example: She wrote a memoir about her childhood in a small village.
memoir.exampleZh: 她写了一本关于自己在一个小村庄度过的童年的回忆录。

memorable.example: The trip to the beach was a memorable day for our family.
memorable.exampleZh: 那次去海滩的旅行对我们全家来说是难忘的一天。

memorial.example: We visited the war memorial to honor the brave soldiers who died.
memorial.exampleZh: 我们参观了战争纪念碑，以纪念那些牺牲的勇敢士兵。

memorize.example: I try to memorize ten new words every morning before school.
memorize.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前尽量记住十个新单词。

memory.example: My memory of that summer is still very clear.
memory.exampleZh: 我对那个夏天的记忆仍然非常清晰。

menace.example: The dark clouds on the horizon were a menace to the small fishing boats.
menace.exampleZh: 地平线上的乌云对小渔船来说是一种威胁。

mend.example: My father will mend the broken chair this afternoon.
mend.exampleZh: 我父亲今天下午会修理那把坏掉的椅子。

mendacious.example: The mendacious witness told the court a story that was not true.
mendacious.exampleZh: 那个说谎的证人向法庭讲述了一个不真实的故事。

mental.example: Regular exercise is good for both your physical and mental health.
mental.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对身体和心理健康都有好处。

mentality.example: Her positive mentality helped her solve the problem quickly.
mentality.exampleZh: 她积极的心态帮助她很快解决了问题。

mention.example: She did not mention the meeting in her email to us.
mention.exampleZh: 她在给我们的邮件中没有提及那次会议。

mentor.example: My mentor helped me learn the job in my first month.
mentor.exampleZh: 我的导师在我第一个月帮我熟悉了这份工作。

menu.example: The waiter gave me a menu with many dishes on it.
menu.exampleZh: 服务员给了我一份菜单，上面有很多菜。

mercantile.example: The city became a mercantile center where ships brought goods from many countries.
mercantile.exampleZh: 这座城市成为了一个商业中心，船只从许多国家运来货物。

mercenary.example: The old soldier became a mercenary and fought for money.
mercenary.exampleZh: 那个老兵当了雇佣兵，为钱打仗。

merchandise.example: The store sells a wide range of merchandise for the home.
merchandise.exampleZh: 这家商店出售各种各样的家居商品。

merchant.example: The merchant sold fresh fruit at a small shop near the river.
merchant.exampleZh: 这位商人在河边的一家小店里卖新鲜水果。

merciful.example: The judge was merciful and gave the young man a second chance.
merciful.exampleZh: 法官很仁慈，给了那个年轻人第二次机会。

mercury.example: The thermometer contains a small amount of mercury inside its glass tube.
mercury.exampleZh: 温度计的玻璃管内含有少量的水银。

mercy.example: The kind judge showed mercy and let the young man go home.
mercy.exampleZh: 仁慈的法官网开一面，让那个年轻人回家了。

mere.example: The mere thought of the exam makes me feel nervous.
mere.exampleZh: 仅仅想到考试就让我感到紧张。

merge.example: The two small teams will merge into one next month.
merge.exampleZh: 这两个小团队下个月将合并成一个。

merger.example: The merger of the two small banks created a much larger company.
merger.exampleZh: 两家小银行的合并创建了一家规模大得多的公司。

merit.example: Her hard work and honesty have great merit.
merit.exampleZh: 她的勤奋和诚实很有价值。

merry.example: The children were merry at the birthday party and sang songs together.
merry.exampleZh: 孩子们在生日聚会上很欢乐，一起唱歌。

mesh.example: The fish escaped through a hole in the mesh of the net.
mesh.exampleZh: 鱼从网眼的破洞中逃走了。

mess.example: Your room is a mess, so please clean it up now.
mess.exampleZh: 你的房间一团糟，请现在把它收拾干净。

message.example: I got a message from my teacher about the school trip.
message.exampleZh: 我收到了老师关于学校旅行的消息。

messenger.example: The messenger brought a letter to the king.
messenger.exampleZh: 信使给国王带来了一封信。

metal.example: This box is made of metal and it feels very cold.
metal.exampleZh: 这个盒子是用金属做的，摸起来很凉。

metallic.example: The old car had a bright metallic paint that looked nice in the sun.
metallic.exampleZh: 这辆旧车有一种明亮的金属漆，在阳光下看起来很好看。

metamorphosis.example: The caterpillar's metamorphosis into a butterfly takes several weeks.
metamorphosis.exampleZh: 毛毛虫变成蝴蝶的蜕变过程需要几周时间。

metaphor.example: The poet uses a metaphor to compare life to a long journey.
metaphor.exampleZh: 诗人用隐喻把人生比作一段漫长的旅程。

metaphorical.example: The teacher said the poem uses metaphorical language to describe love as a rose.
metaphorical.exampleZh: 老师说这首诗用隐喻的语言把爱情比作玫瑰。

mete.example: The judge will mete out a fair punishment to each offender.
mete.exampleZh: 法官会对每个违法者给予公正的惩罚。

meteor.example: Last night I saw a bright meteor move quickly across the dark sky.
meteor.exampleZh: 昨晚我看见一颗明亮的流星快速划过漆黑的天空。

meteorology.example: She studies meteorology at university because she wants to understand the weather.
meteorology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习气象学，因为她想了解天气。

method.example: This method is simple and works well for most students.
method.exampleZh: 这个方法很简单，对大多数学生都有效。

methodical.example: Her methodical way of working helps the whole team finish on time.
methodical.exampleZh: 她有条理的工作方式帮助整个团队按时完成任务。

methodology.example: The team's methodology for testing new ideas is simple and clear.
methodology.exampleZh: 团队测试新想法的方法论简单明了。

meticulous.example: She is meticulous about every detail in her work.
meticulous.exampleZh: 她对工作中的每一个细节都一丝不苟。

metric.example: Our team uses one metric to measure how well the new plan works.
metric.exampleZh: 我们团队用一个指标来衡量新计划的效果如何。

metropolis.example: Tokyo is a huge metropolis with many people and busy streets.
metropolis.exampleZh: 东京是一个人口众多、街道繁忙的大都市。

metropolitan.example: The metropolitan area has many jobs and good public transport.
metropolitan.exampleZh: 这个大都市区有很多工作机会和良好的公共交通。

microbe.example: Washing your hands helps remove microbes that can make you sick.
microbe.exampleZh: 洗手有助于清除可能让你生病的微生物。

microbiology.example: She studies microbiology at the university and hopes to work in a hospital lab.
microbiology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习微生物学，希望将来在医院实验室工作。

microcosm.example: This small village is a microcosm of the whole country.
microcosm.exampleZh: 这个小村庄是整个国家的缩影。

microeconomic.example: The microeconomic effects of this new tax are small for most families.
microeconomic.exampleZh: 这项新税对大多数家庭的微观经济影响很小。

microphone.example: She spoke into the microphone so everyone in the room could hear her.
microphone.exampleZh: 她对着麦克风讲话，好让房间里的每个人都能听到。

microscope.example: We used a microscope to look at the tiny cells in science class.
microscope.exampleZh: 我们在科学课上用显微镜观察微小的细胞。

microscopic.example: Under the microscope, we could see tiny microscopic creatures moving in the water.
microscopic.exampleZh: 在显微镜下，我们能看到水中移动的微小生物。

microwave.example: He put the cold soup in the microwave for two minutes.
microwave.exampleZh: 他把冷汤放进微波炉里热了两分钟。

middle.example: The middle of the room is empty, so we can put the table there.
middle.exampleZh: 房间中间是空的，所以我们可以把桌子放在那里。

middleman.example: The middleman buys fruit from farmers and sells it to shops.
middleman.exampleZh: 中间商从农民那里买水果，再卖给商店。

midst.example: In the midst of the crowd, I lost sight of my friend.
midst.exampleZh: 在人群之中，我看不见我的朋友了。

mien.example: His calm mien made everyone feel safe during the storm.
mien.exampleZh: 他镇定的神态让每个人在暴风雨中都感到安心。

might.example: She might use her power to help the poor.
might.exampleZh: 她可能会用她的权力来帮助穷人。

migrant.example: The migrant workers travel to the city every spring to find work.
migrant.exampleZh: 外来务工人员每年春天前往城市寻找工作。

migrate.example: Many birds migrate to warm places when winter comes.
migrate.exampleZh: 冬天来临时，许多鸟类迁徙到温暖的地方。

migration.example: The migration of birds to warm places happens every winter.
migration.exampleZh: 鸟类迁徙到温暖的地方每年冬天都会发生。

mild.example: The winter here is mild, so we can still walk outside.
mild.exampleZh: 这里的冬天很温和，所以我们仍然可以在户外散步。

militant.example: The militant group refused to talk with the government about peace.
militant.exampleZh: 该好战组织拒绝与政府讨论和平问题。

military.example: The country spends a lot of money on military training every year.
military.exampleZh: 这个国家每年在军事训练上花费大量资金。

milk.example: I drink a glass of milk every morning before school.
milk.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前喝一杯牛奶。

mill.example: The old mill by the river still grinds wheat into flour.
mill.exampleZh: 河边的老磨坊仍在把小麦磨成面粉。

millennium.example: People celebrated the new millennium with fireworks and music in many cities.
millennium.exampleZh: 许多城市的人们用烟花和音乐庆祝新的千禧年。

milligram.example: The doctor said this pill contains only one milligram of the medicine.
milligram.exampleZh: 医生说这粒药只含一毫克药物。

millimeter.example: The bug is only three millimeters long, so you need a glass to see it.
millimeter.exampleZh: 这只虫子只有三毫米长，所以你需要用放大镜才能看到它。

million.example: The city has more than one million people living in it now.
million.exampleZh: 这座城市现在有超过一百万人居住。

mimic.example: Children often mimic the way their parents speak at home.
mimic.exampleZh: 孩子们常常模仿父母在家说话的方式。

minatory.example: His minatory tone made the small children step back in fear.
minatory.exampleZh: 他威胁的语气让小孩子害怕地后退了。

mince.example: Please mince the garlic and add it to the hot pan.
mince.exampleZh: 请把大蒜切碎，然后放进热锅里。

mind.example: Please keep in mind that the train leaves at eight tomorrow morning.
mind.exampleZh: 请记住明天早上八点火车出发。

mine.example: The old mine near our town is now closed.
mine.exampleZh: 我们镇附近的那座老矿现在已经关闭了。

mineral.example: Plants need water and minerals from the soil to grow well.
mineral.exampleZh: 植物需要水和土壤中的矿物质才能长得好。

mingle.example: At the party, old friends mingled with new guests and talked all evening.
mingle.exampleZh: 在聚会上，老朋友和新客人交融在一起，聊了一整晚。

miniature.example: She keeps a miniature horse on her small farm.
miniature.exampleZh: 她的小农场里养着一匹微型马。

minimal.example: The new design uses minimal space and costs very little.
minimal.exampleZh: 新设计占用的空间极小，成本也很低。

minimize.example: We should minimize the noise so the baby can sleep well.
minimize.exampleZh: 我们应该尽量减少噪音，好让宝宝好好睡觉。

minimum.example: Please keep your work at a minimum and check every number twice.
minimum.exampleZh: 请把你的工作量保持在最低限度，并把每个数字都核对两遍。

minister.example: The minister spoke to the students at the school this morning.
minister.exampleZh: 今天上午，部长在学校对学生们讲了话。

ministry.example: The ministry of health announced a new plan to help hospitals.
ministry.exampleZh: 卫生部宣布了一项帮助医院的新计划。

minor.example: He had a minor problem with his car, so he fixed it quickly.
minor.exampleZh: 他的车出了个小问题，所以他很快就修好了。

minority.example: Only a small minority of students came to the meeting today.
minority.exampleZh: 今天只有少数学生来参加了会议。

mint.example: The old mint makes coins and also sells fresh mint for tea.
mint.exampleZh: 这家古老的铸币厂制造硬币，也出售泡茶用的新鲜薄荷。

minus.example: Ten minus four is six, and the temperature outside is minus five degrees.
minus.exampleZh: 十减四等于六，外面的气温是零下五度。

minute.example: Please wait a minute; the smallest details matter here.
minute.exampleZh: 请稍等一分钟；在这里最微小的细节也很重要。

miracle.example: It was a miracle that no one was hurt in the car accident.
miracle.exampleZh: 车祸中没有人受伤，这真是个奇迹。

mirage.example: The tired travelers thought they saw water, but it was only a mirage.
mirage.exampleZh: 疲惫的旅人以为看到了水，但那只是海市蜃楼。

mire.example: The company slowly mired itself in debt after a few bad years.
mire.exampleZh: 几个糟糕的年头过后，公司慢慢陷入了债务困境。

mirror.example: The still lake was a mirror that showed the mountains and the sky.
mirror.exampleZh: 平静的湖面是一面镜子，映出了群山和天空。

misanthrope.example: The old misanthrope lives alone and rarely speaks to his neighbors.
misanthrope.exampleZh: 那个年老的厌世者独自生活，很少和邻居说话。

miscarriage.example: The loss of the deal was a miscarriage of their long planning.
miscarriage.exampleZh: 那笔交易的失败是他们长期规划的一次流产。

miscellaneous.example: The box held miscellaneous tools, old keys, and a few broken toys.
miscellaneous.exampleZh: 盒子里装着各种杂物、旧钥匙和几个坏掉的玩具。

mischief.example: The little boy got into mischief while his mother was on the phone.
mischief.exampleZh: 小男孩在妈妈打电话时胡闹起来。

misconception.example: Many students have a misconception that learning English only means memorizing words.
misconception.exampleZh: 许多学生有一个误解，认为学英语只是背单词。

misconduct.example: The manager was fired for serious misconduct at work.
misconduct.exampleZh: 这位经理因工作中的严重不当行为被解雇了。

miscreant.example: The police caught the miscreant who stole money from the old woman.
miscreant.exampleZh: 警察抓住了那个偷老妇人钱财的歹徒。

miserable.example: He felt miserable because he lost his job and had no money.
miserable.exampleZh: 他感到很悲惨，因为他失去了工作，也没有钱。

misery.example: The loss of her home brought her deep misery for many years.
misery.exampleZh: 失去家园给她带来了多年的深切痛苦。

misfortune.example: His greatest misfortune was losing his job just before winter.
misfortune.exampleZh: 他最大的不幸是在冬天到来前失去了工作。

misgiving.example: I had a slight misgiving about the plan, but I agreed to it.
misgiving.exampleZh: 我对这个计划有点疑虑，但还是同意了。

misleading.example: The advertisement was misleading, so many people bought the wrong product.
misleading.exampleZh: 这则广告具有误导性，因此许多人买错了产品。

misnomer.example: Calling a whale a fish is a misnomer that many children learn to correct.
misnomer.exampleZh: 把鲸鱼叫作鱼是一种误称，许多孩子后来都学会了纠正这一点。

misplace.example: I often misplace my keys in the morning.
misplace.exampleZh: 我早上经常把钥匙放错地方。

miss.example: I miss my old friends, but I never miss the bus now.
miss.exampleZh: 我想念我的老朋友，但我现在再也不会错过公交车了。

missile.example: The army fired a missile at the target far away.
missile.exampleZh: 军队向远处的目标发射了一枚导弹。

missing.example: The police are still looking for the missing child near the river.
missing.exampleZh: 警方仍在河边寻找那个失踪的孩子。

mission.example: Our mission is to help young people learn new skills.
mission.exampleZh: 我们的使命是帮助年轻人学习新技能。

missionary.example: The missionary traveled to Africa to teach and help local people.
missionary.exampleZh: 那位传教士前往非洲教书并帮助当地人。

mist.example: A thin mist covered the lake early this morning.
mist.exampleZh: 今天清晨，一层薄雾笼罩着湖面。

mistake.example: Everyone makes a mistake sometimes, so do not be afraid to try again.
mistake.exampleZh: 每个人有时都会犯错，所以不要害怕再试一次。

mistress.example: The old house belonged to the mistress of a rich businessman.
mistress.exampleZh: 这栋老房子属于一位富商的情妇。

misunderstand.example: Please do not misunderstand me; I only want to help you.
misunderstand.exampleZh: 请不要误会我，我只是想帮你。

mite.example: A tiny mite lives in the dust on the old bed.
mite.exampleZh: 一只微小的螨虫生活在旧床上的灰尘里。

mitigate.example: The new rules may mitigate the damage caused by heavy traffic.
mitigate.exampleZh: 新规定可能会减轻繁忙交通造成的损害。

mix.example: Mix the flour and eggs together, then add some milk.
mix.exampleZh: 把面粉和鸡蛋混合在一起，然后加一些牛奶。

mixture.example: The cake is a mixture of flour, eggs, and sugar.
mixture.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕是面粉、鸡蛋和糖的混合物。

moan.example: She let out a soft moan and closed her eyes in pain.
moan.exampleZh: 她轻轻呻吟了一声，痛苦地闭上了眼睛。

moat.example: The old castle was protected by a deep moat full of water.
moat.exampleZh: 那座古老的城堡被一条深深的、满是水的护城河保护着。

mob.example: An angry mob gathered outside the court after the trial.
mob.exampleZh: 审判结束后，一群愤怒的暴民聚集在法院外面。

mobile.example: My grandfather uses a mobile phone to call us every Sunday.
mobile.exampleZh: 我爷爷每周日都用手机给我们打电话。

mobility.example: Good public transport gives poor people more mobility in the city.
mobility.exampleZh: 良好的公共交通让穷人在城市中有更多的流动性。

mobilize.example: The teacher tried to mobilize all the students to help clean the park.
mobilize.exampleZh: 老师试图动员所有学生帮忙打扫公园。

mock.example: The students mock his old phone, but he does not care.
mock.exampleZh: 学生们嘲笑他的旧手机，但他并不在意。

mode.example: Reading in bed is his favorite mode of relaxation after work.
mode.exampleZh: 躺在床上看书是他下班后最喜欢的放松方式。

model.example: She is a model for the art class, and he models a new car on the computer.
model.exampleZh: 她是美术课的模特，而他在电脑上为新车建模。

modem.example: I turned off the modem and waited a minute before turning it on again.
modem.exampleZh: 我关掉调制解调器，等了一分钟再重新打开。

moderate.example: The doctor told him to do moderate exercise and drink more water every day.
moderate.exampleZh: 医生让他每天做适度运动，多喝水。

moderation.example: He eats sweets in moderation to stay healthy.
moderation.exampleZh: 他适度吃甜食以保持健康。

modern.example: This modern phone is easy to use and very fast.
modern.exampleZh: 这部现代的手机很容易使用，而且速度很快。

modernization.example: The modernization of our city has brought many new jobs.
modernization.exampleZh: 我们城市的现代化带来了许多新的工作机会。

modernize.example: We plan to modernize the old factory next year.
modernize.exampleZh: 我们计划明年使这座老工厂现代化。

modest.example: She is modest about her success and always thanks her team.
modest.exampleZh: 她对自己的成功很谦虚，总是感谢她的团队。

modification.example: The teacher asked us to make one small modification to the plan.
modification.exampleZh: 老师让我们对这个计划做一处小小的修改。

modify.example: We need to modify the plan before the meeting starts tomorrow.
modify.exampleZh: 我们需要在明天会议开始前修改这个计划。

modular.example: The new phone has a modular design, so broken parts are easy to replace.
modular.exampleZh: 这款新手机采用模块化设计，所以损坏的部件很容易更换。

modulate.example: We can modulate the light to make the room feel calm.
modulate.exampleZh: 我们可以调节灯光，让房间感觉更宁静。

module.example: This software module helps students learn new words in a fun way.
module.exampleZh: 这个软件模块帮助学生以有趣的方式学习新单词。

moist.example: The cake stays moist if you keep it in a closed box.
moist.exampleZh: 如果你把蛋糕放在密封的盒子里，它就能保持湿润。

moisture.example: The moisture in the air makes the room feel cold and wet.
moisture.exampleZh: 空气中的水分让房间感觉又冷又潮。

mold.example: The bread was left too long and now has green mold on it.
mold.exampleZh: 面包放得太久，现在上面长了绿色的霉菌。

molecular.example: Water is a molecular substance made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
molecular.exampleZh: 水是一种分子物质，由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成。

molecule.example: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
molecule.exampleZh: 一个水分子含有两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

molest.example: He was punished for trying to molest a child in the park.
molest.exampleZh: 他因试图在公园里调戏一名儿童而受到惩罚。

moment.example: Please wait a moment while I find your file.
moment.exampleZh: 请稍等片刻，我找一下你的文件。

momentum.example: The team kept its momentum and won the next three games easily.
momentum.exampleZh: 这支队伍保持了势头，轻松赢下了接下来的三场比赛。

monarch.example: The old monarch ruled the country for more than fifty years.
monarch.exampleZh: 这位年迈的君主统治这个国家五十多年。

monarchy.example: The country changed from a monarchy to a republic many years ago.
monarchy.exampleZh: 这个国家多年前从君主制变成了共和国。

monastery.example: The old monastery stands quietly on the hill above our village.
monastery.exampleZh: 那座古老的修道院静静地矗立在我们村庄上方的山上。

monetary.example: The bank must control monetary policy to keep prices stable.
monetary.exampleZh: 银行必须控制货币政策以保持物价稳定。

money.example: She saves some money every month for a new bike.
money.exampleZh: 她每个月都存一些钱，想买一辆新自行车。

monitor.example: The teacher asked the class monitor to turn on the monitor.
monitor.exampleZh: 老师让班长打开显示器。

monopoly.example: The company has a monopoly on all the water in this small town.
monopoly.exampleZh: 这家公司垄断了这个小镇的所有水资源。

monotone.example: His voice had a dull monotone that made the long speech hard to follow.
monotone.exampleZh: 他的声音单调沉闷，让这场冗长的演讲很难听下去。

monster.example: The little boy thinks a monster lives under his bed at night.
monster.exampleZh: 这个小男孩认为夜里有一只怪物住在他的床下。

monthly.example: We have a monthly meeting to talk about our work.
monthly.exampleZh: 我们每月开一次会来讨论工作。

monument.example: They built a stone monument in the park to remember the soldiers.
monument.exampleZh: 他们在公园里建了一座石碑纪念碑来纪念那些士兵。

monumental.example: Building the bridge was a monumental task for the small town.
monumental.exampleZh: 建造这座桥对这个小镇来说是一项巨大的工程。

mood.example: Her mood got much better after she heard the good news today.
mood.exampleZh: 她今天听到这个好消息后，心情好多了。

moon.example: The moon is very bright tonight, so we can walk home without a light.
moon.exampleZh: 今晚月亮很亮，所以我们不用灯就能走回家。

mop.example: I use a mop to clean the kitchen floor every Saturday.
mop.exampleZh: 我每周六用拖把拖厨房的地板。

moral.example: Good parents teach their children to make moral choices every day.
moral.exampleZh: 好的父母每天都会教孩子做出有道德的选择。

morale.example: The team's morale was low after they lost three games in a row.
morale.exampleZh: 球队连输三场之后，士气很低。

morality.example: Honesty is an important part of morality in every culture.
morality.exampleZh: 诚实是每种文化中道德的重要组成部分。

moreover.example: The room is clean and cheap; moreover, it is very close to the station.
moreover.exampleZh: 这个房间干净又便宜，而且离车站很近。

morning.example: I drink a glass of warm water every morning before breakfast.
morning.exampleZh: 我每天早上早餐前喝一杯温水。

mortal.example: All humans are mortal, so we should value our time.
mortal.exampleZh: 所有人终有一死，所以我们应该珍惜时间。

mortality.example: The mortality rate among young children has fallen in recent years.
mortality.exampleZh: 近年来幼儿的死亡率已经下降。

mortar.example: The workers used mortar to hold the bricks together.
mortar.exampleZh: 工人们用灰浆把砖块粘在一起。

mortgage.example: They took out a mortgage to buy their first house last year.
mortgage.exampleZh: 他们去年办了一笔抵押贷款，买了第一套房子。

mosque.example: The old mosque near our school has a beautiful garden.
mosque.exampleZh: 我们学校附近的那座古老清真寺有一个美丽的花园。

mosquito.example: A mosquito bit me on the arm while I was sleeping last night.
mosquito.exampleZh: 昨晚我睡觉时，一只蚊子咬了我的胳膊。

most.example: Most students in our class like to play basketball after school.
most.exampleZh: 我们班大多数学生喜欢放学后打篮球。

mostly.example: The students in my class are mostly from small towns nearby.
mostly.exampleZh: 我班上的学生多半来自附近的小镇。

motel.example: We stayed at a cheap motel near the highway for one night.
motel.exampleZh: 我们在高速公路附近的一家便宜汽车旅馆住了一晚。

moth.example: A moth flew into the lamp and stayed there all night.
moth.exampleZh: 一只蛾飞进灯里，在那里待了一整夜。

motion.example: The club voted on a motion to change its meeting time.
motion.exampleZh: 俱乐部就一项更改会议时间的动议进行了投票。

motivate.example: Teachers should motivate students to read more books at home.
motivate.exampleZh: 老师应该激励学生在家多读书。

motivation.example: Her motivation to learn English grew stronger after she made her first foreign friend.
motivation.exampleZh: 在交了第一个外国朋友之后，她学英语的动力变得更强了。

motive.example: The police could not find a clear motive for the crime.
motive.exampleZh: 警方找不到这起犯罪的明确动机。

motor.example: The motor skills of young children develop quickly.
motor.exampleZh: 幼儿的运动技能发展得很快。

motorcycle.example: My father rides his motorcycle to work every morning when the weather is good.
motorcycle.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我父亲每天早上骑摩托车去上班。

mould.example: She poured the hot liquid into a small metal mould.
mould.exampleZh: 她把热液体倒进一个小金属模具里。

mount.example: The climbers reached the mount before the sun went down.
mount.exampleZh: 登山者在太阳下山前到达了那座山。

mountain.example: We climbed a high mountain and saw the whole city below.
mountain.exampleZh: 我们爬上了一座高山，看到了下面的整座城市。

mourn.example: There was deep mourn in his voice after the bad news.
mourn.exampleZh: 听到坏消息后，他的声音里带着深深的哀伤。

move.example: The move to a new apartment made everyone in the family very happy.
move.exampleZh: 搬到新公寓让家里每个人都很开心。

movement.example: The slow movement of the turtle across the road made everyone stop and wait.
movement.exampleZh: 乌龟缓慢地穿过马路，让每个人都停下来等待。

movie.example: My friends and I watched a funny movie at home last night.
movie.exampleZh: 昨晚我和朋友们在家看了一部有趣的电影。

much.example: You have given me much to think about today.
much.exampleZh: 你今天给了我很多值得思考的东西。

mud.example: The children came home with mud all over their shoes.
mud.exampleZh: 孩子们回家时鞋上沾满了泥。

muddle.example: Too many rules will only muddle the students and make them give up.
muddle.exampleZh: 太多规则只会让学生糊涂，并使他们放弃。

muffle.example: He put a thick cloth over the drum to muffle its sound.
muffle.exampleZh: 他在鼓上盖了一块厚布，把鼓声裹住、压低。

multiple.example: The doctor checked multiple tests before he made his final decision.
multiple.exampleZh: 医生在做出最终决定前查看了多项检查。

multiply.example: If you multiply those two numbers, you will get the right answer.
multiply.exampleZh: 如果你把这两个数相乘，你就会得到正确答案。

multitude.example: A multitude of fans waited outside the stadium for the team.
multitude.exampleZh: 大批球迷在体育场外等候球队。

municipal.example: The municipal government built a new park for local families.
municipal.exampleZh: 市政府为当地家庭建了一个新公园。

murder.example: The police are investigating the murder of a young man last night.
murder.exampleZh: 警方正在调查昨晚一名年轻男子的谋杀案。

murderous.example: The police caught the murderous man before he could hurt anyone else.
murderous.exampleZh: 警方在那个凶残的男人伤害更多人之前抓住了他。

murmur.example: I heard a soft murmur from the next room.
murmur.exampleZh: 我听到隔壁房间传来轻柔的低语声。

muscle.example: He goes to the gym every day to build strong muscles.
muscle.exampleZh: 他每天去健身房锻炼，以增强强壮的肌肉。

muscular.example: He goes to the gym every day and has become very muscular.
muscular.exampleZh: 他每天去健身房，已经变得非常肌肉发达了。

museum.example: We visited the museum with our class last Friday morning.
museum.exampleZh: 上周五上午我们全班一起参观了博物馆。

mushroom.example: Mushrooms grow fast in warm, wet weather after the rain.
mushroom.exampleZh: 雨后温暖潮湿的天气里，蘑菇长得很快。

music.example: I like to listen to music when I walk home from school.
music.exampleZh: 我喜欢在放学回家的路上听音乐。

musical.example: The musical show was fun and everyone sang along with the happy songs.
musical.exampleZh: 这场音乐剧表演很有趣，每个人都跟着欢快的歌曲一起唱。

musician.example: The musician plays the piano very well and loves to teach children.
musician.exampleZh: 这位音乐家钢琴弹得很好，而且喜欢教孩子们。

must.example: In this job, a good plan is a must for everyone.
must.exampleZh: 在这份工作中，一份好的计划对每个人来说都是必需的。

mustard.example: She put a little mustard on her sandwich before eating it.
mustard.exampleZh: 她在吃三明治之前在上面放了一点芥末。

mutate.example: Small changes in the virus can mutate quickly and spread to other people.
mutate.exampleZh: 病毒的微小变化会迅速突变，并传播给其他人。

mutation.example: A small mutation in the gene can change how the plant grows.
mutation.exampleZh: 基因中的一个微小突变就能改变这种植物的生长方式。

mute.example: He stayed mute during the whole meeting and said nothing.
mute.exampleZh: 整个会议期间他一直沉默不语，什么都没说。

mutiny.example: The captain feared a mutiny among the tired sailors on the ship.
mutiny.exampleZh: 船长担心船上疲惫的水手们会发动兵变。

mutter.example: I heard a low mutter from the back of the room.
mutter.exampleZh: 我听到房间后面传来一声低沉的嘀咕。

mutton.example: My mother cooked mutton with potatoes for dinner last night.
mutton.exampleZh: 昨晚我妈妈用土豆炖羊肉当晚餐。

mutual.example: Good friendship needs mutual trust and respect between both people.
mutual.exampleZh: 好的友谊需要两个人之间的相互信任与尊重。

myriad.example: The night sky holds a myriad of stars above the quiet town.
myriad.exampleZh: 宁静的小镇上空，夜空中有无数的星星。

myself.example: I made this cake by myself for my mother's birthday.
myself.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕是我为妈妈的生日亲自做的。

mysterious.example: The old house on the hill looks mysterious at night.
mysterious.exampleZh: 山上的那座老房子在夜里显得很神秘。

mystery.example: The old house is still a mystery to everyone in our small town.
mystery.exampleZh: 那座老房子对我们小镇上的每个人来说仍然是个谜。

myth.example: The myth story about the hero is not true.
myth.exampleZh: 关于那个英雄的神话故事不是真的。

mythology.example: She studies Greek mythology at the university and loves the old stories.
mythology.exampleZh: 她在大学研究希腊神话，并且很喜欢那些古老的故事。

nab.example: The police nabbed the thief as he ran out of the store.
nab.exampleZh: 小偷跑出商店时，警察抓住了他。

nadir.example: The loss of his job marked the nadir of a very difficult year.
nadir.exampleZh: 失去工作标志着那段艰难一年的最低点。

nag.example: My mother keeps nagging me about cleaning my room every single day.
nag.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天都唠叨我打扫房间。

nail.example: He used a hammer to drive the nail into the wood.
nail.exampleZh: 他用锤子把钉子钉进木头里。

naive.example: She is too naive to understand that some people are not kind.
naive.exampleZh: 她太天真了，不明白有些人心地并不善良。

naked.example: The little boy ran naked across the sand toward the sea.
naked.exampleZh: 那个小男孩光着身子跑过沙滩，向大海奔去。

name.example: Please write your full name at the top of the page.
name.exampleZh: 请在这页纸的顶端写下你的全名。

namely.example: She likes two sports, namely swimming and running.
namely.exampleZh: 她喜欢两项运动，即游泳和跑步。

nap.example: After lunch, he took a short nap on the sofa.
nap.exampleZh: 午饭后，他在沙发上小睡了一会儿。

narcotic.example: The doctor gave him a narcotic to help with the pain.
narcotic.exampleZh: 医生给了他一种麻醉药来缓解疼痛。

narrate.example: Grandma likes to narrate stories about her childhood to us.
narrate.exampleZh: 奶奶喜欢向我们讲述她童年的故事。

narration.example: The film's narration was slow and clear, so everyone could follow the story.
narration.exampleZh: 这部电影的旁白缓慢而清晰，所以每个人都能跟上故事。

narrative.example: Her new book tells a powerful narrative about a small village.
narrative.exampleZh: 她的新书讲述了一个关于小村庄的动人故事。

narrator.example: The narrator of the story is a young boy from a small village.
narrator.exampleZh: 这个故事的叙述者是一个来自小村庄的小男孩。

narrow.example: This street is very narrow, so two cars cannot pass at the same time.
narrow.exampleZh: 这条街很窄，所以两辆车不能同时通过。

nasturtium.example: She planted a bright nasturtium by the kitchen window last spring.
nasturtium.exampleZh: 去年春天她在厨房窗边种了一株鲜艳的旱金莲。

nation.example: China is a large nation with a long and rich history.
nation.exampleZh: 中国是一个幅员辽阔、历史悠久的国家。

national.example: The national team won the game and made the whole country proud.
national.exampleZh: 国家队赢得了比赛，让整个国家感到骄傲。

nationalism.example: The war made many people feel a strong sense of nationalism.
nationalism.exampleZh: 那场战争让许多人产生了强烈的民族主义情感。

nationwide.example: The new law will apply nationwide starting next month.
nationwide.exampleZh: 这项新法律将从下个月起在全国范围内生效。

native.example: She is a native speaker of English and teaches local children.
native.exampleZh: 她是英语母语者，教当地的孩子。

nativity.example: The little town celebrates the nativity of a famous writer every winter.
nativity.exampleZh: 这个小镇每年冬天都会庆祝一位著名作家的诞生。

natty.example: He wore a natty blue suit to the party last night.
natty.exampleZh: 昨晚他穿了一套整洁的蓝色西装去参加聚会。

natural.example: She has a natural ability to make people feel comfortable.
natural.exampleZh: 她天生就有让人感到自在的能力。

nature.example: It is in her nature to help people who are in trouble.
nature.exampleZh: 乐于帮助有困难的人是她的本性。

nauseate.example: The smell of old milk began to nauseate everyone in the small kitchen.
nauseate.exampleZh: 旧牛奶的气味开始让厨房里的每个人感到恶心。

nautical.example: The old sailor told us many nautical stories about his life at sea.
nautical.exampleZh: 那位老水手给我们讲了许多关于他海上生活的航海故事。

naval.example: The naval base is near the sea and many ships stay there.
naval.exampleZh: 那个海军基地位于海边，许多船只停在那里。
