navigate.example: We used a map to navigate through the old city.
navigate.exampleZh: 我们用地图在古城中导航。

navigation.example: The ship's navigation system broke during the storm last night.
navigation.exampleZh: 昨晚暴风雨中，船上的导航系统坏了。

navy.example: My uncle joined the navy when he was eighteen years old.
navy.exampleZh: 我叔叔十八岁时加入了海军。

near.example: My school is near the park, so I walk there every morning.
near.exampleZh: 我的学校靠近公园，所以我每天早上走路去那里。

nearby.example: There is a small park nearby where children often play.
nearby.exampleZh: 附近有个小公园，孩子们经常在那里玩。

neat.example: Her neat handwriting makes the notes easy to read.
neat.exampleZh: 她整洁的字迹让笔记很容易看懂。

neatly.example: She neatly put all the books back on the shelf.
neatly.exampleZh: 她把所有的书整齐地放回了书架上。

neatness.example: Her neatness makes the small room look much bigger and brighter.
neatness.exampleZh: 她的整洁让这个小房间显得更大更明亮。

necessary.example: It is not necessary to bring your own lunch today.

necessity.example: Clean water is a daily necessity for every family in the village.
necessity.exampleZh: 干净的水是村里每个家庭的日常必需品。

neck.example: The scarf around her neck is warm and soft.
neck.exampleZh: 她脖子上的围巾又暖和又柔软。

necklace.example: She wore a beautiful silver necklace to the party last night.
necklace.exampleZh: 昨晚她戴了一条漂亮的银项链去参加聚会。

nectar.example: The bee flies from flower to flower to collect sweet nectar.
nectar.exampleZh: 蜜蜂从一朵花飞到另一朵花，采集甜甜的花蜜。

need.example: I need your help with this homework today.
need.exampleZh: 我今天需要你帮忙做这个作业。

needle.example: The nurse used a clean needle to give him the medicine.
needle.exampleZh: 护士用一根干净的针给他注射药物。

needless.example: It is needless to say that she works very hard every day.
needless.exampleZh: 不用说，她每天都工作得很努力。

negative.example: The doctor said my test result was negative, so I felt very happy.
negative.exampleZh: 医生说我检查结果是阴性，所以我非常高兴。

neglect.example: Many students neglect their homework until the last day.
neglect.exampleZh: 许多学生忽视作业，直到最后一天才做。

negligence.example: The driver's negligence caused the accident and hurt two people.
negligence.exampleZh: 司机的疏忽导致了这场事故，并造成两人受伤。

negligent.example: The negligent driver forgot to check his mirrors before changing lanes.
negligent.exampleZh: 那位疏忽的司机在变道前忘了查看后视镜。

negligible.example: The difference between the two plans is negligible for most families.
negligible.exampleZh: 对大多数家庭来说，这两个计划之间的差别微不足道。

negotiate.example: The two companies will negotiate a new deal next week.
negotiate.exampleZh: 这两家公司下周将谈判一项新协议。

negotiation.example: The two sides began a long negotiation to end the strike.
negotiation.exampleZh: 双方开始了一场漫长的谈判以结束罢工。

neighbor.example: My neighbor often helps me water the plants when I am away.
neighbor.exampleZh: 我不在的时候，我的邻居经常帮我给植物浇水。

neighborhood.example: There is a small park in my neighborhood where children like to play.
neighborhood.exampleZh: 我家附近有一个小公园，孩子们喜欢在那里玩。

neighboring.example: The neighboring town has a small park and a quiet library.
neighboring.exampleZh: 邻近的镇子上有一个小公园和一座安静的图书馆。

neither.example: Neither of the two answers is right, so please try again.
neither.exampleZh: 这两个答案都不对，所以请再试一次。

neon.example: The sign outside the bar was made of bright red neon.
neon.exampleZh: 酒吧外面的招牌是用明亮的红色霓虹灯做的。

neonatal.example: The hospital has a special unit for neonatal care.
neonatal.exampleZh: 这家医院有一个专门的新生儿护理病房。

nephew.example: My nephew is only five years old, but he can already read simple books.
nephew.exampleZh: 我的侄子才五岁，但他已经能读简单的书了。

nerve.example: It takes a lot of nerve to speak in front of the whole school.
nerve.exampleZh: 在全校师生面前讲话需要很大的勇气。

nervous.example: I always feel nervous before I speak in front of many people.
nervous.exampleZh: 我在很多人面前讲话之前总是感到紧张。

nest.example: The bird built a warm nest for its baby birds.
nest.exampleZh: 这只鸟为它的幼鸟筑了一个温暖的巢。

net.example: He caught several big fish in a small net and made a net profit.
net.exampleZh: 他用一张小网抓到了几条大鱼，还净赚了一笔。

network.example: The city has a large network of buses and trains.
network.exampleZh: 这座城市拥有庞大的公交和火车网络。

neutral.example: She stayed neutral and did not support either side in the argument.
neutral.exampleZh: 她保持中立，在争论中不支持任何一方。

neutron.example: A neutron has no electric charge and is found in the nucleus of atoms.
neutron.exampleZh: 中子不带电荷，存在于原子的原子核中。

never.example: I never drink coffee after six in the evening.
never.exampleZh: 我从不在晚上六点以后喝咖啡。

nevertheless.example: It was raining hard, nevertheless we decided to go out for a walk.
nevertheless.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，尽管如此，我们还是决定出去散步。

new.example: I bought a new bike for my son last week.
new.exampleZh: 上周我给我儿子买了一辆新自行车。

newly.example: The newly opened shop sells fresh bread every morning.
newly.exampleZh: 这家新近开张的商店每天早上出售新鲜面包。

news.example: I heard the news about the storm on the radio this morning.
news.exampleZh: 今天早上我在收音机里听到了关于暴风雨的新闻。

next.example: I will see you next week at the same place.
next.exampleZh: 我下周会在同一个地方见你。

nice.example: It is nice to meet you and your family today.
nice.exampleZh: 今天见到你和你的家人真是太好了。

niche.example: The small shop found a niche in the local market.
niche.exampleZh: 这家小店在当地市场中找到了一个利基。

night.example: The stars are bright in the sky at night.

nightmare.example: I had a terrible nightmare last night and woke up very scared.
nightmare.exampleZh: 昨晚我做了一个可怕的噩梦，醒来时非常害怕。

nil.example: The team scored nil in the second half of the game.
nil.exampleZh: 该队在下半场比赛中一分未得。

nimble.example: The nimble cat jumped over the wall and ran away.
nimble.exampleZh: 那只敏捷的猫跳过墙跑走了。

nine.example: My little brother is nine years old and loves to play football.
nine.exampleZh: 我弟弟九岁了，他喜欢踢足球。

nip.example: The cold wind can nip your ears if you stay outside too long.
nip.exampleZh: 如果你在外面待太久，寒风会冻伤你的耳朵。

nitrate.example: Farmers often add nitrate to the soil to help their crops grow faster.
nitrate.exampleZh: 农民常常在土壤中添加硝酸盐，帮助庄稼长得更快。

nitrogen.example: Plants need nitrogen from the soil to grow strong leaves and stems.
nitrogen.exampleZh: 植物需要从土壤中获取氮，才能长出强壮的叶子和茎。

no.example: No, I do not want to go home now.

noble.example: She is a noble woman who always helps poor people in her town.
noble.exampleZh: 她是一位高尚的女性，总是帮助镇上的穷人。

nobody.example: Nobody in the room knew the answer to that simple question.
nobody.exampleZh: 房间里没有人知道那个简单问题的答案。

nod.example: She gave a small nod and smiled at me.
nod.exampleZh: 她轻轻点了点头，对我笑了笑。

noise.example: The loud noise from the street woke me up at midnight.
noise.exampleZh: 街上很大的噪音在半夜把我吵醒了。

noisy.example: The classroom was too noisy, so the teacher asked us to be quiet.
noisy.exampleZh: 教室太吵了，所以老师让我们安静下来。

nomad.example: The nomad moved from town to town with his family.
nomad.exampleZh: 那个游牧民带着家人从一个城镇搬到另一个城镇。

nomadic.example: The nomadic family moved from place to place with their animals.
nomadic.exampleZh: 这个游牧家庭带着牲畜四处迁移。

nominal.example: He is the nominal leader, but other people make all the important decisions.
nominal.exampleZh: 他是名义上的领导，但所有重要决定都是别人做的。

nominate.example: The teacher will nominate two students for the school prize.
nominate.exampleZh: 老师将提名两名学生参评学校奖项。

nomination.example: Her nomination for the award surprised everyone in the small office.
nomination.exampleZh: 她被提名该奖项，这让小办公室里的每个人都很惊讶。

none.example: None of my friends came to the party last night.
none.exampleZh: 昨晚我的朋友一个都没有来参加聚会。

nonetheless.example: The plan was risky; nonetheless, we decided to try it.
nonetheless.exampleZh: 这个计划有风险；尽管如此，我们还是决定试一试。

nonsense.example: What he just said is complete nonsense, and nobody in the room believes it.
nonsense.exampleZh: 他刚才说的完全是胡说，房间里没人相信。

nook.example: She found a quiet nook by the window to read her book.
nook.exampleZh: 她在窗边找到一个安静的角落读她的书。

noon.example: We will meet at the school gate at noon tomorrow.
noon.exampleZh: 我们明天中午在学校门口见面。

noose.example: The hunter made a noose from rope to catch the wild rabbit.
noose.exampleZh: 猎人用绳子打了个套索来捕捉野兔。

norm.example: Wearing a seatbelt has become the norm for most drivers.
norm.exampleZh: 系安全带已成为大多数司机的常态。

normal.example: It is normal to feel tired after a long day of work.
normal.exampleZh: 工作了一整天后感到累是正常的。

normative.example: His normative view of family life feels old-fashioned to many young people today.
normative.exampleZh: 他对家庭生活所持的规范观念，在如今的许多年轻人看来已经过时了。

north.example: The north of the country is cold and snowy in winter.
north.exampleZh: 这个国家的北部冬天寒冷多雪。

northern.example: The northern part of the country is cold and snowy in winter.
northern.exampleZh: 这个国家的北部地区冬天寒冷多雪。

nose.example: The dog has a wet nose and a very good sense of smell.
nose.exampleZh: 这只狗有个湿鼻子，嗅觉非常灵敏。

not.example: I am not hungry now, but I will eat later.
not.exampleZh: 我现在不饿，但稍后会吃。

notable.example: This small town is notable for its old bridge and famous writer.
notable.exampleZh: 这个小镇因它的古桥和著名作家而闻名。

notation.example: She wrote the music in a simple notation that children could read.
notation.exampleZh: 她用一种孩子们能看懂的简单记法写下了这首曲子。

note.example: Please take notes during class and note the important dates.
note.exampleZh: 上课时请记笔记，并注意重要的日期。

nothing.example: There is nothing in the old box on the table.
nothing.exampleZh: 桌子上那个旧盒子里什么都没有。

notice.example: I did not notice the small notice on the door this morning.
notice.exampleZh: 我今天早上没有注意到门上的那张小布告。

noticeable.example: There is a noticeable change in the weather today.
noticeable.exampleZh: 今天的天气有显著的变化。

notion.example: She has only a vague notion of how the machine actually works.
notion.exampleZh: 她对这台机器实际如何运作只有一个模糊的概念。

notorious.example: This street is notorious for its heavy traffic and loud noise.
notorious.exampleZh: 这条街因交通拥堵和噪音大而声名狼藉。

notwithstanding.example: Notwithstanding the rain, we went for a walk in the park.
notwithstanding.exampleZh: 尽管下雨，我们还是去公园散步了。

noun.example: The word noun is an important part of every English sentence.
noun.exampleZh: 单词 noun 是每个英语句子中的重要组成部分。

novel.example: She is reading a novel about life in a small village.
novel.exampleZh: 她正在读一本关于小村庄生活的小说。

novelty.example: The novelty of the new toy wore off after a few days.
novelty.exampleZh: 新玩具的新奇感几天后就消失了。

now.example: I am busy now, so please call me later tonight.
now.exampleZh: 我现在很忙，所以请今晚晚些时候再打给我。

nowhere.example: There was nowhere to sit, so we stood by the door.
nowhere.exampleZh: 没有地方可坐，所以我们站在门边。

nuclear.example: Nuclear power can give us clean energy without burning coal.
nuclear.exampleZh: 核能可以在不烧煤的情况下为我们提供清洁能源。

nude.example: The artist painted a nude woman sitting by the window.
nude.exampleZh: 那位艺术家画了一位坐在窗边的裸体女子。

nuisance.example: The noise from the street is a real nuisance at night.
nuisance.exampleZh: 街上的噪音在晚上真是件烦人的事。

null.example: The contract is null because both sides never signed it.
null.exampleZh: 这份合同无效，因为双方从未签字。

numb.example: My fingers went numb after I played in the cold snow for an hour.
numb.exampleZh: 在冰冷的雪地里玩了一小时后，我的手指变得麻木了。

number.example: Please write your phone number at the top of this page.
number.exampleZh: 请在这页的顶部写下你的电话号码。

numerical.example: The report gives numerical data about the city's population and growth.
numerical.exampleZh: 这份报告提供了关于该城市人口和增长的数字数据。

numerous.example: Numerous students joined the science club this year.
numerous.exampleZh: 今年许多学生加入了这个科学社团。

nurse.example: The nurse took good care of my mother in the hospital last week.
nurse.exampleZh: 上周那位护士在医院里悉心照顾了我的母亲。

nut.example: He ate a nut and then fixed the loose wheel with a small nut.
nut.exampleZh: 他吃了一颗坚果，然后用一个小螺母固定了松动的轮子。

nutrition.example: Good nutrition helps children grow strong and stay healthy.
nutrition.exampleZh: 良好的营养能帮助孩子们强壮成长并保持健康。

nylon.example: She bought a nylon bag for her trip to the beach.
nylon.exampleZh: 她为去海滩的旅行买了一个尼龙包。

nymph.example: The little nymph lived near the river and sang sweet songs every morning.
nymph.exampleZh: 那个小仙女住在河边，每天早晨都唱着甜美的歌。

oak.example: The old oak in our garden is very tall and gives good shade.
oak.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老橡树很高，能提供很好的阴凉。

oar.example: He used a wooden oar to row the small boat across the lake.
oar.exampleZh: 他用一支木桨划着小船穿过湖面。

oasis.example: The small garden in the city is a quiet oasis for tired workers.
oasis.exampleZh: 城市里的这个小花园是疲惫的工人们一片安静的绿洲。

oath.example: He made an oath to tell the truth in court.
oath.exampleZh: 他在法庭上发誓说出真相。

obdurate.example: He was too obdurate to listen to anyone's advice.
obdurate.exampleZh: 他太顽固了，听不进任何人的劝告。

obedience.example: The dog showed great obedience to its owner every day.
obedience.exampleZh: 这只狗每天都对主人表现出极大的服从。

obedient.example: The obedient dog sat quietly when its owner gave a simple hand signal.
obedient.exampleZh: 那只顺从的狗在主人给出一个简单手势时安静地坐下了。

obese.example: The doctor said he was obese and should eat less sugar.
obese.exampleZh: 医生说他太肥胖了，应该少吃糖。

obey.example: Students must obey the school rules if they want to stay here.
obey.exampleZh: 学生如果想留在这里，就必须遵守校规。

obfuscate.example: He tried to obfuscate the facts so nobody would understand the report.
obfuscate.exampleZh: 他试图混淆事实，好让没人能看懂这份报告。

object.example: She could not see the small object in the dark room.
object.exampleZh: 她看不见黑暗房间里的那个小物体。

objection.example: My main objection to the plan is that it costs too much.
objection.exampleZh: 我对这个计划的主要反对理由是它花费太多。

objective.example: She gave an objective report on the problem and set a clear objective.
objective.exampleZh: 她对这个问题做了一份客观的报告，并设定了一个明确的目标。

objectivity.example: Good reporters must keep their objectivity when they write about a difficult story.
objectivity.exampleZh: 优秀的记者在报道棘手的新闻时必须保持客观性。

obligation.example: Every citizen has an obligation to pay taxes and follow the law.
obligation.exampleZh: 每个公民都有纳税和遵守法律的义务。

oblige.example: The heavy rain obliged us to stay at home all day.
oblige.exampleZh: 大雨迫使我们整天待在家里。

oblique.example: He gave an oblique answer instead of telling us the truth.
oblique.exampleZh: 他没有告诉我们真相，而是给了一个拐弯抹角的回答。

obliterate.example: The flood obliterated the small village and left nothing behind.
obliterate.exampleZh: 洪水摧毁了这个小村庄，什么也没留下。

oblivion.example: After many years, his name fell into oblivion.
oblivion.exampleZh: 多年以后，他的名字渐渐被人遗忘。

oblivious.example: He was oblivious to the loud noise and kept reading his book.
oblivious.exampleZh: 他对很大的噪音毫无察觉，继续读着他的书。

obnoxious.example: His obnoxious behavior at the party made everyone want to leave early.
obnoxious.exampleZh: 他在聚会上令人讨厌的行为让每个人都想早点离开。

obscene.example: The court banned the obscene movie from being shown in public theaters.
obscene.exampleZh: 法院禁止这部淫秽电影在公共影院放映。

obscure.example: The old book's meaning is obscure to most modern readers today.
obscure.exampleZh: 这本旧书的意思对今天大多数现代读者来说晦涩难懂。

observance.example: The strict observance of these rules is important for all new members.
observance.exampleZh: 严格遵守这些规则对所有新成员都很重要。

observant.example: She is very observant and notices small changes in her friends.
observant.exampleZh: 她非常善于观察，能注意到朋友们身上的细微变化。

observation.example: Her careful observation of the birds helped the class learn a lot.
observation.exampleZh: 她对鸟儿细致的观察帮助全班学到了很多东西。

observatory.example: We visited the observatory on the hill to look at the stars.
observatory.exampleZh: 我们参观了山上的天文台，去观看星星。

observe.example: Scientists observe the stars every night to learn more about space.
observe.exampleZh: 科学家每晚观测星星，以便更多地了解太空。

obsess.example: His fear of failure began to obsess him day and night.
obsess.exampleZh: 对失败的恐惧开始日夜困扰着他。

obsession.example: Her obsession with old movies keeps her up late every night.
obsession.exampleZh: 她对老电影的痴迷让她每晚都很晚才睡。

obsolescent.example: These old machines are obsolescent and will soon be replaced by new ones.
obsolescent.exampleZh: 这些旧机器即将过时，很快会被新机器取代。

obsolete.example: This old phone is obsolete and no longer works well.
obsolete.exampleZh: 这部旧手机已经过时，不再好用了。

obstacle.example: The biggest obstacle to our plan is the lack of money.
obstacle.exampleZh: 我们计划最大的障碍是缺少资金。

obstinate.example: My obstinate uncle refuses to see a doctor about his cough.
obstinate.exampleZh: 我固执的叔叔不肯去看医生治疗咳嗽。

obstreperous.example: The obstreperous children would not stop shouting during the quiet library hour.
obstreperous.exampleZh: 那些吵闹的孩子在图书馆安静时段里一直不停地大喊大叫。

obstruct.example: A fallen tree obstructed the road, so we had to take another way.
obstruct.exampleZh: 一棵倒下的树堵住了路，所以我们只好走另一条路。

obtain.example: You can obtain a free map at the front desk of the hotel.
obtain.exampleZh: 你可以在酒店前台获得一张免费地图。

obtrusive.example: The bright red sign on the old wall looked very obtrusive.
obtrusive.exampleZh: 旧墙上的鲜红色标牌看起来非常扎眼。

obtuse.example: The angle of a square corner is not acute but obtuse.
obtuse.exampleZh: 方角的角度不是锐角，而是钝角。

obvious.example: It is obvious that he does not want to go with us.
obvious.exampleZh: 很明显，他不想和我们一起去。

occasion.example: A wedding is a special occasion for the whole family.
occasion.exampleZh: 婚礼是全家人的一个特殊场合。

occasional.example: We take an occasional trip to the beach when the weather is nice.
occasional.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我们偶尔会去海边玩一趟。

occident.example: People in the Occident often drink coffee in the morning.
occident.exampleZh: 西方国家的人常常在早上喝咖啡。

occult.example: The old house had an occult feeling that scared the children.
occult.exampleZh: 那座老房子有一种神秘的感觉，让孩子们感到害怕。

occupancy.example: The hotel checks each room's occupancy before new guests arrive.
occupancy.exampleZh: 酒店在新客人到达前会检查每个房间的入住情况。

occupational.example: Long hours of sitting is a common occupational problem for office workers.
occupational.exampleZh: 长时间坐着是办公室职员常见的职业病问题。

occupy.example: The new library will occupy the space where the old shop stood.
occupy.exampleZh: 新图书馆将占用旧商店所在的那块地方。

occur.example: Such problems often occur when people do not read the instructions carefully.
occur.exampleZh: 人们不仔细阅读说明时，这类问题常常会发生。

occurrence.example: The occurrence of heavy rain caused the game to be delayed.
occurrence.exampleZh: 大雨的发生导致比赛被推迟。

ocean.example: The ocean is very deep and full of many strange fish.
ocean.exampleZh: 海洋非常深，里面有许多奇怪的鱼。

oceanography.example: She studies oceanography because she wants to learn more about the sea.
oceanography.exampleZh: 她学习海洋学，因为她想更多地了解海洋。

octagon.example: The red sign in front of the school is a large octagon.
octagon.exampleZh: 学校前面的红色标志是一个大的八角形。

octopus.example: The octopus hid in a rock and changed color to escape danger.
octopus.exampleZh: 章鱼躲在岩石里并改变颜色以逃避危险。

odd.example: It is odd that he left the party so early.
odd.exampleZh: 他这么早离开聚会很奇怪。

oddity.example: The old clock in his room is a charming oddity that everyone notices.
oddity.exampleZh: 他房间里那座旧钟是个古怪却讨人喜欢的东西，人人都注意到它。

odds.example: The odds of winning the game are very low for us.
odds.exampleZh: 我们赢得这场比赛的几率非常低。

odor.example: The kitchen had a strange odor after we left the fish out overnight.
odor.exampleZh: 我们把鱼放在外面过夜后，厨房里有一股奇怪的气味。

offence.example: He was arrested for a serious offence last night.
offence.exampleZh: 他昨晚因一项严重罪行被逮捕。

offend.example: I did not mean to offend you with my words.
offend.exampleZh: 我不是有意用我的话冒犯你。

offensive.example: His offensive words made everyone in the room angry and upset.
offensive.exampleZh: 他那冒犯性的话让房间里的每个人都又生气又难过。

offer.example: They offered him a good job in the city last week.
offer.exampleZh: 他们上周在城里给了他一份好工作。

office.example: My father works in a small office near the city center.
office.exampleZh: 我父亲在市中心附近的一间小办公室工作。

officer.example: The officer gave us clear instructions before we entered the building.
officer.exampleZh: 我们进入大楼之前，那位军官给了我们明确的指示。

official.example: The official report gives clear facts about the new school.
official.exampleZh: 这份官方报告提供了关于新学校的明确事实。

officiate.example: The judge will officiate at the wedding ceremony next Saturday.
officiate.exampleZh: 法官将在下周六主持婚礼仪式。

offset.example: Higher prices may offset the extra cost of shipping to small towns.
offset.exampleZh: 更高的价格可能会抵消向小城镇运送货物的额外成本。

offshoot.example: This small art project later became an offshoot of a larger university program.
offshoot.exampleZh: 这个小艺术项目后来成了一个大型大学项目的分支。

offshore.example: They are building a new offshore wind farm near the coast.
offshore.exampleZh: 他们正在海岸附近建造一座新的近海风电场。

offspring.example: The two birds built a small nest to raise their offspring in spring.
offspring.exampleZh: 这两只鸟筑了一个小巢，在春天养育它们的后代。

often.example: I often walk to school with my sister in the morning.
often.exampleZh: 我经常早上和妹妹一起走路去学校。

ogle.example: The man at the bar kept ogling the singer on stage.
ogle.exampleZh: 酒吧里那个男人一直色眯眯地盯着台上的歌手看。

ogre.example: The ogre in the story eats people and frightens every child in the village.
ogre.exampleZh: 故事里的食人恶魔吃人，把村子里的每个孩子都吓坏了。

oil.example: Please add some oil to the pan before you cook the eggs.
oil.exampleZh: 煎鸡蛋之前，请往锅里加一些油。

ointment.example: The doctor told me to put some ointment on the small cut.
ointment.exampleZh: 医生让我在那个小伤口上涂一些药膏。

okay.example: Is it okay if I open the window for some fresh air?
okay.exampleZh: 我打开窗户透透气，可以吗？

old.example: This old book is very useful for my English class.
old.exampleZh: 这本旧书对我的英语课很有用。

oligarchy.example: The small country was ruled by an oligarchy of wealthy families for many years.
oligarchy.exampleZh: 这个小国多年来由富裕家族组成的寡头政治统治。

olive.example: She put a green olive on top of the salad.
olive.exampleZh: 她在沙拉上面放了一颗绿色的橄榄。

omega.example: The teacher said omega is the last letter of the Greek alphabet.
omega.exampleZh: 老师说欧米伽是希腊字母表的最后一个字母。

omission.example: The omission of his name from the list was a simple mistake.
omission.exampleZh: 名单上遗漏了他的名字，这只是一个简单的失误。

omit.example: Please do not omit any important details from your report.
omit.exampleZh: 请不要遗漏你报告中的任何重要细节。

omnipotent.example: In the story, the king believed he was omnipotent and could control the weather.
omnipotent.exampleZh: 在故事里，国王相信自己无所不能，能够控制天气。

omnipresent.example: In big cities, cameras seem omnipresent on streets, in shops, and on buses.
omnipresent.exampleZh: 在大城市里，摄像头似乎无所不在，街道上、商店里和公交车上都有。

omniscient.example: In the story, an omniscient narrator knows what every character is thinking.
omniscient.exampleZh: 在这个故事里，一位无所不知的叙述者知道每个角色在想什么。

on.example: The book is on the table and the light is on.

once.example: Once you start reading this book, you will not want to stop.
once.exampleZh: 一旦你开始读这本书，你就会不想停下来。

oncoming.example: The driver did not see the oncoming truck until it was very close.
oncoming.exampleZh: 司机直到那辆迎面而来的卡车离得很近才看见它。

ongoing.example: The ongoing training helps all new workers learn the job faster.
ongoing.exampleZh: 这项持续进行的培训帮助所有新员工更快学会这份工作。

onion.example: My mother cut the onion into small pieces for the soup.
onion.exampleZh: 我妈妈把洋葱切成小块，用来做汤。

online.example: You can buy tickets online or at the train station.
online.exampleZh: 你可以在网上买票，也可以在火车站买票。

onlooker.example: The onlookers watched quietly as the two boys argued in the street.
onlooker.exampleZh: 旁观者们安静地看着两个男孩在街上争吵。

only.example: This is the only key that opens the door.
only.exampleZh: 这是唯一能打开这扇门的钥匙。

onset.example: The doctor said the onset of the illness was sudden and very serious.
onset.exampleZh: 医生说这种病的发作很突然，而且非常严重。

onslaught.example: The army could not stop the sudden onslaught of enemy soldiers.
onslaught.exampleZh: 军队无法阻止敌军士兵的突然猛攻。

onto.example: The cat jumped onto the table and looked out the window.
onto.exampleZh: 猫跳到桌子上，朝窗外看。

onus.example: The onus is on parents to teach their children good habits.
onus.exampleZh: 教导孩子养成良好习惯的责任在父母身上。

onward.example: The team walked onward through the cold night toward the small town.
onward.exampleZh: 队伍在寒冷的夜里继续向前，走向那个小镇。

opaque.example: The old glass bottle is opaque, so I cannot see the water inside.
opaque.exampleZh: 这个旧玻璃瓶是不透明的，所以我看不见里面的水。

open.example: The shop is open, so we can go in and look around.
open.exampleZh: 商店开着门，我们可以进去看看。

opening.example: There is a small opening in the fence, and the opening speech begins at nine.
opening.exampleZh: 篱笆上有一个小开口，开场演讲九点开始。

opera.example: My sister and I went to the opera with our parents last night.
opera.exampleZh: 昨晚我和姐姐跟父母一起去看歌剧了。

operate.example: He knows how to operate the new machine in the factory.
operate.exampleZh: 他知道如何操作工厂里的这台新机器。

operation.example: The doctor will do the operation early tomorrow morning.
operation.exampleZh: 医生明天一早会做这台手术。

operational.example: The new system is now fully operational and the team uses it every day.
operational.exampleZh: 新系统现在已完全可投入使用，团队每天都在使用它。

operative.example: The new safety rules are now operative in every factory.
operative.exampleZh: 新的安全规定现在在每家工厂都已生效。

operator.example: The machine operator stopped the line when he saw a problem.
operator.exampleZh: 操作员看到问题后停下了生产线。

opine.example: Many experts opine that regular exercise is good for health.
opine.exampleZh: 许多专家认为规律运动有益健康。

opinion.example: In my opinion, this book is easy and fun to read.
opinion.exampleZh: 在我看来，这本书读起来既简单又有趣。

opium.example: The doctor warned him that opium can be very dangerous to his health.
opium.exampleZh: 医生警告他，鸦片对他的健康非常危险。

opponent.example: My opponent in the final match played very well today.
opponent.exampleZh: 我在决赛中的对手今天打得非常好。

opportune.example: It was an opportune moment to ask the teacher for help.
opportune.exampleZh: 那是一个向老师求助的恰当时机。

opportunist.example: He is an opportunist who always takes advantage of others' mistakes.
opportunist.exampleZh: 他是个机会主义者，总是利用别人的错误。

opportunity.example: This is a good opportunity for you to learn something new.
opportunity.exampleZh: 这是一个让你学习新东西的好机会。

oppose.example: Many people oppose the new plan because it costs too much money.
oppose.exampleZh: 许多人反对这项新计划，因为它花费太多钱。

opposite.example: The bank is on the opposite side of the street from my house.
opposite.exampleZh: 银行在我家街道的对面。

opposition.example: The plan met with strong opposition from local residents.
opposition.exampleZh: 这个计划遭到了当地居民的强烈反对。

oppress.example: The bad king oppressed the poor people in his country.
oppress.exampleZh: 那个坏国王压迫他国家的穷人。

oppression.example: The people suffered from years of oppression under the cruel ruler.
oppression.exampleZh: 人民在残酷统治者的压迫下受苦多年。

oppressive.example: The air in the small room was oppressive and made everyone feel tired.
oppressive.exampleZh: 小房间里的空气很闷热，让每个人都感到疲倦。

opt.example: You can opt for the cheaper plan if you want.
opt.exampleZh: 如果你愿意，可以选择更便宜的那个方案。

optic.example: The optic nerve carries signals from the eye to the brain.
optic.exampleZh: 视神经将信号从眼睛传递到大脑。

optical.example: The optical lens makes the small print look much bigger and clearer.
optical.exampleZh: 这个光学镜片让很小的字看起来更大更清晰。

optimal.example: This is the optimal time to plant these flowers.
optimal.exampleZh: 这是种这些花的最佳时机。

optimism.example: Her optimism helped the whole team stay calm during the difficult week.
optimism.exampleZh: 她的乐观帮助整个团队在那艰难的一周里保持冷静。

optimistic.example: She is optimistic about her new job and works hard every day.
optimistic.exampleZh: 她对这份新工作很乐观，并且每天都努力工作。

optimize.example: We can optimize our study time by making a simple plan.
optimize.exampleZh: 我们可以通过制定一个简单的计划来充分利用学习时间。

optimum.example: The optimum for this plant is warm sun and wet soil.
optimum.exampleZh: 这种植物的最佳条件是温暖的阳光和湿润的土壤。

option.example: You have the option to take a different class next year.
option.exampleZh: 你明年可以选择上一门不同的课。

optional.example: This part of the form is optional, so you can leave it empty.
optional.exampleZh: 表格中的这部分是可选的，所以你可以留空。

opulent.example: The opulent hotel lobby had gold walls and a huge crystal lamp.
opulent.exampleZh: 这家豪华的酒店大堂有金色的墙壁和一盏巨大的水晶灯。

or.example: You can have tea or coffee, but please choose one now.
or.exampleZh: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，但现在请选一个。

oracle.example: People traveled far to ask the oracle about their future.
oracle.exampleZh: 人们远道而来，向神谕询问他们的未来。

oral.example: We have an oral test in English class this Friday.
oral.exampleZh: 这个星期五我们英语课有一场口试。

orange.example: She peeled an orange and shared it with her little brother.
orange.exampleZh: 她剥了一个橙子，和她的弟弟一起分享。

oration.example: The president gave a short oration at the ceremony yesterday.
oration.exampleZh: 总统昨天在仪式上发表了一段简短的正式演说。

orator.example: The young orator spoke so well that everyone in the hall listened quietly.
orator.exampleZh: 这位年轻的演说家讲得非常好，大厅里的每个人都安静地听着。

orbit.example: The moon moves in a fixed orbit around the earth.
orbit.exampleZh: 月球沿着固定的轨道绕地球运行。

orchard.example: My grandparents grow apples and pears in a small orchard behind their house.
orchard.exampleZh: 我的祖父母在屋后的小果园里种苹果和梨。

orchestra.example: The orchestra played beautiful music at the concert last night.
orchestra.exampleZh: 昨晚管弦乐队在音乐会上演奏了美妙的音乐。

orchestrate.example: She orchestrated the whole event carefully.
orchestrate.exampleZh: 她精心策划了整个活动。

ordain.example: The church decided to ordain him as a priest last spring.
ordain.exampleZh: 教会决定去年春天任命他为神父。

ordeal.example: Losing his job and his home in one year was a long ordeal for him.
ordeal.exampleZh: 一年内失去工作和住所，对他来说是一段漫长的苦难经历。

order.example: Please put these books in the right order before you leave.
order.exampleZh: 请你离开前把这些书按正确的顺序放好。

orderliness.example: Her orderliness makes the small kitchen easy to use every day.
orderliness.exampleZh: 她的整洁让这个小厨房每天都很好用。

orderly.example: The teacher likes our orderly classroom because every book is in its place.
orderly.exampleZh: 老师喜欢我们有秩序的教室，因为每本书都放在该放的地方。

ordinal.example: In English class we learned how to use an ordinal number to talk about dates.
ordinal.exampleZh: 在英语课上，我们学习了如何用序数词来谈论日期。

ordinance.example: The city passed an ordinance that bans smoking in public parks.
ordinance.exampleZh: 该市通过了一项禁止在公园吸烟的法令。

ordinary.example: This is just an ordinary day for most people in our town.
ordinary.exampleZh: 对我们镇上的大多数人来说，这只是普通的一天。

ore.example: This ore contains a lot of iron and is mined from deep mountains.
ore.exampleZh: 这种矿石含铁量很高，采自深山之中。

organ.example: The heart is an important organ in the human body.
organ.exampleZh: 心脏是人体内一个重要的器官。

organic.example: Organic food is often more expensive than food grown with chemicals.
organic.exampleZh: 有机食品通常比用化学物质种植的食品更贵。

organism.example: Every living organism needs water and food to grow and stay alive.
organism.exampleZh: 每一个生物体都需要水和食物来生长并维持生命。

organize.example: We need to organize a meeting for next Monday morning.
organize.exampleZh: 我们需要安排下周一早上的会议。

oriental.example: She likes oriental art and often visits the museum near her home.
oriental.exampleZh: 她喜欢东方艺术，经常去她家附近的博物馆参观。

orientation.example: The new students attended an orientation to learn about the campus.
orientation.exampleZh: 新生们参加了迎新培训，以了解校园情况。

origin.example: The origin of this old story is still a mystery to us.
origin.exampleZh: 这个古老故事的起源对我们来说仍是个谜。

original.example: This painting is the original, and the copy hangs in the hall.
original.exampleZh: 这幅画是原作，复制品挂在大厅里。

originality.example: Her originality makes the whole design feel fresh and full of life.
originality.exampleZh: 她的独创性让整个设计显得清新而充满生机。

originate.example: Many popular foods originated in small villages long ago.
originate.exampleZh: 许多流行食物很久以前起源于小村庄。

ornament.example: She put a small gold ornament on the tree and smiled at it.
ornament.exampleZh: 她在树上放了一个小金饰，并对着它笑了笑。

ornate.example: The old church has an ornate ceiling with many gold details.
ornate.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂有一个装饰华丽的天花板，上面有许多金色细节。

orphan.example: The little orphan lives with his kind grandmother in a small village.
orphan.exampleZh: 那个小孤儿和他善良的祖母住在一个小村庄里。

orthodox.example: Her family follows the orthodox traditions of the old village.
orthodox.exampleZh: 她的家人遵循那个古老村庄的传统习俗。

orthodoxy.example: Many young people question the orthodoxy of their parents and teachers.
orthodoxy.exampleZh: 许多年轻人质疑父母和老师的正统观念。

orthography.example: Learning English orthography helps you spell words correctly.
orthography.exampleZh: 学习英语正字法有助于你正确拼写单词。

oscillate.example: The fan blades oscillate quickly when the old motor starts.
oscillate.exampleZh: 旧电机启动时，风扇叶片会快速摆动。

osmosis.example: Learning a new language often happens by osmosis when you live abroad.
osmosis.exampleZh: 在国外生活时，学一门新语言往往是潜移默化的。

ossify.example: Old rules can ossify and stop a company from growing.
ossify.exampleZh: 旧的规则会僵化，阻碍公司发展。

ostensible.example: His ostensible reason for leaving early was a headache.
ostensible.exampleZh: 他早退表面的理由是头痛。

ostentatious.example: His ostentatious new car made everyone in the small town talk.
ostentatious.exampleZh: 他那辆铺张的新车让小镇上的每个人都在议论。

ostracism.example: The new student felt the ostracism of his classmates and ate lunch alone.
ostracism.exampleZh: 这个新同学感受到了同学们的排斥，一个人吃午饭。

ostracize.example: The group decided to ostracize him after he told their secret.
ostracize.exampleZh: 在他泄露了他们的秘密之后，这群人决定排挤他。

ostrich.example: The ostrich ran across the field very fast when it saw the dog.
ostrich.exampleZh: 鸵鸟看到狗时飞快地跑过了田野。

other.example: Some people like tea, but other people like coffee.
other.exampleZh: 有些人喜欢茶，但另外一些人喜欢咖啡。

otherness.example: Learning about otherness helps us understand people from different cultures.
otherness.exampleZh: 了解他者性有助于我们理解来自不同文化的人。

otherwise.example: Hurry up, otherwise we will miss the last bus home.
otherwise.exampleZh: 快点，否则我们会错过回家的末班车。

otter.example: The otter swam quickly across the river and then climbed onto a rock.
otter.exampleZh: 水獭迅速游过河，然后爬上了一块岩石。

ought.example: You ought to see a doctor about that bad cough.
ought.exampleZh: 你应当就那个严重的咳嗽去看医生。

ounce.example: Add two ounces of milk to the flour and mix well.
ounce.exampleZh: 往面粉里加两盎司牛奶，搅拌均匀。

outbid.example: The other company outbid us for the land.
outbid.exampleZh: 另一家公司出价高于我们，买下了这块地。

outbreak.example: A serious outbreak of flu closed the school for a week.
outbreak.exampleZh: 一场严重的流感爆发使学校停课一周。

outburst.example: His sudden outburst of anger surprised everyone in the quiet room.
outburst.exampleZh: 他突然爆发的怒火让安静房间里的每个人都吃了一惊。

outcast.example: After the war, he lived as an outcast in a small village.
outcast.exampleZh: 战后，他在一个小村庄里作为被社会排斥的人生活着。

outcome.example: Nobody knows the outcome of the game yet.
outcome.exampleZh: 还没有人知道这场比赛的结果。

outcry.example: The new tax law caused a loud outcry from many angry citizens.
outcry.exampleZh: 新的税法引起了许多愤怒民众的强烈抗议。

outdated.example: My phone is old and outdated, so I want to buy a new one.
outdated.exampleZh: 我的手机又旧又过时，所以我想买一部新的。

outdo.example: She always tries to outdo her brother in every game they play.
outdo.exampleZh: 在她和弟弟玩的每个游戏里，她总是想胜过他。

outdoor.example: We often have outdoor games in the park on sunny days.
outdoor.exampleZh: 晴天的时候，我们经常在公园里玩户外游戏。

outer.example: The outer layer of the cake is hard and sweet.

outfit.example: She wore a new outfit to the party last night.
outfit.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一套新衣服去参加聚会。

outflank.example: The general moved his troops at night to outflank the enemy.
outflank.exampleZh: 将军夜里调动部队，从翼侧包围了敌人。

outgrowth.example: This big success is a natural outgrowth of years of hard work.
outgrowth.exampleZh: 这个巨大的成功是多年努力的自然结果。

outing.example: We went on a family outing to the lake last Saturday.
outing.exampleZh: 上周六我们一家人去湖边短途游玩。

outlandish.example: He wore an outlandish hat to the party last night.
outlandish.exampleZh: 他昨晚戴着一顶古怪的帽子去参加聚会。

outlast.example: True friendships often outlast the changes of time and distance.
outlast.exampleZh: 真正的友谊往往比时间和距离的变化更持久。

outlay.example: The outlay for the new computer was more than we expected.
outlay.exampleZh: 这台新电脑的支出超出了我们的预期。

outlet.example: This store is an outlet for cheap clothes and shoes.
outlet.exampleZh: 这家店是廉价衣服和鞋子的专卖店。

outlier.example: That one very high price is an outlier in our sales data.
outlier.exampleZh: 那个特别高的价格是我们销售数据中的一个离群值。

outline.example: The teacher gave us a brief outline of the whole course.
outline.exampleZh: 老师给我们简要概述了整个课程的内容。

outlook.example: Her outlook on life changed a lot after that trip.
outlook.exampleZh: 那次旅行之后，她对生活的看法改变了很多。

outlying.example: The small outlying villages have no bus service after dark.
outlying.exampleZh: 那些偏远的小村庄天黑后没有公交车。

outmoded.example: This old phone is outmoded and cannot use the new apps.
outmoded.exampleZh: 这部旧手机已经过时，无法使用新的应用程序。

outnumber.example: In our class, girls outnumber boys by almost two to one.
outnumber.exampleZh: 在我们班，女生的人数几乎是男生的两倍。

outperform.example: Our small team can outperform larger teams by working together every day.
outperform.exampleZh: 我们的小团队每天齐心协力，就能胜过更大的团队。

outpost.example: The small outpost was far from the city and had only a few soldiers.
outpost.exampleZh: 这个小前哨离城市很远，只有几名士兵。

outpouring.example: Her letter brought an outpouring of love from all her old friends.
outpouring.exampleZh: 她的来信引来了所有老朋友倾泻而出的关爱。

output.example: The factory increased its output by ten percent last year.
output.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年的产量增加了百分之十。

outrage.example: The whole town felt outrage at the cruel attack on the old man.
outrage.exampleZh: 整个小镇都对那位老人遭受的残忍袭击感到愤怒。

outrageous.example: It is outrageous that he took the money without asking anyone.
outrageous.exampleZh: 他没问过任何人就拿走了钱，真是无耻。

outright.example: He bought the old car outright and paid the full price today.
outright.exampleZh: 他一次性买下了那辆旧车，今天付了全款。

outrun.example: No one can outrun him in a short race.
outrun.exampleZh: 在短跑比赛中，没有人能跑得比他快。

outset.example: She made her goal clear at the outset of the meeting.
outset.exampleZh: 她在会议开始时就把自己的目标说清楚了。

outshine.example: She hopes to outshine her sister at the school concert tonight.
outshine.exampleZh: 她希望今晚在学校音乐会上比姐姐更出色。

outside.example: The children are playing outside the house in the warm sun.
outside.exampleZh: 孩子们在房子外面的暖阳下玩耍。

outskirts.example: They live on the outskirts of the city, near a small lake.
outskirts.exampleZh: 他们住在城市郊区，靠近一个小湖。

outspoken.example: She is an outspoken woman who always tells people the truth.
outspoken.exampleZh: 她是个坦率的女人，总是对人说真话。

outstanding.example: She did outstanding work on the project, but one bill is still outstanding.
outstanding.exampleZh: 她在这个项目上做得非常出色，但还有一笔账单未结清。

outstrip.example: Her speed soon outstripped all the other runners in the race.
outstrip.exampleZh: 她的速度很快就超过了比赛中的所有其他选手。

outward.example: The outward door was locked, so we had to go around the back.
outward.exampleZh: 外面的门锁着，所以我们只好绕到后面去。

outweigh.example: Her love for music outweighs all the difficulties in her daily life.
outweigh.exampleZh: 她对音乐的热爱胜过她日常生活中的一切困难。

outwit.example: The clever fox outwitted the hunters and escaped into the forest.
outwit.exampleZh: 那只聪明的狐狸骗过了猎人，逃进了森林。

oval.example: This oval table fits well in our small dining room.
oval.exampleZh: 这张椭圆形桌子放在我们的小餐厅里很合适。

ovary.example: The doctor said each ovary releases an egg about once a month.
ovary.exampleZh: 医生说每个卵巢大约每月排出一个卵子。

ovation.example: The singer received a long ovation after her final song.
ovation.exampleZh: 歌手唱完最后一首歌后，观众长时间地为她热烈鼓掌。

oven.example: She put the bread in the oven for twenty minutes.
oven.exampleZh: 她把面包放进烤箱里烤了二十分钟。

over.example: The plane flew over the city and then landed safely.
over.exampleZh: 飞机飞过城市上空，然后安全降落。

overact.example: Some actors overact when they are nervous on stage.
overact.exampleZh: 有些演员在舞台上紧张时就会演得过火。

overall.example: The overall plan looks good, and we need to check it carefully.
overall.exampleZh: 总体计划看起来不错，我们需要仔细检查一下。

overarch.example: A tall tree overarches the path in the old garden.
overarch.exampleZh: 一棵高大的树在古老花园的小路上方形成拱形。

overarching.example: Our overarching goal is to help students learn English with confidence.
overarching.exampleZh: 我们首要的目标是帮助学生自信地学习英语。

overawe.example: The huge old building seemed to overawe the children at first.
overawe.exampleZh: 那座巨大的老建筑起初似乎让孩子们感到敬畏。

overburden.example: The extra work may overburden the new staff in our small team.
overburden.exampleZh: 额外的工作可能会让我们小团队里的新员工负担过重。

overcast.example: The sky was overcast all morning, so we stayed home.
overcast.exampleZh: 整个上午天空都是阴的，所以我们待在家里。

overcharge.example: The taxi driver tried to overcharge us for the short trip to the hotel.
overcharge.exampleZh: 出租车司机想因为去酒店的这一小段路程多收我们钱。

overcome.example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
overcome.exampleZh: 她努力克服了当众讲话的恐惧。

overcompensate.example: He often overcompensates for his mistakes by working much too hard.
overcompensate.exampleZh: 他常常为了弥补错误而工作得过于拼命，结果矫枉过正。

overcrowd.example: Too many tourists overcrowd the small beach every summer.
overcrowd.exampleZh: 每年夏天太多的游客使这个小海滩过度拥挤。

overdo.example: Don't overdo the salt in this simple soup recipe.
overdo.exampleZh: 这道简单的汤里别放太多盐。

overdose.example: The doctor warned that an overdose of this medicine can be very dangerous.
overdose.exampleZh: 医生警告说，过量服用这种药会非常危险。

overdue.example: The library books are two weeks overdue, so I must return them today.
overdue.exampleZh: 图书馆的书逾期两周了，所以我今天必须还回去。

overemphasize.example: Some teachers overemphasize grades and forget that students need time to relax.
overemphasize.exampleZh: 有些老师过分强调成绩，忘了学生也需要时间放松。

overestimate.example: People often overestimate how much they can finish in one day.
overestimate.exampleZh: 人们常常高估自己一天内能完成的事情有多少。

overexpose.example: Do not overexpose your skin to the sun in summer.
overexpose.exampleZh: 夏天不要让你的皮肤过度暴露在阳光下。

overfeed.example: Don't overfeed the fish, or they will get sick and die.
overfeed.exampleZh: 不要给鱼喂得太多，否则它们会生病死掉。

overfish.example: Many countries now worry that big fishing boats will overfish the cold northern seas.
overfish.exampleZh: 许多国家现在担心大型渔船会过度捕捞寒冷的北部海域。

overflow.example: The river may overflow after three days of heavy rain.
overflow.exampleZh: 连续三天大雨之后，河水可能会溢出。

overgrow.example: In summer the old garden begins to overgrow with tall grass and wild flowers.
overgrow.exampleZh: 夏天时，那座老旧的花园开始长满高高的草和野花。

overhang.example: A large rock overhangs the path, so walk carefully.
overhang.exampleZh: 一块大岩石悬垂在小路上方，所以走路要小心。

overhaul.example: The old factory needs a complete overhaul before it can reopen.
overhaul.exampleZh: 这家旧工厂在重新开工前需要一次全面大修。

overhead.example: The overhead lights in the kitchen are too bright in the morning.
overhead.exampleZh: 厨房里头顶的灯在早上太亮了。

overhear.example: I overheard them talking about the surprise party in the kitchen.
overhear.exampleZh: 我在厨房无意中听到他们在谈论那个惊喜派对。

overheat.example: If you leave the phone in the sun, it may overheat quickly.
overheat.exampleZh: 如果你把手机放在阳光下，它可能会很快过热。

overindulge.example: Parents who overindulge their children often have trouble saying no.
overindulge.exampleZh: 溺爱孩子的父母往往很难说出拒绝的话。

overjoyed.example: She was overjoyed to see her old friends at the party.
overjoyed.exampleZh: 在聚会上见到老朋友，她欣喜若狂。

overlap.example: The two plans overlap in several areas, so we can save money.
overlap.exampleZh: 这两个计划在几个方面有重叠，所以我们可以省钱。

overlay.example: They put a thin overlay of gold on the old wooden frame.
overlay.exampleZh: 他们在旧木框上铺了一层薄薄的金箔。

overload.example: Do not overload the small boat with too many heavy boxes.
overload.exampleZh: 不要用太多沉重的箱子使这艘小船超载。

overlook.example: We should not overlook the small mistakes in our daily work.
overlook.exampleZh: 我们不应该忽视日常工作中的小错误。

overlord.example: The cruel overlord made all the farmers work for him without any pay.
overlord.exampleZh: 那个残暴的封建领主让所有农民为他干活，却分文不给。

overnight.example: The weather changed overnight, so we stayed home today.
overnight.exampleZh: 天气一夜之间变了，所以我们今天待在家里。

overpay.example: I did not want to overpay for the old car, so I waited.
overpay.exampleZh: 我不想为那辆旧车多付钱，所以我等了等。

overplay.example: Do not overplay the risks of the new plan.
overplay.exampleZh: 不要夸大新计划的风险。

overpopulated.example: The city is overpopulated because too many people move there every year.
overpopulated.exampleZh: 这座城市人口过剩，因为每年有太多人搬到这里。

overproduce.example: Many factories overproduce goods when demand is low.
overproduce.exampleZh: 当需求低迷时，许多工厂会生产过剩。

overprotect.example: Some parents overprotect their children and never let them try new things alone.
overprotect.exampleZh: 有些父母过度保护孩子，从不让他们独自尝试新事物。

overqualified.example: She did not get the job because the manager thought she was overqualified.
overqualified.exampleZh: 她没有得到那份工作，因为经理认为她资历过高。

overrate.example: Many people overrate the importance of money in their daily lives.
overrate.exampleZh: 许多人高估了金钱在日常生活中的重要性。

override.example: The manager can override the committee's decision if he thinks it is wrong.
override.exampleZh: 如果经理认为委员会的决定有误，他可以推翻它。

overrule.example: The judge decided to overrule the objection and let the witness speak.
overrule.exampleZh: 法官决定驳回反对意见，让证人发言。

overrun.example: Weeds soon overrun the garden when nobody takes care of it.
overrun.exampleZh: 如果没人打理，杂草很快就会蔓延整个花园。

overseas.example: My brother found a good job overseas after he finished college.
overseas.exampleZh: 我哥哥大学毕业后在海外找到了一份好工作。

oversee.example: Our manager will oversee the whole project and check our work every week.
oversee.exampleZh: 我们的经理将监督整个项目，并每周检查我们的工作。

overshadow.example: Her talent was so great that it overshadowed everyone else in the small team.
overshadow.exampleZh: 她的才华如此出众，以至于让这个小团队里的其他人都显得逊色。

oversight.example: The new manager promised better oversight of the company's daily spending.
oversight.exampleZh: 新经理承诺对公司的日常开支进行更好的监督。

oversimplify.example: Don't oversimplify the problem, because it has many causes.
oversimplify.exampleZh: 不要把这个问题的成因过分简单化，因为它有很多原因。

overstate.example: It is easy to overstate how much money we can save this year.
overstate.exampleZh: 我们很容易夸大今年能省下多少钱。

overstep.example: The manager overstepped his authority when he signed the contract alone.
overstep.exampleZh: 经理独自签署那份合同时逾越了自己的权限。

overstock.example: The store overstocked on winter coats and now has no space left.
overstock.exampleZh: 这家商店冬衣进货过多，现在没有空间了。

oversupply.example: There is an oversupply of oil in the world market right now.
oversupply.exampleZh: 目前世界市场上石油供过于求。

overt.example: Her overt dislike of the plan made everyone at the meeting uncomfortable.
overt.exampleZh: 她对这项计划明显的反感让会上所有人都感到不自在。

overtake.example: We drove faster than the truck so we could overtake it.
overtake.exampleZh: 我们开得比那辆卡车快，这样才能超过它。

overtax.example: The new rules may overtax small businesses that already work long hours.
overtax.exampleZh: 新规定可能会让本就长时间工作的小企业负担过重。

overthrow.example: The people rose up to overthrow the old king and his cruel government.
overthrow.exampleZh: 人民奋起推翻了旧国王及其残暴的政府。

overtime.example: He works overtime every Friday to finish his reports on time.
overtime.exampleZh: 他每周五都加班，以便按时完成报告。

overtone.example: His joke had a serious overtone that everyone in the room noticed.
overtone.exampleZh: 他的玩笑带着一种严肃的言外之意，房间里的每个人都察觉到了。

overtrain.example: If you overtrain, your body will get tired and weak.
overtrain.exampleZh: 如果你训练过度，身体就会变得疲惫虚弱。

overturn.example: The court decided to overturn the old law last week.
overturn.exampleZh: 法院上周决定推翻这项旧法律。

overuse.example: Doctors warn that people often overuse painkillers, which can cause serious health problems.
overuse.exampleZh: 医生警告说，人们常常过度使用止痛药，这可能会导致严重的健康问题。

overvalue.example: Many people overvalue money and forget the importance of health.
overvalue.exampleZh: 很多人对金钱估价过高，却忘记了健康的重要性。

overview.example: The first chapter gives a short overview of the whole problem.
overview.exampleZh: 第一章对整个问题作了简短的概述。

overwhelm.example: Heavy work and little sleep often overwhelm young workers.
overwhelm.exampleZh: 繁重的工作和睡眠不足常常让年轻员工不知所措。

overwhelming.example: The team won by an overwhelming majority of votes.
overwhelming.exampleZh: 这支队伍以压倒性的多数票获胜。

overwork.example: She became sick because she often overworks and never takes a rest.
overwork.exampleZh: 她因为经常工作过度又从不休息而生病了。

overwrought.example: She felt overwrought after working late for three nights in a row.
overwrought.exampleZh: 连续三个晚上加班后，她感到过度紧张。

ovulate.example: Most women ovulate about two weeks before their next period begins.
ovulate.exampleZh: 大多数女性在下次月经开始前约两周排卵。

owe.example: I owe my friend ten dollars, and I will pay him back tomorrow.
owe.exampleZh: 我欠我朋友十美元，我明天会还给他。

owl.example: An owl sat in the tree and watched us walk home.
owl.exampleZh: 一只猫头鹰坐在树上，看着我们走回家。

own.example: I want to own my own small shop near the river.
own.exampleZh: 我想在河边拥有一家自己的小店。

owner.example: The owner of the small shop is very kind to children.
owner.exampleZh: 这家小店的店主对孩子们非常和善。

ownership.example: The ownership of the land belongs to the whole village.
ownership.exampleZh: 这片土地的所有权属于整个村庄。

ox.example: The old farmer uses an ox to pull the heavy wooden cart.
ox.exampleZh: 这位老农用一头公牛来拉那辆沉重的木车。

oxide.example: Rust on iron is an oxide that forms when metal meets water.
oxide.exampleZh: 铁锈是一种氧化物，在金属接触水时形成。

oxidize.example: When iron is left in wet air, it oxidizes and turns red.
oxidize.exampleZh: 铁放在潮湿的空气中会氧化并变红。

oyster.example: The restaurant serves fresh oysters with lemon and bread every Friday.
oyster.exampleZh: 这家餐厅每周五供应配柠檬和面包的新鲜牡蛎。

ozone.example: The ozone layer above the earth protects us from harmful sun rays.
ozone.exampleZh: 地球上方的大气臭氧层保护我们免受有害太阳光线的伤害。

pabulum.example: The teacher said good books are pabulum for a young mind.
pabulum.exampleZh: 老师说好书是年轻人心灵的精神食粮。

pace.example: She walked at a slow pace and soon fell behind the others.
pace.exampleZh: 她以很慢的步速走着，很快就落在了其他人后面。

pacific.example: The two countries signed a pacific agreement after a long and difficult discussion.
pacific.exampleZh: 经过长时间艰难的讨论，两国签署了一项和平协议。

pacifism.example: My grandfather believed in pacifism and refused to fight in any war.
pacifism.exampleZh: 我的祖父信奉和平主义，拒绝参加任何战争。

pacifist.example: My uncle is a pacifist who refuses to fight in any war.
pacifist.exampleZh: 我的叔叔是一位和平主义者，拒绝参与任何战争。

pacify.example: The mother sang softly to pacify her crying baby.
pacify.exampleZh: 母亲轻声唱歌来安抚哭泣的婴儿。

pack.example: She will pack her clothes into a small bag before the trip.
pack.exampleZh: 旅行前，她会把衣服打包进一个小包里。

package.example: The package arrived at my door early this morning.
package.exampleZh: 包裹今天一早送到了我家门口。

pact.example: The two countries signed a pact to keep peace in the region.
pact.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项协定，以维护该地区的和平。

pad.example: Please write your phone number on the small pad beside the phone.
pad.exampleZh: 请把你的电话号码写在电话旁边的小便签本上。

paddle.example: We used a wooden paddle to move the small boat across the lake.
paddle.exampleZh: 我们用木桨把小船划过湖面。

pagan.example: Long ago, pagan tribes worshipped the sun and many other natural forces.
pagan.exampleZh: 很久以前，异教部落崇拜太阳和许多其他自然力量。

page.example: The picture is on the first page of the book.
page.exampleZh: 那幅画在这本书的第一页上。

paid.example: The paid workers finished the job before noon today.
paid.exampleZh: 受雇的工人们在今天中午前完成了这项工作。

pain.example: She felt a sharp pain in her back after the long walk.
pain.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，她感到背部一阵剧痛。

painful.example: The cut on my finger is very painful when I wash my hands.
painful.exampleZh: 我洗手时手指上的伤口非常疼。

paint.example: She likes to paint small pictures of flowers in her free time.
paint.exampleZh: 她喜欢在空闲时间画一些小花图。

painting.example: The painting on the wall is old but very beautiful.
painting.exampleZh: 墙上的那幅油画很旧，但非常漂亮。

pair.example: She bought a pair of new shoes for her son.
pair.exampleZh: 她给儿子买了一双新鞋。

palace.example: The old palace stands in the middle of the city.
palace.exampleZh: 这座古老的宫殿坐落在城市中央。

palatable.example: The soup was very palatable, and everyone asked for more.
palatable.exampleZh: 这汤非常可口，大家都要求再来一些。

pale.example: Her face was pale because she had been sick all week.
pale.exampleZh: 她的脸色苍白，因为她已经病了一整周。

palm.example: She held the small coin in the palm of her hand.
palm.exampleZh: 她把那枚小硬币握在手心里。

pamphlet.example: The teacher gave each student a small pamphlet about the school rules.
pamphlet.exampleZh: 老师给每个学生发了一本关于校规的小册子。

pan.example: She put the eggs in a hot pan with some butter.
pan.exampleZh: 她把鸡蛋放进加了黄油的熱平底锅里。

panacea.example: Exercise is not a panacea for every health problem.
panacea.exampleZh: 运动并不是所有健康问题的万灵药。

pancake.example: My mother makes pancakes with milk and eggs for breakfast every Sunday.
pancake.exampleZh: 每个星期天，我妈妈用牛奶和鸡蛋做薄煎饼当早餐。

pandemic.example: The pandemic changed how people around the world live and work.
pandemic.exampleZh: 这场大流行病改变了世界各地人们的生活和工作方式。

panel.example: A panel of experts will answer questions after the talk.
panel.exampleZh: 一个专家小组将在讲座后回答提问。

panic.example: She felt panic when she could not find her keys.
panic.exampleZh: 当她找不到钥匙时，她感到恐慌。

panorama.example: The book gives a broad panorama of modern art history.
panorama.exampleZh: 这本书对现代艺术史做了全面的综述。

pant.example: After running up the stairs, he began to pant and could not speak.
pant.exampleZh: 跑上楼梯后，他开始气喘吁吁，说不出话来。

paper.example: She wrote her name on a piece of paper and gave it to me.
paper.exampleZh: 她把名字写在一张纸上，然后递给了我。

par.example: The two players are on par with each other in skill.
par.exampleZh: 这两名球员在技术上是同等水平。

parade.example: The whole town came out to watch the parade on Saturday morning.
parade.exampleZh: 整个小镇的人都出来观看周六上午的游行。

paradigm.example: The new teaching paradigm puts students at the center of learning.
paradigm.exampleZh: 新的教学范式把学生放在学习的中心。

paradox.example: It is a paradox that the richest man says money cannot buy happiness.
paradox.exampleZh: 最富有的人说金钱买不到幸福，这真是个悖论。

paragraph.example: Please read the first paragraph of the story and tell me what it is about.
paragraph.exampleZh: 请阅读这个故事的第一段，然后告诉我它讲了什么。

parallel.example: The two roads are parallel and run beside the river.
parallel.exampleZh: 这两条路是平行的，沿着河边延伸。

paralysis.example: The accident left him with paralysis in both legs.
paralysis.exampleZh: 那场事故使他双腿瘫痪。

paralyze.example: The accident paralyzed his legs, so he now uses a wheelchair every day.
paralyze.exampleZh: 那场事故使他的双腿瘫痪，所以他现在每天都要坐轮椅。

paraphrase.example: Can you paraphrase this sentence in simple English for me?
paraphrase.exampleZh: 你能用简单的英语为我改写一下这个句子吗？

parasite.example: This small parasite lives inside the fish and eats its food.
parasite.exampleZh: 这种小寄生虫生活在鱼体内，吃鱼的食物。

parcel.example: She sent a small parcel to her brother last week.
parcel.exampleZh: 她上周给弟弟寄了一个小包裹。

pardon.example: She asked pardon for being late to the meeting.
pardon.exampleZh: 她为开会迟到请求原谅。

parent.example: My parent came to the school meeting with me yesterday.
parent.exampleZh: 我的父亲（或母亲）昨天和我一起参加了学校会议。

parenthesis.example: Please put the extra information in a parenthesis at the end.
parenthesis.exampleZh: 请把补充信息放在末尾的圆括号里。

parish.example: The old church is the center of our small parish.
parish.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂是我们这个小教区的中心。

parity.example: There is no parity between the pay of men and women here.
parity.exampleZh: 这里男女的薪酬并不均等。

park.example: We walk in the park every morning before work.
park.exampleZh: 我们每天早上上班前都去公园散步。

parliament.example: The new law was passed by parliament after a long debate.
parliament.exampleZh: 经过长时间辩论，议会通过了这项新法律。

parlor.example: The family sat in the parlor and talked after dinner.
parlor.exampleZh: 晚饭后，一家人坐在客厅里聊天。

parrot.example: The green parrot in the pet shop can say a few simple words.
parrot.exampleZh: 宠物店里的那只绿鹦鹉会说几个简单的词。

parse.example: The program can parse the data and find the main errors quickly.
parse.exampleZh: 这个程序能够解析数据，并快速找出主要错误。

partial.example: The teacher gave us only a partial answer to the question.
partial.exampleZh: 老师只给了我们这个问题的一部分答案。

partiality.example: The judge showed partiality toward his friend and that was not fair.
partiality.exampleZh: 法官偏袒他的朋友，这并不公平。

participant.example: Every participant in the race received a small gift at the end.
participant.exampleZh: 比赛的每位参与者最后都收到了一份小礼物。

participate.example: Many students participate in sports and music activities after school.
participate.exampleZh: 许多学生放学后参加体育和音乐活动。

particle.example: Tiny particles of dust floated in the sunlight through the window.
particle.exampleZh: 细小的尘埃微粒在透过窗户的阳光中飘浮。

particular.example: She has a particular way of making tea in the morning.
particular.exampleZh: 她早上泡茶有自己特别的一套方法。

partly.example: I partly agree with you, but the plan still needs more work.
partly.exampleZh: 我部分同意你的看法，但这个计划仍需要更多完善。

partner.example: My business partner helps me with all the hard work.
partner.exampleZh: 我的生意伙伴帮我处理所有艰难的工作。

partnership.example: Our partnership with the local school has helped many children learn to read.
partnership.exampleZh: 我们与当地学校的合作关系帮助许多孩子学会了阅读。

party.example: My friend joined a new party before the local election last year.
party.exampleZh: 我朋友去年在地方选举前加入了一个新政党。

pass.example: Please pass me the salt and show your pass at the gate.
pass.exampleZh: 请把盐递给我，并在门口出示你的通行证。

passage.example: A narrow passage leads from the kitchen to the garden.
passage.exampleZh: 一条狭窄的通道从厨房通向花园。

passenger.example: The bus stopped and every passenger got off at the last station.
passenger.exampleZh: 公交车停下，所有乘客都在最后一站下了车。

passion.example: Her passion for music made every lesson fun and exciting.
passion.exampleZh: 她对音乐的热情让每节课都充满乐趣和激动。

passive.example: He stayed passive during the meeting and never shared his ideas.
passive.exampleZh: 他在会议上很消极，从未分享自己的想法。

past.example: In the past, we walked past the old school every day.
past.exampleZh: 在过去，我们每天都会经过那所旧学校。

paste.example: She used paste to stick the paper on the wall.
paste.exampleZh: 她用浆糊把纸粘在墙上。

pastime.example: Reading books is my favorite pastime on quiet weekend afternoons.
pastime.exampleZh: 在安静的周末午后读书是我最喜欢的消遣。

pasture.example: The cows walked slowly across the green pasture near the farm.
pasture.exampleZh: 奶牛慢慢走过农场附近那片绿色的牧场。

pat.example: She gave the dog a gentle pat on the head and smiled.
pat.exampleZh: 她轻轻拍了拍狗的头，笑了。

patch.example: The doctor put a small patch on my arm to help it heal.
patch.exampleZh: 医生在我手臂上贴了一小块药贴，帮助它愈合。

patent.example: The company applied for a patent on its new battery design last year.
patent.exampleZh: 该公司去年为其新电池设计申请了专利。

path.example: We walked along a narrow path through the green fields.
path.exampleZh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路穿过绿色的田野。

pathetic.example: He looked pathetic sitting alone in the rain with no umbrella.
pathetic.exampleZh: 他独自坐在雨中没有雨伞，看上去很可怜。

pathos.example: The old song filled the room with pathos and made everyone quiet.
pathos.exampleZh: 这首老歌让房间里充满了悲情，使每个人都安静下来。

patience.example: Learning a new language takes patience and a lot of daily practice.
patience.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要耐心和大量的日常练习。

patient.example: The doctor is very patient with his young patients.
patient.exampleZh: 这位医生对年轻病人非常有耐心。

patriot.example: The old soldier was a true patriot who loved his country.
patriot.exampleZh: 那位老兵是一位真正热爱自己国家的爱国者。

patriotic.example: Many patriotic people sing the national song with pride on that day.
patriotic.exampleZh: 那天，许多爱国的人自豪地唱起国歌。

patrol.example: The police patrol the streets at night to keep everyone safe.
patrol.exampleZh: 警察在夜间巡逻街道以保障大家的安全。

patron.example: The old patron visits the small bookshop every Friday afternoon.
patron.exampleZh: 这位老主顾每周五下午都会光顾这家小书店。

patronize.example: Please do not patronize me just because I am new here.
patronize.exampleZh: 请不要因为我是新来的就用高人一等的态度对待我。

pattern.example: The dress has a pretty flower pattern on it.
pattern.exampleZh: 这条连衣裙上有漂亮的花卉图案。

pause.example: Let us pause for a moment before we continue the story.
pause.exampleZh: 在我们继续这个故事之前，让我们暂停一会儿。

pave.example: The workers will pave the road in front of our school next week.
pave.exampleZh: 工人们下周会铺设我们学校前面的那条路。

paw.example: The little dog hurt its paw on a sharp rock in the yard.
paw.exampleZh: 那只小狗在院子里被一块尖石头弄伤了爪子。

pay.example: I will pay for the coffee and then give you the change.
pay.exampleZh: 我会付咖啡的钱，然后把找零给你。

payment.example: You can make the payment online with a credit card.
payment.exampleZh: 你可以用信用卡在网上付款。

pea.example: My mother cooks green peas with rice for dinner every Friday.
pea.exampleZh: 我妈妈每周五晚餐都会做青豆配米饭。

peace.example: The two countries finally found peace after many long years of war.
peace.exampleZh: 经过多年漫长的战争，这两个国家终于迎来了和平。

peaceful.example: The village is very peaceful at night, so I sleep well there.
peaceful.exampleZh: 这个村子在夜里非常安宁，所以我在那里睡得很好。

peak.example: We climbed for six hours to reach the peak of the mountain before sunrise.
peak.exampleZh: 我们爬了六个小时，在日出前到达了这座山的顶峰。

peanut.example: My little brother likes to eat peanut butter on bread for breakfast.
peanut.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜欢早餐时在面包上抹花生酱吃。

pearl.example: The queen wore a beautiful pearl necklace to the party last night.
pearl.exampleZh: 昨晚女王戴着一条美丽的珍珠项链去参加聚会。

peasant.example: The peasant works hard in the field from morning to night.
peasant.exampleZh: 这个农民从早到晚在田里辛勤劳作。

pebble.example: The little boy threw a smooth pebble into the quiet lake.
pebble.exampleZh: 小男孩把一颗光滑的卵石扔进了平静的湖里。

pecking.example: The chickens showed a clear pecking order at the feeder.
pecking.exampleZh: 鸡群在食槽边表现出明显的啄食顺序。

peculiar.example: There is a peculiar smell in this old room.
peculiar.exampleZh: 这个旧房间里有一股奇怪的气味。

pedagogy.example: Her pedagogy helps young children learn to read with confidence.
pedagogy.exampleZh: 她的教学法帮助幼儿自信地学会阅读。

pedal.example: He put his foot on the pedal and the bike began to move.
pedal.exampleZh: 他把脚放在踏板上，自行车开始移动。

pedestrian.example: The driver stopped for a pedestrian who was crossing the busy street.
pedestrian.exampleZh: 司机停下来让一位正在穿过繁忙街道的行人先走。

pedigree.example: The old man showed us the pedigree of his family on paper.
pedigree.exampleZh: 那位老人给我们看了纸上他家的家谱。

peel.example: I peel an apple for my little sister every morning.
peel.exampleZh: 我每天早上给我妹妹削一个苹果。

peer.example: She likes to peer at the stars with her peers every night.
peer.exampleZh: 她喜欢每晚和同龄人一起凝视星星。

pen.example: The farmer keeps his sheep behind a strong pen.
pen.exampleZh: 农夫把羊群关在一个结实的围栏里。

penalize.example: The new rules will penalize companies that pollute the river.
penalize.exampleZh: 新规定将处罚那些污染河流的公司。

penalty.example: The player got a penalty after a bad foul in the game.
penalty.exampleZh: 这名球员在比赛中因严重犯规而被判罚点球。

pencil.example: I use a pencil to write my name on the paper.
pencil.exampleZh: 我用铅笔在纸上写我的名字。

pending.example: The final decision is still pending while the team reviews the report.
pending.exampleZh: 在团队审阅报告期间，最终决定仍然待定。

pendulum.example: The pendulum of the clock swung slowly back and forth.
pendulum.exampleZh: 钟的摆慢慢地来回摆动。

penetrate.example: The rain can penetrate through the thin roof of the old house.
penetrate.exampleZh: 雨水会渗透过那座老房子的薄屋顶。

peninsula.example: Many small towns sit along the narrow peninsula by the sea.
peninsula.exampleZh: 许多小镇坐落在海边的狭长半岛上。

penny.example: I have only one penny in my pocket today.
penny.exampleZh: 我今天口袋里只有一便士。

pension.example: She lives on a small pension after forty years of hard work.
pension.exampleZh: 辛勤工作四十年后，她靠一笔微薄的养老金生活。

people.example: Many people in this city take the bus to work every day.
people.exampleZh: 这座城市里许多人每天乘公交车上班。

pepper.example: She adds a little pepper to her soup to make it taste better.
pepper.exampleZh: 她在汤里加了一点胡椒，让它味道更好。

per.example: We meet twice per week to talk about our work.
per.exampleZh: 我们每周见两次面，谈谈工作。

per capita.example: The country's per capita income has risen slowly over the past five years.
per capita.exampleZh: 这个国家的人均收入在过去五年里缓慢上升。

perceive.example: Many people perceive him as a kind and honest man.
perceive.exampleZh: 许多人认为他是一个善良诚实的人。

percent.example: Only ten percent of the students came to class today.
percent.exampleZh: 今天只有百分之十的学生来上课。

perception.example: My perception of the city changed after I lived there for a year.
perception.exampleZh: 我在那座城市住了一年后，对它的看法改变了。

perennial.example: Gardening is a perennial hobby for many people in this small town.
perennial.exampleZh: 园艺是这个小镇上许多人的长期爱好。

perfect.example: Nobody is perfect, but we can always improve our skills with practice.
perfect.exampleZh: 没有人是完美的，但我们可以通过练习不断完善自己的技能。

perfection.example: She practiced the song every day until she reached perfection.
perfection.exampleZh: 她每天练习这首歌，直到达到完美的境界。

perfidy.example: His perfidy hurt the friends who had trusted him for years.
perfidy.exampleZh: 他的背信弃义伤害了那些多年来一直信任他的朋友。

perform.example: The team will perform a short play at school next week.
perform.exampleZh: 这个团队下周将在学校表演一个短剧。

performance.example: Her performance in the school play made everyone clap loudly.
performance.exampleZh: 她在学校戏剧中的表演让所有人都热烈鼓掌。

perfunctory.example: His perfunctory answer showed that he did not care about the question.
perfunctory.exampleZh: 他敷衍的回答说明他并不在意这个问题。

perhaps.example: Perhaps she will come to the party tomorrow night.
perhaps.exampleZh: 也许她明天晚上会来参加聚会。

peril.example: The sailors knew the peril of sailing into the storm.
peril.exampleZh: 水手们知道驶入暴风雨的危险。

period.example: This period of history is very important for us to study.
period.exampleZh: 这段历史时期对我们学习非常重要。

periodic.example: The doctor says I need periodic checks of my blood pressure.
periodic.exampleZh: 医生说我需要定期检查血压。

periodical.example: She reads a science periodical every month at the library.
periodical.exampleZh: 她每个月都在图书馆读一本科普期刊。

periphery.example: The new factory is on the periphery of the city, far from shops.
periphery.exampleZh: 新工厂位于城市边缘，离商店很远。

perish.example: Without water, these plants will perish quickly in the hot sun.
perish.exampleZh: 没有水，这些植物在烈日下很快就会枯死。

perjury.example: She was charged with perjury after lying about the money in court.
perjury.exampleZh: 她在法庭上就那笔钱撒谎后，被指控犯有伪证罪。

permanent.example: The museum is a permanent home for many famous old paintings.
permanent.exampleZh: 这座博物馆是许多著名古画的永久收藏地。

permeate.example: The smell of fresh coffee permeated the whole house this morning.
permeate.exampleZh: 今天早上，新鲜咖啡的香味弥漫了整个房子。

permission.example: You need permission from your teacher to leave the room early.
permission.exampleZh: 你需要得到老师的允许才能提前离开教室。

permit.example: The school does not permit students to use phones during class.
permit.exampleZh: 学校不允许学生在课堂上使用手机。

pernicious.example: This pernicious habit can slowly harm your health.
pernicious.exampleZh: 这个有害的习惯会慢慢损害你的健康。

perpetual.example: The machine runs with a perpetual hum that never stops day or night.
perpetual.exampleZh: 这台机器发出永不停息的嗡嗡声，日夜不停。

perpetuate.example: Some old stories perpetuate wrong ideas about women and their work.
perpetuate.exampleZh: 一些古老的故事使关于女性和她们工作的错误观念延续下去。

perplex.example: The strange question seemed to perplex even the most experienced teacher.
perplex.exampleZh: 这个奇怪的问题似乎连最有经验的老师都感到困惑。

persecute.example: The cruel king persecuted people who did not share his religion.
persecute.exampleZh: 那个残暴的国王迫害不信仰他宗教的人。

persist.example: If the pain persists, you should see a doctor right away.
persist.exampleZh: 如果疼痛持续不退，你应该立刻去看医生。

persistent.example: Her persistent efforts finally helped the team finish the project on time.
persistent.exampleZh: 她坚持不懈的努力最终帮助团队按时完成了项目。

person.example: She is a kind person who always helps her friends.
person.exampleZh: 她是个总是帮助朋友的善良的人。

personal.example: This is my personal opinion, and you can disagree with it.
personal.exampleZh: 这是我的个人看法，你可以不同意。

personality.example: Her warm personality makes everyone feel happy at school.
personality.exampleZh: 她温暖的个性让学校里的每个人都感到快乐。

personnel.example: The manager asked all personnel to attend the meeting on Monday morning.
personnel.exampleZh: 经理要求全体员工参加周一上午的会议。

perspective.example: Her trip abroad gave her a new perspective on life.
perspective.exampleZh: 她的海外旅行让她对生活有了新的视角。

persuade.example: I tried to persuade my brother to study English with me.
persuade.exampleZh: 我试着说服我弟弟和我一起学英语。

persuasion.example: Her calm persuasion made him change his mind about the trip.
persuasion.exampleZh: 她冷静的说服让他改变了对这次旅行的想法。

pertain.example: These rules pertain to everyone who works in this office.
pertain.exampleZh: 这些规定适用于在这个办公室工作的每一个人。

pertinent.example: Her question was very pertinent to our discussion about the new plan.
pertinent.exampleZh: 她的问题与我们关于新计划的讨论非常相关。

perturb.example: The sudden noise perturbed the baby and she began to cry.
perturb.exampleZh: 突然的噪音让婴儿不安，她开始哭了起来。

pervade.example: A warm smell of bread seemed to pervade the whole house.
pervade.exampleZh: 一股温暖的面包香味似乎弥漫了整座房子。

pervasive.example: Social media has become a pervasive part of daily life for young people.
pervasive.exampleZh: 社交媒体已成为年轻人日常生活中无处不在的一部分。

pessimism.example: His pessimism about the future made it hard for him to try new things.
pessimism.exampleZh: 他对未来的悲观态度让他很难去尝试新事物。

pessimistic.example: She feels pessimistic about the test because she did not study.
pessimistic.exampleZh: 她对这次考试感到悲观，因为她没有学习。

pest.example: Farmers use special chemicals to keep pests away from their crops.
pest.exampleZh: 农民使用特殊的化学品来防止害虫侵害他们的庄稼。

pet.example: My pet dog likes to sleep on my bed every night.
pet.exampleZh: 我的宠物狗喜欢每天晚上睡在我的床上。

petition.example: Many people signed the petition to save the old park.
petition.exampleZh: 许多人签署了请愿书，要求保住这座老公园。

petrify.example: The terrible news petrified her, and she could not speak for a moment.
petrify.exampleZh: 那个可怕的消息把她惊呆了，她一时说不出话来。

petrol.example: We need to buy petrol before we drive to the city.
petrol.exampleZh: 开车去城里之前我们需要买汽油。

petroleum.example: Many countries buy petroleum from other nations to make fuel for cars.
petroleum.exampleZh: 许多国家从其他国家购买石油来制造汽车燃料。

petty.example: She often argues with her neighbors about petty things like parking spaces.
petty.exampleZh: 她经常因为停车位这类琐事和邻居争吵。

phase.example: This project is still in its early phase, so we need more time.
phase.exampleZh: 这个项目仍处于早期阶段，所以我们需要更多时间。

phenomenon.example: This strange weather pattern is a natural phenomenon that scientists study.
phenomenon.exampleZh: 这种奇怪的天气模式是科学家研究的一种自然现象。

phenotype.example: The phenotype of this plant changes when it gets more sunlight.
phenotype.exampleZh: 这种植物的表型在获得更多阳光时会发生变化。

philanthropy.example: Her philanthropy helped many poor children in our city go to school.
philanthropy.exampleZh: 她的慈善事业帮助了我们城市里许多贫困儿童上学。

philosopher.example: The old philosopher often asked simple questions about life and time.
philosopher.exampleZh: 这位老哲学家常常提出关于生命和时间的简单问题。

philosophy.example: Her philosophy of life is to stay curious and be kind.
philosophy.exampleZh: 她的人生观是保持好奇并待人友善。

phone.example: I use my phone to call my mother every evening.
phone.exampleZh: 我每天晚上用手机给我妈妈打电话。

photo.example: I took a photo of my family in the park yesterday.
photo.exampleZh: 昨天我在公园给家人拍了一张照片。

photograph.example: She showed me a photograph of her family at the beach.
photograph.exampleZh: 她给我看了一张她家人在海滩上的照片。

photography.example: She learned photography from her father when she was young.
photography.exampleZh: 她小时候跟着父亲学习摄影。

phrase.example: The teacher taught us a useful phrase in class today.
phrase.exampleZh: 老师今天在课堂上教了我们一个有用的短语。

physical.example: Regular physical exercise helps children stay healthy and learn better at school.
physical.exampleZh: 规律的体育锻炼有助于孩子保持健康，并在学校里学得更好。

physician.example: My physician told me to rest and drink more water every day.
physician.exampleZh: 我的医生告诉我每天多休息、多喝水。

physicist.example: The physicist explained how the new machine works.
physicist.exampleZh: 这位物理学家解释了这台新机器是如何运作的。

physics.example: I like physics because it helps me understand how the world works.
physics.exampleZh: 我喜欢物理学，因为它帮助我理解世界是如何运作的。

physiological.example: The doctor said the change was a normal physiological response to stress.
physiological.exampleZh: 医生说这种变化是对压力的正常生理反应。

physiology.example: She studies physiology at the university because she wants to understand how the human body works.
physiology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习生理学，因为她想了解人体是如何运作的。

physique.example: His strong physique helps him play many sports very well.
physique.exampleZh: 他强壮的体格帮助他很好地参与许多运动。

piano.example: She practices the piano for an hour every day after school.
piano.exampleZh: 她每天放学后练一个小时钢琴。

pick.example: She likes to pick fresh apples from the tree in her garden.
pick.exampleZh: 她喜欢从花园的树上摘新鲜苹果。

picnic.example: We had a picnic in the park with our friends last Sunday.
picnic.exampleZh: 上周日我们和朋友在公园里野餐。

picture.example: There is a picture of my family on the wall.
picture.exampleZh: 墙上有一张我家人的照片。

pie.example: My mother made a delicious apple pie for our family dinner last night.
pie.exampleZh: 昨天晚上我妈妈为我们家的晚餐做了一个美味的苹果馅饼。

piece.example: She gave me a piece of cake after dinner.
piece.exampleZh: 晚饭后她给了我一块蛋糕。

pierce.example: The sharp needle can pierce through the thick cloth very easily.
pierce.exampleZh: 这根尖针能很容易地刺穿厚布。

pig.example: The pig is sleeping in the mud near the old red barn.
pig.exampleZh: 那头猪正在谷仓旁的泥里睡觉。

pigeon.example: A gray pigeon sat on the roof and watched the people below.
pigeon.exampleZh: 一只灰色的鸽子停在屋顶上，看着下面的人们。

pile.example: There is a big pile of books on my desk.
pile.exampleZh: 我的书桌上有一大堆书。

pilgrim.example: The tired pilgrim walked slowly along the old road to the holy city.
pilgrim.exampleZh: 那位疲惫的朝圣者沿着古老的道路慢慢走向圣城。

pill.example: She takes a pill every morning after breakfast to stay healthy.
pill.exampleZh: 她每天早上吃完早饭吃一片药，以保持健康。

pillar.example: The old pillar in the hall holds up the heavy roof.
pillar.exampleZh: 大厅里的那根旧柱子支撑着沉重的屋顶。

pillow.example: I put a soft pillow under my head before I go to sleep.
pillow.exampleZh: 我睡觉前会在头下放一个柔软的枕头。

pilot.example: The pilot flew the small plane across the wide blue sea.
pilot.exampleZh: 飞行员驾驶小飞机飞越宽阔的蓝色大海。

pin.example: She used a pin to hold the paper on the board.
pin.exampleZh: 她用一枚大头针把纸固定在板上。

pinch.example: She gave my arm a quick pinch to wake me up.
pinch.exampleZh: 她在我胳膊上轻轻捏了一下，把我叫醒。

pine.example: The tall pine trees grow along the quiet road near my home.
pine.exampleZh: 高大的松树生长在我家附近那条安静的路旁。

pink.example: The little girl is wearing a pink dress to the party.
pink.exampleZh: 小女孩穿着一条粉红色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

pinnacle.example: Winning that prize was the pinnacle of her long career.
pinnacle.exampleZh: 赢得那个奖项是她漫长职业生涯的顶峰。

pint.example: He drank a pint of cold beer after work yesterday.
pint.exampleZh: 他昨天下班后喝了一品脱冷啤酒。

pioneer.example: He was a pioneer in the field of computer science.
pioneer.exampleZh: 他是计算机科学领域的先驱。

pipe.example: Water flows through the long pipe under the street.
pipe.exampleZh: 水流过街道下面的长管子。

pistol.example: The police officer found a small pistol hidden under the man's coat.
pistol.exampleZh: 警察在那名男子的外套下发现了一把藏起来的小手枪。

piston.example: The piston moves up and down inside the engine to help the car run.
piston.exampleZh: 活塞在发动机内上下移动，帮助汽车运行。

pit.example: The workers dug a deep pit near the old coal mine.
pit.exampleZh: 工人们在旧煤矿附近挖了一个深坑。

pitch.example: The singer hit a high pitch at the end of the song.
pitch.exampleZh: 歌手在歌曲结尾唱出了一个高音。

pity.example: It is a pity that you cannot come to the party tonight.
pity.exampleZh: 很可惜你今晚不能来参加聚会。

pivotal.example: His advice was pivotal to our success in the final match.
pivotal.exampleZh: 他的建议对我们在最后一场比赛中的成功至关重要。

placate.example: She tried to placate the angry customer with a sincere apology.
placate.exampleZh: 她试着用真诚的道歉来安抚那位愤怒的顾客。

place.example: Please place your bag in a safe place near the door.
place.exampleZh: 请把你的包放在门附近一个安全的地方。

plagiarism.example: The teacher said that copying other people's writing is a kind of plagiarism.
plagiarism.exampleZh: 老师说，抄袭别人的文章是一种剽窃行为。

plagiarize.example: He was caught trying to plagiarize parts of another writer's book.
plagiarize.exampleZh: 他被人发现试图抄袭另一位作家书中的部分内容。

plague.example: The plague killed many people in the small town last year.
plague.exampleZh: 去年这场瘟疫在这个小镇上夺去了许多人的生命。

plain.example: Her plain words made the whole idea easy to understand.
plain.exampleZh: 她朴素的措辞让整个想法变得容易理解。

plan.example: We need a good plan before we start the new project.
plan.exampleZh: 在开始新项目之前，我们需要一个完善的计划。

plane.example: The plane flies high above the clouds on a clear day.
plane.exampleZh: 在晴朗的日子里，飞机在云层上方高高飞行。

planet.example: Earth is the only planet we know with life on it.
planet.exampleZh: 地球是我们所知唯一有生命的行星。

plant.example: My mother planted some beautiful flowers in our small garden last spring.
plant.exampleZh: 去年春天，我妈妈在我们的小花园里种了一些美丽的花。

plantation.example: My grandfather worked on a banana plantation when he was young.
plantation.exampleZh: 我祖父年轻时在一个香蕉种植园工作。

plastic.example: This chair is made of plastic, so it is light and cheap.
plastic.exampleZh: 这把椅子是塑料做的，所以又轻又便宜。

plate.example: She put the hot soup in a white plate on the table.
plate.exampleZh: 她把热汤盛在一个白色盘子里，放在桌上。

platform.example: The train to Beijing will arrive at platform three in ten minutes.
platform.exampleZh: 开往北京的火车将在十分钟后到达三号站台。

platitude.example: His speech was full of platitudes that everyone had heard many times before.
platitude.exampleZh: 他的演讲满是陈词滥调，那些话大家早已听过很多遍了。

plausible.example: Her story sounds plausible, but I still have some doubts.
plausible.exampleZh: 她的说法听起来似乎合理，但我仍有些怀疑。

play.example: The children play in the park and then play a funny game at home.
play.exampleZh: 孩子们在公园里玩耍，然后在家玩一个有趣的游戏。

plea.example: She made a plea for help, but no one listened to her.
plea.exampleZh: 她恳求帮助，但没有人听她的。

plead.example: She began to plead with the doctor to save her little son.
plead.exampleZh: 她开始恳求医生救救她的小儿子。

pleasant.example: The weather was pleasant, so we walked to the park together.
pleasant.exampleZh: 天气很好，所以我们一起走到了公园。

please.example: The little boy tried hard to please his parents with a small gift.
please.exampleZh: 那个小男孩努力用一份小礼物让父母高兴。

pleasure.example: Reading a good book brings me great pleasure after a long day.
pleasure.exampleZh: 漫长的一天后读一本好书给我带来很大乐趣。

pledge.example: She made a pledge to help her friend every day.
pledge.exampleZh: 她发誓每天都要帮助她的朋友。

plenary.example: The plenary meeting will start at nine in the morning.
plenary.exampleZh: 全体会议将于上午九点开始。

plenty.example: There is plenty of food and water for everyone at the party.
plenty.exampleZh: 聚会上有充足的食物和水供每个人享用。

plethora.example: There is a plethora of cheap restaurants near the station.
plethora.exampleZh: 车站附近有很多便宜的餐馆。

plight.example: The flood left many families in a serious plight.
plight.exampleZh: 洪水使许多家庭陷入严重的困境。

plot.example: The movie has a simple plot that everyone can understand easily.
plot.exampleZh: 这部电影有一个简单的情节，大家都能轻松理解。

plow.example: The farmer uses a plow to prepare the field for planting.
plow.exampleZh: 农夫用犁整地，为播种做准备。

plug.example: Please plug the lamp into the wall before it gets dark.
plug.exampleZh: 请在天黑前把台灯插到墙上。

plumb.example: The team will plumb the river to find out how deep it is.
plumb.exampleZh: 团队将探测这条河，查明它有多深。

plummet.example: The bird's temperature began to plummet during the cold winter night.
plummet.exampleZh: 在寒冷的冬夜，那只鸟的体温开始骤然下降。

plunge.example: He plunged into the cold water without a second thought.
plunge.exampleZh: 他想都没想就跳进了冰冷的水里。

plus.example: The price is fifty dollars plus ten dollars for delivery.
plus.exampleZh: 价格是五十美元外加十美元配送费。

plutocracy.example: The country fell into a plutocracy ruled by a few rich families.
plutocracy.exampleZh: 这个国家沦为由少数富豪家族统治的财阀政治。

pneumonia.example: The doctor said my cough was caused by pneumonia last week.
pneumonia.exampleZh: 医生说我的咳嗽是上周肺炎引起的。

pocket.example: He put the keys in his pocket and left the house.
pocket.exampleZh: 他把钥匙放进他的口袋里，然后离开了房子。

poem.example: She wrote a short poem about the sea for her class.
poem.exampleZh: 她为班级写了一首关于大海的短诗。

poet.example: The old poet wrote a short poem about the sea and the sky.
poet.exampleZh: 那位老诗人写了一首关于大海和天空的短诗。

poetry.example: She writes poetry about the quiet sea and the bright morning sky.
poetry.exampleZh: 她写关于宁静大海和明亮晨空的诗歌。

point.example: I see your point, but I still disagree with your plan.
point.exampleZh: 我明白你的观点，但我仍然不同意你的计划。

poison.example: The old man used poison to kill the rats in his house.
poison.exampleZh: 那个老人用毒药杀死了他房子里的老鼠。

poisonous.example: Some wild mushrooms are poisonous, so you should never eat them.
poisonous.exampleZh: 有些野生蘑菇有毒，所以你千万不要吃它们。

polar.example: The polar bear lives in a very cold place near the sea.
polar.exampleZh: 北极熊生活在海边一个非常寒冷的地方。

polarize.example: The new law may polarize voters and make simple talks much harder.
polarize.exampleZh: 新法律可能会使选民两极分化，并使简单的对话变得更加困难。

pole.example: He used a long wooden pole to pull the boat closer to the shore.
pole.exampleZh: 他用一根长木杆把船拉近岸边。

polemic.example: The article started a long polemic between the two famous writers.
polemic.exampleZh: 这篇文章在两位著名作家之间引发了一场旷日持久的论战。

police.example: The police came quickly and helped the lost child find his parents.
police.exampleZh: 警察很快赶来，帮助走失的孩子找到了父母。

policy.example: The company has a clear policy about working from home.
policy.exampleZh: 公司有关于居家办公的明确政策。

polish.example: She helped me polish my essay before I gave it to the teacher.
polish.exampleZh: 她把我的文章交给我之前，帮我润色了文章。

polite.example: She is always polite to her teachers and classmates at school.
polite.exampleZh: 她在学校对老师和同学总是很有礼貌。

political.example: My friends and I often talk about political ideas after class.
political.exampleZh: 我和朋友们常在课后谈论政治理念。

politician.example: The politician promised to improve schools and create more jobs in our city.
politician.exampleZh: 这位政治家承诺改善学校并在我们城市创造更多就业机会。

politicize.example: Some people try to politicize every small problem at school.
politicize.exampleZh: 有些人试图把学校里的每个小问题都政治化。

politics.example: My brother studies politics at university because he wants to help his country.
politics.exampleZh: 我哥哥在大学学习政治学，因为他想帮助自己的国家。

poll.example: The newspaper published a new poll about the coming election.
