poll.exampleZh: 报纸发布了一项关于即将到来的选举的新民意测验。

pollute.example: Factory waste can pollute the river and kill many fish.
pollute.exampleZh: 工厂废料会污染河流，并导致许多鱼死亡。

pollution.example: Air pollution is a big problem in many large cities.
pollution.exampleZh: 空气污染是许多大城市的一大问题。

polymorphous.example: The artist's polymorphous style makes each of her paintings look completely different.
polymorphous.exampleZh: 这位艺术家多变的风格使她的每幅画看起来都完全不同。

pond.example: There are many small fish in the pond behind our house.
pond.exampleZh: 我们家后面的池塘里有很多小鱼。

ponder.example: She sat by the window and pondered her next move.
ponder.exampleZh: 她坐在窗边，沉思着下一步该怎么办。

pool.example: The children swim in the small pool near our house every summer.
pool.exampleZh: 每年夏天，孩子们都会在我们家附近的小水塘里游泳。

poor.example: The poor family lives in a small house near the river.
poor.exampleZh: 这个贫穷的家庭住在河边的一间小房子里。

pop.example: Pop music is very popular with young people in our city.
pop.exampleZh: 流行音乐在我们城市的年轻人中很受欢迎。

popular.example: This song is very popular with young people all over the world.
popular.exampleZh: 这首歌在世界各地的年轻人中非常受欢迎。

population.example: The population of our city has grown quickly in recent years.
population.exampleZh: 我们城市的人口近年来增长得很快。

porch.example: She sat on the front porch and drank a cup of tea.
porch.exampleZh: 她坐在前门廊上喝了一杯茶。

pore.example: Steam can open the pores on your face and help clean your skin.
pore.exampleZh: 蒸汽能打开脸上的毛孔，帮助清洁皮肤。

pork.example: My mother cooked pork with rice for dinner last night.
pork.exampleZh: 昨晚妈妈做了猪肉配米饭当晚餐。

port.example: The ship arrived at the port early this morning.
port.exampleZh: 这艘船今天一早抵达了港口。

portable.example: This small and portable radio is easy to carry anywhere.
portable.exampleZh: 这台小巧便携的收音机很方便随身携带。

portion.example: She ate only a small portion of the cake and saved the rest.
portion.exampleZh: 她只吃了一小部分蛋糕，把剩下的留了下来。

portrait.example: There is a famous portrait of the queen in the museum.
portrait.exampleZh: 博物馆里有一幅著名的女王肖像。

portray.example: The movie portrays a young teacher who changes a small village school.
portray.exampleZh: 这部电影描绘了一位改变乡村小学的年轻教师。

pose.example: She posed for a photo in front of the old church.
pose.exampleZh: 她在那座古老教堂前摆姿势拍照。

posit.example: Scientists posit that the new planet has water under its surface.
posit.exampleZh: 科学家假定这颗新行星的表面之下有水。

position.example: The map shows the exact position of the small island.
position.exampleZh: 地图显示了这座小岛的准确位置。

positive.example: She always keeps a positive attitude when she faces difficult problems at work.
positive.exampleZh: 她在工作中遇到困难问题时总是保持积极的态度。

possess.example: Many young people possess great talent but need more practice.
possess.exampleZh: 许多年轻人拥有很大的天赋，但需要更多练习。

possession.example: His most valuable possession is an old family watch.
possession.exampleZh: 他最珍贵的财产是一块家传旧手表。

possibility.example: There is a real possibility that it will rain this afternoon.
possibility.exampleZh: 今天下午真的有下雨的可能。

possible.example: It is possible to finish this work before Friday.
possible.exampleZh: 在周五之前完成这项工作是可能的。

post.example: She found a new post at a small company near her home.
post.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一家小公司找到了一个新岗位。

postage.example: The postage for this heavy box costs more than the book itself.
postage.exampleZh: 这个重箱子的邮费比书本身还贵。

poster.example: There is a big poster of a movie star on my bedroom wall.
poster.exampleZh: 我卧室的墙上有一张电影明星的大海报。

posterior.example: The posterior part of the brain controls some simple movements.
posterior.exampleZh: 大脑的后部控制一些简单的动作。

posterity.example: Our children and posterity will inherit the world we build today.
posterity.exampleZh: 我们的孩子和后代将继承我们今天所建立的世界。

postmodern.example: The museum shows postmodern art made by young artists from many countries.
postmodern.exampleZh: 这家博物馆展出来自许多国家的年轻艺术家创作的后现代艺术作品。

postpone.example: We had to postpone the meeting because the manager was still sick.
postpone.exampleZh: 我们不得不推迟会议，因为经理还在生病。

postulate.example: Scientists often postulate a simple cause before they test their ideas.
postulate.exampleZh: 科学家常常在验证自己的想法之前先假定一个简单的原因。

pot.example: She put the soup in a large pot on the stove.
pot.exampleZh: 她把汤倒进炉子上的一个大锅里。

potato.example: My mother bought three potatoes and some carrots at the market yesterday.
potato.exampleZh: 我妈妈昨天在市场买了三个土豆和一些胡萝卜。

potent.example: This potent medicine can cure the disease very quickly.
potent.exampleZh: 这种强效的药物能够很快治愈这种疾病。

potential.example: She has great potential to become a strong leader in the future.
potential.exampleZh: 她有成为未来强大领导者的巨大潜力。

potentiality.example: This child has great potentiality for learning new languages.
potentiality.exampleZh: 这个孩子在学习新语言方面有很大的潜力。

pound.example: I bought two pounds of apples for three pounds at the small shop.
pound.exampleZh: 我在那家小商店花三英镑买了两磅苹果。

pour.example: She poured the hot water into the cup slowly.
pour.exampleZh: 她慢慢地把热水倒进杯子里。

poverty.example: Many families in this small village still live in poverty today.
poverty.exampleZh: 这个村子里的许多家庭今天仍然生活在贫困之中。

powder.example: The powder is very fine and white, like the sugar we use for baking.
powder.exampleZh: 这种粉末非常细腻而洁白，就像我们烘焙时用的糖一样。

power.example: The new machine needs a lot of power to run.
power.exampleZh: 这台新机器需要大量电力才能运转。

powerful.example: This small car has a powerful engine and runs very fast.
powerful.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车有一台强劲的发动机，跑得很快。

practical.example: We need a practical plan that everyone can follow easily.
practical.exampleZh: 我们需要一个每个人都能轻松执行的实用计划。

practice.example: Daily practice is the best way to improve your English skills.
practice.exampleZh: 每天练习是提高英语水平的最好方法。

practitioner.example: The young practitioner works in a small clinic near the river.
practitioner.exampleZh: 这位年轻的从业者在河边的一家小诊所工作。

prairie.example: Many wild horses run freely across the wide prairie in summer.
prairie.exampleZh: 夏天，许多野马在广阔的大草原上自由奔跑。

praise.example: My teacher gave me great praise for my hard work.
praise.exampleZh: 老师对我的努力给予了高度赞扬。

praxis.example: Good teachers connect theory with praxis in every lesson they plan.
praxis.exampleZh: 优秀的教师备课时总把理论与实践结合起来。

pray.example: Every night she prays for her family to be safe and happy.
pray.exampleZh: 每天晚上她都祈祷家人平安快乐。

preach.example: My grandfather likes to preach about the value of hard work.
preach.exampleZh: 我祖父喜欢宣扬努力工作的价值。

precarious.example: His job is precarious and he never knows if he will be paid.
precarious.exampleZh: 他的工作很不稳定，他永远不知道会不会拿到工资。

precaution.example: We take every precaution to keep the children safe at school.
precaution.exampleZh: 我们采取一切预防措施，确保孩子在学校的安全。

precede.example: Dark clouds usually precede a heavy storm in summer.
precede.exampleZh: 夏天，乌云通常出现在暴风雨之前。

precedent.example: This court case may set a precedent for future cases like it.
precedent.exampleZh: 这个法庭案件可能会为类似案件创下先例。

precious.example: This old photo is very precious to my family.
precious.exampleZh: 这张老照片对我的家人来说非常珍贵。

precipice.example: He stood at the edge of the precipice and looked down.
precipice.exampleZh: 他站在悬崖边缘向下望去。

precipitate.example: The bad news may precipitate a sharp fall in prices.
precipitate.exampleZh: 这个坏消息可能促成价格大幅下跌。

precise.example: Her answer was so precise that everyone understood it at once.
precise.exampleZh: 她的回答非常精确，大家立刻就明白了。

precision.example: This machine can cut the metal with great precision.
precision.exampleZh: 这台机器能非常精确地切割金属。

preclude.example: Bad weather may preclude us from going out today.
preclude.exampleZh: 恶劣天气可能会妨碍我们今天出门。

predator.example: The lion is a strong predator that hunts smaller animals in the wild.
predator.exampleZh: 狮子是一种强壮的捕食者，在野外捕猎较小的动物。

predecessor.example: My predecessor left many useful notes for me in this office.
predecessor.exampleZh: 我的前任在这个办公室给我留下了许多有用的笔记。

predicament.example: He lost his passport and money, so he was in a real predicament.
predicament.exampleZh: 他丢了护照和钱，因此陷入了真正的困境。

predict.example: Experts predict that the weather will be warmer next week.
predict.exampleZh: 专家预测下周天气会更暖和。

prediction.example: Her prediction about the weather came true, and it rained all weekend.
prediction.exampleZh: 她对天气的预测成真了，整个周末都在下雨。

predictor.example: A good predictor of success is hard work over many years.
predictor.exampleZh: 成功的一个良好预测因素是多年来的努力。

predominant.example: Blue is the predominant color in this small room.
predominant.exampleZh: 蓝色是这个狭小房间里的主色调。

preeminent.example: She is a preeminent scientist in the field of medicine.
preeminent.exampleZh: 她是医学领域一位杰出的科学家。

preempt.example: The company acted early to preempt any criticism from customers.
preempt.exampleZh: 公司提早行动，以先发制人地避免客户的任何批评。

preference.example: My preference is to study in the morning when the house is quiet.
preference.exampleZh: 我更喜欢在早上学习，那时家里很安静。

prejudice.example: We should judge people by their actions, not by prejudice.
prejudice.exampleZh: 我们应该以行动而非成见来评判他人。

preliminary.example: The preliminary results look good, so we will continue the study.
preliminary.exampleZh: 初步结果看起来不错，所以我们将继续这项研究。

premier.example: The premier promised to build more schools for children in small towns.
premier.exampleZh: 总理承诺为小城镇的孩子们建更多的学校。

premise.example: The whole plan rests on the premise that prices will stay low.
premise.exampleZh: 整个计划建立在一个前提之上：价格会保持低位。

premium.example: I pay a small premium each month so my family is safe.
premium.exampleZh: 我每月支付一小笔保险费，这样我的家人就有保障。

preparation.example: Good preparation before the exam helps students feel much calmer.
preparation.exampleZh: 考试前做好充分准备能让学生感到平静得多。

prepare.example: I need to prepare dinner for my family tonight.
prepare.exampleZh: 我今晚需要为家人准备晚饭。

prerequisite.example: Good sleep is a prerequisite for learning well in class.
prerequisite.exampleZh: 充足的睡眠是课堂上好好学习的一个先决条件。

prescribe.example: The doctor will prescribe some medicine for your bad cough.
prescribe.exampleZh: 医生会为你的严重咳嗽开一些药。

prescription.example: The doctor wrote a prescription for my cough and told me to rest.
prescription.exampleZh: 医生给我开了一张治咳嗽的处方，并让我休息。

prescriptive.example: The school has prescriptive rules about how students must dress.
prescriptive.exampleZh: 学校对学生必须如何穿着有明确规定。

presence.example: Her calm presence made everyone in the room feel safe.
presence.exampleZh: 她沉稳的仪态让房间里的每个人都感到安心。

present.example: She is present at the meeting and gives him a small gift.
present.exampleZh: 她出席了会议，并送给他一个小礼物。

presentation.example: Her presentation about the new project was clear and easy to understand.
presentation.exampleZh: 她关于新项目的展示清晰易懂。

preservation.example: The preservation of old buildings is important for our city.
preservation.exampleZh: 保护老建筑对我们的城市很重要。

preserve.example: We must preserve the old trees in our town.
preserve.exampleZh: 我们必须保护我们镇上的老树。

preside.example: The teacher will preside over the meeting in the main hall today.
preside.exampleZh: 老师今天将在大厅里主持这次会议。

president.example: The president of the company will speak to all the workers today.
president.exampleZh: 公司的总裁今天将对所有员工讲话。

press.example: She pressed the button and waited for the door to open.
press.exampleZh: 她按下按钮，等着门打开。

pressure.example: I feel a lot of pressure before every exam at school.
pressure.exampleZh: 每次在学校考试前我都感到很大的压力。

prestige.example: The old school has great prestige in our city.
prestige.exampleZh: 这所老学校在我们城市享有很高的声望。

prestigious.example: She studies at a prestigious university in the north of our country.
prestigious.exampleZh: 她在我国北部一所有声望的大学学习。

presumably.example: He is not here, so he is presumably still at work.
presumably.exampleZh: 他不在这里，所以大概还在上班。

presume.example: I presume you are tired after the long trip.
presume.exampleZh: 我猜你长途旅行后一定累了。

pretend.example: He pretended to be asleep when his mother came into the room.
pretend.exampleZh: 他妈妈走进房间时，他假装睡着了。

pretext.example: He called me at work under the pretext of asking about the meeting.
pretext.exampleZh: 他借口询问会议情况，在我上班时给我打了电话。

pretty.example: She has a pretty garden with many red flowers. The test was pretty easy for most students.
pretty.exampleZh: 她有一个漂亮的、种着许多红花的花园。这次考试对大多数学生来说相当容易。

prevail.example: We hope that common sense will prevail in this difficult situation.
prevail.exampleZh: 我们希望在这种困难的情况下，常识能够占上风。

prevalent.example: Smartphones are prevalent among students today.
prevalent.exampleZh: 如今智能手机在学生中很普遍。

prevent.example: Wash your hands often to prevent yourself from getting sick.
prevent.exampleZh: 经常洗手可以防止你生病。

prevention.example: Good hand washing is important for the prevention of many common diseases.
prevention.exampleZh: 勤洗手对预防许多常见疾病很重要。

previous.example: I met her once before, but I forgot her previous name.
previous.exampleZh: 我以前见过她一次，但我忘了她先前的名字。

prey.example: Lions hunt their prey at night and rest during the day.
prey.exampleZh: 狮子在夜间捕猎猎物，白天休息。

price.example: The price of this red shirt is very low.
price.exampleZh: 这件红衬衫的价格很低。

pride.example: She felt great pride when her students all passed the test.
pride.exampleZh: 当她的学生全部通过考试时，她感到非常自豪。

priest.example: The priest read a short prayer for the family after the meal.
priest.exampleZh: 饭后，神父为这家人念了一段简短的祷文。

primal.example: Our primal fear of the dark is very old and common.
primal.exampleZh: 我们对黑暗的原始恐惧非常古老而普遍。

primarily.example: This book is primarily for students who want to learn English quickly.
primarily.exampleZh: 这本书主要是为想快速学英语的学生写的。

primary.example: This is the primary reason why I want to learn English well.
primary.exampleZh: 这就是我想学好英语的主要原因。

prime.example: Safety is our prime concern when we build any new road.
prime.exampleZh: 修建任何新道路时，安全都是我们首要关注的问题。

primitive.example: Their tools were primitive but strong enough to cut wood.
primitive.exampleZh: 他们的工具很简陋，但足以砍木头。

primordial.example: The forest still holds a primordial calm that modern cities have long lost.
primordial.exampleZh: 这片森林仍保留着一种原始宁静，现代城市早已失去。

principal.example: The principal of our school spoke to the students about the new rules.
principal.exampleZh: 我们学校的校长向学生们讲述了新规定。

principally.example: The money was used principally to build new schools in the village.
principally.exampleZh: 这笔钱主要用来在村里建新学校。

principle.example: Honesty is an important principle in our daily life.
principle.exampleZh: 诚实是我们日常生活中一条重要的原则。

print.example: She likes to print her photos at home on weekends.
print.exampleZh: 她喜欢在周末在家打印照片。

prior.example: She had no prior experience in teaching before she joined our small school.
prior.exampleZh: 她在加入我们这所小学校之前没有教学经验。

priority.example: Learning English is my top priority this year because I need it for work.
priority.exampleZh: 今年学好英语是我的首要任务，因为工作需要用到它。

prison.example: The man was sent to prison for stealing a car last year.
prison.exampleZh: 那个男人去年因偷车被送进了监狱。

private.example: This is a private school, so students pay for their own classes.
private.exampleZh: 这是一所私立学校，所以学生需要自己支付课程费用。

privation.example: The family lived in great privation after the father lost his job.
privation.exampleZh: 父亲失业后，这家人生活极度贫困。

privilege.example: It is a great privilege to work with such kind and helpful people.
privilege.exampleZh: 能和这样友善又乐于助人的人一起工作，是一种莫大的荣幸。

privy.example: Only the manager and I were privy to the details of the new plan.
privy.exampleZh: 只有经理和我知晓新计划的细节。

prize.example: She won first prize in the school singing contest last year.
prize.exampleZh: 她在去年的学校歌唱比赛中获得了一等奖。

probability.example: There is a high probability that it will rain tomorrow.
probability.exampleZh: 明天有很大的概率会下雨。

probable.example: It is probable that it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
probable.exampleZh: 明天下午很可能会下雨。

probate.example: The lawyer said the will must go through probate before the family gets anything.
probate.exampleZh: 律师说，这份遗嘱必须先经过遗嘱认证，家人才能得到任何东西。

probe.example: The doctor used a small probe to check the wound, then probed it again.
probe.exampleZh: 医生用一个小探测器检查伤口，然后又探查了一次。

probity.example: His probity in handling the money made everyone trust him.
probity.exampleZh: 他处理钱财时的正直让每个人都信任他。

problem.example: We must find a way to solve this problem today.
problem.exampleZh: 我们必须找到今天解决这个问题的办法。

procedural.example: The judge said the mistake was procedural and did not change the final result.
procedural.exampleZh: 法官说这个错误是程序上的，并没有改变最终结果。

procedure.example: Please follow the correct procedure before you start the new test.
procedure.exampleZh: 在开始新测试之前，请遵循正确的程序。

proceed.example: After a short break, we will proceed with the meeting.
proceed.exampleZh: 短暂休息后，我们将继续进行会议。

proceeds.example: She gave all the proceeds from the concert to a local school.
proceeds.exampleZh: 她把音乐会的全部收益都捐给了一所当地学校。

process.example: Learning a new language is a slow process that needs daily practice.
process.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言是一个需要每天练习的缓慢过程。

proclaim.example: The new king will proclaim his plans to the people tomorrow.
proclaim.exampleZh: 新国王明天将向人民宣布他的计划。

proclamation.example: The king sent a proclamation to every town in the country.
proclamation.exampleZh: 国王向全国每个城镇都发布了公告。

proclivity.example: He has a proclivity for staying up late and reading novels.
proclivity.exampleZh: 他有熬夜看小说的癖性。

procrastinate.example: I always procrastinate when I have to study for a difficult exam.
procrastinate.exampleZh: 每当我要为一场难考的考试复习时，我总是拖延。

procrastination.example: Her procrastination made her miss the deadline again.
procrastination.exampleZh: 她的拖延让她再次错过了截止日期。

prod.example: The farmer prodded the cow with a stick to make it walk.
prod.exampleZh: 农夫用棍子戳了戳那头牛，让它往前走。

prodigy.example: The young girl was a prodigy who could play the piano beautifully.
prodigy.exampleZh: 那个小女孩是个天才，钢琴弹得非常优美。

produce.example: The factory can produce many cheap toys for children.
produce.exampleZh: 这家工厂能为孩子们生产许多便宜的玩具。

product.example: This new product is very popular with young people.
product.exampleZh: 这款新产品很受年轻人欢迎。

production.example: The factory increased its production of cars last year.
production.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年提高了汽车的产量。

productive.example: A short break can make your afternoon more productive.
productive.exampleZh: 短暂休息能让你的下午更富有成效。

productivity.example: Good sleep can improve your productivity at work and school.
productivity.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠能提高你在工作和学习中的效率。

profane.example: They said the old church had been turned into a profane place for parties.
profane.exampleZh: 他们说那座古老的教堂已经变成了一个供人聚会的世俗场所。

profanity.example: The teacher told him not to use profanity in class.
profanity.exampleZh: 老师告诉他不要在课堂上说脏话。

profess.example: Many people profess to care about the environment but rarely change their daily habits.
profess.exampleZh: 许多人声称关心环境，却很少改变日常习惯。

profession.example: Teaching is a profession that requires patience and a real love for children.
profession.exampleZh: 教学是一门需要耐心和对孩子真正关爱的职业。

professional.example: She is a professional nurse and she works in a big hospital.
professional.exampleZh: 她是一名专业护士，在一家大医院工作。

professor.example: My professor is very kind and often helps us after class.
professor.exampleZh: 我的教授很和蔼，经常在课后帮助我们。

proffer.example: She proffered her hand to the new student with a warm smile.
proffer.exampleZh: 她面带温暖的微笑，向新同学伸出了手。

proficiency.example: She showed great proficiency in English after years of study.
proficiency.exampleZh: 经过多年的学习，她展现出很高的英语熟练度。

proficient.example: She is proficient in English and often helps her friends with their homework.
proficient.exampleZh: 她精通英语，经常帮助朋友们做作业。

profile.example: The profile of the mountain looked clear against the morning sky.
profile.exampleZh: 那座山的轮廓在清晨的天空下显得很清晰。

profit.example: The small shop makes a good profit every month.
profit.exampleZh: 这家小店每个月都能获得不错的利润。

profitable.example: This small shop is very profitable because many people buy food there every day.
profitable.exampleZh: 这家小店很赚钱，因为每天有很多人在那里买食物。

profligate.example: His profligate spending on cars left him with no money at all.
profligate.exampleZh: 他在汽车上挥霍无度的花销让他最后一分钱都没有了。

profound.example: The old teacher had a profound effect on all his students.
profound.exampleZh: 这位老教师对所有学生都产生了深远的影响。

progeny.example: The old farmer hoped his progeny would take care of the land.
progeny.exampleZh: 这位老农夫希望他的后代能照料这片土地。

prognosis.example: The doctor gave a good prognosis for my grandfather after the surgery.
prognosis.exampleZh: 手术后，医生对我祖父的病情给出了良好的预后。

prognostication.example: His prognostication about the weather turned out to be wrong again.
prognostication.exampleZh: 他对天气的预测又一次错了。

program.example: My favorite program on TV starts at eight every Friday night.
program.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的电视节目每周五晚上八点开始。

progress.example: She has made great progress in English this year.
progress.exampleZh: 她今年在英语方面取得了很大的进步。

progressive.example: The school uses a progressive way to teach young children every day.
progressive.exampleZh: 这所学校每天用渐进的方式教育年幼的孩子。

prohibit.example: The school prohibits students from using phones during class.
prohibit.exampleZh: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。

project.example: Our team will start a new project next month and finish it by June.
project.exampleZh: 我们团队下个月将启动一个新项目，并在六月前完成。

projectile.example: The soldier watched the projectile fly through the air and hit the wall.
projectile.exampleZh: 士兵看着弹丸在空中飞过，击中了墙。

projection.example: Sales projections for next year look much better than before.
projection.exampleZh: 明年的销售预测看起来比之前好得多。

proletarian.example: The proletarian workers in the factory asked for better pay and shorter hours.
proletarian.exampleZh: 工厂里的无产者工人要求提高工资并缩短工时。

proletariat.example: The proletariat worked long hours in the factories for very low pay.
proletariat.exampleZh: 无产阶级在工厂里长时间工作，工资却非常低。

proliferate.example: Fake news can proliferate quickly on social media today.
proliferate.exampleZh: 如今虚假新闻会在社交媒体上迅速扩散。

proliferation.example: The rapid proliferation of cheap phones changed daily life in many poorer countries.
proliferation.exampleZh: 廉价手机的迅速普及改变了许多较贫穷国家的日常生活。

prologue.example: The prologue of the book explains how the story began long ago.
prologue.exampleZh: 这本书的序言讲述了故事很久以前是如何开始的。

prolong.example: They decided to prolong the meeting because many questions were left.
prolong.exampleZh: 他们决定延长会议，因为还有许多问题没有解决。

prominent.example: She is a prominent scientist at our university.
prominent.exampleZh: 她是我们大学一位著名的科学家。

promise.example: I promise I will call you after work tonight.
promise.exampleZh: 我保证今晚下班后给你打电话。

promising.example: The young doctor is a promising researcher in our hospital.
promising.exampleZh: 这位年轻医生是我们医院一位有前途的研究者。

promontory.example: We walked to the promontory to watch the sun go down over the sea.
promontory.exampleZh: 我们走到海角上，看太阳在海上落下。

promote.example: Good teachers often promote group work in class to help students learn faster.
promote.exampleZh: 好老师常常在课堂上推动小组合作，帮助学生学得更快。

prompt.example: The question was a prompt for a long talk.
prompt.exampleZh: 这个问题促发了一场长时间的讨论。

promulgate.example: The government will promulgate the new law next month.
promulgate.exampleZh: 政府将在下个月颁布这项新法律。

prone.example: He is prone to make mistakes when he works too fast.
prone.exampleZh: 他工作太快时容易出错。

pronoun.example: A pronoun can replace a noun in a sentence to make it shorter.
pronoun.exampleZh: 代词可以在句子中代替名词，使句子更简短。

pronounce.example: Many students cannot pronounce this long word correctly at first.
pronounce.exampleZh: 许多学生一开始无法正确发音这个长单词。

proof.example: The police found no proof that he took the money.
proof.exampleZh: 警方没有找到他拿走了那笔钱的证据。

propaganda.example: The government used propaganda to make people believe the false news.
propaganda.exampleZh: 政府利用宣传让人们相信那条假消息。

propagate.example: We can propagate these plants easily by cutting their stems.
propagate.exampleZh: 我们可以通过剪下茎来轻松繁殖这些植物。

propel.example: The strong wind helped propel the small boat across the lake.
propel.exampleZh: 大风帮助推动小船穿过湖面。

propensity.example: She has a propensity to talk too much when she is nervous.
propensity.exampleZh: 她紧张时有一种话太多的倾向。

proper.example: It is proper to say thank you when someone helps you.
proper.exampleZh: 当别人帮助你时，说声谢谢是适当的。

property.example: Water has many special properties that make it important for life.
property.exampleZh: 水具有许多特殊的性质，这些性质使它对生命很重要。

prophecy.example: The old woman's prophecy about the flood came true years later.
prophecy.exampleZh: 那位老妇人关于洪水的预言多年后应验了。

prophet.example: The old prophet said the rain would come soon.
prophet.exampleZh: 那位年老的先知说雨很快就会来。

prophetic.example: The old man's prophetic words came true many years later.
prophetic.exampleZh: 那位老人预言般的话语在多年后成真了。

propinquity.example: The propinquity of the two small houses made the neighbors close friends.
propinquity.exampleZh: 这两栋小房子的邻近让邻居们成了好朋友。

propitiate.example: She tried to propitiate her angry boss with a sincere apology.
propitiate.exampleZh: 她试图用真诚的道歉来抚慰生气的老板。

propitious.example: The clear sky was a propitious sign for our long journey.
propitious.exampleZh: 晴朗的天空是我们长途旅行的吉祥征兆。

proponent.example: She is a strong proponent of healthy eating for children.
proponent.exampleZh: 她是儿童健康饮食的坚定倡导者。

proportion.example: A large proportion of the students walk to school every day.
proportion.exampleZh: 很大一部分学生每天步行上学。

proposal.example: She accepted his proposal to meet again next week.
proposal.exampleZh: 她接受了他下周再见面一次的提议。

propose.example: I propose that we meet tomorrow morning to discuss the plan.
propose.exampleZh: 我建议我们明天上午见面讨论这个计划。

proposition.example: She explained her proposition to the group in simple words.
proposition.exampleZh: 她用简单的语言向大家解释了自己的主张。

proprietary.example: The company keeps its proprietary software secret and does not share the code.
proprietary.exampleZh: 这家公司对其专有软件保密，不共享代码。

proprietor.example: The proprietor of the small shop knows all his customers by name.
proprietor.exampleZh: 这家小商店的业主认识所有顾客的名字。

propriety.example: He always behaves with propriety when he visits his grandparents.
propriety.exampleZh: 他去看望祖父母时总是举止得体。

propulsion.example: The rocket uses strong propulsion to lift off the ground.
propulsion.exampleZh: 火箭利用强大的推进力升离地面。

prosaic.example: The movie was prosaic and did not excite the children.
prosaic.exampleZh: 这部电影平淡乏味，没有让孩子们感到兴奋。

proscribe.example: The new law proscribes the sale of these dangerous chemicals.
proscribe.exampleZh: 新法律禁止销售这些危险化学品。

prose.example: She likes to read prose before going to sleep at night.
prose.exampleZh: 她喜欢在晚上睡觉前读散文。

prosecute.example: The police decided to prosecute him for stealing money from the shop.
prosecute.exampleZh: 警方决定以从商店偷钱的罪名起诉他。

proselytize.example: He tried to proselytize his friends at school but they ignored him.
proselytize.exampleZh: 他试图在学校劝诱朋友们改宗，但他们没有理他。

prosody.example: In poetry class, we learned how prosody shapes the rhythm of a poem.
prosody.exampleZh: 在诗歌课上，我们学习了韵律学如何塑造诗歌的节奏。

prospect.example: The prospect of a better job makes him study harder every day.
prospect.exampleZh: 找到更好工作的前景让他每天更努力地学习。

prospectus.example: The company sent me a prospectus before I decided to buy its shares.
prospectus.exampleZh: 在我决定购买该公司股票之前，它给我寄了一份招股说明书。

prosper.example: Small shops can prosper when the whole town works together.
prosper.exampleZh: 当全镇齐心协力时，小商铺就能繁荣起来。

prosperity.example: The whole town enjoyed years of peace and prosperity after the new factory opened.
prosperity.exampleZh: 新工厂开业后，整个小镇享受了多年的和平与繁荣。

protect.example: Parents should protect their children from danger when they are young.
protect.exampleZh: 父母应该在孩子年幼时保护他们免受危险。

protectionism.example: Many people believe protectionism makes goods more expensive for ordinary families.
protectionism.exampleZh: 许多人认为保护主义会让普通家庭的商品变得更贵。

protege.example: The old professor treated the young man as his protege for many years.
protege.exampleZh: 这位老教授多年来一直把那个年轻人当作自己的门生。

protein.example: You need to eat more protein if you want to build strong muscles.
protein.exampleZh: 如果你想练出强壮的肌肉，就需要多吃蛋白质。

protest.example: Many students protested against the new school rules last week.
protest.exampleZh: 许多学生上周抗议学校的新规定。

protocol.example: Both sides agreed to follow the protocol during the meeting.
protocol.exampleZh: 双方同意在会议期间遵守该协议。

protracted.example: The protracted meeting lasted three hours and made everyone very tired.
protracted.exampleZh: 这场拖延的会议持续了三个小时，让每个人都感到很累。

proud.example: My parents are very proud of me because I work hard.
proud.exampleZh: 我的父母为我感到非常自豪，因为我工作努力。

prove.example: Can you prove that you were at home last night?
prove.exampleZh: 你能证明昨晚你在家吗？

provide.example: The school will provide free books to all new students this year.
provide.exampleZh: 学校今年将向所有新生免费提供书籍。

provident.example: A provident family saves money for hard times.
provident.exampleZh: 一个节俭的家庭会为困难时期存钱。

province.example: She grew up in a small province in the south of China.
province.exampleZh: 她在中国南方的一个小省份长大。

provincial.example: His provincial accent made it hard for city people to understand him.
provincial.exampleZh: 他的地方口音让城里人很难听懂他说话。

provision.example: The school makes provision for students who need extra help.
provision.exampleZh: 学校为需要额外帮助的学生做好了准备。

provisional.example: We made a provisional plan for the trip but may change it later.
provisional.exampleZh: 我们为这次旅行制定了一个临时的计划，但之后可能会改变。

proviso.example: He agreed to help, with the proviso that he could leave early.
proviso.exampleZh: 他同意帮忙，但附有一个条件：他可以提前离开。

provocative.example: His provocative question made everyone in the room feel uncomfortable.
provocative.exampleZh: 他那挑衅性的问题让房间里的每个人都感到不舒服。

provoke.example: His rude words provoked her, and she walked out of the room.
provoke.exampleZh: 他粗鲁的话激怒了她，她便走出了房间。

prowess.example: Her prowess in chess made her famous in our small town.
prowess.exampleZh: 她在国际象棋方面的高超技艺让她在我们小镇出了名。

proximity.example: The hotel's proximity to the train station makes it very convenient.
proximity.exampleZh: 这家酒店邻近火车站，出行非常方便。

proxy.example: She sent her brother as a proxy to the meeting.
proxy.exampleZh: 她派她的弟弟作为代理人去参加会议。

prude.example: My sister is such a prude that she turns red at any silly joke.
prude.exampleZh: 我妹妹太拘谨了，听到任何无聊的玩笑都会脸红。

prudent.example: It is prudent to save some money for a rainy day.
prudent.exampleZh: 存一些钱以备不时之需是谨慎的。

pseudonym.example: The famous writer used a pseudonym so that no one would know his real name.
pseudonym.exampleZh: 这位著名作家使用了一个笔名，这样就没有人会知道他的真实姓名。

psyche.example: The doctor tried to understand the patient's psyche before treating the illness.
psyche.exampleZh: 医生在治疗疾病之前试图了解病人的心理。

psychiatrist.example: The psychiatrist talked with the young man for an hour and helped him feel calm.
psychiatrist.exampleZh: 精神科医生和那个年轻人谈了一个小时，帮助他平静下来。

psychiatry.example: She decided to study psychiatry because she wanted to help people with mental illness.
psychiatry.exampleZh: 她决定学习精神病学，因为她想帮助患有精神疾病的人。

psychoanalysis.example: She studied psychoanalysis for many years and now works with young children.
psychoanalysis.exampleZh: 她研究精神分析多年，现在从事幼儿相关工作。

psycholinguistics.example: She studies psycholinguistics to understand how children learn their first language.
psycholinguistics.exampleZh: 她研究心理语言学，以了解儿童是如何学会母语的。

psychological.example: Stress can have a serious psychological effect on young children.
psychological.exampleZh: 压力会对幼儿产生严重的心理影响。

psychologist.example: The psychologist asked me many questions about my sleep and my worries.
psychologist.exampleZh: 心理学家问了我很多关于睡眠和烦恼的问题。

psychology.example: She wants to study psychology because she is interested in how people think.
psychology.exampleZh: 她想学心理学，因为她对人的思维方式很感兴趣。

psychosis.example: The doctor said his psychosis needed long and careful treatment.
psychosis.exampleZh: 医生说他的精神病需要长期细心的治疗。

psychosomatic.example: His stomach pain was psychosomatic, caused by stress rather than illness.
psychosomatic.exampleZh: 他的胃痛是心身性的，源于压力而非疾病。

psychotropic.example: The doctor said psychotropic drugs can change a person's mood and sleep.
psychotropic.exampleZh: 医生说影响精神的药物会改变一个人的情绪和睡眠。

pub.example: We met some friends at a small pub near the river last night.
pub.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在河边一家小酒吧见了几位朋友。

puberty.example: During puberty, many children grow taller and their voices change.
puberty.exampleZh: 在青春期，许多孩子会长高，声音也会变化。

public.example: The public can use this park every day for free.
public.exampleZh: 公众每天可以免费使用这个公园。

publican.example: The publican smiled and brought us two cold drinks after work.
publican.exampleZh: 那个酒馆老板微笑着，在下班后给我们端来两杯冷饮。

publication.example: The publication of her first book made her very happy.
publication.exampleZh: 她第一本书的出版让她非常开心。

publicist.example: The publicist helped the young actor talk to many newspapers and TV shows.
publicist.exampleZh: 公关人员帮助这位年轻演员与许多报纸和电视节目交流。

publicity.example: The new film received a lot of publicity before it came out.
publicity.exampleZh: 这部新电影在上映前获得了大量宣传。

publicize.example: The school will publicize the concert dates on its website next week.
publicize.exampleZh: 学校下周将在其网站上宣传音乐会的日期。

publish.example: The writer will publish his new book next month.
publish.exampleZh: 这位作家下个月将出版他的新书。

pueblo.example: We visited an old pueblo where Native American families lived for many years.
pueblo.exampleZh: 我们参观了一座古老的普韦布洛村落，美洲原住民家庭在那里生活了很多年。

puff.example: She took a deep puff of fresh air and smiled at the morning sun.
puff.exampleZh: 她深吸了一口新鲜空气，对着晨阳微笑。

pugnacious.example: The pugnacious little dog barked at every stranger who walked past our gate.
pugnacious.exampleZh: 那只好斗的小狗对每个从我们门前走过的人吠叫。

puissance.example: The old king showed great puissance in every battle he fought.
puissance.exampleZh: 这位年老的国王在他参加的每一场战斗中都展现出强大的威力。

pulchritude.example: The garden's pulchritude made everyone stop and smile on a sunny morning.
pulchritude.exampleZh: 花园的美丽让每个人在晴朗的早晨停下脚步微笑。

pull.example: Please pull the heavy box over here so we can open it.
pull.exampleZh: 请把那个沉重的箱子拉到这边来，这样我们就能打开它了。

pulp.example: The orange has sweet pulp that children like to eat.
pulp.exampleZh: 橙子有甜甜的果肉，孩子们喜欢吃。

pulsar.example: A pulsar sends regular radio signals that scientists can detect from Earth.
pulsar.exampleZh: 脉冲星发出规律的射电信号，科学家可以从地球上探测到。

pulse.example: The nurse checked his pulse and said it was normal.
pulse.exampleZh: 护士检查了他的脉搏，说一切正常。

pumice.example: The rough pumice stone can smooth dry skin on your feet.
pumice.exampleZh: 粗糙的浮石可以磨平你脚上的干皮。

pump.example: The workers used a pump to move water out of the old well.
pump.exampleZh: 工人们用泵把水从旧井里抽出来。

punch.example: He gave the wall a hard punch and hurt his hand.
punch.exampleZh: 他用力猛击墙壁，伤到了自己的手。

punctual.example: She is always punctual and never arrives late for work.
punctual.exampleZh: 她总是很守时，上班从不迟到。

pungent.example: The pungent smell of onions made my eyes water.
pungent.exampleZh: 洋葱的辛辣气味让我的眼睛流泪。

punish.example: The teacher will punish students who break the classroom rules.
punish.exampleZh: 老师会惩罚违反课堂规则的学生。

punishment.example: The teacher gave him a punishment for being late to class again.
punishment.exampleZh: 老师因为他再次上课迟到而处罚了他。

punitive.example: The judge gave him a punitive fine for breaking the rules.
punitive.exampleZh: 法官因他违反规则而判他惩罚性罚款。

puny.example: The small boy felt puny next to the tall basketball players.
puny.exampleZh: 那个小男孩站在高大的篮球运动员旁边，觉得自己很弱小。

pupate.example: The caterpillars will pupate in the soil after they stop eating.
pupate.exampleZh: 毛毛虫停止进食后会在土壤中化蛹。

pupil.example: The pupil asked her teacher a simple question after class.
pupil.exampleZh: 这个学生下课后问了老师一个简单的问题。

puppet.example: The little boy played with a puppet on his hand all morning.
puppet.exampleZh: 小男孩整个上午都在玩手上的木偶。

puppetry.example: The children enjoyed a clever puppetry show at the local school last Friday.
puppetry.exampleZh: 孩子们上周五在当地学校欣赏了一场巧妙的木偶戏表演。

purblind.example: The purblind old man did not see the car coming near him.
purblind.exampleZh: 那位半盲的老人没有看到汽车正朝他驶来。

purchase.example: I need to purchase a new computer for my online classes this year.
purchase.exampleZh: 今年我需要为我的在线课程购买一台新电脑。

pure.example: She drank a glass of pure water after her long run.
pure.exampleZh: 长跑后她喝了一杯纯净水。

purify.example: They use a simple machine to purify the water in their home.
purify.exampleZh: 他们用一台简单的机器来净化家里的水。

purple.example: She wore a purple dress to the party last night.
purple.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条紫色连衣裙去参加聚会。

purport.example: The letter purports to explain the new rules in simple terms.
purport.exampleZh: 这封信声称要用简单的语言解释新规则。

purpose.example: The purpose of this meeting is to plan our next project.
purpose.exampleZh: 这次会议的目的是规划我们的下一个项目。

purposeful.example: She made a purposeful plan and worked hard to finish it.
purposeful.exampleZh: 她制定了一个有目的的计划，并努力完成它。

purr.example: The happy cat began to purr softly while it sat on my lap.
purr.exampleZh: 那只开心的猫坐在我腿上时开始轻轻地发出呼噜声。

purse.example: She put her keys and phone into her small black purse before leaving home.
purse.exampleZh: 她出门前把钥匙和手机放进了她的小黑钱包里。

pursue.example: She decided to pursue her dream of becoming a doctor.
pursue.exampleZh: 她决定追求成为医生的梦想。

pursuit.example: Her pursuit of happiness keeps her busy every single day.
pursuit.exampleZh: 她对幸福的追求让她每天都忙忙碌碌。

pus.example: The doctor cleaned the wound because pus was coming out of it.
pus.exampleZh: 医生清理了伤口，因为有脓从里面流出来。

push.example: Please push the door open and come into the room.
push.exampleZh: 请把门推开，然后进房间。

put.example: Please put your books on the desk before you leave.
put.exampleZh: 请在离开前把你的书放在桌子上。

putative.example: The putative leader of the group has not yet spoken to the police.
putative.exampleZh: 该团体推定的领导人尚未与警方交谈。

putrefy.example: If the meat is left outside, it will putrefy in the heat.
putrefy.exampleZh: 如果肉放在外面，它会在高温下腐烂。

putrid.example: The putrid smell from the old trash can made everyone leave the room.
putrid.exampleZh: 旧垃圾桶散发的恶臭让每个人都离开了房间。

puzzle.example: The missing piece of the puzzle made the whole problem harder.
puzzle.exampleZh: 拼图缺失的那一块让整个问题变得更难。

pygmy.example: The small boy was called a pygmy by his teasing classmates.
pygmy.exampleZh: 那个小男孩被爱取笑的同学称为侏儒。

pyramid.example: The pyramid in Egypt is very old and many people visit it.
pyramid.exampleZh: 埃及的金字塔非常古老，许多人去参观它。

pyromania.example: The doctor said his pyromania made him start fires on purpose.
pyromania.exampleZh: 医生说他的纵火狂使他故意放火。

python.example: A large python can swallow a whole chicken in one meal.
python.exampleZh: 一条大蟒蛇能在一餐中吞下整只鸡。

quack.example: The old quack sold useless pills to everyone in our small town.
quack.exampleZh: 那个老庸医向我们小镇上的每个人出售无用的药丸。

quadrangle.example: The students sat in the quadrangle and talked after their morning classes.
quadrangle.exampleZh: 学生们早上上课后坐在四方庭院里聊天。

quadrant.example: The top right quadrant of the chart shows a steady rise in sales.
quadrant.exampleZh: 图表的右上象限显示销售额稳步上升。

quadrennial.example: The quadrennial election gives people a chance to choose new leaders.
quadrennial.exampleZh: 四年一次的选举给人们一个选择新领导人的机会。

quadriceps.example: The quadriceps help you straighten your knee when you walk or run.
quadriceps.exampleZh: 股四头肌帮助你在走路或跑步时伸直膝盖。

quadriplegia.example: After the accident, he lived with quadriplegia and needed help every day.
quadriplegia.exampleZh: 事故之后，他因四肢瘫痪生活，每天都需要帮助。

quadruped.example: A horse is a strong quadruped that can run very fast.
quadruped.exampleZh: 马是一种强壮的四足动物，能跑得很快。

quadruple.example: The company plans to quadruple its sales in the next five years.
quadruple.exampleZh: 公司计划在未来五年内使销售额增至四倍。

quaff.example: At the party, he quaffed a cold drink after the long game.
quaff.exampleZh: 聚会上，他在漫长的比赛后痛饮了一杯冷饮。

quagmire.example: The heavy rain turned the road into a quagmire that trapped our car.
quagmire.exampleZh: 大雨把道路变成了困住我们汽车的泥潭。

quail.example: The little boy quailed when he saw the big angry dog.
quail.exampleZh: 小男孩看到那只又大又凶的狗时畏缩了。

quaint.example: We stayed in a quaint little hotel near the old town square.
quaint.exampleZh: 我们住在老城广场附近一家古雅的小旅馆里。

quake.example: The ground began to quake and the people ran out of their homes.
quake.exampleZh: 地面开始震动，人们跑出了自己的家。

qualification.example: She has the right qualifications for this job.
qualification.exampleZh: 她具备这份工作所需的资格。

qualified.example: She is qualified to teach English at the local high school.
qualified.exampleZh: 她有资格在当地高中教英语。

qualify.example: She must study hard to qualify for the final exam next week.
qualify.exampleZh: 她必须努力学习才能获得下周期末考试的资格。

qualitative.example: The study gives a qualitative picture of how people feel about the new park.
qualitative.exampleZh: 这项研究定性地描绘了人们对新公园的感受。

quality.example: The quality of the food here is very good.
quality.exampleZh: 这里的食物质量非常好。

qualm.example: He had no qualm about telling the truth to his friend.
qualm.exampleZh: 他对向朋友说实话毫无疑虑。

qualmish.example: She felt qualmish about the plan but still said yes.
qualmish.exampleZh: 她对那个计划感到疑虑，但还是答应了。

quandary.example: I was in a quandary about which bus to take to work today.
quandary.exampleZh: 我今天为上班该坐哪路公交车而进退两难。

quantify.example: It is hard to quantify how much time we save each day.
quantify.exampleZh: 我们很难量化每天节省了多少时间。

quantitative.example: The researchers collected quantitative data to compare the two groups clearly.
quantitative.exampleZh: 研究人员收集了定量数据，以清晰地比较这两个组。

quantity.example: The store has a large quantity of fresh apples today.
quantity.exampleZh: 这家商店今天有大量新鲜苹果。

quantum.example: The scientist studied a quantum of light in the lab today.
quantum.exampleZh: 科学家今天在实验室里研究了一个光量子。

quarantine.example: The doctor said we must stay in quarantine for two weeks.
quarantine.exampleZh: 医生说我们必须隔离两周。

quark.example: A quark is a very small particle that makes up protons and neutrons.
quark.exampleZh: 夸克是一种非常小的粒子，构成质子和中子。

quarrel.example: They had a quarrel about money, but they made up soon.
quarrel.exampleZh: 他们为了钱吵了一架，但很快就和好了。

quarry.example: The old quarry is now a deep lake near our town.
quarry.exampleZh: 那个旧采石场现在是我们镇附近的一个深湖。

quarter.example: She saved a quarter of her salary every month for a new bike.
quarter.exampleZh: 她每个月把四分之一的工资存起来买一辆新自行车。

quarterly.example: The company publishes a quarterly report and shares it with all its staff.
quarterly.exampleZh: 公司发布季度报告，并与全体员工分享。

quartz.example: This clear quartz is very hard and can cut glass.
quartz.exampleZh: 这种透明石英非常坚硬，可以切割玻璃。

quash.example: The judge decided to quash the unfair ruling after hearing new evidence.
quash.exampleZh: 法官在听取新证据后决定撤销这一不公正的裁决。

quasi.example: The quasi scientist made claims that were not supported by any real evidence.
quasi.exampleZh: 这位准科学家提出的说法没有任何真实证据支持。

quay.example: We walked along the quay and watched the small boats come in.
quay.exampleZh: 我们沿着码头散步，看着小船驶进来。

queasy.example: The boat was rocking so much that I felt queasy.
queasy.exampleZh: 船晃动得很厉害，我感到恶心。

queen.example: The queen lives in a big palace with her family.
queen.exampleZh: 女王和她的家人住在一座大宫殿里。

queenly.example: She gave a queenly smile to everyone in the room.
queenly.exampleZh: 她向房间里的每个人投以女王般的微笑。

queer.example: There was a queer smell in the room, so we opened the window.
queer.exampleZh: 房间里有一股奇怪的气味，所以我们打开了窗户。

quell.example: The police moved quickly to quell the small protest before it grew.
quell.exampleZh: 警察迅速采取行动，在小规模抗议扩大前将其平息。

quench.example: A glass of cold water can quench your thirst on a hot day.
quench.exampleZh: 一杯冷水能在炎热的日子里解渴。

quenchless.example: Her quenchless curiosity made her ask questions all day long.
quenchless.exampleZh: 她那不可抑制的好奇心让她整天问问题。

querulous.example: The querulous old man complained about the food and the noisy neighbors.
querulous.exampleZh: 那个爱抱怨的老人抱怨食物和吵闹的邻居。

query.example: I have a query about the new schedule for next week.
query.exampleZh: 我对下周的新日程有一个疑问。

question.example: I have a question about the homework for tomorrow.
question.exampleZh: 关于明天的作业我有个问题。

questionable.example: The safety of that old building is questionable, so we stay outside.
questionable.exampleZh: 那座旧建筑的安全性很可疑，所以我们待在外面。

queue.example: We had to queue for a long time to buy tickets.
queue.exampleZh: 我们不得不排了很久的队才买到票。

quibble.example: They wasted the whole meeting to quibble about a tiny detail.
quibble.exampleZh: 他们浪费了整个会议来为一个小细节吹毛求疵。

quick.example: The quick rabbit ran across the field before we could catch it.
quick.exampleZh: 那只敏捷的兔子在我们抓住它之前跑过了田野。

quickly.example: She finished her homework quickly and then went out to play with her friends.
quickly.exampleZh: 她很快做完作业，然后出去和朋友们玩。

quiescent.example: The old machine stayed quiescent for years before someone finally started it again.
quiescent.exampleZh: 那台旧机器多年保持静止，直到终于有人再次启动它。

quiet.example: The library is very quiet, so we can read books in peace.
quiet.exampleZh: 图书馆很安静，所以我们可以安静地读书。

quietly.example: She quietly closed the door so she would not wake the baby.
quietly.exampleZh: 她悄悄地关上门，以免吵醒婴儿。

quietude.example: The quietude of the early morning helped me think clearly.
quietude.exampleZh: 清晨的宁静帮助我清楚地思考。

quill.example: The writer dipped his quill into the ink and began to write.
quill.exampleZh: 作家把羽毛笔蘸进墨水，开始写作。

quilt.example: She pulled the warm quilt up to her chin and fell asleep quickly.
quilt.exampleZh: 她把温暖的被子拉到下巴，很快就睡着了。

quilted.example: She wore a quilted jacket on the cold winter morning.
quilted.exampleZh: 她在寒冷的冬日早晨穿了一件绗缝夹克。

quinine.example: The doctor gave him quinine to treat his malaria.
quinine.exampleZh: 医生给他奎宁来治疗疟疾。

quinquennial.example: The town holds a quinquennial fair that brings many visitors every five years.
quinquennial.exampleZh: 这个小镇每五年举办一次集市，吸引许多游客。

quintessence.example: Her calm smile is the quintessence of grace and quiet strength.
quintessence.exampleZh: 她平静的微笑是优雅与安静力量的典范。

quintessential.example: This small cafe is the quintessential example of a friendly neighborhood restaurant.
quintessential.exampleZh: 这家小咖啡馆是友好社区餐馆的典型例子。

quintet.example: The jazz quintet played a short song at the small club last night.
quintet.exampleZh: 这支爵士五重奏昨晚在小俱乐部演奏了一首短歌。

quip.example: He made a clever quip about the weather and everyone laughed.
quip.exampleZh: 他就天气说了一句俏皮话，大家都笑了。

quirk.example: Everyone laughs at his little quirk of tapping the table twice.
quirk.exampleZh: 每个人都笑他敲两下桌子的小怪癖。

quit.example: He decided to quit his job and look for a new one.
quit.exampleZh: 他决定辞掉工作，去找一份新工作。

quite.example: The test was quite easy, and all the students finished it quickly.
quite.exampleZh: 这次考试相当简单，所有学生都很快完成了。

quiver.example: Her hands began to quiver with cold as she waited for the bus.
quiver.exampleZh: 她在等公交车时，双手因寒冷开始颤抖。

quixotic.example: His quixotic plan to build a school on the moon seemed impossible to everyone.
quixotic.exampleZh: 他那个在月球上建学校的堂吉诃德式计划在所有人看来都不可能。

quiz.example: Our teacher will give us a short quiz before the class starts.
quiz.exampleZh: 我们老师会在上课前给我们做一个小测验。

quizzical.example: She gave me a quizzical look when I told her the strange news.
quizzical.exampleZh: 当我告诉她这个奇怪的消息时，她疑惑地看了我一眼。

quorum.example: We cannot start the meeting until we have a quorum.
quorum.exampleZh: 在达到法定人数之前，我们不能开始会议。

quota.example: Each worker must meet a monthly quota before the company pays a bonus.
quota.exampleZh: 每个工人必须完成每月配额，公司才会支付奖金。

quote.example: She likes to quote her teacher when she explains the lesson to us.
quote.exampleZh: 她喜欢在给我们讲课时引用她老师的话。

quotient.example: The quotient of ten divided by two is five.

rabbi.example: The rabbi read from the old book and spoke to the people.
rabbi.exampleZh: 拉比从旧书中诵读，并向人们讲话。

rabbit.example: The rabbit ate a carrot in the garden this morning.
rabbit.exampleZh: 今天早上，兔子在花园里吃了一根胡萝卜。

rabble.example: The angry rabble gathered outside the town hall and shouted at the officials.
rabble.exampleZh: 愤怒的暴民聚集在镇政厅外，对着官员们大喊。

rabid.example: The rabid dog ran through the street and scared all the children.
rabid.exampleZh: 那只患狂犬病的狗跑过街道，吓坏了所有孩子。

rabies.example: Rabies is a dangerous disease that can kill both people and animals.
rabies.exampleZh: 狂犬病是一种危险的疾病，可以杀死人和动物。

raccoon.example: The raccoon climbed the tree to look for food.
raccoon.exampleZh: 那只浣熊爬上树去寻找食物。

race.example: The race was long, but every runner finished with a smile.
race.exampleZh: 那场比赛很长，但每位跑者都笑着跑完了。

racer.example: The racer drove very fast and won the big race yesterday.
racer.exampleZh: 这位赛车手昨天开得很快，赢得了那场大赛。

racial.example: People should treat everyone equally and never judge others because of racial differences.
racial.exampleZh: 人们应该平等对待每个人，永远不要因为种族差异而评判他人。

racism.example: Racism hurts people and divides communities in many countries around the world.
racism.exampleZh: 种族主义伤害人们，并在世界许多国家造成社区分裂。

rack.example: He put the old books on the wooden rack.
rack.exampleZh: 他把旧书放在木架子上。

racket.example: He bought a new tennis racket for his younger brother yesterday.
racket.exampleZh: 他昨天给弟弟买了一个新网球拍。

racketeer.example: The police arrested a racketeer who had cheated many local shop owners.
racketeer.exampleZh: 警方逮捕了一名曾欺骗许多当地店主的敲诈勒索者。

raconteur.example: My uncle is a natural raconteur who makes every family dinner interesting.
raconteur.exampleZh: 我叔叔是个天生的故事高手，他让每次家庭聚餐都很有趣。

radar.example: The ship uses radar to find other boats in the dark.
radar.exampleZh: 这艘船用雷达在黑暗中寻找其他船只。

radial.example: The radial lines on the map lead out from the center.
radial.exampleZh: 地图上的径向线从中心向外延伸。

radiant.example: Her face looked radiant in the soft morning light.
radiant.exampleZh: 在柔和的晨光中，她的脸显得容光焕发。

radiate.example: The warm sun can radiate heat and light across the wide field.
radiate.exampleZh: 温暖的太阳可以向广阔的田野辐射热和光。

radiation.example: The sun sends harmful radiation to the earth every day.
radiation.exampleZh: 太阳每天向地球发送有害辐射。

radical.example: The new plan makes a radical change to how we work.
radical.exampleZh: 新计划对我们的工作方式做出了彻底的改变。

radicate.example: We need to radicate these new ideas in the local community.
radicate.exampleZh: 我们需要让这些新想法在当地社区扎根。

radio.example: I listen to the radio every morning while I eat breakfast.
radio.exampleZh: 我每天早上吃早饭时听收音机。

radioactive.example: The workers wear special clothes because the waste is highly radioactive.
radioactive.exampleZh: 工人们穿特殊衣服，因为这种废物具有高度放射性。

radiology.example: She studied radiology for two years before she started working in the hospital.
radiology.exampleZh: 她在医院工作前学了两年放射学。

radish.example: My mother put a fresh radish in the salad for lunch today.
radish.exampleZh: 我妈妈今天午餐时在沙拉里放了一个新鲜的小萝卜。

radium.example: Radium is a radioactive metal that glows faintly in the dark.
radium.exampleZh: 镭是一种在黑暗中会微微发光的放射性金属。

radius.example: The circle has a radius of five meters from the center.
radius.exampleZh: 这个圆的半径是从圆心算起五米。

radon.example: Radon is a colorless gas that can be found in some homes.
radon.exampleZh: 氡是一种无色气体，可能存在于一些房屋中。

raffle.example: We bought ten tickets for the school raffle and hoped to win a prize.
raffle.exampleZh: 我们买了十张学校抽奖的票，希望能赢得奖品。

raft.example: We built a small raft and floated down the river.
raft.exampleZh: 我们造了一个小木筏，顺着河漂流。

rag.example: He used an old rag to clean the dirty window.
rag.exampleZh: 他用一块旧破布擦脏窗户。

rage.example: The storm raged all night and frightened the children in the small house.
rage.exampleZh: 暴风雨肆虐了一整夜，吓坏了小房子里的孩子们。

ragged.example: The ragged old man walked slowly down the dusty road alone.
ragged.exampleZh: 那个衣衫褴褛的老人独自沿着尘土飞扬的路慢慢走着。

raid.example: The police made a raid on the old house last night.
raid.exampleZh: 警方昨晚突袭了那栋老房子。

rail.example: The train ran along the steel rail beside the old road.
rail.exampleZh: 火车沿着旧路旁的钢轨行驶。

rain.example: The rain was very heavy, so we stayed at home all day.
rain.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，所以我们整天待在家里。

rainbow.example: After the rain, a beautiful rainbow appeared in the sky above our house.
rainbow.exampleZh: 雨后，我们家上方的天空中出現了一道美麗的彩虹。

raise.example: We need to raise money to build a new school for the children.
raise.exampleZh: 我们需要筹钱为孩子们建一所新学校。

rake.example: He used a rake to clean the leaves from the yard.
rake.exampleZh: 他用耙子清理院子里的落叶。

rally.example: The team will rally together after a hard loss this week.
rally.exampleZh: 球队本周经历一场惨败后会团结起来重振士气。

ram.example: The angry ram hit the wooden fence and broke one small board.
ram.exampleZh: 那只愤怒的公羊撞上木栅栏，撞断了一块小木板。

ramble.example: We rambled through the quiet woods and talked about our day.
ramble.exampleZh: 我们在安静的树林里漫步，聊着我们的一天。

ramp.example: The workers built a ramp so people in wheelchairs could enter the building.
ramp.exampleZh: 工人们修建了一条坡道，让坐轮椅的人能够进入大楼。

rampage.example: The angry crowd went on a rampage through the quiet town.
rampage.exampleZh: 愤怒的人群在安静的小镇上疯狂破坏。

rampant.example: The disease was rampant in the village and many people became very sick.
rampant.exampleZh: 这种疾病在村里猖獗，许多人都病得很重。

ranch.example: The old ranch has many cows and horses near the river.
ranch.exampleZh: 这座老牧场在河边养着许多牛和马。

rancid.example: The old butter in the fridge smells rancid and must be thrown away.
rancid.exampleZh: 冰箱里的旧黄油闻起来腐臭了，必须扔掉。

rancor.example: Years later, he still felt deep rancor toward the people who had hurt him.
rancor.exampleZh: 多年以后，他对那些伤害过他的人仍然怀有深深的积怨。

random.example: We picked a random number between one and ten for the game.
random.exampleZh: 我们为游戏在1到10之间随机选了一个数字。

range.example: The store sells a wide range of cheap and useful things for students.
range.exampleZh: 这家商店出售各种便宜又实用的学生用品。

rank.example: He is above me in rank at the company.
rank.exampleZh: 在公司里他的等级比我高。

ransom.example: The family paid a large ransom to bring the boy home safely.
ransom.exampleZh: 这家人支付了一大笔赎金，把男孩安全地带回家。

rap.example: He heard a loud rap on the door and opened it quickly.
rap.exampleZh: 他听到门上有一声重重的敲击，便迅速打开了门。

rapacious.example: The rapacious king took all the land from poor farmers.
rapacious.exampleZh: 那个贪婪的国王夺走了贫穷农民的所有土地。

rape.example: The court punished the man for rape and sent him to prison.
rape.exampleZh: 法庭因强奸罪惩罚了那名男子并把他送进监狱。

rapid.example: The rapid growth of the city brought many new jobs.
rapid.exampleZh: 这座城市的迅速发展带来了许多新工作。

rapprochement.example: The two countries worked hard for a rapprochement after many years of conflict.
rapprochement.exampleZh: 两国在多年冲突后努力实现和解。

rapture.example: She felt pure rapture when she heard the good news.
rapture.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她感到纯粹的狂喜。

rare.example: It is rare to see snow in this warm city.
rare.exampleZh: 在这个温暖的城市看到雪是罕见的。

rascal.example: That little rascal hid my shoes under the bed again.
rascal.exampleZh: 那个小捣蛋鬼又把我的鞋子藏到床底下了。

rash.example: He made a rash decision and later got a red rash on his arm.
rash.exampleZh: 他做了一个鲁莽的决定，后来手臂上起了红色皮疹。

rasp.example: His loud voice rasped through the quiet room.
rasp.exampleZh: 他那响亮的声音刺耳地响彻安静的房间。

rat.example: The rat ran across the kitchen floor and hid under the old table.
rat.exampleZh: 老鼠跑过厨房地板，躲到了旧桌子下面。

rate.example: The hotel offers a good rate for guests who stay two nights.
rate.exampleZh: 这家酒店为住两晚的客人提供优惠价格。

rather.example: I would rather stay home tonight than go out in the rain.
rather.exampleZh: 今晚我宁愿待在家里，也不愿冒雨出门。

ratify.example: The government will ratify the new trade agreement next week.
ratify.exampleZh: 政府将于下周批准这项新的贸易协议。

ratio.example: The ratio of boys to girls in our class is two to one.
ratio.exampleZh: 我们班男生与女生的比例是二比一。

ration.example: Each family received a small ration of rice and water every day.
ration.exampleZh: 每个家庭每天都会收到一小份大米和水的定量配给。

rational.example: It is rational to save some money for a rainy day.
rational.exampleZh: 为雨天存点钱是理性的。

rationalize.example: He tried to rationalize his mistake instead of just saying sorry to her.
rationalize.exampleZh: 他试图为自己的错误找借口，而不是直接向她道歉。

rattle.example: The strong wind made the old windows rattle all night long.
rattle.exampleZh: 大风让旧窗户整夜嘎嘎作响。

ravage.example: The storm ravaged the small village and left many families without homes.
ravage.exampleZh: 暴风雨摧毁了这个小村庄，使许多家庭无家可归。

rave.example: Fans rave about the new singer and dance all night.
rave.exampleZh: 粉丝们对这位新歌手狂热赞扬，并整夜跳舞。

raven.example: A large black raven sat on the old fence and looked at us.
raven.exampleZh: 一只大黑渡鸦停在旧栅栏上看着我们。

ravine.example: The hikers crossed a narrow ravine before the sun went down.
ravine.exampleZh: 徒步者在太阳落山前穿过了一条狭窄的沟壑。

raving.example: The raving man stood in the street and shouted at everyone.
raving.exampleZh: 那个疯狂的男人站在街上对所有人喊叫。

ravish.example: The beautiful music ravished her mind and made her forget all her worries.
ravish.exampleZh: 美妙的音乐使她陶醉，让她忘记了所有烦恼。

raw.example: You should wash raw vegetables carefully before you cook them for dinner.
raw.exampleZh: 做晚饭前，你应该仔细清洗生蔬菜。

ray.example: A thin ray of sunlight came through the small window and lit the room.
ray.exampleZh: 一缕微弱的阳光透过小窗户照进房间。

raze.example: The old building was razed to make room for a park.
raze.exampleZh: 那座旧楼被夷为平地，为建公园腾出地方。

razor.example: He used a sharp razor to shave his face this morning.
razor.exampleZh: 他今天早上用一把锋利的剃刀刮了脸。

reach.example: We can reach the top of the hill before dark.
reach.exampleZh: 我们能在天黑前到达山顶。

react.example: People often react quickly when they hear a loud and sudden noise.
react.exampleZh: 人们听到响亮而突然的声音时常常会迅速反应。

reaction.example: Her reaction to the news was very calm and quiet.
reaction.exampleZh: 她对这个消息的反应非常平静。

reactionary.example: His reactionary ideas made him oppose every new change in the company.
reactionary.exampleZh: 他反动的思想使他反对公司里的每一项新变革。

read.example: I read a short book before I go to bed every night.
read.exampleZh: 我每天晚上睡觉前都会读一本短书。

readable.example: This book uses simple words, so it is readable for young children.
readable.exampleZh: 这本书用词简单，所以对幼儿来说很容易读。

reader.example: The reader asked the writer a simple question about the new book.
reader.exampleZh: 读者就这本新书向作者问了一个简单的问题。

readily.example: She readily agreed to help us with the project.
readily.exampleZh: 她乐意地答应帮助我们做这个项目。

reading.example: Reading every day helps young students build a strong vocabulary.
reading.exampleZh: 每天阅读能帮助年轻学生建立丰富的词汇量。

readjust.example: We had to readjust our plans when the weather changed suddenly.
readjust.exampleZh: 天气突然变化时，我们不得不重新调整计划。

ready.example: I am ready to go to school with my friends now.
ready.exampleZh: 我现在准备好和朋友们一起去上学了。

real.example: The story is based on real events that happened many years ago.
real.exampleZh: 这个故事基于多年前发生的真实事件。

realign.example: We need to realign our team with the new goals this week.
realign.exampleZh: 我们需要本周让团队与新的目标重新对齐。

realistic.example: We need a realistic plan before we start the new project.
realistic.exampleZh: 我们需要在开始新项目之前制定一个现实的计划。

reality.example: The reality of the situation is harder than we expected.
reality.exampleZh: 这个情况的现实比我们预想的更难。

realize.example: I did not realize how late it was until I got home.
realize.exampleZh: 直到回到家我才意识到已经这么晚了。

realm.example: He is famous in the realm of modern science.
realm.exampleZh: 他在现代科学领域很有名。

reap.example: Farmers reap the crops when they are ready in autumn.
reap.exampleZh: 农民在秋天庄稼成熟时收割庄稼。

rear.example: The children sat in the rear of the car and sang songs.
rear.exampleZh: 孩子们坐在汽车后部，唱着歌。

reason.example: I have no reason to doubt what you told me today.
reason.exampleZh: 我没有理由怀疑你今天告诉我的话。

reasonable.example: It is reasonable to ask for help when you are busy.
reasonable.exampleZh: 当你忙碌时，寻求帮助是合理的。

reassess.example: After the meeting, we need to reassess our plan before Friday.
reassess.exampleZh: 会议之后，我们需要在周五之前重新评估我们的计划。

reassure.example: I tried to reassure her that everything would be fine soon.
reassure.exampleZh: 我试着让她安心，一切很快就会好起来。

rebel.example: The young rebel refused to follow the unfair rules of the old king.
rebel.exampleZh: 那个年轻的叛逆者拒绝遵守老国王的不公平规则。

rebellion.example: The king sent soldiers to stop the rebellion in the north.
rebellion.exampleZh: 国王派士兵去阻止北方的叛乱。

rebirth.example: The city celebrated its rebirth after many years of hard work.
rebirth.exampleZh: 这座城市在多年努力之后庆祝了它的重生。

rebound.example: After the bad week, his mood began to rebound quickly.
rebound.exampleZh: 糟糕的一周过后，他的心情开始迅速回升。

rebuke.example: The teacher had to rebuke the noisy students for wasting class time.
rebuke.exampleZh: 老师不得不斥责那些吵闹的学生浪费课堂时间。

rebuttal.example: Her quick rebuttal made the whole room quiet for a moment.
rebuttal.exampleZh: 她迅速的反驳让整个房间安静了片刻。

recalcitrant.example: The recalcitrant student refused to follow the simple classroom rules again.
recalcitrant.exampleZh: 那个顽抗的学生再次拒绝遵守简单的课堂规则。

recall.example: I cannot recall the name of the restaurant we visited last night.
recall.exampleZh: 我想不起我们昨晚去的那家餐厅的名字了。

recapture.example: The soldiers tried to recapture the small town before sunrise.
recapture.exampleZh: 士兵们试图在日出前夺回那座小镇。

recast.example: The writer decided to recast the old story for modern readers.
recast.exampleZh: 作家决定为现代读者改写这个旧故事。

recede.example: The flood waters began to recede after the heavy rain stopped.
recede.exampleZh: 大雨停止后，洪水开始退去。

receipt.example: I asked the shop to give me a receipt for my purchase.
receipt.exampleZh: 我请商店给我一张购物收据。

receive.example: I hope to receive a letter from my friend soon.
receive.exampleZh: 我希望很快能收到我朋友的一封信。

recent.example: I have not seen him in recent weeks because he is very busy.
recent.exampleZh: 最近几周我没见过他，因为他很忙。

receptacle.example: Please put the empty bottle in the plastic receptacle near the door.
receptacle.exampleZh: 请把空瓶子放进靠近门口的塑料容器里。

reception.example: The hotel reception was very busy when we arrived last night.
reception.exampleZh: 我们昨晚到达时，酒店前台非常忙。

receptive.example: She is very receptive to new ideas and always listens to her friends.
receptive.exampleZh: 她非常善于接受新想法，总是倾听朋友的意见。

recess.example: The children played outside during the short recess after lunch.
recess.exampleZh: 孩子们在午餐后的短暂休息时间到外面玩了。

recession.example: The country's economy fell into a recession after many factories closed last year.
recession.exampleZh: 去年许多工厂关闭后，这个国家的经济陷入了衰退。

recidivism.example: The program aims to lower recidivism among people who leave prison.
recidivism.exampleZh: 该项目旨在降低出狱人员的累犯率。

recipient.example: The recipient of the package signed for it at the front desk.
recipient.exampleZh: 包裹的接收者在前台签收了它。

reciprocal.example: A good friendship is based on reciprocal trust and respect.
reciprocal.exampleZh: 良好的友谊建立在相互的信任和尊重之上。

recital.example: She gave a short piano recital for her family last night.
recital.exampleZh: 昨晚她为家人举行了一场简短的钢琴演奏会。

recite.example: Students often recite poems in class to remember them better.
recite.exampleZh: 学生经常在课堂上背诵诗歌，以便更好地记住它们。

reckless.example: His reckless driving caused a serious accident on the busy road.
reckless.exampleZh: 他在繁忙道路上鲁莽驾驶，造成了一起严重事故。

reckon.example: I reckon we should leave now before the rain gets too heavy.
reckon.exampleZh: 我觉得我们应该趁雨还没下大现在就走。

reclaim.example: The city plans to reclaim the old land and build a new park.
reclaim.exampleZh: 这座城市计划开垦这块旧地并建造一个新公园。

recline.example: I like to recline on the sofa and read a book after work.
recline.exampleZh: 我喜欢下班后斜倚在沙发上读一本书。

recognition.example: She received public recognition for her hard work and honest service.
recognition.exampleZh: 她因努力工作和诚实服务而获得了公众认可。

recognize.example: I did not recognize you at first because you looked so different today.
recognize.exampleZh: 我一开始没认出你，因为你今天看起来太不一样了。

recoil.example: She felt the gun recoil and stepped back in surprise.
recoil.exampleZh: 她感觉到枪的后坐力，惊讶地往后退了一步。

recollect.example: I cannot recollect where I put my keys this morning.
recollect.exampleZh: 我想不起来今天早上把钥匙放在哪里了。

recommend.example: I recommend this book to anyone who likes simple stories.
recommend.exampleZh: 我向任何喜欢简单故事的人推荐这本书。

reconcile.example: She tried to reconcile her busy job with her family life.
reconcile.exampleZh: 她努力调和繁忙的工作与家庭生活。

reconnaissance.example: The soldiers went on a reconnaissance mission to check the bridge.
reconnaissance.exampleZh: 士兵们执行了一次侦察任务去查看那座桥。

reconsider.example: We should reconsider our plan before we spend more money on it.
reconsider.exampleZh: 在我们为此花更多钱之前，我们应该重新考虑我们的计划。

reconstruct.example: We need to reconstruct the old bridge before the rainy season starts.
reconstruct.exampleZh: 我们需要在雨季开始前重建这座旧桥。

record.example: Please record the meeting and keep the record in a safe place.
record.exampleZh: 请记录会议，并把记录保存在安全的地方。

recourse.example: We had no recourse but to ask the police for help.
recourse.exampleZh: 我们别无他法，只能向警察求助。

recover.example: She hopes to recover from the flu before the school trip next week.
recover.exampleZh: 她希望在下周学校旅行前从流感中恢复过来。

recreate.example: The children recreate a simple game with their friends after school.
recreate.exampleZh: 孩子们放学后和朋友们重新创造了一个简单的游戏。

recruit.example: The company plans to recruit ten new workers next month.
recruit.exampleZh: 公司计划下个月招募十名新员工。

rectangle.example: The teacher drew a long rectangle on the whiteboard for the students.
rectangle.exampleZh: 老师在白板上为学生们画了一个长方形。

rectify.example: The manager will rectify the mistake before the report is sent to clients.
rectify.exampleZh: 经理会在报告发给客户之前纠正这个错误。

recur.example: The same problem may recur if we do not fix it today.
recur.exampleZh: 如果我们今天不解决，同样的问题可能会再次出现。

recycle.example: We should recycle old paper and plastic to help keep our city clean.
recycle.exampleZh: 我们应该回收旧纸张和塑料，帮助保持城市清洁。

red.example: She wore a red dress to the party last night with her friends.
red.exampleZh: 她昨晚和朋友们一起穿了一条红色连衣裙去参加聚会。

redeem.example: He worked hard to redeem his mistake and win back his friends.
redeem.exampleZh: 他努力工作来弥补自己的错误，并赢回朋友们的心。

redemptive.example: The story has a redemptive ending that gives people hope after pain.
redemptive.exampleZh: 这个故事有一个救赎式的结局，在痛苦之后给人们希望。

reduce.example: We should reduce the amount of sugar we eat every day.
reduce.exampleZh: 我们应该减少每天吃的糖的量。

redundancy.example: The company cut costs by reducing redundancy in its offices.
redundancy.exampleZh: 公司通过减少办公室的冗余来削减成本。

redundant.example: The old rule is redundant, so we can delete it now.
redundant.exampleZh: 这条旧规则是多余的，所以我们现在可以把它删掉。

refer.example: Please refer to the first page of the book for more details.
refer.exampleZh: 请参考这本书的第一页以了解更多细节。

referee.example: The referee stopped the game because one player broke a rule.
referee.exampleZh: 裁判停止了比赛，因为一名球员违反了规则。

reference.example: You can find more information in the reference section of this book.
reference.exampleZh: 你可以在本书的参考部分找到更多信息。

refine.example: We refine our plan every week to make it better and easier to use.
refine.exampleZh: 我们每周改进计划，使它更好、更易用。

refinement.example: This small refinement made the old machine much easier to use.
refinement.exampleZh: 这个小改进让旧机器更容易使用。

reflect.example: The calm lake can reflect the bright colors of the evening sky.
reflect.exampleZh: 平静的湖面能映出傍晚天空的明亮色彩。

reflection.example: Her calm reflection on the past year helped her make better plans.
reflection.exampleZh: 她对过去一年的冷静反思帮助她制定了更好的计划。

reflective.example: She wrote a reflective essay about her first year in college.
reflective.exampleZh: 她写了一篇反思性的文章，讲述大学第一年的经历。

reform.example: The new leader wants to reform the old rules and help every student.
reform.exampleZh: 新领导想要改革旧规则，并帮助每一位学生。

reformist.example: The reformist group wants to change some old rules in a peaceful way.
reformist.exampleZh: 这个改良主义团体希望以和平的方式改变一些旧规则。

refrain.example: Please refrain from using your phone during dinner with our family.
refrain.exampleZh: 请在我们家人共进晚餐时不要使用手机。

refresh.example: A cool drink can refresh you after a long walk in the sun.
refresh.exampleZh: 在太阳下走了很久后，一杯冷饮能让你恢复精神。

refreshment.example: We stopped at a small shop for a cold drink and some refreshment.
refreshment.exampleZh: 我们在一家小店停下来，喝了冷饮，吃了些点心。

refuge.example: The old church became a refuge for families during the storm.
refuge.exampleZh: 暴风雨期间，那座古老的教堂成了家庭的避难所。

refund.example: The store will refund your money if you return the item.
refund.exampleZh: 如果你退回商品，商店会给你退款。

refutable.example: The teacher said the claim is refutable with simple evidence.
refutable.exampleZh: 老师说这个说法可以用简单的证据反驳。

refute.example: He tried to refute my argument with some simple facts.
refute.exampleZh: 他试图用一些简单的事实来反驳我的论点。

regain.example: She slowly regained her strength after the long illness.
regain.exampleZh: 久病之后，她慢慢恢复了体力。

regard.example: Many people regard him as a kind and honest friend.
regard.exampleZh: 许多人把他视为一位善良诚实的朋友。

regeneration.example: The regeneration of the forest after the fire took many years.
regeneration.exampleZh: 火灾后森林的再生花了很多年。

regime.example: The new regime promised to improve the lives of ordinary people.
regime.exampleZh: 新政权承诺改善普通人的生活。

regimen.example: The doctor gave him a simple regimen to follow every morning.
regimen.exampleZh: 医生给了他一个每天早晨遵循的简单养生法。

region.example: This region is known for its beautiful mountains and clean rivers.
region.exampleZh: 这个地区以美丽的山脉和清澈的河流而闻名。

register.example: Please register your name at the front desk before you enter the hall.
register.exampleZh: 请在进入大厅前到前台登记你的名字。

regress.example: Without practice, many students may regress and lose the skills they learned.
regress.exampleZh: 如果不练习，许多学生可能会退步，并失去他们学过的技能。

regressive.example: The new tax is regressive because it hurts poor families the most.
regressive.exampleZh: 这项新税是递减的，因为它对贫困家庭的伤害最大。

regular.example: I take regular breaks at work to stay healthy and focused.
regular.exampleZh: 我在工作中定期休息以保持健康和专注。

regulate.example: The government makes new rules to regulate how companies use water.
regulate.exampleZh: 政府制定新规则来规范公司如何用水。

regulatory.example: The new regulatory rules make it harder for small companies to open.
regulatory.exampleZh: 新的监管规定使小公司更难开业。

rehabilitate.example: The program helps prisoners rehabilitate and return to normal life.
rehabilitate.exampleZh: 该项目帮助囚犯改造并回归正常生活。

rehearsal.example: We have a final rehearsal for the school play this afternoon.
rehearsal.exampleZh: 我们今天下午为学校话剧做最后一次排练。

reign.example: The king's reign lasted for many years and brought peace to the land.
reign.exampleZh: 国王的统治持续了很多年，并为这片土地带来了和平。

reimbursement.example: My company sent me the reimbursement for my travel costs last week.
reimbursement.exampleZh: 公司上周把我出差的费用报销给我了。

rein.example: The rider pulled the reins to stop the horse.
rein.exampleZh: 骑手拉紧缰绳让马停下来。

reincarnate.example: Some people believe that a good soul may reincarnate into a new body.
reincarnate.exampleZh: 有些人相信善良的灵魂可能会转世到一个新的身体里。

reincarnation.example: Many people in that village believe in reincarnation after death.
reincarnation.exampleZh: 那个村子里的许多人相信死后会转世。

reinforce.example: The new evidence will reinforce our belief that the plan is safe.
reinforce.exampleZh: 新证据将加强我们对该计划安全的信心。

reiterate.example: I want to reiterate that we must finish the work today.
reiterate.exampleZh: 我想重申，我们今天必须完成这项工作。

reject.example: The manager decided to reject our plan because it was too expensive.
reject.exampleZh: 经理决定驳回我们的计划，因为它太贵了。

rejoice.example: We rejoice when our friends do well and share their happiness.
rejoice.exampleZh: 当朋友做得好时，我们感到高兴并分享他们的快乐。

relapse.example: The doctor warned that a relapse could happen if he stopped taking his medicine.
relapse.exampleZh: 医生警告说，如果他停止服药，可能会复发。

relate.example: I can relate this story to my own life.
relate.exampleZh: 我能把这个故事和我自己的生活联系起来。

relation.example: The relation between the two countries has improved in recent years.
relation.exampleZh: 近年来，两国之间的关系有所改善。

relative.example: The price of the house is relative to its location and size.
relative.exampleZh: 房子的价格相对于它的位置和大小。

relativity.example: Einstein's theory of relativity changed how we understand time and space.
relativity.exampleZh: 爱因斯坦的相对论改变了我们对时间和空间的理解。

relax.example: After a long week at work, I like to relax at home on weekends.
relax.exampleZh: 工作了一整周后，周末我喜欢在家放松。

relaxation.example: A warm bath and soft music can bring deep relaxation after a long day.
relaxation.exampleZh: 热水澡和轻柔的音乐能在漫长的一天后带来深度放松。

release.example: The band will release a new album next month.
release.exampleZh: 乐队下个月将发行一张新专辑。

relevant.example: This information is relevant to our discussion about the new project.
relevant.exampleZh: 这条信息与我们关于新项目的讨论相关。

reliability.example: The reliability of this old car is very important to us.
reliability.exampleZh: 这辆旧车的可靠性对我们非常重要。

reliable.example: She is a reliable friend who always helps me.
reliable.exampleZh: 她是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮助我。

reliance.example: Her reliance on her parents grew stronger after she lost her job.
reliance.exampleZh: 失业后，她对父母的依赖变得更强了。

relief.example: The medicine gave him great relief from the pain in his back.
relief.exampleZh: 这种药大大缓解了他背部的疼痛。

religion.example: Many people around the world follow a religion that gives them hope.
religion.exampleZh: 世界上许多人信奉一种给他们希望的宗教。

relinquish.example: He did not want to relinquish control of the small company.
relinquish.exampleZh: 他不想放弃对这家小公司的控制权。

relinquishment.example: Her relinquishment of the old house surprised all of us.
relinquishment.exampleZh: 她放弃那栋老房子让我们所有人感到惊讶。

relish.example: I relish every quiet morning I spend reading by the open window.
relish.exampleZh: 我很享受每一个在敞开的窗边读书的安静早晨。

reluctant.example: She was reluctant to go out in the cold rain.
reluctant.exampleZh: 她不愿意在冷雨中出门。

rely.example: Many small businesses rely on local customers to keep their doors open every day.
rely.exampleZh: 许多小企业依靠本地顾客来维持每天营业。

remain.example: Please remain calm and wait here until the doctor comes back.
remain.exampleZh: 请保持冷静并在这里等待，直到医生回来。

remainder.example: I ate some of the cake and saved the remainder for later.
remainder.exampleZh: 我吃了一些蛋糕，把剩下的留到以后。

remark.example: I want to remark that your idea is very useful and clear.
remark.exampleZh: 我想评论说你的想法非常有用而且清晰。

remedial.example: The school offers remedial classes to help students improve their reading skills.
remedial.exampleZh: 学校提供补救课程，帮助学生提高阅读能力。

remedy.example: The doctor gave him a simple remedy for his bad cough.
remedy.exampleZh: 医生给了他一个简单的办法来治疗他的严重咳嗽。

remember.example: I still remember the first day we met at school.
remember.exampleZh: 我仍然记得我们在学校第一次见面的那天。

remind.example: Please remind me to call my mother when I get home.
remind.exampleZh: 请提醒我到家后给我妈妈打电话。

reminisce.example: Old friends often reminisce about their happy school days over coffee.
reminisce.exampleZh: 老朋友们常边喝咖啡边追忆快乐的求学时光。

reminiscent.example: The old song is reminiscent of my happy childhood summers.
reminiscent.exampleZh: 这首老歌让我想起快乐的童年夏天。

remit.example: Please remit the payment by Friday so we can close your account.
remit.exampleZh: 请在周五前汇款，以便我们关闭你的账户。

remnant.example: A small remnant of the old wall still stands near the river.
remnant.exampleZh: 旧墙的一小段残余仍然立在河边。

remorse.example: He felt deep remorse after he lied to his best friend.
remorse.exampleZh: 他对最好的朋友撒谎后深感懊悔。

remorseful.example: He felt remorseful after he said unkind words to his best friend.
remorseful.exampleZh: 他对最好的朋友说了刻薄的话后感到懊悔。

remote.example: The remote village has no hospital, so people travel far for help.
remote.exampleZh: 这个偏远的村庄没有医院，所以人们要远行求医。

removal.example: The removal of the old tree made the garden much brighter.
removal.exampleZh: 移除那棵老树让花园明亮了许多。

remove.example: Please remove your shoes before you enter the clean room.
remove.exampleZh: 请在你进入干净的房间前把鞋脱掉。

render.example: The new software can render the image much faster than before.
render.exampleZh: 新软件能比以往更快地渲染这张图像。

rendering.example: The artist's rendering of the city looked very real and bright.
rendering.exampleZh: 这位艺术家对这座城市的渲染看起来非常真实而明亮。

renew.example: I need to renew my passport before the end of this month.
renew.exampleZh: 我需要在这个月底之前更新我的护照。

renewable.example: Solar power is a renewable source of energy that many countries use today.
renewable.exampleZh: 太阳能是一种许多国家如今使用的可再生能源。

renounce.example: She decided to renounce her old job and start a new life.
renounce.exampleZh: 她决定放弃旧工作，开始新生活。

renovate.example: They plan to renovate the old house before they move in next spring.
renovate.exampleZh: 他们计划在明年春天搬进去之前翻新那栋老房子。

renowned.example: He is a renowned writer, and many people enjoy reading his books.
renowned.exampleZh: 他是一位著名的作家，很多人喜欢读他的书。

rent.example: We pay rent at the start of every month for our small apartment.
rent.exampleZh: 我们每月初为我们的小公寓支付租金。

renunciation.example: Her renunciation of the old plan surprised all of us.
renunciation.exampleZh: 她对旧计划的放弃让我们所有人都感到惊讶。

repair.example: I need to repair my old bike before I ride it again.
repair.exampleZh: 我需要在我再次骑它之前修理我的旧自行车。

repairable.example: This old chair is repairable, so we do not need to buy a new one.
repairable.exampleZh: 这把旧椅子可以修理，所以我们不需要买新的。

reparations.example: The country agreed to pay reparations to the families after the long war.
reparations.exampleZh: 战后，该国同意向这些家庭支付赔偿。

repay.example: I will repay the money I borrowed from you next week.
repay.exampleZh: 我下周会偿还向你借的钱。

repeal.example: The new government decided to repeal the old law last year.
repeal.exampleZh: 新政府去年决定废除那项旧法律。

repeat.example: Please repeat the question slowly so I can understand it.
repeat.exampleZh: 请慢慢重复这个问题，这样我能听懂。

repel.example: The strong smell can repel insects and keep them away from food.
repel.exampleZh: 这种强烈的气味能驱赶昆虫，使它们远离食物。

repercussion.example: The new law will have serious repercussions for small businesses across the country.
repercussion.exampleZh: 这项新法律将对全国的小企业产生严重的后果。

repertoire.example: The pianist added several new songs to her repertoire this year.
repertoire.exampleZh: 这位钢琴家今年在她的曲目中增加了几首新歌。

repertory.example: The theater keeps a large repertory of plays for every season.
repertory.exampleZh: 这家剧院为每个演出季保留了大量剧目。

repetition.example: Repetition helps me remember new words.
repetition.exampleZh: 重复能帮助我记住新单词。

repetitive.example: His repetitive questions made the long meeting feel very boring and slow.
repetitive.exampleZh: 他重复的问题让漫长的会议显得非常无聊又缓慢。

replace.example: We will replace the old computer with a new one tomorrow.
replace.exampleZh: 我们明天会用一台新电脑替换那台旧电脑。

replacement.example: We need a replacement for the old broken chair in the kitchen.
replacement.exampleZh: 我们需要一个替代品来替换厨房里那把破旧的椅子。

replete.example: The old library is replete with rare books and quiet study corners.
replete.exampleZh: 这座老图书馆充满了珍本书和安静的学习角落。

reply.example: Please reply to my email before you leave the office today.
reply.exampleZh: 请在你今天离开办公室之前回复我的邮件。

report.example: I will report the meeting results to my manager tomorrow morning.
report.exampleZh: 我明天上午会向经理报告会议结果。

represent.example: These three colors represent the main parts of our school.
represent.exampleZh: 这三种颜色代表我们学校的主要部分。

repression.example: The government used repression to stop people from speaking against it.
repression.exampleZh: 政府用镇压来阻止人们发表反对言论。

reprieve.example: The judge gave him a reprieve so he could spend time with his family.
reprieve.exampleZh: 法官给了他缓刑，让他能和家人待一段时间。

reproach.example: She began to reproach herself for missing the simple warning signs.
reproach.exampleZh: 她开始因错过那些简单的警示信号而责备自己。

reproduce.example: Many animals reproduce quickly when food is easy to find.
reproduce.exampleZh: 当食物容易找到时，许多动物会迅速繁殖。

reproduction.example: The reproduction of these small fish usually happens in warm shallow water.
reproduction.exampleZh: 这些小鱼的繁殖通常发生在温暖的浅水中。

reproductive.example: The reproductive system helps animals make new young.
reproductive.exampleZh: 生殖系统帮助动物繁衍新的后代。

reptile.example: A turtle is a reptile that lives both in water and on land.
reptile.exampleZh: 乌龟是一种既生活在水中又生活在陆地上的爬行动物。

republic.example: The people formed a new republic after the long war ended.
republic.exampleZh: 长期战争结束后，人民建立了一个新的共和国。

republican.example: The republican form of government gives citizens a voice in public life.
republican.exampleZh: 共和制政府让公民在公共生活中有发言权。

republicanism.example: Many people believe republicanism is an important part of a free society.
republicanism.exampleZh: 许多人认为共和主义是自由社会的重要组成部分。

repudiate.example: The company decided to repudiate the false claims made by its rival.
repudiate.exampleZh: 公司决定否认其竞争对手提出的虚假说法。

repudiation.example: The manager's repudiation of the claim surprised everyone at the meeting.
repudiation.exampleZh: 经理对这项索赔的否认让会上所有人都感到惊讶。

repugnance.example: She felt deep repugnance when she saw the dirty kitchen.
repugnance.exampleZh: 当她看到脏乱的厨房时，她感到深深的厌恶。

repulse.example: The army repulsed the attack and the strange smell repulsed everyone.
repulse.exampleZh: 军队击退了进攻，奇怪的气味让所有人感到厌恶。

repulsion.example: Her face showed clear repulsion when she saw the dirty old room.
repulsion.exampleZh: 当她看到那个脏旧的房间时，脸上露出明显的厌恶。

reputable.example: This is a reputable company that treats its workers and customers fairly.
reputable.exampleZh: 这是一家声誉好的公司，公平对待员工和顾客。

reputation.example: His good reputation helped him get the job easily.
reputation.exampleZh: 他良好的名誉帮助他轻松得到了这份工作。

reputedly.example: The old house is reputedly haunted by a friendly ghost.
reputedly.exampleZh: 据说那座老房子里住着一个友善的鬼魂。

request.example: I will request a copy of the report from the office tomorrow.
request.exampleZh: 我明天会向办公室请求一份报告副本。

require.example: Many jobs require people to work well with others.
require.exampleZh: 许多工作要求人们善于与他人合作。

requirement.example: The main requirement for this job is good communication skills.
requirement.exampleZh: 这份工作的主要要求是良好的沟通能力。

requisite.example: A passport is requisite for travel to many countries.
requisite.exampleZh: 护照是去许多国家旅行所必需的。

rescission.example: The court ordered the rescission of the unfair contract last week.
rescission.exampleZh: 法院上周下令撤销这份不公平的合同。

rescue.example: The firemen worked hard to rescue the child from the burning house.
