stoic.example: She stayed stoic and calm while everyone around her was panicking.
stoic.exampleZh: 当周围所有人都在惊慌时，她依然坚忍而冷静。

stolid.example: The stolid guard stood by the door and said nothing to us.
stolid.exampleZh: 那个冷漠的守卫站在门边，什么也没对我们说。

stomach.example: My stomach hurts after I ate too much spicy food.
stomach.exampleZh: 我吃了太多辛辣食物后肚子疼。

stone.example: The boy threw a small stone into the clear river.
stone.exampleZh: 男孩把一块小石头扔进了清澈的河里。

stop.example: Please stop the car before the red light and wait for the children.
stop.exampleZh: 请在红灯前把车停下，并等孩子们过来。

storage.example: We keep our winter clothes in storage until the cold weather comes.
storage.exampleZh: 我们把冬天的衣服存放起来，直到寒冷的天气来临。

store.example: We store extra food in the small room next to the kitchen.
store.exampleZh: 我们把多余的食物存放在厨房旁边的小房间里。

storm.example: The storm broke the old tree and blocked the road.
storm.exampleZh: 暴风雨折断了老树，堵住了道路。

story.example: She told her little brother a funny story before bed last night.
story.exampleZh: 昨晚睡前她给弟弟讲了一个有趣的故事。

straight.example: Please walk straight down this road and turn left at the bank.
straight.exampleZh: 请沿这条路直走，然后在银行处左转。

strain.example: The heavy box strained his back, so he stopped and rested for a while.
strain.exampleZh: 那个沉重的箱子拉伤了他的背，所以他停下来休息了一会儿。

strand.example: She found one strand of hair on her coat.
strand.exampleZh: 她在自己的外套上发现了一根头发。

strange.example: It is strange that he did not come to school today.
strange.exampleZh: 很奇怪，他今天没来学校。

strangle.example: The thief tried to strangle the guard but failed and ran away.
strangle.exampleZh: 小偷试图勒死警卫，但失败了，然后逃跑了。

strap.example: He used a strap to tie the box to his bike.
strap.exampleZh: 他用一条带子把箱子绑在自行车上。

stratagem.example: The old general used a clever stratagem to defeat the larger army.
stratagem.exampleZh: 老将军用了一条巧妙的计谋击败了更庞大的军队。

strategic.example: The company made a strategic plan to enter the new market.
strategic.exampleZh: 公司制定了一项战略计划，以进入新的市场。

strategy.example: The team made a new strategy to win more customers this year.
strategy.exampleZh: 团队制定了一项新战略，以便今年赢得更多客户。

stratify.example: Scientists stratify the soil samples by depth before they test them.
stratify.exampleZh: 科学家在检测土壤样本前按深度将其分层。

stratum.example: The rock stratum near the river is easy to see.
stratum.exampleZh: 河边的岩层很容易看到。

stray.example: The stray dog followed us home and would not leave.
stray.exampleZh: 那只流浪狗跟着我们回了家，怎么也不肯离开。

streak.example: The cat has a white streak on its back.
streak.exampleZh: 这只猫背上有一道白色条纹。

stream.example: A small stream flows through the green field behind our house.
stream.exampleZh: 一条小溪流过我们家房子后面的绿色田野。

street.example: There is a small coffee shop on the street near my house.
street.exampleZh: 我家附近的街上有一家小咖啡店。

strength.example: He used all his strength to lift the heavy box.
strength.exampleZh: 他用尽全力搬起那个沉重的箱子。

strenuous.example: The long hike was strenuous, but we felt happy after it.
strenuous.exampleZh: 这次长途徒步很费力，但之后我们感到很开心。

stress.example: Too much stress can make it hard to sleep well at night.
stress.exampleZh: 太多的压力会让人晚上很难睡好。

stretch.example: I stretch my arms every morning before I start my day.
stretch.exampleZh: 我每天早上开始一天前都会伸展双臂。

strict.example: Our teacher is very strict about homework and always checks every answer.
strict.exampleZh: 我们老师对作业要求很严格，并且总是检查每一道答案。

stride.example: He made great strides in learning English this year.
stride.exampleZh: 今年他在学习英语方面取得了很大进步。

strident.example: Her strident voice made everyone in the small room feel uncomfortable.
strident.exampleZh: 她刺耳的声音让小房间里的每个人都感到不舒服。

strike.example: The workers decided to strike for better pay and safer working conditions.
strike.exampleZh: 工人们决定为了更好的薪酬和更安全的工作条件而罢工。

striking.example: She made a striking change in her room last week.
striking.exampleZh: 她上周把房间做了显著改变。

string.example: She tied the box with a piece of string and carried it home.
string.exampleZh: 她用一根细绳把盒子捆好，然后带回了家。

stringent.example: The school has stringent rules about wearing uniforms every day.
stringent.exampleZh: 学校对每天穿校服有严格的规定。

strip.example: She used a knife to strip the old paint from the wooden door.
strip.exampleZh: 她用刀把木门上的旧油漆剥掉。

strive.example: We strive to do our best every day at school and work.
strive.exampleZh: 我们每天在学校和工作中努力做到最好。

stroke.example: My grandfather had a stroke last year but he is fine now.
stroke.exampleZh: 我爷爷去年中风了，但他现在很好。

stroll.example: We took a slow stroll along the river after dinner.
stroll.exampleZh: 晚饭后我们沿着河边慢慢散步。

strong.example: He is strong enough to lift the heavy box by himself.
strong.exampleZh: 他足够强壮，能独自抬起那个重箱子。

structure.example: The old building has a simple structure and very strong walls.
structure.exampleZh: 这座老建筑结构简单，墙壁非常坚固。

struggle.example: Many people struggle to balance their work and family life every day.
struggle.exampleZh: 许多人每天努力平衡工作和家庭生活。

stubborn.example: My stubborn little brother never listens to anyone when he wants to play outside.
stubborn.exampleZh: 我固执的小弟弟想在外面玩时，从不听任何人的话。

student.example: Every student in my class works hard and asks many questions.
student.exampleZh: 我们班每个学生都很努力，还会问很多问题。

studious.example: She is a studious student who always finishes her homework on time.
studious.exampleZh: 她是个好学的学生，总是按时完成作业。

study.example: I study English every day after school with my friends.
study.exampleZh: 我每天放学后和朋友们一起学习英语。

stuff.example: Please stuff all your clothes into the bag before we leave.
stuff.exampleZh: 请在我们离开前把你所有的衣服都塞进包里。

stultify.example: Too many strict rules can stultify children and stop them from learning.
stultify.exampleZh: 太多严格的规定会使孩子们变得迟钝，并阻碍他们学习。

stumble.example: I saw him stumble on the stairs but he did not fall.
stumble.exampleZh: 我看见他在楼梯上绊了一下，但他没有摔倒。

stun.example: The sudden news stunned everyone in the room and left them silent.
stun.exampleZh: 这个突如其来的消息让房间里的每个人都惊呆了，沉默不语。

stunt.example: The actor did a dangerous stunt in the new movie.
stunt.exampleZh: 那位演员在新电影里做了一个危险的特技。

style.example: Her writing style is clear and simple, so everyone enjoys reading her stories.
style.exampleZh: 她的写作风格清晰简洁，所以大家都喜欢读她的故事。

suave.example: The suave young man spoke politely to everyone at the party.
suave.exampleZh: 那位温文尔雅的年轻人在聚会上礼貌地对每个人说话。

subculture.example: The new music scene quickly became a popular subculture among young people.
subculture.exampleZh: 这个新的音乐场景很快在年轻人中成为一种流行的亚文化。

subdue.example: The police tried to subdue the angry crowd before it grew worse.
subdue.exampleZh: 警察试图在愤怒的人群变得更糟之前制服他们。

subject.example: Math is my favorite subject at school this year.
subject.exampleZh: 数学是我今年在学校最喜欢的科目。

subjective.example: Our choice of colors is often subjective and may differ from person to person.
subjective.exampleZh: 我们对颜色的选择往往是主观的，可能因人而异。

subjugate.example: The cruel king tried to subjugate all the nearby small villages.
subjugate.exampleZh: 那个残暴的国王试图征服附近所有的小村庄。

sublimate.example: Good writers sublimate their painful memories into beautiful stories for readers.
sublimate.exampleZh: 优秀的作家把痛苦的记忆升华为读者喜爱的美丽故事。

sublime.example: The view from the mountain was sublime and made us feel very small.
sublime.exampleZh: 从山上看到的景色非常壮丽，让我们觉得自己很渺小。

subliminal.example: The quiet music had a subliminal effect on how I felt.
subliminal.exampleZh: 那轻柔的音乐对我的感受产生了潜意识的影响。

submarine.example: The submarine went under the water and stayed there for a long time.
submarine.exampleZh: 那艘潜艇潜入水下并在那里停留了很长时间。

submerge.example: He watched the old boat slowly submerge under the dark water.
submerge.exampleZh: 他看着旧船慢慢沉入深色的水下。

submissive.example: He was too submissive and never said no to his boss.
submissive.exampleZh: 他太顺从了，从不对老板说不。

submit.example: Please submit your report to the teacher before Friday morning.
submit.exampleZh: 请在周五早上之前把报告交给老师。

subordinate.example: A good manager treats every subordinate with respect and listens to their ideas.
subordinate.exampleZh: 一位好的经理会尊重每一位下属，并倾听他们的想法。

subscribe.example: I subscribe to two magazines and read them every week.
subscribe.exampleZh: 我订阅了两本杂志，并且每周都读。

subsequent.example: The subsequent meeting was short and easy to understand.
subsequent.exampleZh: 随后的会议很短，也很容易理解。

subservient.example: He was too subservient to his boss and never spoke his mind.
subservient.exampleZh: 他对老板过于恭顺，从不表达自己的想法。

subsidiary.example: The company opened a new subsidiary in Asia last year.
subsidiary.exampleZh: 这家公司去年在亚洲开设了一家新的子公司。

subsidy.example: The government gives a subsidy to farmers every year.
subsidy.exampleZh: 政府每年给农民发放补贴。

substance.example: Water is a substance that every living thing needs to survive.
substance.exampleZh: 水是每一种生物生存都必需的一种物质。

substantial.example: The company made a substantial profit after it changed its sales plan.
substantial.exampleZh: 公司在改变销售计划后获得了可观的利润。

substantiate.example: The police need more evidence to substantiate the man's story about the missing car.
substantiate.exampleZh: 警方需要更多证据来证实那名男子关于失踪汽车的说法。

substantive.example: The report made a substantive change to our old plan.
substantive.exampleZh: 这份报告对我们的旧计划做了实质性修改。

substitute.example: You can use honey as a substitute for sugar in this recipe.
substitute.exampleZh: 在这个食谱中，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

subterfuge.example: He used a harmless subterfuge to avoid going to the party with them.
subterfuge.exampleZh: 他用了一个无害的借口来避免和他们一起去参加聚会。

subtitle.example: The subtitle at the bottom of the screen explains what the speaker is saying.
subtitle.exampleZh: 屏幕底部的字幕解释了说话者在说什么。

subtle.example: There is a subtle difference between these two colors in the light.
subtle.exampleZh: 在光线下，这两种颜色之间有一个微妙的差别。

subtlety.example: I did not understand the subtlety of his question at first.
subtlety.exampleZh: 我一开始没有理解他问题的微妙之处。

subtract.example: If you subtract five from ten, you get five.
subtract.exampleZh: 如果你从十中减去五，你会得到五。

suburb.example: They moved to a quiet suburb after their first child was born.
suburb.exampleZh: 他们的第一个孩子出生后，他们搬到了一个安静的郊区。

suburban.example: They live in a quiet suburban area near the city.
suburban.exampleZh: 他们住在城市附近一个安静的郊区。

subvert.example: Some people try to subvert the rules for their own gain.
subvert.exampleZh: 有些人为了自己的利益试图破坏规则。

succeed.example: If you work hard every day, you will succeed in the end.
succeed.exampleZh: 如果你每天努力工作，你最终会成功。

success.example: Hard work and a good plan can lead to success in life.
success.exampleZh: 努力工作和好的计划能带来人生的成功。

successful.example: She worked hard every day and became a very successful doctor.
successful.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，成为了一名非常成功的医生。

successive.example: The team won three successive games last month and felt very happy.
successive.exampleZh: 这支队伍上个月连续赢了三场比赛，感到非常高兴。

succinct.example: Her succinct answer helped us understand the main point quickly.
succinct.exampleZh: 她简明的回答帮助我们很快理解了要点。

such.example: I have never seen such a beautiful flower in my life.
such.exampleZh: 我一生中从未见过如此美丽的花。

suck.example: The baby likes to suck milk from a bottle every morning.
suck.exampleZh: 这个婴儿喜欢每天早上从奶瓶里吸奶。

sudden.example: A sudden noise woke the baby and made everyone run outside.
sudden.exampleZh: 一声突然的巨响吵醒了婴儿，让大家都跑到外面。

suffer.example: Many people suffer from back pain after sitting too long.
suffer.exampleZh: 许多人坐得太久后都会遭受背痛。

suffering.example: Many people around the world still live with great suffering every day.
suffering.exampleZh: 世界上许多人每天仍然生活在巨大的痛苦之中。

sufficient.example: We have sufficient food and water for everyone in the group.
sufficient.exampleZh: 我们有足够的食物和水供小组里的每个人使用。

sugar.example: I put two spoons of sugar in my morning coffee today.
sugar.exampleZh: 我今天早上在咖啡里放了两勺糖。

suggest.example: I suggest we take the early train to avoid traffic.
suggest.exampleZh: 我建议我们乘坐早班火车以避开交通拥堵。

suggestion.example: I have a good suggestion for our next class trip to the museum.
suggestion.exampleZh: 我对我们下次去博物馆的班级旅行有一个好建议。

suicide.example: He said the suicide was a tragedy for the whole small town.
suicide.exampleZh: 他说这起自杀事件对整个小镇来说是一场悲剧。

suit.example: This dark suit fits him well and is right for the meeting.
suit.exampleZh: 这套深色西装很适合他，也适合这次会议。

suitable.example: This movie is not suitable for very young children.
suitable.exampleZh: 这部电影不适合很小的孩子。

sully.example: He did not want to sully his good name with a lie.
sully.exampleZh: 他不想用谎言玷污自己的好名声。

sultry.example: The sultry summer night made it hard for us to sleep.
sultry.exampleZh: 闷热的夏夜让我们难以入睡。

sum.example: The total sum of these numbers is fifty dollars.
sum.exampleZh: 这些数字的总和是五十美元。

summarize.example: Please summarize the main points of the report in a few sentences.
summarize.exampleZh: 请用几句话总结报告的主要观点。

summary.example: I read a short summary of the book before the class.
summary.exampleZh: 上课前我读了一本书的简短摘要。

summer.example: We often go swimming at the lake during the hot summer.
summer.exampleZh: 夏天炎热的时候，我们经常去湖边游泳。

summit.example: They reached the summit after a long and difficult climb.
summit.exampleZh: 他们经过漫长而艰难的攀登到达了顶峰。

summon.example: The king will summon all his soldiers to the castle before sunrise tomorrow.
summon.exampleZh: 国王将在明天日出前把所有士兵召唤到城堡。

sumptuous.example: They enjoyed a sumptuous dinner in the large hotel dining room.
sumptuous.exampleZh: 他们在一间宽敞的酒店餐厅里享用了一顿豪华的晚餐。

sun.example: The sun is bright and warm today, so we will play outside.
sun.exampleZh: 今天太阳明亮又温暖，所以我们要去外面玩。

sundry.example: She bought sundry items at the store for the party.
sundry.exampleZh: 她为聚会从商店买了各种物品。

super.example: This super new phone is very fast and easy to use.
super.exampleZh: 这部超棒的新手机速度很快，而且很容易使用。

supercilious.example: His supercilious smile made everyone in the room feel small and unwelcome.
supercilious.exampleZh: 他傲慢的微笑让房间里的每个人都感到渺小和不受欢迎。

superficial.example: Her knowledge of the topic is superficial, so she cannot answer deep questions.
superficial.exampleZh: 她对这个话题的了解很肤浅，所以无法回答深入的问题。

superfluous.example: The extra details in his report were superfluous and made it harder to read.
superfluous.exampleZh: 他报告中多余的细节是累赘的，让人更难阅读。

superior.example: She is superior to me at chess and often wins our games.
superior.exampleZh: 她下棋比我强，常常赢我们的对局。

supersede.example: New technology will supersede the old system very soon.
supersede.exampleZh: 新技术很快就会取代旧系统。

supervise.example: Teachers supervise students during the exam to keep everything fair.
supervise.exampleZh: 老师在考试期间监督学生，以确保一切公平。

supervision.example: The new workers need close supervision during their first week on the job.
supervision.exampleZh: 新员工在工作的第一周需要密切监督。

supine.example: He lay supine on the sofa all afternoon and watched television.
supine.exampleZh: 他整个下午仰卧在沙发上看电视。

supple.example: The supple leather makes these shoes comfortable for long walks.
supple.exampleZh: 柔软的皮革使这双鞋在长时间行走时很舒适。

supplement.example: I take a vitamin supplement every morning to stay healthy and strong.
supplement.exampleZh: 我每天早上服用维生素补充剂以保持健康和强壮。

supply.example: The company can supply fresh water to every home in the village.
supply.exampleZh: 这家公司能为村里的每家每户供应干净的水。

support.example: My family will support me when I start my new job next week.
support.exampleZh: 当我下周开始新工作时，我的家人会支持我。

suppose.example: I suppose we should leave early to avoid the traffic.
suppose.exampleZh: 我想我们应该早点出发以避开交通拥堵。

suppress.example: The government tried to suppress the news about the protest.
suppress.exampleZh: 政府试图压制有关抗议的新闻。

supreme.example: The supreme court made a very important decision for the whole country.
supreme.exampleZh: 最高法院为整个国家做出了一个非常重要的决定。

sure.example: I am sure you will pass the test tomorrow.
sure.exampleZh: 我确信你明天会通过考试。

surface.example: The fish swam near the surface of the clear blue water.
surface.exampleZh: 鱼在清澈的蓝色水面附近游动。

surge.example: The sudden surge in demand made it hard to buy tickets.
surge.exampleZh: 需求的突然激增使得买票变得很难。

surgeon.example: The surgeon washed his hands carefully before he began the long operation.
surgeon.exampleZh: 外科医生在开始长时间手术前仔细洗了手。

surly.example: The surly waiter did not smile at us all evening.
surly.exampleZh: 那个脾气坏的侍者整晚都没有对我们笑。

surmise.example: I can only surmise that he forgot our meeting.
surmise.exampleZh: 我只能推测他忘了我们的会面。

surmount.example: She worked hard to surmount every difficulty and finally reached her goal.
surmount.exampleZh: 她努力克服每一个困难，最终实现了目标。

surpass.example: She works hard every day and hopes to surpass her older brother.
surpass.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，希望超过她的哥哥。

surplus.example: The company had a surplus of goods after the busy season ended.
surplus.exampleZh: 旺季结束后，公司有了一批过剩的货物。

surprise.example: The news came as a big surprise to everyone in our class.
surprise.exampleZh: 这个消息让我们班上每个人都非常意外。

surrender.example: The soldiers had no food or water, so they chose to surrender to the enemy.
surrender.exampleZh: 士兵们没有食物和水，所以他们选择向敌人投降。

surround.example: Tall trees surround the small house and keep it cool in summer.
surround.exampleZh: 高大的树木环绕着这座小房子，使它在夏天保持凉爽。

surveillance.example: The police kept the suspect under close surveillance for several days.
surveillance.exampleZh: 警方对嫌疑人进行了几天的严密监视。

survey.example: We will survey the local shops to learn what people want.
survey.exampleZh: 我们将调查当地的商店，了解人们想要什么。

survival.example: The survival of the small village depended on clean water and hard work.
survival.exampleZh: 这个小村庄的生存依赖于干净的水和辛勤的劳动。

survive.example: People who stay calm and help each other can survive even the hardest times.
survive.exampleZh: 保持冷静并互相帮助的人甚至能挺过最艰难的时期。

suspect.example: I suspect that he is lying about the missing money.
suspect.exampleZh: 我怀疑他在丢失的钱这件事上撒谎。

suspend.example: The school will suspend classes for two days because of the storm.
suspend.exampleZh: 学校将因暴风雨停课两天。

suspense.example: The movie kept us in suspense until the very last scene.
suspense.exampleZh: 这部电影让我们一直悬着心，直到最后一幕。

suspicion.example: I have a strong suspicion that he took the money.
suspicion.exampleZh: 我强烈怀疑是他拿了那笔钱。

sustain.example: We need enough food and water to sustain life on the long trip.
sustain.exampleZh: 我们需要足够的食物和水来维持这次长途旅行中的生命。

sustainability.example: We need to protect the environment and improve sustainability for future generations.
sustainability.exampleZh: 我们需要保护环境并提高可持续性，以造福子孙后代。

sustainable.example: We need to find sustainable ways to use water and energy.
sustainable.exampleZh: 我们需要找到可持续的方式来使用水和能源。

swagger.example: He walked with a swagger after winning the big game yesterday.
swagger.exampleZh: 他昨天赢下那场重要比赛后，大摇大摆地走着。

swallow.example: The bird tried to swallow a small fish near the river.
swallow.exampleZh: 那只鸟在河边试图吞下一条小鱼。

swamp.example: He got lost in the swamp and could not find his way home.
swamp.exampleZh: 他在沼泽里迷了路，找不到回家的路。

swap.example: I swap seats with my friend so we can sit together.
swap.exampleZh: 我和朋友交换座位，这样我们就能坐在一起。

swarm.example: A swarm of bees flew over the garden and landed on a tree.
swarm.exampleZh: 一群蜜蜂飞过花园，落在了一棵树上。

sway.example: The gentle wind made the tall trees sway slowly in the evening.
sway.exampleZh: 晚风让高高的树木缓缓摇摆。

swear.example: I swear I will never tell anyone your secret.
swear.exampleZh: 我发誓我绝不会把你的秘密告诉任何人。

sweep.example: She used a broom to sweep the leaves from the front porch.
sweep.exampleZh: 她用扫帚把前廊的叶子扫掉了。

sweet.example: The sweet smell of fresh bread filled the small kitchen this morning.
sweet.exampleZh: 今天早上，新鲜面包的甜香充满了小厨房。

swell.example: After the injury, his ankle began to swell and hurt when he walked.
swell.exampleZh: 受伤后，他的脚踝开始肿胀，走路时就疼。

swelling.example: The swelling on my ankle went down after I rested it.
swelling.exampleZh: 我休息后，脚踝上的肿胀消退了。

swerve.example: The driver had to swerve to avoid a dog in the road.
swerve.exampleZh: 司机不得不突然转向，以避开路上的狗。

swift.example: The swift runner crossed the finish line before everyone else.
swift.exampleZh: 那名迅捷的跑者比所有人都先冲过终点线。

swim.example: I like to swim in the lake with my friends every summer.
swim.exampleZh: 我喜欢每年夏天和朋友们在湖里游泳。

swing.example: The children like to swing on the new swing in the park.
swing.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里荡那个新秋千。

switch.example: Please switch off the lights before you leave the room.

swivel.example: The office chair can swivel so you can face your coworker.
swivel.exampleZh: 这把办公椅可以旋转，所以你能面向同事。

sword.example: The knight drew his sword and ran toward the enemy.
sword.exampleZh: 骑士拔出他的剑，朝敌人跑去。

sycophant.example: The manager ignored the sycophant who kept praising him at every meeting.
sycophant.exampleZh: 经理没有理会那个每次开会都不断称赞他的马屁精。

symbol.example: The dove is a symbol of peace in many cultures around the world.
symbol.exampleZh: 鸽子在世界许多文化中是和平的象征。

symbolic.example: The dove is a symbolic image of peace in many cultures.
symbolic.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，鸽子是和平的象征性形象。

symmetry.example: The butterfly's wings show perfect symmetry when you look at them closely.
symmetry.exampleZh: 当你仔细观察时，蝴蝶的翅膀呈现出完美的对称。

sympathetic.example: She was very sympathetic when I told her about my difficult day.
sympathetic.exampleZh: 当我告诉她我这一天过得很艰难时，她非常同情我。

sympathy.example: I feel great sympathy for the people who lost their homes in the flood.
sympathy.exampleZh: 我对在洪水中失去家园的人们深感同情。

symptom.example: A high fever is a common symptom of this viral infection.
symptom.exampleZh: 高烧是这种病毒感染的常见症状。

synchronize.example: We need to synchronize our watches before the race starts.
synchronize.exampleZh: 比赛开始前我们需要把手表校准同步。

synchronized.example: The two clocks are synchronized so they show the same time.
synchronized.exampleZh: 这两个时钟是同步的，因此显示相同的时间。

syndrome.example: The doctor said the patient has a rare syndrome that affects his muscles.
syndrome.exampleZh: 医生说这位病人患有一种影响肌肉的罕见综合征。

synergy.example: The synergy between the two teams made the whole project much faster and cheaper.
synergy.exampleZh: 两个团队之间的协同作用使整个项目变得更快、成本更低。

synopsis.example: The teacher asked us to write a short synopsis of the story.
synopsis.exampleZh: 老师让我们写一个简短的故事梗概。

syntax.example: The syntax of this sentence is simple and easy to understand.
syntax.exampleZh: 这个句子的句法简单易懂。

synthesis.example: The synthesis of these ideas led to a better plan.
synthesis.exampleZh: 这些想法的综合带来了一个更好的计划。

synthetic.example: The synthetic fabric is cheap and easy to wash.
synthetic.exampleZh: 这种合成纤维便宜且容易清洗。

syrup.example: She poured warm syrup over the pancakes and smiled at her family.
syrup.exampleZh: 她把温热的糖浆浇在煎饼上，对家人笑了笑。

system.example: The new school system helps students learn in a clear and fair way.
system.exampleZh: 新的学校制度帮助学生在清晰而公平的方式中学习。

systematic.example: She takes a systematic approach to cleaning the house every weekend.
systematic.exampleZh: 她每个周末都用有条理的方法打扫房子。

systemic.example: The disease is systemic and affects many parts of the body.
systemic.exampleZh: 这种疾病是全身性的，会影响身体的许多部位。

taboo.example: In some cultures, it is a taboo to talk about death at dinner.
taboo.exampleZh: 在某些文化中，晚餐时谈论死亡是一种禁忌。

tabula rasa.example: The newborn's mind is often described as a tabula rasa by philosophers.
tabula rasa.exampleZh: 哲学家常把新生儿的心灵描述为一块白板。

tabular.example: The report presents the data in a clear tabular form for easy reading.
tabular.exampleZh: 这份报告以清晰的表格形式呈现数据，便于阅读。

tabulate.example: Please tabulate the results so we can compare them easily.
tabulate.exampleZh: 请把结果制成表格，以便我们轻松比较。

tachometer.example: The mechanic checked the tachometer to see how fast the engine was running.
tachometer.exampleZh: 机械师检查了转速表，看看发动机运转得有多快。

tacit.example: There was a tacit agreement between them not to discuss the matter.
tacit.exampleZh: 他们之间有一个不讨论此事的默契。

tacit approval.example: Her silence was taken as tacit approval of the new plan.
tacit approval.exampleZh: 她的沉默被当作对新计划的默许。

taciturn.example: The taciturn old man sat by the window and rarely spoke to anyone.
taciturn.exampleZh: 那位沉默寡言的老人坐在窗边，很少和任何人说话。

tack.example: She used a tack to pin the note to the board.
tack.exampleZh: 她用一枚大头针把便条钉在板上。

tackle.example: We must tackle this problem before it gets worse.
tackle.exampleZh: 我们必须在问题变得更糟之前解决它。

tact.example: She showed great tact when she told him the bad news.
tact.exampleZh: 她在告诉他坏消息时表现得非常圆滑得体。

tactic.example: Changing the plan at the last minute was a clever tactic.
tactic.exampleZh: 在最后一刻改变计划是一个聪明的策略。

tactical.example: The coach made a tactical change to help our team win the game.
tactical.exampleZh: 教练做出了战术调整，帮助我们队赢得比赛。

tactics.example: The coach changed his tactics in the second half and won the game.
tactics.exampleZh: 教练在下半场改变了战术，并赢得了比赛。

tactile.example: The soft blanket gives a pleasant tactile feeling on my skin.
tactile.exampleZh: 这条柔软的毯子在我的皮肤上带来舒适的触感。

tadpole.example: The little tadpole swam in the pond with its small tail.
tadpole.exampleZh: 这只小蝌蚪甩着小尾巴在池塘里游。

tag.example: Please put a name tag on your bag before the trip starts.
tag.exampleZh: 请在旅行开始前在你的包上挂一个姓名标签。

tailor.example: The tailor made a beautiful suit for my father last week.
tailor.exampleZh: 这位裁缝上周为我父亲做了一套漂亮的西装。

tailwind.example: The new policy gave a tailwind to small businesses trying to grow.
tailwind.exampleZh: 这项新政策为想要发展的小企业提供了助力。

take.example: Please take this book and give it to your sister.
take.exampleZh: 请把这本书拿去给你妹妹。

takeoff.example: The plane's takeoff was delayed by heavy snow this morning.
takeoff.exampleZh: 今天早上大雪延误了飞机起飞。

takeover.example: The company announced a takeover of its smaller rival last week.
takeover.exampleZh: 该公司上周宣布收购其规模较小的竞争对手。

talcum.example: She put some talcum powder on the baby after the bath.
talcum.exampleZh: 她给宝宝洗完澡后涂了一些爽身粉。

tale.example: My grandfather told us a funny tale about his old dog.
tale.exampleZh: 我爷爷给我们讲了一个关于他老狗的有趣故事。

talent.example: She has a rare talent for drawing and loves to share it with friends.
talent.exampleZh: 她有绘画的罕见天赋，并喜欢与朋友分享。

talisman.example: She keeps a small talisman in her bag for good luck.
talisman.exampleZh: 她为了好运在包里带着一个小护身符。

tally.example: Please tally the votes before we announce the final results to everyone.
tally.exampleZh: 请在向大家宣布最终结果之前清点选票。

tallyman.example: The tallyman wrote down every sale in his small notebook.
tallyman.exampleZh: 记账员把每一笔销售都记在他的小本子上。

tamarind.example: The tamarind gives this soup a slightly sweet and sour taste.
tamarind.exampleZh: 罗望子让这道汤带有一点酸甜的味道。

tamp.example: Workers tamp the loose soil down before they build the new road.
tamp.exampleZh: 工人们在修建新路之前把松软的泥土夯实。

tamper.example: Someone tried to tamper with the lock on my door last night.
tamper.exampleZh: 昨晚有人试图撬弄我门上的锁。

tandem.example: They rode a tandem bicycle along the quiet road by the river.
tandem.exampleZh: 他们沿着河边安静的路骑双人自行车。

tangent.example: The teacher went off on a tangent about his favorite old movies.
tangent.exampleZh: 老师离题讲起了他最喜欢的老电影。

tangential.example: His long story was tangential and did not answer our simple question.
tangential.exampleZh: 他冗长的故事离题了，没有回答我们简单的问题。

tangible.example: The company needs tangible results before it can plan the next step.
tangible.exampleZh: 公司需要切实的成果，才能规划下一步。

tangle.example: The wires tangle easily, so keep them neatly in a box.
tangle.exampleZh: 这些电线很容易缠结，所以要把它们整齐地放在盒子里。

tanker.example: The tanker carried a large amount of oil across the sea.
tanker.exampleZh: 这艘油轮载着大量石油横渡大海。

tannin.example: Tannin in tea can make your mouth feel dry and rough.
tannin.exampleZh: 茶中的单宁会让你的口腔感到干涩粗糙。

tantalize.example: The smell of fresh cookies can tantalize anyone who is trying to diet.
tantalize.exampleZh: 新鲜饼干的香味会挑逗任何正在节食的人。

tap.example: She turned off the tap and dried her hands with a towel.
tap.exampleZh: 她关上水龙头，用毛巾擦干了手。

tape.example: I used tape to fix the broken box before we moved it.
tape.exampleZh: 我用胶带修好了那个破箱子，然后我们把它搬走了。

tapir.example: The tapir lives in the forest and eats leaves and fruit.
tapir.exampleZh: 貘生活在森林里，吃树叶和水果。

taproot.example: The taproot of the old tree grew deep into the dry soil.
taproot.exampleZh: 那棵老树的主根深深扎进了干燥的土壤里。

tarantula.example: I saw a big tarantula near the old tree in our garden.
tarantula.exampleZh: 我在我们花园里的老树附近看到了一只大狼蛛。

tardy.example: He was tardy for class three times this week.
tardy.exampleZh: 他这周上课迟到了三次。

target.example: Our main target is to finish the project before the end of this month.
target.exampleZh: 我们的主要目标是在本月底前完成这个项目。

tariff.example: The new tariff made imported goods more expensive for local families.
tariff.exampleZh: 新的关税使进口商品对当地家庭来说更贵了。

tarmac.example: The plane waited on the tarmac for two long hours before takeoff.
tarmac.exampleZh: 飞机在停机坪上等了两个漫长的小时才起飞。

tarnish.example: Too much rain can tarnish the bright metal on the old gate.
tarnish.exampleZh: 过多的雨水会使旧大门上明亮的金属失去光泽。

tarry.example: We cannot tarry here any longer because the train will leave soon.
tarry.exampleZh: 我们不能再在这里逗留了，因为火车很快就要开了。

tart.example: This apple is too tart for me, but my sister likes it.
tart.exampleZh: 这个苹果对我来说太酸了，但我妹妹喜欢。

task.example: My first task today is to clean the kitchen and wash the dishes.
task.exampleZh: 我今天的第一项任务是打扫厨房和洗碗。

taste.example: This soup has a very strong taste, so I only eat a little.
taste.exampleZh: 这汤味道很重，所以我只吃一点。

tasteful.example: Her tasteful decorations made the small room feel warm and beautiful.
tasteful.exampleZh: 她雅致的装饰让这个小房间显得温暖又漂亮。

tasteless.example: The soup was tasteless because the cook forgot to add any salt.
tasteless.exampleZh: 这汤没味道，因为厨师忘了加盐。

tatter.example: The old shirt was torn into tatters after the dog played with it.
tatter.exampleZh: 那件旧衬衫被狗玩过之后撕成了破布。

tattoo.example: She got a small tattoo on her wrist last summer.
tattoo.exampleZh: 去年夏天她在手腕上纹了一个小纹身。

taunt.example: The boys taunt the new student because he wears old clothes.
taunt.exampleZh: 男孩子们嘲笑那个新学生，因为他穿着旧衣服。

taut.example: The rope was taut as we pulled it across the wide river.
taut.exampleZh: 我们把绳子拉过宽阔的河面时，它绷得紧紧的。

tautology.example: Saying a free gift is a tautology because gifts are always free.
tautology.exampleZh: 说免费礼物是同义反复，因为礼物总是免费的。

tavern.example: We stopped at a small tavern and had dinner before going home.
tavern.exampleZh: 我们在一家小酒馆停下吃了晚饭，然后回家。

tawdry.example: She wore a tawdry dress that looked cheap and bright.
tawdry.exampleZh: 她穿了一条俗丽而廉价的亮色裙子。

tax.example: The new tax on cars will make many families pay more.
tax.exampleZh: 新的汽车税会让许多家庭支付更多。

taxi.example: We took a taxi to the train station early this morning.
taxi.exampleZh: 我们今天早上乘出租车去了火车站。

taxonomy.example: The taxonomy of plants helps scientists organize and understand different species.
taxonomy.exampleZh: 植物的分类学帮助科学家组织和理解不同的物种。

teach.example: My father will teach me how to drive a car this summer.
teach.exampleZh: 今年夏天我父亲会教我开车。

teachable.example: A good teacher knows that every student is teachable with the right help.
teachable.exampleZh: 好老师知道，只要有正确的帮助，每个学生都是可教的。

teacher.example: My teacher gave us a simple book to read at home today.
teacher.exampleZh: 我的老师今天给了我们一本简单的书，让我们在家读。

teacup.example: She poured hot tea into a small teacup and smiled at me.
teacup.exampleZh: 她把热茶倒进一个小茶杯里，对我微笑。

team.example: Our team works well together and finishes every project on time.
team.exampleZh: 我们的团队合作得很好，并且总能按时完成每个项目。

teamwork.example: Good teamwork helps us finish the work faster and with less stress.
teamwork.exampleZh: 良好的团队合作帮助我们更快完成工作，压力也更小。

tear.example: She had to tear the old paper into small pieces.
tear.exampleZh: 她不得不把旧纸撕成小碎片。

teardrop.example: A single teardrop rolled slowly down her cheek and fell onto the floor.
teardrop.exampleZh: 一滴泪珠慢慢从她的脸颊滚落，掉到地板上。

tease.example: The children tease their new classmate because he speaks with a different accent.
tease.exampleZh: 孩子们取笑他们的新同学，因为他的口音不同。

teat.example: The baby drank milk from the teat of the bottle.
teat.exampleZh: 婴儿从奶瓶的奶嘴喝奶。

technical.example: The technical team fixed the problem quickly and easily.
technical.exampleZh: 技术团队快速且轻松地解决了这个问题。

technicality.example: The judge dismissed the case because of a legal technicality.
technicality.exampleZh: 法官因一个法律技术性问题而驳回了此案。

technician.example: The technician quickly fixed the broken machine in our office.
technician.exampleZh: 技术员很快修好了我们办公室里的坏机器。

technique.example: She learned a new technique to make bread at home.
technique.exampleZh: 她学会了一种在家做面包的新方法。

technocracy.example: Some people worry that technocracy gives too much power to experts.
technocracy.exampleZh: 有些人担心技术统治会给专家过多权力。

technology.example: Modern technology makes it easy for people to work from home.
technology.exampleZh: 现代技术让人们在家工作变得容易。

tedious.example: The long meeting was tedious, so we all wanted to go home.
tedious.exampleZh: 那个漫长的会议很乏味，所以我们都想回家。

tedium.example: The daily tedium of the job made him feel tired and bored.
tedium.exampleZh: 这份工作日常的单调乏味让他感到疲惫和厌烦。

teem.example: The river teems with fish after the spring rain.
teem.exampleZh: 春雨过后，这条河里鱼群丰富。

teen.example: The teen next door often helps his mother carry bags from the store.
teen.exampleZh: 隔壁的青少年经常帮他妈妈从商店提袋子。

teenager.example: The teenager likes to play basketball with his friends after school.
teenager.exampleZh: 这个青少年喜欢放学后和朋友们打篮球。

teeter.example: The old man began to teeter as he walked across the icy road.
teeter.exampleZh: 那位老人走过结冰的路时开始摇晃。

teeth.example: You should brush your teeth twice a day to keep them clean.
teeth.exampleZh: 你应该每天刷两次牙，保持牙齿清洁。

telecommunications.example: Modern telecommunications make it easy to talk with people around the world.
telecommunications.exampleZh: 现代电信使人们很容易与世界各地的人交谈。

telegram.example: I sent a telegram to my grandmother because she does not use email.
telegram.exampleZh: 我给祖母发了一封电报，因为她不用电子邮件。

telemetry.example: The space team uses telemetry to check the health of the satellite.
telemetry.exampleZh: 太空团队使用遥测数据来检查卫星的健康状况。

teleology.example: Some philosophers use teleology to explain why living things seem purposeful.
teleology.exampleZh: 一些哲学家使用目的论来解释为什么生物看起来有目的。

telephone.example: I used the telephone to call my mother this morning.
telephone.exampleZh: 今天早上我用电话给妈妈打了电话。

telescope.example: He used a telescope to look at the stars last night.
telescope.exampleZh: 昨晚他用望远镜观察星星。

televise.example: The station will televise the game live for people at home.
televise.exampleZh: 电视台将为在家的人们现场转播这场比赛。

telex.example: We sent the final order by telex because the phone line was down.
telex.exampleZh: 我们通过电传发送了最终订单，因为电话线坏了。

tell.example: Please tell me the truth about what happened last night.
tell.exampleZh: 请告诉我昨晚发生的事情的真相。

temper.example: He lost his temper and shouted at the noisy children.
temper.exampleZh: 他发脾气了，对着吵闹的孩子们大喊。

temperament.example: Her calm temperament helps her stay friendly even in difficult situations.
temperament.exampleZh: 她沉稳的性情帮助她在困难的情况下也能保持友善。

temperance.example: His temperance helped him avoid alcohol and live a healthy life.
temperance.exampleZh: 他的节制帮助他远离酒精并过上健康的生活。

temperate.example: The weather in this temperate region is mild and pleasant all year.
temperate.exampleZh: 这个温带地区的天气全年温和宜人。

temperature.example: The temperature in the room is too high for us.
temperature.exampleZh: 这个房间里的温度对我们来说太高了。

tempest.example: The sudden tempest forced the small fishing boats to return to the harbor.
tempest.exampleZh: 突如其来的暴风雨迫使小渔船返回港口。

template.example: The teacher gave us a template to help write our report.
template.exampleZh: 老师给了我们一个模板来帮助写报告。

temple.example: The old temple stands quietly on the hill near our small village.
temple.exampleZh: 那座古老的寺庙静静地坐落在我们小村庄附近的山上。

tempo.example: The music slowed its tempo, and everyone danced more slowly to the beat.
tempo.exampleZh: 音乐放慢了节奏，大家都随着节拍跳得更慢了。

temporal.example: The temporal nature of life reminds us to enjoy each day.
temporal.exampleZh: 生命的暂时性提醒我们要享受每一天。

temporary.example: This is only a temporary job for the summer.
temporary.exampleZh: 这只是一份夏季的临时工作。

tempt.example: The cheap price may tempt many people to buy this old car
tempt.exampleZh: 低廉的价格可能会诱使许多人购买这辆旧车。

ten.example: I have ten small books on my desk at home.
ten.exampleZh: 我家书桌上有十本小书。

tenable.example: Her argument is tenable because the facts support it.
tenable.exampleZh: 她的论点站得住脚，因为事实支持它。

tenacious.example: He is a tenacious worker who never gives up on a difficult task.
tenacious.exampleZh: 他是一个顽强的工人，从不放弃困难的任务。

tenacity.example: Her tenacity helped her finish the hard job on time.
tenacity.exampleZh: 她的坚韧帮助她按时完成了这项艰难的工作。

tenant.example: The tenant pays the rent on the first day of each month.
tenant.exampleZh: 租户在每个月的第一天支付房租。

tend.example: People who sleep well tend to feel happier during the day.
tend.exampleZh: 睡眠好的人往往在白天感觉更快乐。

tendency.example: There is a growing tendency for young people to work from home.
tendency.exampleZh: 年轻人居家办公的趋势正在增长。

tendentious.example: That tendentious article only shows one side of the story.
tendentious.exampleZh: 那篇有倾向性的文章只展示了故事的一面。

tender.example: She gave me a tender smile and asked if I was okay.
tender.exampleZh: 她给了我一个温柔的微笑，并问我是否还好。

tendon.example: The doctor said I hurt a tendon in my ankle while running.
tendon.exampleZh: 医生说我在跑步时伤到了脚踝的肌腱。

tenet.example: Honesty is a central tenet of our family.
tenet.exampleZh: 诚实是我们家庭的核心信条。

tennis.example: I play tennis with my friends every Saturday morning at the park.
tennis.exampleZh: 我每周六早上和朋友们在公园打网球。

tenor.example: The tenor sang a beautiful song at the concert last night.
tenor.exampleZh: 男高音昨晚在音乐会上唱了一首优美的歌。

tense.example: I felt very tense before the big exam, but I passed it.
tense.exampleZh: 大考前我感到非常紧张，但我通过了。

tensile.example: The tensile strength of this thin wire is strong enough for the job.
tensile.exampleZh: 这根细金属线的抗拉强度足以胜任这项工作。

tension.example: The tension in the room made everyone feel nervous and uncomfortable.
tension.exampleZh: 房间里的紧张气氛让每个人都感到紧张不安。

tent.example: We put up a tent beside the lake before it got dark.
tent.exampleZh: 我们在天黑前在湖边搭了一个帐篷。

tentative.example: Our tentative plan is to meet again next week.
tentative.exampleZh: 我们暂定的计划是下周再见面。

tenth.example: This is the tenth time I have read this book.
tenth.exampleZh: 这是我第十次读这本书。

tenuous.example: The bridge looked tenuous, so we did not cross it.
tenuous.exampleZh: 那座桥看起来很单薄，所以我们没有过桥。

tenure.example: She received tenure after six years of hard work at the university.
tenure.exampleZh: 她在大学努力工作六年后获得了终身教职。

tepee.example: The family slept in a tepee during their trip to the plains.
tepee.exampleZh: 一家人在去平原旅行时睡在一个圆锥形帐篷里。

tepid.example: The tea was tepid, and his reply was just as unenthusiastic.
tepid.exampleZh: 茶是温的，他的回答也同样不热情。

term.example: The new term starts next week and all students are ready.
term.exampleZh: 新学期下周开始，所有学生都准备好了。

terminal.example: The bus stopped at the terminal before it returned to the city.
terminal.exampleZh: 公交车在终点站停下，然后返回了城市。

terminate.example: The company will terminate the contract if we miss the deadline.
terminate.exampleZh: 如果我们错过截止日期，公司就会终止合同。

terminology.example: The teacher explained the terminology before we started the science lesson today.
terminology.exampleZh: 老师在我们今天开始科学课之前解释了这些术语。

terminus.example: The train stopped at the final terminus after a long journey through the mountains.
terminus.exampleZh: 火车穿过群山后，在长途旅程的终点站停下。

terrace.example: We had dinner on the terrace and watched the sunset.
terrace.exampleZh: 我们在露台上吃晚饭，看着日落。

terrain.example: The hikers moved slowly across the rocky terrain before dark.
terrain.exampleZh: 徒步者在天黑前缓慢穿过多岩石的地带。

terrestrial.example: Many terrestrial animals live in forests and need clean water and safe places.
terrestrial.exampleZh: 许多陆生动物生活在森林里，需要干净的水和安全的栖息地。

terrible.example: The weather was terrible, so we stayed at home all day.
terrible.exampleZh: 天气糟透了，所以我们整天待在家里。

terrific.example: The weather was terrific, so we went to the beach.
terrific.exampleZh: 天气非常好，所以我们去了海滩。

terrify.example: The loud thunder may terrify the small dog during the storm.
terrify.exampleZh: 巨大的雷声可能会在暴风雨中吓到那只小狗。

territory.example: The small island is part of our country's territory and is carefully protected.
territory.exampleZh: 这座小岛是我国领土的一部分，并受到精心保护。

terror.example: The loud explosion filled the small town with terror and fear.
terror.exampleZh: 巨大的爆炸让小镇充满了恐惧和害怕。

tertiary.example: The tertiary level of education comes after high school in many countries.
tertiary.exampleZh: 在许多国家，高等教育阶段在高中之后。

test.example: We will have a test in class tomorrow morning.
test.exampleZh: 我们明天早上课堂上会有一次测验。

testify.example: Several witnesses will testify in court about what they saw that night.
testify.exampleZh: 几名证人将在法庭上就他们当晚看到的情况作证。

testimonial.example: The happy student wrote a short testimonial about her favorite teacher.
testimonial.exampleZh: 这位开心的学生写了一篇关于她最喜欢的老师的简短推荐书。

testimony.example: Her testimony helped the police understand what really happened that night.
testimony.exampleZh: 她的证词帮助警方了解了那天晚上真正发生的事情。

testosterone.example: The doctor said my testosterone level was normal after the test.
testosterone.exampleZh: 医生说检查后我的睾酮水平正常。

tether.example: The farmer used a strong rope to tether the goat near the fence.
tether.exampleZh: 农夫用一根结实的绳子把山羊拴在栅栏附近。

text.example: I sent a short text to my friend before the class started.
text.exampleZh: 我在上课前给朋友发了一条简短短信。

textbook.example: This textbook is the best one for our English class.
textbook.exampleZh: 这本教科书是我们英语课上最好的一本。

texture.example: The texture of this bread is soft and slightly sweet.
texture.exampleZh: 这种面包的质地柔软，还有点甜。

than.example: She runs faster than her brother does.

thank.example: I want to thank you for all your help today.
thank.exampleZh: 我想感谢你今天所有的帮助。

that.example: I know that she will come to the party tonight.
that.exampleZh: 我知道她今晚会来参加聚会。

thatch.example: The old house has a thatch roof that keeps it cool.
thatch.exampleZh: 这座老房子的茅草屋顶让它保持凉爽。

the.example: The cat is sleeping on the warm sofa in the living room.
the.exampleZh: 那只猫正在客厅里温暖的沙发上睡觉。

theater.example: We went to the theater to see a new play last night.
theater.exampleZh: 昨晚我们去剧场看了一部新戏。

theft.example: The police arrested him for theft after he took money from the store.
theft.exampleZh: 他从商店偷钱后，警方以盗窃罪逮捕了他。

their.example: The students put their books on the desk before class started.
their.exampleZh: 学生们在上课前把他们的书放在了桌子上。

them.example: I gave the books to them because they needed them for school.
them.exampleZh: 我把那些书给了他们，因为他们上学需要这些书。

thematic.example: The teacher planned a thematic unit about animals for our class.
thematic.exampleZh: 老师为我们班设计了一个关于动物的主题单元。

theme.example: The main theme of the book is love and friendship.
theme.exampleZh: 这本书的主题是爱与友谊。

themselves.example: The children made the cookies themselves and shared them with friends.
themselves.exampleZh: 孩子们自己做了饼干，并和朋友们分享。

then.example: We ate dinner and then we went for a short walk outside.
then.exampleZh: 我们吃了晚饭，然后到外面散了一会儿步。

theology.example: She studied theology for many years and now teaches at a small college.
theology.exampleZh: 她学习神学多年，现在在一所小型学院任教。

theorem.example: The teacher explained the theorem in a simple way to the class.
theorem.exampleZh: 老师用简单的方式向全班解释了这一定理。

theoretical.example: The theoretical plan sounds good, but we need to test it in practice.
theoretical.exampleZh: 这个理论上的计划听起来不错，但我们需要在实践中检验它。

theory.example: This theory is easy to understand and it explains many everyday things.
theory.exampleZh: 这个理论很容易理解，它解释了许多日常现象。

therapeutic.example: The doctor said the new drug has a strong therapeutic effect on many patients.
therapeutic.exampleZh: 医生说这种新药对许多病人有很强的疗效。

therapy.example: He goes to therapy every week to talk about his feelings.
therapy.exampleZh: 他每周去接受心理治疗，谈谈自己的感受。

there.example: You can put your bag there and sit next to me.
there.exampleZh: 你可以把包放在那里，然后坐在我旁边。

thereafter.example: He left the company in June and thereafter never spoke to his old boss.
thereafter.exampleZh: 他六月离开了公司，此后就再也没和他的旧老板说过话。

thereby.example: He saved money every month, thereby allowing his family to take a nice trip.
thereby.exampleZh: 他每个月存钱，从而让家人能进行一次愉快的旅行。

therefore.example: It was raining hard; therefore, we stayed at home all day.
therefore.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此我们整天待在家里。

therein.example: The rules are clear, and the answer is hidden therein for careful readers.
therein.exampleZh: 规则很清楚，答案就藏在其中，细心的读者会发现。

thereof.example: The contract and the terms thereof must be signed today.
thereof.exampleZh: 合同及其条款必须在今天签署。

thereunder.example: You can find the rules and the exceptions thereunder in this book.
thereunder.exampleZh: 你可以在这本书里找到规则及其下面的例外。

thermal.example: This thermal jacket keeps me warm on cold winter days.
thermal.exampleZh: 这件保暖夹克在寒冷的冬日里让我保持温暖。

thermocline.example: The thermocline is a layer where the water temperature drops quickly with depth.
thermocline.exampleZh: 温跃层是水温随深度迅速下降的水层。

thermodynamics.example: I am learning thermodynamics because it explains how heat and energy move.
thermodynamics.exampleZh: 我正在学习热力学，因为它解释热量和能量如何移动。

thermometer.example: The nurse used a thermometer to check the child's temperature.
thermometer.exampleZh: 护士用体温计给那个孩子量体温。

thermostat.example: The thermostat keeps the room warm during the cold winter nights.
thermostat.exampleZh: 恒温器在寒冷的冬夜让房间保持温暖。

thesis.example: Her thesis is about how children learn to read at home.
thesis.exampleZh: 她的论文是关于孩子如何在家里学习阅读的。

thick.example: The ice on the lake is very thick this winter.
thick.exampleZh: 今年冬天湖上的冰很厚。

thin.example: The ice on the lake is very thin, so do not walk on it.
thin.exampleZh: 湖面上的冰很薄，所以不要在上面走。

thing.example: The first thing I do every morning is drink a glass of water.
thing.exampleZh: 我每天早上做的第一件事就是喝一杯水。

think.example: I think we should go home now.
think.exampleZh: 我想我们现在应该回家了。

third.example: She finished third in the race and won a small prize.
third.exampleZh: 她在比赛中获得第三名，并赢得了一个小奖品。

thirst.example: After the long run, his thirst was stronger than his hunger.
thirst.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他的口渴比饥饿更强烈。

thirteen.example: There are thirteen students in the small classroom this morning.
thirteen.exampleZh: 今天早上这间小教室里有十三名学生。

thirty.example: My father is thirty years old and he works in a small shop.
thirty.exampleZh: 我父亲三十岁，他在一家小商店工作。

this.example: This book is very easy to read and I like it a lot.
this.exampleZh: 这本书很容易读，我非常喜欢它。

thorn.example: The rose has a sharp thorn that can hurt your hand.
thorn.exampleZh: 玫瑰有一根锋利的刺，会伤到你的手。

thorny.example: The thorny bush hurt my hands when I tried to pick the red flowers.
thorny.exampleZh: 当我试图摘那些红花时，多刺的灌木弄伤了我的手。

thorough.example: The teacher did a thorough check of our homework before class.
thorough.exampleZh: 老师在课前对我们的作业做了彻底的检查。

thoroughfare.example: The busy thoroughfare was full of cars and people during the morning rush.
thoroughfare.exampleZh: 早晨高峰时段，这条繁忙的主干道上满是汽车和行人。

thoroughly.example: The teacher thoroughly explained the lesson so every student could understand it.
thoroughly.exampleZh: 老师彻底讲解了这节课，让每个学生都能听懂。

those.example: Those are my books on the table near the window.
those.exampleZh: 那些是我放在窗边桌子上的书。

though.example: Though it was raining, we still went out for a walk.
though.exampleZh: 虽然下雨了，我们还是出去散步了。

thought.example: A good thought came to me while I was walking home.
thought.exampleZh: 我走路回家时，一个好想法出现在我脑海中。

thoughtful.example: She is a thoughtful friend who always remembers my birthday and asks how I am.
thoughtful.exampleZh: 她是一个体贴的朋友，总是记得我的生日并问我过得怎么样。

thousand.example: There are more than a thousand people in the park today.
thousand.exampleZh: 今天公园里有一千多人。

thrall.example: He lived in thrall to fear and could not make his own choices.
thrall.exampleZh: 他活在恐惧的奴役中，无法做出自己的选择。

thrash.example: The strong team will thrash the weak team in the final game.
thrash.exampleZh: 强队将在决赛中彻底击败弱队。

thread.example: She used a thin thread to sew the button back onto her coat.
thread.exampleZh: 她用一根细线把纽扣重新缝到外套上。

threadbare.example: The old sofa looked threadbare after years of daily use by the family.
threadbare.exampleZh: 那张旧沙发在家人每天使用多年后显得磨破了。

threat.example: The dark clouds are a threat to our picnic today.
threat.exampleZh: 乌云对我们今天的野餐是个威胁。

threaten.example: He did not threaten anyone, but his words still scared us.
threaten.exampleZh: 他没有威胁任何人，但他的话仍然让我们害怕。

three.example: There are three books on the small table near the window.
three.exampleZh: 窗边的小桌子上有三本书。

threshold.example: The water rose above the threshold and came into the room.
threshold.exampleZh: 水漫过门槛，流进了房间。

thrift.example: My grandmother always taught us that thrift helps a family save money.
thrift.exampleZh: 我奶奶总是教导我们，节俭能帮助家庭省钱。

thrifty.example: My thrifty grandmother saves money by growing vegetables in her garden.
thrifty.exampleZh: 我节俭的祖母通过在自己的花园里种菜来省钱。

thrill.example: The roller coaster gave me a big thrill that I will never forget.
thrill.exampleZh: 过山车给了我一次巨大的刺激，我永远不会忘记。

thrive.example: These small plants thrive in warm weather and plenty of sunlight.
thrive.exampleZh: 这些小型植物在温暖天气和充足阳光下茁壮成长。

throat.example: My throat hurts a little, so I will drink some warm water.
throat.exampleZh: 我的喉咙有点痛，所以我要喝些温水。

throb.example: My head began to throb after I ran for a long time.
throb.exampleZh: 我跑了很久之后，头开始抽痛。

throne.example: The young prince sat on the throne for the first time.
throne.exampleZh: 年轻的王子第一次坐在王座上。

throng.example: A large throng of people filled the square to watch the show.
throng.exampleZh: 一大群人挤满广场观看表演。

throttle.example: The new rules may throttle small businesses and slow their growth.
throttle.exampleZh: 新规定可能会压制小企业并减缓它们的增长。

through.example: We walked through the old park on our way home.
through.exampleZh: 我们在回家的路上穿过了那个老公园。

throughout.example: The rain kept falling throughout the day and made the streets very wet.
throughout.exampleZh: 雨下了一整天，把街道弄得非常湿。

throw.example: Please throw the ball to me.

thrust.example: He thrust the heavy box forward and it moved across the floor.
thrust.exampleZh: 他猛地把沉重的箱子向前推，它在地板上移动了。

thud.example: The heavy box fell off the table and hit the floor with a loud thud.
thud.exampleZh: 那个沉重的箱子从桌上掉下来，砰的一声重重地砸在地板上。

thug.example: The thug pushed the old man and ran away down the street.
thug.exampleZh: 那个暴徒推倒老人，然后沿街跑掉了。

thumb.example: My thumb hurts after I hit it with a hammer.
thumb.exampleZh: 我的拇指被锤子砸到后很疼。

thump.example: The heavy box fell and hit the floor with a loud thump.
thump.exampleZh: 那个重箱子掉下来，砰的一声砸在地板上。

thunder.example: The loud thunder woke the little boy in the middle of the night.
thunder.exampleZh: 响亮的雷声在半夜吵醒了那个小男孩。

thus.example: The road was closed, and thus we had to take a longer route.
thus.exampleZh: 道路封闭了，因此我们不得不走更长的路线。

thwart.example: Bad weather thwarted our plans to have a picnic in the park.
thwart.exampleZh: 坏天气阻挠了我们在公园野餐的计划。

tick.example: Please tick the box if you agree with our simple plan.
tick.exampleZh: 如果你同意我们简单的计划，请在方框里打勾。

ticket.example: I bought a train ticket for my trip to the city.
ticket.exampleZh: 我为去城里的旅行买了一张火车票。

tickle.example: The little girl laughed when her father tried to tickle her feet.
tickle.exampleZh: 小女孩笑了，因为她爸爸试图挠她的脚。

ticklish.example: My little brother is very ticklish and laughs when I touch his feet.
ticklish.exampleZh: 我弟弟很怕痒，我一碰他的脚他就笑。

tidal.example: The tidal waves are strong near the beach at night.
tidal.exampleZh: 夜晚海滩附近的潮汐浪很大。

tide.example: The tide comes in and the children run back to the sand.
tide.exampleZh: 潮水涨上来，孩子们跑回沙滩。

tidy.example: Please tidy your room before you go out to play with your friends.
tidy.exampleZh: 请在你和朋友出去玩之前整理你的房间。

tie.example: He wears a blue tie to work every day and looks very smart.
tie.exampleZh: 他每天上班都系一条蓝色领带，看起来很精神。

tier.example: This product belongs to the highest tier of our new pricing plan.
tier.exampleZh: 这款产品属于我们新定价方案的最高层级。

tiger.example: The tiger is a big wild cat that lives in the forest.
tiger.exampleZh: 老虎是一种生活在森林里的大型野生猫科动物。

tight.example: The lid is too tight, so I cannot open the jar.
tight.exampleZh: 盖子太紧了，所以我打不开这个罐子。

tightrope.example: Walking on a tightrope is hard and it can be very dangerous.
tightrope.exampleZh: 走钢丝很难，而且可能非常危险。

tile.example: The worker placed a new tile on the roof yesterday morning.
tile.exampleZh: 工人昨天早上在屋顶上铺了一块新瓦片。

till.example: Please wait here till I come back from the store.
till.exampleZh: 请在这里等到我从商店回来。

tillage.example: The farmers use tillage to prepare the soil before planting their crops.
tillage.exampleZh: 农民在种植作物前用耕作来整地。

tilt.example: The old table began to tilt when I put the heavy box on it.
tilt.exampleZh: 当我把重箱子放在上面时，那张旧桌子开始倾斜。

timber.example: The old house was built with strong timber from the forest.
timber.exampleZh: 这座老房子是用森林里结实的木材建造的。

time.example: We had a good time at the park with our friends yesterday.
time.exampleZh: 昨天我们和朋友们在公园玩得很开心。

timid.example: The timid boy did not want to speak in front of the class.
timid.exampleZh: 那个胆小的男孩不想在全班同学面前说话。

tin.example: She opened a tin of soup and poured it into a pot.
tin.exampleZh: 她打开了一罐汤，把它倒进锅里。

tinge.example: A tinge of sadness remained in her voice after the long goodbye.
tinge.exampleZh: 漫长的告别之后，她的声音里仍带着一丝悲伤。

tingle.example: My cheeks tingle when I step into the cold wind.
tingle.exampleZh: 我走进冷风里时，脸颊感到刺痛。

tinker.example: He likes to tinker with old radios in his free time.
tinker.exampleZh: 他喜欢在空闲时间摆弄旧收音机。

tinkle.example: The little bells tinkle softly when the cold wind blows through the trees.
tinkle.exampleZh: 当寒风吹过树林时，小铃铛轻轻叮当作响。

tip.example: She left a small tip on the table and said goodbye.
tip.exampleZh: 她在桌上留了一点小费，然后说了再见。

tirade.example: He gave a long tirade about the broken machine at work.
tirade.exampleZh: 他在工作中就那台坏掉的机器发表了一通长篇激烈的指责。

tire.example: Long hours of work can tire even the strongest and most patient people.
tire.exampleZh: 长时间工作甚至会让最强壮、最有耐心的人感到疲倦。

tissue.example: The doctor looked at the tissue under a microscope.
tissue.exampleZh: 医生在显微镜下观察了这种组织。

titanic.example: The titanic wave crashed over the small boat and threw everyone into the cold sea.
titanic.exampleZh: 巨大的海浪冲过小船，把所有人都抛进了冰冷的海里。

titantic.example: The titantic wave hit the small boat and threw it onto the beach.
titantic.exampleZh: 巨大的海浪击中了小船，把它抛到了海滩上。

tithe.example: In the past, farmers gave a tithe of their crops to the church.
tithe.exampleZh: 过去，农民把收成的十分之一交给教会。

title.example: She put a clear title on the first page of her report.
title.exampleZh: 她在报告的第一页上写了一个清晰的标题。

toad.example: The green toad sat quietly on a wet rock near the pond.
toad.exampleZh: 那只绿色的蟾蜍静静地坐在池塘边一块湿石头上。

toast.example: We had toast and eggs for breakfast before we left home.
toast.exampleZh: 我们离家前早餐吃了烤面包和鸡蛋。

today.example: I have a lot of work to do today.
today.exampleZh: 我今天有很多工作要做。

toe.example: He hurt his big toe while playing football in the park.
toe.exampleZh: 他在公园踢足球时伤到了大脚趾。

together.example: We often cook dinner together and talk about our day.
together.exampleZh: 我们经常一起做晚饭，聊聊我们的一天。

toil.example: Farmers toil in the hot sun to grow food for us.
toil.exampleZh: 农民在烈日下辛勤劳作，为我们种植粮食。

toilet.example: The toilet in our new apartment is very clean and bright.
toilet.exampleZh: 我们新公寓里的马桶非常干净明亮。

token.example: He gave me a token to use on the bus.
token.exampleZh: 他给了我一个代币用来坐公交车。

tolerance.example: Good tolerance helps people live and work together in a peaceful world.
tolerance.exampleZh: 良好的宽容有助于人们在和平的世界中共同生活和工作。

tolerant.example: She is very tolerant of her noisy neighbors and their loud music.
tolerant.exampleZh: 她对吵闹的邻居和他们大声的音乐非常宽容。

tolerate.example: I can tolerate a little noise, but I cannot tolerate rude behavior.
tolerate.exampleZh: 我可以容忍一点噪音，但我不能容忍粗鲁的行为。

toll.example: The new bridge toll is too high for many poor drivers.
toll.exampleZh: 新桥的通行费对许多贫穷司机来说太高了。

tomato.example: I put a red tomato in my salad for lunch today.
tomato.exampleZh: 我今天午餐在沙拉里放了一个红番茄。

tomb.example: The old tomb stands quietly under the large tree near our village.
tomb.exampleZh: 那座古老的坟墓静静地立在我们村庄附近的大树下。

tomography.example: The doctor used tomography to look inside the patient's body.
tomography.exampleZh: 医生用断层扫描来查看病人的身体内部。

tomorrow.example: I will go to the park with my friends tomorrow morning.
tomorrow.exampleZh: 明天早上我会和朋友们去公园。

ton.example: This truck can carry a ton of sand to the building site.
ton.exampleZh: 这辆卡车能把一吨沙子运到建筑工地。

tonality.example: The artist used warm colors to change the tonality of the whole room.
tonality.exampleZh: 这位艺术家用暖色改变了整个房间的色调。

tone.example: His tone was calm and friendly during the whole meeting.
tone.exampleZh: 整个会议期间，他的语气平静而友好。

tongue.example: She burned her tongue while drinking the hot soup at lunch.
tongue.exampleZh: 她午餐喝热汤时烫到了舌头。

tonic.example: The doctor said this tonic would help him feel strong again.
tonic.exampleZh: 医生说这种补药能帮助他重新感到强壮。

tonight.example: I will finish my homework tonight and then watch a movie with my family.
tonight.exampleZh: 我今晚会完成作业，然后和家人一起看电影。

too.example: This bag is too heavy for me to carry home today.
too.exampleZh: 这个包太重了，我今天没法把它带回家。

tool.example: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things at home.
tool.exampleZh: 锤子是在家修理东西的有用工具。

tooth.example: The dentist said my tooth is healthy and I should brush it daily.
tooth.exampleZh: 牙医说我的牙齿很健康，我应该每天刷它。

top.example: The book is on the top shelf near the window.
top.exampleZh: 这本书在窗户附近的顶层架子上。

topic.example: The topic of today's class is very interesting to all students.
topic.exampleZh: 今天课上的话题对所有学生来说都很有趣。

topical.example: The doctor said this topical cream is safe for the skin.
topical.exampleZh: 医生说这种局部药膏对皮肤是安全的。

topography.example: The topography of this area is flat and easy to study.
topography.exampleZh: 这个地区的地形平坦，容易研究。

topology.example: The topology of this network makes it easy for data to move.
topology.exampleZh: 这个网络的拓扑结构使数据易于传输。

topple.example: The strong wind made the old tree topple onto the empty road.
topple.exampleZh: 强风使那棵老树倒在了空荡的路上。

torch.example: He used a torch to find his way through the dark forest.
torch.exampleZh: 他用手电筒在黑暗的森林里找到了路。

torment.example: The bad memories still torment him every single night at home.
torment.exampleZh: 那些糟糕的回忆仍然每晚在家里折磨他。

tornado.example: The tornado destroyed several houses and trees in our small town last night.
tornado.exampleZh: 昨晚，龙卷风摧毁了我们小镇上的几座房屋和树木。

torpid.example: The torpid cat lay on the warm floor all afternoon.
torpid.exampleZh: 那只迟钝的猫整个下午都躺在温暖的地板上。

torpor.example: After the long winter, the bear slowly woke from its deep torpor.
torpor.exampleZh: 漫长冬天过后，那只熊慢慢从深深的蛰伏中醒来。

torrent.example: A sudden torrent of rain filled the small street in minutes.
torrent.exampleZh: 一阵突如其来的暴雨在几分钟内淹没了小街。

torsion.example: The engineer measured the torsion in the metal bar after the heavy load.
torsion.exampleZh: 工程师在重载之后测量了金属杆中的扭转。

tortoise.example: The tortoise walks slowly across the green grass in the garden.
tortoise.exampleZh: 乌龟慢慢地穿过花园里绿色的草地。

tortuous.example: The tortuous road climbed slowly through the green hills behind our small town.
tortuous.exampleZh: 那条曲折的道路缓缓爬过我们小镇后面的青山。

torture.example: The prisoners suffered terrible torture, and their families also felt deep pain.
torture.exampleZh: 囚犯们遭受了可怕的酷刑，他们的家人也深感痛苦。

toss.example: She tossed the ball to her dog in the park.
toss.exampleZh: 她在公园里把球扔给了她的狗。

total.example: The total cost of the trip was more than we expected.
total.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总费用超出了我们的预期。

totalitarian.example: The country was ruled by a totalitarian government for many years.
totalitarian.exampleZh: 这个国家多年来被一个极权政府统治。

totter.example: The old man tottered down the street and almost fell near the corner.
totter.exampleZh: 老人沿街蹒跚而行，在拐角附近差点摔倒。

touch.example: Please do not touch the wet paint on the wall.
touch.exampleZh: 请不要触摸墙上的湿油漆。

touchstone.example: A good test is a touchstone for measuring a student's true ability.
touchstone.exampleZh: 好的测试是衡量学生真实能力的试金石。

tough.example: Learning a new language can be tough, but it is also very rewarding.
tough.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言可能很难，但也非常有收获。

tour.example: We took a short tour of the old city after lunch.
tour.exampleZh: 午饭后我们短途游览了老城区。

tournament.example: Our school team will play in a big tournament next month.
tournament.exampleZh: 我们校队下个月将参加一场大型锦标赛。

tout.example: Some people tout this old medicine as a cure for many common illnesses.
tout.exampleZh: 有些人吹捧这种老药是治疗许多常见病的灵丹妙药。

toward.example: She walked slowly toward the old house at the end of the street.
toward.exampleZh: 她慢慢地朝街道尽头的那座老房子走去。

towel.example: Please put the wet towel in the laundry basket after your shower.
towel.exampleZh: 洗完澡后请把湿毛巾放进洗衣篮里。

tower.example: The old tower stands at the top of the hill.
tower.exampleZh: 那座古老的塔矗立在山顶上。

town.example: The small town is very quiet at night.
town.exampleZh: 这个小镇在夜晚非常安静。

toxic.example: This chemical is toxic to fish and can make the water unsafe.
toxic.exampleZh: 这种化学品对鱼类有毒，并会使水变得不安全。

toxicity.example: The toxicity of this chemical can harm small animals and plants.
toxicity.exampleZh: 这种化学物质的毒性会伤害小动物和植物。

toy.example: The little girl got a new toy for her birthday last week.
toy.exampleZh: 小女孩上周生日时得到了一个新玩具。

trace.example: The police found a trace of the missing car near the river.
trace.exampleZh: 警察在河边发现了失踪汽车的一点痕迹。

track.example: The dog followed the track through the snow to the old house.
track.exampleZh: 那只狗沿着雪地上的足迹一直追到那座老房子。

tract.example: The farmer bought a large tract of land near the river last year.
tract.exampleZh: 农夫去年在河边买了一大片土地。

tractable.example: This problem is tractable because it has only a few simple steps.
tractable.exampleZh: 这个问题很容易处理，因为它只有几个简单的步骤。

tractor.example: The farmer drove his old tractor across the field to pull a heavy cart.
tractor.exampleZh: 农民开着旧拖拉机穿过田地，去拉一辆沉重的推车。

trade.example: My father works in the trade of fresh fruit and vegetables.
trade.exampleZh: 我父亲从事新鲜水果和蔬菜的贸易。

tradition.example: It is a family tradition to eat dumplings together on New Year's Eve.
tradition.exampleZh: 除夕夜一起吃饺子是我们家的一个传统。

traffic.example: There is too much traffic on the road during rush hour.
traffic.exampleZh: 高峰时段路上的交通太拥堵了。

tragedy.example: The fire was a terrible tragedy that changed the whole town.
tragedy.exampleZh: 那场火灾是一场可怕的悲剧，改变了整个小镇。

trail.example: We followed a narrow trail through the quiet green forest to the lake.
trail.exampleZh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路穿过安静的绿色森林来到湖边。

train.example: I take the train to work every morning with my sister.
train.exampleZh: 我每天早上和姐姐一起坐火车上班。

trait.example: Patience is an important trait for a good teacher.
trait.exampleZh: 耐心是一名好老师的重要特质。

traitor.example: Everyone in the small town called him a traitor after the war.
traitor.exampleZh: 战后，小镇上的每个人都称他为叛徒。

trajectory.example: The rocket's trajectory changed suddenly after it entered the thicker atmosphere near the coast.
trajectory.exampleZh: 火箭进入海岸附近更厚的大气层后，其轨迹突然改变。

tram.example: We took a tram to the old part of the city.
tram.exampleZh: 我们乘有轨电车去了老城区。

tramp.example: The old man tramped through the muddy field on his way home.
tramp.exampleZh: 那位老人踩着泥泞的田地走回家。

trample.example: Please do not trample the flowers in the park.
trample.exampleZh: 请不要践踏公园里的花。

trance.example: She sat in a trance and did not hear me call.
trance.exampleZh: 她坐在那里出神，没有听见我叫她。

tranquil.example: The lake is tranquil in the early morning before the birds wake up.
tranquil.exampleZh: 清晨鸟儿醒来之前，湖面十分宁静。

transaction.example: The bank confirmed the transaction and sent me a receipt by email.
transaction.exampleZh: 银行确认了这笔交易，并通过电子邮件给我发了一张收据。

transcend.example: Great music can transcend language and touch people from many different countries.
transcend.exampleZh: 伟大的音乐能够超越语言，打动来自许多不同国家的人。

transcript.example: She sent her transcript to the university with her application.
transcript.exampleZh: 她把成绩单连同申请表一起寄给了大学。

transducer.example: The doctor used a transducer to measure the sound waves inside the patient's chest.
transducer.exampleZh: 医生用换能器测量病人胸腔内的声波。

transect.example: The team used a long rope to mark the transect across the field.
transect.exampleZh: 团队用一根长绳在田野上标出样带。

transfer.example: I need to transfer some money to my sister today.
transfer.exampleZh: 我今天需要转一些钱给我妹妹。

transform.example: The new app can transform a simple photo into a beautiful painting.
transform.exampleZh: 这款新应用能把一张普通照片变成一幅美丽的画。

transient.example: The transient rain stopped before we reached the park.
transient.exampleZh: 短暂的雨在我们到达公园前停了。

transistor.example: This small transistor helps the radio work well every day.
transistor.exampleZh: 这个小晶体管帮助收音机每天正常工作。

transit.example: The city needs better public transit for people who travel to work every day.
transit.exampleZh: 这座城市需要更好的公共交通，方便每天通勤的人。

transition.example: The transition from school to work can be difficult for many young people.
transition.exampleZh: 从学校到工作的过渡对许多年轻人来说可能很困难。

translate.example: Can you translate this short letter into simple English for me?
translate.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这封短信翻译成简单的英语吗？

translucent.example: The translucent glass lets soft light into the small room.
translucent.exampleZh: 这块半透明的玻璃让柔和的光线照进小房间。

transmission.example: The transmission of the disease can be stopped by washing your hands often.
transmission.exampleZh: 勤洗手可以阻止这种疾病的传播。

transmutation.example: The old story tells of a strange transmutation of stone into gold.
transmutation.exampleZh: 这个古老的故事讲述了石头变成黄金的奇异嬗变。

transmute.example: Alchemists once tried to transmute common metals into gold.
transmute.exampleZh: 炼金术士曾试图将普通金属变成黄金。

transparent.example: The glass is transparent, so we can see the garden through it.
transparent.exampleZh: 玻璃是透明的，所以我们可以透过它看到花园。

transplant.example: They will transplant the young tree to a sunny garden next spring.
transplant.exampleZh: 他们明年春天会把那棵小树移栽到阳光充足的花园里。

transport.example: The company uses trucks to transport goods to nearby cities every day.
transport.exampleZh: 这家公司每天用卡车把货物运到附近的城市。

trapezoid.example: A trapezoid has four sides, and only two of them are parallel.
trapezoid.exampleZh: 梯形有四条边，其中只有两条边平行。

trauma.example: He still feels deep trauma from the car accident last year.
trauma.exampleZh: 他至今仍因去年的车祸感到深深的创伤。

travel.example: Many people travel to new cities by train during the summer.
travel.exampleZh: 许多人在夏天乘火车去新的城市旅行。

traverse.example: We will traverse the wide forest on foot tomorrow morning.
traverse.exampleZh: 明天早上我们将徒步横穿这片宽阔的森林。

travesty.example: The trial was a travesty of justice and everyone knew it.
travesty.exampleZh: 这场审判是对正义的歪曲，人人皆知。

trawl.example: They trawl the river every morning to catch fresh fish.
trawl.exampleZh: 他们每天早上在河里拖网捕鱼。

tray.example: She put the cups on a tray and carried them to the table.
tray.exampleZh: 她把杯子放在托盘上，端到了桌子旁。

treacherous.example: The treacherous path was hard to cross after the storm.
treacherous.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，那条危险的小路很难穿过。

tread.example: Please tread carefully on the wet floor near the stairs.
tread.exampleZh: 请在楼梯附近的湿地板小心行走。

treason.example: He was found guilty of treason after he helped the enemy.
treason.exampleZh: 他帮助敌人后，被判叛国罪。

treasure.example: She keeps her old letters as a treasure and reads them often.
treasure.exampleZh: 她把旧信件当作珍宝珍藏，并经常阅读它们。

treasury.example: The treasury keeps the country's money safe and pays for many public services.
treasury.exampleZh: 国库保管国家的资金，并为许多公共服务支付费用。

treat.example: She treats every child with great care and kindness.
treat.exampleZh: 她非常关心和友善地对待每个孩子。

treatise.example: He wrote a short treatise about the history of modern art.
treatise.exampleZh: 他写了一篇关于现代艺术史的简短论述。

treaty.example: The two countries signed a peace treaty after many years of war.
treaty.exampleZh: 两国在多年战争后签署了一项和平条约。

treble.example: The company hopes to treble its sales in the next three years.
treble.exampleZh: 公司希望在未来三年内使销售额增至三倍。

tree.example: The old tree in our garden gives us cool shade in summer.
tree.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老树在夏天为我们提供阴凉。

trek.example: We had to trek through the hills for three long days.
trek.exampleZh: 我们不得不长途跋涉穿过山丘，走了整整三天。

tremble.example: Her hands began to tremble when she stood in front of the large crowd.
tremble.exampleZh: 当她站在一大群人面前时，她的双手开始颤抖。

tremendous.example: The team made a tremendous effort and won the game in the end.
tremendous.exampleZh: 这支队伍付出了巨大的努力，最终赢得了比赛。

tremor.example: A small tremor shook the town early this morning.
tremor.exampleZh: 今天清晨一场小地震震动了这个小镇。

trench.example: The workers dug a deep trench along the road to carry away rainwater.
trench.exampleZh: 工人们在路边挖了一条深沟来排走雨水。

trend.example: More and more young people follow this new trend in fashion.
trend.exampleZh: 越来越多的年轻人追随这一新的时尚趋势。

trespass.example: Please do not trespass on our land because it is private property.
trespass.exampleZh: 请不要侵入我们的土地，因为这是私人财产。

trial.example: The new drug will go on trial next month in several big hospitals.
trial.exampleZh: 这种新药下个月将在几家大医院进行试验。

triangle.example: The child drew a red triangle on the white paper.
triangle.exampleZh: 孩子在白纸上画了一个红色的三角形。

triangular.example: The tent has a triangular shape that is easy to set up.
triangular.exampleZh: 这个帐篷呈三角形，很容易搭建。

tribal.example: The tribal leaders met to discuss the new rules for their village.
tribal.exampleZh: 部落首领开会讨论他们村庄的新规定。

tribe.example: The small tribe lived near the river and shared food every day.
tribe.exampleZh: 这个小部落住在河边，每天分享食物。

tributary.example: The small river is a tributary of the large river near our town.
tributary.exampleZh: 这条小河是我们镇附近那条大河的支流。

tribute.example: They paid tribute to the brave soldiers with a simple and moving ceremony.
tribute.exampleZh: 他们用一场简单而感人的仪式向勇敢的士兵致敬。

trick.example: He used a clever trick to open the old box quickly.
trick.exampleZh: 他用了一个聪明的诡计很快打开了那个旧盒子。

trickle.example: A little water began to trickle down the cold glass window.
trickle.exampleZh: 一点水开始顺着冰冷的玻璃窗往下淌。

tricky.example: This tricky question is hard for most of the new students.
tricky.exampleZh: 这个棘手的问题对大多数新生来说很难。

tricyclic.example: The doctor gave him a tricyclic drug for his severe nerve pain.
tricyclic.exampleZh: 医生给他开了一种三环类药物来治疗他的严重神经痛。

trifle.example: Do not waste your time worrying about such a small trifle.
trifle.exampleZh: 不要浪费时间担心这样的小事。

trifling.example: Do not waste your time on such a trifling problem today.
trifling.exampleZh: 不要把你的时间浪费在这样一个微不足道的问题上。

trigger.example: A loud noise can trigger a panic attack in some people.
trigger.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音可能会在某些人身上触发惊恐发作。

trilogy.example: The director made a famous trilogy about a young wizard and his friends.
trilogy.exampleZh: 这位导演拍了一部关于一位年轻巫师和他的朋友的著名三部曲。

trim.example: I need to trim the bushes before my friends come over tomorrow.
trim.exampleZh: 我需要在朋友们明天来之前修剪灌木。

trinity.example: The idea of the trinity is central to Christian belief.
trinity.exampleZh: 三位一体的观念是基督教信仰的核心。

trinket.example: She bought a small trinket at the market for her sister.
trinket.exampleZh: 她在市场上给妹妹买了一个小饰品。

trip.example: We took a short trip to the beach last weekend.
trip.exampleZh: 上周末我们去海边做了一次短途旅行。

triple.example: The company plans to triple its sales in the next five years.
triple.exampleZh: 公司计划在未来五年内将销售额增至三倍。

trite.example: His advice was trite and did not help us solve the problem.
trite.exampleZh: 他的建议陈腐，没有帮助我们解决问题。

triumph.example: She felt a great triumph after she won the race.
triumph.exampleZh: 她赢得比赛后感到极大的胜利喜悦。

trivia.example: My brother loves sharing useless trivia about old movies at dinner.
trivia.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜欢在晚饭时分享关于老电影的无用冷知识。

trivial.example: This is a trivial problem that we can solve quickly.
trivial.exampleZh: 这是一个琐碎的问题，我们可以很快解决。

trolley.example: I pushed the heavy trolley through the busy supermarket and found the milk.
trolley.exampleZh: 我推着沉重的手推车穿过繁忙的超市，找到了牛奶。

troop.example: The troop marched slowly down the road toward the small village.
troop.exampleZh: 这支部队沿着道路缓慢地向小村庄行进。

trophic.example: The trophic levels in this small pond help us understand how life feeds.
trophic.exampleZh: 这个小池塘里的营养级帮助我们理解生命如何获取食物。

trophy.example: He lifted the golden trophy above his head and smiled at the crowd.
trophy.exampleZh: 他把金色的奖杯举过头顶，对着人群微笑。

tropic.example: The Tropic of Cancer lies north of the equator.
tropic.exampleZh: 北回归线位于赤道以北。

tropical.example: The weather is hot and tropical in this small island town.
tropical.exampleZh: 这个小小的岛屿小镇天气炎热，充满热带气息。

trot.example: The little horse began to trot across the green field toward its mother.
trot.exampleZh: 小马开始小跑着穿过绿色的田野，朝它的母亲跑去。

trouble.example: I had some trouble finding the right bus this morning.
trouble.exampleZh: 今天早上我找对公交车时遇到了一些麻烦。

trough.example: The water in the trough was too cold for the animals to drink.
trough.exampleZh: 水槽里的水太冷了，动物们不能喝。

trounce.example: Our team trounced the visitors by five goals in the final game.
trounce.exampleZh: 我们在决赛中以五球大胜客队。

troupe.example: The troupe of dancers performed a beautiful show for the whole town last night.
troupe.exampleZh: 昨晚，这个舞蹈团为全镇人表演了一场精彩的节目。

trousers.example: He bought a new pair of trousers for the school party last week.
trousers.exampleZh: 他上周为学校派对买了一条新裤子。

truce.example: The two sides agreed to a truce after many long talks.
truce.exampleZh: 双方在多次长时间会谈后同意休战。

truck.example: The truck is carrying a lot of boxes to the new store.
truck.exampleZh: 这辆卡车正载着许多箱子去新商店。

trudge.example: We had to trudge through the deep snow for two long hours.
trudge.exampleZh: 我们不得不在深雪中艰难地走了两个小时。

true.example: It is true that she works very hard every day.
true.exampleZh: 她每天工作非常努力，这是真的。

truism.example: It is a truism that people need clean water and fresh air.
truism.exampleZh: 人们需要干净的水和新鲜空气，这是不言而喻的真理。

trumpet.example: She plays the trumpet in our school band every Friday.
trumpet.exampleZh: 她每周五在我们学校乐队里吹小号。

truncate.example: The editor had to truncate the long article before printing it.
truncate.exampleZh: 编辑在打印前不得不删节这篇长文章。

trunk.example: The elephant used its long trunk to pick up a small branch.
trunk.exampleZh: 大象用长长的鼻子捡起了一根小树枝。

trust.example: I trust my best friend because he always tells me the truth.
trust.exampleZh: 我相信我最好的朋友，因为他总是对我说真话。

trustee.example: The trustee must keep the money safe for the children.
trustee.exampleZh: 受托人必须为孩子们妥善保管这笔钱。

truth.example: The truth is that I forgot to bring my book today.
truth.exampleZh: 事实是我今天忘记带书了。

try.example: I will try to finish my homework before dinner tonight.
try.exampleZh: 我会努力在今晚晚饭前完成作业。

tub.example: She filled the tub with warm water and washed the dirty clothes.
tub.exampleZh: 她把浴缸装满温水，洗了脏衣服。

tube.example: The nurse used a small tube to give the patient some water.
tube.exampleZh: 护士用一根小管子给病人喂了一些水。

tuck.example: She helped tuck the children into bed before the long trip.
tuck.exampleZh: 长途旅行前，她帮忙把孩子们安顿上床睡觉。

tug.example: The little boy tried to tug the heavy box across the floor.
tug.exampleZh: 小男孩试着把沉重的箱子拖过地板。

tuition.example: My parents pay the tuition for my college classes every year.
tuition.exampleZh: 我父母每年为我支付大学课程的学费。

tulip.example: I planted a red tulip in my garden last spring.
tulip.exampleZh: 去年春天我在花园里种了一株红色郁金香。

tumble.example: The little boy tripped and tumbled down the soft grassy hill.
tumble.exampleZh: 小男孩绊了一下，从柔软的草坡上滚了下来。

tumor.example: The doctor found a small tumor in his left lung last week.
tumor.exampleZh: 医生上周在他的左肺发现了一个小肿瘤。

tumult.example: The loud tumult in the street woke me up early this morning.
tumult.exampleZh: 街上响亮的喧嚣一大早就把我吵醒了。

tune.example: He can tune the old guitar and play a simple song.
tune.exampleZh: 他能给这把旧吉他调音，并弹一首简单的歌。

tunnel.example: The train went through a long dark tunnel under the mountain.
tunnel.exampleZh: 火车穿过山下一段又长又黑的隧道。

turbid.example: The river looked turbid after the heavy rain.
turbid.exampleZh: 大雨过后，河水看起来很浑浊。

turbine.example: The wind turns the turbine and makes electricity for the small town.
turbine.exampleZh: 风转动涡轮机，为这个小镇发电。

turbulence.example: The plane shook badly because of strong turbulence during the storm.
turbulence.exampleZh: 由于暴风雨中的强烈湍流，飞机剧烈颠簸。

turbulent.example: The turbulent river was too dangerous for the small boat to cross.
turbulent.exampleZh: 这条湍急的河流太危险，小船无法通过。

turgid.example: The turgid speech was long and hard for us to understand.
turgid.exampleZh: 那篇浮夸的演讲冗长，让我们很难理解。

turmoil.example: The country was in great turmoil after the sudden change of government.
turmoil.exampleZh: 政府突然更迭后，这个国家陷入了巨大的动荡。

turn.example: Please turn left at the next corner and wait for me there.
turn.exampleZh: 请在下一个路口左转，并在那里等我。

turnover.example: The company's annual turnover increased after it hired more sales staff.
turnover.exampleZh: 公司招聘更多销售人员后，年营业额增长了。

turpitude.example: His act of turpitude shocked the whole village and hurt many people.
turpitude.exampleZh: 他的卑劣行为震惊了整个村庄，也伤害了许多人。

turret.example: The old castle has a tall turret near the main gate.
turret.exampleZh: 这座古老的城堡在大门附近有一座高高的塔楼。

turtle.example: The turtle swam slowly across the clear blue water.
turtle.exampleZh: 那只海龟在清澈湛蓝的水中慢慢游动。

tusk.example: The elephant has a long white tusk on each side.
tusk.exampleZh: 这头大象两侧各有一根长长的白色长牙。

tutor.example: The tutor explains difficult problems to me in simple words.
tutor.exampleZh: 导师用简单的话给我讲解难题。

tutorial.example: Our teacher gave a short tutorial on how to use the new software.
tutorial.exampleZh: 我们的老师就如何使用新软件做了一个简短的辅导。

twilight.example: The old man liked to sit outside and watch the twilight after dinner.
twilight.exampleZh: 那位老人喜欢晚饭后坐在外面看暮光。

twin.example: My twin brother and I go to the same school every day.
twin.exampleZh: 我的双胞胎兄弟和我每天去同一所学校。

twinge.example: She felt a sharp twinge in her knee after the long run.
twinge.exampleZh: 长跑之后，她感到膝盖一阵刺痛。

twist.example: She had to twist the lid hard to open the jar.
twist.exampleZh: 她不得不使劲扭动盖子才能打开罐子。

twitch.example: His left eye began to twitch after he drank too much coffee.
twitch.exampleZh: 他喝了太多咖啡后，左眼开始抽搐。

twitter.example: The little birds twitter in the trees every morning.
twitter.exampleZh: 小鸟们每天早上在树上叽叽喳喳地叫。

two.example: I have two apples and my sister has two oranges in her bag.
two.exampleZh: 我有两个苹果，我妹妹的包里有两只橙子。

tycoon.example: The old tycoon built a huge company and gave much money to schools.
tycoon.exampleZh: 这位年迈的大亨建立了一家大公司，并向学校捐了很多钱。

type.example: I like this type of music because it is very relaxing and fun.
type.exampleZh: 我喜欢这种类型的音乐，因为它非常放松又有趣。

typhoid.example: Typhoid is a serious disease that can spread through dirty food and water.
typhoid.exampleZh: 伤寒是一种严重的疾病，可通过不洁食物和水传播。

typhoon.example: The strong typhoon hit our town and damaged many old houses last night.
typhoon.exampleZh: 昨晚强台风袭击了我们的小镇，损坏了许多老房子。

typical.example: This is a typical day in our small and quiet town.
typical.exampleZh: 这是我们安静小镇上典型的一天。

typify.example: These old houses typify the quiet life of the small town.
typify.exampleZh: 这些老房子代表了这座小镇宁静的生活。

typology.example: The study of language typology helps us compare different grammar systems.
typology.exampleZh: 语言类型学的研究帮助我们比较不同的语法系统。

tyranny.example: The people rose up to end the tyranny of the cruel king.
tyranny.exampleZh: 人民奋起反抗那位残酷国王的暴政。

tyrant.example: The cruel tyrant made everyone in the small town afraid of him.
tyrant.exampleZh: 那个残暴的暴君让小镇上的每个人都害怕他。

ubiquitous.example: Smartphones are ubiquitous today, and almost everyone uses them in daily life.
ubiquitous.exampleZh: 如今智能手机无处不在，几乎每个人在日常生活中都会使用它们。

ubiquity.example: The ubiquity of smartphones has changed how people talk and share news.
ubiquity.exampleZh: 智能手机的无处不在改变了人们交谈和分享新闻的方式。

ugly.example: That old building is ugly, but many people still take photos of it.
ugly.exampleZh: 那座旧楼很难看，但许多人仍然给它拍照。

ulterior.example: He had an ulterior motive when he offered to help us.
ulterior.exampleZh: 他提出帮助我们时别有用心的。

ultimate.example: The ultimate goal of the team is to win the final game.
ultimate.exampleZh: 这支队伍的最终目标是赢得最后一场比赛。

ultimatum.example: The boss gave the workers an ultimatum to return to work tomorrow.
ultimatum.exampleZh: 老板给工人们下了最后通牒，要求他们明天复工。

ultra.example: He has an ultra simple plan that almost everyone can understand.
ultra.exampleZh: 他有一个极简单的计划，几乎每个人都能理解。

ultrasonic.example: The doctor used an ultrasonic machine to look at her heart.
ultrasonic.exampleZh: 医生用一台超声仪器检查她的心脏。

ultraviolet.example: Ultraviolet light from the sun can hurt your skin if you stay outside too long.
ultraviolet.exampleZh: 太阳发出的紫外线如果长时间待在户外会伤害你的皮肤。

umbrella.example: I always carry an umbrella in my bag when the sky looks gray.
umbrella.exampleZh: 当天色看起来阴沉时，我总会在包里带一把伞。

umpire.example: The umpire made a fair call and the players accepted it quickly.
umpire.exampleZh: 裁判做出了公正的判罚，球员们很快接受了。

unable.example: I am unable to come to the meeting because I am very busy today.
unable.exampleZh: 我今天很忙，所以无法来参加会议。

unanimity.example: The small team reached unanimity after a long and friendly discussion.
unanimity.exampleZh: 这个小组在长时间友好讨论后达成了一致同意。

unanimous.example: The whole class was unanimous in choosing a topic for the science project.
unanimous.exampleZh: 全班在选定科学项目的主题上意见一致。

unanswered.example: The teacher asked a question, but it remained unanswered for a long time.
unanswered.exampleZh: 老师问了一个问题，但它很长时间都没有得到回答。

unassuming.example: He is an unassuming man who never talks about his own success.
unassuming.exampleZh: 他是一个谦逊的人，从不谈论自己的成功。

unauthorized.example: The guard stopped an unauthorized person from entering the building.
unauthorized.exampleZh: 警卫阻止了一名未经授权的人进入大楼。

unavailable.example: The book you want is unavailable at the library today.
unavailable.exampleZh: 你想要的那本书今天在图书馆借不到。

unavoidable.example: Some mistakes are unavoidable when you learn a new language.
