unavoidable.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言时，有些错误是不可避免的。

unaware.example: She was unaware that the meeting had been moved to Monday.
unaware.exampleZh: 她不知道会议已被改到星期一。

unbearable.example: The heat in the small room was unbearable for everyone.
unbearable.exampleZh: 小房间里的高温让每个人都难以忍受。

unbiased.example: A good judge should stay unbiased when listening to both sides of a case.
unbiased.exampleZh: 一位好法官在听取案件双方陈述时应保持公正。

uncanny.example: It was uncanny how she knew my name before I told her.
uncanny.exampleZh: 在我告诉她之前她就知道我的名字，这太不可思议了。

uncertainty.example: There is still some uncertainty about the time of the meeting.
uncertainty.exampleZh: 会议时间仍有一些不确定性。

uncharted.example: They got lost in an uncharted part of the forest.
uncharted.exampleZh: 他们在森林中一片未标明的区域迷路了。

uncle.example: My uncle lives in a small town near the sea.
uncle.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在海边的一个小镇上。

uncomfortable.example: I feel uncomfortable when I wear this old coat in summer.
uncomfortable.exampleZh: 夏天穿这件旧外套时我感到不舒服。

unconscious.example: The patient was unconscious for two hours after the accident.
unconscious.exampleZh: 事故后，病人昏迷了两个小时。

unconventional.example: She has an unconventional way of solving simple problems at work.
unconventional.exampleZh: 她有一种非常规的方式来解决工作中的简单问题。

uncooperative.example: The new student was uncooperative and refused to join our group work.
uncooperative.exampleZh: 那个新学生不合作，拒绝参加我们的小组活动。

uncountable.example: The teacher explained that water is an uncountable noun in English.
uncountable.exampleZh: 老师解释说，water 在英语中是不可数名词。

uncover.example: The police worked hard to uncover the truth about the missing money.
uncover.exampleZh: 警方努力揭开失踪钱款的真相。

undeniable.example: It is undeniable that regular exercise helps people stay healthy and happy.
undeniable.exampleZh: 不可否认，经常锻炼有助于人们保持健康和快乐。

underestimate.example: Many people underestimate how much time it takes to learn a new language.
underestimate.exampleZh: 很多人低估了学习一门新语言需要多少时间。

undergo.example: Many patients undergo surgery every year and need time to rest.
undergo.exampleZh: 许多病人每年都要接受手术，并且需要时间休息。

undergraduate.example: My sister is an undergraduate at a large university in the city.
undergraduate.exampleZh: 我姐姐是城里一所大型大学的本科生。

underground.example: The underground group met in secret to plan a peaceful protest.
underground.exampleZh: 这个地下组织秘密会面，计划一场和平抗议。

underlie.example: Many small choices underlie the success of a simple daily habit.
underlie.exampleZh: 许多小的选择构成了一个简单日常习惯成功的基础。

underline.example: Please underline the important words in this short text before you read it.
underline.exampleZh: 请在你阅读之前，在这篇短文中重要的词下面划线。

underlying.example: The doctor found an underlying cause for his sudden and serious pain.
underlying.exampleZh: 医生找到了他突发剧痛的潜在原因。

undermine.example: Too much stress can undermine your health and make it hard to focus.
undermine.exampleZh: 过多的压力会削弱你的健康，并让你难以集中注意力。

underscore.example: The teacher used a red pen to underscore the most important words in the text.
underscore.exampleZh: 老师用红笔在课文里最重要的词下面画了线。

understand.example: I can understand why you feel tired after such a long day.
understand.exampleZh: 我能理解你过了这么漫长的一天后为什么会感到疲倦。

understandable.example: Her explanation was clear and understandable to everyone in the class.
understandable.exampleZh: 她的解释清晰易懂，班上每个人都能理解。

undertake.example: We will undertake the new project next month.
undertake.exampleZh: 我们下个月将着手这个新项目。

undertaking.example: Starting a small business is a difficult undertaking for many young people.
undertaking.exampleZh: 创办小企业对许多年轻人来说是一项艰难的事业。

undo.example: Please undo the last change and save the file again.
undo.exampleZh: 请撤销上一次更改并再次保存文件。

undoubtedly.example: She is undoubtedly the best player on our team this year.
undoubtedly.exampleZh: 她无疑是今年我们队里最好的球员。

uneasy.example: She felt uneasy about walking home alone in the dark.
uneasy.exampleZh: 她对于天黑后独自走回家感到不安。

unemployment.example: The unemployment rate is high because many people lost their jobs last year.
unemployment.exampleZh: 失业率高是因为去年许多人失去了工作。

unequal.example: The two teams were unequal in strength, so the game was not fair.
unequal.exampleZh: 两支球队实力不平等，所以比赛不公平。

uneven.example: The ground here is uneven, so be careful when you walk.
uneven.exampleZh: 这里的地面不平坦，所以你走路时要小心。

unexpected.example: The unexpected rain made everyone run back to the house quickly.
unexpected.exampleZh: 这场意外的雨让大家赶紧跑回了家。

unfair.example: It is unfair to blame him for a mistake he did not make.
unfair.exampleZh: 把不是他犯的错误归咎于他是不公平的。

unfamiliar.example: She felt nervous in the unfamiliar city on her first day.
unfamiliar.exampleZh: 第一天在那座陌生的城市里，她感到紧张。

unfold.example: She opened the letter and watched the story slowly unfold before her eyes.
unfold.exampleZh: 她打开信，看着故事在她眼前慢慢展开。

unforeseen.example: The heavy rain caused some unforeseen problems for the travelers.
unforeseen.exampleZh: 大雨给旅行者带来了一些未预见到的麻烦。

unfortunate.example: It was unfortunate that we missed the last bus home.
unfortunate.exampleZh: 很遗憾我们错过了回家的末班公交车。

unfounded.example: The teacher said the rumor about our test was completely unfounded.
unfounded.exampleZh: 老师说关于我们考试的谣言完全没有根据。

unhappy.example: She was unhappy because her best friend moved to another city last week.
unhappy.exampleZh: 她很不开心，因为她最好的朋友上周搬到了另一个城市。

uniform.example: All the students in my class wear the same blue school uniform.
uniform.exampleZh: 我班所有学生都穿同样的蓝色校服。

unify.example: The new leader hopes to unify the team before the big match.
unify.exampleZh: 新队长希望在大赛前把队伍团结起来。

unilateral.example: The company made a unilateral decision to close the small office.
unilateral.exampleZh: 公司单方面决定关闭那个小办公室。

unimaginable.example: The damage from the storm was unimaginable to everyone in the small town.
unimaginable.exampleZh: 这场风暴造成的破坏对小镇上的每个人来说都难以想象。

union.example: The workers formed a union to protect their rights and improve their pay.
union.exampleZh: 工人们成立了一个工会来保护自己的权利并提高工资。

unique.example: Each person has a unique story that makes life more interesting.
unique.exampleZh: 每个人都有独特的故事，让生活更有趣。

unison.example: The whole class sang the song in unison and everyone enjoyed it.
unison.exampleZh: 全班同学齐声唱这首歌，大家都很喜欢。

unit.example: Each unit in this building has two bedrooms and a small kitchen.
unit.exampleZh: 这栋楼里的每个单元都有两间卧室和一个小厨房。

unite.example: The workers unite to ask for better pay and safer working conditions.
unite.exampleZh: 工人们联合起来，要求更好的薪酬和更安全的工作条件。

unity.example: The team showed great unity when they faced a difficult problem together.
unity.exampleZh: 当团队共同面对一个难题时，他们表现出了极大的团结。

universal.example: The idea of fairness is universal and important to almost everyone.
universal.exampleZh: 公平的理念是普遍的，对几乎所有人都很重要。

universe.example: Many people wonder how the universe began and what it is made of.
universe.exampleZh: 许多人想知道宇宙是如何开始的，以及它是由什么构成的。

university.example: My sister studies at a large university in the north.
university.exampleZh: 我姐姐在北方一所很大的大学读书。

unjust.example: The teacher said the rule was unjust and changed it for us.
unjust.exampleZh: 老师说这条规则不公正，并为我们改了它。

unkind.example: It is unkind to laugh at someone who makes a mistake.
unkind.exampleZh: 嘲笑犯错的人是不友善的。

unknown.example: The cause of the strange noise is still unknown to everyone.
unknown.exampleZh: 那奇怪噪音的原因对大家来说仍然未知。

unless.example: You cannot go out unless you finish your homework first.
unless.exampleZh: 除非你先完成作业，否则你不能出去。

unlike.example: Unlike my sister, I really enjoy reading books before bed.
unlike.exampleZh: 不像我姐姐，我很喜欢睡前读书。

unlikely.example: It is unlikely that they will finish the work today.
unlikely.exampleZh: 他们今天不太可能完成这项工作。

unlimited.example: The internet gives us unlimited access to information.
unlimited.exampleZh: 互联网让我们可以无限获取信息。

unlock.example: The key can unlock the old door quickly.
unlock.exampleZh: 这把钥匙能很快打开那扇旧门。

unmatched.example: Her skill in the game was unmatched by any other player.
unmatched.exampleZh: 她在这项游戏中的技巧是其他任何玩家都无法比拟的。

unmistakable.example: The difference between the two pictures was unmistakable to everyone in the room.
unmistakable.exampleZh: 这两幅图之间的差别对房间里的每个人来说都清清楚楚。

unnatural.example: It feels unnatural to wear a heavy coat in summer.
unnatural.exampleZh: 夏天穿厚外套让人感觉很不自然。

unnecessary.example: Buying a new car is unnecessary because your old one still works well.
unnecessary.exampleZh: 买新车是不必要的，因为你的旧车还很好用。

unofficial.example: Many people still share unofficial news about the event on social media.
unofficial.exampleZh: 许多人仍在社交媒体上分享关于该活动的非官方消息。

unprecedented.example: The team faced an unprecedented problem and asked for help from everyone.
unprecedented.exampleZh: 团队遇到了前所未有的问题，并向所有人求助。

unpredictable.example: The weather in spring is unpredictable, so we always bring a jacket.
unpredictable.exampleZh: 春天的天气变幻莫测，所以我们总是带一件夹克。

unproductive.example: Long meetings without a clear plan are often unproductive and waste everyone's time.
unproductive.exampleZh: 没有明确计划的冗长会议往往效率低下，浪费大家的时间。

unprofessional.example: It is unprofessional to answer the phone during an important meeting.
unprofessional.exampleZh: 在重要会议期间接电话是不专业的。

unqualified.example: He is unqualified for the job because he has no experience.
unqualified.exampleZh: 他不胜任这份工作，因为他没有经验。

unquestionable.example: Her hard work and honesty made her success unquestionable to everyone.
unquestionable.exampleZh: 她的努力和诚实让所有人都觉得她的成功是毫无疑问的。

unravel.example: We must unravel the mystery before the old man leaves.
unravel.exampleZh: 我们必须在老人离开之前解开这个谜团。

unrealistic.example: It is unrealistic to think you can learn a language in one week.
unrealistic.exampleZh: 认为自己能在一周内学会一门语言是不切实际的。

unreasonable.example: It is unreasonable to expect one person to do all this work.
unreasonable.exampleZh: 指望一个人做所有这些工作是不合理的。

unresolved.example: The problem is still unresolved, so we need to talk about it today.
unresolved.exampleZh: 这个问题仍未解决，所以我们需要今天讨论一下。

unrest.example: The city had much unrest after the new law was passed.
unrest.exampleZh: 新法律通过后，这座城市出现了很多动荡。

unsatisfactory.example: The test results were unsatisfactory, so we decided to try again.
unsatisfactory.exampleZh: 测试结果不能令人满意，所以我们决定再试一次。

unscientific.example: His claim about the new medicine is unscientific and lacks any real evidence.
unscientific.exampleZh: 他关于这种新药的说法是不科学的，而且缺乏任何真实证据。

unsettle.example: The sudden bad news began to unsettle her mind and she could not sleep.
unsettle.exampleZh: 这个突然的坏消息开始让她心神不宁，她无法入睡。

unsettling.example: The strange noise from the empty room was very unsettling to everyone.
unsettling.exampleZh: 空房间里传来的奇怪声音让每个人都感到非常不安。

unsightly.example: The old factory left an unsightly mess along the river.
unsightly.exampleZh: 那座旧工厂在河边留下了一片难看的杂乱景象。

unsophisticated.example: He is an unsophisticated man who enjoys simple food and quiet walks.
unsophisticated.exampleZh: 他是个不懂世故的人，喜欢简单的食物和安静的散步。

unsound.example: The old bridge is unsound and dangerous for people to cross.
unsound.exampleZh: 这座旧桥不稳固，人们过桥很危险。

unstable.example: The old bridge is unstable, so people should not walk on it.
unstable.exampleZh: 这座旧桥不稳固，所以人们不应该在上面行走。

unsuitable.example: This movie is unsuitable for young children because it is too scary.
unsuitable.exampleZh: 这部电影不适合年幼的孩子，因为它太吓人了。

untangle.example: She tried to untangle the long wires behind her desk.
untangle.exampleZh: 她试着解开书桌后面的长电线。

untie.example: Please help me untie this knot before we go outside.
untie.exampleZh: 请在我们出门前帮我解开这个结。

until.example: We waited at the station until the last train arrived.
until.exampleZh: 我们在车站等到最后一班火车到达。

untrue.example: The story he told us was untrue and made everyone feel upset.
untrue.exampleZh: 他告诉我们的故事是假的，让大家感到不安。

unusual.example: It is unusual to see snow here in summer.
unusual.exampleZh: 这里夏天看到雪是不寻常的。

unveil.example: The company will unveil its new phone at the big event next week.
unveil.exampleZh: 公司将在下周的大型活动上公布其新手机。

unwarranted.example: Their criticism of my work was unwarranted and quite unfair.
unwarranted.exampleZh: 他们对我工作的批评是没有根据的，而且相当不公平。

unwieldy.example: This old box is unwieldy and hard to carry up the stairs.
unwieldy.exampleZh: 这个旧箱子很笨重，很难搬上楼梯。

unwilling.example: She was unwilling to answer my question in front of everyone.
unwilling.exampleZh: 她不愿意在大家面前回答我的问题。

up.example: Please stand up and put your books on the desk now.
up.exampleZh: 请站起来，现在把你的书放在桌子上。

up-to-date.example: Our new computer system is up-to-date and easy to use.
up-to-date.exampleZh: 我们的新电脑系统是最新的，而且易于使用。

upcoming.example: We are excited about the upcoming school trip next week.
upcoming.exampleZh: 我们对下周即将到来的学校旅行感到兴奋。

update.example: Please update your address in the system before you order the new book.
update.exampleZh: 请在你订购这本新书之前更新你在系统中的地址。

upgrade.example: We plan to upgrade our old computer next week before the new project starts.
upgrade.exampleZh: 我们计划下周在新项目开始前升级我们的旧电脑。

upheld.example: The court upheld the old law after a long and careful review.
upheld.exampleZh: 经过漫长而仔细的审查，法院维持了这项旧法律。

uphold.example: We must uphold the rules and treat everyone in a fair way.
uphold.exampleZh: 我们必须维护规则，公平对待每一个人。

upon.example: Upon arriving home, she put her bag on the table and sat down.
upon.exampleZh: 一到家，她就把包放在桌上然后坐了下来。

upper.example: The upper shelf is too high for the child to reach.
upper.exampleZh: 上面的架子太高，孩子够不着。

upright.example: She stood upright and spoke to the class with a calm voice.
upright.exampleZh: 她站得笔直，用平静的声音对全班讲话。

uprising.example: The people started an uprising against the cruel king and his army.
uprising.exampleZh: 人民发动起义，反抗残暴的国王和他的军队。

uproar.example: The sudden uproar in the hall made everyone stop and look around.
uproar.exampleZh: 大厅里突然的骚动让每个人都停下来四处张望。

upset.example: The bad news upset her, but she stayed calm and finished her work.
upset.exampleZh: 这个坏消息让她心烦，但她保持冷静并完成了工作。

upstairs.example: My sister is upstairs in her room and she is reading a book.
upstairs.exampleZh: 我姐姐在楼上的房间里看书。

upstream.example: The small boat moved slowly upstream against the strong river current.
upstream.exampleZh: 小船顶着强劲的河水慢慢向上游移动。

upward.example: The upward path to the hill is steep but safe.
upward.exampleZh: 通往山丘的上坡路很陡，但很安全。

urban.example: More people are moving to urban areas to find better jobs and schools.
urban.exampleZh: 更多人搬到城市地区寻找更好的工作和学校。

urge.example: I urge you to drink more water every day after lunch.
urge.exampleZh: 我敦促你每天午饭后多喝水。

urgent.example: We need urgent help with this problem before the meeting starts today.
urgent.exampleZh: 我们需要在今天会议开始前紧急处理这个问题。

us.example: Please come with us to the park after school today.
us.exampleZh: 请今天放学后和我们一起去公园。

use.example: You can use this simple tool to fix the chair.
use.exampleZh: 你可以用这个简单的工具来修椅子。

used.example: This used book is still in good condition and costs very little.
used.exampleZh: 这本旧书仍然保存得很好，而且价格很便宜。

useful.example: This small book is very useful for learning English every day.
useful.exampleZh: 这本小书对每天学习英语非常有用。

usual.example: We met at the usual place after school on Friday.
usual.exampleZh: 我们周五放学后在通常的地方见面。

utilitarian.example: The design is utilitarian rather than beautiful, but it works very well.
utilitarian.exampleZh: 这个设计偏实用而非美观，但用起来非常好。

utility.example: The utility of this simple tool is easy to see.
utility.exampleZh: 这个简单工具的效用很容易看出来。

utilize.example: We can utilize the empty room to store our old books and toys.
utilize.exampleZh: 我们可以利用这个空房间来存放旧书和玩具。

utmost.example: She tried her utmost to finish the work on time.
utmost.exampleZh: 她竭尽全力按时完成工作。

utopia.example: Many people dream of a peaceful utopia where everyone lives without fear.
utopia.exampleZh: 许多人梦想一个和平的乌托邦，在那里每个人都能免于恐惧地生活。

utter.example: She was too afraid to utter a single word during the meeting.
utter.exampleZh: 她在会议上太害怕了，一句话也没说。

vacancy.example: There is a vacancy for a new teacher at our school this year.
vacancy.exampleZh: 我们学校今年有一个新教师的空缺职位。

vacant.example: The old house on our street has been vacant for many years.
vacant.exampleZh: 我们街上的那栋老房子已经空置很多年了。

vacate.example: We must vacate the apartment before the new tenants arrive next week.
vacate.exampleZh: 我们必须在新租客下周到来之前搬出这套公寓。

vacation.example: I will take a long vacation with my family next month.
vacation.exampleZh: 下个月我将和我的家人一起度长假。

vacuum.example: The machine uses a vacuum to lift the heavy boxes safely.
vacuum.exampleZh: 这台机器利用真空来安全地抬起沉重的箱子。

vague.example: His answer was vague and did not help us at all.
vague.exampleZh: 他的回答很含糊，一点也没帮到我们。

vain.example: All our efforts to save the old tree were in vain.
vain.exampleZh: 我们为拯救那棵老树所做的一切努力都是徒劳的。

valid.example: Your ticket is still valid for the whole day.
valid.exampleZh: 你的票一整天内仍然有效。

validate.example: The engineer will validate the new design before we start production.
validate.exampleZh: 工程师会在我们开始生产前验证这个新设计。

validity.example: The validity of the test results is still in question.
validity.exampleZh: 测试结果的有效性仍然存疑。

valley.example: The river runs through the green valley and past many small farms.
valley.exampleZh: 这条河流穿过绿色的山谷，经过许多小农场。

value.example: She values her family more than money or success.
value.exampleZh: 她重视家庭胜过金钱和成功。

valve.example: The plumber closed the valve to stop the water leak.
valve.exampleZh: 水管工关上了阀门，以止住漏水。

vanish.example: The old houses will vanish when the new road comes through town.
vanish.exampleZh: 当新路穿过小镇时，那些老房子将会消失。

vanity.example: His vanity made him talk about himself all the time.
vanity.exampleZh: 他的虚荣心让他总是谈论自己。

vapor.example: A thin vapor rose from the hot cup of tea.
vapor.exampleZh: 一缕薄薄的蒸汽从热茶杯中升起。

variable.example: The temperature is a variable that changes from day to day.
variable.exampleZh: 温度是一个每天都会变化的变量。

variance.example: There is a small variance between the two test results.
variance.exampleZh: 两次测试结果之间存在很小的差异。

variation.example: There is a small variation in the temperature from day to day.
variation.exampleZh: 每天的温度有一点小变化。

variety.example: The store sells a wide variety of fresh fruit and vegetables every day.
variety.exampleZh: 这家商店每天出售种类繁多的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

various.example: The store sells various fruits, such as apples, bananas, and oranges.
various.exampleZh: 这家商店出售各种水果，比如苹果、香蕉和橙子。

vary.example: The prices of these fruits vary from season to season.
vary.exampleZh: 这些水果的价格因季节而异。

vast.example: The vast ocean stretches far beyond what we can see from here.
vast.exampleZh: 广阔的大海延伸到我们从这里看不到的远方。

vector.example: The scientist used a vector to carry the gene into the cell.
vector.exampleZh: 科学家使用载体将基因带入细胞。

vehicle.example: The vehicle stopped in front of the school and the children got on.
vehicle.exampleZh: 那辆车停在学校前面，孩子们上了车。

veil.example: She wore a white veil on her wedding day.
veil.exampleZh: 她在婚礼那天戴着白色面纱。

vein.example: The doctor put a thin needle into the vein in his arm.
vein.exampleZh: 医生把一根细针扎进了他手臂上的静脉。

velocity.example: The car moved with great velocity down the long straight road.
velocity.exampleZh: 汽车以极快的速度沿着长长的直路行驶。

velvet.example: The soft velvet dress feels warm and smooth on my skin.
velvet.exampleZh: 这件柔软的天鹅绒连衣裙穿在皮肤上又暖又滑。

vendor.example: The vendor sells fresh fruit and vegetables at the market every morning.
vendor.exampleZh: 这个小贩每天早上在市场卖新鲜水果和蔬菜。

vengeance.example: He wanted vengeance for his brother, but his friends asked him to forgive.
vengeance.exampleZh: 他想为兄弟报仇，但朋友们劝他宽恕。

venom.example: The snake's venom can be very dangerous to small animals and people.
venom.exampleZh: 蛇的毒液对小型动物和人可能非常危险。

venture.example: They decided to venture into a new business despite the risks.
venture.exampleZh: 尽管有风险，他们还是决定冒险进入一个新行业。

verb.example: In this sentence the verb comes after the subject and before the object.
verb.exampleZh: 在这个句子中，动词位于主语之后、宾语之前。

verbal.example: Her verbal skills help her speak clearly in every meeting.
verbal.exampleZh: 她的言语能力帮助她在每次会议上都表达清楚。

verdict.example: The jury reached a verdict after two hours of careful discussion.
verdict.exampleZh: 陪审团经过两小时的仔细讨论后作出了裁决。

verge.example: The company is on the verge of a big change this year.
verge.exampleZh: 这家公司今年正处于重大变革的边缘。

verify.example: Please verify your email address before you log in to the new account.
verify.exampleZh: 请在登录新账户之前核实你的电子邮箱地址。

veritable.example: The small library was a veritable treasure chest for curious young readers.
veritable.exampleZh: 这个小图书馆对好奇的年轻读者来说是一个名副其实的宝库。

vernacular.example: The old stories were written in the vernacular so everyone could understand them.
vernacular.exampleZh: 这些古老的故事是用白话写的，所以每个人都能看懂。

versatile.example: She is a versatile worker who can handle many different tasks.
versatile.exampleZh: 她是一名多才多艺的员工，能处理许多不同的任务。

verse.example: He read a short verse from the old poem to the class.
verse.exampleZh: 他给全班读了那首旧诗里的一小段诗句。

version.example: This is the newest version of the app on my phone.
version.exampleZh: 这是我手机上最新版本的这个应用。

versus.example: The new plan is better versus the old one in many ways.
versus.exampleZh: 新计划在许多方面比旧计划更好。

vertical.example: The flag hangs from a vertical pole in front of the school.
vertical.exampleZh: 那面旗子挂在学校前面的一根垂直旗杆上。

very.example: This soup is very hot, so please wait a minute before you eat it.
very.exampleZh: 这汤很烫，所以请等一分钟再喝。

vessel.example: The doctor said a small blood vessel in his eye burst yesterday.
vessel.exampleZh: 医生说昨天他眼睛里的一根小血管破了。

veteran.example: The veteran soldier told us a simple story about his long journey home.
veteran.exampleZh: 这位老兵给我们讲了一个关于他漫长回家之路的简单故事。

via.example: We drove to the beach via a small road through the hills.
via.exampleZh: 我们经由一条穿过山丘的小路开车去了海滩。

viable.example: The plan is viable because we have enough money and time.
viable.exampleZh: 这个计划是可行的，因为我们有足够的钱和时间。

vibrant.example: The vibrant colors of the flowers make the garden look happy and alive.
vibrant.exampleZh: 花朵鲜艳的颜色让花园看起来快乐而充满生机。

vibrate.example: The washing machine begins to vibrate loudly when it spins fast.
vibrate.exampleZh: 洗衣机快速旋转时会开始大声振动。

vice.example: Greed is a dangerous vice that can ruin a good person.
vice.exampleZh: 贪婪是一种危险的恶习，会毁掉一个好人。

vicinity.example: There are several small shops in the vicinity of our school.
vicinity.exampleZh: 我们学校附近有几家小商店。

vicious.example: The vicious dog scared every child in the small park.
vicious.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗吓坏了小公园里的每个孩子。

victim.example: The victim asked the police for help after the accident.
victim.exampleZh: 事故发生后，受害者向警方求助。

victory.example: The team worked hard all year and finally won a great victory.
victory.exampleZh: 这支队伍全年努力拼搏，最终赢得了一场伟大的胜利。

video.example: I watched a short video about making bread at home yesterday afternoon.
video.exampleZh: 昨天下午我看了一个关于在家做面包的短视频。

view.example: From the top of the hill, you get a clear view of the city.
view.exampleZh: 从山顶上，你可以清楚地看到整座城市。

vigilant.example: The guard stayed vigilant all night and watched the gate carefully.
vigilant.exampleZh: 守卫整夜保持警惕，仔细看守着大门。

vigor.example: After a good night's sleep, she returned to work with renewed vigor.
vigor.exampleZh: 睡了一夜好觉后，她重新充满活力地回到工作岗位。

vile.example: He said vile things to her, and everyone was very angry.
vile.exampleZh: 他对她说了恶劣的话，大家都很生气。

village.example: My grandmother lives in a small village near the river.
village.exampleZh: 我的祖母住在河边的一个小村庄里。

villain.example: The villain in the story tries to steal the king's gold.
villain.exampleZh: 故事里的反派试图偷走国王的金子。

vinegar.example: A little vinegar makes the soup taste fresh and bright.
vinegar.exampleZh: 加一点醋能让汤的味道清新爽口。

violate.example: People who violate the law may face serious punishment from the court.
violate.exampleZh: 违反法律的人可能会受到法院的严厉惩罚。

violence.example: The school teaches students that violence is never a good way to solve problems.
violence.exampleZh: 学校教导学生，暴力绝不是解决问题的好方法。

violent.example: The violent storm broke many trees and blocked the small road.
violent.exampleZh: 猛烈的暴风雨折断了许多树木，堵住了那条小路。

violet.example: She wore a violet dress and carried a small bunch of violets to the party.
violet.exampleZh: 她穿了一条紫色连衣裙，带着一小束紫罗兰去参加聚会。

violin.example: My sister plays the violin every day after school in the living room.
violin.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天放学后在客厅拉小提琴。

virtual.example: This virtual meeting feels almost like a real conversation with friends.
virtual.exampleZh: 这个虚拟会议感觉几乎像和朋友的真正交谈。

virtue.example: Honesty is a virtue that everyone should try to practice every day.
virtue.exampleZh: 诚实是一种每个人都应努力每天践行的美德。

virus.example: A virus can make you sick, so wash your hands often.
virus.exampleZh: 病毒会让你生病，所以要经常洗手。

visible.example: The small sign is visible from the road on clear days.
visible.exampleZh: 那块小牌子在晴天从路上可以看到。

vision.example: His vision is very poor, so he wears glasses every day.
vision.exampleZh: 他的视力很差，所以他每天戴眼镜。

visual.example: The visual effects in that movie look very real and exciting.
visual.exampleZh: 那部电影里的视觉效果看起来非常真实且令人兴奋。

vital.example: Clean water is vital for the health of every child.
vital.exampleZh: 清洁的水对每个孩子的健康至关重要。

vitamin.example: Oranges are a good source of vitamin C.
vitamin.exampleZh: 橙子是维生素C的良好来源。

vivid.example: Her vivid description made the old town feel real to everyone.
vivid.exampleZh: 她生动的描述让每个人都觉得那座老城真实无比。

vocabulary.example: Reading every day helps you build a larger vocabulary over time.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 每天阅读能帮助你随着时间积累更大的词汇量。

vocal.example: She is very vocal about her opinions at every meeting.
vocal.exampleZh: 她在每次会议上都直言不讳地表达自己的意见。

vocation.example: Teaching is not just a job for her but a true vocation.
vocation.exampleZh: 对她来说，教书不仅是一份工作，更是一种真正的使命。

voice.example: She used her voice to speak up for the children in her class.
voice.exampleZh: 她用自己的声音为班里的孩子们发声。

void.example: The empty room felt like a dark void after she left.
void.exampleZh: 她离开后，空荡荡的房间就像一个黑暗的空洞。

volatile.example: The weather here is volatile, so bring a coat and an umbrella.
volatile.exampleZh: 这里的天气很不稳定，所以带上一件外套和一把伞。

volcano.example: The old volcano is quiet now, but people still watch it closely.
volcano.exampleZh: 这座古老的火山现在很安静，但人们仍然密切观察着它。

volume.example: Please turn down the volume because the music is too loud for me.
volume.exampleZh: 请把音量调低，因为音乐对我来说太吵了。

voluntary.example: She does voluntary work at the local animal shelter every Saturday morning.
voluntary.exampleZh: 她每周六上午在当地动物收容所做志愿工作。

volunteer.example: She decided to volunteer at the local animal shelter every Saturday morning.
volunteer.exampleZh: 她决定每周六上午在当地动物收容所做志愿者。

vomit.example: The sick child began to vomit after eating too much candy.
vomit.exampleZh: 那个生病的孩子吃了太多糖果后开始呕吐。

vote.example: Every adult in our town can vote in the local election this year.
vote.exampleZh: 我们镇上的每位成年人都能在今年的地方选举中投票。

vouch.example: I can vouch for his honesty because I have known him for years.
vouch.exampleZh: 我可以为他的诚实担保，因为我认识他多年了。

voyage.example: They made a long voyage across the sea last summer.
voyage.exampleZh: 去年夏天他们进行了一次穿越海洋的漫长航行。

wade.example: We had to wade through the shallow river to reach the other side.
wade.exampleZh: 我们不得不涉水穿过浅河到达对岸。

wafer.example: She ate a thin chocolate wafer with her tea after lunch.
wafer.exampleZh: 她午饭后喝茶时吃了一块薄薄的巧克力威化饼。

wag.example: The dog will wag its tail when it sees its owner.
wag.exampleZh: 狗看到主人时会摇尾巴。

wage.example: The company pays a fair wage to every worker each month.
wage.exampleZh: 公司每个月给每位工人支付公平的工资。

wait.example: Please wait here for a few minutes while I call your mother.
wait.exampleZh: 请在这里等几分钟，我给你的母亲打个电话。

wake.example: I usually wake up early and drink a glass of water.

walk.example: I walk to school with my sister every morning before eight.
walk.exampleZh: 我每天早上八点前和妹妹一起步行去学校。

wall.example: The old wall around the garden keeps the cold wind away.
wall.exampleZh: 花园周围的老墙挡住了冷风。

wander.example: We like to wander through the old streets on quiet Sunday mornings.
wander.exampleZh: 我们喜欢在安静的周日早晨漫步穿过老街。

wane.example: As the night went on, the moon began to wane slowly.
wane.exampleZh: 随着夜色渐深，月亮开始慢慢亏缺。

want.example: I want to buy some fresh fruit for my family today.
want.exampleZh: 我今天想给家人买一些新鲜水果。

war.example: The country tried hard to avoid war but failed in the end.
war.exampleZh: 这个国家努力避免战争，但最终失败了。

ward.example: The nurse walked into the ward to check on the patients.
ward.exampleZh: 护士走进病房查看病人。

warden.example: The warden unlocked the prison gate and let the visitors enter.
warden.exampleZh: 典狱长打开监狱大门，让探视者进去。

warehouse.example: The workers moved all the boxes into the warehouse before noon.
warehouse.exampleZh: 工人们在中午前把所有箱子搬进了仓库。

warfare.example: The country spent many years trying to end the long and terrible warfare.
warfare.exampleZh: 这个国家花了很多年试图结束这场漫长而可怕的战争。

warm.example: The warm sun made the children happy on a cold winter morning.
warm.exampleZh: 在一个寒冷的冬日早晨，温暖的阳光让孩子们很开心。

warn.example: I warn you that the road is very dangerous after dark.
warn.exampleZh: 我警告你，天黑后这条路非常危险。

warrant.example: The police got a warrant to search the old house.
warrant.exampleZh: 警察拿到了搜查那座老房子的授权令。

warranty.example: The store gave me a one-year warranty for the new computer.
warranty.exampleZh: 商店给了我这台新电脑一年的保修单。

wary.example: She is wary of strangers when she walks home late at night.
wary.exampleZh: 她深夜步行回家时对陌生人保持警惕。

wash.example: I need to wash these dirty clothes before we go out tonight.
wash.exampleZh: 今晚出门前我需要把这些脏衣服洗了。

waste.example: We should not waste water because clean water is very important to everyone.
waste.exampleZh: 我们不应该浪费水，因为干净的水对每个人都非常重要。

watch.example: I like to watch the birds in the park on Sundays.
watch.exampleZh: 我喜欢星期天在公园里观鸟。

water.example: Please water the flowers in the garden before the sun goes down.
water.exampleZh: 请在太阳下山前给花园里的花浇水。

watt.example: This small lamp uses only five watts of power when it is on.
watt.exampleZh: 这盏小灯亮着时只使用五瓦电。

wave.example: The wave hit the small boat and made it rock.
wave.exampleZh: 波浪拍打着小船，使它摇晃起来。

waver.example: She did not waver when the difficult choice had to be made.
waver.exampleZh: 当必须做出艰难选择时，她没有动摇。

wax.example: The moon will wax until it is full and bright.
wax.exampleZh: 月亮会渐渐变圆，直到又圆又亮。

way.example: I do not know the way to the train station from here.
way.exampleZh: 我不知道从这里去火车站的路。

we.example: We go to the park every day after school.
we.exampleZh: 我们每天放学后都去公园。

weak.example: After the long illness, he felt very weak and could not walk far.
weak.exampleZh: 久病之后，他感到很虚弱，走不了多远。

wealth.example: His great wealth did not bring him true happiness in life.
wealth.exampleZh: 他的巨额财富并没有给他带来真正的幸福。

weapon.example: The police found a weapon hidden under the old wooden floor.
weapon.exampleZh: 警方发现了一件藏在旧木地板下的武器。

wear.example: I wear a warm coat when the weather is cold.
wear.exampleZh: 天气冷的时候我会穿一件暖和的外套。

weary.example: After the long trip, the weary children fell asleep quickly.
weary.exampleZh: 长途旅行后，疲倦的孩子们很快就睡着了。

weather.example: The weather is warm and sunny today, so we can go outside.
weather.exampleZh: 今天天气温暖晴朗，所以我们可以去外面。

weave.example: She will weave the colorful threads into a warm winter scarf for her mother.
weave.exampleZh: 她将把这些彩色的线织成一条温暖的冬围巾送给她的母亲。

web.example: The spider made a small web between the two old trees.
web.exampleZh: 蜘蛛在两棵老树之间结了一张小网。

wedding.example: My sister is planning her wedding for next month in a small garden.
wedding.exampleZh: 我姐姐正在计划下个月在一个小花园里举行她的婚礼。

wedge.example: He used a wooden wedge to keep the door open.
wedge.exampleZh: 他用一块木楔让门开着。

weed.example: The gardener pulled every weed out of the flower bed this morning.
weed.exampleZh: 园丁今天早上把花坛里的每一株杂草都拔掉了。

week.example: I will visit my grandparents next week and stay for two days.
week.exampleZh: 下周我会去看望我的祖父母，并住两天。

weigh.example: Please weigh the apples before you put them in the bag.
weigh.exampleZh: 请你在把苹果放进袋子前先称一下。

weight.example: The box has a weight that is too heavy for me to carry.
weight.exampleZh: 这个箱子的重量太重了，我搬不动。

weird.example: It is weird that my cat sleeps in the kitchen sink every night.
weird.exampleZh: 我的猫每天晚上睡在厨房水槽里，这很奇怪。

welcome.example: You are always welcome to visit our home for dinner.
welcome.exampleZh: 你随时欢迎来我们家吃晚饭。

welfare.example: The government should protect the welfare of children and old people.
welfare.exampleZh: 政府应该保护儿童和老人的福利。

well.example: She speaks English very well and her brother is well too.
well.exampleZh: 她英语说得很好，她哥哥身体也很好。

west.example: The sun sets in the west and the sky turns orange.
west.exampleZh: 太阳从西方落下，天空变成橙色。

wet.example: The grass is wet after the rain, so we cannot play outside today.
wet.exampleZh: 雨后草地是湿的，所以我们今天不能在外面玩。

whale.example: The blue whale is the largest animal that lives in the sea.
whale.exampleZh: 蓝鲸是生活在海洋中的最大的动物。

wharf.example: The small boat waited at the old wharf until the tide came in.
wharf.exampleZh: 小船在旧码头等待，直到潮水涨起来。

what.example: What do you want to eat for lunch today with us?
what.exampleZh: 你今天想和我们一起吃什么午餐？

wheat.example: Farmers grow wheat in the fields and sell it at the market.
wheat.exampleZh: 农民在田里种小麦，并把它卖到市场上。

wheel.example: The front wheel of my bicycle is flat and needs some air.
wheel.exampleZh: 我自行车的前轮瘪了，需要打点气。

when.example: I was reading a book when my friend called me yesterday.
when.exampleZh: 昨天我朋友打电话给我时，我正在看书。

where.example: I know where you live and I can find your house.
where.exampleZh: 我知道你住在哪里，而且我能找到你的房子。

whereas.example: I like tea, whereas my brother likes coffee.
whereas.exampleZh: 我喜欢茶，而我弟弟喜欢咖啡。

whereby.example: They made a simple plan whereby everyone could share the work fairly.
whereby.exampleZh: 他们制定了一个简单的计划，借此每个人都能公平地分担工作。

wherein.example: This is the room wherein we keep all our old books.
wherein.exampleZh: 这就是我们存放所有旧书的房间。

whether.example: I don't know whether he will come to the party today.
whether.exampleZh: 我不知道他今天是否会来参加聚会。

which.example: Which of these two books do you want to read first?
which.exampleZh: 这两本书中你想先读哪一本？

while.example: I read a book while she cooked dinner for us.
while.exampleZh: 她为我们做晚饭时，我在看书。

whip.example: The farmer used a whip to guide his sheep across the field.
whip.exampleZh: 农夫用鞭子引导他的羊穿过田野。

whirl.example: The dancers whirl around the room until they feel dizzy and laugh.
whirl.exampleZh: 舞者们在房间里旋转，直到感到头晕并笑起来。

whisper.example: She leaned close to whisper a secret in my ear.
whisper.exampleZh: 她凑近我耳边低声说了一个秘密。

whistle.example: The teacher blew her whistle and all the children stopped running.
whistle.exampleZh: 老师吹了哨子，所有孩子都停止了奔跑。

white.example: She wore a white dress and carried a small bag to the party.
white.exampleZh: 她穿了一条白色连衣裙，带着一个小包去参加聚会。

who.example: I know a man who can fix your old bike easily.
who.exampleZh: 我认识一个能轻松修好你那辆旧自行车的人。

whole.example: The whole class went to the museum together after lunch.
whole.exampleZh: 午饭后全班一起去了博物馆。

wholesale.example: They buy goods at wholesale prices and sell them in small shops.
wholesale.exampleZh: 他们以批发价购买商品，然后在小商店里出售。

wholly.example: I wholly agree with your simple plan for the weekend.
wholly.exampleZh: 我完全同意你关于周末的简单计划。

whom.example: The teacher whom we met yesterday was very kind to us.
whom.exampleZh: 我们昨天见到的那位老师对我们非常友善。

whose.example: I have a friend whose father works in a big hospital.
whose.exampleZh: 我有一个朋友，他的父亲在一家大医院工作。

why.example: I do not know why he left the party so early.
why.exampleZh: 我不知道他为什么这么早离开聚会。

wicked.example: That wicked boy played a mean trick on his little sister.
wicked.exampleZh: 那个淘气的男孩对他妹妹玩了一个卑鄙的把戏。

wide.example: The river is very wide, so we cannot swim across it today.
wide.exampleZh: 这条河非常宽，所以我们今天无法游过去。

widespread.example: The use of smartphones is widespread among young people today.
widespread.exampleZh: 如今，智能手机的使用在年轻人中很普遍。

width.example: The width of the table is one meter, so it fits here.
width.exampleZh: 这张桌子的宽度是一米，所以它能放在这里。

wife.example: My wife and I go to the park every Sunday morning.
wife.exampleZh: 我和妻子每个星期天早上都去公园。

wild.example: We saw a wild deer running through the tall grass.
wild.exampleZh: 我们看到一只野生鹿在高草中奔跑。

will.example: I will help you with your homework after dinner.
will.exampleZh: 晚饭后我会帮你做作业。

willing.example: She is always willing to help her friends with their homework.
willing.exampleZh: 她总是乐意帮助朋友们做作业。

win.example: Our team played hard and we hope to win the final game.
win.exampleZh: 我们队打得很努力，我们希望赢得最后一场比赛。

wind.example: The cold wind blew through the trees all night long.

window.example: She opened the window to let in some fresh air.
window.exampleZh: 她打开窗户让一些新鲜空气进来。

wine.example: My father likes to drink a glass of red wine with dinner.
wine.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢晚餐时喝一杯红葡萄酒。

wing.example: The bird hurt its wing and could not fly for a few days.
wing.exampleZh: 这只鸟伤了翅膀，好几天都不能飞。

wink.example: He winked at me and then walked out of the room.
wink.exampleZh: 他朝我眨了下眼，然后走出了房间。

winner.example: The winner of the race smiled and thanked everyone for their support.
winner.exampleZh: 比赛的获胜者微笑着感谢大家的支持。

winter.example: I wear a warm coat in winter because the weather is very cold.
winter.exampleZh: 冬天我穿暖和的外套，因为天气很冷。

wipe.example: Please wipe the table with a clean cloth before we eat dinner.
wipe.exampleZh: 请在我们吃晚饭前用一块干净的布把桌子擦干净。

wire.example: The worker used a thin wire to fix the broken fence.
wire.exampleZh: 工人用一根细金属丝修好了破损的栅栏。

wisdom.example: His words of wisdom helped me make a better choice today.
wisdom.exampleZh: 他充满智慧的话帮助我今天做出了更好的选择。

wise.example: It is wise to ask for help when you do not know the answer.
wise.exampleZh: 当你不知道答案时，寻求帮助是明智的。

wish.example: I wish you good luck with your new job.
wish.exampleZh: 我祝你在新工作中好运。

wit.example: Her quick wit made everyone laugh during the long meeting.
wit.exampleZh: 她机智风趣，让每个人在漫长的会议中都笑了。

with.example: I went to the park with my best friend after school today.
with.exampleZh: 今天放学后我和我最好的朋友一起去了公园。

withdraw.example: They decided to withdraw their money from the bank before the holiday.
withdraw.exampleZh: 他们决定在假期前从银行取出他们的钱。

wither.example: Without water, the beautiful flowers in the garden will wither and die.
wither.exampleZh: 如果没有水，花园里美丽的花会枯萎死去。

withhold.example: The company may withhold your pay until you finish the report.
withhold.exampleZh: 公司可能会扣留你的工资，直到你完成报告。

within.example: Please finish the report within three days and send it to me.
within.exampleZh: 请在三天内完成报告并发送给我。

without.example: We cannot finish the work without your help today.
without.exampleZh: 今天没有你的帮助，我们无法完成这项工作。

withstand.example: These strong walls can withstand high winds and heavy rain.
withstand.exampleZh: 这些坚固的墙能经受强风和暴雨。

witness.example: She was a witness to the accident and told the police what happened.
witness.exampleZh: 她是那起事故的目击者，并告诉了警察所发生的事。

wolf.example: The hungry wolf ran through the dark forest looking for food.
wolf.exampleZh: 那只饥饿的狼穿过黑暗的森林寻找食物。

woman.example: The woman works in a small shop near my house.
woman.exampleZh: 这位妇女在我家附近的一家小商店工作。

wonder.example: I wonder what the little boy is doing in the garden now.
wonder.exampleZh: 我想知道那个小男孩现在在花园里做什么。

wood.example: The old table is made of wood and it looks very strong.
wood.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子是用木头做的，看起来很结实。

wool.example: My grandmother made a warm scarf from soft wool for me.
wool.exampleZh: 我奶奶用柔软的羊毛给我做了一条温暖的围巾。

word.example: I do not know the meaning of this new word.
word.exampleZh: 我不知道这个新单词的意思。

work.example: I have a lot of work to do before I can go home.
work.exampleZh: 我回家前有很多工作要做。

workshop.example: Our teacher will hold a small writing workshop in the school library tomorrow.
workshop.exampleZh: 我们的老师明天将在学校图书馆举办一个小型写作研讨会。

world.example: She wants to travel around the world after she finishes school.
world.exampleZh: 她想在完成学业后环游世界。

worldwide.example: The company has fans worldwide who love its simple and useful products.
worldwide.exampleZh: 这家公司在全世界都有喜欢它简单实用产品的粉丝。

worm.example: The early bird catches the worm before the sun comes up.
worm.exampleZh: 早起的鸟儿在太阳升起前就捉到虫子。

worry.example: I worry about my exams, but my friends say I will do well.
worry.exampleZh: 我担心考试，但朋友们说我会考得好。

worse.example: The weather is worse today, so we should stay at home.
worse.exampleZh: 今天天气更糟，所以我们应该待在家里。

worship.example: Many people worship in this old church every Sunday morning.
worship.exampleZh: 许多人每个星期天早上在这座古老的教堂里做礼拜。

worst.example: This is the worst movie I have ever seen in my life.
worst.exampleZh: 这是我一生中看过的最差的一部电影。

worth.example: This old book is worth more than you might think.
worth.exampleZh: 这本旧书比你想象的更有价值。

worthwhile.example: It is worthwhile to spend time with your family every day.
worthwhile.exampleZh: 每天花时间陪伴家人是值得的。

worthy.example: She is worthy of our respect because she always helps others.
worthy.exampleZh: 她值得我们尊敬，因为她总是帮助别人。

would.example: I would help you if I had more time today.
would.exampleZh: 如果今天我有更多时间，我会帮助你。

wound.example: The doctor cleaned the wound and told him to rest for a few days.
wound.exampleZh: 医生清洗了伤口，并让他休息几天。

wrap.example: She will wrap the gift in colorful paper before the party starts.
wrap.exampleZh: 她会在聚会开始前用彩色纸把礼物包起来。

wreck.example: The storm left a wreck on the beach near our small town.
wreck.exampleZh: 暴风雨在我们小镇附近的海滩上留下了一艘失事船只。

wrestle.example: The two boys began to wrestle on the grass after school.
wrestle.exampleZh: 放学后两个男孩开始在草地上摔跤。

wretched.example: The wretched man had no home and no food to eat.
wretched.exampleZh: 那个可怜的人没有家，也没有食物吃。

wrinkle.example: She has a small wrinkle near her left eye when she smiles.
wrinkle.exampleZh: 她笑的时候左眼附近有一条小皱纹。

wrist.example: She hurt her wrist when she fell off her bike yesterday afternoon.
wrist.exampleZh: 她昨天下午从自行车上摔下来时伤到了手腕。

write.example: I will write a short letter to my best friend today.
write.exampleZh: 我今天会给最好的朋友写一封短信。

writing.example: Her writing is clear and easy to read.
writing.exampleZh: 她的字迹清晰，容易阅读。

wrong.example: It is wrong to blame him for a mistake he did not make.
wrong.exampleZh: 把不是他犯的错误归咎于他是错误的。

x-ray.example: The doctor used an x-ray to check my broken arm.
x-ray.exampleZh: 医生用X光检查了我受伤的手臂。

xenon.example: Xenon is a heavy gas that is used in some bright lamps.
xenon.exampleZh: 氙是一种重气体，用于一些明亮的灯中。

xenophobia.example: Xenophobia can make people treat newcomers unfairly and keep them apart.
xenophobia.exampleZh: 排外心理会使人们不公平地对待新来者，并使他们被孤立。

xerography.example: Modern offices still use xerography to make many copies of documents quickly.
xerography.exampleZh: 现代办公室仍然使用静电复印术快速制作许多文件副本。

xerox.example: Please xerox this page and put the copy on my desk.
xerox.exampleZh: 请复印这一页，并把复印件放在我桌上。

xylem.example: Water moves through the xylem from the roots to the leaves.
xylem.exampleZh: 水通过木质部从根部输送到叶子。

xylophone.example: She played a happy tune on the xylophone at the school concert.
xylophone.exampleZh: 她在学校音乐会上用木琴演奏了一首欢快的曲子。

yacht.example: They rented a small yacht for a trip along the coast.
yacht.exampleZh: 他们租了一艘小游艇，沿着海岸旅行。

yak.example: The yak walked slowly across the cold mountain road while carrying heavy bags.
yak.exampleZh: 牦牛背着沉重的袋子，缓慢地走过寒冷的山路。

yard.example: The children are playing in the yard with a small red ball.
yard.exampleZh: 孩子们正在院子里玩一个小红球。

yawn.example: The long meeting made me yawn three times before it finally ended.
yawn.exampleZh: 漫长的会议让我在结束前打了三次哈欠。

year.example: I will start a new job next year and work hard every day.
year.exampleZh: 我明年将开始一份新工作，并且每天努力工作。

yearn.example: Many people yearn for a quiet life in the countryside.
yearn.exampleZh: 许多人渴望乡村里安静的生活。

yeast.example: The baker added yeast to the dough so the bread would rise.
yeast.exampleZh: 面包师在面团里加入酵母，让面包发酵起来。

yellow.example: She wore a bright yellow dress to the party last night.
yellow.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条亮黄色的裙子去参加聚会。

yes.example: Yes, I will go to the store with you after lunch today.
yes.exampleZh: 好的，我今天午饭後和你一起去商店。

yesterday.example: I saw my old friend yesterday, and we talked for a long time.
yesterday.exampleZh: 我昨天见到了老朋友，我们聊了很久。

yet.example: I am tired, yet I still have much work to do.
yet.exampleZh: 我很累，但我还有很多工作要做。

yield.example: The old farm can yield enough corn for the whole village.
yield.exampleZh: 这座老农场能为整个村子出产足够的玉米。

yoga.example: My sister does yoga every morning before she goes to work.
yoga.exampleZh: 我姐姐每天早上上班前都会做瑜伽。

yogurt.example: I eat yogurt with fresh fruit every morning before I go to work.
yogurt.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都吃酸奶配新鲜水果。

yoke.example: The two countries were yoked together by a shared history and common goals.
yoke.exampleZh: 这两个国家因共同的历史和共同的目标而紧密相连。

yolk.example: The bright yellow yolk of the egg is good for you.
yolk.exampleZh: 鸡蛋鲜黄的蛋黄对你有好处。

you.example: You can sit here and wait for your friend.
you.exampleZh: 你可以坐在这里等你的朋友。

young.example: The young boy likes to play football with his friends after school.
young.exampleZh: 这个年幼的男孩喜欢放学后和朋友们一起踢足球。

your.example: Please put your books on the desk before class starts.
your.exampleZh: 请在开始上课前把你的书放在桌子上。

youth.example: In my youth, I loved playing football with my friends.
youth.exampleZh: 我年轻时喜欢和朋友们一起踢足球。

yuppie.example: My uncle is a yuppie who works hard and enjoys fancy coffee.
yuppie.exampleZh: 我叔叔是个雅皮士，工作努力，还喜欢喝高档咖啡。

zeal.example: Her zeal for the project inspired the whole team to work harder.
zeal.exampleZh: 她对项目的热情激励整个团队更加努力地工作。

zebra.example: The zebra at the zoo has black and white stripes on its body.
zebra.exampleZh: 动物园里的那只斑马身上有黑白相间的条纹。

zero.example: The temperature dropped to zero last night.

zest.example: She has a real zest for life and loves trying new things every day.
zest.exampleZh: 她对生活充满真正的热情，喜欢每天尝试新事物。

zigzag.example: The narrow road goes up the hill in a zigzag.
zigzag.exampleZh: 这条窄路呈之字形向山上延伸。

zinc.example: Zinc is a metal that helps our body stay healthy.
zinc.exampleZh: 锌是一种有助于我们身体保持健康的金属。

zone.example: This area is a quiet zone, so please do not make loud noise.
zone.exampleZh: 这个区域是安静区，所以请不要大声喧哗。

zoo.example: We took the children to the zoo to see the pandas.
zoo.exampleZh: 我们带孩子们去动物园看熊猫。

zoology.example: She studies zoology at the university and hopes to work with wild animals.
zoology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习动物学，希望将来从事野生动物相关工作。

zoom.example: The little car zoomed past us on the busy street.
zoom.exampleZh: 那辆小汽车在繁忙的街道上从我们身边疾驰而过。
